headings.arabic: قاعدة جليلة إذا أردت الانتفاع بالقرآن فاجمع قلبك عند تلاوته وسماعه
headings.english: [A] Great Principle: If You Want to Benefit from the Quran, Then Gather Your Heart During Its Recitation and Hearing [It]

segments.arabic: بِسم الله الرَّحْمَن الرَّحِيم
segments.english: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الشَّيْخ مُحي الدّين السنّة قامع الْبِدْعَة أَبُو عبد الله الشهير بِابْن قيّم الجوزيّة ﵀ ورضى عَنهُ
segments.english: The Sheikh, reviver of the religion [and] the Sunnah, suppressor of innovation, Abu Abdullah, known as Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyya — may God have mercy on him and [be] pleased with him — said:

segments.arabic: إِذا أردْت الِانْتِفَاع بِالْقُرْآنِ فاجمع قَلْبك عِنْد تِلَاوَته وسماعه
segments.english: If you want to benefit from the Quran, then gather your heart during its recitation and hearing [it],

segments.arabic: وأَلْقِ سَمعك واحضر حُضُور من يخاطبه بِهِ من تكلّم بِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ مِنْهُ إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and direct your hearing, and be present [with] the presence of one whom the One who spoke it — glorified [is] He — addresses with it, from Him to him.

segments.arabic: فانه خَاطب مِنْهُ لَك على لِسَان رَسُوله
segments.english: For it [is] an address from Him to you upon the tongue of His messenger.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَذِكْرَى لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيد﴾
segments.english: Indeed in that [is] surely [a] reminder for whoever [there] was for him [a] heart, or [he] directed [his] hearing while he [is] [a] witness.
segments.sahih_international: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ أَن تَمام التَّأْثِير لمّا كَانَ مَوْقُوفا على مُؤثر مُقْتَض
segments.english: And that [is] because the completeness of the effect, since it was dependent on [a] necessary effective cause,

segments.arabic: وَمحل قَابل وَشرط لحُصُول الْأَثر وَانْتِفَاء الْمَانِع الَّذِي يمْنَع مِنْهُ
segments.english: and [a] receiving place, and [a] condition for the occurrence of the effect, and the absence of the obstacle that prevents it —

segments.arabic: تضمّنت الْآيَة بَيَان ذَلِك كلّه بأوجز لفظ وأبينه وأدلّه على المُرَاد
segments.english: the verse contained the explanation of all of that in the most concise wording, the clearest of it, and the most indicative of the intended [meaning].

segments.arabic: فَقَوله ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لذكرى﴾ اشار إِلَى مَا تقدّم من أوّل السُّورَة الى هَهُنَا
segments.english: So His saying ﴿Indeed in that [is] surely [a] reminder﴾ pointed to what preceded from the beginning of the surah to here.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا هُوَ المؤثّر
segments.english: And this — it [is] the effective cause.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله ﴿لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ﴾ فَهَذَا هُوَ الْمحل الْقَابِل
segments.english: And His saying ﴿for whoever [there] was for him [a] heart﴾ — so this — it [is] the receiving place.

segments.arabic: وَالْمرَاد بِهِ الْقلب الحيّ الَّذِي يعقل عَن الله
segments.english: And what [is] meant by it [is] the living heart that understands from God,

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: as [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْآنٌ مُبِينٌ﴾
segments.english: It [is] nothing but [a] remembrance and [a] clear Quran,
segments.sahih_international: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an

segments.arabic: ﴿لِيُنْذِرَ مَنْ كَانَ حَيّا﴾
segments.english: to warn whoever was alive.

segments.arabic: أَي حيّ الْقلب
segments.english: Meaning: alive of heart.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله ﴿أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ﴾ أَي وجَّه سَمعه وأصغى حاسّة سَمعه إِلَى مَا يُقَال لَهُ
segments.english: And His saying ﴿or directed [his] hearing﴾ — meaning: he directed his hearing and inclined his sense of hearing to what [is] said to him.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا شَرط التأثّر بالْكلَام
segments.english: And this [is] the condition for being affected by the speech.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله ﴿وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ﴾ أَي شَاهد الْقلب حَاضر غير غَائِب
segments.english: And His saying ﴿while he [is] [a] witness﴾ — meaning: [the] heart [is] witnessing, present, not absent.

segments.arabic: قَالَ ابْن قُتَيْبَة اسْتمع كتاب الله وَهُوَ شَاهد الْقلب والفهم لَيْسَ بغافل وَلَا ساه
segments.english: Ibn Qutaybah said: [He] listened to the Book of God while he [is] present of heart and understanding, not heedless and not inattentive.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ إِشَارَة إِلَى الْمَانِع من حُصُول التَّأْثِير
segments.english: And it [is] [a] reference to the obstacle [preventing] the occurrence of the effect,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سَهْو الْقلب وغيبته عَن تعقّل مَا يُقَال لَهُ وَالنَّظَر فِيهِ وتأمّله
segments.english: and it [is] the heart's neglect and its absence from understanding what [is] said to it, and looking into it, and contemplating it.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا حصل الْمُؤثر وَهُوَ الْقُرْآن وَالْمحل الْقَابِل وَهُوَ الْقلب الْحَيّ
segments.english: So when the effective cause [is] present — and it [is] the Quran — and the receiving place — and it [is] the living heart —

segments.arabic: وَوجد الشَّرْط وَهُوَ الإصغاء وانتفى الْمَانِع
segments.english: and the condition [is] found — and it [is] attentive listening — and the obstacle [is] removed —

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ اشْتِغَال الْقلب وذهوله عَن معنى الْخطاب وانصرافه عَنهُ إِلَى شَيْء آخر
segments.english: and it [is] the heart's distraction and its drifting from the meaning of the address, and its turning away from it to something else —

segments.arabic: حصل الْأَثر وَهُوَ الِانْتِفَاع والتذكّر
segments.english: the effect occurred, and it [is] benefit and remembering.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قيل إِذا كَانَ التَّأْثِير إِنَّمَا يتم بِمَجْمُوع هَذِه فَمَا وَجه دُخُول أَدَاة أَو فِي قَوْله
segments.english: If it [is] said: if the effect [is] only completed by the combination of all these, then what [is] the reason for the use of the particle "or" in His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ﴾
segments.english: "or [he] cast [his] hearing"

segments.arabic: والموضع مَوضِع وَاو الْجمع لَا مَوضِع أَو الَّتِي هِيَ لأحد الشَّيْئَيْنِ
segments.english: when the place [is] [a] place for the "and" of joining, not [a] place for "or" which [is] for one of two things?

segments.arabic: قيل هَذَا سُؤال جيّد وَالْجَوَاب عَنهُ أَن يُقَال
segments.english: It [is] said: this [is] [a] good question, and the answer to it [is] that it [is] said:

segments.arabic: خرج الْكَلَام بِأَو بِاعْتِبَار حَال الْمُخَاطب الْمَدْعُو
segments.english: the speech came with "or" in consideration of the condition of the one addressed [and] called.

segments.arabic: فَإِن من النَّاس من يكون حَيّ الْقلب واعيه تَامّ الْفطْرَة
segments.english: For among people [is he] who has [a] living heart, aware, complete in inborn nature.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا فكَّر بِقَلْبِه وجال بفكره دلّه قلبه وعقله على صحّة الْقُرْآن وَأَنه الْحق
segments.english: So when he reflects with his heart and roams with his thought, his heart and mind guide him to the soundness of the Quran and that it [is] the truth.

segments.arabic: وَشهد قلبه بِمَا أخبر بِهِ الْقُرْآن
segments.english: And his heart testifies to what the Quran informed of.

segments.arabic: فَكَانَ وُرُود الْقُرْآن على قلبه نورا على نور الْفطْرَة
segments.english: So the arrival of the Quran upon his heart was [a] light upon the light of inborn nature.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا وصف الَّذين قيل فيهم
segments.english: And this [is] the description of those about whom it was said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَيَرَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ هُوَ الْحق﴾
segments.english: "And those who were given knowledge see that what was sent down to you from your Lord — it [is] the truth."
segments.sahih_international: And those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, and it guides to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ فِي حقّهم
segments.english: And He said regarding them:

segments.arabic: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ الْمِصْبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍ الزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ
segments.english: "God [is] the light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light [is] like [a] niche in which [there is] [a] lamp. The lamp [is] in [a] glass. The glass [is] as if it [were] [a] shining star,
segments.sahih_international: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp, the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allah guides to His light whom He wills. And Allah presents examples for the people, and Allah is Knowing of all things.

segments.arabic: يُوقَدُ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِيءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ
segments.english: lit from [a] blessed tree — an olive, neither eastern nor western — its oil almost glows even if no fire touched it.

segments.arabic: نُورٌ عَلَى نُورٍ يَهْدِي اللَّهُ لِنُورِهِ مَنْ يَشَاء
segments.english: Light upon light. God guides to His light whom He wills."

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا نور الْفطْرَة على نور الْوَحْي
segments.english: So this [is] the light of inborn nature upon the light of revelation.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا حَال صَاحب الْقلب الْحَيّ الواعي
segments.english: And this [is] the condition of the one with the living, aware heart.

segments.arabic: قَالَ ابْن الْقيم وَقد ذكرنَا مَا تضمّنت هَذِه الْآيَة من الْأَسْرَار والعبر فِي كتاب اجْتِمَاع الجيوش الإسلامية على غَزْو المعطّلة والجهميّة
segments.english: Ibn al-Qayyim said: we have mentioned what this verse contains of secrets and lessons in the book "The Gathering of the Islamic Armies for the Campaign Against the Deniers and the Jahmiyyah."

segments.arabic: فَصَاحب الْقلب يجمع بَين قلبه وَبَين مَعَاني الْقُرْآن فيجدها كَأَنَّهَا قد كتبت فِيهِ
segments.english: So the one with [a] heart gathers between his heart and the meanings of the Quran, and he finds them as if they were written in it.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ يَقْرَأها عَن ظَهْر قَلْب
segments.english: So he reads them by heart.

segments.arabic: وَمن النَّاس من لَا يكون تامَّ الاستعداد واعي الْقلب كَامِل الْحَيَاة
segments.english: And among people [is he] who [is] not complete in readiness, nor aware of heart, nor fully alive.

segments.arabic: فَيحْتَاج إِلَى شَاهد يميّز لَهُ بَين الْحق وَالْبَاطِل
segments.english: So he needs [a] witness to distinguish for him between the truth and falsehood.

segments.arabic: وَلم تبلغ حَيَاة قلبه ونوره وزكاء فطرته مبلغ صَاحب الْقلب الْحَيّ الواعي
segments.english: And the life of his heart, its light, and the purity of his inborn nature have not reached the level of the one with the living, aware heart.

segments.arabic: فطريق حُصُول هدايته أَن يفرغ سَمعه للْكَلَام وَقَلبه لتأمله والتفكير فِيهِ وتعقل مَعَانِيه
segments.english: So the way to gain his guidance [is] that he empties his hearing for the speech, and his heart for reflecting on it, thinking about it, and understanding its meanings.

segments.arabic: فَيعلم حِينَئِذٍ أَنه الْحق
segments.english: Then he knows at that point that it [is] the truth.

segments.arabic: فَالْأول حَال من رأى بِعَيْنِه مَا دعِي إِلَيْهِ وَأخْبر بِهِ
segments.english: So the first [is] the condition of one who saw with his own eye what he was called to and informed about.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي حَال من علم صدق الْمخبر وتيقّنه وَقَالَ يَكْفِينِي خَبره
segments.english: And the second [is] the condition of one who knew the truthfulness of the informer and was certain of it, and said: "His report [is] enough for me."

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ فِي مقَام الْإِيمَان والأوّل فِي مقَام الْإِحْسَان
segments.english: So he [is] in the station of faith, and the first [is] in the station of excellence.

segments.arabic: هَذَا قد وصل إِلَى علم الْيَقِين وترقى قلبه مِنْهُ إِلَى منزلة عين الْيَقِين
segments.english: This one has reached the knowledge of certainty, and his heart rose from it to the level of the eye of certainty.

segments.arabic: وَذَاكَ مَعَه التَّصْدِيق الْجَازِم الَّذِي خرج بِهِ من الْكفْر وَدخل بِهِ فِي الْإِسْلَام
segments.english: And that one has with him the firm belief by which he left disbelief and entered Islam.

segments.arabic: فعين الْيَقِين نَوْعَانِ نوع فِي الدُّنْيَا وَنَوع فِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: So the eye of certainty [is] two types: [a] type in this world, and [a] type in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: فَالْحَاصِل فِي الدُّنْيَا نسبته إِلَى الْقلب كنسبة الشَّاهِد
segments.english: The one attained in this world — its relation to the heart [is] like the relation of the witness

headings.arabic: فصل وقد جمعت هذه السورة من أصول الإيمان ما يكفي ويشفي ويغني عن
headings.english: Section: This surah has gathered from the foundations of faith what suffices, heals, and frees [one] from

segments.arabic: إِلَى الْعين وَمَا أخْبرت بِهِ الرُّسُل من الْغَيْب يعاين فِي الْآخِرَة بالأبصار
segments.english: to the eye. And what the messengers informed of from the unseen [will be] seen in the Hereafter with [the] eyes,

segments.arabic: وَفِي الدُّنْيَا بالبصائر
segments.english: and in this world with [the] inner sight.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ عين يَقِين فِي المرتبتين
segments.english: So it [is] the essence of certainty in both levels.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا تضمّنت تَقْرِير المبدأ والمعاد والتوحيد والنبوّة وَالْإِيمَان بِالْمَلَائِكَةِ
segments.english: For it contained the establishment of the Origin, the Return, monotheism, prophethood, and faith in the angels,

segments.arabic: وانقسام النَّاس إِلَى هَالك شقي وفائز سعيد
segments.english: and the division of people into [a] destroyed, wretched [group] and [a] successful, happy [one],

segments.arabic: وأوصاف هَؤُلَاءِ وَهَؤُلَاء
segments.english: and the descriptions of these and those.

segments.arabic: وتضمّنت إِثْبَات صِفَات الْكَمَال لله وتنزيهه عَمَّا يضاد كمله من النقائص والعيوب
segments.english: And it contained the affirmation of the attributes of perfection for God, and declaring Him far above what contradicts His perfection of flaws and defects.

segments.arabic: وَذكر فِيهَا القيامتين الصُّغْرَى والكبرى
segments.english: And He mentioned in it the two risings: the lesser and the greater,

segments.arabic: وَالْعَالمِينَ الْأَكْبَر وَهُوَ عَالم الْآخِرَة والأصغر وَهُوَ عَالم الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: and the two worlds: the greater — which [is] the world of the Hereafter — and the lesser — which [is] this world.

segments.arabic: وَذكر فِيهَا خلق الْإِنْسَان ووفاته وإعادته
segments.english: And He mentioned in it the creation of man, his death, and his return,

segments.arabic: وحاله عِنْد وَفَاته وَيَوْم معاده
segments.english: and his state at his death and [on] the day of his return,

segments.arabic: وإحاطته سُبْحَانَهُ بِهِ من كل وَجه حَتَّى علمه بوساوس نَفسه
segments.english: and His — glorified [is] He — surrounding him from every side, even His knowledge of the whispers of his self,

segments.arabic: وَإِقَامَة الْحفظَة عَلَيْهِ يُحصونَ عَلَيْهِ كل لَفْظَة يتَكَلَّم بهَا
segments.english: and the appointing of guardians over him, recording against him every word he speaks.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه يوافيه يَوْم الْقِيَامَة وَمَعَهُ سائق يَسُوقهُ إِلَيْهِ وَشَاهد يشْهد عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And that he [will] come on the Day of Resurrection, and with him [is a] driver driving him to Him and [a] witness testifying against him.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أحضرهُ السَّائِق قَالَ
segments.english: So when the driver brings him, he says:

segments.arabic: ﴿هَذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ﴾
segments.english: "This [is] what [is] with me, ready."

segments.arabic: أَي هَذَا الَّذِي أمرت بإحضاره قد أحضرته
segments.english: Meaning: this [is] the one I was commanded to bring — I have brought him.

segments.arabic: فَيُقَال عِنْد إِحْضَاره
segments.english: Then it [is] said upon bringing him:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَلْقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ﴾
segments.english: "Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever!"
segments.sahih_international: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,

segments.arabic: كَمَا يحضر الْجَانِي إِلَى حَضْرَة السُّلْطَان فَيُقَال هَذَا فلَان قد أحضرته
segments.english: Just as [a] criminal [is] brought to the presence of the king, and it [is] said: "This [is] so-and-so, I have brought him,"

segments.arabic: فَيَقُول اذْهَبُوا بِهِ إِلَى السجْن وعاقبوه بِمَا يستحقّه
segments.english: so he says: "Take him to the prison and punish him with what he deserves."

segments.arabic: وتأمّل كَيفَ دلّت السُّورَة صَرِيحًا على أَن الله سُبْحَانَهُ يُعِيد هَذَا الْجَسَد بِعَيْنِه
segments.english: And reflect [on] how the surah indicated clearly that God — glorified [is] He — [will] return this very body,

segments.arabic: الَّذِي أطَاع وَعصى فينعمه ويعذّبه
segments.english: the one that obeyed and disobeyed — so He [will] bless it and punish it,

segments.arabic: كَمَا ينعم الرّوح الَّتِي آمَنت بِعَينهَا ويعذّب الَّتِي كفرت بِعَينهَا
segments.english: just as He [will] bless the very soul that believed and punish the very [one] that disbelieved —

segments.arabic: لَا أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ يخلق روحا أُخْرَى غير هَذِه فينعمها ويعذبها
segments.english: not that He — glorified [is] He — [will] create another soul other than this one, then bless it and punish it,

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَه من لم يعرف الْمعَاد الَّذِي أخْبرت بِهِ الرُّسُل
segments.english: as said by those who did not know the Return that the messengers informed of,

segments.arabic: حَيْثُ زعم أَن الله سُبْحَانَهُ يخلق بدنا غير هَذَا الْبدن من كل وَجه
segments.english: where he claimed that God — glorified [is] He — [will] create [a] body other than this body in every way,

segments.arabic: عَلَيْهِ يَقع النَّعيم وَالْعَذَاب
segments.english: upon which the bliss and the punishment [will] fall.

segments.arabic: وَالروح عِنْده عرض من أَعْرَاض الْبدن
segments.english: And the soul, according to him, [is] an accident among the accidents of the body,

segments.arabic: فيخلق روحا غير هَذِه الرّوح وبدنا غير هَذَا الْبدن
segments.english: so He [would] create [a] soul other than this soul and [a] body other than this body.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا غير مَا اتّفقت عَلَيْهِ الرُّسُل ودلّ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْآن والسنّة وَسَائِر كتب الله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And this [is] other than what the Messengers agreed upon, and what the Quran, the Sunnah, and the rest of the books of God Most High indicated.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا فِي الْحَقِيقَة إِنْكَار للمعاد وموافقة لقَوْل من أنكرهُ من المكذبين
segments.english: And this [is] in reality [a] denial of the Return, and [an] agreement with the statement of those who denied it among the deniers.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُم لم ينكروا قدرَة الله على خلق أجسام أخر غير هَذِه الْأَجْسَام يعذبها وينعمها
segments.english: For they did not deny the ability of God to create other bodies besides these bodies, [to] torment them and bless them.

segments.arabic: كَيفَ وهم يشْهدُونَ النَّوْع الإنساني يخلق شَيْئا بعد شَيْء
segments.english: How [could they], when they witness the human species [being] created one after another?

segments.arabic: فَكل وَقت يخلق الله سُبْحَانَهُ أجسامًا وأرواحًا غير الْأَجْسَام الَّتِي فنيت
segments.english: For every moment God, glorified [is] He, creates bodies and souls other than the bodies that perished.

segments.arabic: فَكيف يتعجّبون من شَيْء يشاهدونه عيَانًا
segments.english: So how [can] they be amazed at something they witness with [their own] eyes?

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا تعجّبوا من عودهم بأعيانهم بعد أَن مزّقهم البلى وصاروا عظاما ورفاتا
segments.english: Rather, they were amazed at their return — themselves — after decay tore them apart and they became bones and remains.

segments.arabic: فتعجّبوا أَن يَكُونُوا هم بأعيانهم مبعوثين للجزاء
segments.english: So they were amazed that they — themselves — [would be] raised for recompense.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا
segments.english: And for this [reason],

segments.arabic: ﴿قَالُوا أئذا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وعظامًا أئنا لمبعوثون﴾
segments.english: They said, 'When we [have] died and become dust and bones, will we indeed be raised?'
segments.sahih_international: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

segments.arabic: وَقَالُوا
segments.english: And they said,

segments.arabic: ﴿ذَلِكَ رَجْعٌ بعيد﴾
segments.english: 'That [is a] far-fetched return.'

segments.arabic: وَلَو كَانَ الْجَزَاء إِنَّمَا هُوَ لأجسام غير هَذِه لم يكن ذَلِك بعثا وَلَا رجعا بل يكون ابْتِدَاء
segments.english: And if the recompense were only for bodies other than these, that would not be [a] raising nor [a] return, but rather [it would be a] beginning.

segments.arabic: وَلم يكن لقَوْله
segments.english: And there would not be for His saying —

segments.arabic: ﴿قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنْقُصُ الأَرْض مِنْهُم﴾
segments.english: 'We already know what the earth takes away from them'
segments.sahih_international: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

segments.arabic: كَبِير معنى
segments.english: — much meaning.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ جعل هَذَا جَوَابا لسؤال مقدّر
segments.english: For He, glorified [is] He, made this [an] answer to [an] implied question,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أنّه يُمَيّز تِلْكَ الْأَجْزَاء الَّتِي اخْتلطت بِالْأَرْضِ واستحالت إِلَى العناصر بِحَيْثُ لَا تتميّز
segments.english: and that [is]: how does He distinguish those parts that mixed with the earth and turned into elements such that they [can] no [longer] be distinguished?

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَنه قد علم مَا تنقصه الأَرْض من لحومهم وعظامهم وأشعارهم
segments.english: So He, glorified [is] He, informed that He already knows what the earth takes away of their flesh, their bones, and their hair.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه كَمَا هُوَ عَالم بِتِلْكَ الْأَجْزَاء فَهُوَ قَادر على تَحْصِيلهَا وَجَمعهَا بعد تفرّقها
segments.english: And that just as He [is] knowing of those parts, He [is] able to obtain them and collect them after their scattering,

segments.arabic: وتأليفها خلقا جَدِيدا
segments.english: and compose them [as a] new creation.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يُقرر الْمعَاد بِذكر كَمَال علمه وَكَمَال قدرته وَكَمَال حكمته
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, establishes the Return by mentioning the completeness of His knowledge, the completeness of His power, and the completeness of His wisdom.

segments.arabic: فَإِن شُبه المنكرين لَهُ كلهَا تعود إِلَى ثَلَاثَة أَنْوَاع
segments.english: For the doubts of the deniers of it all go back to three types.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا اخْتِلَاط أجزائهم بأجزاء الأَرْض على وَجه لَا يتميّز
segments.english: The first [is] the mixing of their parts with the parts of the earth in [a] way that cannot be distinguished,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يحصل مَعهَا تميز شخص عَن شخص
segments.english: and with which one person cannot be told apart from [another] person.

segments.arabic: الثَّانِي أَن الْقُدْرَة لَا تتعلّق بذلك
segments.english: The second [is] that [divine] power does not extend to that.

segments.arabic: الثَّالِث أَن ذَلِك أَمر لَا فَائِدَة فِيهِ
segments.english: The third [is] that this [is a] matter with no benefit in it,

segments.arabic: أَو إِنَّمَا الْحِكْمَة اقْتَضَت دوَام هَذَا النَّوْع الإنساني شَيْئا بعد شَيْء هَكَذَا أبدا
segments.english: or that wisdom only required the continuation of this human species, one after another, like this forever —

segments.arabic: كلما مَاتَ جيل خَلفه جيل آخر
segments.english: whenever [a] generation died, another generation succeeded it.

segments.arabic: فأمّا أَن يُمِيت النَّوْع الإنساني كُله ثمَّ يحيه بعد ذَلِك فَلَا حِكْمَة فِي ذَلِك
segments.english: As for causing the entire human species to die, then bringing it to life after that — [there is] no wisdom in that.

segments.arabic: فَجَاءَت براهين الْمعَاد فِي الْقُرْآن مبنيّة على ثَلَاثَة أصُول
segments.english: So the proofs of the Return came in the Quran, built upon three foundations.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا تَقْرِير كَمَال علم الرب سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: The first [is] establishing the completeness of the knowledge of the Lord, glorified [is] He.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ فِي جَوَاب من قَالَ
segments.english: As He said in answer to the one who said,

segments.arabic: مَن يُحيي الْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٌ
segments.english: 'Who [will] give life to the bones when they [are] decayed?'
segments.sahih_international: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

segments.arabic: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِي أَنْشَأَهَا أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عليم
segments.english: Say, 'The One who produced them the first time [will] give them life, and He [is] knowing of every creation.'
segments.sahih_international: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said,

segments.arabic: ﴿وَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَآتِيَةٌ فَاصْفَحِ الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيلَ﴾
segments.english: 'And indeed the Hour [is] surely coming, so forgive [with a] gracious forgiveness.'
segments.sahih_international: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ﴾
segments.english: 'Indeed your Lord — He [is] the All-Creating, the All-Knowing.'
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said,

segments.arabic: ﴿قَدْ عَلِمْنَا﴾
segments.english: 'We already know…'

segments.arabic: ﴿مَا تَنْقُصُ الْأَرْضُ مِنْهُم﴾
segments.english: what the earth takes away from them

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي تَقْرِير كَمَال قدرته كَقَوْلِه
segments.english: And the second [is] establishing the completeness of His power, as in His saying:

segments.arabic: أَو لَيْسَ الَّذِي خلق السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْضَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ
segments.english: 'Is not the One who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them?'

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: and His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿بَلَى قَادِرِينَ عَلَى أَنْ نُسَوِّيَ بنانه﴾
segments.english: Yes, [We are] able to reshape his fingertips
segments.sahih_international: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وانه يحي الْمَوْتَى وَأَنَّهُ عَلَى كل شَيْء قدير
segments.english: and His saying: 'That [is] because God — He [is] the Truth, and He gives life to the dead, and He [is] over everything capable'

segments.arabic: وَيجمع سُبْحَانَهُ بَين الْأَمريْنِ كَمَا فِي قَوْله
segments.english: And He — glorified [is] He — combines the two matters, as in His saying:

segments.arabic: أَو لَيْسَ الَّذِي خلق السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْضَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ بَلَى وَهُوَ الْخَلاقُ الْعَلِيم
segments.english: 'Is not the One who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Yes indeed, and He [is] the Supreme Creator, the All-Knowing'

segments.arabic: الثَّالِث كَمَال حكمته كَقَوْلِه
segments.english: The third [is] the completeness of His wisdom, as in His saying:

segments.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض وَمَا بَينهمَا لاعبين
segments.english: 'And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what [is] between them playing'

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: and His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاء وَالْأَرْض وَمَا بَينهمَا بَاطِلا﴾
segments.english: And We did not create the sky and the earth and what [is] between them in vain
segments.sahih_international: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: and His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَيَحْسَبُ الْأِنْسَانُ أَنْ يُتْرَكَ سُدىً﴾
segments.english: Does man think that he [will] be left without purpose?
segments.sahih_international: Does man think that he will be left neglected?

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: and His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ﴾
segments.english: Did you then think that We created you without purpose, and that to Us you [would] not be returned?
segments.sahih_international: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

segments.arabic: ﴿فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحق﴾
segments.english: So exalted [is] God, the King, the Truth

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: and His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ نَجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ﴾
segments.english: Or do those who committed evil deeds think that We [will] make them like those who believed and did righteous deeds —
segments.sahih_international: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.

segments.arabic: ﴿سَوَاءً مَحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ﴾
segments.english: equal [in] their living and their dying? Evil [is] what they judge!

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كَانَ الصَّوَاب أَن الْمعَاد مَعْلُوم بِالْعقلِ مَعَ الشَّرْع
segments.english: And for this [reason], the correct [view] [is] that the Return [is] known through reason along with revelation

segments.arabic: وَأَن كَمَال الرب تَعَالَى وَكَمَال أَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاته تَقْتَضِيه وتوجبه
segments.english: and that the perfection of the Lord, Most High, and the perfection of His names and attributes necessitate it and require it

segments.arabic: وَأَنه منزّه عمّا يَقُوله منكروه كَمَا ينزه كَمَاله عَن سَائِر الْعُيُوب والنقائص
segments.english: and that He [is] far above what its deniers say, just as His perfection [is] far above all flaws and defects

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَن المنكرين لذَلِك لمّا كذّبوا بِالْحَقِّ اخْتَلَط عَلَيْهِم أَمرهم
segments.english: Then He — glorified [is] He — informed that those who denied that, when they rejected the truth, their affair became confused upon them

segments.arabic: ﴿فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مريج﴾
segments.english: so they [are] in [a] confused affair

segments.arabic: مختلط لَا يحصلون مِنْهُ على شَيْء
segments.english: mixed up — they do not arrive from it at anything

segments.arabic: ثمَّ دعاهم إِلَى النّظر فِي الْعَالم الْعلوِي وبنائه وارتفاعه واستوائه وَحسنه والتئامه
segments.english: Then He called them to look at the upper world — its structure, its height, its evenness, its beauty, and its harmony

segments.arabic: ثمَّ إِلَى الْعَالم السفلي وَهُوَ الأَرْض وَكَيف بسطها وهيّأها بالبسط لما يُرَاد مِنْهَا
segments.english: then to the lower world, which [is] the earth, and how He spread it out and prepared it by [the] spreading for what [is] intended from it

segments.arabic: وثبّتها بالجبال وأودع فِيهَا الْمَنَافِع
segments.english: and He secured it with mountains and placed in it benefits

segments.arabic: وَأنْبت فِيهَا من كل صنف حسن من أَصْنَاف النَّبَات
segments.english: and He grew in it every beautiful kind of [the] types of plants

segments.arabic: على اخْتِلَاف أشكاله وألوانه ومقاديره ومنافعه وَصِفَاته
segments.english: despite the differences of their shapes, colors, sizes, benefits, and qualities

segments.arabic: وَأَن ذَلِك تبصرة إِذا تأمّلها العَبْد الْمُنِيب وتبصّر بهَا
segments.english: and that that [is] an insight — when the servant who turns [to God] reflects on it and gains insight from it

segments.arabic: تذكر مَا دلّت عَلَيْهِ مِمَّا أخْبرت بِهِ الرُّسُل من التَّوْحِيد والمعاد
segments.english: he remembers what it pointed to of what the messengers informed of — monotheism and the Return

segments.arabic: فالناظر فِيهَا يتبصّر أَولا ثمَّ يتَذَكَّر ثَانِيًا
segments.english: So the one looking at it gains insight first, then remembers second

segments.arabic: وَأَن هَذَا لَا يحصل إِلَّا لعبد منيب إِلَى الله بِقَلْبِه وجوارحه
segments.english: and that this does not happen except for [a] servant who turns to God with his heart and his limbs

segments.arabic: ثمَّ دعاهم إِلَى التفكّر فِي مَادَّة أَرْزَاقهم وأقواتهم وملابسهم ومراكبهم وجناتهم
segments.english: Then He called them to reflect on the source of their provisions, their food, their clothing, their mounts, and their gardens

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ المَاء الَّذِي أنزلهُ من السَّمَاء وَبَارك فِيهِ
segments.english: which [is] the water that He sent down from the sky and blessed it

segments.arabic: حَتَّى أنبت بِهِ جنّات مُخْتَلفَة الثِّمَار والفواكه
segments.english: until He grew with it gardens of different fruits and produce

segments.arabic: مَا بَين أَبيض وأسود وأحمر وأصفر وحلو وحامض وَبَين ذَلِك
segments.english: ranging between white and black and red and yellow, and sweet and sour and in between

segments.arabic: مَعَ اخْتِلَاف منابعها وتنوع أجناسها وَأنْبت بِهِ
segments.english: despite the differences of their sources and the variety of their kinds; and He grew with it

segments.arabic: الْحُبُوب كلهَا على تنوعها وَاخْتِلَاف مَنَافِعهَا وصفاتها وأشكالها ومقاديرها
segments.english: all the grains, in their variety and the differences of their benefits, their qualities, their shapes, and their amounts.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أفرد النّخل لما فِيهِ من مَوضِع الْعبْرَة وَالدّلَالَة الَّتِي لَا تخفى عَليّ المتأمل
segments.english: Then He singled out the date palm for what [there is] in it of [a] place of lesson and indication that [is] not hidden from the one who reflects.

segments.arabic: وَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوتهَا
segments.english: And He gave life through it [to] the earth after its death.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ قَالَ كَذَلِكَ الْخُرُوج
segments.english: Then He said: "Like that [is] the coming out."

segments.arabic: أَي مثل هَذَا الْإِخْرَاج من الأَرْض الْفَوَاكِه وَالثِّمَار والأقوات والحبوب خروجكم من الأَرْض بعد مَا غيّبتم فِيهَا
segments.english: Meaning: like this bringing out from the earth of fruits, produce, foods, and grains [is] your coming out from the earth after you were buried in it.

segments.arabic: وَقد ذكرنَا هَذَا الْقيَاس وَأَمْثَاله من المقاييس الْوَاقِعَة فِي الْقُرْآن فِي كتَابنَا المعالم
segments.english: And we have mentioned this comparison and others like it from the comparisons found in the Quran in our book al-Ma'aalim,

segments.arabic: وبيّنا بعض مَا فِيهَا من الْأَسْرَار والعبر
segments.english: and we explained some of what [there is] in them of secrets and lessons.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ انْتقل سُبْحَانَهُ إِلَى تَقْرِير النبوّة بِأَحْسَن تَقْرِير وأوجر لفظ وأبعده عَن كل شُبْهَة وَشك
segments.english: Then He — glorified [is] He — moved to establishing prophethood with the best establishment, the most concise wording, and the furthest from every doubt and uncertainty.

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر أَنه أرسل إِلَى قوم نوح وَعَاد وَثَمُود وَقوم لوط وَقوم فِرْعَوْن رسلًا فكذّبوهم فأهلكهم بأنواع الْهَلَاك
segments.english: So He informed that He sent to the people of Nuh, 'Aad, Thamud, the people of Lut, and the people of Fir'awn — messengers, but they rejected them, so He destroyed them with [various] types of destruction.

segments.arabic: وَصدق فيهم وعيده الَّذِي أَو عدتهمْ بِهِ رسله إِن لم يُؤمنُوا
segments.english: And His threat came true upon them — the one that His messengers had warned them with if they did not believe.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا تَقْرِير لنبوّتهم ولنبوة من أخبر بذلك عَنْهُم
segments.english: And this [is] an establishment of their prophethood and [of] the prophethood of the one who reported that about them,

segments.arabic: من غير أَن يتَعَلَّم ذَلِك من معلّم وَلَا قَرَأَهُ فِي كتاب
segments.english: without having learned that from [a] teacher, nor having read it in [a] book,

segments.arabic: بل أخبر بِهِ إِخْبَارًا مفصّلا مطابقا لما عِنْد أهل الْكتاب
segments.english: but rather he reported it [in] a detailed report, matching what the People of the Book had.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يرد على هَذَا إِلَّا سُؤال البهت والمكابرة على جحد الضروريات
segments.english: And nothing [can] be raised against this except the question of slander and stubbornness in denying what [is] necessarily [known],

segments.arabic: بِأَنَّهُ لم يكن شَيْء من ذَلِك
segments.english: [by claiming] that none of that happened,

segments.arabic: أَو أَن حوادث الدَّهْر ونكباته أَصَابَتْهُم كَمَا أَصَابَت غَيرهم
segments.english: or that the events of time and its disasters struck them just as they struck others.

segments.arabic: وَصَاحب هَذَا السُّؤَال يعلم من نَفسه أَنه باهت مبَاحث جَاحد لما شهد بِهِ العيان
segments.english: And the one [who raises] this question knows within himself that he [is a] slanderer, [a] liar, [a] denier of what eyewitness [testimony] has confirmed,

segments.arabic: وتناقلته الْقرن قرنا بعد قررن
segments.english: and [what] the generations have passed down, generation after generation.

segments.arabic: فإنكاره بِمَنْزِلَة إِنْكَار وجود الْمَشْهُورين من الْمُلُوك وَالْعُلَمَاء والبلاد النائية
segments.english: So his denial [is] at the level of denying the existence of the well-known kings and scholars, and [of] distant lands.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ عَاد سُبْحَانَهُ إِلَى تَقْرِير الْمعَاد بقوله
segments.english: Then He — glorified [is] He — returned to establishing the Return with His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَفَعَيِينَا بالخلق الأول﴾
segments.english: "Were We then tired by the first creation?"

segments.arabic: يُقَال لكل من عجز عَن شَيْء عيي بِهِ
segments.english: It [is] said of everyone who [is] unable [to do] something: he was baffled by it.

segments.arabic: وعيي فلَان بِهَذَا الْأَمر
segments.english: And "so-and-so was baffled by this matter."

segments.arabic: قَالَ الشَّاعِر عيوا بأمرهم كَمَا ... عييت ببيضتها الْحَمَامَة
segments.english: The poet said: "They were baffled by their matter, just as... the dove was baffled by its egg."

segments.arabic: وَمِنْه قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And from this [is] the saying of [God] Most High:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَلَمْ يعي بخلقهن﴾
segments.english: "and was not tired by their creation."

segments.arabic: قَالَ ابْن عَبَّاس يُرِيد أفعجزنا
segments.english: Ibn 'Abbas said: it means — were We unable?

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ قَالَ مقَاتل
segments.english: And likewise said Muqatil.

segments.arabic: قلت هَذَا تَفْسِير بِلَازِم اللَّفْظَة وحقيقتها أَعم من ذَلِك
segments.english: I say: this [is] an explanation by the implication of the word, but its true meaning [is] broader than that.

segments.arabic: فان الْعَرَب تَقول أعياني أَن أعرف كَذَا وعييت بِهِ
segments.english: For the Arabs say: "It baffled me to know such-and-such" and "I was baffled by it,"

segments.arabic: إِذا لم تهتد لَهُ لوجهه وَلم تقدر على مَعْرفَته وتحصيله
segments.english: when you [are] not guided to its way and [are] not able to know it or achieve it.

segments.arabic: فَتَقول أعياني دواؤك إِذا لم تهتد وَلم تقف عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: So you say: "Your cure baffled me" — when you [are] not guided [to it] and have not found it.

segments.arabic: ولازم هَذَا الْمَعْنى الْعَجز عَنهُ
segments.english: And the implication of this meaning [is] inability to [do] it.

segments.arabic: وَالْبَيْت الَّذِي اسْتشْهدُوا بِهِ شَاهد لهَذَا الْمَعْنى
segments.english: And the verse of poetry they used as evidence [is] a witness to this meaning.

segments.arabic: فان الْحَمَامَة لم تعجز عَن
segments.english: For the dove was not unable to —

segments.arabic: بيضتها وَلَكِن أعيادها إِذا أَرَادَت أَن تبيض أَيْن ترمي بالبيضة
segments.english: its egg — but what exhausts it, when it wants to lay, [is] where to drop the egg.

segments.arabic: فَهِيَ تَدور وتجول حَتَّى ترمي بهَا
segments.english: So it goes around and wanders until it drops it.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا باضت أعياها أَيْن تحفظها وتودعها حَتَّى لَا تُنال
segments.english: Then when it [has] laid, what exhausts it [is] where to keep it and store it so it [is] not reached.

segments.arabic: فَهِيَ تنقلها من مَكَان إِلَى مَكَان وتحار أَيْن تجْعَل مقرّها
segments.english: So it moves it from [one] place to [another] place, confused [about] where to make its resting place —

segments.arabic: كَمَا هُوَ حَال من عيَّ بأَمْره فَلم يدر من أَيْن يقْصد لَهُ وَمن أَيْن يَأْتِيهِ
segments.english: just as [is] the condition of someone who [is] helpless in his affair, not knowing from where to approach it or from where to come at it.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ المُرَاد بالإعياء فِي هَذِه الْآيَة التَّعَب كَمَا يظنّه من لم يعرف تَفْسِير الْقُرْآن
segments.english: And what [is] meant by "exhaustion" in this verse [is] not tiredness, as those who do not know the interpretation of the Quran think.

segments.arabic: بل هَذَا الْمَعْنى هُوَ الَّذِي نَفَاهُ سُبْحَانَهُ عَن نَفسه فِي آخر السُّورَة بقوله
segments.english: Rather, this meaning [is] what He — glorified [is] He — denied of Himself at the end of the surah by His saying:

segments.arabic: وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُغُوبٍ
segments.english: and no weariness touched Us.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ أنّهم
segments.english: Then He — glorified [is] He — informed that they [are]

segments.arabic: فِي لَبْسٍ مِنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
segments.english: in confusion about [a] new creation.
segments.sahih_international: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.

segments.arabic: أَي أَنهم الْتبس عَلَيْهِم إِعَادَة الْخلق خلقا جَدِيدا
segments.english: Meaning: the re-creation of [the] creation as [a] new creation confused them.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ نبههم على مَا هُوَ من أعظم آيَات قدرته وشواهد ربوبيّته وأدلّة الْمعَاد
segments.english: Then He drew their attention to what [is] among the greatest signs of His power, the proofs of His lordship, and the evidence for the Return —

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ خلق الْإِنْسَان فَإِنَّهُ من أعظم الْأَدِلَّة على التَّوْحِيد والمعاد
segments.english: and that [is] the creation of the human being, for it [is] among the greatest evidence for monotheism and the Return.

segments.arabic: وَأي دَلِيل أوضح من تركيب هَذِه الصُّورَة الآدميّة بأعضائها وقواها وصفاتها
segments.english: And what evidence [is] clearer than the structure of this human form — with its limbs, its powers, and its qualities,

segments.arabic: وَمَا فِيهَا من اللَّحْم والعظم وَالْعُرُوق والأعصاب والرباطات والمنافذ والآلات
segments.english: and what [is] in it of flesh, bone, veins, nerves, ligaments, openings, and organs,

segments.arabic: والعلوم والإرادات والصناعات كل ذَلِك من نُطْفَة مَاء
segments.english: and knowledge, will, and skills — all of that from [a] drop of water!

segments.arabic: فَلَو أنصف العَبْد ربه لاكتفى بفكره فِي نَفسه
segments.english: So if the servant were fair to his Lord, he would [have] been satisfied by reflecting on himself

segments.arabic: وَاسْتدلَّ بِوُجُودِهِ على جَمِيع مَا أخْبرت بِهِ الرُّسُل عَن الله وأسمائه وَصِفَاته
segments.english: and used his [own] existence as proof for everything the messengers reported about God, His names, and His attributes.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ عَن إحاطة علمه بِهِ حَتَّى علم وساوس نَفسه
segments.english: Then He — glorified [is] He — told of His knowledge surrounding him, until He [even] knew the whispers of his self.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر عَن قربه إِلَيْهِ بِالْعلمِ والإحاطة
segments.english: Then He told of His closeness to him through knowledge and encompassing,

segments.arabic: وَأَن ذَلِك أدنى إِلَيْهِ من الْعرق الَّذِي هُوَ دَاخل بدنه
segments.english: and that this [is] nearer to him than the vein that [is] inside his body.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ أقرب إِلَيْهِ بِالْقُدْرَةِ عَلَيْهِ وَالْعلم بِهِ من ذَلِك الْعرق
segments.english: So He [is] closer to him — in power over him and knowledge of him — than that vein.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ شَيخنَا المُرَاد بقول نَحن أَي ملائكتنا
segments.english: And our shaykh said: what [is] meant by the saying "We" [is] "Our angels" —

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ
segments.english: as He said:

segments.arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قرآنه
segments.english: So when We [have] recited it, then follow its recitation.

segments.arabic: أَي إِذا قَرَأَهُ عَلَيْك رَسُولنَا جِبْرِيل
segments.english: Meaning: when Our messenger Jibril [has] recited it to you.

segments.arabic: قَالَ وَيدل عَلَيْهِ قَوْله
segments.english: He said: and what proves this [is] His saying:

segments.arabic: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى المتلقيان
segments.english: when the two receivers receive.

segments.arabic: فقيد الْقرب الْمَذْكُور بتلقّي الْملكَيْنِ
segments.english: So He tied the mentioned closeness to the receiving of the two angels.

segments.arabic: وَلَو كَانَ المُرَاد بِهِ قرب الذَّات لم يتَقَيَّد بِوَقْت تلقي الْملكَيْنِ
segments.english: And if what [was] meant by it [were] closeness of [His] essence, it would not [have been] tied to the time of the two angels' receiving.

segments.arabic: فَلَا فِي صَحبه الْآيَة لحلولي وَلَا معطّل
segments.english: So there [is] nothing in the correct [meaning of] the verse for [one who believes in] indwelling, nor for [one who] denies [God's attributes].

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَن على يَمِينه وشماله ملكَيْنِ يكتبان أَعماله وأقواله
segments.english: Then He — glorified [is] He — informed that on his right and his left [are] two angels writing his deeds and his words.

segments.arabic: وَنبهَ بإحصاء الْأَقْوَال وكتابتها على كِتَابَة الْأَعْمَال
segments.english: And He drew attention — through the recording of words and their writing — to the writing of deeds,

segments.arabic: الَّتِي هِيَ أقل وقوعا وَأعظم أثرا من الْأَقْوَال
segments.english: which [are] less frequent and greater in effect than words,

segments.arabic: وَهِي غايات الْأَقْوَال ونهايتها
segments.english: and they [are] the goals of words and their end-point.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر عَن الْقِيَامَة الصُّغْرَى وَهِي سكرة الْمَوْت
segments.english: Then He told about the lesser resurrection — and it [is] the stupor of death —

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهَا تَجِيء بِالْحَقِّ وَهُوَ لقاؤه سُبْحَانَهُ والقدوم عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and that it comes with the truth, and that [is] meeting Him — glorified [is] He — and arriving before Him,

segments.arabic: وَعرض الرّوح عَلَيْهِ وَالثَّوَاب وَالْعِقَاب الَّذِي تعجل
segments.english: and the presenting of the soul before Him, and the reward and punishment that [is] hastened.

segments.arabic: لَهَا قبل الْقِيَامَة الْكُبْرَى
segments.english: for it before the Great Rising.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ ذكر الْقِيَامَة الْكُبْرَى بقول
segments.english: Then He mentioned the Great Rising with [His] saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ ذَلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيد﴾
segments.english: And the trumpet [will be] blown — that [is the] Day of the Threat.
segments.sahih_international: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر عَن أَحْوَال الْخلق فِي هَذَا الْيَوْم
segments.english: Then He told about the conditions of creation on this Day,

segments.arabic: وَأَن كل أحد يَأْتِي الله سُبْحَانَهُ ذَلِك الْيَوْم
segments.english: and that every person [will] come to God — glorified [is] He — on that Day,

segments.arabic: وَمَعَهُ سائق يَسُوقهُ وشهيد يشْهد عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and with him [is a] driver driving him and [a] witness testifying against him.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا غير شَهَادَة جوارحه وَغير شَهَادَة الأَرْض الَّتِي كَانَ عَلَيْهَا لَهُ عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And this [is] other than the testimony of his limbs, and other than the testimony of the earth that he was on — [testifying] for him [or] against him,

segments.arabic: وَغير شَهَادَة رَسُوله وَالْمُؤمنِينَ
segments.english: and other than the testimony of His messenger and the believers.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الله سُبْحَانَهُ يستشهد على العَبْد الْحفظَة والأنبياء
segments.english: For God — glorified [is] He — calls as witnesses against the servant: the guardian [angels], the prophets,

segments.arabic: والأمكنة الَّتِي عمِلُوا عَلَيْهَا الْخَيْر وَالشَّر
segments.english: the places on which they did good and evil,

segments.arabic: والجلود الَّتِي عصوه بهَا
segments.english: and the skins with which they disobeyed Him.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يحكم بَينهم بمجرّد علمه وَهُوَ أعدل العادلين وَأحكم الْحَاكِمين
segments.english: And He does not judge between them by His knowledge alone, though He [is] the most just of judges and the wisest of rulers.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا أخبر نبيه أَنه يحكم بَين النَّاس بِمَا سَمعه من إقرارهم وَشَهَادَة البيّنة لَا بمجرّد علمه
segments.english: And for this [reason] He told His prophet that He judges between people by what He heard from their confessions and the testimony of evidence — not by His knowledge alone.

segments.arabic: فَكيف يسوغ لحَاكم أَن يحكم بِمُجَرَّد علمه من غير بيّنة وَلَا إِقْرَار
segments.english: So how [is it] allowed for [a] judge to judge by his knowledge alone, without evidence or confession?

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَن الْإِنْسَان فِي غَفلَة من هَذَا الشَّأْن
segments.english: Then He — glorified [is] He — told that man [is] in heedlessness of this matter,

segments.arabic: الَّذِي هُوَ حقيق بِأَن لَا يغْفل عَنهُ
segments.english: which he [is] most deserving not to be heedless of,

segments.arabic: وَأَن لَا يزَال على ذكره وباله
segments.english: and that it should remain in his remembrance and on his mind.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ ﴿فِي غَفلَة من هَذَا﴾ وَلم يقل عَنهُ
segments.english: And He said "in heedlessness of this" and did not say "from it,"

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ
segments.english: just as He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مريب﴾
segments.english: And indeed they [are] surely in doubt of it — [a] troubling [doubt].
segments.sahih_international: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt.

segments.arabic: وَلم يقل فِي شكّ فِيهِ
segments.english: And He did not say "in doubt about it."

segments.arabic: وَجَاء هَذَا فِي الْمصدر وان لم يجىء فِي الْفِعْل
segments.english: And this came in the verbal noun form, even though it does not come in the verb form.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يُقَال غفلت مِنْهُ وَلَا شَككت مِنْهُ
segments.english: So one does not say "I was heedless from it" nor "I doubted from it" —

segments.arabic: كَأَن غفلته وشكه ابْتِدَاء مِنْهُ فَهُوَ مبدأ غفلته وشكّه
segments.english: as if his heedlessness and doubt originate from it, so it [is] the starting point of his heedlessness and his doubt.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا أبلغ من أَن يُقَال فِي غَفلَة عَنهُ وَشك فِيهِ
segments.english: And this [is] more powerful than saying "in heedlessness from it" and "doubt about it."

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ جعل مَا يَنْبَغِي أَن يكون مبدأ التَّذْكِرَة وَالْيَقِين ومنشأهما
segments.english: For He made what should be the starting point of remembrance and certainty and their source

segments.arabic: مبدأ للغفلة وَالشَّكّ
segments.english: [into a] starting point for heedlessness and doubt.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر أَن غطاء الْغَفْلَة والذهول يكْشف عَنهُ ذَلِك الْيَوْم
segments.english: Then He told that the covering of heedlessness and absent-mindedness [will be] removed from him on that Day,

segments.arabic: كَمَا يكْشف غطاء النّوم عَن الْقلب فيستيقظ وَعَن الْعين فتنفتح
segments.english: just as the covering of sleep [is] removed from the heart so it awakens, and from the eye so it opens.

segments.arabic: فنسبة كشف هَذَا الغطاء عَن العَبْد عِنْد المعاينة كنسبة كشف غطاء النّوم عَنهُ عِنْد الانتباه
segments.english: So the comparison of removing this covering from the servant at the time of witnessing [is] like the comparison of removing the covering of sleep from him at the time of waking.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَن قرينه وَهُوَ الَّذِي قرن بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا من الْمَلَائِكَة يكْتب عمله وَقَوله
segments.english: Then He — glorified [is] He — told that his companion, who [is] the one paired with him in this world from the angels, writing his deeds and his words,

segments.arabic: يَقُول لمّا يحضرهُ هَذَا الَّذِي كنت وكّلتني بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا قد أحضرته وَأَتَيْتُك بِهِ
segments.english: [will] say when he brings him: "This [is] the one You entrusted me with in this world — I have brought him and come to You with him."

segments.arabic: هَذَا قَول مُجَاهِد
segments.english: This [is] the saying of Mujahid.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ ابْن قُتَيْبَة الْمَعْنى هَذَا مَا كتبته عَلَيْهِ وأحصيته من قَوْله وَعَمله حَاضر عِنْدِي
segments.english: And Ibn Qutaybah said: the meaning [is] "This [is] what I recorded against him and counted of his words and deeds — [it is] present with me."

segments.arabic: وَالتَّحْقِيق أَن الْآيَة تتضمن الْأَمريْنِ
segments.english: And the correct [view is] that the verse includes both meanings:

segments.arabic: أَي هَذَا الشَّخْص الَّذِي وكلت بِهِ وَهَذَا عمله الَّذِي أحصيته عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: meaning: this [is] the person I was entrusted with, and this [is] his deed that I recorded against him.

segments.arabic: فَحِينَئِذٍ يُقَال
segments.english: So at that point it [will be] said:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَلْقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ﴾
segments.english: "Throw [him] into Hell!"

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا إِمَّا أَن يكون خطابا للسائق والشهيد
segments.english: And this [is] either [a] command addressed to the driver and the witness,

segments.arabic: أَو خطابا للْملك الْمُوكل بعذابه وَإِن كَانَ وَاحِدًا
segments.english: or [it is] an address to the angel appointed over his punishment, even though he was one [angel].

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ مَذْهَب مَعْرُوف من مَذَاهِب الْعَرَب فِي خطابها
segments.english: And this [is] [a] well-known way among the ways of the Arabs in their speech.

segments.arabic: أَو تكون الْألف منقلبة عَن نون التَّأْكِيد الْخَفِيفَة
segments.english: Or the alif [is] changed from the light nun of emphasis,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أجري الْوَصْل مجْرى الْوَقْف
segments.english: then the connected [form was] treated like the paused [form].

segments.arabic: ثمَّ ذكر صِفَات هَذَا الْملقى فَذكر لَهُ سِتّ صِفَات
segments.english: Then He mentioned the qualities of this one thrown [into the Fire], and He mentioned for him six qualities.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا أَنه كفار لنعم الله وحقوقه
segments.english: The first [is] that he [is] [a] persistent denier of the blessings of God and His rights,

segments.arabic: كفار بِدِينِهِ وتوحيده وأسمائه وَصِفَاته
segments.english: [a] persistent denier of His religion, His monotheism, His names, and His attributes,

segments.arabic: كفّار برسله وَمَلَائِكَته كفار بكتبه ولقائه
segments.english: [a] persistent denier of His messengers and His angels, [a] persistent denier of His books and His meeting.

segments.arabic: الثَّانِيَة أَنه معاند للحق بِدَفْعِهِ جحدا وعنادا
segments.english: The second [is] that he [is] stubborn against the truth, pushing it away [in] denial and stubbornness.

segments.arabic: الثَّالِثَة أَنه مناع للخير
segments.english: The third [is] that he [is one who] prevents good.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يعم مَنعه للخير الَّذِي هُوَ إِحْسَان إِلَى نَفسه من الطَّاعَات والقرب إِلَى الله
segments.english: And this includes his preventing of good that [is] kindness to himself — from acts of obedience and drawing near to God —

segments.arabic: وَالْخَيْر الَّذِي هُوَ إِحْسَان إِلَى النَّاس
segments.english: and the good that [is] kindness to people.

segments.arabic: فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ خير لنَفسِهِ وَلَا لبني جنسه
segments.english: So there [is] no good in him for himself, nor for his fellow people,

segments.arabic: كَمَا هُوَ الْحَال أَكثر الْخلق
segments.english: as [is] the case [with] most of creation.

segments.arabic: الرَّابِعَة أَنه مَعَ مَنعه للخير مُعْتَد على النَّاس ظلوم غشوم
segments.english: The fourth [is] that along with his preventing of good, he [is] aggressive against people — very unjust, very oppressive —

segments.arabic: مُعْتَد عَلَيْهِم بِيَدِهِ وَلسَانه
segments.english: aggressive against them with his hand and his tongue.

segments.arabic: الْخَامِسَة أَنه مريب أَي صَاحب ريب وَشك
segments.english: The fifth [is] that he [is] doubtful — meaning [a] person of doubt and uncertainty.

segments.arabic: وَمَعَ هَذَا فَهُوَ آتٍ لكل رِيبَة
segments.english: And along with this, he [is one who] commits every suspicious act.

segments.arabic: يُقَال فلَان مريب إِذا كَانَ صَاحب رِيبَة
segments.english: [It is] said: "So-and-so [is] doubtful" when he [is] [a] person of suspicion.

segments.arabic: السَّادِسَة أَنه مَعَ ذَلِك مُشْرك بِاللَّه
segments.english: The sixth [is] that along with all that, he [is one] associating partners with God.

segments.arabic: قد اتّخذ مَعَ الله إِلَهًا آخر يعبده وَيُحِبهُ
segments.english: He had taken alongside God another god — he worships him and loves him,

segments.arabic: ويغضب لَهُ ويرضى لَهُ وَيحلف باسمه وينذر لَهُ
segments.english: and gets angry for him, and [is] pleased for him, and swears by his name, and makes vows to him,

segments.arabic: ويوالي فِيهِ ويعادي فِيهِ
segments.english: and allies [with others] for his sake, and shows enmity for his sake.

segments.arabic: فيختصم هُوَ وقرينه من الشَّيَاطِين
segments.english: So he and his companion from the devils dispute [with each other],

segments.arabic: ويحيل الْأَمر عَلَيْهِ وَأَنه هُوَ الَّذِي أطغاه وأضله
segments.english: and he throws the blame on him, [saying] that he [is] the one who made him transgress and led him astray.

segments.arabic: فَيَقُول قرينه لم يكن لي قوّة أَن أضلّه وأطغيه
segments.english: So his companion says: "I did not have [the] power to lead him astray and make him transgress,

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن كَانَ فِي ضلال بعيد اخْتَارَهُ لنَفسِهِ وآثره على الْحق
segments.english: but he was in [a] far misguidance — he chose it for himself and preferred it over the truth."

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ إِبْلِيس لأهل النَّار
segments.english: Just as Iblis said to the people of the Fire:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ لِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا أَنْ دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَاسْتَجَبْتُمْ لي﴾
segments.english: "And I did not have over you any authority, except that I called you and you responded to me."
segments.sahih_international: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "Indeed, Allah had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allah] before. Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."

segments.arabic: وعَلى هَذَا فالقرين هُنَا هُوَ شَيْطَانه يختصمان عِنْد الله
segments.english: And based on this, the companion here [is] his devil — they dispute before God.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَت طَائِفَة بل قرينه هَهُنَا هُوَ الْملك
segments.english: And [a] group said: rather, his companion here [is] the angel.

segments.arabic: فيدعي عَلَيْهِ أَنه زَاد عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا كتبه عَلَيْهِ وطغى
segments.english: So he claims against him that he added against him in what he recorded about him, and went too far,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه لم يفعل ذَلِك كُله
segments.english: and that he did not do all of that,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه أعجله بِالْكِتَابَةِ عَن التَّوْبَة وَلم يمهله حَتَّى يَتُوب
segments.english: and that he rushed him with the recording before repentance and did not give him time until he [could] repent.

segments.arabic: فَيَقُول الْملك مَا زِدْت فِي الْكِتَابَة على مَا عمل وَلَا أعجلته عَن التَّوْبَة
segments.english: So the angel says: "I did not add in the recording beyond what he did, nor did I rush him before repentance."

segments.arabic: ﴿وَلَكِنْ كَانَ فِي ضلال بعيد﴾
segments.english: "But he was in [a] far misguidance."
segments.sahih_international: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."

segments.arabic: فَيَقُول الرب تَعَالَى
segments.english: So the Lord, Most High, says:

segments.arabic: ﴿لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا لَدَي﴾
segments.english: "Do not dispute before Me."

segments.arabic: وَقد أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ عَن اختصام الْكفَّار وَالشَّيَاطِين بَين يَدَيْهِ فِي سُورَة الصافات والأعراف
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, told about the dispute of the disbelievers and the devils before Him in Surah al-Saffat and al-A'raf.

segments.arabic: وَأخْبر عَن اختصام النَّاس بَين يَدَيْهِ فِي سُورَة الزمر
segments.english: And He told about the dispute of people before Him in Surah al-Zumar.

segments.arabic: وَأخْبر عَن اختصام أهل النَّار فِيهَا فِي سُورَة الشُّعَرَاء وَسورَة ص
segments.english: And He told about the dispute of the people of the Fire in it, in Surah al-Shu'ara and Surah Sad.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَنه لَا يبدَّل القَوْل لَدَيْهِ
segments.english: Then He, glorified [is] He, told that the word [is] not changed before Him.

segments.arabic: فَقيل المُرَاد بذلك قَوْله
segments.english: And [it was] said [that] what [is] meant by that [is] His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الجِنَّة وَالنَّاس﴾
segments.english: "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people."
segments.sahih_international: Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together."

segments.arabic: أَجْمَعِينَ ووعده لأهل الْإِيمَان بِالْجنَّةِ وَأَن هَذَا لَا يُبدل وَلَا يخلف
segments.english: all of them, and His promise to the people of faith of Paradise, and that this [is] not changed nor broken.

segments.arabic: قَالَ ابْن عَبَّاس يُرِيد مالو عدي خلف لأهل طَاعَتي وَلَا أهل معصيتي
segments.english: Ibn Abbas said: [it] means — My promise [is] not broken for the people of My obedience nor the people of My disobedience.

segments.arabic: قَالَ مُجَاهِد قد قضيت مَا أَنا قَاض
segments.english: Mujahid said: I have decreed what I [am] decreeing.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا أصح الْقَوْلَيْنِ فِي الْآيَة
segments.english: And this [is] the more correct of the two opinions regarding the verse.

segments.arabic: وفيهَا قَول آخر أَن الْمَعْنى مَا يغيّر القَوْل عِنْدِي بِالْكَذِبِ والتلبيس كَمَا يغيّر عِنْد الْمُلُوك والحكّام
segments.english: And there [is] in it another opinion — that the meaning [is]: speech [is] not altered before Me through lying and deception, as it [is] altered before kings and judges.

segments.arabic: فَيكون المُرَاد بالْقَوْل قَول المختصمين وَهُوَ اخْتِيَار الْفراء وَابْن قُتَيْبَة
segments.english: So what [is] meant by "the speech" [would be] the speech of the disputing parties. And this [is] the choice of al-Farra' and Ibn Qutaybah.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْفراء الْمَعْنى مَا يكذب عِنْدِي لعلمي بِالْغَيْبِ
segments.english: Al-Farra' said: the meaning [is] — no one lies before Me, because of My knowledge of the unseen.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ ابْن قُتَيْبَة أَي مَا يحرف القَوْل عِنْدِي وَلَا يُزَاد فِيهِ وَلَا ينقص مِنْهُ
segments.english: And Ibn Qutaybah said: meaning — speech [is] not distorted before Me, nor [is anything] added to it, nor taken away from it.

segments.arabic: قَالَ لِأَنَّهُ قَالَ القَوْل عِنْدِي وَلم يقل قولي
segments.english: He said: because He said "the speech before Me" and did not say "My speech."

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا كَمَا يُقَال لَا يكذب عِنْدِي
segments.english: And this [is] like when it [is] said: no one lies before Me.

segments.arabic: فعلى القَوْل الأوّل يكون قَوْله
segments.english: So according to the first opinion, His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَمَا أَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ﴾
segments.english: And I [am] not unjust to [My] servants

segments.arabic: من تَمام قَوْله
segments.english: [is] a completion of His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لدي﴾
segments.english: The speech [is] not changed before Me

segments.arabic: فِي الْمَعْنى أَي مَا قلته ووعدت بِهِ لَا بُد من فعله
segments.english: in meaning — that is: what I have said and promised must be carried out.

segments.arabic: وَمَعَ هَذَا فَهُوَ عدل لَا ظلم فِيهِ وَلَا جور
segments.english: And along with this, it [is] justice — no wrongdoing in it and no unfairness.

segments.arabic: وعَلى الثَّانِي يكون قد وصف نَفسه بأمرين
segments.english: And according to the second [opinion], He would have described Himself with two matters.

segments.arabic: أَحدهمَا أَن كَمَال علمه واطلاعه يمْنَع من تَبْدِيل القَوْل بَين يَدَيْهِ وترويج الْبَاطِل عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: The first [is] that the perfection of His knowledge and awareness prevents the altering of speech before Him and the passing of falsehood upon Him.

segments.arabic: وَكَمَال عدله وغناه يمْنَع من ظلمه لعبيده
segments.english: And the perfection of His justice and self-sufficiency prevents Him from wronging His servants.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر عَن سَعَة جهنّم وَأَنَّهَا كلّما ألْقى فِيهَا تَقول هَل من مزِيد
segments.english: Then He told about the vastness of Hellfire, and that every time [something is] thrown into it, it says: "[Is there] any more?"

segments.arabic: وَأَخْطَأ من قَالَ أَن ذَلِك للنَّفْي أَي لَيْسَ من مزِيد
segments.english: And whoever said that this [is] a negation — meaning "there [is] no more" — [is] mistaken.

segments.arabic: والْحَدِيث الصَّحِيح يردّ هَذَا التَّأْوِيل
segments.english: And the authentic hadith refutes this interpretation.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر عَن تقريب الْجنَّة من الْمُتَّقِينَ
segments.english: Then He told about Paradise being brought near to the God-conscious.

segments.arabic: وَأَن أَهلهَا هم الَّذين اتصفوا بِهَذِهِ الصِّفَات الْأَرْبَع
segments.english: And that its people [are] those who [are] described with these four qualities.

segments.arabic: إِحْدَاهَا أَن يكون أوابا أَي رجَّاعًا إِلَى الله من مَعْصِيَته إِلَى طَاعَته وَمن الْغَفْلَة عَنهُ إِلَى ذكره
segments.english: The first of them [is] that he be one who constantly returns — meaning one who turns back to God, from disobedience to obedience, and from heedlessness of Him to remembrance of Him.

segments.arabic: قَالَ عبيد بن عُمَيْر الأوّاب الَّذِي يتَذَكَّر ذنُوبه ثمَّ يسْتَغْفر مِنْهَا
segments.english: 'Ubayd ibn 'Umayr said: the one who constantly returns [is] the one who remembers his sins then seeks forgiveness for them.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ مُجَاهِد هُوَ الَّذِي إِذا ذكر ذَنبه فِي الْخَلَاء اسْتغْفر مِنْهُ
segments.english: And Mujahid said: he [is] the one who, when he remembers his sin in private, seeks forgiveness for it.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ سعيد بن المسيّب هُوَ الَّذِي يُذنب ثمَّ يَتُوب ثمَّ يُذنب ثمَّ يَتُوب
segments.english: And Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib said: he [is] the one who sins then repents, then sins then repents.

segments.arabic: الثَّانِيَة أَن يكون حفيظا
segments.english: The second [is] that he be a guardian [over himself].

segments.arabic: قَالَ ابْن عبّاس لما ائتمنه الله عَلَيْهِ وافترضه
segments.english: Ibn Abbas said: [a guardian] over what God entrusted him with and made obligatory upon him.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ قَتَادَة حَافظ لما استودعه الله من حقّه وَنعمته
segments.english: And Qatadah said: [a] preserver of what God placed in his keeping of His right and His blessing.

segments.arabic: وَلما كَانَت النَّفس لَهَا قوّتان قُوَّة الطّلب وَقُوَّة الْإِمْسَاك
segments.english: And since the self has two powers — the power of seeking and the power of holding back —

segments.arabic: كَانَ الأواب مُسْتَعْملا لقُوَّة الطّلب فِي رُجُوعه إِلَى الله ومرضاته وطاعته
segments.english: the one who constantly returns [is] using the power of seeking in his turning back to God, His pleasure, and His obedience.

segments.arabic: والحفيظ مُسْتَعْملا لقُوَّة الْحِفْظ فِي الْإِمْسَاك عَن مَعَاصيه ونواهيه
segments.english: And the guardian [is] using the power of guarding in holding back from His sins and His prohibitions.

segments.arabic: فالحفيظ الممسك نَفسه عَمَّا حرّم عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: So the guardian [is] the one who holds himself back from what [was] forbidden for him.

segments.arabic: والأوّاب الْمقبل على الله بِطَاعَتِهِ
segments.english: And the one who constantly returns [is] the one who turns to God with his obedience.

segments.arabic: الثَّالِثَة
segments.english: The third —

segments.arabic: قَوْله
segments.english: His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿مَنْ خَشِيَ الرَّحْمَن بِالْغَيْبِ﴾
segments.english: whoever feared the Most Merciful in the unseen

segments.arabic: يتَضَمَّن الْإِقْرَار بِوُجُودِهِ وربوبيته وَقدرته وَعلمه واطلاعه على تفاصيل أَحْوَال العَبْد
segments.english: [it] includes the acknowledgment of His existence, His lordship, His power, His knowledge, and His awareness of the details of the servant's conditions.

segments.arabic: ويتضمن الْإِقْرَار بكتبه وَرُسُله وَأمره وَنَهْيه
segments.english: And it includes the acknowledgment of His books, His messengers, His commands, and His prohibitions.

segments.arabic: ويتضمن الْإِقْرَار بوعده ووعيده ولقائه
segments.english: And it includes the acknowledgment of His promise, His threat, and His meeting.

segments.arabic: فَلَا تصح خشيَة الرَّحْمَن بِالْغَيْبِ إِلَّا بعد هَذَا كُله
segments.english: So the fear of the Most Merciful in the unseen [is] not sound except after all of this.

segments.arabic: الرَّابِعَة قَوْله
segments.english: The fourth: His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَجَاءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُنِيبٍ﴾
segments.english: and came with [a] heart turning [in repentance]

segments.arabic: قَالَ ابْن عَبَّاس رَاجع عَن معاصي الله مقبل على طَاعَة الله
segments.english: Ibn Abbas said: returning from disobedience of God, turning to obedience of God.

segments.arabic: وَحَقِيقَة الْإِنَابَة عكوف الْقلب على طَاعَة الله ومحبته والإقبال عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And the reality of turning [in repentance is] the heart's devotion to obedience of God, love of Him, and turning toward Him.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ ذكر سُبْحَانَهُ جَزَاء من قَامَت بِهِ هَذِه الْأَوْصَاف بقوله
segments.english: Then He — glorified [is] He — mentioned the reward of whoever these qualities stood in, by His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلامٍ ذَلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُودِ﴾
segments.english: Enter it in peace; that [is] the Day of Eternity.
segments.sahih_international: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."

segments.arabic: ﴿لَهُم مَا يشاؤون فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ﴾
segments.english: For them [is] whatever they wish therein, and with Us [is] more.
segments.sahih_international: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ خوَّفهم بِأَن يصيبهم من الْهَلَاك مَا أصَاب من قبلهم
segments.english: Then He warned them that [there would] strike them of destruction what struck those before them,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا أَشد مِنْهُم بطشا وَلم يدْفع عَنْهُم الْهَلَاك شدّة بطشهم
segments.english: and that they were stronger than them in might, and the strength of their might did not ward off destruction from them.

segments.arabic: وَلَهُم عِنْد الْهَلَاك تقلّبوا وطافوا فِي الْبِلَاد وَهل يَجدونَ محيصا ومنجى من عَذَاب الله
segments.english: And for them, at [the time of] destruction, they turned about and roamed through the lands — could they find [an] escape or refuge from the punishment of God?

segments.arabic: قَالَ قَتَادَة حَاص أَعدَاء الله فوجدوا أَمر الله لَهُم مدْركا
segments.english: Qatadah said: the enemies of God tried to flee, but they found the decree of God reaching them.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ الزّجاج طوّفوا وفتشوا فَلم يرو محيصا من الْمَوْت
segments.english: And al-Zajjaj said: they roamed and searched, but they did not find [an] escape from death.

segments.arabic: وَحَقِيقَة ذَلِك أَنهم طلبُوا الْمَهْرَب من الْمَوْت فَلم يجدوه
segments.english: And the reality of that [is] that they sought [a] way to flee from death, but they did not find it.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَن فِي هَذَا الذى ذكر ذكرى
segments.english: Then He — glorified [is] He — informed that in this which [He] mentioned [is] a reminder

segments.arabic: لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
segments.english: for whoever [there] was for him [a] heart, or [he] gave ear while he [was] [a] witness.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر أَنه خلق السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض وَمَا بَينهمَا فِي ستّة أيّام
segments.english: Then He informed that He created the heavens and the earth and what [is] between them in six days,

segments.arabic: وَلم يمسهُ من تَعب وَلَا إعياء
segments.english: and no weariness or fatigue touched Him —

segments.arabic: تَكْذِيب لأعدائه من الْيَهُود حَيْثُ قَالُوا أَنه استراح فِي الْيَوْم السَّابِع
segments.english: [as a] denial of His enemies among the Jews, when they said that He rested on the seventh day.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أَمر نبيه بالتأسي بِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ فِي الصَّبْر على مَا يَقُول أعداؤه فِيهِ
segments.english: Then He commanded His Prophet to follow His example — glorified [is] He — in patience over what his enemies say about Him,

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ صَبر على قَول الْيَهُود أَنه استراح
segments.english: just as He — glorified [is] He — [was] patient over the saying of the Jews that He rested.

segments.arabic: وَلَا أحد أَصْبِر على أَذَى يسمعهُ مِنْهُ
segments.english: And no one [is] more patient over harm that he hears than Him.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أمره بِمَا يَسْتَعِين بِهِ على الصَّبْر وَهُوَ التَّسْبِيح بِحَمْد ربه
segments.english: Then He commanded him with what he [could] seek help through for patience, and it [is] glorifying with the praise of his Lord —

segments.arabic: قبل طُلُوع الشَّمْس وَقبل غُرُوبهَا وبالليل وأدبار السُّجُود
segments.english: before the rising of the sun, before its setting, during the night, and after the prostrations.

segments.arabic: فَقيل هُوَ الْوتر وَقيل الركعتان بعد الْمغرب
segments.english: So [some] said it [is] the witr [prayer], and [some] said the two units [of prayer] after Maghrib.

segments.arabic: وَالْأول قَول ابْن عَبَّاس وَالثَّانِي قَول عمر وَعلي وَأبي هُرَيْرَة وَالْحسن بن عَليّ
segments.english: And the first [is] the saying of Ibn Abbas, and the second [is] the saying of Umar, Ali, Abu Hurayrah, and al-Hasan ibn Ali,

segments.arabic: وَإِحْدَى الرِّوَايَتَيْنِ عَن ابْن عَبَّاس
segments.english: and [it is] one of the two narrations from Ibn Abbas.

segments.arabic: وَعَن ابْن عَبَّاس رِوَايَة ثَالِثَة أَنه التَّسْبِيح بِاللِّسَانِ أدبار الصَّلَاة المكتوبات
segments.english: And from Ibn Abbas [there is] a third narration: that it [is] glorification with the tongue after the obligatory prayers.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ ختم السُّورَة بِذكر الْمعَاد ونداء الْمُنَادِي بِرُجُوع الْأَرْوَاح إِلَى أجسادها للحشر
segments.english: Then He sealed the surah with the mention of the Return and the call of the caller for the return of the souls to their bodies for the gathering.

segments.arabic: وَأخْبر أَن هَذَا النداء من مَكَان قريب يسمعهُ كل أحد
segments.english: And He informed that this call [is] from [a] near place — every person [will] hear it —

segments.arabic: ﴿يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ﴾
segments.english: the Day they [will] hear the shout in truth.

headings.arabic: فَائِدَة
headings.english: Benefit

segments.arabic: بِالْبَعْثِ ولقاء الله
segments.english: with the resurrection and meeting God

segments.arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ كَمَا تشقق عَن النَّبَات
segments.english: [on] the day the earth splits open from them, just as it splits open from plants

segments.arabic: فَيخْرجُونَ سرَاعًا من غير مهلة وَلَا بطء
segments.english: and they [will] come out quickly, without delay or slowness

segments.arabic: ذَلِك حشر يسير عَلَيْهِ سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: that [is a] gathering [that is] easy for Him, glorified [is] He

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَنه عَالم بِمَا يَقُول أعداؤه
segments.english: Then He — glorified [is] He — informed that He [is] knowing of what His enemies say

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ يتضمّن مجازاته لَهُم بقَوْلهمْ إِذْ لم يخف عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and that implies His repaying them for their words, since [nothing] [was] hidden from Him

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يذكر علمه وَقدرته لتحقيق الْجَزَاء
segments.english: and He — glorified [is] He — mentions His knowledge and His power to confirm the repayment

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبرهُ أَنه لَيْسَ بمسلط عَلَيْهِم وَلَا قهّار
segments.english: Then He informed him that he [is] not [a] dominator over them, nor [a] compeller

segments.arabic: وَلم يبْعَث ليجبرهم على الْإِسْلَام ويكرههم عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and he was not sent to force them into Islam or compel them to [accept] it

segments.arabic: وَأمره أَن يذكر بِكَلَامِهِ من يخَاف وعيده
segments.english: and He commanded him to remind with His words whoever fears His warning

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ الَّذِي ينْتَفع بالتذكير
segments.english: for he [is] the one who benefits from the reminder

segments.arabic: وَأما من لَا يُؤمن بلقائه وَلَا يخَاف وعيده وَلَا يَرْجُو ثَوَابه
segments.english: As for whoever does not believe in meeting Him, nor fears His warning, nor hopes for His reward

segments.arabic: فَلَا ينْتَفع بالتذكير
segments.english: then he does not benefit from the reminder

segments.arabic: قَول النَّبِي لعمر
segments.english: The saying of the Prophet to Umar:

segments.arabic: وَمَا يدْريك أَن الله اطّلع على أهل بدر فَقَالَ اعْمَلُوا مَا شِئْتُم فقد غفرت لكم
segments.english: "And what would make you know that God looked upon the people of Badr and said: 'Do whatever you wish, for I have forgiven you'"

segments.arabic: أشكل على كثير من النَّاس مَعْنَاهُ
segments.english: its meaning [has] confused many of the people

segments.arabic: فَإِن ظَاهره
segments.english: for its apparent [meaning]

segments.arabic: إِبَاحَة كل الْأَعْمَال لَهُم وتخييرهم فِيمَا شاؤا مِنْهَا
segments.english: permitting all deeds for them and giving them the choice in whatever they wished of them,

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ مُمْتَنع
segments.english: and that [is] impossible.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَت طَائِفَة مِنْهُم ابْن الْجَوْزِيّ
segments.english: So [a] group said, among them Ibn al-Jawzi:

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ المُرَاد من قَوْله اعْمَلُوا الِاسْتِقْبَال
segments.english: the intended [meaning] of His saying 'do [as you wish]' [is] not the future,

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ للماضي وَتَقْدِيره أَي عمل كَانَ لكم فقد غفرته
segments.english: rather it [is] for the past, and its meaning [is]: whatever deed was done by you, I have [already] forgiven it.

segments.arabic: قَالَ وَيدل على ذَلِك شَيْئَانِ
segments.english: He said: and two things point to that.

segments.arabic: أَحدهمَا أَنه لَو كَانَ للمستقبل كَانَ جَوَابه قَوْله فسأغفر لكم
segments.english: The first [is] that if it were for the future, the response [would] have been His saying: 'then I will forgive you.'

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي أَنه كَانَ يكون إطلاقا فِي الذُّنُوب وَلَا وَجه لذَلِك
segments.english: And the second [is] that it would be [a] blanket permission regarding sins, and there [is] no basis for that.

segments.arabic: وَحَقِيقَة هَذَا الْجَواب أَنِّي قد غفرت لكم بِهَذِهِ الْغَزْوَة مَا سلف من ذنوبكم
segments.english: And the reality of this answer [is]: I have forgiven you, through this battle, whatever preceded of your sins.

segments.arabic: لكنه ضَعِيف من وَجْهَيْن
segments.english: However, it [is] weak for two reasons.

segments.arabic: أَحدهمَا أَن لفظ اعْمَلُوا يأباه
segments.english: The first [is] that the wording of 'do [as you wish]' rejects this,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ للاستقبال دون الْمَاضِي
