segments.english: for it [is] for the future, not the past.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله قد غفرت لكم لَا يُوجب أَن يكون اعْمَلُوا مثله
segments.english: And His saying 'I have forgiven you' does not require that 'do [as you wish]' be the same [tense] as it.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قَوْله قد غفرت تَحْقِيق لوُقُوع الْمَغْفِرَة فِي الْمُسْتَقْبل
segments.english: For His saying 'I have forgiven' [is a] confirmation of the occurrence of forgiveness in the future,

segments.arabic: كَقَوْلِه
segments.english: like His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَتَى أَمر الله﴾
segments.english: The command of God has come

segments.arabic: وَجَاء رَبك ونظائره
segments.english: and 'your Lord has come,' and similar [examples].

segments.arabic: الثَّانِي أَن نفس الحَدِيث يردّه
segments.english: The second [is] that the hadith itself refutes it,

segments.arabic: فَإِن سَببه قصّة حَاطِب
segments.english: for its cause [was] the story of Hatib.

segments.arabic: وتجسسه على النَّبِي
segments.english: and his spying on the Prophet

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ ذَنْب وَاقع بعد غَزْوَة بدر لَا قبلهَا
segments.english: and that [was a] sin that occurred after the Battle of Badr, not before it

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سَبَب الحَدِيث فَهُوَ مُرَاد مِنْهُ قطعا
segments.english: and it [is] the cause of the hadith, so it [is] intended by it with certainty

segments.arabic: فَالَّذِي نظن فِي ذَلِك وَالله أعلم
segments.english: So what we think regarding that — and God knows best —

segments.arabic: أَن هَذَا خطاب لقوم قد علم الله سُبْحَانَهُ أنّهم لَا يفارقون دينهم
segments.english: [is] that this [is] an address to a people [whom] God, glorified [is] He, knew that they would not leave their religion

segments.arabic: بل يموتون على الْإِسْلَام
segments.english: but [rather] they would die upon Islam

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ قد يقارفون بعض مَا يقارفه غَيرهم من الذُّنُوب
segments.english: and that they may commit some of what others commit of sins

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن لَا يتركهم سُبْحَانَهُ مصرِّين عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: but He, glorified [is] He, does not leave them persisting in them

segments.arabic: بل يوفّقهم لتوبة نصوح واستغفار وحسنات تمحو أثر ذَلِك
segments.english: but [rather] He guides them to sincere repentance and seeking forgiveness and good deeds that erase the trace of that

segments.arabic: وَيكون تخصيصهم بِهَذَا دون غَيرهم
segments.english: And their being singled out with this, apart from others, [is]

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ قد تحقق ذَلِك فيهم وَأَنَّهُمْ مغْفُور لَهُم
segments.english: because that was realized in them, and that they [are] forgiven

segments.arabic: وَلَا يمْنَع ذَلِك كَون الْمَغْفِرَة حصلت بِأَسْبَاب تقوم بهم
segments.english: And that does not prevent [the fact] that the forgiveness came about through causes that they carried out

segments.arabic: كَمَا لَا يَقْتَضِي ذَلِك أَن يعطّلوا الْفَرَائِض وثوقا بالمغفرة
segments.english: just as that does not require that they abandon the obligations [out of] trust in the forgiveness

segments.arabic: فَلَو كَانَت قد حصلت بِدُونِ الِاسْتِمْرَار على الْقيام بالأوامر
segments.english: For if it had come about without continuing to fulfill the commands

segments.arabic: لما احتاجوا بعد ذَلِك إِلَى صَلَاة وَلَا صِيَام وَلَا حج وَلَا زَكَاة وَلَا جِهَاد
segments.english: they would not have needed after that [any] prayer, nor fasting, nor pilgrimage, nor charity, nor striving

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا محَال
segments.english: and this [is] impossible

segments.arabic: وَمن أوجب الْوَاجِبَات التَّوْبَة بعد الذَّنب
segments.english: And among the most obligatory of obligations [is] repentance after sin

segments.arabic: فضمان الْمَغْفِرَة لَا يوجّب تَعْطِيل أَسبَاب الْمَغْفِرَة
segments.english: So the guarantee of forgiveness does not require abandoning the means of forgiveness

segments.arabic: وَنَظِير هَذَا قَوْله فِي الحَدِيث الآخر
segments.english: And similar to this [is] His saying in the other hadith:

segments.arabic: أذْنب عبد ذَنبا فَقَالَ أَي ربّ أذنبت ذَنبا فاغفره لي فغفر لَهُ
segments.english: "A servant committed a sin and said: 'O my Lord, I committed a sin, so forgive me,' so He forgave him."

segments.arabic: ثمَّ مكث مَا شَاءَ الله أَن يمْكث
segments.english: "Then he remained [as long] as God willed him to remain."

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أذْنب ذَنبا آخر فَقَالَ أَي ربّ أصبت ذَنبا فَاغْفِر لي فغفر لَهُ
segments.english: "Then he committed another sin and said: 'O my Lord, I have committed a sin, so forgive me,' so He forgave him."

segments.arabic: ثمَّ مكث مَا شَاءَ الله أَن يمْكث
segments.english: "Then he remained [as long] as God willed him to remain."

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أذْنب ذَنبا آخر فَقَالَ رب أصبت ذَنبا فاغفره لي
segments.english: "Then he committed another sin and said: 'My Lord, I have committed a sin, so forgive me.'"

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ الله علم عَبدِي أَن لَهُ رَبًّا يغْفر الذَّنب وَيَأْخُذ بِهِ
segments.english: "So God said: 'My servant knew that he has a Lord who forgives sin and holds [one] accountable for it.'"

segments.arabic: قد غفرت لعبدي فليعمل مَا شَاءَ
segments.english: "'I have forgiven My servant, so let him do what he wills.'"

segments.arabic: فَلَيْسَ فِي هَذَا إِطْلَاق وَإِذن مِنْهُ سُبْحَانَهُ لَهُ فِي المحرّمات والجرائم
segments.english: So there [is] not in this [a] free pass or permission from Him, glorified [is] He, for him regarding forbidden things and crimes

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا يدل على أَنه يغْفر لَهُ مَا دَامَ كَذَلِك إِذا أذْنب تَابَ
segments.english: Rather, it indicates that He forgives him as long as he [is] like that — whenever he sins, he repents

headings.arabic: فائدة جليلة قوله تعالى
headings.english: [A] Great Benefit — [God] Most High's saying

segments.arabic: واختصاص هَذَا العَبْد بِهَذَا لِأَنَّهُ قد علم أَنه لَا يصر على ذَنْب وَأَنه كلما أذْنب تَابَ
segments.english: And the singling out of this servant with this [is] because He knew that he [would] not persist upon [a] sin, and that whenever he sinned he repented —

segments.arabic: حكم يعم كل من كَانَت حَاله حَاله
segments.english: [this is a] ruling [that] includes everyone whose condition [was] his condition.

segments.arabic: لَكِن ذَلِك العَبْد مَقْطُوع لَهُ بذلك كَمَا قطع بِهِ لأهل بدر
segments.english: But that servant [was] guaranteed that, just as it was guaranteed for the people of Badr.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ كل من بشّره رَسُول الله بِالْجنَّةِ أَو أخبرهُ بِأَنَّهُ مغْفُور لَهُ
segments.english: And likewise everyone whom the Messenger of God gave glad tidings of Paradise, or told him that he [was] forgiven —

segments.arabic: لم يفهم مِنْهُ هُوَ وَلَا غَيره من الصَّحَابَة إِطْلَاق الذُّنُوب والمعاصي لَهُ ومسامحته بترك الْوَاجِبَات
segments.english: neither he nor anyone else among the Companions understood from it [a] free pass for sins and disobedience for him, or [that] he [was] excused from leaving the obligations.

segments.arabic: بل كَانَ هَؤُلَاءِ أَشد اجْتِهَادًا وحذرا وخوفا بعد الْبشَارَة مِنْهُم قبلهَا
segments.english: Rather, these [people] were more striving, more cautious, and more fearful after the glad tidings than [they were] before it —

segments.arabic: كالعشرة الْمَشْهُود لَهُم بِالْجنَّةِ
segments.english: like the ten [who were] testified for [with] Paradise.

segments.arabic: وَقد كَانَ الصديّق شَدِيد الحذر والمخافة وَكَذَلِكَ عمر
segments.english: And Abu Bakr the Truthful was intense [in] caution and fear, and likewise [was] Umar.

segments.arabic: فَلهم علمُوا أَن الْبشَارَة الْمُطلقَة مقيّدة بشروطها والاستمرار عَلَيْهَا إِلَى الْمَوْت
segments.english: So they knew that the unconditional glad tidings [was] restricted by its conditions and [by] continuing upon them until death,

segments.arabic: ومقيدة بانتقاء موانعها
segments.english: and restricted by the absence of its obstacles.

segments.arabic: وَلم يفهم أحد مِنْهُم من ذَلِك الْإِطْلَاق الْإِذْن فِيمَا شاؤا من الْأَعْمَال
segments.english: And not one of them understood from that unrestricted [promise] permission [to do] whatever they wished of deeds.

segments.arabic: ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي جعل لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا مِنْ رِزْقِهِ وَإِلَيْهِ النشور﴾
segments.english: He [is] the One who made the earth easy [for] you, so walk in its paths and eat from His provision, and to Him [is] the resurrection.
segments.sahih_international: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

segments.arabic: أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَنه جعل الأَرْض ذلولا منقادة للْوَطْء عَلَيْهَا وحفرها وشقّها وَالْبناء عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: He — glorified [is] He — told [us] that He made the earth easy [and] yielding to be stepped upon, dug into, split open, and built upon,

segments.arabic: وَلم يَجْعَلهَا مستصعبة ممتنعة على من أَرَادَ ذَلِك مِنْهَا
segments.english: and He did not make it difficult [or] refusing for whoever wanted that from it.

segments.arabic: وَأخْبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَنه جعلهَا مهادا وفراشا وبساطا وقرارا وكفاتا
segments.english: And He — glorified [is] He — told [us] that He made it [a] cradle, [a] bed, [a] spread, [a] resting place, and [a] gathering [place].

segments.arabic: وَأخْبر أَنه دحاها وطحاها
segments.english: And He told [us] that He spread it out and flattened it,

segments.arabic: وَأخرج مِنْهَا ماءها ومرعاها
segments.english: and brought out from it its water and its pasture,

segments.arabic: وثبَّتها بالجبال ونهج فِيهَا الفجاج والطرق
segments.english: and made it firm with mountains and carved through it the wide passes and roads,

segments.arabic: وأجرى فِيهَا الْأَنْهَار والعيون
segments.english: and made the rivers and springs flow through it,

segments.arabic: وَبَارك فِيهَا وقدّر فِيهَا أقواتها
segments.english: and blessed it and set within it its provisions.

segments.arabic: وَمن بركتها أَن الْحَيَوَانَات كلهَا وأرزاقها وأقواتها تخرج مِنْهَا
segments.english: And from its blessing [is] that all creatures and their food and provisions come out from it.

segments.arabic: وَمن بركاتها أَنَّك تودع فِيهَا الْحبّ فتخرجه لَك أَضْعَاف أَضْعَاف مَا كَانَ
segments.english: And from its blessings [is] that you place the seed in it, and it brings it out for you many times over what it was.

segments.arabic: وَمن بركاتها أَنَّهَا تحمل الْأَذَى على ظهرهَا وَتخرج لَك من بَطنهَا أحسن الْأَشْيَاء وأنفعها
segments.english: And from its blessings [is] that it carries the filth upon its back and brings out for you from its belly the most beautiful and useful things.

segments.arabic: فتوارى مِنْهُ كل قَبِيح وَتخرج لَهُ كل مليح
segments.english: So it hides from him every ugly thing and brings out for him every beautiful thing.

segments.arabic: وَمن بركتها أَنَّهَا تستر قبائح العَبْد وفضلات بدنه وتواريها
segments.english: And from its blessing [is] that it covers the servant's shameful things and his body's waste and hides them,

segments.arabic: وتضمّه وتؤويه وَتخرج لَهُ طَعَامه وَشَرَابه
segments.english: and it holds him and shelters him and brings out for him his food and his drink.

segments.arabic: فَهِيَ أحمل شَيْء للأذى وأعوده بالنفع
segments.english: So it [is] the most bearing thing of harm and the most returning with benefit.

segments.arabic: فَلَا كَانَ من التُّرَاب خير مِنْهُ وَأبْعد من الْأَذَى وَأقرب إِلَى الْخَيْر
segments.english: And there [is] nothing from the dust better than it, nor further from harm, nor closer to good.

headings.arabic: فائدة للإنسان قوتان قوة علمية نظرية وقوة عملية إرادية وسعادته
headings.english: A Benefit: The human has two powers — a power of knowledge and thought, and a power of action and will — and his happiness

segments.arabic: وَالْمَقْصُود أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ جعل لنا الأَرْض كَالْجمَلِ الذلول الَّذِي كَيْفَمَا يُقَاد ينقاد
segments.english: And the point [is] that He — glorified [is] He — made the earth for us like the tame camel that however it [is] led, it follows.

segments.arabic: وَحسن التَّعْبِير بمناكبها عَن طرقها وفجاجها لما تقدّم من وصفهَا بِكَوْنِهَا ذلولا
segments.english: And how good [is] the expression with 'its shoulders' for its paths and wide roads, because of what preceded of describing it as tame.

segments.arabic: فالماشي عَلَيْهَا يطَأ على مناكبها وَهُوَ أَعلَى شَيْء فِيهَا
segments.english: So the one walking on it steps on its shoulders, and that [is] the highest thing on it.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا فسرت المناكب بِالْجَبَلِ كمناكب الْإِنْسَان وَهِي أعاليه
segments.english: And for this [reason], the 'shoulders' were explained as the mountains — like the shoulders of [a] person, and they [are] its high parts.

segments.arabic: قَالُوا وَذَلِكَ تَنْبِيه على أَن الْمَشْي فِي سهولها أيسر
segments.english: They said: and that [is] [a] hint that walking in its flat lands [is] easier.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَت طَائِفَة بل المناكب الجوانب والنواحي وَمِنْه مناكب الْإِنْسَان لجوانبه
segments.english: And [a] group said: rather, the 'shoulders' [are] the sides and regions — and from this [are] the shoulders of [a] person, [meaning] his sides.

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِي يظْهر أَن المُرَاد بالمناكب الأعالي
segments.english: And what appears [correct is] that what [is] meant by 'shoulders' [is] the high parts.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا الْوَجْه الَّذِي يمشي عَلَيْهِ الْحَيَوَان هُوَ العالي من الأَرْض دون الْوَجْه الْمُقَابل لَهُ
segments.english: And this surface on which creatures walk — it [is] the upper [part] of the earth, not the opposite surface.

segments.arabic: فان سطح الكرة أَعْلَاهَا وَالْمَشْي إِنَّمَا يَقع فِي سطحها
segments.english: For the surface of the sphere [is] its highest [part], and walking only happens on its surface.

segments.arabic: وَحسن التَّعْبِير عَنهُ بالمناكب لما تقدّم من وصفهَا بِأَنَّهَا ذَلُول
segments.english: And how good [is] the expression for it with 'shoulders,' because of what preceded of describing it as tame.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أَمرهم أَن يَأْكُلُوا من رزقه الَّذِي أودعهُ فِيهَا
segments.english: Then He commanded them to eat from His provision that He placed in it.

segments.arabic: فذلّلها لَهُم ووطّأها وفتق فِيهَا السبل والطرق الَّتِي يَمْشُونَ فِيهَا وأودعها رزقهم
segments.english: So He made it tame for them and made it smooth, and opened up in it the ways and paths that they walk in, and placed in it their provision.

segments.arabic: فَذكر تهيئة الْمسكن للِانْتِفَاع والتقلب فِيهِ بالذهاب والمجيء
segments.english: So He mentioned the preparation of the dwelling for benefit and moving about in it by going and coming,

segments.arabic: وَالْأكل مِمَّا أودع فِيهَا للساكن
segments.english: and eating from what He placed in it for the dweller.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ نبّه بقوله وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ على أنّا فِي هَذَا الْمسكن غير مستوطنين وَلَا مقيمين
segments.english: Then He drew attention with His saying 'and to Him [is] the resurrection' — that we [are] in this dwelling not settling and not staying.

segments.arabic: بل دخلناه عابري سَبِيل
segments.english: Rather, we entered it [as] passersby.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يحسن أَن نتخذه وطنا ومستقرّا
segments.english: So it [is] not fitting that we take it [as] [a] homeland and [a] permanent place.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا دخلناه لنتزوّد مِنْهُ إِلَى دَار الْقَرار
segments.english: Rather, we only entered it to take provision from it for the abode of permanence.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ منزل عبور لَا مُسْتَقر حبور ومعبر وممر لَا وَطن ومستقر
segments.english: So it [is] [a] place of passing, not [a] place of joy — [a] crossing and [a] passage, not [a] homeland and [a] permanent place.

segments.arabic: فتضمّنت الْآيَة الدّلَالَة على ربوبيّته ووحدانيّته وَقدرته وحكمته ولطفه
segments.english: So the verse contained [the] evidence of His lordship, His oneness, His power, His wisdom, and His gentleness,

segments.arabic: والتذكير بنعمه وإحسانه والتحذير من الركون إِلَى الدُّنْيَا واتخاذها وطنا ومستقرا
segments.english: and [a] reminder of His blessings and His goodness, and [a] warning against leaning toward this world and taking it [as] [a] homeland and [a] permanent place.

segments.arabic: بل نسرع فِيهَا السّير إِلَى دَاره وجنّته
segments.english: Rather, we should hasten in it the journey to His abode and His Paradise.

segments.arabic: فَالله فِي مَا ضمن هَذِه الْآيَة من مَعْرفَته وتوحيده والتذكير بنعمه
segments.english: So [how great is] God in what this verse contains of knowing Him, [affirming] His oneness, and reminding of His blessings,

segments.arabic: والحث على السّير إِلَيْهِ والاستعداد للقائه والقدوم عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and urging the journey to Him, and preparing for meeting Him and arriving before Him,

segments.arabic: والإعلام بِأَنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ يطوي هَذِه الدَّار كَأَن لم تكن
segments.english: and the announcement that He — glorified [is] He — [will] fold up this abode as if it never was,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه يحي أَهلهَا بعد مَا أماتهم وَإِلَيْهِ النشور
segments.english: and that He [will] bring its people to life after He caused them to die — and to Him [is] the resurrection.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة
segments.english: [A] Benefit

segments.arabic: للْإنْسَان قوتان قُوَّة علمية نظرية وَقُوَّة عملية إرادية
segments.english: The human has two powers: [a] power of knowledge [and] thought, and [a] power of action [and] will.

segments.arabic: وسعادته التَّامَّة مَوْقُوفَة على استكمال قوتيه العلمية الارادية
segments.english: And his complete happiness [is] dependent on perfecting his two powers — the [power] of knowledge and the [power] of will.

segments.arabic: واستكمال الْقُوَّة العلمية إِنَّمَا يكون بِمَعْرِفَة
segments.english: And perfecting the power of knowledge [is] only [achieved] through knowing —

segments.arabic: فاطره وبارئه
segments.english: his Creator and his Originator

segments.arabic: وَمَعْرِفَة أَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاته
segments.english: and knowledge of His names and attributes

segments.arabic: وَمَعْرِفَة الطَّرِيق الَّتِي توصل إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and knowledge of the path that leads to Him

segments.arabic: وَمَعْرِفَة آفاتها
segments.english: and knowledge of its dangers

segments.arabic: وَمَعْرِفَة نَفسه وَمَعْرِفَة عيوبها
segments.english: and knowledge of his self and knowledge of its flaws

segments.arabic: فبهذه المعارف الْخَمْسَة يحصل كَمَال قوته العلمية
segments.english: So by these five types of knowledge, the perfection of his intellectual faculty [is] achieved.

segments.arabic: وَأعلم النَّاس أعرفهم بهَا وأفقههم فِيهَا
segments.english: And the most knowledgeable of people [are] those who know them best and have the deepest understanding of them.

segments.arabic: استكمال الْقُوَّة العلمية الإرادية لَا تحصل إِلَّا بمراعاة حُقُوقه سُبْحَانَهُ على العَبْد
segments.english: Completing the volitional faculty [is] not achieved except by observing His rights — glorified [is] He — upon the servant

segments.arabic: وَالْقِيَام بهَا إخلاصا وصدقا وَنصحا وإحسانا ومتابعة
segments.english: and fulfilling them [with] sincerity, truthfulness, good counsel, excellence, and following [the Prophet]

segments.arabic: وشهودا لمنّته عَلَيْهِ وتقصيره هُوَ فِي أَدَاء حقّه
segments.english: and witnessing His favor upon him, and his own falling short in fulfilling His right

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مستحي من مواجهته بِتِلْكَ الْخدمَة
segments.english: So he [is] ashamed of presenting that service before Him

segments.arabic: لعلمه أَنَّهَا دون مَا يستحقّه عَلَيْهِ وَدون دون ذَلِك
segments.english: knowing that it [is] less than what He deserves from him — and far less than that.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه لَا سَبِيل لَهُ إِلَى استكمال هَاتين القوتين إِلَّا بمعونته
segments.english: And that [there is] no way for him to complete these two faculties except by His help.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مُضْطَر إِلَى أَن يهديه الصِّرَاط الْمُسْتَقيم الَّذِي هدى إِلَيْهِ أولياءه وخاصّته
segments.english: So he [is] in desperate need [for God] to guide him [to] the straight path — the one He guided His close servants and chosen ones to

segments.arabic: وَأَن يجنّبه الْخُرُوج عَن ذَلِك الصِّرَاط
segments.english: and to keep him away from departing from that path

segments.arabic: إِمَّا بِفساد فِي قوته العلمية فَيَقَع فِي الضلال
segments.english: either by corruption in his intellectual faculty, so he falls into misguidance

segments.arabic: واما فِي قوّته العملية فَيُوجب لَهُ الْغَضَب
segments.english: or in his practical faculty, which brings upon him [God's] anger.

segments.arabic: فكمال الْإِنْسَان وسعادته لَا تتمّ إِلَّا بِمَجْمُوع هَذِه الْأُمُور
segments.english: So the perfection of the human being and his happiness [are] not complete except by the combination of these matters.

segments.arabic: وَقد تضمنّتها سُورَة الْفَاتِحَة وانتظمتها أكمل انتظام
segments.english: And Surah al-Fatihah has contained them and arranged them in the most complete arrangement.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قَوْله
segments.english: For His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿الْحَمد لله رب الْعَالَمِينَ﴾
segments.english: All praise [is] for God, Lord of all the worlds

segments.arabic: ﴿الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ﴾
segments.english: the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful

segments.arabic: ﴿مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ﴾
segments.english: Master of the Day of Judgment

segments.arabic: يتضمّن الأَصْل الأوّل وَهُوَ معرفَة الرب تَعَالَى
segments.english: contains the first foundation, which [is] knowledge of the Lord, Most High

segments.arabic: وَمَعْرِفَة أَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاته وأفعاله
segments.english: and knowledge of His names, attributes, and actions.

segments.arabic: والأسماء الْمَذْكُورَة فِي هَذِه السُّورَة هِيَ أصُول الْأَسْمَاء الْحسنى
segments.english: And the names mentioned in this surah — they [are] the foundations of the Beautiful Names

segments.arabic: وَهِي اسْم الله والرب والرحمن
segments.english: and they [are]: the name 'Allah,' 'the Lord,' and 'the Most Merciful.'

segments.arabic: فاسم الله متضمّن لصفات الألوهيّة
segments.english: So the name 'Allah' contains the attributes of divinity

segments.arabic: وَاسم الرب متضمّن الربوبية
segments.english: and the name 'the Lord' contains [the attributes of] lordship

segments.arabic: وَاسم الرَّحْمَن مُتَضَمّن لصفات الْإِحْسَان والجود وَالْبر
segments.english: and the name 'the Most Merciful' contains the attributes of goodness, generosity, and kindness.

segments.arabic: ومعاني أَسْمَائِهِ تَدور على هَذَا
segments.english: And the meanings of His names revolve around this.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ﴾
segments.english: You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help

segments.arabic: يتضمّن معرفَة الطَّرِيق الموصلة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: contains knowledge of the path that leads to Him

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهَا لَيست إِلَّا عِبَادَته وَحده بِمَا يحبّه ويرضاه واستعانته على عِبَادَته
segments.english: and that it [is] nothing but worshipping Him alone with what He loves and [is] pleased with, and seeking His help in worshipping Him.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاط الْمُسْتَقيم﴾
segments.english: Guide us [to] the straight path

segments.arabic: يتضمّن بَيَان أَن العَبْد لَا سَبِيل لَهُ إِلَى سعادته إِلَّا باستقامته على الصِّرَاط الْمُسْتَقيم
segments.english: contains [a] clarification that the servant has no way to his happiness except by being steadfast on the straight path

segments.arabic: وَأَنه لَا سَبِيل لَهُ إِلَى الاسْتقَامَة إِلَّا بهداية ربه لَهُ
segments.english: and that he has no way to steadfastness except by his Lord's guidance to him

segments.arabic: كَمَا لَا سَبِيل لَهُ إِلَى عِبَادَته بمعونته
segments.english: just as he has no way to His worship except by His help.

segments.arabic: فَلَا سَبِيل لَهُ إِلَى الاسْتقَامَة على الصِّرَاط إِلَّا بهدايته
segments.english: So he has no way to steadfastness on the path except by His guidance.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا الضَّالِّينَ﴾
segments.english: not [the path] of those [who earned Your] anger upon them, nor of those [who are] astray
segments.sahih_international: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.

segments.arabic: يتضمّن بَيَان طرفِي الانحراف عَن الصِّرَاط الْمُسْتَقيم
segments.english: contains [a] clarification of the two sides of deviation from the straight path.

segments.arabic: وَأَن الانحراف إِلَى أحد الطَّرفَيْنِ انحراف إِلَى الضلال الَّذِي هُوَ فَسَاد الْعلم والاعتقاد
segments.english: And that deviation to one of the two sides [is] deviation to misguidance, which [is] the corruption of knowledge and belief

segments.arabic: والانحراف إِلَى الطّرف الآخر انحراف إِلَى الْغَضَب الَّذِي سَببه فَسَاد الْقَصْد وَالْعَمَل
segments.english: and deviation to the other side [is] deviation to [God's] anger, the cause of which [is] corruption of intention and action.

headings.arabic: فائدة الرب تعالى يدعو عباده في القرآن إلى معرفته من طريقين أحدهما
headings.english: Benefit: The Lord Most High calls His servants in the Quran to know Him through two paths

segments.arabic: فأوّل السُّورَة رَحْمَة وأوسطها هِدَايَة وَآخِرهَا نعْمَة
segments.english: So the beginning of the surah [is] mercy, its middle [is] guidance, and its end [is] blessing.

segments.arabic: وحظ العَبْد من النِّعْمَة على قدر حظّه من الْهِدَايَة وحظّه مِنْهَا على قدر حظّه من الرَّحْمَة
segments.english: And the servant's share of blessing [is] according to his share of guidance, and his share of it [is] according to his share of mercy.

segments.arabic: فَعَاد الْأَمر كلّه إِلَى نعْمَته وَرَحمته
segments.english: So the whole matter returns to His blessing and His mercy.

segments.arabic: وَالنعْمَة وَالرَّحْمَة من لَوَازِم ربوبيّته فَلَا يكون إِلَّا رحِيما منعما
segments.english: And blessing and mercy [are] from the necessities of His lordship, so He [can] only be merciful, [a] giver of blessings.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ من مُوجبَات الهيّته فَهُوَ الْإِلَه الْحق
segments.english: And that [is] from what His divinity requires, so He [is] the true God.

segments.arabic: وَإِن جَحده الجاحدون وَعدل بِهِ الْمُشْركُونَ
segments.english: Even if the deniers deny Him and those who associate partners [with God] set up equals to Him.

segments.arabic: فَمن تحقّق بمعاني الْفَاتِحَة علما وَمَعْرِفَة وَعَملا وَحَالا فقد فَازَ من كَمَاله بأوفر نصيب
segments.english: So whoever realizes the meanings of Al-Fatihah — in knowledge, understanding, action, and state — [he] has won the fullest share of perfection.

segments.arabic: وَصَارَت عبوديّته عبوديّة الخاصّة الَّذين ارْتَفَعت درجتهم عَن عوام المتعبّدين
segments.english: And his worship becomes the worship of the elite — those whose rank [has] risen above the common worshippers.

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: And God [is] the One whose help [is] sought.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة
segments.english: Benefit:

segments.arabic: الرب تَعَالَى يَدْعُو عباده فِي الْقُرْآن إِلَى مَعْرفَته من طَرِيقين
segments.english: The Lord Most High calls His servants in the Quran to know Him through two paths.

segments.arabic: أَحدهمَا النّظر فِي مفعولاته
segments.english: The first [is] looking at His created works.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي التفكر فِي آيَاته وتدبّرها
segments.english: And the second [is] reflecting on His verses and pondering them.

segments.arabic: فَتلك آيَاته المشهودة وَهَذِه آيَاته المسموعة المعقولة
segments.english: So those [are] His witnessed signs, and these [are] His heard and understood signs.

segments.arabic: فالنوع الأوّل كَقَوْلِه
segments.english: The first type [is] like His saying:

segments.arabic: إِنَّ فِي خلق السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَالْفُلْكِ الَّتِي تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِمَا يَنْفَعُ النَّاسَ
segments.english: Indeed in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of the night and the day, and the ships that sail in the sea with what benefits people...
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and earth, and the alternation of the night and the day, and the [great] ships which sail through the sea with that which benefits people, and what Allah has sent down from the heavens of rain, giving life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and dispersing therein every [kind of] moving creature, and [His] directing of the winds and the clouds controlled between the heaven and the earth are signs for a people who use reason.

segments.arabic: إِلَى آخرهَا
segments.english: ...to the end of it.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: إِنَّ فِي خلق السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآياتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَاب
segments.english: Indeed in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of the night and the day, [there are] surely signs for people of understanding.
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ كثير فِي الْقُرْآن
segments.english: And this [is] frequent in the Quran.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي كَقَوْلِه
segments.english: And the second [is] like His saying:

segments.arabic: أَفَلا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآن
segments.english: Do they not then ponder the Quran?

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا القَوْل
segments.english: Have they not then pondered the Word?

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِيَدَّبَّرُوا آيَاته
segments.english: [It is a] blessed Book [that] We sent down to you, so that they may ponder its verses.
segments.sahih_international: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ كثير أَيْضا
segments.english: And this [is] frequent as well.

segments.arabic: فأمّا المفعولات فَإِنَّهَا دالّة على الْأَفْعَال وَالْأَفْعَال دالّة على الصِّفَات
segments.english: As for the created works, they point to [His] actions, and [His] actions point to [His] attributes.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْمَفْعُول يدل على فَاعل فعله
segments.english: For the created thing points to [a] doer who did it.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ يسْتَلْزم وجوده وَقدرته ومشيئته وَعلمه
segments.english: And that necessarily implies His existence, His power, His will, and His knowledge.

segments.arabic: لِاسْتِحَالَة صُدُور الْفِعْل الِاخْتِيَارِيّ من مَعْدُوم
segments.english: Because [it is] impossible for [a] chosen action to come from something nonexistent,

segments.arabic: أَو مَوْجُود لَا قدرَة لَهُ وَلَا حَيَاة وَلَا علم وَلَا إِرَادَة
segments.english: or from something that exists [but] has no power, no life, no knowledge, and no will.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ مَا فِي المفعولات من التخصيصات المتنوعة دالّ على إِرَادَة الْفَاعِل
segments.english: Then what [is] in the created works of various distinctions points to the will of the Doer,

segments.arabic: وَأَن فعله لَيْسَ بالطبع بِحَيْثُ يكون وَاحِدًا غير متكرر
segments.english: and that His action [is] not by nature — such that it would be one [and] not repeated.

segments.arabic: وَمَا فِيهَا من الْمصَالح وَالْحكم والغايات المحمودة دَال على حكمته تَعَالَى
segments.english: And what [is] in them of benefits, wisdoms, and praiseworthy purposes points to His wisdom, Most High.

segments.arabic: وَمَا فِيهَا من النَّفْع وَالْإِحْسَان وَالْخَيْر دَال على رَحمته
segments.english: And what [is] in them of benefit, goodness, and good [is] pointing to His mercy.

segments.arabic: وَمَا فِيهَا من الْبَطْش والانتقام والعقوبة دَال
segments.english: And what [is] in them of force, retribution, and punishment [is] pointing —

headings.arabic: فائدة في المسند وصحيح أبي الحاتم من حديث عبد الله بن مسعود قال
headings.english: [A] Benefit — from the Musnad and Sahih of Abu Hatim, from the hadith of Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, [who] said

segments.arabic: على غَضَبه
segments.english: of His anger.

segments.arabic: وَمَا فِيهَا من الْإِكْرَام والتقريب والعناية دَال على محبّته
segments.english: And what [is] in them of honoring, drawing near, and care [is] a sign of His love.

segments.arabic: وَمَا فِيهَا من الإهانة والإبعاد والخذلان دَال على بغضه ومقته
segments.english: And what [is] in them of humiliation, distancing, and abandonment [is] a sign of His hatred and disgust.

segments.arabic: وَمَا فِيهَا من ابْتِدَاء الشَّيْء فِي غَايَة النَّقْص والضعف ثمَّ سوقه إِلَى تَمَامه ونهايته دَال على وُقُوع الْمعَاد
segments.english: And what [is] in them of the beginning of [a] thing in the utmost lack and weakness, then driving it toward its completion and end, [is] a sign of the occurrence of the Return.

segments.arabic: وَمَا فِيهَا من أَحْوَال النَّبَات وَالْحَيَوَان وَتصرف الْمِيَاه دَلِيل على إِمْكَان الْمعَاد
segments.english: And what [is] in them of the states of plants and animals and the movement of waters [is] proof of the possibility of the Return.

segments.arabic: وَمَا فِيهَا من ظُهُور آثَار الرَّحْمَة وَالنعْمَة على خلقه دَلِيل على صحّة النبوّات
segments.english: And what [is] in them of the appearance of traces of mercy and blessing upon His creation [is] proof of the soundness of the prophethoods.

segments.arabic: وَمَا فِيهَا من الكمالات الَّتِي لَو عدمتها كَانَت نَاقِصَة دَلِيل على أَن معطي تِلْكَ الكمالات أَحَق بهَا
segments.english: And what [is] in them of perfections — which if they lacked [them], they would be lacking — [is] proof that the giver of those perfections [is] more deserving of them.

segments.arabic: فمفعولاته من أدل شَيْء على صِفَاته وَصدق مَا أخْبرت بِهِ رسله عَنهُ
segments.english: So His works [are] among the greatest signs of His attributes and [of] the truthfulness of what His messengers reported about Him.

segments.arabic: فالمصنوعات شاهدة تصدق الْآيَات المسموعات
segments.english: So the created things [are] witnesses confirming the heard verses,

segments.arabic: منبّهة على الِاسْتِدْلَال بِالْآيَاتِ المصنوعات
segments.english: drawing attention to seeking proof through the created signs.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿سَنُرِيهِمْ آيَاتِنَا فِي الْآفَاقِ وَفِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ﴾
segments.english: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and in themselves, until it becomes clear to them that it [is] the Truth.
segments.sahih_international: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?

segments.arabic: أَي أَن الْقُرْآن حق
segments.english: meaning that the Quran [is] truth.

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر أنّه لَا بُد من أَن يُرِيهم من آيَاته المشهودة مَا يبيّن لَهُم أَن آيَاته المتلوّة حق
segments.english: So He informed that He must show them from His witnessed signs what makes clear to them that His recited verses [are] truth.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أخبر بكفاية شَهَادَته على صِحَة خَبره بِمَا أَقَامَ من الدَّلَائِل والبراهين على صدق رَسُوله
segments.english: Then He informed of the sufficiency of His testimony to the soundness of His message, through what He established of proofs and evidence for the truthfulness of His messenger.

segments.arabic: فآياته شاهدة بصدقه وَهُوَ شَاهد بِصدق رَسُوله بآياته
segments.english: So His signs [are] witnesses to His truthfulness, and He [is] [a] witness to the truthfulness of His messenger through His signs.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ الشَّاهِد والمشهود لَهُ وَهُوَ الدَّلِيل والمدلول عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And He [is] the Witness and the One witnessed for, and He [is] the Proof and the One proven.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ الدَّلِيل بِنَفسِهِ على نَفسه
segments.english: So He [is] the proof by Himself of Himself,

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ بعض العارفين كَيفَ أطلب لدَلِيل على من هُوَ دَلِيل على كل شَيْء
segments.english: as some of the knowers said: How [can] I seek [a] proof for the One who [is] [a] proof of everything?

segments.arabic: فَأَي دَلِيل طلبته عَلَيْهِ فَوَجَدَهُ أظهر مِنْهُ
segments.english: So whatever proof you seek for Him, His existence [is] more evident than it.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَ الرُّسُل لقومهم
segments.english: And for this [reason] the messengers said to their people:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَفِي اللَّهِ شَكّ﴾
segments.english: [Is there] about God [any] doubt?

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ أعرف من كل مَعْرُوف وَأبين من كل دَلِيل
segments.english: So He [is] more known than everything known, and clearer than every proof.

segments.arabic: فالأشياء عُرفت بِهِ فِي الْحَقِيقَة
segments.english: So things [are] known through Him in reality,

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ عُرف بهَا فِي النّظر وَالِاسْتِدْلَال بأفعاله وَأَحْكَامه عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: even if He [is] known through them in reasoning and deduction — through His actions and rulings — back to Him.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة فِي الْمسند وصحيح أبي الحاتم من حَدِيث عبد الله بن مَسْعُود قَالَ
segments.english: [A] Benefit — In the Musnad and Sahih of Abu Hatim, from the hadith of Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, [who] said:

segments.arabic: قَالَ رَسُول الله مَا أصَاب عبدا هم وَلَا حزن فَقَالَ
segments.english: The Messenger of God said: No worry or sadness strikes [a] servant, and he says:

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبدك وَابْن عَبدك ابْن أمتك
segments.english: O God, I [am] Your servant, and the son of Your servant, the son of Your female servant.

segments.arabic: ناصيتي بِيَدِك مَاض فِي حكمك عدل فِي قضاؤك
segments.english: My forelock [is] in Your hand. Your judgment upon me [is] past. Your decree concerning me [is] just.

segments.arabic: أَسأَلك بِكُل اسْم هُوَ لَك سميت بِهِ نَفسك
segments.english: I ask You by every name that [is] Yours, [that] You named Yourself [with],

segments.arabic: أَو أنزلته فِي كتابك أَو علّمته أحدا من خلقك أَو استأثرت
segments.english: or sent down in Your Book, or taught [to] anyone of Your creation, or kept exclusively

segments.arabic: بِهِ فِي علم الْغَيْب عنْدك أَن تجْعَل الْقُرْآن ربيع قلبِي وَنور صَدْرِي وجلاء حزني وَذَهَاب همّي وغمّي
segments.english: by it in the knowledge of the unseen with You — that You make the Quran the spring of my heart, and the light of my chest, and the clearing of my sadness, and the removal of my worry and grief

segments.arabic: إِلَّا أذهب الله همه وغمه وأبدله مَكَانَهُ فَرحا
segments.english: except that God [will] remove his worry and grief, and replace it in its place [with] joy.

segments.arabic: قَالُوا يَا رَسُول الله أَفلا نتعلّمهن
segments.english: They said: O Messenger of God, should we not learn them?

segments.arabic: قَالَ بلَى يَنْبَغِي لمن سمعهن أَن يتعلّمهن
segments.english: He said: Yes, it [is] fitting for whoever hears them to learn them.

segments.arabic: فتضمّن هَذَا الحَدِيث الْعَظِيم أمورا من الْمعرفَة والتوحيد والعبوديّة
segments.english: So this great hadith contained matters of knowledge, monotheism, and servitude.

segments.arabic: مِنْهَا أَن الدَّاعِي بِهِ صدَّر سُؤَاله بقوله إِنِّي عَبدك ابْن عَبدك ابْن أمتك
segments.english: Among them [is] that the one calling by it opened his request with his saying: "I [am] Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your female servant."

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يتَنَاوَل مَن فَوْقه من آبَائِهِ وأمهاته إِلَى أَبَوَيْهِ آدم وحوّاء
segments.english: And this includes those above him from his fathers and mothers, [going back] to his [first] parents Adam and Eve.

segments.arabic: وَفِي ذَلِك تملّق لَهُ واستخذا بَين يَدَيْهِ واعتراف بِأَنَّهُ مَمْلُوكه وآباؤه مماليكه
segments.english: And in that [is] humbling [oneself] before Him, and submission before Him, and acknowledgment that he [is] His property and his fathers [are] His property.

segments.arabic: وَأَن العَبْد لَيْسَ لَهُ غير بَاب سيّده وفضله وإحسانه
segments.english: And that the servant has nothing except the door of his Master, and His generosity, and His kindness.

segments.arabic: وَأَن سيّده إِن أهمله وتخلّى عَنهُ هلك وَلم يُؤوه أحد وَلم يعْطف عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And that if his Master neglects him and abandons him, he [will] perish, and no one [will] shelter him, and no one [will] show him kindness.

segments.arabic: بل يضيع أعظم ضَيْعَة
segments.english: Rather, he [will] be lost [with] the greatest loss.

segments.arabic: فتحت هَذَا الِاعْتِرَاف أَنِّي لَا غنى بِي عَنْك طرفَة عين
segments.english: So beneath this acknowledgment [is]: I have no independence from You [for] the blink of an eye.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ لي من أعوذ بِهِ وألوذ بِهِ غير سيّدي الَّذِي أَنا عَبده
segments.english: And I have no one to seek refuge in and take shelter in other than my Master, whose servant I [am].

segments.arabic: وَفِي ضمن ذَلِك الِاعْتِرَاف بِأَنَّهُ مربوب مدبّر مَأْمُور مَنْهِيّ
segments.english: And within that [is] the acknowledgment that he [is one] governed, managed, commanded, [and] prohibited.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا يتصرّف بِحكم العبوديّة لَا بِحكم الِاخْتِيَار لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: He only acts by the rule of servitude, not by the rule of free choice for himself.

segments.arabic: فَلَيْسَ هَذَا شَأْن العَبْد بل شَأْن الْمُلُوك والأحرار
segments.english: For this [is] not the business of the servant, but [rather] the business of kings and free people.

segments.arabic: وَأما العبيد فتعرفهم على مَحْض العبوديّة
segments.english: As for the servants, their conduct [is] upon pure servitude.

segments.arabic: فَهَؤُلَاءِ عبيد الطَّاعَة المضافون إِلَيْهِ سُبْحَانَهُ فِي قَوْله
segments.english: So these [are] the servants of obedience, attributed to Him — glorified [is] He — in His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِم سُلْطَان﴾
segments.english: "Indeed, My servants — you have no authority over them."
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الأَرْض هونا﴾
segments.english: "And the servants of the Most Merciful [are] those who walk upon the earth humbly."
segments.sahih_international: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,

segments.arabic: وَمن عداهم عبيد الْقَهْر والربوبية
segments.english: And those other than them [are] servants of [His] power and lordship.

segments.arabic: فأضافتهم إِلَيْهِ كإضافة سَائِر الْبيُوت إِلَى ملكه
segments.english: So their attribution to Him [is] like the attribution of all [other] houses to His ownership.

segments.arabic: وَإِضَافَة أُولَئِكَ كإضافة الْبَيْت الْحَرَام إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And the attribution of those [first ones is] like the attribution of the Sacred House to Him,

segments.arabic: اضافة نَاقَته إِلَيْهِ وداره الَّتِي هِيَ الْجنَّة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: [and like] the attribution of His she-camel to Him, and His home — which [is] Paradise — to Him.

segments.arabic: وَإِضَافَة عبودية رَسُوله إِلَيْهِ بقوله
segments.english: And [like] the attribution of the servitude of His Messenger to Him, in His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِمَّا نَزَّلْنَا على عَبدنَا﴾
segments.english: "And if you [are] in doubt about what We sent down upon Our servant."
segments.sahih_international: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down upon Our Servant [Muhammad], then produce a surah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses other than Allah, if you should be truthful.

segments.arabic: ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي أَسْرَى بِعَبْدِهِ﴾
segments.english: "Glorified [is] the One who took His servant [on a] night journey."

segments.arabic: ﴿وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ﴾
segments.english: "And that when the servant of God stood up calling upon Him."
segments.sahih_international: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."

segments.arabic: وَفِي التَّحْقِيق بِمَعْنى قَوْله أَنِّي عَبدك
segments.english: And in realizing the meaning of his saying "I [am] Your servant" —

segments.arabic: الْتِزَام عبوديته من الذل والخضوع والإنابة وامتثال أَمر سيّده وَاجْتنَاب نَهْيه
segments.english: [there is] commitment to His servitude, through humility, submission, turning [to Him], obeying the command of his Master, and avoiding His prohibition,

segments.arabic: ودوام الافتقار اليه واللجأ إِلَيْهِ والاستعانة بِهِ والتوكّل عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and constant neediness toward Him, and seeking refuge in Him, and seeking help from Him, and reliance [on God],

segments.arabic: وعياذ العَبْد بِهِ ولياذه بِهِ
segments.english: and the servant's seeking protection in Him and taking shelter in Him,

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم لَا يتعلّق قلبه بِغَيْرِهِ محبّة وخوفا ورجاء
segments.english: and that his heart does not attach to anyone other than Him — [in] love, fear, and hope.

segments.arabic: وَفِيه أَيْضا أَنِّي عبد من جَمِيع الْوُجُوه صَغِيرا وكبيرا حيّا وميّتا ومطيعا وعاصيا معافى ومبتلى
segments.english: And in it also [is]: I [am a] servant from every angle — young and old, alive and dead, obedient and disobedient, healthy and tested.

segments.arabic: بِالروحِ وَالْقلب وَاللِّسَان والجوارح
segments.english: [In] spirit, heart, tongue, and limbs.

segments.arabic: وَفِي أَيْضا أَن مَالِي وَنَفْسِي ملك لَك فَإِن العَبْد وَمَا
segments.english: And in it also [is] that my wealth and my self [are] owned by You, for the servant and what —

segments.arabic: يملك لسيّده
segments.english: [a slave] owns [nothing] for his master.

segments.arabic: وَفِيه أَيْضا أَنَّك أَنْت الَّذِي مننت عليَّ بِكُل مَا أَنا فِيهِ من نعْمَة
segments.english: And in it also [is] that You [are] the One who granted me every blessing I [am] in.

segments.arabic: فَذَلِك كلّه من إنعامك على عَبدك
segments.english: So that — all of it — [is] from Your favor upon Your servant.

segments.arabic: وَفِيه أَيْضا أَنِّي لَا أتصرّف فِيمَا خوّلتني من مَالِي وَنَفْسِي إِلَّا بِأَمْرك
segments.english: And in it also [is] that I do not manage what You have given me of my wealth and my self except by Your command,

segments.arabic: كَمَا لَا يتصرّف العَبْد إِلَّا بِإِذن سيّده
segments.english: just as the servant does not act except by the permission of his master.

segments.arabic: وَأَنِّي لَا أملك لنَفْسي ضرّا وَلَا نفعا وَلَا موتا وَلَا حَيَاة وَلَا نشورا
segments.english: And that I do not possess for myself [any] harm, nor benefit, nor death, nor life, nor resurrection.

segments.arabic: فَإِن صحّ لَهُ شُهُود ذَلِك فقد قَالَ أَنِّي عَبدك حَقِيقَة
segments.english: So if witnessing that [is] sound for him, then he has truly said "I [am] Your servant."

segments.arabic: ثمَّ قَالَ ناصيتي بِيَدِك
segments.english: Then he said: "My forelock [is] in Your hand,"

segments.arabic: أَي أَنْت المتصرّف فيَّ تصرّفي كَيفَ تشَاء
segments.english: meaning: You [are] the one managing me, directing me however You will.

segments.arabic: لست أَنا المتصرّف فِي نَفسِي
segments.english: I [am] not the one managing my own self.

segments.arabic: وَكَيف يكون لَهُ فِي نَفسه تصرّف من نَفسه بيد ربه وسيده وناصيته بِيَدِهِ
segments.english: And how can he have control over himself when his self [is] in the hand of his Lord and Master, and his forelock [is] in His hand,

segments.arabic: وَقَلبه بَين أصبعين من أَصَابِعه
segments.english: and his heart [is] between two fingers of His fingers,

segments.arabic: وَمَوته وحياته وسعادته وشقاوته وعافيته وبلاؤه كُله إِلَيْهِ سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: and his death and his life, his happiness and his misery, his well-being and his trial — all of it [is] up to Him, glorified [is] He.

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ إِلَى العَبْد مِنْهُ شَيْء
segments.english: [There] is not for the servant any of it [at all].

segments.arabic: بل هُوَ فِي قَبْضَة سَيّده أَضْعَف من مَمْلُوك ضَعِيف حقير ناصيته بيد سُلْطَان قاهر مَالك لَهُ تَحت تصرّفه وقهره
segments.english: Rather, he [is] in the grip of his Master, weaker than [a] weak, lowly slave whose forelock [is] in the hand of [an] overpowering king who owns him, under his control and his power.

segments.arabic: بل الْأَمر فَوق ذَلِك
segments.english: Rather, the matter [is] above that.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى شهد العَبْد أَن ناصيته ونواصي الْعباد كلهَا بيد الله وَحده يصرفهم كَيفَ يَشَاء
segments.english: And whenever the servant witnesses that his forelock and the forelocks of all the servants [are] in the hand of God alone, He directs them however He wills,

segments.arabic: لم يخفهم بعد ذَلِك وَلم يرجهم
segments.english: he [will] not fear them after that, and [will] not hope in them,

segments.arabic: وَلم ينزلهم منزلَة المالكين بل منزلَة عبيد مقهورين مربوبين
segments.english: and [will] not place them in the position of owners, but [rather] in the position of overpowered, owned slaves.

segments.arabic: المتصرّف فيهم سواهُم والمدبّر لَهُم غَيرهم
segments.english: The one managing them [is] other than them, and the one directing them [is] other than them.

segments.arabic: فَمن شهد نَفسه بِهَذَا المشهد صَار فقره وضرورته إِلَى ربه وَصفا لَازِما لَهُ
segments.english: So whoever witnesses himself with this witnessing, his poverty and his need for his Lord become [a] permanent quality of his.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى شهد النَّاس كَذَلِك لم يفْتَقر إِلَيْهِم وَلم يعلّق أمله ورجاءه بهم
segments.english: And whenever he witnesses people likewise, he [will] not be in need of them, and [will] not attach his hope and expectation to them.

segments.arabic: فاستقام توحيده وتوكّله وعبوديته
segments.english: So his monotheism, his reliance [on God], and his servitude become upright.

segments.arabic: وَلذَا قَالَ هود لِقَوْمِهِ
segments.english: And for this reason, Hud said to his people:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنِّي تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ مَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي على صِرَاط مُسْتَقِيم﴾
segments.english: "Indeed I have relied upon God, my Lord and your Lord. [There is] no creature except that He [is] seizing [it] by its forelock. Indeed my Lord [is] on [a] straight path."
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, I have relied upon Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds its forelock. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight."

segments.arabic: وَقَوله مَاض فيَّ حكمك عدل فِي قضاؤك
segments.english: And his saying: "Your decree [is] carried out upon me, [and] Your judgment [is] just"

segments.arabic: تضمّن هَذَا الْكَلَام أَمريْن
segments.english: — this statement contains two matters.

segments.arabic: أَحدهمَا مضاء حكمه فِي عَبده
segments.english: The first of them [is] the carrying out of His decree upon His servant.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي يتضمّن حَمده وعدله
segments.english: And the second includes His praise and His justice.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ لَهُ الْملك وَله الْحَمد
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, to Him [belongs] the sovereignty and to Him [belongs] the praise.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا معنى قَول نبيّه هود
segments.english: And this [is] the meaning of the saying of His prophet Hud:

segments.arabic: ﴿مَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا﴾
segments.english: "[There is] no creature except that He [is] seizing [it] by its forelock."

segments.arabic: ثمَّ قَالَ
segments.english: Then he said:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي على صِرَاط مُسْتَقِيم﴾
segments.english: "Indeed my Lord [is] on [a] straight path."

segments.arabic: أَي مَعَ كَونه مَالِكًا قاهرًا متصرّفا فِي عباده نواصيهم بِيَدِهِ
segments.english: Meaning: along with Him being [an] Owner, Overpowerer, [and] Manager of His servants — their forelocks [are] in His hand —

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ على صِرَاط مُسْتَقِيم وَهُوَ الْعدْل الَّذِي يتصرّف بِهِ فيهم
segments.english: He [is] on [a] straight path, and it [is] the justice by which He manages them.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ على صِرَاط مُسْتَقِيم فِي قَوْله وَفعله وقضائه وَقدره وَأمره وَنَهْيه وثوابه وعقابه
segments.english: So He [is] on [a] straight path in His speech, His action, His judgment, His decree, His command, His prohibition, His reward, and His punishment.

segments.arabic: فخبره كُله صدق وقضاؤه كلّه عدل وَأمره كُله مصلحَة
segments.english: So His news [is] all truthful, His judgment [is] all just, and His command [is] all good.

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِي نهى عَنهُ كُله مفسدة
segments.english: And what He prohibited [is] all harmful.

segments.arabic: وثوابه لمن يسْتَحق الثَّوَاب بفضله وَرَحمته
segments.english: And His reward [is] for whoever deserves the reward, by His grace and His mercy.

segments.arabic: وعقابه لمن يسْتَحق الْعقَاب بعدله وحكمته
segments.english: And His punishment [is] for whoever deserves the punishment, by His justice and His wisdom.

segments.arabic: وَفرق بَين
segments.english: And [there is a] difference between

segments.arabic: الحكم وَالْقَضَاء وَجعل المضاء للْحكم وَالْعدْل لقَضَاء
segments.english: the ruling and the decree, and He made execution for the ruling and justice for the decree.

segments.arabic: فَإِن حكمه سُبْحَانَهُ يتَنَاوَل حكمه الديني الشَّرْعِيّ وَحكمه الكوني القدري
segments.english: For His ruling — glorified [is] He — covers His religious, legislative ruling and His universal, decreed ruling.

segments.arabic: والنوعان نافذان فِي العَبْد ان ماضيان فِيهِ
segments.english: And the two types [are] effective upon the servant, carried out upon him.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ مقهور تَحت الْحكمَيْنِ قد مضيا فِيهِ ونفذا فِيهِ شَاءَ أم أَبى
segments.english: And he [is] overpowered under the two rulings — they have been carried out upon him and executed upon him, whether he willed or refused.

segments.arabic: لَكِن الحكم الكوني لَا يُمكنهُ مُخَالفَته
segments.english: But the universal ruling — he cannot go against it.

segments.arabic: وَأما الديني الشَّرْعِيّ فقد يُخَالِفهُ
segments.english: As for the religious, legislative [ruling], he may go against it.

segments.arabic: وَلما كَانَ الْقَضَاء هُوَ الْإِتْمَام والإكمال وَذَلِكَ إِنَّمَا يكون بعد مضيه ونفوذه
segments.english: And since the decree — it [is] the completion and the fulfillment, and that only comes after it has been carried out and executed —

segments.arabic: قَالَ عدل فيَّ قضاؤك
segments.english: he said: 'Your decree upon me [is] just'

segments.arabic: أَي الحكم الَّذِي أكملته وأتممته ونفّذته فِي عَبدك عدل مِنْك فِيهِ
segments.english: meaning: the ruling that You completed and fulfilled and executed upon Your servant [is] justice from You in it.

segments.arabic: وَأما الحكم فَهُوَ مَا يحكم بِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَقد يَشَاء تنفيذه وَقد لَا ينفذهُ
segments.english: As for the ruling, it [is] what He — glorified [is] He — rules with, and He may will its execution, and He may not execute it.

segments.arabic: فَإِن كَانَ حكما دينيا فَهُوَ مَاض فِي العَبْد
segments.english: So if it [was] a religious ruling, then it [is] carried out upon the servant.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ كونيا فَإِن نفذه سُبْحَانَهُ مضى فِيهِ
segments.english: And if it [was] a universal [ruling], then if He — glorified [is] He — executed it, it [was] carried out upon him.

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم ينفّذه انْدفع عَنهُ
segments.english: And if He did not execute it, it [was] repelled from him.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يقْضِي مَا يقْضِي بِهِ
segments.english: So He — glorified [is] He — decrees what He decrees.

segments.arabic: وَغَيره قد يقْضِي بِقَضَاء وَيقدر أَمر وَلَا يَسْتَطِيع تنفيذه
segments.english: And other than Him may decree [a] decree and determine [a] matter, yet not be able to execute it.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يقْضِي ويمضي فَلهُ الْقَضَاء والإمضاء
segments.english: And He — glorified [is] He — decrees and carries out, so to Him [belongs] the decree and the execution.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله عدل فيَّ قضاؤك يتَضَمَّن جَمِيع أقضيته فِي عَبده من كل الْوُجُوه
segments.english: And his saying 'Your decree upon me [is] just' includes all of His decrees upon His servant from every angle —

segments.arabic: من صِحَة وسقم وغنى وفقر ولذّة وألم وحياة وَمَوْت وعقوبة وَتجَاوز وَغير ذَلِك
segments.english: of health and illness, and wealth and poverty, and pleasure and pain, and life and death, and punishment and pardon, and other than that.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ مِنْ مُصِيبَة فِيمَا كسبت أَيْدِيكُم
segments.english: [God] Most High said: 'And whatever strikes you of hardship [is] because of what your hands have earned.'

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ الْأِنْسَانَ كفور﴾
segments.english: And if [a] bad thing strikes them because of what their hands have put forward, then indeed man [is] ungrateful.
segments.sahih_international: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.

segments.arabic: فَكل مَا يقْضى على العَبْد فَهُوَ عدل فِيهِ
segments.english: So everything that [is] decreed upon the servant — it [is] justice upon him.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قيل فالمعصية عنْدكُمْ بِقَضَائِهِ وَقدره فَمَا وَجه الْعدْل فِي قَضَائهَا
segments.english: So if it [is] said: 'Disobedience, according to you, [is] by His decree and His destiny — so what [is] the angle of justice in decreeing it?'

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْعدْل فِي الْعقُوبَة عَلَيْهَا ظَاهر
segments.english: 'For the justice in punishing for it [is] clear.'

segments.arabic: قيل هَذَا سُؤال لَهُ شَأْن
segments.english: [It is] said: this [is] a question of importance.

segments.arabic: وَمن أَجله زعمت طَائِفَة أَن الْعدْل هُوَ الْمَقْدُور وَالظُّلم مُمْتَنع لذاته
segments.english: And because of it, [a] group claimed that justice [is] whatever [is] decreed, and injustice [is] impossible in itself.

segments.arabic: قَالُوا لِأَن الظُّلم هُوَ التصرّف فِي ملك الْغَيْر
segments.english: They said: 'Because injustice [is] acting in the property of another.'

segments.arabic: وَالله لَهُ كل شَيْء فَلَا يكون تصرّفه فِي خلقه إِلَّا عدلا
segments.english: 'And God owns everything, so His acting upon His creation can only be justice.'

segments.arabic: وَقَالَت طَائِفَة بل الْعدْل أَنه لَا يُعَاقب على مَا قَضَاهُ وَقدره
segments.english: And [another] group said: 'Rather, justice [is] that He does not punish for what He decreed and destined.'

segments.arabic: فلمّا حسن مِنْهُ الْعقُوبَة على الذَّنب عُلم أنّه لَيْسَ بِقَضَائِهِ وَقدره
segments.english: 'So since punishing for the sin [was] fitting from Him, it [is] known that it [is] not by His decree and His destiny.'

segments.arabic: فَيكون الْعدْل هُوَ جَزَاؤُهُ على الذَّنب بالعقوبة والذم
segments.english: 'So justice [is] His repaying the sin with punishment and blame —'

segments.arabic: إِمَّا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَإِمَّا فِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: either in this world or in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وصعب على هَؤُلَاءِ الْجمع بَين الْعدْل وَبَين الْقدر
segments.english: And it [was] difficult for these [people] to combine between justice and destiny.

segments.arabic: فزعموا أَن من أثبت الْقدر لم يُمكنهُ أَن يَقُول بِالْعَدْلِ
segments.english: So they claimed that whoever affirmed destiny could not hold to justice,

segments.arabic: وَمن قَالَ بِالْعَدْلِ لم يُمكنهُ أَن يَقُول بِالْقدرِ
segments.english: and whoever held to justice could not hold to destiny.

segments.arabic: كَمَا صَعب عَلَيْهِم الْجمع بَين التَّوْحِيد وَإِثْبَات الصِّفَات
segments.english: Just as it [was] difficult for them to combine between monotheism and affirming the attributes [of God].

segments.arabic: فزعموا أَنه لَا يُمكنهُم إِثْبَات التَّوْحِيد إِلَّا بإنكار الصِّفَات
segments.english: So they claimed that they could not affirm monotheism except by denying the attributes.

segments.arabic: فَصَارَ توحيدهم تعطيلا
segments.english: So their monotheism became denial.

segments.arabic: وعدلهم تَكْذِيبًا بِالْقدرِ
segments.english: and their justice [is] a denial of [divine] decree.

segments.arabic: وَأما أهل السّنة فهم مثبتون للأمرين
segments.english: As for the people of the Sunnah, they affirm both matters.

segments.arabic: وَالظُّلم عِنْدهم هُوَ وضع الشَّيْء فِي غير مَوْضِعه
segments.english: And wrongdoing according to them — it [is] placing [a] thing in other than its [proper] place,

segments.arabic: كتعذيب الْمُطِيع وَمن لَا ذَنْب لَهُ
segments.english: like punishing the obedient one and the one who has no sin.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا قد نزّه الله نَفسه عَنهُ فِي غير مَوضِع من كِتَابه
segments.english: And this — God has declared Himself far above it in more than one place in His Book.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ وَإِن أضلّ من شَاءَ وَقضى بالمعصية والغي على من شَاءَ
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, even if He misguided whom He willed and decreed disobedience and misguidance upon whom He willed —

segments.arabic: فَذَلِك مَحْض الْعدْل فِيهِ
segments.english: then that [is] pure justice in it,

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ وضع الإضلال والخذلان فِي مَوْضِعه اللَّائِق بِهِ
segments.english: because He placed the misguidance and the abandonment in its fitting place.

segments.arabic: كَيفَ وَمن أَسْمَائِهِ الْحسنى الْعدْل
segments.english: How [could it be otherwise] when among His most beautiful names [is] the Just —

segments.arabic: الَّذِي كل أَفعاله وَأَحْكَامه سداد وصواب وَحقّ
segments.english: the One whose every action and ruling [is] sound, correct, and true.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ قد أوضح السبل وَأرْسل الرُّسُل وَأنزل الْكتب وأزاح الْعِلَل
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, has made clear the paths, sent the messengers, sent down the books, and removed the excuses,

segments.arabic: ومكّن من أَسبَاب الْهِدَايَة وَالطَّاعَة بالأسماع والأبصار والعقول
segments.english: and enabled the means of guidance and obedience through hearing, sight, and minds.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا عدله
segments.english: And this [is] His justice.

segments.arabic: ووفّق من شَاءَ بمزيد عناية وَأَرَادَ من نَفسه أَن يُعينهُ ويوفّقه
segments.english: And He granted success to whom He willed with extra care, and He willed from Himself to help him and guide him to success —

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا فَضله
segments.english: so this [is] His grace.

segments.arabic: وخذل من لَيْسَ بِأَهْل لتوفيقه وفضله وخلى بَينه وَبَين نَفسه
segments.english: And He abandoned the one who [was] not worthy of His guidance and His grace, and left him to himself,

segments.arabic: وَلم يرد سُبْحَانَهُ من نَفسه أَن يوفّقه
segments.english: and He did not will, glorified [is] He, from Himself to grant him success.

segments.arabic: فَقطع عَنهُ فَضله وَلم يحرمه عدله
segments.english: So He cut off from him His grace, but did not deprive him of His justice.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا نَوْعَانِ
segments.english: And this [is of] two types.

segments.arabic: أَحدهمَا مَا يكون جَزَاء مِنْهُ للْعَبد على إعراضه عَنهُ
segments.english: The first [is] what [comes] as repayment from Him to the servant for his turning away from Him,

segments.arabic: وإيثار عدوه فِي الطَّاعَة والموافقة عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and preferring His enemy in obedience and agreement over Him,

segments.arabic: وتناسي ذكره وشكره
segments.english: and forgetting His remembrance and gratitude [to Him].

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ أهل أَن يَخْذُلهُ ويتخلى عَنهُ
segments.english: So he [is] deserving of [God] abandoning him and leaving him.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي أَن لَا يَشَاء لَهُ ذَلِك ابْتِدَاء
segments.english: And the second [is] that He does not will that for him from the start,

segments.arabic: لما يعلم مِنْهُ أَنه لَا يعرف قدر نعْمَة الْهِدَايَة وَلَا يشكره عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: because of what He knows about him — that he would not recognize the value of the blessing of guidance, nor thank Him for it,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يثني عَلَيْهِ بهَا وَلَا يُحِبهُ
segments.english: nor praise Him for it, nor love Him.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يشاؤها لَهُ لعدم صَلَاحِية مَحَله
segments.english: So He does not will it for him because of the unsuitability of his place [for it].

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَكَذَلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لِيَقُولُوا أَهَؤُلاءِ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَم بِالشَّاكِرِينَ﴾
segments.english: "And likewise We tested some of them by others, so that they would say: '[Are] these the ones God has favored from among us?' [Is] God not most knowing of the grateful?"
segments.sahih_international: And thus We have tried some of them through others that the disbelievers might say, "Is it these whom Allah has favored among us?" Is not Allah most knowing of those who are grateful?

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَلَوْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا لأسمعهم﴾
segments.english: "And if God had known any good in them, He would have made them hear."
segments.sahih_international: Had Allah known any good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He had made them hear, they would [still] have turned away, while they were refusing.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا قضى على هَذِه النُّفُوس بالضلال وَالْمَعْصِيَة كَانَ ذَلِك مَحْض الْعدْل
segments.english: So when He decrees upon these souls misguidance and disobedience, that [is] pure justice,

segments.arabic: كَمَا إِذا قضى على الحيّة بِأَن تقتل وعَلى الْعَقْرَب وعَلى الْكَلْب الْعَقُور
segments.english: just as when He decrees that the snake [is] to be killed, and the scorpion, and the biting dog —

segments.arabic: كَانَ ذَلِك عدلا فِيهِ وَإِن كَانَ مخلوقا على هَذِه الصّفة
segments.english: that [is] justice regarding it, even if it was created upon this nature.

segments.arabic: وَقد اسْتَوْفَيْنَا الْكَلَام فِي هَذَا فِي كتَابنَا الْكَبِير فِي الْقَضَاء وَالْقدر
segments.english: And we have covered the discussion on this fully in our large book on decree and destiny.

segments.arabic: وَالْمَقْصُود أَن قَوْله مَاض فِي حكمك عدل فِي قضاؤك
segments.english: And the point [is] that his saying "Your ruling [is] carried out, Your decree [is] just"

segments.arabic: رد على الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ
segments.english: [is] a response to the two groups:

segments.arabic: القدريّة الَّذين يُنكرُونَ عُمُوم أقضية الله فِي عَبده
segments.english: the Qadariyyah, who deny the generality of God's decrees over His servant,

segments.arabic: وَيخرجُونَ أَفعَال الْعباد عَن كَونهَا بِقَضَائِهِ وَقدره
segments.english: and exclude the actions of the servants from being by His decree and destiny,

segments.arabic: ويردون الْقَضَاء إِلَى الْأَمر وَالنَّهْي
segments.english: and reduce the decree to [only] the command and the prohibition;

segments.arabic: وعَلى الجبريّة الَّذين يَقُولُونَ كل مَقْدُور عدل
segments.english: and the Jabriyyah, who say every decreed thing [is] justice,

segments.arabic: فَلَا يبْقى لقَوْله عدل فِي قضاؤك فَائِدَة
segments.english: so there remains no benefit in his saying "Your decree [is] just."

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْعدْل عِنْدهم كل مَا يُمكن
segments.english: For justice according to them [is] everything that [is] possible.

segments.arabic: فعله وَالظُّلم هُوَ الْمحَال لذاته
segments.english: His action. And injustice — it [is] the impossible by its very nature.

segments.arabic: فَكَأَنَّهُ قَالَ مَاض ونافذ فيّ قضاؤك
segments.english: So [it is] as if he said: Your decree [is] proceeding and effective over me.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا هُوَ الأول بِعَيْنِه
segments.english: And this [is] the first [meaning] itself.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله أَسأَلك بِكُل اسْم إِلَى آخِره
segments.english: And his saying "I ask You by every name" to the end of it —

segments.arabic: توسل إِلَيْهِ بأسمائه كلهَا مَا علم العَبْد مِنْهَا وَمَا لم يعلم
segments.english: [is] seeking means to Him through all His names — what the servant knew of them and what he did not know.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه أحب الْوَسَائِل إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And these [are] the most beloved means [of approach] to Him.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا وَسِيلَة بصفاته وأفعاله الَّتِي هِيَ مَدْلُول أَسْمَائِهِ
segments.english: For they [are] a means through His attributes and His actions, which [are] the meanings of His names.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله أَن تجْعَل الْقُرْآن ربيع قلبِي وَنور صَدْرِي
segments.english: And his saying "that You make the Quran the spring of my heart and the light of my chest" —

segments.arabic: الرّبيع الْمَطَر الَّذِي يحيي الأَرْض
segments.english: the spring [means] the rain that gives life to the earth.

segments.arabic: شبّه الْقُرْآن بِهِ لحياة الْقُلُوب بِهِ
segments.english: He compared the Quran to it because of the life of hearts through it.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ شبهه الله بالمطر
segments.english: And likewise, God compared it to the rain.

segments.arabic: وَجمع بَين المَاء الَّذِي تحصل بِهِ الْحَيَاة والنور الَّذِي تحصل بِهِ الإضاءة وَالْإِشْرَاق
segments.english: And He combined water — by which life [is] obtained — and light — by which illumination and brightness [are] obtained.

segments.arabic: كَمَا جمع بَينهمَا سُبْحَانَهُ فِي قَوْله
segments.english: Just as He — glorified [is] He — combined them both in His saying:

segments.arabic: أنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ بِقَدَرِهَا فَاحْتَمَلَ السَّيْلُ زَبَدًا رَابِيًا
segments.english: He sent down from the sky water, and valleys flowed according to their measure, and the flood carried rising foam.
segments.sahih_international: He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. And from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. Thus Allah presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allah present examples.

segments.arabic: وَمِمَّا توقدون عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّارِ ابْتِغَاء حلية
segments.english: And from what they heat upon it in the fire seeking ornaments...

segments.arabic: وفى قَوْله
segments.english: And in His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ الَّذِي اسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًا فَلَمَّا أَضَاءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهُ ذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ﴾
segments.english: Their example [is] like the example of the one who lit [a] fire, and when it illuminated what [was] around him, God took away their light.
segments.sahih_international: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ قَالَ
segments.english: Then He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ﴾
segments.english: Or like [a] rainstorm from the sky.

segments.arabic: وَفِي قَوْله اللَّهُ نور السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْضِ مَثَلُ نُورِهِ الْآيَات
segments.english: And in His saying: "God [is] the light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light..." — the [rest of the] verses.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ قَالَ أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يزجي السَّحَاب ثمَّ يؤلف بَينه الْآيَة
segments.english: Then He said: "Have you not seen that God drives the clouds, then joins between them" — the [rest of the] verse.

segments.arabic: فتضمّن الدُّعَاء أَن يحيي قلبه بربيع الْقُرْآن
segments.english: So the supplication included [asking] that He give life to his heart with the spring of the Quran,

segments.arabic: وَأَن ينوّر بِهِ صَدره فتجتمع لَهُ الْحَيَاة والنور
segments.english: and that He illuminate his chest with it, so that life and light come together for him.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَو من كَانَ مَيْتًا فَأَحْيَيْنَاهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُ نُورًا يَمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ﴾
segments.english: Or [is] one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him [a] light [by which] he walks among the people —
segments.sahih_international: And is one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him light by which to walk among the people like one who is in darkness, never to emerge therefrom? Thus it has been made pleasing to the disbelievers that which they were doing.

segments.arabic: ﴿كَمَنْ مَثَلُهُ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ لَيْسَ بِخَارِج مِنْهَا﴾
segments.english: like one whose example [is] in the darknesses, not coming out of them?

segments.arabic: وَلما كَانَ الصَّدْر أوسع من الْقلب
segments.english: And since the chest [is] wider than the heart,

segments.arabic: كَانَ النُّور الْحَاصِل لَهُ يسري مِنْهُ إِلَى الْقلب
segments.english: the light obtained by it flows from it to the heart,

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ قد حصل لما هُوَ أوسع مِنْهُ
segments.english: because it [has] reached what [is] wider than it.

segments.arabic: وَلما كَانَت حَيَاة الْبدن والجوارح كلهَا بحياة الْقلب
segments.english: And since the life of the body and all the limbs [is] through the life of the heart —

segments.arabic: تسري الْحَيَاة مِنْهُ إِلَى الصَّدْر ثمَّ إِلَى الْجَوَارِح
segments.english: life flows from it to the chest, then to the limbs —

segments.arabic: سَأَلَ الْحَيَاة لَهُ بِالربيعِ الَّذِي هُوَ مادّتها
segments.english: he asked for life for it through the spring, which [is] its source.

segments.arabic: وَلما كَانَ الْحزن والهم وَالْغَم يضاد حَيَاة الْقلب واستنارته
segments.english: And since sadness, worry, and grief oppose the life of the heart and its illumination,

segments.arabic: سَأَلَ أَن يكون ذهابها بِالْقُرْآنِ
segments.english: he asked that their removal be through the Quran.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا أَحْرَى أَن لَا تعود
segments.english: For then they [are] more likely not to return.

segments.arabic: وَأما إِذا ذهبت بِغَيْر الْقُرْآن من صِحَة أَو دنيا أَو جاه أَو زَوْجَة أَو ولد
segments.english: But if they go away through something other than the Quran — [such as] health, or worldly things, or status, or [a] wife, or [a] child —

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا تعود بذهاب ذَلِك
segments.english: then they return when that goes away.

segments.arabic: وَالْمَكْرُوه الْوَارِد على الْقلب
segments.english: And the hardship that comes upon the heart:

segments.arabic: إِن كَانَ من أَمر مَاض أحدث الْحزن
segments.english: if it [is] from [a] past matter, it produces sadness;

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ من مُسْتَقْبل أحدث الْهم
segments.english: and if it [is] from [a] future [matter], it produces worry;

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ من أَمر حَاضر أحدث الْغم
segments.english: and if it [is] from [a] present matter, it produces grief.

segments.arabic: وَالله أعلم
segments.english: And God knows best.

headings.arabic: فائدة أنزه الموجودات وأظهرها وأنورها وأشرفها وأعلاها ذاتا وقدرا
headings.english: [A] Benefit: The Purest of Existing Things, the Most Manifest, Most Radiant, Most Noble, and Highest in Essence and Worth

segments.arabic: أنزه الموجودات وأظهرها وأنورها وَأَشْرَفهَا وأعلاها ذاتا وَقدرا وأوسعها عرش الرَّحْمَن ﷻ
segments.english: The purest of existing things, the most manifest, the most radiant, the most noble, the highest in essence and worth, and the most vast [is] the Throne of the Most Merciful, mighty and majestic [is] He.

segments.arabic: وَلذَلِك صلح لاستوائه عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And because of that, it [was] fit for His rising over it.

segments.arabic: وكل مَا كَانَ أقرب إِلَى الْعَرْش كَانَ أنور وأنزه وأشرف مِمَّا بعد عَنهُ
segments.english: And everything that was closer to the Throne was more radiant, purer, and nobler than what [was] far from it.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كَانَت جنّة الفردوس أَعلَى الْجنان وَأَشْرَفهَا وأنورها وأجلّها لقربها من الْعَرْش إِذْ هُوَ سقفها
segments.english: And for this reason, the Garden of Firdaws was the highest of the gardens [of Paradise], the noblest, the most radiant, and the most exalted, due to its closeness to the Throne, since it [is] its ceiling.

segments.arabic: وكل مَا بعد عَنهُ كَانَ أظلم وأضيق
segments.english: And everything that [was] far from it was darker and more constricted.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كَانَ أَسْفَل سافلين شرّ الْأَمْكِنَة وأضيقها وأبعدها من كل خير
segments.english: And for this reason, the lowest of the low was the worst of places, the most constricted, and the farthest from every good.

segments.arabic: وَخلق الله الْقُلُوب وَجعلهَا محلا لمعرفته ومحبّته وإرادته
segments.english: And God created the hearts and made them [a] place for knowing Him, loving Him, and [having] will [directed] toward Him.

segments.arabic: فَهِيَ عرش الْمثل الْأَعْلَى الَّذِي هُوَ مَعْرفَته ومحبّته وإرادته
segments.english: So they [are] the throne of the highest description, which [is] knowing Him, loving Him, and [having] will [directed] toward Him.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوْءِ وَلِلَّهِ الْمَثَلُ الْأَعْلَى وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيم
segments.english: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter [is] the description of evil, and to God [belongs] the highest description, and He [is] the Mighty, the Wise.
segments.sahih_international: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَهُ الْمَثَلُ الْأَعْلَى فِي السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيم
segments.english: And He [is] the One who begins creation, then repeats it, and it [is] easier for Him. And to Him [belongs] the highest description in the heavens and the earth, and He [is] the Mighty, the Wise.
segments.sahih_international: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest attribute in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ كمثله شَيْء
segments.english: There [is] nothing like Him.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا من الْمثل الْأَعْلَى
segments.english: So this [is] from the highest description.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ مستو على قلب الْمُؤمن فَهُوَ عَرْشه
segments.english: And it [is] settled upon the heart of the believer, so it [is] its throne.

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم يكن أطهر الْأَشْيَاء وأنزهها وأطيبها وأبعدها من كل دنس وخبث لم يصلح لِاسْتِوَاء الْمثل الْأَعْلَى عَلَيْهِ معرفَة ومحبة وَإِرَادَة
segments.english: And if [the heart] [is] not the purest of things, the cleanest, the finest, and the farthest from every filth and corruption, it [is] not fit for the settling of the highest description upon it — [in] knowledge, love, and will.

segments.arabic: فَاسْتَوَى عَلَيْهِ مثل الدُّنْيَا الْأَسْفَل ومحبتها وإرادتها والتعلّق بهَا
segments.english: So there settles upon it the lower description of this world, its love, its pursuit, and attachment to it.

segments.arabic: فَضَاقَ وأظلم وَبعد من كَمَاله وفلاحه
segments.english: So it becomes constricted and darkened and far from its perfection and its success.

segments.arabic: حَتَّى تعود الْقُلُوب على قلبين
segments.english: Until the hearts come back [as] two [types of] hearts:

segments.arabic: قلب هُوَ عرش الرَّحْمَن فَفِيهِ النُّور والحياة والفرح وَالسُّرُور والبهجة وذخائر الْخَيْر
segments.english: [a] heart that [is] the throne of the Most Merciful — in it [is] light, life, joy, happiness, delight, and treasures of good;

segments.arabic: وقلب هُوَ عرش الشَّيْطَان فهناك الضّيق والظلمة وَالْمَوْت والحزن وَالْغَم والهم
segments.english: and [a] heart that [is] the throne of Satan — there [is] constriction, darkness, death, sadness, grief, and worry.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ حَزِين على مَا مضى مهموم بِمَا يسْتَقْبل مغموم فِي الْحَال
segments.english: So he [is] sad over what [has] passed, worried about what [is] coming, and grieved in the present.

segments.arabic: وَقد روى التِّرْمِذِيّ وَغَيره عَن النَّبِي أَنه قَالَ
