segments.english: And al-Tirmidhi and others narrated from the Prophet ﷺ that he said:

segments.arabic: إِذا دخل النُّور الْقلب انْفَسَخ وانشرح
segments.english: "When light enters the heart, it expands and opens up."

segments.arabic: قَالُوا فَمَا عَلامَة ذَلِك يَا رَسُول الله
segments.english: They said: "Then what [is] the sign of that, O Messenger of God?"

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْإِنَابَة إِلَى دَار الخلود والتجافي عَن دَار الْغرُور والاستعداد للْمَوْت قبل نُزُوله
segments.english: He said: "Turning toward the abode of eternity, pulling away from the abode of deception, and preparing for death before its arrival."

segments.arabic: والنور الَّذِي يدْخل الْقلب إِنَّمَا هُوَ آثَار الْمثل الْأَعْلَى
segments.english: And the light that enters the heart — it [is] nothing but the traces of the highest description.

segments.arabic: فَلذَلِك يَنْفَسِخ وينشرح
segments.english: So because of that, it expands and opens up.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا لم يكن فِيهِ معرفَة الله ومحبّته فحظّه الظلمَة والضيق
segments.english: And if there [is] not in it knowledge of God and love of Him, then its portion [is] darkness and constriction.

headings.arabic: فَائِدَة
headings.english: A Benefit

segments.arabic: تأمّل خطاب الْقُرْآن تَجِد ملكا لَهُ الْملك كُله وَله الْحَمد كُله
segments.english: Reflect on the address of the Quran [and] you [will] find [a] King — to Him [belongs] all the dominion, and to Him [belongs] all the praise.

segments.arabic: أزِمَّة الْأُمُور كلهَا بِيَدِهِ ومصدرها مِنْهُ ومرادها إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: The reins of all affairs [are] in His hand, their source [is] from Him, and their return [is] to Him.

segments.arabic: مستويا على سَرِير ملكه لَا تخفى عَلَيْهِ خافية فِي أقطار مَمْلَكَته
segments.english: Established upon the throne of His kingdom — no hidden thing [is] hidden from Him in [any] region of His dominion.

segments.arabic: عَالما بِمَا فِي نفوس عبيده مطّلعا على أسرارهم وعلانيتهم
segments.english: Knowing what [is] in the souls of His servants, fully aware of their secrets and what they show openly.

segments.arabic: مُنْفَردا بتدبير المملكة يسمع وَيرى وَيُعْطِي وَيمْنَع ويثيب ويعاقب
segments.english: Alone in managing the kingdom — He hears and sees, gives and withholds, rewards and punishes.

segments.arabic: وَيكرم ويهين ويخلق ويرزق وَيُمِيت ويحيي وَيقدر وَيَقْضِي
segments.english: And He honors and humbles, creates and provides, causes death and gives life, decrees and judges.

segments.arabic: ويدبّر الْأُمُور نازلة من عِنْده دقيقها وجليلها وصاعدة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And He manages all affairs — descending from Him, [both] their small and great [ones], and ascending to Him.

segments.arabic: لَا تتحرك فِي ذرّة إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ وَلَا تسْقط ورقة إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ
segments.english: Not [a] speck moves except by His permission, and not [a] leaf falls except by His knowledge.

segments.arabic: فتأمّل كَيفَ تَجدهُ يثني على نَفسه ويمجّد نَفسه ويحمد نَفسه
segments.english: So reflect [on] how you find Him praising Himself, glorifying Himself, and commending Himself.

segments.arabic: وَينْصَح عباده ويدلّهم على مَا فِيهِ سعادتهم وفلاحهم
segments.english: And He advises His servants and guides them to what contains their happiness and their success.

segments.arabic: ويرغّبهم فِيهِ ويحذّرهم مِمَّا فِيهِ هلاكهم
segments.english: And He encourages them toward it and warns them from what contains their ruin.

segments.arabic: ويتعرّف إِلَيْهِم بأسمائه وَصِفَاته ويتحبب إِلَيْهِم بنعمه وآلائه
segments.english: And He makes Himself known to them through His names and attributes, and He endears Himself to them through His blessings and favors.

segments.arabic: فيذكّرهم بنعمه عَلَيْهِم وَيَأْمُرهُمْ بِمَا يستوجبون بِهِ تَمامهَا
segments.english: So He reminds them of His blessings upon them, and commands them with what [will] earn them [the] completion of those [blessings].

segments.arabic: ويحذّرهم من نقمه
segments.english: And He warns them of His punishment.

segments.arabic: ويذكّرهم بِمَا أعد لَهُم من الْكَرَامَة إِن أطاعوه
segments.english: And He reminds them of what He [has] prepared for them of honor if they obey Him.

segments.arabic: وَمَا أعد لَهُم من الْعقُوبَة إِن عصوه
segments.english: And what He [has] prepared for them of punishment if they disobey Him.

segments.arabic: ويخبرهم بصنعه فِي أوليائه وأعدائه وَكَيف كَانَت عَاقِبَة هَؤُلَاءِ وَهَؤُلَاء
segments.english: And He tells them of His dealing with His allies and His enemies, and how [was] the end of these and those.

segments.arabic: ويثني على أوليائه بِصَالح أَعْمَالهم وَأحسن أوصافهم
segments.english: And He praises His allies for the righteousness of their deeds and the best of their qualities.

segments.arabic: ويذم أعداءه بسيء أَعْمَالهم وقبيح صفاتهم
segments.english: And He condemns His enemies for the evil of their deeds and the ugliness of their qualities.

segments.arabic: وَيضْرب الْأَمْثَال وينوّع الأدلّة والبراهين
segments.english: And He strikes examples and varies the proofs and evidences.

segments.arabic: ويجيب عَن شبه أعدائه أحسن الْأَجْوِبَة
segments.english: And He answers the doubts of His enemies with the best of answers.

segments.arabic: وَيصدق الصَّادِق ويكذب الْكَاذِب وَيَقُول الْحق وَيهْدِي السَّبِيل
segments.english: And He confirms the truthful and exposes the liar, and He speaks the truth and guides [to] the way.

segments.arabic: وَيَدْعُو إِلَى دَار السَّلَام وَيذكر أوصافها وحسنها وَنَعِيمهَا
segments.english: And He calls to the Abode of Peace, and mentions its qualities, its beauty, and its bliss.

segments.arabic: ويحذّر من دَار الْبَوَار وَيذكر عَذَابهَا وقبحها وآلامها
segments.english: And He warns of the Abode of Ruin, and mentions its punishment, its ugliness, and its pains.

segments.arabic: وَيذكر عباده فَقرهمْ إِلَيْهِ وشدّة حَاجتهم إِلَيْهِ من كل وَجه
segments.english: And He reminds His servants of their neediness toward Him and the intensity of their need for Him in every way.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ لَا غنى لَهُم عَنهُ طرفَة عين
segments.english: And that they have no independence from Him [for even] the blink of an eye.

segments.arabic: وَيذكر غناهُ عَنْهُم وَعَن جَمِيع الموجودات
segments.english: And He mentions His independence from them and from all created things.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه الْغَنِيّ بِنَفسِهِ عَن كل مَا سواهُ وكل مَا سواهُ فَقير إِلَيْهِ بِنَفسِهِ
segments.english: And that He [is] the Self-Sufficient by Himself, [free] from all that [is] other than Him, and all that [is] other than Him [is] needy toward Him by its very nature.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه لَا ينَال أحد ذرة من الْخَيْر فَمَا فَوْقهَا إِلَّا بفضله وَرَحمته
segments.english: And that no one attains [a] speck of good — or more than it — except by His grace and mercy.

segments.arabic: وَلَا ذرّة من الشَّرّ فَمَا فَوْقهَا إِلَّا بعدله وحكمته
segments.english: And not [a] speck of evil — or more than it — except by His justice and wisdom.

segments.arabic: وَيشْهد من خطابه عتابه لأحبابه ألطف عتاب
segments.english: And you witness in His address His reproach to His beloved ones — the gentlest reproach.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه مَعَ ذَلِك مقيل عثراتهم وغافر زلاتهم ومقيم أعذارهم ومصلح فسادهم والدافع
segments.english: And that He, along with that, [is the] pardoner of their stumbles, forgiver of their slips, accepter of their excuses, mender of their faults, and the one who defends —

headings.arabic: فائدة قبول المحل لما يوضع فيه مشروط بتفريغه من ضده وهذا كما أنه
headings.english: Benefit: The acceptance of [a] place for what [is] placed in it [is] conditioned on emptying it of its opposite

segments.arabic: عَنْهُم والمحامي عَنْهُم والناصر لَهُم وَالْكَفِيل بمصالحهم والمنجي لَهُم من كل كرب
segments.english: on their behalf, and the defender of them, and the helper for them, and the guarantor of their welfare, and the one who saves them from every hardship

segments.arabic: والموفي لَهُم بوعده وَأَنه وليّهم الَّذِي لَا ولي لَهُم سواهُ
segments.english: and the one who fulfills for them His promise, and that He [is] their protector — the one whom there [is] no protector for them other than Him

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مَوْلَاهُم الْحق ونصيرهم على عدوهم
segments.english: so He [is] their true Master and their helper against their enemy

segments.arabic: فَنعم الْمولى وَنعم النصير
segments.english: so how excellent [is] the Master, and how excellent [is] the Helper!

segments.arabic: فَإِذا شهِدت الْقُلُوب من الْقُرْآن ملكا عَظِيما رحِيما جوادا جميلا هَذَا شَأْنه
segments.english: So when the hearts witness from the Quran [a] King — great, merciful, generous, beautiful — this [is] His way,

segments.arabic: فَكيف لَا تحبّه وتنافس فِي الْقرب مِنْهُ
segments.english: then how can they not love Him and compete in [getting] close to Him,

segments.arabic: وتنفق أنفاسها فِي التودد إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and spend their breaths in seeking closeness to Him,

segments.arabic: وَيكون أحب إِلَيْهَا من كل مَا سواهُ
segments.english: and [He] becomes more beloved to them than everything other than Him,

segments.arabic: وَرضَاهُ آثر عِنْدهَا من رضَا كل مَا سواهُ
segments.english: and His pleasure [is] more preferred to them than the pleasure of everything other than Him?

segments.arabic: وَكَيف لَا تلهج بِذكرِهِ
segments.english: And how can they not be constantly occupied with His remembrance,

segments.arabic: وَيصير حبه والشوق إِلَيْهِ والأنس بِهِ هُوَ غذائها وقوتها ودواؤها
segments.english: and His love, and the longing for Him, and the comfort in Him become their nourishment, their strength, and their cure —

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ إِن فقدت ذَلِك فَسدتْ وَهَلَكت وَلم تَنْفَع بحياتها
segments.english: such that if they lose that, they [are] ruined and destroyed, and they do not benefit from their life?

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة قبُول الْمحل لما يوضع فِيهِ مَشْرُوط بتفريغه من ضدّه
segments.english: Benefit: The acceptance of [a] place for what [is] placed in it [is] conditioned on emptying it of its opposite.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا كَمَا أَنه فِي الذوات والأعيان فَكَذَلِك هُوَ فِي الاعتقادات والإرادات
segments.english: And this, just as it [is] in physical things and objects, so likewise it [is] in beliefs and desires.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَ الْقلب ممتلئا بِالْبَاطِلِ اعتقادا ومحبّة
segments.english: So when the heart [is] filled with falsehood — in belief and in love —

segments.arabic: لم يبْق فِيهِ لاعتقاد الْحق ومحبّته مَوضِع
segments.english: there does not remain in it for the belief of the truth and its love [any] place,

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن اللِّسَان إِذا اشْتغل بالتكلم بِمَا لَا ينفع لم يتَمَكَّن صَاحبه من النُّطْق بِمَا يَنْفَعهُ
segments.english: just as the tongue, when it [is] busy speaking what does not benefit, its owner cannot speak what benefits him,

segments.arabic: إِلَّا إِذا فزع لِسَانه من النُّطْق بِالْبَاطِلِ
segments.english: unless his tongue [is] freed from speaking falsehood.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ الْجَوَارِح إِذا اشتغلت بِغَيْر الطَّاعَة لم يُمكن شغلها بِالطَّاعَةِ إِلَّا إِذا فرغها من ضدها
segments.english: And likewise the limbs — when they [are] busy with other than obedience, it [is] not possible to occupy them with obedience unless [one] frees them from its opposite.

segments.arabic: فَكَذَلِك الْقلب المشغول بمحبّة غير الله وإرادته والشوق إِلَيْهِ والأنس بِهِ
segments.english: So likewise the heart [that is] busy with love of other than God, and desire for it, and longing for it, and comfort in it —

segments.arabic: لَا يُمكن شغله بمحبة الله وإرادته وحبه والشوق إِلَى لِقَائِه
segments.english: [it is] not possible to occupy it with love of God, and desire for Him, and love of Him, and longing to meet Him,

segments.arabic: إِلَّا بتفريغه من تعلّقه بِغَيْرِهِ
segments.english: except by emptying it of its attachment to other than Him.

segments.arabic: وَلَا حَرَكَة اللِّسَان بِذكرِهِ والجوارح بخدمته
segments.english: Nor [can] the tongue move with His remembrance, and the limbs with His service,

segments.arabic: إِلَّا إِذا فرغها من ذكر غَيره وخدمته
segments.english: unless [one] frees them from the remembrance of other than Him and service [of other than Him].

segments.arabic: فَإِذا امْتَلَأَ الْقلب بِالشغلِ بالمخلوق والعلوم الَّتِي لَا تَنْفَع
segments.english: So when the heart [is] filled with being busy with the creation and knowledge that does not benefit,

segments.arabic: لم يبْقى فِيهَا مَوضِع للشغل بِاللَّه وَمَعْرِفَة أَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاته وَأَحْكَامه
segments.english: there does not remain in it [any] place for being busy with God and knowing His names, His attributes, and His rulings.

segments.arabic: وسر ذَلِك أَن إصغاء الْقلب كإصغاء الْأذن
segments.english: And the secret of that [is] that the listening of the heart [is] like the listening of the ear.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أصغى إِلَى غير حَدِيث الله لم يبْق فِيهِ إصغاء وَلَا فهم لحديثه
segments.english: So when it listens to other than the speech of God, there does not remain in it [any] listening or understanding of His speech,

segments.arabic: كَمَا إِذا مَال إِلَى غير محبّة الله لم يبْق فِيهِ ميل إِلَى محبّته
segments.english: just as when it inclines to other than the love of God, there does not remain in it [any] inclination to His love.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا نطق الْقلب بِغَيْر ذكره لم يبْق فِيهِ مَحل للنطق بِذكرِهِ كاللسان
segments.english: So when the heart speaks with other than His remembrance, there does not remain in it [any] place for speaking His remembrance — like the tongue.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا فِي الصَّحِيح عَن النَّبِي ﷺ أَنه قَالَ
segments.english: And for this [reason], in the Sahih, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said:

segments.arabic: لِأَن يمتلىء جَوف أحدكُم قَيْحا حَتَّى يَرِيَهُ خير لَهُ من أَن يمتلىء
segments.english: "That the belly of one of you be filled with pus until it destroys him [is] better for him than to be filled —"

headings.arabic: فائدة قوله تعالى ألهاكم التكاثر إلى آخرها أخلصت هذه السورة للوعد
headings.english: Benefit: [God] Most High's saying 'Competing for more distracted you' to its end — this surah [is] devoted to the promise,

segments.arabic: شعرًا فبيّن أَن الْجوف يمتلىء بالشعر
segments.english: poetry. So he made clear that the belly becomes filled with poetry.

segments.arabic: فَكَذَلِك يمتلىء بالشبه والشكوك والخيالات والتقديرات الَّتِي لَا وجود لَهَا
segments.english: And likewise it becomes filled with false ideas, doubts, fantasies, and assumptions that have no existence,

segments.arabic: والعلوم الَّتِي لَا تَنْفَع والمفاكهات والمضاحكات والحكايات وَنَحْوهَا
segments.english: and knowledge that does not benefit, and jokes, and humor, and stories, and the like.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا امْتَلَأَ الْقلب بذلك جَاءَتْهُ حقائق الْقُرْآن
segments.english: And when the heart becomes filled with that, the truths of the Quran come to it,

segments.arabic: وَالْعلم الَّذِي بِهِ كَمَاله وسعادته
segments.english: and the knowledge by which [is] its perfection and happiness,

segments.arabic: فَلم تَجِد فِيهِ فراغا لَهَا وَلَا قبولا
segments.english: but they do not find in it [any] space for them, nor acceptance.

segments.arabic: فتعدته وجاوزته إِلَى مَحل سواهُ
segments.english: So they pass it by and go beyond it to [a] place other than it,

segments.arabic: كَمَا إِذا بذلت النَّصِيحَة لقلب ملآن من ضدها لَا منفذ لَهَا فِيهِ
segments.english: just as when advice [is] offered to [a] heart full of its opposite, [with] no way in for it.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لَا يقبلهَا وَلَا تلج فِيهِ
segments.english: For indeed it does not accept it, nor does it enter into it,

segments.arabic: لَكِن تمر مجتازة لَا مستوطنة
segments.english: but it passes through, not settling.

segments.arabic: وَلذَلِك قيل
segments.english: And for that [reason] it was said:

segments.arabic: نزّه فُؤَادك من سوانا تلقنا ... فجنابنا حل لكل منزّه
segments.english: Purify your heart from other than us, [and] you will find us — for our side [is] open to every purified one.

segments.arabic: وَالصَّبْر طلسم لكنز وصالنا ... من حل ذَا الطلسم فَازَ بكنزه
segments.english: And patience [is a] talisman for the treasure of our union — whoever unlocked this talisman won its treasure.

segments.arabic: وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And with God [is] success.

segments.arabic: الْوَعيد والتهديد وَكفى بهَا موعظة لمن عقلهَا
segments.english: the threat, and the intimidation. And it suffices as [a] lesson for whoever understands it.

segments.arabic: فَقَوله تَعَالَى أَلْهَاكُمُ أَي شغلكم على وَجه لَا تعتذرون فِيهِ
segments.english: So His saying, Most High, 'distracted you' — meaning: [it] occupied you in [a] way [where] you have no excuse.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الإلهاء عَن الشَّيْء هُوَ الِاشْتِغَال عَنهُ
segments.english: For distraction from [a] thing — it [is] being occupied away from it.

segments.arabic: فَإِن كَانَ بِقصد فَهُوَ مَحل التَّكْلِيف
segments.english: So if it was with intention, then it [is] the place of accountability.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ بِغَيْر قصد كَقَوْلِه فِي الخميصة إِنَّهَا ألهتني آنِفا عَن صَلَاتي
segments.english: And if it was without intention, like his saying about the decorated garment: 'It distracted me just now from my prayer,'

segments.arabic: كَانَ صَاحبه مَعْذُورًا وَهُوَ نوع من النسْيَان
segments.english: [then] its doer was excused. And it [is] [a] type of forgetfulness.

segments.arabic: وَفِي الحَدِيث فلهَا عَن الصَّبِي أَي ذهل عَنهُ
segments.english: And in the hadith: 'she became distracted from the child' — meaning: she became unaware of him.

segments.arabic: وَيُقَال لَهَا بالشَّيْء أَي اشْتغل بِهِ
segments.english: And [it] is said: 'he was amused with the thing' — meaning: he became occupied with it.

segments.arabic: وَلها عَنهُ إِذا انْصَرف عَنهُ
segments.english: And 'he turned away from it' — when he left it.

segments.arabic: وَاللَّهْو للقلب واللعب للجوارح وَلِهَذَا يجمع بَينهمَا
segments.english: And distraction [is] for the heart, and play [is] for the limbs. And for this [reason] they are joined together.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كَانَ قَوْله أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ أبلغ فِي الذَّم من شغلكم
segments.english: And for this [reason], His saying 'Competing for more distracted you' was more intense in blame than 'occupied you.'

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْعَامِل قد يسْتَعْمل جوارحه بِمَا يعْمل وَقَلبه غير لاه بِهِ
segments.english: For the worker may use his limbs in what he does, while his heart [is] not distracted by it.

segments.arabic: فاللهو هُوَ ذُهُول وإعراض
segments.english: So distraction — it [is] absent-mindedness and turning away.

segments.arabic: وَالتَّكَاثُر تفَاعل من الْكَثْرَة أَي مكاثرة بَعْضكُم لبَعض
segments.english: And 'competing for more' [is a] reciprocal form from 'abundance' — meaning: each of you competing with the other.

segments.arabic: وَأعْرض عَن ذكر المتكاثر بِهِ إِرَادَة لإطلاقه وعمومه
segments.english: And He left out mentioning what [is] competed over, intending to leave it open and general,

segments.arabic: وَأَن كل مَا يكاثر بِهِ العَبْد غَيره سوى طَاعَة الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: and [that] everything the servant competes with others in, besides obedience to God and His Messenger,

segments.arabic: وَمَا يعود عَلَيْهِ بنفع معاده فَهُوَ دَاخل فِي هَذَا التكاثر
segments.english: and what benefits him for his Return — then it [is] included in this competition.

segments.arabic: فالتكاثر فِي كل شَيْء من مَال أَو جاه أَو رياسة أَو نسْوَة أَو حَدِيث أَو
segments.english: So the competition [is] in everything — from wealth, or status, or leadership, or women, or talk, or —

headings.arabic: تَنْبِيه
headings.english: Note

segments.arabic: علم وَلَا سيّما إِذا لم يحْتَج إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: knowledge — especially if there [is] no need for it —

segments.arabic: وَالتَّكَاثُر فِي الْكتب والتصانيف وَكَثْرَة الْمسَائِل وتفريعها وتوليدها
segments.english: and competing in books and writings, and the abundance of issues, branching them, and generating them.

segments.arabic: وَالتَّكَاثُر أَن يطْلب الرجل أَن يكون أَكثر من غَيره
segments.english: And competing [is] that a man seeks to have more than others.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا مَذْمُوم إِلَّا فِيمَا يقرّب إِلَى الله
segments.english: And this [is] blameworthy, except in what brings [one] closer to God,

segments.arabic: فالتكاثر فِيهِ مُنَافَسَة فِي الْخيرَات ومسابقة إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: for competing in that [is] rivalry in good deeds and racing toward them.

segments.arabic: وَفِي صَحِيح مُسلم من حَدِيث عبد الله بن الشخير
segments.english: And in Sahih Muslim, from the hadith of Abdullah ibn al-Shikhkhir,

segments.arabic: أَنه انْتهى إِلَى النَّبِي وَهُوَ يقْرَأ
segments.english: that he came to the Prophet ﷺ while he was reciting:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ﴾
segments.english: "Competing for more distracted you."

segments.arabic: قَالَ يَقُول ابْن آدم مَالِي مَالِي
segments.english: He said: "The son of Adam says: 'My wealth, my wealth!'

segments.arabic: وَهل لَك من مَالك إِلَّا مَا تصدّقت فأمضيت
segments.english: And do you have from your wealth except what you gave in charity and [so] spent,

segments.arabic: أَو أكلت فأفنيت أَو لبست فأبليت
segments.english: or ate and [so] consumed, or wore and [so] wore out?"

segments.arabic: من لم ينْتَفع بِعَيْنِه لم ينْتَفع بأذنه
segments.english: Whoever did not benefit from his eye will not benefit from his ear.

segments.arabic: للْعَبد ستر بَينه وَبَين الله وَستر بَينه وَبَين النَّاس
segments.english: The servant has [a] veil between him and God, and [a] veil between him and people.

segments.arabic: فَمن هتك السّتْر الَّذِي بَينه وَبَين الله هتك الله السّتْر الَّذِي بَينه وَبَين النَّاس
segments.english: So whoever tears the veil that [is] between him and God, God tears the veil that [is] between him and people.

segments.arabic: للْعَبد رب هُوَ ملاقيه وَبَيت هُوَ ساكنه
segments.english: The servant has [a] Lord he [will] meet, and [a] house he [will] dwell in.

segments.arabic: فَيَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَن يسترضي ربّه قبل لِقَائِه
segments.english: So he should seek the pleasure of his Lord before meeting Him,

segments.arabic: ويعمّر بَيته قبل انْتِقَاله إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and build his house before his move to it.

segments.arabic: إِضَاعَة الْوَقْت أَشد من الْمَوْت
segments.english: Wasting time [is] worse than death,

segments.arabic: لِأَن إِضَاعَة الْوَقْت تقطعك عَن الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة
segments.english: because wasting time cuts you off from God and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: وَالْمَوْت يقطعك عَن الدُّنْيَا وَأَهْلهَا
segments.english: while death cuts you off from this world and its people.

segments.arabic: الدُّنْيَا من أَولهَا إِلَى آخرهَا لَا تَسَاوِي غم سَاعَة
segments.english: This world, from its beginning to its end, [is] not worth [a] moment of grief,

segments.arabic: فَكيف بغم الْعُمر
segments.english: so how about the grief of [a] lifetime?

segments.arabic: مَحْبُوب الْيَوْم يعقب الْمَكْرُوه غَدا
segments.english: What [is] loved today [is] followed by what [is] hated tomorrow,

segments.arabic: ومكروه الْيَوْم يعقب المحبوب غَدا
segments.english: and what [is] hated today [is] followed by what [is] loved tomorrow.

segments.arabic: أعظم الرِّبْح فِي الدُّنْيَا أَن تشغل نَفسك كل وَقت بِمَا هُوَ أولى بهَا وأنفع لَهَا فِي معادها
segments.english: The greatest profit in this world [is] that you occupy yourself every moment with what [is] most worthy of it and most beneficial for it in its Return.

segments.arabic: كَيفَ يكون عَاقِلا من بَاعَ الْجنَّة بِمَا فِيهَا بِشَهْوَة سَاعَة
segments.english: How can [one] be rational who sold Paradise with all that [is] in it for [a] moment's desire?

segments.arabic: يخرج الْعَارِف من الدُّنْيَا وَلم يقْض وطره من شَيْئَيْنِ
segments.english: The knower leaves this world without fulfilling his wish of two things:

segments.arabic: بكاؤه على نَفسه وثناؤه على ربّه
segments.english: his weeping over himself, and his praise of his Lord.

segments.arabic: الْمَخْلُوق إِذا خفته استوحشت مِنْهُ وهربت مِنْهُ
segments.english: A created being — when you fear it, you feel uneasy around it and flee from it.

segments.arabic: والرب تَعَالَى إِذا خفته أنست بِهِ وَقربت إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: But the Lord, Most High — when you fear Him, you find comfort in Him and draw near to Him.

segments.arabic: لَو نفع الْعلم بِلَا عمل لما ذمّ الله سُبْحَانَهُ أَحْبَار أهل الْكتاب
segments.english: If knowledge without action were beneficial, God — glorified [is] He — would not have blamed the scholars of the People of the Book.

segments.arabic: وَلَو نفع الْعَمَل بِلَا إخلاص لما ذمّ الْمُنَافِقين
segments.english: And if action without sincerity were beneficial, He would not have blamed the hypocrites.

segments.arabic: دَافع الخطرة فَإِن لم تفعل صَارَت فكرة
segments.english: Resist the passing thought, for if you do not, it becomes [a] thought.

segments.arabic: فدافع الفكرة فان لم تفعل صَارَت شَهْوَة
segments.english: So resist the thought, for if you do not, it becomes [a] desire.

segments.arabic: فحاربها فَإِن لم تفعل صَارَت عَزِيمَة وهِمَّة
segments.english: So fight it, for if you do not, it becomes [a] resolve and determination.

segments.arabic: فَإِن لم تدافعها صَارَت فعلا
segments.english: And if you do not resist it, it becomes an action.

segments.arabic: فَإِن لم تتداركه بضدّه صَار عَادَة فيصعب عَلَيْك الِانْتِقَال عَنْهَا
segments.english: And if you do not counter it with its opposite, it becomes [a] habit, and [it] becomes hard for you to move away from it.

segments.arabic: التَّقْوَى ثَلَاث مَرَاتِب
segments.english: God-consciousness [has] three levels.

segments.arabic: إِحْدَاهَا حمية الْقلب والجوارح عَن الآثام
segments.english: The first of them [is] protecting the heart and the limbs from sins.

segments.arabic: والمحرّمات
segments.english: and the prohibited things.

segments.arabic: الثَّانِيَة حميتها عَن المكروهات
segments.english: The second: its protection [is] from the disliked things.

segments.arabic: الثَّالِثَة الحمية عَن الفضول وَمَا لَا يَعْنِي
segments.english: The third: the protection from excess and what does not concern [one].

segments.arabic: فَالْأولى تُعْطِي العَبْد حَيَاته
segments.english: So the first gives the servant his life.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانيَِة تفيده صِحَّته وقوته
segments.english: And the second gives him his health and strength.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّالِثَة تكسبه سروره وفرحه وبهجته
segments.english: And the third earns him his joy, his happiness, and his delight.

segments.arabic: غموض الْحق حِين تذب عَنهُ ... يقلل نَاصِر الْخصم المحق
segments.english: The hiddenness of the truth, when you defend it... reduces the supporters of the one [who is] right in the dispute.

segments.arabic: تضل عَن الدَّقِيق فَهُوَ مقوم ... فتقضي للمجلّ على المدقّ
segments.english: You miss the subtle [point] while it [is] sound... so you judge for the general over the precise.

segments.arabic: بِاللَّه أبلغ مَا أسعى وأدركه ... لا بي وَلَا يشفع لي من النَّاس
segments.english: [It is] by God [that] I reach what I strive for and attain it... not by myself, and no one from people intercedes for me.

segments.arabic: إِذا أَيِست وَكَاد الْيَأْس يقطعني ... جَاءَ الرجا مسرعا من جَانب الْيَأْس
segments.english: When I despaired and despair nearly cut me off... hope came rushing from the side of despair.

segments.arabic: من خلقه الله للجنّة لم تزل هَدَايَاهَا تَأتيه من المكاره
segments.english: Whoever God created for Paradise — its gifts keep coming to him through hardships.

segments.arabic: وَمن خلقه للنار لم تزل هَدَايَاهَا تَأتيه من الشَّهَوَات
segments.english: And whoever He created for the Fire — its gifts keep coming to him through desires.

segments.arabic: لما طلب آدم الخلود فِي الْجنَّة من جَانب الشَّجَرَة عُوقِبَ بِالْخرُوجِ مِنْهَا
segments.english: When Adam sought eternal life in Paradise through the tree, he [was] punished by being expelled from it.

segments.arabic: وَلما طلب يُوسُف الْخُرُوج من السجْن من جِهَة صَاحب الرُّؤْيَا لبث فِيهِ بضع سِنِين
segments.english: And when Yusuf sought to leave the prison through the companion of the dream, he remained in it for several years.

segments.arabic: إِذا جرى على العَبْد مَقْدُور يكرههُ فَلهُ فِيهِ ستّة مشَاهد
segments.english: When [a] decree that he dislikes befalls the servant, he has regarding it six perspectives.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا مشْهد التَّوْحِيد وَأَن الله هُوَ الَّذِي قدّره وشاءه وخلقه
segments.english: The first: the perspective of monotheism — that God [is] the One who decreed it, willed it, and created it.

segments.arabic: وَمَا شَاءَ الله كَانَ وَمَا لم يَشَاء لم يكن
segments.english: And whatever God willed [will] be, and whatever He did not will [will] not be.

segments.arabic: الثَّانِي مشْهد الْعدْل وَأَنه مَاض فِيهِ حكمه عدل فِيهِ قَضَاؤُهُ
segments.english: The second: the perspective of justice — that His ruling in it [is] carried out, [and] His judgment in it [is] just.

segments.arabic: الثَّالِث مشْهد الرَّحْمَة وَأَن رَحمته فِي هَذَا الْمَقْدُور غالبة لغضبه وانتقامه
segments.english: The third: the perspective of mercy — that His mercy in this decree overcomes His anger and His punishment.

segments.arabic: وَرَحمته حشوه
segments.english: And His mercy [is] its filling.

segments.arabic: الرَّابِع مشْهد الْحِكْمَة وَأَن حكمته سُبْحَانَهُ اقْتَضَت ذَلِك
segments.english: The fourth: the perspective of wisdom — that His wisdom, glorified [is] He, required that.

segments.arabic: لم يقدّره سدى وَلَا قَضَاهُ عَبَثا
segments.english: He did not decree it without purpose, nor did He ordain it in vain.

segments.arabic: الْخَامِس مشْهد الْحَمد وَأَن لَهُ سُبْحَانَهُ الْحَمد التَّام على ذَلِك من جَمِيع وجوهه
segments.english: The fifth: the perspective of praise — that to Him, glorified [is] He, [belongs] complete praise for that from all its angles.

segments.arabic: السَّادِس مشْهد العبوديّة وَأَنه عبد مَحْض من كل وَجه
segments.english: The sixth: the perspective of servitude — that he [is] [a] pure servant in every way.

segments.arabic: تجْرِي عَلَيْهِ أَحْكَام سيّده وأقضيته بِحكم كَونه ملكه وَعَبده
segments.english: The rulings and judgments of his Master run over him, by virtue of him being His possession and His servant.

segments.arabic: فيصرفه تَحت أَحْكَامه القدريّة كَمَا يصرفهُ تَحت أَحْكَامه الدينيّة
segments.english: So He directs him under His universal decrees just as He directs him under His religious rulings.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مَحل لجَرَيَان هَذِه الْأَحْكَام عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: So he [is] [a] place for these rulings to run upon him.

segments.arabic: قلّة التَّوْفِيق وَفَسَاد الرَّأْي وخفاء الْحق وَفَسَاد الْقلب وخمول الذّكر
segments.english: Lack of guidance, corruption of judgment, hiddenness of the truth, corruption of the heart, and fading of remembrance.

segments.arabic: وإضاعة الْوَقْت ونفرة الْخلق والوحشة بَين العَبْد وَبَين ربّه
segments.english: And wasting of time, and people's aversion, and loneliness between the servant and his Lord.

segments.arabic: وَمنع إِجَابَة الدُّعَاء وقسوة الْقلب ومحق الْبركَة فِي الرزق والعمر
segments.english: And prevention of answered prayer, and hardness of the heart, and removal of blessing from provision and lifespan.

segments.arabic: وحرمان الْعلم ولباس الذل وإهانة الْعَدو وضيق
segments.english: And being deprived of knowledge, and the garment of humiliation, and the enemy's scorn, and tightness

headings.arabic: فصل
headings.english: Section

headings.arabic: فائدة الغيرة غيرتان غيرة على الشيء وغيرة من الشيء فالغيرة على
headings.english: Benefit: Protective jealousy [is of] two types — jealousy over [a] thing and jealousy from [a] thing. So jealousy over

segments.arabic: الصَّدْر والابتلاء بقرناء السوء الَّذين يفسدون الْقلب ويضيعون الْوَقْت
segments.english: the chest, and being tested with evil companions who corrupt the heart and waste time,

segments.arabic: وَطول الْهم وَالْغَم وضنك الْمَعيشَة وكسف البال
segments.english: and prolonged worry and grief, and tightness of livelihood, and gloom of spirit —

segments.arabic: تتولّد من الْمعْصِيَة والغفلة عَن ذكر الله
segments.english: [these] are generated from sin and heedlessness of the remembrance of God,

segments.arabic: كَمَا يتولّد الزَّرْع عَن المَاء والإحراق عَن النَّار
segments.english: just as crops are generated from water, and burning from fire.

segments.arabic: وأضداد هَذِه تتولّد عَن الطَّاعَة
segments.english: And the opposites of these are generated from obedience.

segments.arabic: طُوبَى لمن أنصف ربّه
segments.english: Blessed [is] whoever was fair to his Lord,

segments.arabic: فَأقر لَهُ بِالْجَهْلِ فِي علمه والآفات فِي عمله
segments.english: and admitted to Him [his] ignorance in his knowledge, and the flaws in his deeds,

segments.arabic: والعيوب فِي نَفسه والتفريط فِي حَقه وَالظُّلم فِي مُعَامَلَته
segments.english: and the defects in himself, and the neglect of His right, and the wrongdoing in his dealings with Him.

segments.arabic: فَإِن آخذه بذنوبه رأى عدله
segments.english: So if He held him accountable for his sins, he saw His justice.

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم يؤاخذه بهَا رأى فَضله
segments.english: And if He did not hold him accountable for them, he saw His favor.

segments.arabic: وَإِن عمل حَسَنَة رَآهَا من منّته وصدقته عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And if he did [a] good deed, he saw it [as being] from His grace and His charity upon him.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قبلهَا فمنّة وَصدقَة ثَانِيَة
segments.english: So if He accepted it, [that is a] second grace and charity.

segments.arabic: وَإِن ردّها فلكون مثلهَا لَا يصلح أَن يواجه بِهِ
segments.english: And if He rejected it, [it is] because the likes of it [is] not fit to be presented to Him.

segments.arabic: وَإِن عمل سيّئة رَآهَا من تخلّيه عَنهُ وخذلانه لَهُ وإمساك عصمته عَنهُ
segments.english: And if he did [a] bad deed, he saw it [as being] from His abandoning him, and His forsaking him, and His withholding [His] protection from him.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ من عدله فِيهِ
segments.english: And that [is] from His justice regarding him.

segments.arabic: فَيرى فِي ذَلِك فقره إِلَى ربّه وظلمه فِي نَفسه
segments.english: So he sees in that his neediness toward his Lord and his wrongdoing against himself.

segments.arabic: فَإِن غفرها لَهُ فبمحض إحسانه وجوده وَكَرمه
segments.english: So if He forgave it for him, [it is] by pure goodness, generosity, and nobility.

segments.arabic: ونكتة الْمَسْأَلَة وسرّها أنّه لَا يرى ربه إلا محسنا
segments.english: And the key point of the matter and its secret [is] that he does not see his Lord except [as] good-doing,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يرى نَفسه إِلَّا مسيئا أَو مفرطا أَو مقصّرا
segments.english: and does not see himself except [as] doing wrong, or neglectful, or falling short.

segments.arabic: فَيرى كل مَا يسرّه من فضل ربّه عَلَيْهِ وإحسانه إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: So he sees everything that pleases him [as being] from the favor of his Lord upon him and His goodness toward him.

segments.arabic: وكل مَا يسوءه من ذنُوبه وَعدل الله فِيهِ
segments.english: And everything that displeases him [as being] from his sins and the justice of God regarding him.

segments.arabic: المحبّون إِذا خربَتْ منَازِل أحبّائهم قَالُوا سقيا لسكانها
segments.english: The lovers — when the homes of their beloved ones fell to ruin, they said: "[May there be] rain upon their inhabitants."

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ الْمُحب إِذا أَتَت عَلَيْهِ الأعوام تَحت التُّرَاب
segments.english: And likewise the lover — when years have passed over him under the earth,

segments.arabic: ذكر حِينَئِذٍ حسن طَاعَته فِي الدُّنْيَا وتودده اليه
segments.english: [God] remembers then the beauty of his obedience in this world and his showing affection to Him,

segments.arabic: وتجدد رَحمته وسقياه لمن كَانَ سَاكِنا فِي تِلْكَ الْأَجْسَام البالية
segments.english: and His mercy [is] renewed, and His blessings [are sent] upon whoever was dwelling in those decayed bodies.

segments.arabic: الْغيرَة غيرتان غيرة على الشَّيْء وغيرة من الشَّيْء
segments.english: Protective jealousy [is of] two types: jealousy over [a] thing and jealousy from [a] thing.

segments.arabic: فالغيرة على المحبوب حرصك عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: So jealousy over the beloved [is] your eagerness for him.

segments.arabic: والغيرة من الْمَكْرُوه أَن يزاحمك عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And jealousy from the unwanted [rival is] that he competes with you over him.

segments.arabic: فالغيرة على المحبوب لَا تتمّ إِلَّا بالغيرة من المزاحم
segments.english: So jealousy over the beloved [is] not complete except with jealousy from the competitor.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه تحمد حَيْثُ يكون المحبوب تقبح الْمُشَاركَة فِي حبه كالمخلوق
segments.english: And this [is] praiseworthy where the beloved [is one for whom] sharing in his love [is] ugly, like [a] created being.

segments.arabic: وَأما من تحسن الْمُشَاركَة فِي حبه كالرسول والعالم
segments.english: But as for one for whom sharing in his love [is] good, like the Messenger and the scholar —

segments.arabic: بل الحبيب الْقَرِيب سُبْحَانَهُ فَلَا
segments.english: rather, the Close Beloved, glorified [is] He — then no.

segments.arabic: يتصوّر غيرَة الْمُزَاحمَة عَلَيْهِ بل هُوَ حسد
segments.english: [one can] imagine [a] jealousy of rivalry over Him; rather, it [is] envy.

segments.arabic: والغيرة المحمودة فِي حَقه أَن يغار الْمُحب على محبته لَهُ أَن يصرفهَا إِلَى غَيره
segments.english: And the praiseworthy jealousy regarding Him [is] that the lover [is] jealous over his love for Him — that he [would] direct it to other [than Him],

segments.arabic: أَو يغار عَلَيْهَا أَن يطلع عَلَيْهَا الْغَيْر فيفسدها عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: or he [is] jealous over it — that others [would] discover it and corrupt it against him,

segments.arabic: أَو يغار على أَعماله أَن يكون فِيهَا شَيْء لغير محبوبه
segments.english: or he [is] jealous over his deeds — that there [would] be in them something for other than his Beloved,

segments.arabic: أَو يغار عَلَيْهَا أَن يشوبها مَا يكره محبوبه من رِيَاء أَو إعجاب أَو محبَّة لإشراف غَيره عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: or he [is] jealous over them — that there [would] taint them what his Beloved dislikes of showing off, or self-admiration, or love for others' awareness of them,

segments.arabic: أَو غيبته عَن شُهُود منته عَلَيْهِ فِيهَا
segments.english: or his absence from witnessing His favor upon him in them.

segments.arabic: وَبِالْجُمْلَةِ فغيرته تَقْتَضِي أَن تكون أَحْوَاله وأعماله وأفعاله كلهَا لله
segments.english: And in summary, his jealousy requires that his states, his deeds, and his actions — all of them — [be] for God.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ يغار على أوقاته أَن يذهب مِنْهَا وَقت فِي غير رضى محبوبه
segments.english: And likewise, he [is] jealous over his times — that [a] moment of them [would] pass in other than the pleasure of his Beloved.

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ الْغيرَة من جِهَة العَبْد وَهِي غيرَة من المزاحم لَهُ المعوق الْقَاطِع لَهُ عَن مرضاة محبوبه
segments.english: So this [is] the jealousy from the side of the servant, and it [is] jealousy against the rival who obstructs him [and] cuts him off from the pleasure of his Beloved.

segments.arabic: وَأما غيرَة محبوبه عَلَيْهِ فَهِيَ كَرَاهِيَة أَن ينْصَرف قلبه عَن محبته إِلَى محبَّة غَيره
segments.english: And as for the jealousy of his Beloved over him, it [is] [a] dislike that his heart [would] turn away from His love to the love of other [than Him],

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ يُشَارِكهُ فِي حبه
segments.english: such that [the other] shares with Him in his love.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كَانَت غيرَة الله أَن يَأْتِي العَبْد ماحرم عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And for this [reason], the jealousy of God [is] that the servant commits what He [has] forbidden for him.

segments.arabic: وَلأَجل غيرته سُبْحَانَهُ حرّم الْفَاحِشَة مَا ظهر مِنْهَا وَمَا بطنِ
segments.english: And because of His jealousy — glorified [is] He — He forbade indecency, what [is] apparent of it and what [is] hidden,

segments.arabic: لِأَن الْخلق عبيده وإماؤه فَهُوَ يغار على إمائه كَمَا يغار السَّيِّد على جواريه وَللَّه الْمثل الْأَعْلَى
segments.english: because the creation [are] His servants and His handmaidens. So He [is] jealous over His handmaidens, as the master [is] jealous over his slave-women — and to God [belongs] the highest example.

segments.arabic: ويغار على عبيده أَن تكون محبتهم لغيره بِحَيْثُ تحملهم تِلْكَ الْمحبَّة على عشق الصُّور ونيل الْفَاحِشَة مِنْهَا
segments.english: And He [is] jealous over His servants — that their love [would] be for other than Him, such that that love carries them to [the] infatuation [with] images and committing indecency with them.

segments.arabic: من عظم وقار الله فِي قلبه أَن يعصيه وقّره الله فِي قُلُوب الْخلق أَن يذلّوه
segments.english: Whoever magnified [the] reverence of God in his heart [too much] to disobey Him, God honored him in [the] hearts of creation [too much] to humiliate him.

segments.arabic: إِذا علقت شروش الْمعرفَة فِي أَرض الْقلب نَبتَت فِيهِ شَجَرَة الْمحبَّة
segments.english: When the roots of knowledge take hold in the soil of the heart, the tree of love grows in it.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا تمكّنت وقويت أثمرت الطَّاعَة
segments.english: And when it [is] established and strengthened, it bears [the] fruit of obedience.

segments.arabic: فَلَا تزَال الشَّجَرَة تؤتي أكلهَا كل حِين باذن الله رَبِّهَا
segments.english: And the tree does not cease giving its fruit every season, by the permission of God, its Lord.

segments.arabic: أول منَازِل الْقَوْم
segments.english: The first of the stations of the people [is]:

segments.arabic: اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا
segments.english: Remember God [with] much remembrance,

segments.arabic: وَسَبِّحُوهُ بكرَة وَأَصِيلا
segments.english: and glorify Him morning and evening.

segments.arabic: وأوسطها
segments.english: And the middle of them [is]:

segments.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلائِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النور
segments.english: He [is] the One who sends blessings upon you, and His angels, to bring you out from the darknesses into the light.
segments.sahih_international: It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful.

segments.arabic: وَآخِرهَا
segments.english: And the last of them [is]:

segments.arabic: تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يلقونه سَلام
segments.english: Their greeting [on the] day they meet Him [will be] "Peace."

segments.arabic: أَرض الْفطْرَة رحبة قَابِلَة لما يغْرس فِيهَا
segments.english: The soil of inborn nature [is] spacious, accepting of what [is] planted in it.

segments.arabic: فَإِن غرست شَجَرَة الْإِيمَان وَالتَّقوى أورثت حلاوة الْأَبَد
segments.english: So if the tree of faith and God-consciousness [is] planted, it yields [the] sweetness of eternity.

segments.arabic: وَإِن غرست شَجَرَة الْجَهْل والهوى فَكل الثَّمر مُرّ
segments.english: And if the tree of ignorance and desire [is] planted, then every fruit [is] bitter.

segments.arabic: ارْجع إِلَى الله واطلبه من عَيْنك وسمعك وقلبك وَلِسَانك
segments.english: Return to God and seek Him through your eye, your hearing, your heart, and your tongue.

segments.arabic: وَلَا تشرد عَنهُ من هَذِه الْأَرْبَعَة
segments.english: And do not stray from Him through these four.

segments.arabic: فَمَا رَجَعَ من رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ بتوفيقه إِلَّا مِنْهَا
segments.english: For none who returned to Him by His guidance [did so] except through them,

segments.arabic: وَمَا شرد من شرد عَنهُ بخذلانه إِلَّا مِنْهَا
segments.english: and none who strayed from Him by His abandonment [did so] except through them.

segments.arabic: فالموفق يسمع ويبصر ويتكلّم ويبطش بمولاه
segments.english: So the guided one hears, sees, speaks, and acts by his Lord.

segments.arabic: والمخذول يصدر ذَلِك عَنهُ بِنَفسِهِ وهواه
segments.english: And the forsaken one — that issues from him by his self and his desire.

headings.arabic: فصل اياك والمعاصي فانها أزالت عز اسجدوا
headings.english: Chapter: Beware of sins, for they removed the honor of 'Prostrate!'

segments.arabic: مِثَال تولد الطَّاعَة ونموها وتزايدها كَمثل نواة غرستها فَصَارَت شَجَرَة
segments.english: The example of the birth of obedience, its growth, and its increase [is] like [the example of] a seed you planted, and it became a tree.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أثمرت فَأكلت ثَمَرهَا وغرست نَوَاهَا
segments.english: Then it bore fruit, so you ate its fruit and planted its seeds.

segments.arabic: فَكلما أثمر مِنْهَا شَيْء جنيت ثمره وغرست نَوَاه
segments.english: So whenever something from it bore fruit, you harvested its fruit and planted its seeds.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ تداعي الْمعاصِي
segments.english: And likewise [is] the cascading of sins.

segments.arabic: فليتدبّر اللبيب هَذَا الْمِثَال
segments.english: So let the wise person reflect on this example.

segments.arabic: فَمن ثَوَاب الْحَسَنَة الْحَسَنَة بعْدهَا
segments.english: For from the reward of a good deed [is] the good deed after it.

segments.arabic: وَمن عُقُوبَة السَّيئَة السَّيئَة بعْدهَا
segments.english: And from the punishment of a bad deed [is] the bad deed after it.

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ الْعجب من مَمْلُوك يتذلل لله ويتعبّد لَهُ وَلَا يمل من خدمته مَعَ حَاجته وَفَقره إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: The wonder [is] not about a slave who humbles himself to God and worships Him and does not tire of serving Him, despite his need and poverty toward Him.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا الْعجب من مَالك يتحبب إِلَى مَمْلُوكه بصنوف إنعامه
segments.english: Rather, the wonder [is] about a Master who endears Himself to His slave with types of His blessings,

segments.arabic: ويتودد إِلَيْهِ بأنواع إحسانه مَعَ غناهُ عَنهُ
segments.english: and shows affection to him with kinds of His kindness, despite His freedom from need of him.

segments.arabic: كفى بك عزّا أَنَّك لَهُ عبد ... وَكفى بك فخرا أَنه لَك رب
segments.english: Sufficient for you as honor [is] that you [are] His servant... and sufficient for you as pride [is] that He [is] your Lord.

segments.arabic: اياك والمعاصي فانها أزالت عِزَّ اسْجُدُوا
segments.english: Beware of sins, for they removed the honor of 'Prostrate!'

segments.arabic: وأخرجت إقطاع أَسْكَنَ
segments.english: and removed the grant of 'Dwell.'

segments.arabic: يَا لَهَا لَحْظَة أثمرت حرارة القلق ألف سنة
segments.english: Oh what a moment [that] produced the burning of anxiety for a thousand years!

segments.arabic: مازال يكْتب بِدَم النَّدَم سطور الْحزن فِي الْقَصَص
segments.english: He kept writing with the blood of regret the lines of sorrow in the stories,

segments.arabic: ويرسلها مَعَ أنفاس الأسف
segments.english: and sending them with the breaths of sorrow,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى جَاءَهُ توقيعُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْه
segments.english: until the decree of 'Then He turned to him [in mercy]' came to him.

segments.arabic: فَرح إِبْلِيس بنزول آدم من الجنة
segments.english: Iblis rejoiced at Adam's descent from Paradise.

segments.arabic: وَمَا علم أَن هبوط الغائص فِي اللجة خلف الدّرّ صعُود
segments.english: And he did not know that the descent of the diver into the deep [sea] after pearls [is an] ascent.

segments.arabic: كم بَين قَوْله لآدَم
segments.english: How [vast is the distance] between His saying to Adam:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنِّي جَاعِلٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ خَليفَة﴾
segments.english: Indeed I [am] placing on the earth a successor,
segments.sahih_international: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?" Allah said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."

segments.arabic: وَقَوله لَك
segments.english: and His saying to you:

segments.arabic: ﴿اذْهَبْ فَمَنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ﴾
segments.english: Go, and whoever follows you among them.

segments.arabic: مَا جرى على آدم هُوَ المُرَاد من وجوده
segments.english: What happened to Adam — it [is] what was intended from his existence.

segments.arabic: لَو لم تذنبوا
segments.english: If you did not sin...

segments.arabic: يَا آدم لَا تجزع من قولي لَك اخْرُجْ مِنْهَا
segments.english: O Adam, do not grieve at My saying to you: 'Leave it,'

segments.arabic: فلك ولصالح ذريتك خلقتها
segments.english: for [it is] for you and for the righteous of your offspring [that] I created it.

segments.arabic: يَا آدم كنت تدخل عليَّ دُخُول الْمُلُوك على الْمُلُوك
segments.english: O Adam, you used to enter upon Me as kings enter upon kings,

segments.arabic: وَالْيَوْم تدخل عليَّ دُخُول العبيد على الْمُلُوك
segments.english: and today you enter upon Me as slaves enter upon kings.

segments.arabic: يَا آدم لَا تجزع من كأس زلل كَانَت سَبَب كيسك
segments.english: O Adam, do not grieve over a cup of stumbling [that] was the cause of your wisdom,

segments.arabic: فقد استخرج مِنْك دَاء الْعجب
segments.english: for the disease of self-admiration has been extracted from you,

segments.arabic: وألبست خلعة الْعُبُودِيَّة
segments.english: and you have been clothed with the robe of servitude.

segments.arabic: وَعَسَى أَنْ تكْرهُوا
segments.english: And perhaps you may dislike [something]...

segments.arabic: يَا آدم لم أخرج إقطاعك إِلَى غَيْرك
segments.english: O Adam, I did not give your grant to someone else.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا نحيّتك عَنهُ لتكمل عِمَارَته لَك
segments.english: Rather, I moved you away from it to complete its building for you,

segments.arabic: وليبعث إِلَى العمّال نَفَقَة تَتَجَافَى جنُوبهم
segments.english: and to send to the workers the provision of 'their sides forsake [their beds].'

segments.arabic: تالله مَا نَفعه عِنْد مَعْصِيَته عز اسجدوا
segments.english: By God, the honor of 'Prostrate' did not benefit him at [the time of] his sin,

segments.arabic: وَلَا شرف وَعَلَّمَ آدَمَ
segments.english: nor [did] the honor of 'And He taught Adam,'

segments.arabic: وَلَا خصيصة لِمَا خلقت بيَدي
segments.english: nor [did] the distinction of 'what I created with My hands,'

segments.arabic: وَلَا فَخر
segments.english: nor [did] the pride of:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِي﴾
segments.english: and I blew into him of My spirit.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا انْتفع بذل
segments.english: Rather, he [only] benefited from the humility of:

segments.arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا﴾
segments.english: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves.

segments.arabic: لما لبس درع التَّوْحِيد على بدن الشُّكْر وَقع سهم الْعَدو مِنْهُ فِي غير مقتل
segments.english: When he wore the armor of monotheism over the body of gratitude, the arrow of the enemy fell from him in a non-fatal [spot].

headings.arabic: فصل
headings.english: Section

segments.arabic: فجرحه فَوضع عَلَيْهِ جَبَّار الانكسار
segments.english: So He wounded him, then placed upon him the mender of brokenness,

segments.arabic: فَعَاد كَمَا كَانَ فَقَامَ الجريح كَأَن لم يكن بِهِ قلبة
segments.english: so he returned as he was, and the wounded one stood up as if he had no ailment.

segments.arabic: نَجَائِب النجَاة مهيأة للمراد
segments.english: The swift mounts of salvation [are] prepared for the one [God] intends,

segments.arabic: واقدم المطرود موثوقة بالقيود
segments.english: and the feet of the expelled one [are] bound with chains.

segments.arabic: هبّت عواصف الأقدار فِي بيداء الأكوان
segments.english: The storms of destiny blew in the desert of existence,

segments.arabic: فتقلب الْوُجُود وَنجم الْخَيْر
segments.english: so existence turned over, and goodness emerged.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا ركدت الرّيح
segments.english: Then when the wind settled,

segments.arabic: إِذا أَبُو طَالب غريق فِي لجة الْهَلَاك
segments.english: there [was] Abu Talib drowning in the depths of destruction,

segments.arabic: وسلمان على سَاحل السَّلامَة
segments.english: and Salman [was] on the shore of safety,

segments.arabic: والوليد بن
segments.english: and al-Walid ibn

segments.arabic: الْمُغيرَة يقدم قومه فِي التيه
segments.english: al-Mughira [was] leading his people in the wilderness,

segments.arabic: وصهيب قد قدم بقافلة الرّوم
segments.english: and Suhayb had come with [a] caravan of the Romans,

segments.arabic: وَالنَّجَاشِي فِي أَرض
segments.english: and the Najashi [was] in [the] land of

segments.arabic: الْحَبَشَة يَقُول لبيْك اللَّهُمَّ لبيْك
segments.english: Abyssinia, saying: "Here I am, O God, here I am,"

segments.arabic: وبلال يُنَادي الصَّلَاة خير من النّوم
segments.english: and Bilal [was] calling out: "Prayer [is] better than sleep."

segments.arabic: وَأَبُو جهل فِي رقدة الْمُخَالفَة
segments.english: And Abu Jahl [was] in the slumber of opposition.

segments.arabic: لما قضى فِي الْقدَم بسابقة سلمَان
segments.english: When [God] decreed in pre-eternity the precedence of Salman,

segments.arabic: عرج بِهِ دَلِيل التَّوْفِيق عَن طَرِيق آبَائِهِ فِي التمجس
segments.english: the guide of [divine] success turned him away from the path of his forefathers in fire-worship.

segments.arabic: فَأقبل يناظر أَبَاهُ فِي دين الشّرك
segments.english: So he began debating his father about the religion of associating partners [with God].

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا علاهُ بِالْحجَّةِ لم يكن لَهُ جَوَاب إِلَّا الْقَيْد
segments.english: And when he overcame him with proof, he had no answer except chains.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا جَوَاب يتداوله أهل الْبَاطِل من يَوْم حرفوه
segments.english: And this [is] an answer that the people of falsehood have passed around since the day they crafted it.

segments.arabic: وَبِه أجَاب فِرْعَوْن مُوسَى
segments.english: And with it Pharaoh answered Moses:

segments.arabic: لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ إِلَهًا غَيْرِي
segments.english: "If you take [a] god other than me..."

segments.arabic: وَبِه أجَاب الْجَهْمِية الإِمَام أَحْمد لما عرضوه على السِّيَاط
segments.english: And with it the Jahmiyyah answered Imam Ahmad when they subjected him to the whips.

segments.arabic: وَبِه أجَاب أهل الْبدع شيخ الْإِسْلَام حِين استدعوه السجْن
segments.english: And with it the people of innovation answered Shaykh al-Islam when they summoned him to prison.

segments.arabic: وَهَا نَحن على الْأَثر
segments.english: And here we [are], following in [their] footsteps.

segments.arabic: فَنزل بِهِ ضيف
segments.english: Then [a] guest came down to him —

segments.arabic: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ
segments.english: "And We will surely test you."

segments.arabic: فنال بإكرامه مرتبَة سلمَان منا أهل الْبَيْت
segments.english: So by honoring him, he attained the rank of "Salman [is] from us, the People of the House."

segments.arabic: فَسمع أَن ركبا على نِيَّة السّفر
segments.english: Then he heard that [a] caravan [was] intending to travel.

segments.arabic: فَسرق نَفسه من أَبِيه وَلَا قطع
segments.english: So he stole himself away from his father — and [there was] no cutting [of the hand].

segments.arabic: فَركب رَاحِلَة الْعَزْم يَرْجُو إِدْرَاك مطلب السَّعَادَة
segments.english: So he mounted the riding-camel of determination, hoping to reach the goal of happiness.

segments.arabic: فغاص فِي بَحر الْبَحْث ليَقَع بدرّة الْوُجُود
segments.english: So he dove into the sea of searching to come upon the pearl of existence.

segments.arabic: فَوقف نَفسه على خدمه الأدلاء وقُوف الأذلاء
segments.english: So he devoted himself to serving the guides [with] the devotion of the humble.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا أحس الرهبان بانقراض دولتهم
segments.english: And when the monks sensed the ending of their era,

segments.arabic: سلمُوا إِلَيْهِ أَعْلَام الْأَعْلَام على نبوة نَبينَا
segments.english: they handed over to him the greatest signs about the prophethood of our Prophet.

segments.arabic: وَقَالُوا إِن زَمَانه قد أظل فاحذر أَن تضل
segments.english: And they said: "His time has drawn near, so beware lest you go astray."

segments.arabic: فَرَحل مَعَ رفْقَة لم يرفقوا بِهِ
segments.english: So he traveled with [a] company [who] did not treat him gently.

segments.arabic: فشروه بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَة
segments.english: And they sold him for [a] cheap price — [a few] counted coins.
segments.sahih_international: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.

segments.arabic: فأتباعه يَهُودِيّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ
segments.english: So [a] Jew in Madinah bought him.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا رأى الْحرَّة توقد حرا شوقه
segments.english: And when he saw the Harrah, it ignited the heat of his longing.

segments.arabic: وَلم يعلم رب الْمنزل بوجد النَّازِل
segments.english: And the master of the house did not know of the passion of [his] guest.

segments.arabic: فَبينا هُوَ يكابد سَاعَات الِانْتِظَار
segments.english: And while he was enduring the hours of waiting,

segments.arabic: قدم البشير بقدوم البشير
segments.english: the bearer of good news arrived with [news of] the arrival of the Bringer of Good News.

segments.arabic: وسلمان فِي رَأس نَخْلَة
segments.english: And Salman [was] at the top of [a] palm tree,

segments.arabic: وَكَاد القلق يلقيه لَوْلَا أَن الحزم أمْسكهُ
segments.english: and anxiety almost threw him [down], had not caution held him —

segments.arabic: كَمَا جرى يَوْم
segments.english: just as happened [on] the day [when]:

segments.arabic: إِنْ كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِي بِهِ لَوْلَا أَنْ رَبَطْنَا عَلَى قَلبهَا
segments.english: She almost disclosed [him], had We not strengthened her heart.
segments.sahih_international: And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.

segments.arabic: فَعجل النُّزُول لتلقي ركب الْبشَارَة
segments.english: So he hastened [his] descent to meet the caravan of glad tidings,

segments.arabic: ولسان حَاله يَقُول
segments.english: and the tongue of his state [was] saying:

segments.arabic: خليليَّ من نجد قفا بِي على الرِّبَا ... فقد هَب من تِلْكَ الديار نسيم
segments.english: "My two friends from Najd, stop with me at the hills — for [a] breeze has blown from those lands."

segments.arabic: فصاح بِهِ سَيّده مَالك انْصَرف إِلَى شغلك
segments.english: So his master shouted at him: "What [is it] with you? Go back to your work!"

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ كَيفَ انصرافي ولي فِي داركم شغل
segments.english: So he said: "How [can I] turn away when I have business in your land?"

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أَخذ لِسَان حَاله يترنم لَو سمع الأطروش
segments.english: Then the tongue of his state began to sing — [such that] even the deaf would hear:

segments.arabic: خليليَّ لَا وَالله مَا أَنا مِنْكُمَا ... إِذا علم من آل ليلى بداليا
segments.english: "My two friends, no! By God, I [am] not [one] of you two — when [a] sign from the family of Layla appears to me."

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا لَقِي الرَّسُولَ عَارَضَ نُسْخَةَ الرُّهْبَانِ بِكِتَابِ الأَصْلِ فَوَافَقَهُ
segments.english: So when he met the Messenger, he compared the copy of the monks with the original book, and it matched.

segments.arabic: يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَنْتَ تُرِيدُ أَبَا طَالِبٍ وَنَحْنُ نُرِيدُ سَلْمَانَ
segments.english: O Muhammad, you want Abu Talib, and we want Salman.

segments.arabic: أَبُو طَالِبٍ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنِ اسْمِهِ قَالَ عَبْدُ مَنَافٍ
segments.english: Abu Talib, when he [was] asked about his name, said: "[I am a] servant of Manaf."

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا انْتَسَبَ افْتَخَرَ بِالآبَاءِ
segments.english: And when he traced his lineage, he boasted of [his] forefathers.

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَتِ الأَمْوَالُ عَبْدُ الإِبِلِ
segments.english: And when wealth [was] mentioned, [he was a] servant of camels.

segments.arabic: وَسَلْمَانُ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنِ اسْمِهِ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ
segments.english: And Salman, when he [was] asked about his name, said: "[I am a] servant of God."

segments.arabic: وَعَنْ نَسَبِهِ قَالَ ابْنُ الإِسْلَامِ
segments.english: And about his lineage, he said: "[I am a] son of Islam."

segments.arabic: وَعَنْ مَالِهِ قَالَ الفَقْرُ
segments.english: And about his wealth, he said: "Poverty."

segments.arabic: وَعَنْ حَانُوتِهِ قَالَ المَسْجِدُ
segments.english: And about his shop, he said: "The mosque."

segments.arabic: وَعَنْ كَسْبِهِ قَالَ الصَّبْرُ
segments.english: And about his earning, he said: "Patience."

segments.arabic: وَعَنْ لِبَاسِهِ قَالَ التَّقْوَى وَالتَّوَاضُعُ
segments.english: And about his clothing, he said: "God-consciousness and humility."

segments.arabic: وَعَنْ وِسَادِهِ قَالَ السَّهَرُ
segments.english: And about his pillow, he said: "Wakefulness."

segments.arabic: وَعَنْ فَخْرِهِ قَالَ سَلْمَانُ مِنَّا
segments.english: And about his pride, he said: "Salman [is] from us."

segments.arabic: وَعَنْ قَصْدِهِ قَالَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ
segments.english: And about his goal, he said: "They seek His Face."

segments.arabic: وَعَنْ سَيْرِهِ قَالَ إِلَى الجَنَّةِ
segments.english: And about his journey, he said: "To Paradise."

segments.arabic: وَعَنْ دَلِيلِهِ فِي الطَّرِيقِ قَالَ إِمَامُ الخَلْقِ وَهَادِي الأُمَّةِ
segments.english: And about his guide on the path, he said: "The leader of creation and the guide of the community."

segments.arabic: إِذَا نَحْنُ أَدْلَجْنَا وَأَنْتَ إِمَامُنَا ... كَفَى بِالمَطَايَا طِيبُ ذِكْرَاكَ حَادِيًا
segments.english: When we travel by night and you [are] our leader, the sweetness of your remembrance [is] enough for the mounts as [a] driver.

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ نَحْنُ أَضْلَلْنَا الطَّرِيقَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ ... دَلِيلًا كَفَانَا نُورُ وَجْهِكَ هَادِيًا
segments.english: And if we lose the path and find no guide, the light of your face [is] enough for us as [a] guide.

segments.arabic: الذُّنُوبُ جِرَاحَاتٌ وَرُبَّ جُرْحٍ وَقَعَ فِي مَقْتَلٍ
segments.english: Sins [are] wounds, and many [a] wound falls on [a] fatal spot.

segments.arabic: لَوْ خَرَجَ عَقْلُكَ مِنْ سُلْطَانِ هَوَاكَ عَادَتِ الدَّوْلَةُ لَهُ
segments.english: If your intellect escaped from the rule of your desire, authority [would] return to it.

segments.arabic: دَخَلْتَ دَارَ الهَوَى فَقَامَرْتَ بِعُمْرِكَ
segments.english: You entered the house of desire, so you gambled with your life.

segments.arabic: إِذَا عَرَضَتْ نَظْرَةٌ لَا تَحِلُّ فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهَا مِسْعَرُ حَرْبٍ فَاسْتَتِرْ مِنْهَا بِحِجَابِ
segments.english: When [a] forbidden glance comes your way, know that it [is a] fire-starter of war, so shield yourself from it behind the screen of:

segments.arabic: ﴿قُلْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾
segments.english: "Say to the believers [to lower their gaze]."

segments.arabic: فَقَدْ سَلِمْتَ مِنَ الأَثَرِ
segments.english: Then you [will have] been saved from [its] effect.

segments.arabic: ﴿وَكَفَى اللَّهُ المُؤْمِنِينَ القِتَالَ﴾
segments.english: "And God spared the believers the fight."

segments.arabic: بَحْرُ الهَوَى إِذَا مَدَّ أَغْرَقَ
segments.english: The sea of desire, when it rises, drowns.

segments.arabic: وَأَخْوَفُ المَنَافِذِ عَلَى السَّابِحِ فَتْحُ البَصَرِ فِي المَاءِ
segments.english: And the most dangerous opening for the swimmer [is] opening the eyes in the water.

segments.arabic: مَا أَحَدٌ أَكْرَمُ مِنْ مُفْرَدٍ ... فِي قَبْرِهِ أَعْمَالُهُ تُؤْنِسُهُ
segments.english: No one [is] more honored than [a] solitary one — in his grave, his deeds keep him company.

segments.arabic: مُنَعَّمًا فِي القَبْرِ فِي رَوْضَةٍ ... لَيْسَ كَعَبْدٍ قَبْرُهُ مَحْبِسُهُ
segments.english: [He is] blessed in the grave, in [a] garden — not like [a] servant whose grave [is] his prison.

segments.arabic: عَلَى قَدْرِ فَضْلِ المَرْءِ يَأْتِي خُطُوبُهُ ... وَيُعْرَفُ عِنْدَ الصَّبْرِ فِيمَا يُصِيبُهُ
segments.english: According to the worth of [a] person, his trials come — and he [is] known by [his] patience in what strikes him.

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ قَلَّ فِيمَا يَتَّقِيهِ اصْطِبَارُهُ ... فَقَدْ قَلَّ مِمَّا يَرْتَجِيهِ نَصِيبُهُ
segments.english: And whoever has little patience in what he fears, then his share of what he hopes for [is] also little.

segments.arabic: كَمْ قُطِعَ زَرْعٌ قَبْلَ التَّمَامِ فَمَا ظَنُّ الزَّرْعِ المُسْتَحْصَدِ
segments.english: How many [a] crop [was] cut before it ripened — so what does the ready-to-harvest crop expect?

segments.arabic: اشْتَرِ نَفْسَكَ فَالسُّوقُ قَائِمَةٌ وَالثَّمَنُ مَوْجُودٌ
segments.english: Buy back yourself, for the market [is] open and the price [is] available.

segments.arabic: لَا بُدَّ مِنْ سِنَةِ الغَفْلَةِ وَرُقَادِ الهَوَى
segments.english: [There is] no escape from the slumber of heedlessness and the sleep of desire.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِنْ كُنْ خَفِيفَ النَّوْمِ فَحُرَّاسُ البَلَدِ يَصِيحُونَ دَنَا الصَّبَاحُ
segments.english: But be [a] light sleeper, for the guards of the city [are] calling out: "The morning [is] near!"

segments.arabic: نُورُ العَقْلِ يُضِيءُ فِي لَيْلِ الهَوَى فَتَلُوحُ جَادَّةُ الصَّوَابِ
segments.english: The light of the intellect shines in the night of desire, and the road of correctness appears.

segments.arabic: فَيَتَلَمَّحُ البَصِيرُ فِي ذَلِكَ النُّورِ عَوَاقِبَ الأُمُورِ
segments.english: Then the person of insight sees, in that light, the outcomes of matters.

segments.arabic: أَخْرِجْ بِالعَزْمِ مِنْ هَذَا
segments.english: Get out of this with determination!

segments.arabic: الفناء الضيّق المحشو بالآفات إِلَى ذَلِك الفناء الرحب الَّذِي فِيهِ مَالا عين رَأَتْ
segments.english: the narrow courtyard stuffed with afflictions, to that spacious courtyard in which [is] what no eye has seen.

segments.arabic: فهناك لَا يتعذّر مَطْلُوب وَلَا يفقد مَحْبُوب
segments.english: So there, no desired thing [is] unattainable, and no beloved [is] lost.

segments.arabic: يَا بَائِعا نَفسه بهوى مَنْ حُبُّه ضنا وَوَصله أَذَى وَحسنه إِلَى فَنًّا
segments.english: O [you who are] selling your soul for the desire of one whose love [is] sickness, whose closeness [is] harm, and whose beauty [is] heading to decay —

segments.arabic: لقد بِعْت أنفس الْأَشْيَاء بِثمن بخس
segments.english: you have sold the most precious of things for [a] cheap price,

segments.arabic: كَأَنَّك لم تعرف قدر السّلْعَة وَبلا خسة الثّمن
segments.english: as if you did not know the worth of the merchandise, nor the cheapness of the price,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى إِذا قدمت يَوْم التغابن تبيّن لَك ان الْغبن فِي عقد التبايع
segments.english: until when you arrive on the Day of Mutual Loss, it [will] become clear to you that the loss [was] in the contract of sale.

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَه إِلَّا الله سلْعَة الله مشتريها وَثمنهَا الجنّة والدلال الرَّسُول
segments.english: There [is] no god but God! [It is] a merchandise — God [is] its buyer, and its price [is] Paradise, and the broker [is] the Messenger.

segments.arabic: ترْضى بِبَيْعِهَا بِجُزْء يسير مِمَّا لَا يُسَاوِي كُله جنَاح بعوضة
segments.english: [Are] you pleased to sell it for [a] small portion of what — all of it — [is] not worth [a] mosquito's wing?

segments.arabic: إِذا كَانَ شَيْء لَا يُسَاوِي جَمِيعه ... جنَاح بعوضة عِنْد من صرت عَبده
segments.english: If [a] thing — all of it — [is] not worth [a] mosquito's wing, in the sight of the one whose servant you have become,

segments.arabic: وَيملك جُزْء مِنْهُ كلك مَا الَّذِي ... يكون على ذَا الْحَال قدرك عِنْده
segments.english: and [a] portion of it owns all of you — what would your worth be in his sight in this state?

segments.arabic: وبعت بِهِ نفسا قد استامها بِمَا ... لَدَيْهِ من الْحسنى وَقد زَالَ وده
segments.english: And you sold for it [a] soul that He had offered to buy with what He has of goodness — and [now] His affection has gone.

segments.arabic: يَا مخنت الْعَزْم أَيْن أَنْت وَالطَّرِيق
segments.english: O [you of] weakened resolve — where are you and the path?

segments.arabic: طَرِيق تَعب فِيهِ آدم وناح لأَجله نوح
segments.english: [It is] a path in which Adam toiled, and Noah wept for its sake,

segments.arabic: وَرمي فِي النَّار الْخَلِيل وأضجع للذبح إِسْمَاعِيل
segments.english: and the Close Friend [was] thrown into the fire, and Ishmael [was] laid down for slaughter,

segments.arabic: وَبيع يُوسُف بِثمن بخس ولبث فِي السجْن بضع سِنِين
segments.english: and Joseph [was] sold for [a] cheap price and stayed in prison for several years,

segments.arabic: وَنشر بِالْمِنْشَارِ زَكَرِيَّا وَذبح السَّيِّد الحصور يحيى
segments.english: and Zechariah [was] sawed with the saw, and the noble, chaste John [was] slaughtered,

segments.arabic: وقاسى الضّر أَيُّوب وَزَاد على الْمِقْدَار بكاء دَاوُد
segments.english: and Job endured harm, and David's weeping exceeded all measure,

segments.arabic: وَسَار مَعَ الْوَحْش عِيسَى وعالج الْفقر وأنواع الْأَذَى مُحَمَّد
segments.english: and Jesus walked with the wild animals, and Muhammad struggled with poverty and all kinds of harm —

segments.arabic: تزها أَنْت باللهو واللعب
segments.english: [yet] you amuse yourself with play and entertainment?

segments.arabic: فيا دارها بالحزن ان مزارها ... قريب وَلَكِن دون ذَلِك أهوال
segments.english: So seek it with hardship, for its destination [is] near — but before that [there are] terrors.

segments.arabic: الْحَرْب قَائِمَة وَأَنت أعزل فِي النظارة
segments.english: The war [is] raging and you [are] unarmed among the spectators.

segments.arabic: فَإِن حركت ركابك فللهزيمة
segments.english: And if you moved your mount, [it was] for retreat.

segments.arabic: من لم يُبَاشر حر الهجير فِي طلاب الْمجد لم يَقِل فِي ظلال الشّرف
segments.english: Whoever does not endure the heat of midday in pursuit of glory will not rest in the shade of honor.

segments.arabic: تَقول سليمى لَو أَقمت بأرضنا ... وَلم تدارني للمقام أَطُوف
segments.english: Sulaymā says: 'If only you stayed in our land' — and she did not know that I wander seeking [a] place to settle.

segments.arabic: قيل لبَعض الْعباد إِلَى كم تتعب نَفسك
segments.english: It was said to one of the worshippers: 'How long will you exhaust yourself?'

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ راحتها أُرِيد
segments.english: So he said: '[It is] its rest [that] I seek.'

segments.arabic: يَا مكر مَا بجلة
segments.english: O [what a] scheme — how noble [it is]!

headings.arabic: فائدة من فقد أنسه بالله بين الناس ووجده في الوحدة فهو صادق ضعيف
headings.english: Benefit: Whoever lost his closeness with God among people and found it in solitude, he [is] truthful [but] weak

segments.arabic: الْإِيمَان بعد حلَّة الْعَافِيَة وَهُوَ يخلقهما فِي مُخَالفَة الْخَالِق
segments.english: faith after the garment of well-being — while he strips them both off in disobedience to the Creator.

segments.arabic: لَا تنكر السَّلب
segments.english: Do not be surprised by the deprivation.

segments.arabic: يسْتَحق من اسْتعْمل نعْمَة الْمُنعم فِيمَا يكره أَن يسلبها
segments.english: Whoever used the blessing of the Giver in what He dislikes deserves to have it taken away.

segments.arabic: عرائس الموجودات قد تزينت للناظرين ليبلوهم أَيهمْ يؤثرهن على عرائس الْآخِرَة
segments.english: The brides of created things have adorned themselves for the onlookers, to test them — which of them will prefer them over the brides of the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: فَمن عرف قدر التَّفَاوُت آثر مَا يَنْبَغِي إيثاره
segments.english: So whoever knew the extent of the difference preferred what deserves to be preferred.

segments.arabic: وَحسان الْكَوْن لما أَن بَدَت ... أَقبلت نحوي وَقَالَت لي إِلَيّ
segments.english: And the beauties of the world, when they appeared, came toward me and said to me, 'Come to me!'

segments.arabic: فتعاميت كَأَن لم أرها ... عِنْدَمَا أَبْصرت مقصودي لدي
segments.english: So I pretended [to be] blind as if I had not seen them, when I saw my goal [was] with me.

segments.arabic: كواكب هم العارفين فِي روج عزائمهم سيارة لَيْسَ فِيهَا زحل
segments.english: The planets of the knowers' aspirations, in the constellations of their determinations, [are] orbiting — [there is] no retreat in them.

segments.arabic: يَا من انحرف عَن جادتهم كن فِي أَوَاخِر الركب ونم إِذا نمت على الطَّرِيق
segments.english: O you who deviated from their path — be at the rear of the caravan, and sleep if you sleep on the road,

segments.arabic: فالأمير يُرَاعِي السَّاقَة
segments.english: for the leader watches over those at the rear.

segments.arabic: قيل لِلْحسنِ سبقنَا الْقَوْم على خيل دهم وَنحن على حمر معقرة
segments.english: It was said to al-Hasan: 'The people have preceded us on dark horses, while we [are] on hamstrung donkeys.'

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ إِن كنت على طريقهم فَمَا أسْرع اللحاق بهم
segments.english: He said: 'If you are on their path, how quickly [you will] catch up to them!'

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة من فقد أنسه بِاللَّه بَين النَّاس ووجده فِي الْوحدَة فَهُوَ صَادِق ضَعِيف
segments.english: Benefit: Whoever lost his closeness with God among people and found it in solitude, he [is] truthful [but] weak.

segments.arabic: وَمن وجده بَين النَّاس وفقده فِي الْخلْوَة فَهُوَ مَعْلُول
segments.english: And whoever found it among people and lost it in seclusion, he [is] afflicted.

segments.arabic: وَمن فَقده بَين النَّاس وَفِي الْخلْوَة فَهُوَ ميت مطرود
segments.english: And whoever lost it among people and in seclusion, he [is] dead [and] cast out.

segments.arabic: وَمن وجده فِي الْخلْوَة وَفِي النَّاس فَهُوَ الْمُحب الصَّادِق الْقوي فِي حَاله
segments.english: And whoever found it in seclusion and among people, he [is] the truthful lover, strong in his state.

segments.arabic: وَمن كَانَ فَتحه فِي الْخلْوَة لم يكن مزيده إِلَّا مِنْهَا
segments.english: And whoever's opening was in seclusion, his increase was only from it.

segments.arabic: وَمن كَانَ فَتحه بَيت النَّاس ونصحهم وإرشادهم كَانَ مزيده مَعَهم
segments.english: And whoever's opening was among people — advising them and guiding them — his increase was with them.

segments.arabic: وَمن كَانَ فَتحه فِي وُقُوفه مَعَ مُرَاد الله حَيْثُ أَقَامَهُ وَفِي أَي شَيْء اسْتَعْملهُ
segments.english: And whoever's opening was in standing with what God wills, wherever He placed him and in whatever He employed him,

segments.arabic: كَانَ مزيده فِي خلوته وَمَعَ النَّاس
segments.english: his increase was in his seclusion and with people.

segments.arabic: فَأَشْرَف الْأَحْوَال أَن لَا تخْتَار لنَفسك حَالَة سوى مَا يختاره لَك ويقيمك فِيهِ
segments.english: So the noblest of states [is] that you do not choose for yourself [a] state other than what He chooses for you and places you in.

segments.arabic: فَكُن مَعَ مُرَاده مِنْك وَلَا تكن مَعَ مرادك مِنْهُ
segments.english: So be with His will for you, and do not be with your want from Him.

segments.arabic: مصابيح الْقُلُوب الطاهرة فِي أصل الْفطْرَة منيرة قبل
segments.english: The lamps of pure hearts [are], in the foundation of the inborn nature, shining before —

segments.arabic: الشَّرَائِع يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِيءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تمسسه نَار
segments.english: the revealed laws — their oil almost shines even if no fire touched it.

segments.arabic: وحَّدَ قُسٌّ وَمَا رأى الرَّسُول
segments.english: Quss affirmed monotheism though he never saw the Messenger,

segments.arabic: وَكفر ابْن أُبي وَقد صلى مَعَه فِي الْمَسْجِد
segments.english: and Ibn Ubayy disbelieved though he prayed with him in the mosque.

segments.arabic: مَعَ الصبري وَلَا مَاء
segments.english: [Like one] with aloe but no water,

segments.arabic: وَكم من عطشان فِي اللجة
segments.english: and how many thirsty [people are there] in the deep sea!

segments.arabic: سبق الْعلم بنبوة مُوسَى وإيمان آسِيَة
segments.english: [God's] knowledge preceded [it all] — of the prophethood of Moses and the faith of Asiya.

segments.arabic: فسيق تابوته إِلَى بَيتهَا
segments.english: So his basket was driven to her house.

segments.arabic: فجَاء طِفْل مُنْفَرد عَن أم إِلَى امْرَأَة خَالِيَة عَن ولد
segments.english: So [a] child separated from [a] mother came to [a] woman without [a] child.

segments.arabic: فَللَّه كم فِي هَذِه الْقِصَّة من عِبْرَة
segments.english: By God, how many lessons [there are] in this story!

segments.arabic: كم ذبح فِرْعَوْن فِي طلب مُوسَى من ولد
segments.english: How many children Pharaoh slaughtered in [his] search for Moses!

segments.arabic: ولسان الْقدر يَقُول لَا نربيه إِلَّا فِي حجرك
segments.english: And the tongue of destiny says: we [will] not raise him except in your lap!

segments.arabic: كَانَ ذُو البجادين يَتِيما فِي الصغر فَكَفَلَهُ عَمه
segments.english: Dhu al-Bijadayn was an orphan in childhood, so his uncle took care of him.

segments.arabic: فنازعته نَفسه إِلَى اتّباع الرَّسُول
segments.english: And his self pulled him toward following the Messenger.

segments.arabic: فهمَّ بالنهوض فَإِذا بَقِيَّة الْمَرَض مَانِعَة
segments.english: So he intended to set out, but the remainder of [his] illness [was] preventing [him].

segments.arabic: فَقعدَ ينْتَظر الْعم
segments.english: So he sat waiting [for] the uncle.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا تكاملت صِحَّته نفذ الصَّبْر
segments.english: And when his health [was] complete, patience ran out.

segments.arabic: فناداه ضمير الوجد
segments.english: And the inner voice of longing called him:

segments.arabic: إِلَى كم حَبسهَا تَشْكُو المضيقا ... أَثَرهَا رُبمَا وجدت طَرِيقا
segments.english: How long [will] you keep her imprisoned, complaining of tightness? … Let her go — perhaps she [will] find [a] way.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ يَا عَم طَال انتظاري لإسلامك وَمَا أرى مِنْك نشاطا
segments.english: So he said: O uncle, my waiting for your Islam has been long, and I do not see from you [any] eagerness.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ وَالله لَئِن أسلمت لأنتزعن كل مَا أَعطيتك
segments.english: So he said: By God, if you accept Islam, I [will] surely take back everything I gave you.

segments.arabic: فصاح لِسَان الشوق نظرة من مُحَمَّد أحب إِلَيّ من الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا
segments.english: So the tongue of yearning cried out: [a] glance from Muhammad [is] more beloved to me than this world and what [is] in it!

segments.arabic: وَلَو قيل للمجنون ليلى وَوَصلهَا ... تُرِيدُ أم الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِي طواياها
segments.english: And if [it] were said to the madman of Layla: do you want her and union with her, or this world and what [is] in its folds?

segments.arabic: لقَالَ ترابٌ من غُبَار نعالها ... ألذ إِلَى نَفسِي وأشفى لبلواها
segments.english: He would have said: dirt from the dust of her sandals [is] sweeter to my soul and more healing for its suffering.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا تجرد للسير إِلَى الرَّسُول جرده عَمه من الثِّيَاب
segments.english: And when he set out to travel to the Messenger, his uncle stripped him of [his] clothes.

segments.arabic: فناولته الْأُم بجادا فَقَطعه لسفر الْوَصْل نِصْفَيْنِ
segments.english: So his mother handed him [a] coarse cloth, and he cut it for the journey of reunion [into] two halves.

segments.arabic: اتّزر بِأَحَدِهِمَا وارتدي بِالْآخرِ
segments.english: He wrapped one of them around his waist and wore the other [as a cloak].

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا نَادَى صائح الْجِهَاد قنع أَن يكون فِي سافة الأحباب
segments.english: And when the caller of jihad called out, he [was] content to be in the rear of the beloved ones.

segments.arabic: والمحب لَا يرى طول الطَّرِيق لِأَن الْمَقْصُود يُعينهُ
segments.english: And the lover does not see the length of the road, because the one he seeks helps him.

segments.arabic: أَلا بلّغ الله الْحمى من يُريدهُ ... وَبلغ أكناف الْحمى من يريدها
segments.english: May God bring to the sacred land whoever desires it, and bring to the edges of the sacred land whoever desires them.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا قضى نحبه نزل الرَّسُول يمهد لحده
segments.english: And when he died, the Messenger came down to prepare his grave.

segments.arabic: وَجعل يَقُول اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أمسيت عَنهُ رَاضِيا فارض عَنهُ
segments.english: And he kept saying: O God, I have reached the evening pleased with him, so be pleased with him.

segments.arabic: فصاح ابْن مَسْعُود يَا لَيْتَني كنت صَاحب الْقَبْر
segments.english: So Ibn Mas'ud cried out: Oh, I wish I were the companion of the grave!

segments.arabic: فيا مخنث الْعَزْم أقل مَا فِي الرقعة البيذق
segments.english: So O you of weak resolve — the least [piece] on the [chess]board [is] the pawn.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا نَهَضَ تفرزن رأى بعض
segments.english: But when it advances [and] becomes [a] queen, it sees some —

headings.arabic: فصل الدنيا كامرأة بغي لا تثبت مع زوج إنما تخطب الأزواج ليستحسنوا
headings.english: Chapter: This world [is] like an immoral woman [who] does not stay with [one] husband — she only courts husbands so they may admire her

segments.arabic: الْحُكَمَاء برذونا يسقى عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: the wise men [saw] a mule used for carrying water

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ لَو هملج هَذَا الركب أَقْدَام الْعَزْم بالسلوك
segments.english: So he said: if these riders set the feet of resolve upon the path,
