segments.arabic: انْدفع من بَين أيديها سد القواطع
segments.english: the barrier of obstacles would [be] pushed away from before them.

segments.arabic: القواطع محن يتَبَيَّن بهَا الصَّادِق من الْكَاذِب
segments.english: The obstacles [are] trials by which the truthful [is] distinguished from the liar.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا خضتها انقلبت أعوانا لَك توصلك إِلَى الْمَقْصُود
segments.english: So when you wade through them, they turn into helpers for you that deliver you to the goal.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Chapter

segments.arabic: الدُّنْيَا كامرأة بغي لَا تثبت مَعَ زوج
segments.english: This world [is] like an immoral woman [who] does not stay with [one] husband.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا تخْطب الْأزْوَاج ليستحسنوا عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: She only courts husbands so they may admire her.

segments.arabic: فَلَا ترْضى بالدياثة
segments.english: So do not accept being cuckolded.

segments.arabic: ميزت بَين جمَالهَا وفعالها ... فَإِذا الملاحة بالقباحة لَا تفي
segments.english: I compared her beauty with her deeds… and the charm does not make up for the ugliness.

segments.arabic: حَلَفت لنا أَن لَا تخون عُهُودنَا ... فَكَأَنَّهَا حَلَفت لنا أَن لَا تفي
segments.english: She swore to us that she would not betray our pledges… [it is] as if she swore to us that she would not be faithful.

segments.arabic: السّير فِي طلبَهَا سير فِي أَرض مسبعَة
segments.english: Walking in pursuit of her [is] walking in a land [full] of lions.

segments.arabic: والسباحة فِيهَا سباحة فِي غَدِير التمساح
segments.english: And swimming in her [is] swimming in a crocodile pool.

segments.arabic: المفروح بِهِ مِنْهَا هُوَ عين المحزون عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: What [is] rejoiced over from her — it [is] the very thing [that is] grieved over.

segments.arabic: آلامها مُتَوَلّدَة من لذاتها وأحزانها من أفراحها
segments.english: Her pains [are] born from her pleasures, and her sorrows from her joys.

segments.arabic: مآرب كَانَت فِي الشَّبَاب لأَهْلهَا ... عَذَاب فَصَارَت فِي المشيب عذَابا
segments.english: Desires that were sweet to their people in youth… became torment in old age.

segments.arabic: طَائِر الطَّبْع يرى الْحبَّة وَعين الْعقل ترى الشّرك
segments.english: The bird of [natural] inclination sees the grain, and the eye of reason sees the trap.

segments.arabic: غير أَن عين الْهوى عميا
segments.english: But the eye of desire [is] blind.

segments.arabic: وَعين الرِّضَا عَن كل عيب كليلة ... كَمَا أَن عين السخط تبدي المساويا
segments.english: And the eye of contentment [is] dim to every fault… just as the eye of anger reveals [all] flaws.

segments.arabic: تزخرفت الشَّهَوَات لأعين الطباع
segments.english: Desires adorned themselves for the eyes of [natural] inclination.

segments.arabic: فغض عَنْهَا الَّذين يُؤمنُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ
segments.english: So those who believe in the unseen lowered [their gaze] from them,

segments.arabic: وَوَقع تابعوها فِي بيداء الحسرات
segments.english: and their followers fell into the desert of regrets.

segments.arabic: واؤلئك عَلَى هُدىً مِنْ رَبهم واؤلئك هم المفلحون
segments.english: And those [are] upon guidance from their Lord, and those — they [are] the successful ones.

segments.arabic: وَهَؤُلَاء يُقَال لَهُم
segments.english: And to these [others] it [is] said:

segments.arabic: ﴿كُلُوا وَتَمَتَّعُوا قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مجرمون﴾
segments.english: Eat and enjoy [yourselves] [for] a little; you [are] criminals.
segments.sahih_international: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

segments.arabic: لما عرف الموفقون قدر الْحَيَاة الدُّنْيَا وَقلة الْمقَام فِيهَا
segments.english: When the guided ones knew the worth of the life of this world and the shortness of the stay in it,

segments.arabic: أماتوا فيها الْهوى طلبا لحياة الْأَبَد
segments.english: they killed desire in it, seeking the life of eternity.

segments.arabic: لما استيقظوا من نوم الْغَفْلَة
segments.english: When they woke from the sleep of heedlessness,

segments.arabic: استرجعوا بالجد مَا انهبه الْعَدو مِنْهُم فِي زمن البطالة
segments.english: they recovered through effort what the enemy had plundered from them in the time of idleness.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا طَالَتْ عَلَيْهِم الطَّرِيق تلمحوا الْمَقْصد
segments.english: And when the road grew long for them, they gazed at the destination,

segments.arabic: فَقرب عَلَيْهِم الْبعيد
segments.english: and what [was] far became near for them.

segments.arabic: وَكلما أمرت لَهُم الْحَيَاة حلى لَهُم تذكر
segments.english: And whenever life became bitter for them, [the] remembrance became sweet for them [of]:

segments.arabic: ﴿هَذَا يَوْمُكُمُ الَّذِي كُنْتُم توعدون﴾
segments.english: This [is] your Day which you were promised.
segments.sahih_international: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -

segments.arabic: وَركب سروا اللَّيْل ملق رواقه ... على كل مغْبرّ الْمطَالع قَائِم
segments.english: And riders [who] traveled by night while it cast its curtain… over every dust-covered, standing [traveler].

segments.arabic: حدوا عَزمَات ضَاعَت الأَرْض بَينهَا ... فَصَارَ سراهم فِي طُلُوع العزائم
segments.english: They sharpened resolves before which the earth [was] lost… so their night-travel became [a rising] among the rising of [great] determinations.

headings.arabic: فصل لما رأى المتيقظون سطوة الدنيا بأهلها وخداع الأمل لأربابه وتملك
headings.english: Section: When the Awakened Ones Saw the Tyranny of This World over Its People and the Deception of Hope over Its Holders and the Mastery

segments.arabic: تريهم نُجُوم اللَّيْل مَا يتبعونه ... على عاتق الشعري وهام النعائم
segments.english: The stars of the night show them what they follow… upon the shoulder of Sirius and the heads of the Ostriches

segments.arabic: إِذا اطردت فِي معرك الْجد قصفوا ... رماح العطايا فِي صُدُور المكارم
segments.english: When [they] charged forth in the arena of striving, they shattered the spears of gifts against the chests of noble deeds

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Section

segments.arabic: من أعجب الْأَشْيَاء أَن تعرفه ثمَّ لَا تحبه
segments.english: Among the most wondrous things [is] that you know Him, then do not love Him,

segments.arabic: وَأَن تسمع داعيه ثمَّ تتأخر عَن الْإِجَابَة
segments.english: and that you hear His caller, then delay in answering,

segments.arabic: وَأَن تعرف قدر الرِّبْح فِي مُعَامَلَته ثمَّ تعْمل غَيره
segments.english: and that you know the value of profit in dealing with Him, then deal with other than Him,

segments.arabic: وَأَن تعرف قدر غَضَبه ثمَّ تتعرّض لَهُ
segments.english: and that you know the weight of His anger, then expose yourself to it,

segments.arabic: وَأَن تذوق ألم الوحشة فِي مَعْصِيَته ثمَّ لَا تطلب الْأنس بِطَاعَتِهِ
segments.english: and that you taste the pain of loneliness in disobeying Him, then do not seek comfort in obeying Him,

segments.arabic: وَأَن تذوق عصرة الْقلب عِنْد الْخَوْض فِي غير حَدِيثه والْحَدِيث عَنهُ
segments.english: and that you taste the tightness of the heart when diving into other than His speech and talk about Him,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ لَا تشتاق إِلَى انْشِرَاح الصَّدْر بِذكرِهِ ومناجاته
segments.english: then do not long for the opening of the chest through His remembrance and private conversation with Him,

segments.arabic: وَأَن تذوق الْعَذَاب عِنْد تعلق الْقلب بِغَيْرِهِ
segments.english: and that you taste the torment when the heart clings to other than Him,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تهرب مِنْهُ إِلَى نعيم الإقبال عَلَيْهِ والإنابة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: yet do not flee from it to the bliss of turning to Him and returning to Him.

segments.arabic: وأعجب من هَذَا علمك أَنَّك لابد لَك مِنْهُ وَأَنَّك أحْوج شَيْء إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And more wondrous than this [is] your knowledge that you cannot do without Him, and that you [are] the most in need of Him,

segments.arabic: وَأَنت عَنهُ معرض وَفِيمَا يبعدك عَنهُ رَاغِب
segments.english: yet you turn away from Him, and desire what distances you from Him.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة
segments.english: Benefit

segments.arabic: مَا أَخذ العَبْد مَا حرم عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا من جِهَتَيْنِ
segments.english: The servant does not take what [is] forbidden to him except from two angles.

segments.arabic: إِحْدَاهمَا سوء ظَنّه بربه
segments.english: The first [is] his bad opinion of his Lord —

segments.arabic: وَأَنه لَو أطاعه وآثره لم يُعْطه خيرا مِنْهُ حَلَالا
segments.english: that if he obeyed Him and chose Him, He would not give him [something] better than it [that is] lawful.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانيَِة أَن يكون عَالما بذلك وَأَن من ترك لله شَيْئا أعاضه خيرا مِنْهُ
segments.english: And the second [is] that he knows that, and [knows] that whoever leaves something for God, He compensates him [with something] better than it —

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن تغلب شَهْوَته صبره وهواه عقله
segments.english: but his craving overpowers his patience, and his desire [overpowers] his mind.

segments.arabic: فَالْأول من ضعف علمه وَالثَّانِي من ضعف عقله وبصيرته
segments.english: So the first [is] from the weakness of his knowledge, and the second [is] from the weakness of his mind and insight.

segments.arabic: قَالَ يحي بن معَاذ من جمع الله عَلَيْهِ قلبه فِي الدُّعَاء لم يردهُ
segments.english: Yahya ibn Mu'adh said: whoever God gathers his heart upon in supplication, He does not turn him away.

segments.arabic: قلت إِذا اجْتمع عَلَيْهِ قلبه وصدقت ضَرُورَته وفاقته
segments.english: I say: if his heart [is] gathered upon Him, and his need and poverty [are] sincere,

segments.arabic: وَقَوي رجاؤه فَلَا يكَاد يرد دعاؤه
segments.english: and his hope [is] strong, then his supplication [is] hardly ever turned away.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Section

segments.arabic: لما رأى المتيقظون سطوة الدُّنْيَا بِأَهْلِهَا وخداع الأمل لأربابه
segments.english: When the awakened ones saw the tyranny of this world over its people, and the deception of hope over its holders,

segments.arabic: وتملك الشَّيْطَان وقياد النُّفُوس
segments.english: and the mastery of Satan and [his] leading of souls,

segments.arabic: رَأَوْا الدولة للنَّفس الأمارة
segments.english: [and] they saw [that] the power [belonged] to the commanding self,

segments.arabic: لجأوا إِلَى حصن التضرّع والالتجاء كَمَا
segments.english: they took refuge in the fortress of humble supplication and seeking shelter, just as —

segments.arabic: يأوي العَبْد المذعور إِلَى حرم سَيّده
segments.english: The frightened servant takes refuge in the sanctuary of his master.

segments.arabic: شهوات الدُّنْيَا كلعب الخيال
segments.english: The desires of this world [are] like the play of imagination.

segments.arabic: وَنظر الْجَاهِل مَقْصُور على الظَّاهِر
segments.english: And the gaze of the ignorant [is] limited to the outward.

segments.arabic: فَأَما ذُو الْعقل فَيرى مَا وراء السّتْر
segments.english: But the one with intellect sees what [is] behind the curtain.

segments.arabic: لَاحَ لَهُم المشتهَى
segments.english: The desired [thing] appeared to them.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا مدوا أَيدي التَّنَاوُل أبان لابصار البصائر خبط الفخ
segments.english: But when they stretched out the hands of reaching, the snapping of the trap became clear to the eyes of insight.

segments.arabic: فطاروا بأجنحة الحذر
segments.english: So they flew with the wings of caution.

segments.arabic: وصوبوا إِلَى الرحيل الثَّانِي
segments.english: And they headed toward the second departure.

segments.arabic: ياليت قومِي يعلمُونَ
segments.english: If only my people knew!

segments.arabic: تلمح الْقَوْم الْوُجُود ففهموا الْمَقْصُود
segments.english: The people glimpsed existence and [so] understood the purpose.

segments.arabic: فَأَجْمعُوا الرحيل قبل الرحيل
segments.english: So they resolved [on] departure before the [final] departure.

segments.arabic: وشمروا للسير فِي سَوَاء السَّبِيل
segments.english: And they rolled up [their sleeves] to walk on the middle of the path.

segments.arabic: فَالنَّاس مشتغلون بالفضلات وهم فِي قطع الفلوات
segments.english: So the people [are] busy with leftovers while they [are] crossing the wastelands.

segments.arabic: وعصافير الْهوى فِي وثاق الشبكة ينتظرون الذّبْح
segments.english: And the sparrows of desire [are] in the grip of the net, waiting for [the] slaughter.

segments.arabic: وَقع ثعلبان فِي شبكة
segments.english: Two foxes fell into [a] net.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ أَحدهمَا للْآخر أَيْن الْمُلْتَقى بعد هَذَا
segments.english: One of them said to the other: "Where [will be] the meeting place after this?"

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ بعد يَوْمَيْنِ فِي الدباغة
segments.english: He said: "In two days, in the tannery."

segments.arabic: تالله مَا كَانَت الْأَيَّام الا مناما
segments.english: By God, the days were nothing but [a] sleep.

segments.arabic: فليستيقظوا وَقد حصلوا على الظفر
segments.english: So let them wake up, and they [will] have achieved success.

segments.arabic: مَا مضى من الدُّنْيَا أَحْلَام
segments.english: What has passed of this world [is] dreams.

segments.arabic: وَمَا بَقِي مِنْهَا أماني
segments.english: And what remains of it [is] wishes.

segments.arabic: وَالْوَقْت ضائع بَينهمَا
segments.english: And the time [is] wasted between them.

segments.arabic: كَيفَ يسلم من لَهُ زَوْجَة لَا ترحمه وَولد لَا يعذرهُ وجار لَا يأمنه
segments.english: How can he be safe — one who has a wife [who] does not show him mercy, and a child [who] does not excuse him, and a neighbor he [is] not safe from,

segments.arabic: وَصَاحب لَا ينصحه وَشريك لَا ينصفه وعدو لَا ينَام عَن معاداته
segments.english: and a companion [who] does not advise him sincerely, and a partner [who] does not treat him fairly, and an enemy [who] does not sleep from his hostility,

segments.arabic: وَنَفس أَمارَة بالسوء وَدُنْيا متزيّنة وَهوى مرد
segments.english: and a self constantly commanding evil, and a world adorned, and a rebellious desire,

segments.arabic: وشهوة غالبة لَهُ وَغَضب قاهر وَشَيْطَان مزين وَضعف مستول عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and a lust overpowering him, and an overwhelming anger, and a devil beautifying [evil], and a weakness overtaking him?

segments.arabic: فَإِن تولاه الله وجذبه إِلَيْهِ انقهرت لَهُ هَذِه كلهَا
segments.english: If God takes care of him and draws him to Himself, all of these [are] overcome for him.

segments.arabic: وان تخلى عَنهُ ووكله إِلَى نَفسه اجْتمعت عَلَيْهِ فَكَانَت الهلكة
segments.english: But if He abandons him and leaves him to himself, they gather against him and it [is] destruction.

segments.arabic: لما أعرض النَّاس عَن تحكيم الْكتاب وَالسّنة والمحاكمة إِلَيْهِمَا
segments.english: When the people turned away from ruling by the Book and the Sunnah and referring judgment to them,

segments.arabic: واعتقدوا عدم الِاكْتِفَاء بهما
segments.english: and believed [in] their insufficiency,

segments.arabic: وَعدلُوا إِلَى الآراء وَالْقِيَاس وَالِاسْتِحْسَان وأقوال الشُّيُوخ
segments.english: and turned to opinions, analogy, juristic preference, and the sayings of the scholars —

segments.arabic: عرض لَهُم من ذَلِك فَسَاد فِي فطرهم وظلمة فِي قُلُوبهم
segments.english: there appeared in them from that corruption in their inborn natures and darkness in their hearts,

segments.arabic: وكدر فِي أفهامهم ومحق فِي عُقُولهمْ
segments.english: and muddiness in their understanding and erasure in their minds.

segments.arabic: وعمتهم هَذِه الْأُمُور وغلبت عَلَيْهِم
segments.english: And these matters overtook them and overpowered them,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى رَبِّي فِيهَا الصَّغِير وهرم عَلَيْهَا الْكَبِير
segments.english: until the young were raised upon them and the old grew old upon them.

segments.arabic: فَلم يروها مكرا
segments.english: And they did not see them as [a] trick.

segments.arabic: فجاءتهم دولة أُخْرَى قَامَت فِيهَا الْبدع مقَام السّنَن
segments.english: Then another era came upon them, in which innovations took the place of the prophetic ways,

segments.arabic: وَالنَّفس مقَام الْعقل والهوى مقَام الرشد
segments.english: and the self [took] the place of the intellect, and desire [took] the place of right-mindedness,

segments.arabic: والضلال مقَام الْهدى وَالْمُنكر مقَام الْمَعْرُوف
segments.english: and misguidance [took] the place of guidance, and the wrong [took] the place of the right,

segments.arabic: وَالْجهل مقَام الْعلم والرياء مقَام الْإِخْلَاص
segments.english: and ignorance [took] the place of knowledge, and showing off [took] the place of sincerity,

segments.arabic: وَالْبَاطِل مقَام الْحق وَالْكذب مقَام الصدْق
segments.english: and falsehood [took] the place of truth, and lying [took] the place of truthfulness,

segments.arabic: والمداهنة مقَام النَّصِيحَة وَالظُّلم مقَام الْعدْل
segments.english: and flattery [took] the place of sincere advice, and injustice [took] the place of justice.

segments.arabic: فَصَارَت الدولة
segments.english: And so this became the state [of affairs] —

segments.arabic: وَالْغَلَبَة لهَذِهِ الْأُمُور وَأَهْلهَا هم الْمشَار إِلَيْهِم
segments.english: And the dominance [belongs] to these matters, and their people — they [are] the ones pointed to.

segments.arabic: وَكَانَت قبل ذَلِك لأضدادها وَكَانَ أَهلهَا هم الْمشَار إِلَيْهِم
segments.english: And [it] was before that for their opposites, and their people were the ones pointed to.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا رَأَيْت دولة هَذِه الْأُمُور قد أَقبلت وراياتها قد نصبت وجيوشها قد ركبت
segments.english: So when you see the reign of these matters has come forward, and their banners have been raised, and their armies have mounted —

segments.arabic: فبطن الأَرْض وَالله خير من ظهرهَا
segments.english: then the belly of the earth, by God, [is] better than its surface,

segments.arabic: وقلل الْجبَال خير من السهول
segments.english: and the peaks of the mountains [are] better than the plains,

segments.arabic: ومخالطة الْوَحْش أسلم من مُخَالطَة النَّاس
segments.english: and mixing with wild animals [is] safer than mixing with people.

segments.arabic: اقشعرّت الأَرْض وأظلمت السَّمَاء
segments.english: The earth shuddered and the sky grew dark,

segments.arabic: وَظهر الْفساد فِي الْبر وَالْبَحْر من ظلم الفجرة
segments.english: and corruption appeared on the land and the sea from the wrongdoing of the wicked,

segments.arabic: وَذَهَبت البركات وقلّت الْخيرَات
segments.english: and blessings vanished and good things became few,

segments.arabic: وهُزلت الوحوش وتكدرت الْحَيَاة من فسق الظلمَة
segments.english: and the wild animals grew thin, and life became clouded from the sinfulness of the oppressors,

segments.arabic: وَبكى ضوء النَّهَار وظلمة اللَّيْل من الْأَعْمَال الخبيثة وَالْأَفْعَال الفظيعة
segments.english: and the light of day and the darkness of night wept from the evil deeds and the horrible acts,

segments.arabic: وشكا الْكِرَام الكاتبون والمعقبات إِلَى رَبهم من كَثْرَة الْفَوَاحِش وَغَلَبَة الْمُنْكَرَات والقبايح
segments.english: and the noble recording [angels] and the alternating [angels] complained to their Lord of the abundance of shameful acts, and the dominance of wrongdoings and ugly deeds.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا وَالله مُنْذر بسيل عَذَاب قد انْعَقَد غمامه
segments.english: And this, by God, [is a] warning of [a] flood of punishment whose clouds have gathered,

segments.arabic: ومؤذن بلَيْل بلَاء قد ادلهمّ ظلامه
segments.english: and [a] herald of [a] night of trial whose darkness has thickened.

segments.arabic: فاعزلوا عَن طَرِيق هَذَا السَّبِيل بتوبة نصوح مَا دَامَت التَّوْبَة مُمكنَة وبابها مَفْتُوح
segments.english: So step away from the path of this way with sincere repentance, as long as repentance [is] possible and its door [is] open.

segments.arabic: وكأنكم بِالْبَابِ وَقد أغلق وبالرهن وَقد غلق وبالجناح وَقد علق
segments.english: And [it is] as if you [can see] the door already shut, and the pledge already sealed, and the wing already clipped.

segments.arabic: ﴿وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَنْقَلِبُون﴾
segments.english: And those who wronged will [soon] know what [kind of] return they will return [to].
segments.sahih_international: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.

segments.arabic: اشْتَرِ نَفسك الْيَوْم فَإِن السُّوق قَائِمَة وَالثمن مَوْجُود والبضائع رخيصة
segments.english: Buy [back] yourself today, for the market [is] open, and the price [is] available, and the goods [are] cheap.

segments.arabic: وَسَيَأْتِي على تِلْكَ السُّوق والبضايع يَوْم لَا تصل فِيهَا إِلَى قَلِيل وَلَا كثير
segments.english: And there will come upon that market and [those] goods [a] day [when] you will not reach in it [even a] little or [a] lot.

segments.arabic: ذَلِكَ يَوْم التغابن يَوْم يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ
segments.english: That [is the] Day of Mutual Loss, [the] day the wrongdoer bites his [own] hands.

segments.arabic: إِذا أَنْت لم ترحل بزاد من التقى ... وأبصرت يَوْم الْحَشْر من قد تزودا
segments.english: If you did not travel with [a] provision of God-consciousness… and you saw on the Day of Gathering one who had prepared —

segments.arabic: نَدِمت على أَن لَا تكون كمثله ... وَأَنَّك لم ترصد كَمَا كَانَ أرصدا
segments.english: you [would] regret that you were not like him, and that you did not store up as he had stored up.

segments.arabic: الْعَمَل بِغَيْر إخلاص وَلَا اقْتِدَاء كالمسافر يمْلَأ جرابه رملا يثقله وَلَا يَنْفَعهُ
segments.english: Working without sincerity and without following [the Prophet] [is] like the traveler [who] fills his bag [with] sand — it weighs him down and does not benefit him.

segments.arabic: إِذا حملت على الْقلب هموم الدُّنْيَا وأثقالها وتهاونت بأوراده الَّتِي هِيَ قوته وحياته
segments.english: When you load upon the heart the worries of this world and its burdens, and you neglect its daily portions [of worship] which [are] its strength and its life,

segments.arabic: كنت كالمسافر الَّذِي يحمل دَابَّته فَوق طاقتها وَلَا يوفيها عَلفهَا فَمَا أسْرع مَا تقف بِهِ
segments.english: you [are] like the traveler who loads his riding animal beyond its capacity and does not give it its feed — so how quickly it stops on him!

segments.arabic: ومشتت العزمات ينْفق عمره ... حيران لَا ظفر وَلَا إخفاق
segments.english: And the one whose resolve [is] scattered spends his life confused — no victory and no failure.

segments.arabic: هَل السَّائِق العجلان يملك أمره ... فَمَا كل سير اليعملات وحيد
segments.english: Does the hasty driver control his affair? ... For not every pace of the she-camels [is] the same.

segments.arabic: رويدا بأخفاف المطى فَإِنَّمَا ... تداس جباه تحتهَا وخدود
segments.english: Gently with the hooves of the mounts, for indeed ... foreheads [are] trampled beneath them, and cheeks.

segments.arabic: من تلمح حلاوة الْعَافِيَة هان عَلَيْهِ مرَارَة الصَّبْر
segments.english: Whoever glimpses the sweetness of well-being, the bitterness of patience [becomes] easy for him.

segments.arabic: الْغَايَة أول فِي التَّقْدِير آخر فِي الْوُجُود
segments.english: The goal [is] first in planning, [and] last in existence.

segments.arabic: مبدأ فِي نظر الْعقل مُنْتَهى فِي منَازِل الْوُصُول
segments.english: [It is a] beginning in the view of the mind, [and] an end in the stations of arrival.

segments.arabic: ألفت عجز الْعَادة فَلَو علت بك همّتك رَبًّا الْمَعَالِي لاحت لَك أنوار العزائم
segments.english: You have grown used to the weakness of habit. If your aspiration raised you to the heights of greatness, the lights of determination would appear to you.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا تفَاوت الْقَوْم بالهمم لَا بالصور
segments.english: People only differ by [their] aspirations, not by [their] appearances.

segments.arabic: تَزُول همة الكساح دلاه فِي جب الْعذرَة
segments.english: The aspiration of the crippled [one] fades — [it] lowered him into the pit of filth.

segments.arabic: بَيْنك وَبَين الفائزين جبل الْهوى
segments.english: Between you and the winners [is] the mountain of desire.

segments.arabic: نزلُوا بَين يَدَيْهِ وَنزلت خَلفه
segments.english: They camped before it, and you camped behind it.

segments.arabic: فاطو فضل منزل تلْحق بالقوم
segments.english: So traverse the extra distance [and] you [will] catch up with the people.

segments.arabic: الدُّنْيَا مضمار سباق وَقد انْعَقَد الْغُبَار وخفي السَّابِق
segments.english: This world [is] a racetrack, and the dust has risen, and the leader [is] hidden.

segments.arabic: وَالنَّاس فِي الْمِضْمَار بَين فَارس وراجل وَأَصْحَاب حمر معقرة
segments.english: And the people on the track [are] between horsemen, foot-soldiers, and riders of hamstrung donkeys.

segments.arabic: سَوف ترى إِذا انجلى الْغُبَار ... أَفرس تَحْتك أم حمَار
segments.english: You will see when the dust clears — [is it] a horse beneath you, or [a] donkey?

segments.arabic: فِي الطَّبْع شَره وَالْحمية أوفق
segments.english: In [human] nature [there is] greed, and restraint [is] more fitting.

segments.arabic: لص الْحِرْص لَا يمشي إِلَّا فِي ظلام الْهوى
segments.english: The thief of greed does not walk except in the darkness of desire.

segments.arabic: حَبَّة المشتهى تَحت فخ التّلف
segments.english: The grain of craving [is] beneath the trap of ruin.

segments.arabic: فتفكر الذّبْح وَقد هان الصَّبْر
segments.english: So reflect on the slaughter, and patience [will] become easy.

segments.arabic: قُوَّة الطمع فِي بُلُوغ الأمل توجب الِاجْتِهَاد فِي الطّلب
segments.english: The strength of eagerness to reach [one's] hope requires striving in the pursuit,

segments.arabic: وَشدَّة الحذر من فَوت المأمول
segments.english: and extreme caution against missing what [is] hoped for.

segments.arabic: الْبَخِيل فَقير لَا يُؤجر على فقره
segments.english: The miser [is] poor, [but is] not rewarded for his poverty.

segments.arabic: الصَّبْر على عَطش الضّر وَلَا الشّرْب من شرعة منّ
segments.english: Patience through the thirst of hardship — and do not drink from the stream of [someone's] favor.

segments.arabic: تجوع الْحرَّة وَلَا تَأْكُل ثدييها
segments.english: The free woman starves and does not eat [by means of] her breasts.

segments.arabic: لَا تسْأَل سوى مَوْلَاك
segments.english: Do not ask [anyone] other than your Master.

segments.arabic: فسؤال العَبْد غير سَيّده تشنيع عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: For the servant asking other than his master [is] a disgrace upon him.

segments.arabic: غرس الْخلْوَة يُثمر الْأنس
segments.english: The planting of solitude bears the fruit of intimacy.

segments.arabic: استوحش مِمَّا لَا يَدُوم مَعَك
segments.english: Be wary of what does not last with you,

segments.arabic: واستأنس بِمن لَا يفارقك
segments.english: and find comfort in the One who does not leave you.

segments.arabic: عزلة الْجَاهِل فَسَاد
segments.english: The seclusion of the ignorant [is] corruption.

segments.arabic: وَأما عزلة الْعَالم فمعها حذاؤها وسقاؤها
segments.english: But the seclusion of the scholar — with it [are] its shoes and its water-skin.

segments.arabic: إِذا اجْتمع الْعقل وَالْيَقِين فِي بَيت العزلة واستحضر الْفِكر وَجَرت بَينهم مُنَاجَاة
segments.english: When the mind and certainty gather in the house of seclusion, and reflection [is] brought forth, and intimate conversation flows between them —

segments.arabic: أَتَاك حَدِيث لَا يمل سَمَاعه ... شهى إِلَيْنَا نثره ونظامه
segments.english: [there] comes to you [a] speech [that] one never tires of hearing ... sweet to us [is] its prose and its verse.

segments.arabic: إِذا ذكرته النَّفس زَالَ عناؤها ... وَزَالَ عَن الْقلب الْمَعْنى ظلامه
segments.english: When the soul remembers it, its suffering departs ... and darkness departs from the afflicted heart.

segments.arabic: إِذا خرجت من عَدوك لَفْظَة سفه فَلَا تلحقها بِمِثْلِهَا تلقّحها
segments.english: If [a] foolish word comes out from your enemy, do not follow it with one like it [that] fertilizes it.

segments.arabic: ونسل الْخِصَام نسل مَذْمُوم
segments.english: And the offspring of quarreling [is a] blameworthy offspring.

segments.arabic: حميتك لنَفسك أثر الْجَهْل بهَا
segments.english: Your protectiveness of yourself [is] the result of ignorance of it.

segments.arabic: فَلَو عرفتها حق مَعْرفَتهَا أعنت الْخصم عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: If you knew it truly, you would help the opponent against it.

segments.arabic: إِذا اقتدحت نَار الانتقام من نَار الْغَضَب ابتدأت بإحراق القادح أوثق
segments.english: When you kindle the fire of revenge from the fire of anger, it begins by burning the one who kindled [it] — most surely.

segments.arabic: غضبك بسلسلة الْحلم فَإِنَّهُ كلب إِن أفلت أتلف
segments.english: your anger with the chain of forbearance, for it [is a] dog — if it breaks loose, it destroys.

segments.arabic: من سبقت لَهُ سَابِقَة السَّعَادَة دلّ على الدَّلِيل قبل الطّلب
segments.english: Whoever [there] preceded for him a prior [decree] of happiness, [he] was shown the guide before [the] seeking.

segments.arabic: إِذا أَرَادَ الْقدر شخصا بذر فِي أَرض قلبه بذر التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: When destiny intends [a] person, it sows in the soil of his heart the seed of divine help.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ سقَاهُ بِمَاء الرَّغْبَة والرهبة
segments.english: Then it waters it with the water of hope and fear.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أَقَامَ عَلَيْهِ بأطوار المراقبة واستخدم لَهُ حارس الْعلم
segments.english: Then it sets over it the stages of watchfulness, and employs for it the guard of knowledge.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا الزَّرْع قَائِم على سوقه
segments.english: And then the crop [is] standing on its stems.

segments.arabic: إِذا طلع نجم الهمة فِي ظلام ليل البطالة وَردفهُ قمر الْعَزِيمَة
segments.english: When the star of ambition rises in the darkness of the night of idleness, and the moon of determination follows it,

segments.arabic: أشرقت أَرض الْقلب بِنور رَبهَا
segments.english: the earth of the heart shines with the light of its Lord.

segments.arabic: إِذا جن اللَّيْل تغالب النّوم والسهر
segments.english: When the night falls, sleep and wakefulness struggle against each other.

segments.arabic: فالخوف والشوق فِي مقدم عَسْكَر الْيَقَظَة
segments.english: Fear and longing [are] at the front of the army of wakefulness.

segments.arabic: والكسل والتواني فِي كَتِيبَة الْغَفْلَة
segments.english: And laziness and sluggishness [are] in the battalion of heedlessness.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا حمل الْعَزْم حمل على الميمنة وانهزمت جنود التَّفْرِيط
segments.english: So when resolve charges, it charges on the right flank, and the soldiers of neglect [are] defeated.

segments.arabic: فَمَا يطلع الْفجْر إِلَّا وَقد قسمت السهْمَان وَبَردت الْغَنِيمَة لأَهْلهَا
segments.english: And the dawn does not rise except that the shares have [already] been divided and the spoils have been settled for their people.

segments.arabic: سفر اللَّيْل لَا يطيقه إِلَّا مُضْمر المجاعة
segments.english: Night travel — none can endure it except one made lean by hunger.

segments.arabic: النجائب فِي الأول وحاملات الزَّاد فِي الْأَخير
segments.english: The fine camels [are] at the front, and the provision-carriers [are] at the rear.

segments.arabic: لَا تسأم من الْوُقُوف على الْبَاب وَلَو طردت
segments.english: Do not grow weary of standing at the door, even if you [are] turned away.

segments.arabic: وَلَا تقطع الِاعْتِذَار وَلَو رددت
segments.english: And do not stop apologizing, even if you [are] rejected.

segments.arabic: فَإِن فتح الْبَاب للمقبولين دُونك فاهجم هجوم الْكَذَّابين
segments.english: If the door [is] opened for the accepted ones without you, then rush in [like] the rushing of the bold claimants.

segments.arabic: وادخل دُخُول الطفيلية
segments.english: And enter [like] the entering of the uninvited.

segments.arabic: وابسط كف وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَا
segments.english: And stretch out [a] palm [saying]: 'Give charity to us.'

segments.arabic: يَا مستفتحا بَاب المعاش بِغَيْر إقليد التَّقْوَى
segments.english: O you who opens the door of livelihood without the key of God-consciousness!

segments.arabic: كَيفَ توسع طَرِيق الْخَطَايَا وتشكو ضيق الرزق
segments.english: How [can] you widen the path of sins and [then] complain of the narrowness of provision?

segments.arabic: وَلَو وقفت عِنْد مُرَاد التَّقْوَى لم يفتك مُرَاد الْمعاصِي
segments.english: And if you had stopped at what God-consciousness requires, what [you sought through] sins would not have escaped you.

segments.arabic: سد فِي بَاب الْكسْب
segments.english: [This is a] blockage in the door of earning.

segments.arabic: وَإِن العَبْد ليحرم الرزق بالذنب يُصِيبهُ
segments.english: And indeed the servant [is] deprived of provision because of the sin he commits.

segments.arabic: تالله مَا جِئتُكُمْ زَائِرًا إِلَّا وجدت الأَرْض تطوي لي
segments.english: By God, I never came to you [as a] visitor except [that] I found the earth folding up for me.

segments.arabic: وَلَا انثنى عزمي عَن بَابَكُمْ إِلَّا تعثرت بأذيالي
segments.english: And my resolve never turned away from your door except [that] I stumbled over my garments.

segments.arabic: الْأَرْوَاح فِي الأشباح كالأطيار فِي الأبراج
segments.english: Spirits in bodies [are] like birds in cages.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ مَا أعد للاستفراخ كمن هيء للسباق
segments.english: And what [is] prepared for hatching [is] not like the one [who is] prepared for racing.

segments.arabic: من أَرَادَ من الْعمَّال أَن يعرف قدره عِنْد السُّلْطَان
segments.english: Whoever among the workers wants to know his rank with the king,

segments.arabic: فَلْينْظر مَاذَا يوليه من الْعَمَل وَبِأَيِّ شغل يشْغلهُ
segments.english: let him look at what work he assigns him and with what task he occupies him.

segments.arabic: كن من أَبنَاء الْآخِرَة وَلَا تكن من أَبنَاء الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: Be from the children of the Hereafter and do not be from the children of this world,

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْوَلَد يتبع الْأُم
segments.english: for the child follows the mother.

segments.arabic: الدُّنْيَا لَا تَسَاوِي نقل أقدامك إِلَيْهَا فَكيف تعدو خلفهَا
segments.english: This world [is] not worth moving your feet toward it, so how [can] you run after it?

segments.arabic: الدُّنْيَا جيفة والأسد لَا يَقع على الْجِيَف
segments.english: This world [is a] carcass, and the lion does not fall upon carcasses.

segments.arabic: الدُّنْيَا مجَاز وَالْآخِرَة وَطن والأوطار إِنَّمَا تطلب فِي الأوطان
segments.english: This world [is a] passage and the Hereafter [is a] homeland, and desires [are] only sought in homelands.

segments.arabic: الِاجْتِمَاع بالإخوان قِسْمَانِ
segments.english: Gathering with brothers [is] of two types.

segments.arabic: أَحدهمَا اجْتِمَاع على مؤانسة الطَّبْع وشغل الْوَقْت فَهَذَا
segments.english: One of them [is] gathering for the comfort of [one's] nature and filling time, and this—

headings.arabic: قَاعِدَة
headings.english: A Principle

segments.arabic: مضرّته أرجح من منفعَته
segments.english: its harm [is] more likely than its benefit.

segments.arabic: وَأَقل مَا فِيهِ أَنه يفْسد الْقلب ويضيع الْوَقْت
segments.english: And the least of what [is] in it [is] that it corrupts the heart and wastes time.

segments.arabic: الثَّانِي الِاجْتِمَاع بهم على التعاون على أَسبَاب النجَاة والتواصي بِالْحَقِّ وَالصَّبْر
segments.english: The second [is] gathering with them for cooperation on the means of salvation and advising each other with the truth and patience.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا من أعظم الْغَنِيمَة وأنفعها
segments.english: So this [is] from the greatest of gains and the most beneficial of them.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن فِيهِ ثَلَاث آفَات
segments.english: But in it [there are] three harms:

segments.arabic: احداها تزين بَعضهم لبَعض
segments.english: the first of them [is] each adorning themselves for the other,

segments.arabic: الثَّانِيَة الْكَلَام والخلطة أَكثر من الْحَاجة
segments.english: the second [is] talking and mixing more than [is] needed,

segments.arabic: الثَّالِثَة أَن يصير ذَلِك شَهْوَة وَعَادَة يَنْقَطِع بهَا عَن الْمَقْصُود
segments.english: the third [is] that it becomes [a] desire and [a] habit that cuts [one] off from the goal.

segments.arabic: وَبِالْجُمْلَةِ فالاجتماع والخلطة لقاح إما للنَّفس الأمارة وَإما للقلب وَالنَّفس المطمئنة
segments.english: And in summary, gathering and mixing [is a] pollination — either for the self that commands [evil], or for the heart and the tranquil self.

segments.arabic: والنتيجة مستفادة من اللقَاح
segments.english: And the result [is] gained from the pollination.

segments.arabic: فَمن طاب لقاحه طابت ثَمَرَته
segments.english: So whoever's pollination [was] good, his fruit [was] good.

segments.arabic: وَهَكَذَا الْأَرْوَاح الطيّبة لقاحها من الْملك والخبيثة لقاحها من الشَّيْطَان
segments.english: And likewise, the good souls — their pollination [is] from the angel, and the wicked — their pollination [is] from Satan.

segments.arabic: وَقد جعل الله سُبْحَانَهُ بِحِكْمَتِهِ الطَّيِّبَات للطيبين والطيبين للطيبات وَعكس ذَلِك
segments.english: And God, glorified [is] He, by His wisdom made the good things for the good [people] and the good [people] for the good things — and the opposite of that.

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ فِي الْوُجُود الْمُمكن سَبَب وَاحِد مُسْتَقل بالتأثير
segments.english: There [is] not in [the] possible existence [a] single cause independent in [its] effect.

segments.arabic: بل لَا يُؤثر سَبَب الْبَتَّةَ إِلَّا بانضمام سَبَب آخر إِلَيْهِ وَانْتِفَاء مَانع يمْنَع تَأْثِيره
segments.english: Rather, no cause produces [an] effect at all except by [the] joining of another cause to it and [the] removal of [an] obstacle that prevents its effect.

segments.arabic: هَذَا فِي الْأَسْبَاب المشهودة بالعيان وَفِي الْأَسْبَاب الغائبة والأسباب المعنوية
segments.english: This [is so] for the causes witnessed by sight, and for the unseen causes and the abstract causes.

segments.arabic: كتأثير الشَّمْس فِي الْحَيَوَان والنبات
segments.english: Like the effect of the sun on animals and plants,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ مَوْقُوف على أَسبَاب أخر من وجود مَحل قَابل
segments.english: for it [is] dependent on other causes, [such as] the existence of [a] receiving place,

segments.arabic: وَأَسْبَاب أخر تنضم إِلَى ذَلِك السَّبَب
segments.english: and other causes that join to that cause.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ حُصُول الْوَلَد مَوْقُوف على عدَّة أَسبَاب غير وَطْء الْفَحْل
segments.english: And likewise, the production of offspring [is] dependent on several causes other than the mating of the male.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ جَمِيع الْأَسْبَاب مَعَ مسبباتها
segments.english: And likewise [are] all causes with their effects.

segments.arabic: فَكل مَا يخَاف ويرجى من الْمَخْلُوقَات فأعلى غاياته أَن يكون جُزْء سَبَب غير مُسْتَقل بالتأثير
segments.english: So everything that [is] feared and hoped for from created things — the highest of its limits [is] that it [would] be [a] part of [a] cause, not independent in [its] effect.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يسْتَقلّ بالتأثير وَحده دون توقف تَأْثِيره على غَيره إِلَّا الله الْوَاحِد القهّار
segments.english: And none [is] independent in effect alone — without its effect depending on another — except God, the One, the Overpowering.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يَنْبَغِي أَن يُرْجَى وَلَا يخَاف غَيره
segments.english: So it [is] not fitting that anyone other than Him [should] be hoped in or feared.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا برهَان قَطْعِيّ على أَن تعلق الرَّجَاء وَالْخَوْف بِغَيْرِهِ بَاطِل
segments.english: And this [is a] decisive proof that attaching hope and fear to other than Him [is] false.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لَو فرض أَن ذَلِك سَبَب مُسْتَقل وَحده بالتأثير لكَانَتْ سببيته من غَيره لَا مِنْهُ
segments.english: For if it were supposed that that [was a] cause independent alone in [its] effect, its causality [would be] from another, not from itself.

segments.arabic: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ من نَفسه قُوَّة يفعل بهَا
segments.english: So it has no power from itself by which it acts.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لَا حول وَلَا قُوَّة إِلَّا بِاللَّه
segments.english: For there [is] no power and no strength except through God.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْحول كُله وَالْقُوَّة كلهَا
segments.english: So He [is] the One in whose hand [is] all power and all strength.

segments.arabic: فالحول وَالْقُوَّة الَّتِي يُرْجَى لأجلهما الْمَخْلُوق وَيخَاف إِنَّمَا هما لله وَبِيَدِهِ فِي الْحَقِيقَة
segments.english: So the power and strength for which the created being [is] hoped in and feared — they [are] only for God and in His hand in reality.

segments.arabic: فَكيف يخَاف ويرجى من لَا حول لَهُ وَلَا قُوَّة
segments.english: So how [can] one fear and hope in [one] who has no power and no strength?

segments.arabic: بل خوف الْمَخْلُوق ورجاؤه أحد أَسبَاب الحرمان ونزول الْمَكْرُوه بِمن يرجوه ويخافه
segments.english: Rather, fearing the created being and hoping in it [is] one of the causes of deprivation and the falling of harm upon the one who hopes in it and fears it.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ على قدر خوفك من
segments.english: For according to [the] measure of your fear of —

headings.arabic: فَائِدَة
headings.english: Benefit

segments.arabic: غير الله يُسَلط عَلَيْك
segments.english: other than God [is] given power over you,

segments.arabic: وعَلى قدر رجائك لغيره يكون الحرمان
segments.english: and to the extent of your hope in other than Him [will] be deprivation.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا حَال الْخلق أجمعه
segments.english: And this [is] the condition of creation, all of it,

segments.arabic: وَإِن ذهب عَن أَكْثَرهم علما وَحَالا
segments.english: even if it escapes most of them in knowledge and [in] practice.

segments.arabic: فَمَا شَاءَ الله كَانَ وَلَا بُد
segments.english: So whatever God willed [will] be, without doubt,

segments.arabic: وَمَا لم يَشَأْ لم يكن وَلَو اتّفقت عَلَيْهِ الخليقة
segments.english: and what He did not will [will] not be, even if all of creation agreed upon it.

segments.arabic: التَّوْحِيد مفزع أعدائه وأوليائه
segments.english: Monotheism [is] the refuge of its enemies and its allies.

segments.arabic: فَأَما أعداؤه فينجيهم من كرب الدُّنْيَا وشدائدها
segments.english: As for its enemies, it saves them from the distress of this world and its hardships.

segments.arabic: ﴿فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا فِي الْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ إِذَا هم يشركُونَ﴾
segments.english: So when they board the ship, they call upon God, sincere to Him in religion. But when He saves them to the land, then they associate partners [with Him].
segments.sahih_international: And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him

segments.arabic: وَأما أولياؤه فينجيهم بِهِ من كربات الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة وشدائدها
segments.english: And as for its allies, it saves them by it from the distresses of this world and the Hereafter and their hardships.

segments.arabic: وَلذَلِك فزع إِلَيْهِ يُونُس فنجّاه الله من تِلْكَ الظُّلُمَات
segments.english: And for that reason Yunus turned to it, so God saved him from those darknesses.

segments.arabic: وفزع إِلَيْهِ أَتبَاع الرُّسُل فنجوا بِهِ مِمَّا عذب بِهِ الْمُشْركُونَ فِي الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: And the followers of the messengers turned to it, so they were saved by it from what the polytheists were punished with in this world

segments.arabic: وَمَا أعد لَهُم فِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: and what was prepared for them in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَلما فزع إِلَيْهِ فِرْعَوْن عِنْد مُعَاينَة الْهَلَاك وَإِدْرَاك الْغَرق لَهُ لم يَنْفَعهُ
segments.english: And when Pharaoh turned to it at the moment of witnessing destruction and [when] drowning overtook him, it did not benefit him,

segments.arabic: لِأَن الْإِيمَان عِنْد المعاينة لَا يقبل
segments.english: because faith at the moment of witnessing [is] not accepted.

segments.arabic: هَذِه سنة الله فِي عباده
segments.english: This [is] the way of God with His servants.

segments.arabic: فَمَا دفعت شَدَائِد الدُّنْيَا بِمثل التَّوْحِيد
segments.english: So the hardships of this world are not repelled by [anything] like monotheism.

segments.arabic: وَلذَلِك كَانَ دُعَاء الكرب بِالتَّوْحِيدِ
segments.english: And for that reason, the supplication of distress was with monotheism,

segments.arabic: ودعوة ذِي النُّون الَّتِي مَا دَعَا بهَا مكروب إِلَّا فرّج الله كربه بِالتَّوْحِيدِ
segments.english: and the supplication of Dhul-Nun — which no distressed person ever called upon except [that] God relieved his distress — [was] with monotheism.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يلقى فِي الكرب الْعِظَام إِلَّا الشّرك
segments.english: So nothing throws [one] into great distress except associating partners [with God],

segments.arabic: وَلَا يُنجي مِنْهَا إِلَّا التَّوْحِيد
segments.english: and nothing saves from it except monotheism.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مفزع الخليقة وملجؤها وحصنها وغياثها
segments.english: So it [is] the refuge of creation, its shelter, its fortress, and its rescue.

segments.arabic: وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And with God [is] success.

segments.arabic: اللَّذَّة تَابِعَة للمحبة تقوى بقوتها وتضعف بضعفها
segments.english: Pleasure follows love — it strengthens with its strength and weakens with its weakness.

segments.arabic: فَكلما كَانَت الرَّغْبَة فِي المحبوب والشوق إِلَيْهِ أقوى
segments.english: So whenever the desire for the beloved and the longing for him [were] stronger,

segments.arabic: كَانَت اللَّذَّة بالوصول إِلَيْهِ أتم
segments.english: the pleasure of reaching him [was] more complete.

segments.arabic: والمحبة والشوق تَابع لمعرفته وَالْعلم بِهِ
segments.english: And love and longing follow knowing Him and [having] knowledge of Him.

segments.arabic: فَكلما كَانَ الْعلم بِهِ أتم كَانَت محبته أكمل
segments.english: So whenever the knowledge of Him [was] more complete, the love of Him [was] more perfect.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا رَجَعَ كَمَال النَّعيم فِي الْآخِرَة وَكَمَال اللَّذَّة إِلَى الْعلم وَالْحب
segments.english: So if the perfection of bliss in the Hereafter and the perfection of pleasure go back to knowledge and love,

segments.arabic: فَمن كَانَ يُؤمن بِاللَّه وأسمائه وَصِفَاته وَدينه أعرف
segments.english: then whoever was more knowing of God and His names and His attributes and His religion,

segments.arabic: كَانَ لَهُ أحب
segments.english: [was] more loving of Him,

segments.arabic: وَكَانَت لذته بالوصول إِلَيْهِ ومجاورته وَالنَّظَر إِلَى وَجهه وَسَمَاع كَلَامه أتم
segments.english: and his pleasure in reaching Him, being near Him, looking at His face, and hearing His speech [was] more complete.

segments.arabic: وكل لَذَّة ونعيم وسرور وبهجة بِالْإِضَافَة إِلَى ذَلِك كقطرة فِي بَحر
segments.english: And every pleasure and bliss and joy and delight compared to that [is] like [a] drop in [an] ocean.

segments.arabic: فَكيف يُؤثر من لَهُ عقل لَذَّة ضَعِيفَة قَصِيرَة مشوبة بالآلام
segments.english: So how could someone who has [a] mind prefer [a] weak, short pleasure mixed with pain

segments.arabic: على لَذَّة عَظِيمَة دائمة أَبَد الآباد
segments.english: over [a] great, lasting pleasure for all eternity?

segments.arabic: وَكَمَال العَبْد بِحَسب هَاتين القوتين الْعلم وَالْحب
segments.english: And the perfection of the servant [is] according to these two powers: knowledge and love.

segments.arabic: وَأفضل الْعلم الْعلم بِاللَّه
segments.english: And the best knowledge [is] knowledge of God,

segments.arabic: وَأَعْلَى الْحبّ الْحبّ لَهُ
segments.english: and the highest love [is] love of Him,

segments.arabic: وأكمل اللَّذَّة بحسبهما
segments.english: and the most complete pleasure [is] according to them both.

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: And God [is] the One sought for help.

headings.arabic: قاعدة
headings.english: A Principle

headings.arabic: فائدة جليلة جمع النبى بين تقوى الله وحسن الخلق لأن تقوى الله
headings.english: A great benefit: The Prophet combined between God-consciousness and good character, because God-consciousness

segments.arabic: طَالب الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة لَا يَسْتَقِيم لَهُ سيره وَطَلَبه إِلَّا بحبسين
segments.english: The seeker of God and the Abode of the Hereafter — his path and seeking [will] not [be] straight for him except with two confinements:

segments.arabic: حبس قلبه فِي طلبه ومطلوبه وحبسه عَن الِالْتِفَات إِلَى غَيره
segments.english: confining his heart in his pursuit and what he seeks, and confining it from turning to other than Him,

segments.arabic: وَحبس لِسَانه عَمَّا لَا يُفِيد وحبسه على ذكر الله وَمَا يزِيد فِي إيمَانه ومعرفته
segments.english: and confining his tongue from what does not benefit, and confining it to the remembrance of God and what increases his faith and knowledge,

segments.arabic: وَحبس جوارحه عَن الْمعاصِي والشهوات وحبسها على الْوَاجِبَات والمندوبات
segments.english: and confining his limbs from sins and desires, and confining them to the obligations and recommended acts.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يُفَارق الْحَبْس حَتَّى يلقى ربه فيخلصه من السجْن إِلَى أوسع فضاء وأطيبه
segments.english: So he does not leave confinement until he meets his Lord, and He frees him from the prison to the widest and most pleasant open space.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى لم يصبر على هذَيْن الحبسين وفر مِنْهُمَا إِلَى فضاء الشَّهَوَات أعقبه ذَلِك الْحَبْس الفظيع عِنْد خُرُوجه من الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: And whenever he does not have patience with these two confinements and flees from them to the open space of desires, that [will] lead him to the terrible confinement upon his departure from this world.

segments.arabic: فَكل خَارج من الدُّنْيَا إِمَّا متخلص من الْحَبْس وَإِمَّا ذَاهِب إِلَى الْحَبْس
segments.english: So everyone departing from this world [is] either freed from confinement, or going to confinement.

segments.arabic: وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And with God [is] success.

segments.arabic: ودّع ابْن عون رجلا فَقَالَ عَلَيْك بتقوى الله فَإِن المتقى لَيست عَلَيْهِ وَحْشَة
segments.english: Ibn Awn bade farewell to [a] man and said: 'Hold to God-consciousness, for the God-conscious — [there] is no loneliness upon him.'

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ زيد بن أسلم كَانَ يُقَال من اتَّقى الله أحبه النَّاس وَإِن كَرهُوا
segments.english: And Zayd ibn Aslam said: it used to be said, 'Whoever [is] God-conscious of God, people [will] love him, even if they [would] hate [to].'

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ الثَّوْريّ لِابْنِ أبي ذِئْب إِن اتَّقَيْت الله كَفاك النَّاس
segments.english: And al-Thawri said to Ibn Abi Dhi'b: 'If you are God-conscious of God, [He will] suffice you against people,

segments.arabic: وَإِن اتَّقَيْت النَّاس لن يغنوا عَنْك من الله شَيْئا
segments.english: and if you fear people, they [will] never help you against God [in] anything.'

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ سُلَيْمَان بن دَاوُد أوتينا مِمَّا أُوتِيَ النَّاس وَمِمَّا لم يؤتوا
segments.english: And Sulayman ibn Dawud said: 'We were given from what people were given, and from what they were not given,

segments.arabic: وعلّمنا مِمَّا علّم النَّاس وَمِمَّا لم يعلمُوا
segments.english: and we were taught from what people were taught, and from what they were not taught.

segments.arabic: فَلم نجد شَيْئا أفضل من تقوى الله فِي السِّرّ وَالْعَلَانِيَة
segments.english: And we did not find anything better than God-consciousness in secret and in public,

segments.arabic: وَالْعدْل فِي الْغَضَب وَالرِّضَا وَالْقَصْد فِي الْفقر والغنى
segments.english: and justice in anger and contentment, and moderation in poverty and wealth.'

segments.arabic: وَفِي الزّهْد للْإِمَام أَحْمد أثر إلهي
segments.english: And in al-Zuhd by Imam Ahmad, [there is] a divine report:

segments.arabic: مَا من مَخْلُوق اعْتصمَ بمخلوق دوني إِلَّا قطعت أَسبَاب السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض دونه
segments.english: 'There [is] no creature [who] seeks refuge in [a] creature besides Me, except [that] I cut the means of the heavens and the earth from him.

segments.arabic: فَإِن سَأَلَني لم أعْطه وَإِن دَعَاني لم أجبه وَإِن استغفرني لم أَغفر لَهُ
segments.english: So if he asks Me, I [will] not give him, and if he calls upon Me, I [will] not answer him, and if he seeks My forgiveness, I [will] not forgive him.

segments.arabic: وَمَا من مَخْلُوق اعْتصمَ بِي دون خلقي إِلَّا ضمنت السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض رزقه
segments.english: And there [is] no creature [who] seeks refuge in Me instead of My creation, except [that] I guarantee the heavens and the earth his sustenance.

segments.arabic: فَإِن سَأَلَني أَعْطيته وَإِن دَعَاني أَجَبْته وَإِن استغفرني غفرت لَهُ
segments.english: So if he asks Me, I [will] give him, and if he calls upon Me, I [will] answer him, and if he seeks My forgiveness, I [will] forgive him.'

segments.arabic: يصلح مَا بَين العَبْد وَبَين ربه وَحسن الْخلق يصلح مَا بَينه وَبَين خلقه
segments.english: [it] fixes what [is] between the servant and his Lord, and good character fixes what [is] between him and His creation.

segments.arabic: فتقوى الله توجب لَهُ محبَّة الله وَحسن الْخلق يَدْعُو إِلَى محبته
segments.english: So God-consciousness earns him the love of God, and good character calls [people] to love him.

headings.arabic: قاعدة لشهادة أن لا إله إلا الله عند الموت تأثير عظيم في تكفير
headings.english: A Principle: The testimony that there [is] no god but God at death has [a] great effect in erasing

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة جليلة
segments.english: [A] great benefit

segments.arabic: بَين العَبْد وَبَين الله وَالْجنَّة قنطرة تقطع بخطوتين
segments.english: Between the servant and between God and Paradise [there is a] bridge [that is] crossed with two steps:

segments.arabic: خطْوَة عَن نَفسه وخطوة عَن الْخلق
segments.english: [a] step away from his self, and [a] step away from creation.

segments.arabic: فَيسْقط نَفسه ويلغيها فِيمَا بَينه وَبَين النَّاس
segments.english: So he drops his self and cancels it in what [is] between him and people,

segments.arabic: وَيسْقط النَّاس ويلغيهم فِيمَا بَينه وَبَين الله
segments.english: and he drops people and cancels them in what [is] between him and God.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يلْتَفت إِلَّا إِلَى من دله على الله وعَلى الطَّرِيق الموصلة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: So he does not turn except to the one who guided him to God and to the path leading to Him.

segments.arabic: صَاح بالصحابة واعظُ
segments.english: [A] preacher called out to the Companions:

segments.arabic: اقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُم
segments.english: "The reckoning of people has drawn near."

segments.arabic: فَجَزِعت للخوف قُلُوبهم
segments.english: So their hearts trembled with fear,

segments.arabic: فجرت من الحذر الْعُيُون
segments.english: and the eyes flowed from caution.

segments.arabic: فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ بِقَدرِهَا
segments.english: "So valleys flowed according to their measure."

segments.arabic: تزينت الدُّنْيَا لعَلي
segments.english: This world adorned itself for Ali,

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ أَنْت طَالِق ثَلَاثًا لَا رَجْعَة لي فِيك
segments.english: so he said: "You [are] divorced three times — [there is] no return for me to you."

segments.arabic: وَكَانَت تكفيه وَاحِدَة للسنّة
segments.english: And one [divorce] would have sufficed him according to the Sunnah,

segments.arabic: لكنه جمع الثَّلَاث لِئَلَّا يتَصَوَّر للهوى جَوَاز الْمُرَاجَعَة
segments.english: but he gathered the three so that desire would not imagine the permissibility of taking [her] back.

segments.arabic: وَدينه الصَّحِيح وطبعه السَّلِيم يأنفان من الْمُحَلّل
segments.english: And his sound religion and his sound nature disdain the one who makes [her] lawful [for remarriage].

segments.arabic: كَيفَ وَهُوَ أحد رُوَاة حَدِيث لعن الله الْمُحَلّل
segments.english: How [could they not], when he [is] one of the narrators of the hadith: "God cursed the one who makes [her] lawful [for remarriage]."

segments.arabic: مَا فِي هَذِه الدَّار مَوضِع خلْوَة فاتخذه فِي نَفسك
segments.english: There [is] not in this abode [a] place of seclusion, so take it within yourself.

segments.arabic: لَا بُد أَن تجذبك الجواذب فاعرفها وَكن مِنْهَا على حذر
segments.english: The attractions will surely pull you, so recognize them and be on guard against them.

segments.arabic: لَا تَضُرك الشواغل إِذا خلوت مِنْهَا وَأَنت فِيهَا
segments.english: The distractions [will] not harm you if you [are] free from them while you [are] among them.

segments.arabic: نور الْحق أَضْوَأ من الشَّمْس
segments.english: The light of the Truth [is] brighter than the sun,

segments.arabic: فيحق لخفافيش البصائر أَن تعشو عَنهُ
segments.english: so it [is] fitting for the bats of insight to be blind to it.

segments.arabic: الطَّرِيق إِلَى الله خَال من أهل الشَّك وَمن الَّذين يتبعُون الشَّهَوَات
segments.english: The path to God [is] empty of the people of doubt and of those who follow desires.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ معمور بِأَهْل الْيَقِين وَالصَّبْر
segments.english: And it [is] filled with the people of certainty and patience.

segments.arabic: وهم على الطَّرِيق كالأعلام
segments.english: And they [are] on the path like landmarks.

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا وَكَانُوا بِآياتِنَا يوقنون
segments.english: And We made from among them leaders [who] guide by Our command, when they were patient and had certainty in Our signs.
segments.sahih_international: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.

segments.arabic: لشهادة أَن لَا إِلَه إِلَّا الله عِنْد الْمَوْت تَأْثِير عَظِيم فِي تَكْفِير السَّيِّئَات وإحباطها
segments.english: The testimony that there [is] no god but God at [the time of] death has [a] great effect in erasing sins and nullifying them,

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهَا شَهَادَة من عبد موقن بهَا عَارِف بمضمونها
segments.english: because it [is a] testimony from [a] servant [who is] certain of it, knowing its meaning,

segments.arabic: قد مَاتَت مِنْهُ الشَّهَوَات ولانت نَفسه المتمردة
segments.english: the desires have died in him, and his rebellious self has softened,

segments.arabic: وانقادت بعد إبائها واستعصائها
segments.english: and [it] submitted after its refusal and its resistance,

segments.arabic: وَأَقْبَلت بعد إعراضها وذلت بعد عزها
segments.english: and [it] turned [toward God] after its turning away, and [it] humbled [itself] after its pride,

segments.arabic: وَخرج مِنْهَا حرصاً على الدُّنْيَا وفضولها
segments.english: and greed for this world and its trivialities left it,

segments.arabic: واستخذت بَين يَدي رَبهَا وفاطرها ومولاها الْحق
segments.english: and [it] became submissive before its Lord, its Creator, and its true Master,

segments.arabic: أذلّ مَا كَانَت لَهُ وأرجى مَا كَانَت لعفوه ومغفرته وَرَحمته
segments.english: at its most humble before Him, and at its most hopeful for His pardon, His forgiveness, and His mercy,

segments.arabic: وتجرد
segments.english: and [it] stripped itself [bare]—

segments.arabic: مِنْهَا التَّوْحِيد بِانْقِطَاع أَسبَاب الشّرك وَتحقّق بُطْلَانه
segments.english: Among them [is] monotheism, by the cutting off of the causes of associating partners [with God] and the realization of its falsehood.

segments.arabic: فَزَالَتْ مِنْهَا تِلْكَ المنازعات الَّتِي كَانَت مَشْغُولَة بهَا
segments.english: So those conflicts that it was occupied with were removed from it,

segments.arabic: وَاجْتمعَ همها على من أيقنت بالقدوم عَلَيْهِ والمصير إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and its concern gathered upon the One it was certain of arriving before and returning to.

segments.arabic: فَوجه العَبْد وَجهه بكليته إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: So the servant directed his face entirely toward Him,

segments.arabic: وَأَقْبل بِقَلْبِه وروحه وهمه عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and turned with his heart and his spirit and his concern toward Him.

segments.arabic: فاستسلم وَحده ظَاهرا وَبَاطنا
segments.english: So he submitted to Him alone, outwardly and inwardly,

segments.arabic: واستوى سره وعلانيته
segments.english: and his secret and his open [state] became equal.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ لَا إِلَه إِلَّا الله مخلصا من قلبه
segments.english: So he said, 'There [is] no god but God,' sincerely from his heart,

segments.arabic: وَقد تخلص قلبه من التَّعَلُّق بِغَيْرِهِ والالتفات إِلَى مَا سواهُ
segments.english: and his heart had freed itself from attachment to other than Him and turning to what [is] besides Him.

segments.arabic: قد خرجت الدُّنْيَا كلهَا من قلبه وشارف الْقدوم على ربه
segments.english: This world had entirely left his heart, and he was near to arriving before his Lord.

segments.arabic: وخمدت نيران شَهْوَته وامتلأ قلبه من الْآخِرَة
segments.english: And the fires of his desire died down, and his heart became filled with the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: فَصَارَت نصب عَيْنَيْهِ وَصَارَت الدُّنْيَا وَرَاء ظَهره
segments.english: So it became before his eyes, and this world became behind his back.

segments.arabic: فَكَانَت تِلْكَ الشَّهَادَة الْخَالِصَة خَاتِمَة عمله
segments.english: So that sincere testimony was the seal of his deeds,

segments.arabic: فطهّرته من ذنُوبه وأدخلته على ربه
segments.english: and it purified him from his sins and admitted him before his Lord.

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ لَقِي ربه بِشَهَادَة صَادِقَة خَالِصَة
segments.english: Because he met his Lord with [a] truthful, sincere testimony —

segments.arabic: وَافق ظَاهرهَا بَاطِنهَا وسرها علانيتها
segments.english: its outward matched its inward, and its secret [matched] its open [state].

segments.arabic: فَلَو حصلت لَهُ الشَّهَادَة على هَذَا الْوَجْه فِي أَيَّام الصِّحَّة
segments.english: So if the testimony had occurred for him in this way during the days of health,

segments.arabic: لاستوحش من الدُّنْيَا وَأَهْلهَا
segments.english: he [would have] felt estranged from this world and its people,

segments.arabic: وفر إِلَى الله من النَّاس وَأنس بِهِ دون مَا سواهُ
segments.english: and [would have] fled to God from people, and found comfort in Him apart from what [is] besides Him.

segments.arabic: لكنه شهد بهَا بقلب مشحون بالشهوات وَحب الْحَيَاة وأسبابها
segments.english: But he testified with it with [a] heart filled with desires and love of life and its means,

segments.arabic: وَنَفس مَمْلُوءَة بِطَلَب الحظوظ والالتفات إِلَى غير الله
segments.english: and [a] self filled with seeking worldly gains and turning to other than God.

segments.arabic: فَلَو تجردت كتجردها عِنْد الْمَوْت
segments.english: So if it had been stripped bare as it [is] stripped at death,

segments.arabic: لَكَانَ لَهَا نبأ آخر وعيش آخر سوى عيشها البهيمي
segments.english: there [would have] been for it another story and another life, other than its animal-like life.

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: And God [is] the One whose help [is] sought.

segments.arabic: مَاذَا يملك من أمره من ناصيته بيد الله
segments.english: What does he own of his affair? His forelock [is] in the hand of God,

segments.arabic: وَنَفسه بِيَدِهِ وَقَلبه بَين أصبعين من أَصَابِعه يقلبه كَيفَ يَشَاء
segments.english: and his soul [is] in His hand, and his heart [is] between two fingers of His fingers — He turns it however He wills.

segments.arabic: وحياته بِيَدِهِ وَمَوته بِيَدِهِ وسعادته بِيَدِهِ وشقاوته بِيَدِهِ
segments.english: And his life [is] in His hand, and his death [is] in His hand, and his happiness [is] in His hand, and his misery [is] in His hand.

segments.arabic: وحركاته وسكناته وأقواله وأفعاله بِإِذْنِهِ ومشيئته
segments.english: And his movements and his stillness and his words and his deeds [are] by His permission and His will.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يَتَحَرَّك إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ وَلَا يفعل إِلَّا بمشيئته
segments.english: So he does not move except by His permission, and he does not act except by His will.

segments.arabic: إِن وَكله إِلَى نَفسه وَكله إِلَى عجز وضيعة وتفريط وذنب وخطيئة
segments.english: If He leaves him to himself, He leaves him to weakness and loss and neglect and sin and wrongdoing.

segments.arabic: وَإِن وَكله إِلَى غَيره وَكله إِلَى من لَا يملك لَهُ ضرا وَلَا نفعا وَلَا موتا وَلَا حَيَاة وَلَا نشورا
segments.english: And if He leaves him to other than Him, He leaves him to one who does not own for him [any] harm or benefit or death or life or resurrection.

segments.arabic: وَإِن تخلى عَنهُ استولى عَلَيْهِ عدوّه وَجعله أَسِيرًا لَهُ
segments.english: And if He abandons him, his enemy takes control over him and makes him [a] prisoner to him.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ لَا غنى لَهُ عَنهُ طرفَة عين
segments.english: So he has no independence from Him [for even] the blink of [an] eye.

segments.arabic: بل هُوَ مُضْطَر إِلَيْهِ على مدى الأنفاس فِي كل ذرة من ذراته بَاطِنا وظاهرًا
segments.english: Rather, he [is] in desperate need of Him with every breath, in every particle of his being, inwardly and outwardly.

segments.arabic: فاقته تَامَّة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: His neediness of Him [is] complete.

segments.arabic: وَمَعَ ذَلِك فَهُوَ متخلف عَنهُ معرض عَنهُ
segments.english: And despite that, he [is] falling behind [in his duty to] Him, turning away from Him,

segments.arabic: يتبغض إِلَيْهِ بمعصيته مَعَ شدَّة الضَّرُورَة إِلَيْهِ من كل وَجه
segments.english: making himself hateful to Him through his disobedience, despite [his] intense need of Him in every way.

segments.arabic: قد صَار لذكره نسيا واتخذه وَرَاءه ظهريا
segments.english: He has made His remembrance [a] forgotten thing and cast Him behind his back.

segments.arabic: هَذَا وَإِلَيْهِ مرجعه وَبَين يَدَيْهِ موقفه
segments.english: This — while to Him [is] his return, and before Him [is] his standing.

segments.arabic: فرغ خاطرك للهم بِمَا أمرت بِهِ وَلَا تشغله بِمَا ضمن لَك
segments.english: Free your mind to concern [itself] with what you were commanded with, and do not occupy it with what [has been] guaranteed for you.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الرزق وَالْأَجَل قرينان مضمونان
segments.english: For provision and the lifespan [are] two companions, [both] guaranteed.

segments.arabic: فَمَا دَامَ الْأَجَل بَاقِيا كَانَ الرزق آتِيَا
segments.english: So as long as the lifespan remains, provision [will be] coming.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا سد عَلَيْك بِحِكْمَتِهِ طَرِيقا من طرقه فتح لَك برحمته طَرِيقا أَنْفَع لَك مِنْهُ
segments.english: And if He closes off for you by His wisdom [a] path from His paths, He opens for you by His mercy [a] path more beneficial for you than it.

segments.arabic: فتأمّل حَال الْجَنِين يَأْتِيهِ غذاؤه وَهُوَ الدَّم من طَرِيق وَاحِدَة وَهُوَ السُّرَّة
segments.english: So reflect on the state of the fetus — its nourishment comes to it, which [is] the blood, through one single path, which [is] the umbilical cord.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا خرج من بطن الْأُم وانقطعت تِلْكَ الطَّرِيق فتح لَهُ طَرِيقين اثْنَيْنِ
segments.english: Then when it came out from the mother's womb and that path was cut off, He opened for it two paths.

segments.arabic: وأجرى لَهُ فيهمَا رزقا أطيب وألذ من الأول لَبَنًا خَالِصا سائغا
segments.english: And He made flow for it through them [a] provision purer and sweeter than the first — milk, pure [and] easy [to swallow].

segments.arabic: فَإِذا تمت مُدَّة الرَّضَاع وانقطعت الطريقان بالفطام فتح طرقًا أَرْبَعَة أكمل مِنْهَا
segments.english: Then when the period of nursing was complete and the two paths were cut off by weaning, He opened four paths more complete than them.

segments.arabic: طعامان وشرابان فالطعامان من الْحَيَوَان والنبات والشرابان من الْمِيَاه والألبان وَمَا يُضَاف إِلَيْهِمَا من الْمَنَافِع والملاذ
segments.english: Two foods and two drinks. The two foods [are] from animals and plants, and the two drinks [are] from water and milk, and what [is] added to them of benefits and pleasures.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا مَاتَ انْقَطَعت عَنهُ هَذِه الطّرق الْأَرْبَعَة
segments.english: Then when he dies, these four paths [are] cut off from him.

segments.arabic: لكنه سُبْحَانَهُ فتح لَهُ إِن كَانَ سعيدا طرقا ثَمَانِيَة وَهِي أَبْوَاب الْجنَّة الثَّمَانِية يدْخل من أَيهَا شَاءَ
segments.english: But He, glorified [is] He, opens for him — if he was blessed — eight paths, which [are] the eight gates of Paradise, entering from whichever of them he wishes.

segments.arabic: فَهَكَذَا الرب سُبْحَانَهُ لَا يمْنَع عَبده الْمُؤمن شَيْئا من الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا ويؤتيه أفضل مِنْهُ وأنفع لَهُ
segments.english: So likewise, the Lord, glorified [is] He, does not prevent His believing servant [from a] thing of this world except that He gives him [something] better than it and more beneficial for him.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ ذَلِك لغير الْمُؤمن
segments.english: And that [is] not [the case] for the non-believer.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ يمنعهُ الْحَظ الْأَدْنَى الخسيس وَلَا يرضى لَهُ بِهِ ليعطيه الْحَظ الْأَعْلَى النفيس
segments.english: For He prevents him from the lower, worthless share and [is] not pleased for him with it, in order to give him the higher, precious share.

segments.arabic: وَالْعَبْد لجهله بمصالح نَفسه وجهله بكرم ربه وحكمته ولطفه
segments.english: But the servant, due to his ignorance of what [is] good for himself, and his ignorance of the generosity of his Lord, His wisdom, and His kindness —

segments.arabic: لَا يعرف التَّفَاوُت بَين مَا منع مِنْهُ وَبَين مَا ذخر لَهُ
segments.english: he does not know the difference between what he was prevented from and what was stored up for him.

segments.arabic: بل هُوَ مولع بحب العاجل وَإِن كَانَ دنيئا وبقلة الرَّغْبَة فِي الآجل وَإِن كَانَ عليا
segments.english: Rather, he [is] attached to love of the immediate, even if it [is] lowly, and [has] little desire for the deferred, even if it [is] lofty.

segments.arabic: وَلَو أنصف العَبْد ربه وأنى لَهُ بذلك
segments.english: And if the servant were fair to his Lord — and how [could] that [be] for him! —

segments.arabic: لعلم أَن فَضله عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا مَنعه من الدُّنْيَا ولذاتها وَنَعِيمهَا أعظم من فَضله عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا آتَاهُ من ذَلِك
segments.english: he would know that His favor upon him in what He prevented him from of this world and its pleasures and its comforts [is] greater than His favor upon him in what He gave him of that.

segments.arabic: فَمَا مَنعه إِلَّا ليعطيه وَلَا ابتلاه إِلَّا ليعافيه
segments.english: So He did not prevent him except to give him, and He did not test him except to heal him.

segments.arabic: وَلَا امتحنه إِلَّا ليصافيه وَلَا أَمَاتَهُ إِلَّا ليحييه
segments.english: And He did not try him except to purify him, and He did not cause him to die except to give him life.

segments.arabic: وَلَا أخرجه إِلَى هَذِه الدَّار إِلَّا ليتأهب مِنْهَا للقدوم عَلَيْهِ وليسلك الطَّرِيق الموصلة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And He did not bring him out to this abode except to prepare from it for the arrival to Him, and to travel the path that leads to Him.

segments.arabic: فَجعل اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شكُورًا
segments.english: So He made the night and the day [in] succession, for whoever wanted to remember or wanted [to show] gratitude.
segments.sahih_international: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.

segments.arabic: وأبى الظَّالِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
segments.english: But the wrongdoers refused [everything] except ingratitude.

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: And God [is] the One whose help [is] sought.

segments.arabic: من عرف نَفسه اشْتغل بإصلاحها عَن عُيُوب النَّاس
segments.english: Whoever knows himself [is] busy with fixing himself [rather] than [with] the faults of people.

segments.arabic: من عرف ربه اشْتغل بِهِ عَن هوى نَفسه
segments.english: Whoever knows his Lord [is] busy with Him [rather] than [with] the desire of his self.

segments.arabic: أَنْفَع الْعَمَل أَن تغيب فِيهِ عَن النَّاس بالإخلاص وَعَن نَفسك بِشُهُود المنّة
segments.english: The most beneficial deed [is] that you disappear in it from people through sincerity, and from yourself through witnessing [God's] favor.

segments.arabic: فَلَا ترى فِيهِ نَفسك وَلَا ترى الْخلق
segments.english: So you do not see in it yourself, and you do not see the creation.

segments.arabic: دخل النَّاس النَّار من ثَلَاثَة أَبْوَاب
segments.english: People entered the Fire through three doors:

segments.arabic: بَاب شُبْهَة أورثت شكا فِي دين الله
segments.english: [a] door of doubt that produced uncertainty in the religion of God,

segments.arabic: وَبَاب شَهْوَة أورثت تَقْدِيم الْهوى على طَاعَته ومرضاته
segments.english: and [a] door of lust that produced putting desire above His obedience and His pleasure,

segments.arabic: وَبَاب غضب أورث الْعدوان على خلقه
segments.english: and [a] door of anger that produced aggression against His creation.

segments.arabic: أصُول الْخَطَايَا كلهَا ثَلَاثَة
segments.english: The roots of all sins [are] three:

segments.arabic: الْكبر وَهُوَ الَّذِي أصار إِبْلِيس إِلَى مَا أصاره
segments.english: arrogance — and it [is] what brought Iblis to what it brought him to,

segments.arabic: والحرص وَهُوَ الَّذِي أخرج آدم من الْجنَّة
segments.english: and greed — and it [is] what expelled Adam from Paradise,

segments.arabic: والحسد وَهُوَ الَّذِي جرأ أحد بني آدم على أَخِيه
segments.english: and envy — and it [is] what made one of the sons of Adam bold against his brother.

segments.arabic: فَمن وقِي شَرّ هَذِه الثَّلَاثَة فقد وقى الشَّرّ
segments.english: So whoever [is] protected from the evil of these three, [he] has been protected from evil.

segments.arabic: فالكفر من الْكبر والمعاصي من الْحِرْص وَالْبَغي وَالظُّلم من الْحَسَد
segments.english: For disbelief [is] from arrogance, sins [are] from greed, and transgression and injustice [are] from envy.

segments.arabic: جعل الله بِحِكْمَتِهِ كل جُزْء من أَجزَاء ابْن آدم ظَاهِرَة وباطنة آلَة لشَيْء
segments.english: God, in His wisdom, made every part of the parts of the son of Adam — outer and inner — [a] tool for something.

segments.arabic: إِذا اسْتعْمل فِيهِ فَهُوَ كَمَاله
segments.english: When it [is] used for [that purpose], then that [is] its perfection.

segments.arabic: فالعين آلَة للنَّظَر وَالْأُذن آلَة للسماع وَالْأنف آلَة للشم
segments.english: The eye [is] [a] tool for seeing, the ear [is] [a] tool for hearing, the nose [is] [a] tool for smelling,

segments.arabic: وَاللِّسَان آلَة للنطق والفرج للنِّكَاح وَالْيَد للبطش وَالرجل للمشي
segments.english: the tongue [is] [a] tool for speech, the private part for marriage, the hand for grasping, and the foot for walking,

segments.arabic: وَالْقلب للتوحيد والمعرفة وَالروح للمحبة
segments.english: the heart for monotheism and knowledge, the spirit for love,

segments.arabic: وَالْعقل آلَة للتفكر والتدبر لعواقب الْأُمُور الدِّينِيَّة والدنيوية
segments.english: and the mind [is] [a] tool for thinking and reflecting on the outcomes of religious and worldly matters,

segments.arabic: وإيثار مَا يَنْبَغِي إيثاره وإهمال مَا يَنْبَغِي إهماله
segments.english: and preferring what should be preferred, and neglecting what should be neglected.

segments.arabic: أخسر النَّاس صَفْقَة من اشْتغل عَن الله بِنَفسِهِ
segments.english: The most losing of people in trade [is] whoever [was] distracted from God by himself,

segments.arabic: بل أخسر مِنْهُ من اشْتغل عَن نَفسه بِالنَّاسِ
segments.english: rather, more losing than him [is] whoever [was] distracted from himself by people.

segments.arabic: فِي السّنَن من حَدِيث أبي سعيد يرفعهُ
segments.english: In the Sunan, from the hadith of Abu Sa'id, who raised it [to the Prophet]:

segments.arabic: إِذا أصبح ابْن آدم فَإِن الْأَعْضَاء كلهَا تكفر اللِّسَان
segments.english: "When the son of Adam wakes in the morning, all the limbs humble [themselves] to the tongue,

segments.arabic: تَقول اتَّقِ الله فَإِنَّمَا نَحن بك
segments.english: saying: 'Fear God, for we [are] only through you.

segments.arabic: فان اسْتَقَمْت استقمنا وَإِن اعوججت اعوججنا
segments.english: If you stand straight, we stand straight, and if you go crooked, we go crooked.'"

segments.arabic: قَوْله تكفر اللِّسَان قيل مَعْنَاهُ تخضع لَهُ
segments.english: His saying "humble [themselves] to the tongue" — it [is] said its meaning [is]: they submit to it.

segments.arabic: وَفِي الحَدِيث أَن الصَّحَابَة لما دخلُوا على النَّجَاشِيّ لم يكفروا لَهُ
segments.english: And in the hadith, when the Companions entered upon al-Najashi, they did not bow to him —

segments.arabic: أَي لم يسجدوا وَلم يخضعوا
segments.english: meaning they did not prostrate and did not submit.

segments.arabic: وَلذَلِك قَالَ لَهُ عَمْرو بن الْعَاصِ أَيهَا الْملك إِنَّهُم لَا يكفرون لَك
segments.english: And because of that, Amr ibn al-As said to him: 'O king, they do not bow to you.'

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا خضعت للسان لِأَنَّهُ بريد الْقلب وترجمانه والواسطة بَينه وَبَين الْأَعْضَاء
segments.english: And they only submitted to the tongue because it [is] the messenger of the heart and its translator, and the link between it and the limbs.

segments.arabic: وَقَوْلها إِنَّمَا نَحن بك أَي نجاتنا بك وهلاكنا بك
segments.english: And their saying 'we [are] only through you' means: our salvation [is] through you, and our destruction [is] through you.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَت فَإِن اسْتَقَمْت استقمنا وَإِن اعوججت اعوججنا
segments.english: And because of this they said: 'If you stand straight, we stand straight, and if you go crooked, we go crooked.'

headings.arabic: فصل
headings.english: Section

headings.arabic: فائدة
headings.english: Benefit

headings.arabic: فائدة قال تعالى والذين جاهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا علق سبحانه الهداية
headings.english: Benefit: [God] Most High said, "And those who strive in Us, We will surely guide them [to] Our paths" — glorified [is] He — He linked guidance

segments.arabic: جمع النَّبِي ﷺ فِي قَوْله فَاتَّقُوا الله وأجملوا فِي الطّلب بَين مصَالح الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: The Prophet ﷺ combined, in his saying "Fear God and be moderate in seeking," between the benefits of this world and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَنَعِيمهَا ولذاتها إِنَّمَا ينَال بتقوى الله
segments.english: And its bliss and pleasures [are] only attained through God-consciousness.

segments.arabic: وراحة الْقلب وَالْبدن وَترك الاهتمام والحرص الشَّديد والتعب والعناء والكد والشقاء فِي طلب الدُّنْيَا إِنَّمَا ينَال بالإجمال فِي الطّلب
segments.english: And rest of the heart and body, and leaving behind worry, intense greed, tiredness, hardship, toil, and misery in seeking this world — [is] only attained by being moderate in seeking.

segments.arabic: فَمن اتَّقى الله فَازَ بلذة الْآخِرَة وَنَعِيمهَا
segments.english: So whoever feared God [has] won the pleasure of the Hereafter and its bliss.

segments.arabic: وَمن أجمل فِي الطّلب استراح من نكد الدُّنْيَا وهمومها
segments.english: And whoever [was] moderate in seeking [has] found rest from the misery of this world and its worries.

segments.arabic: فَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: And God [is] the One whose help [is] sought.

segments.arabic: قد نادت الدُّنْيَا على نَفسهَا ... لَو كَانَ فِي ذَا الْخلق من يسمع
segments.english: This world has called out against itself... if only there were among this creation [those] who listen.

segments.arabic: كم واثق بالعيش أهلكته ... وجامع فرقت مَا يجمع
segments.english: How many confident in life [did] it destroy... and [how many a] gatherer — I scattered what he gathers.

segments.arabic: جمع النَّبِي ﷺ بَين المأثم والمغرم
segments.english: The Prophet ﷺ combined between sin and debt.

segments.arabic: فَإِن المأثم يُوجب خسارة الْآخِرَة
segments.english: For sin causes the loss of the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: والمغرم يُوجب خسارة الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: And debt causes the loss of this world.

segments.arabic: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا﴾
segments.english: And those who strive in Us, We will surely guide them [to] Our paths.
segments.sahih_international: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.

segments.arabic: علق سُبْحَانَهُ الْهِدَايَة بِالْجِهَادِ
segments.english: He — glorified [is] He — linked guidance to striving.

segments.arabic: فأكمل النَّاس هِدَايَة أعظمهم جهادا
segments.english: So the most complete of people in guidance [are] the greatest of them in striving.

segments.arabic: وأفرض الْجِهَاد جِهَاد النَّفس وَجِهَاد الْهوى وَجِهَاد الشَّيْطَان وَجِهَاد الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: And the most obligatory striving [is] striving against the self, and striving against desire, and striving against Satan, and striving against this world.

segments.arabic: فَمن جَاهد هَذِه الْأَرْبَعَة فِي الله هداه الله سبل رِضَاهُ الموصلة إِلَى جنته
