segments.english: So whoever strives against these four for God's sake, God [will] guide him [to] the paths of His pleasure that lead to His Paradise.

segments.arabic: وَمن ترك الْجِهَاد فَاتَهُ من الْهدى بِحَسب مَا عطل من الْجِهَاد
segments.english: And whoever leaves striving, he misses of guidance in proportion to what he neglected of striving.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْجُنَيْد وَالَّذين جاهدوا أهواءهم فِينَا بِالتَّوْبَةِ لنهدينهم سبل الْإِخْلَاص
segments.english: Al-Junayd said: "And those who strive against their desires in Us through repentance, We will guide them [to] the paths of sincerity."

segments.arabic: وَلَا يتَمَكَّن من جِهَاد عدوه فِي الظَّاهِر إِلَّا من جَاهد هَذِه الْأَعْدَاء بَاطِنا
segments.english: And no one [is] able to strive against his enemy outwardly except [the one] who strives against these enemies inwardly.

segments.arabic: فَمن نصر عَلَيْهَا نصر على عدوه
segments.english: So whoever [is] given victory over them, [is] given victory over his enemy.

segments.arabic: وَمن نصرت عَلَيْهِ نصر عَلَيْهِ عدوه
segments.english: And whoever they are given victory over, his enemy [is] given victory over him.

headings.arabic: فصل ألقى الله سبحانه العداوة بين الشيطان وبين الملك والعداوة بين
headings.english: Chapter: God, glorified [is] He, cast enmity between the devil and the angel, and enmity between

segments.arabic: ألْقى الله سُبْحَانَهُ الْعَدَاوَة بَين الشَّيْطَان وَبَين الْملك
segments.english: God, glorified [is] He, cast enmity between the devil and the angel,

segments.arabic: والعداوة بَين الْعقل وَبَين الْهوى
segments.english: and enmity between the mind and desire,

segments.arabic: والعداوة بَين النَّفس الأمارة وَبَين الْقلب
segments.english: and enmity between the commanding self and the heart.

segments.arabic: وابتلى العَبْد بذلك وَجمع لَهُ بَين هَؤُلَاءِ
segments.english: And [He] tested the servant with that and gathered these [forces] together for him,

segments.arabic: وأمد كل حزب بِجُنُود وَأَعْوَان
segments.english: and supplied each party with soldiers and helpers.

segments.arabic: فَلَا تزَال الْحَرْب سجالا ودولا بَين الْفَرِيقَيْنِ
segments.english: So the war does not cease going back and forth between the two groups,

segments.arabic: إِلَى أَن يستولي أَحدهمَا على الآخر وَيكون الآخر مقهورا مَعَه
segments.english: until one of them overpowers the other and the other [is] defeated under him.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَت النّوبَة للقلب وَالْعقل وَالْملك
segments.english: So when the turn [is] for the heart, the mind, and the angel,

segments.arabic: فهنالك السرُور وَالنَّعِيم واللذة والبهجة والفرح وقرة الْعين
segments.english: then there [is] joy, bliss, pleasure, delight, happiness, and coolness of the eye,

segments.arabic: وَطيب الْحَيَاة وانشراح الصَّدْر والفوز بالغنائم
segments.english: and goodness of life, and expansion of the chest, and winning of the rewards.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا كَانَت النّوبَة للنَّفس والهوى والشيطان
segments.english: And when the turn [is] for the self, desire, and the devil,

segments.arabic: فهنالك الغموم والهموم وَالْأَحْزَان وأنواع المكاره
segments.english: then there [are] the worries, the concerns, the sorrows, and types of hardships,

segments.arabic: وضيق الصَّدْر وَحبس الْملك
segments.english: and tightness of the chest, and the imprisonment of the king.

segments.arabic: فَمَا ظَنك بِملك استولى عَلَيْهِ عدوه
segments.english: So what do you think of [a] king whose enemy overpowered him,

segments.arabic: فأنزله عَن سَرِير ملكه وأسره وحبسه
segments.english: and removed him from the throne of his kingdom, and captured him, and imprisoned him,

segments.arabic: وَحَال بَينه وَبَين خزائنه وذخائره وخدمه وصيّرها لَهُ
segments.english: and came between him and his treasures, his stores, and his servants, and made them his own?

segments.arabic: وَمَعَ هَذَا فَلَا يَتَحَرَّك الْملك لطلب ثَأْره
segments.english: And despite this, the king does not move to seek his revenge,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يستغيث بِمن يغيثه وَلَا يستنجد بِمن ينجده
segments.english: and does not cry for help to one who [would] help him, and does not seek aid from one who [would] aid him.

segments.arabic: وَفَوق هَذَا الْملك ملك قاهر لَا يقهر وغالب لَا يغلب وعزيز لَا يذل
segments.english: And above this king [is a] King — overpowering, never overpowered; dominant, never dominated; mighty, never humbled.

segments.arabic: فَأرْسل إِلَيْهِ إِن استنصرتني نصرتك وَإِن استغثت بِي أغثتك
segments.english: So He sent to him: 'If you seek My help, I [will] help you; and if you cry out to Me, I [will] rescue you;

segments.arabic: وَإِن التجأت إِلَيّ أخذت بثأرك
segments.english: and if you turn to Me, I [will] take your revenge [for you];

segments.arabic: وَإِن هربت إِلَيّ وأويت إِلَيّ سلطتك على عَدوك وَجَعَلته تَحت أسرك
segments.english: and if you flee to Me and take shelter with Me, I [will] give you power over your enemy and place him under your captivity.'

segments.arabic: فَإِن قَالَ هَذَا الْملك المأسور قد شدّ عدوي وثاقي وَأحكم رباطي
segments.english: So if this captive king says: 'My enemy has tightened my chains and secured my bonds,

segments.arabic: واستوثق مني بالقيود وَمَنَعَنِي من النهوض إِلَيْك والفرار إِلَيْك والمسير إِلَى بابك
segments.english: and bound me firmly with shackles, and prevented me from rising to You, fleeing to You, and traveling to Your door.

segments.arabic: فَإِن أرْسلت جندا من عنْدك يحل وثاقي ويفك قيودي ويخرجني من حَبسه
segments.english: So if You send soldiers from You who [will] untie my chains, break my shackles, and take me out of his prison,

segments.arabic: أمكنني أَن أوافي بابك وَإِلَّا لم يمكنني مُفَارقَة محبسي وَلَا كسر قيودي
segments.english: [then] it [would be] possible for me to reach Your door; otherwise it [is] not possible for me to leave my prison or break my shackles.'

segments.arabic: فَإِن قَالَ ذَلِك احتجاجا على ذَلِك السُّلْطَان ودفعا لرسالته
segments.english: So if he said that as [an] argument against that Sultan, and [as a] rejection of His message,

segments.arabic: ورضا بِمَا هُوَ فِيهِ عِنْد عدوّه
segments.english: and [out of] contentment with what he [is] in with his enemy —

segments.arabic: خلاه السُّلْطَان الْأَعْظَم وحاله وولاه مَا تولى
segments.english: the Supreme Sultan [will] abandon him and leave him to himself, and hand him over to what he chose.

segments.arabic: وَإِن قَالَ ذَلِك افتقارا إِلَيْهِ وإظهارا لعَجزه وذله
segments.english: And if he said that [out of] neediness toward Him, and showing his weakness and lowliness,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه أَضْعَف وأعجز أَن يسير إِلَيْهِ بِنَفسِهِ
segments.english: and that he [is] too weak and too powerless to travel to Him by himself,

segments.arabic: وَيخرج من حبس عدوه ويتخلص مِنْهُ بحوله وقوته
segments.english: and to escape from his enemy's prison and free himself from him by his [own] strength and power,

segments.arabic: وَأَن من تَمام نعْمَته ذَلِك عَلَيْهِ كَمَا أرسل إِلَيْهِ هَذِه الرسَالَة أَن يمده من جنده
segments.english: and that [it is] from the completeness of His favor upon him — just as He sent him this message — that He supply him from His soldiers —

segments.arabic: ومماليكه بِمن يُعينهُ على الْخَلَاص وَيكسر بَاب محبسه ويفك قيوده
segments.english: and His slaves, with someone [who] helps him to [gain] freedom and breaks the door of his prison and removes his chains.

segments.arabic: فَإِن فعل بِهِ ذَلِك فقد أتم إنعامه عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: So if He did that for him, then He [has] completed His blessing upon him.

segments.arabic: وان تخلى عَنهُ فَلم يَظْلمه وَلَا مَنعه حَقًا هوله
segments.english: And if He left him, then He [did] not wrong him, nor [did] He withhold from him a right that [was] his.

segments.arabic: وَأَن حَمده وحكمته اقْتضى مَنعه وتخليته فِي محبسه
segments.english: And that His praise and His wisdom required withholding from him and leaving him in his prison.

segments.arabic: وَلَا سِيمَا إِذا علم أَن الْحَبْس حَبسه
segments.english: Especially if he knew that the imprisonment [is] His imprisonment,

segments.arabic: وَأَن هَذَا الْعَدو الَّذِي حَبسه مَمْلُوك من مماليكه وَعبد من عبيده
segments.english: and that this enemy who imprisoned him [is] a slave from among His slaves and a servant from among His servants,

segments.arabic: ناصيته بِيَدِهِ لَا يتَصَرَّف إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ومشيئته
segments.english: his forelock [is] in His hand — he does not act except by His permission and His will.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ غير ملتفت إِلَيْهِ وَلَا خَائِف مِنْهُ
segments.english: So he [is] not turning toward him, nor afraid of him,

segments.arabic: وَلَا مُعْتَقد أَن لَهُ شَيْئا من الْأَمر وَلَا بِيَدِهِ نفع وَلَا ضرّ
segments.english: nor believing that he has anything of the matter, nor [is there] in his hand benefit or harm.

segments.arabic: بل هُوَ ناظر إِلَى مَالِكه ومتولي أمره وَمن ناصيته بِيَدِهِ
segments.english: Rather, he [is] looking to his Master and the One [who] manages his affair, and the One in whose hand [is] his forelock.

segments.arabic: قد أفرده بالخوف والرجاء والتضرّع إِلَيْهِ والالتجاء
segments.english: He has singled Him out with fear and hope and humble pleading to Him and seeking refuge,

segments.arabic: وَالرَّغْبَة والرهبة
segments.english: and longing and dread.

segments.arabic: فهناك تَأتيه جيوش النَّصْر وَالظفر
segments.english: So there, the armies of victory and triumph come to him.

segments.arabic: أَعلَى الهمم فِي طلب علم الْكتاب وَالسّنة والفهم عَن الله وَرَسُوله نفس المُرَاد
segments.english: The highest of aspirations in seeking the knowledge of the Book and the Sunnah [is] understanding from God and His Messenger the actual intent,

segments.arabic: وَعلم حُدُود الْمنزل
segments.english: and knowing the limits of what [was] revealed.

segments.arabic: وأخّس همم طلاب الْعلم قصر همته على تتبع شواذ الْمسَائِل وَمَا لم ينزل وَلَا هُوَ وَاقع
segments.english: And the lowest of aspirations of the seekers of knowledge [is] limiting one's aspiration to tracking down rare issues — and what has not been revealed, nor [is it] happening.

segments.arabic: أَو كَانَت همته معرفَة الِاخْتِلَاف وتتبع أَقْوَال النَّاس
segments.english: Or his aspiration [was] knowing the disagreements and tracking the opinions of people,

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ لَهُ همة إِلَى معرفَة الصَّحِيح من تِلْكَ الْأَقْوَال
segments.english: while he has no aspiration to know the correct [one] from those opinions.

segments.arabic: وقلّ أَن ينْتَفع وَاحِد من هَؤُلَاءِ بِعِلْمِهِ
segments.english: And rarely does one of these people benefit from his knowledge.

segments.arabic: وَأَعْلَى الهمم فِي بَاب الْإِرَادَة أَن تكون الهمة مُتَعَلقَة بمحبة الله وَالْوُقُوف مَعَ مُرَاده الديني الأمري
segments.english: And the highest of aspirations in the matter of will [is] that the aspiration [is] attached to the love of God and standing with His religious, commanded will.

segments.arabic: وأسفلها أَن تكون الهمة واقفة مَعَ مُرَاد صَاحبهَا من الله
segments.english: And the lowest of them [is] that the aspiration stands with what its owner wants from God.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ إِنَّمَا يعبده لمراده مِنْهُ لَا لمراد الله مِنْهُ
segments.english: So he only worships Him for what he wants from Him, not for what God wants from him.

segments.arabic: فَالْأول يُرِيد الله وَيُرِيد مُرَاده
segments.english: So the first [person] wants God and wants what He wants,

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي يُرِيد من الله وَهُوَ فارغ عَن إِرَادَته
segments.english: and the second wants from God while he [is] empty of wanting Him.

segments.arabic: عُلَمَاء السوء جَلَسُوا على بَاب الْجنَّة يدعونَ إِلَيْهَا النَّاس بأقوالهم
segments.english: The scholars of evil sat at the gate of Paradise, calling people to it with their words,

segments.arabic: ويدعونهم إِلَى النَّار بأفعالهم
segments.english: and calling them to the Fire with their actions.

segments.arabic: فَكلما قَالَت أَقْوَالهم للنَّاس هلمّوا قَالَت أفعالهم لَا تسمعوا مِنْهُم
segments.english: So whenever their words said to people, "Come!" — their actions said, "Do not listen to them!"

segments.arabic: فَلَو كَانَ مَا دعوا إِلَيْهِ حَقًا كَانُوا أول المستجيبين لَهُ
segments.english: So if what they called to [were] true, they would [have] been the first [to] respond to it.

segments.arabic: فهم فِي الصُّورَة أدلاء وَفِي الْحَقِيقَة قطّاع الطّرق
segments.english: So they [are] in appearance guides, but in reality highway robbers.

segments.arabic: إِذا كَانَ الله وَحده حظك ومرادك فالفضل كُله تَابع لَك يزدلف إِلَيْك
segments.english: If God alone [was] your portion and your aim, then all bounty [is] following you, drawing near to you —

segments.arabic: أَي أَنْوَاعه تبدأ بِهِ
segments.english: whichever of its kinds you begin with.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا كَانَ حظك مَا تنَال مِنْهُ فالفضل مَوْقُوف عَنْك
segments.english: And if your portion [was] what you obtain from Him, then the bounty [is] withheld from you,

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ بِيَدِهِ تَابع لَهُ فعل من أَفعاله
segments.english: because it [is] in His hand, following Him — [it is] an act from among His acts.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا حصل لَك حصل لَك الْفضل بطرِيق الضمن والتبع
segments.english: So if He [is] obtained by you, the bounty [is] obtained by you by way of inclusion and consequence.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا كَانَ الْفضل مقصودك لم يحصل الله بطرِيق الضمن والتبع
segments.english: And if the bounty [is] your aim, God [is] not obtained by way of inclusion and consequence.

segments.arabic: فَإِن
segments.english: And if —

headings.arabic: فصل لما خرج رسول الله من حصر العدو دخل في حصر النصر
headings.english: Chapter: When the Messenger of God came out of the siege of the enemy, he entered the siege of victory

segments.arabic: كنت قد عَرفته وأنست بِهِ
segments.english: you had known Him and found comfort in Him,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ سَقَطت إِلَى طلب الْفضل حَرمك إِيَّاه عُقُوبَة لَك
segments.english: then [you] fell to seeking the extra favor — He deprived you of it [as a] punishment for you.

segments.arabic: ففاتك الله وفاتك الْفضل
segments.english: So you missed God, and you missed the extra favor.

segments.arabic: فعبثت أَيدي سراياه بالنصر فِي الْأَطْرَاف
segments.english: And the hands of his expeditions played with victory in the outskirts,

segments.arabic: فطار ذكره فِي الْآفَاق
segments.english: and his mention flew across the horizons.

segments.arabic: فَصَارَ الْخلق مَعَه ثَلَاثَة أَقسَام
segments.english: So people became, with him, three groups:

segments.arabic: مُؤمن بِهِ ومسالم لَهُ وخائف مِنْهُ
segments.english: [a] believer in him, [one at] peace with him, and [one] afraid of him.

segments.arabic: ألْقى بذر الصَّبْر فِي مزرعة
segments.english: He cast the seed of patience in the farm of:

segments.arabic: فَاصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبر أولو الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ
segments.english: 'Be patient as those of determination among the messengers were patient.'
segments.sahih_international: So be patient, [O Muhammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أَغْصَان النَّبَات تهتز بخزامى
segments.english: And behold, the branches of the plant [were] swaying with lavender.

segments.arabic: وَالْحُرُمَاتُ قصاص
segments.english: And sacred things [are subject to] retaliation.

segments.arabic: فَدخل مَكَّة دُخُولا مَا دخله أحد قبله وَلَا بعده
segments.english: So he entered Mecca [with] an entry that no one [had] entered before him nor after him,

segments.arabic: حوله الْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَالْأَنْصَار لَا يبين مِنْهُم إِلَّا الحدق
segments.english: around him [were] the Emigrants and the Helpers — nothing showing from them except [the] pupils of [their] eyes,

segments.arabic: وَالصَّحَابَة على مَرَاتِبهمْ وَالْمَلَائِكَة فَوق رؤوسهم
segments.english: and the Companions in their ranks, and the angels above their heads,

segments.arabic: وَجِبْرِيل يتَرَدَّد بَينه وَبَين ربه
segments.english: and Gabriel going back and forth between him and his Lord.

segments.arabic: وَقد أَبَاحَ لَهُ حرمه الَّذِي لم يحله لأحد سواهُ
segments.english: And He had permitted for him His sanctuary, which He had not made lawful for anyone other than him.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا قايس بَين هَذَا الْيَوْم وَبَين يَوْم
segments.english: And when he compared between this day and the day of:

segments.arabic: وَإِذْ يمكر بِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يخرجوك
segments.english: 'And when those who disbelieved plotted against you to imprison you, or kill you, or expel you'
segments.sahih_international: And [remember, O Muhammad], when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you [from Makkah]. But they plan, and Allah plans. And Allah is the best of planners.

segments.arabic: فأخرجوه ثَانِي اثْنَيْنِ
segments.english: — and they expelled him, [the] second of two —

segments.arabic: دخل وذقنه تمس قربوس سَرْجه خضوعا وذلا
segments.english: he entered with his chin touching the front of his saddle, [in] humility and lowliness,

segments.arabic: لمن ألبسهُ ثوب هَذَا الْعِزّ
segments.english: to the One who clothed him [in] the garment of this honor —

segments.arabic: الَّذِي رفعت إِلَيْهِ فِيهِ الخليقة رؤوسها
segments.english: [the honor] in which all creation raised their heads toward him,

segments.arabic: ومدت إِلَيْهِ الْمُلُوك أعناقها
segments.english: and the kings stretched their necks toward him.

segments.arabic: فَدخل مَكَّة مَالِكًا مؤيدا منصورا
segments.english: So he entered Mecca [as a] master, supported, victorious.

segments.arabic: وَعلا كَعْب بِلَال فَوق الْكَعْبَة
segments.english: And the heel of Bilal rose above the Kaaba,

segments.arabic: بعد أَن كَانَ يجر فِي الرمضاء على جمر الْفِتْنَة
segments.english: after he used to be dragged on the scorching ground over the embers of trial.

segments.arabic: فنشر بزا طوى عَن الْقَوْم من يَوْم قَوْله أحد أحد
segments.english: So he unfolded [a] cloth [that had been] folded away from the people since the day of his saying: 'One, One.'

segments.arabic: وَرفع صَوته بِالْأَذَانِ
segments.english: And he raised his voice with the call to prayer,

segments.arabic: فأجابته الْقَبَائِل من كل نَاحيَة
segments.english: and the tribes answered him from every direction.

segments.arabic: فَأَقْبَلُوا يؤمُّونَ الصَّوْت
segments.english: And they came heading toward the sound,

segments.arabic: فَدَخَلُوا فِي دين الله أَفْوَاجًا
segments.english: and they entered into the religion of God in crowds,

segments.arabic: وَكَانُوا قبل ذَلِك يأْتونَ آحادا
segments.english: and they used to come before that [as] individuals.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا جلس الرَّسُول على مِنْبَر الْعِزّ وَمَا نزل عَنهُ قطّ
segments.english: And when the Messenger sat on the pulpit of honor — and he never came down from it —

segments.arabic: مدت الْمُلُوك أعناقها بالخضوع إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: the kings stretched their necks in submission toward him.

segments.arabic: فَمنهمْ من سلم إِلَيْهِ مَفَاتِيح الْبِلَاد
segments.english: Among them [were those] who handed him the keys of [their] lands,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من سَأَلَهُ الْمُوَادَعَة وَالصُّلْح
segments.english: and among them [were those] who asked him for truce and peace,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من أقرّ بالجزية وَالصغَار
segments.english: and among them [were those] who accepted the tribute and [its] humiliation,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من أَخذ فِي الْجمع وَالتَّأَهُّب للحرب
segments.english: and among them [were those] who began gathering and preparing for war,

segments.arabic: وَلم يدر أَنه لم يزدْ على جمع الْغَنَائِم وسوق الْأُسَارَى إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: not knowing that he [did] nothing more than gather the spoils and drive the captives to him.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَكَامل نَصره وبلّغ الرسَالَة وَأدّى الْأَمَانَة
segments.english: And when his victory was complete, and he delivered the message, and fulfilled the trust,

segments.arabic: وجاءه منشور
segments.english: and there came to him the decree:

segments.arabic: إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا
segments.english: Indeed, We have opened for you [a] clear opening,
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muhammad], a clear conquest

segments.arabic: لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ مَا تقدم من ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا
segments.english: so that God may forgive for you what came before of your sins and what came after, and complete His blessing upon you, and guide you [to a] straight path,
segments.sahih_international: That Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path

segments.arabic: وَيَنْصُرَكَ
segments.english: and [that He may] help you

headings.arabic: فصل يا مغرورا بالأماني لعن إبليس وأهبط من منزل العز بترك سجدة واحدة
headings.english: Chapter: O you [who are] deceived by wishful thinking — Iblis was cursed and cast down from the station of honor for leaving a single prostration

segments.arabic: ﴿اللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا﴾
segments.english: ...God [with] [a] mighty victory.

segments.arabic: وَبعده توقيع
segments.english: And after it [was a] decree:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ﴾
segments.english: When the help of God and the victory come,
segments.sahih_international: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,

segments.arabic: ﴿وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ الله أَفْوَاجًا﴾
segments.english: and you see the people entering into the religion of God in crowds.
segments.sahih_international: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,

segments.arabic: جَاءَهُ رَسُول ربه يُخبرهُ بَين الْمقَام فِي الدُّنْيَا وَبَين لِقَائِه
segments.english: The messenger of his Lord came to him, giving him [the choice] between staying in this world and between meeting Him.

segments.arabic: فَاخْتَارَ لِقَاء ربه شوقا إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: So he chose meeting his Lord, out of longing for Him.

segments.arabic: فتزينت الْجنان ليَوْم قدوم روحه الْكَرِيمَة
segments.english: So the gardens [of Paradise] adorned themselves for the day of the arrival of his noble soul —

segments.arabic: لَا كزينة الْمَدِينَة يَوْم قدوم الْملك
segments.english: not like the adornment of [a] city on the day of the arrival of [a] king.

segments.arabic: إِذا كَانَ عرش الرَّحْمَن فقد اهتز لمَوْت بعض أَتْبَاعه فَرحا واستبشارا بقدوم روحه
segments.english: If the Throne of the Most Merciful shook at the death of some of his followers, out of joy and delight at the arrival of his soul,

segments.arabic: فَكيف بِروح سيّد الْخَلَائق
segments.english: then how [would it be] for the soul of the master of [all] creation?

segments.arabic: فيا منتسبا إِلَى غير هَذَا الجناب
segments.english: O you who affiliates [yourself] to other than this station,

segments.arabic: وَيَا وَاقِفًا بِغَيْر هَذَا الْبَاب
segments.english: and O you who stands at other than this door —

segments.arabic: ستعلم يَوْم الْحَشْر أَي سريرة تكون عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: you will know on the Day of Gathering which inner state you will be upon,

segments.arabic: يَوْمَ تبلى السرائر
segments.english: on the day [when] the secrets [are] tested.

segments.arabic: فصل يَا مغرورا بالأماني
segments.english: Chapter: O you [who are] deceived by wishful thinking!

segments.arabic: لعن إِبْلِيس وأهبط من منزل الْعِزّ بترك سَجْدَة وَاحِدَة أَمر بهَا
segments.english: Iblis was cursed and cast down from the station of honor for leaving [a] single prostration he was commanded [to do].

segments.arabic: وَأخرج آدم من الْجنَّة بلقمة تنَاولهَا
segments.english: And Adam was expelled from Paradise for [a] morsel he took.

segments.arabic: وحجب الْقَاتِل عَنْهَا بعد أَن رَآهَا عيَانًا بملء كف من دم
segments.english: And the killer was veiled from it after he had seen it with his own eyes, for [a] handful of blood.

segments.arabic: وَأمر بقتل الزَّانِي أشنع القتلات بإيلاج قدر الْأُنْمُلَة فِيمَا لَا يحل
segments.english: And [He] commanded the killing of the adulterer — the most ugly of killings — for inserting the length of [a] fingertip into what [is] not lawful.

segments.arabic: وَأمر بإيساع الظّهْر سياطا بِكَلِمَة قذف أَو بقطرة سكر
segments.english: And [He] commanded that the back be lashed with whips for [a] word of slander, or for [a] drop of intoxicant.

segments.arabic: وَأَبَان عضوا من أعضائك بِثَلَاثَة دَرَاهِم
segments.english: And [He] severed [a] limb from your limbs for three coins.

segments.arabic: فَلَا تأمنه أَن يحبسك فِي النَّار بِمَعْصِيَة وَاحِدَة من مَعَاصيه
segments.english: So do not feel safe from Him imprisoning you in the Fire for [a] single sin from among His [forbidden] sins.

segments.arabic: ﴿وَلا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا﴾
segments.english: And He does not fear its outcome.

segments.arabic: دخلت امْرَأَة النَّار فِي هرة
segments.english: [A] woman entered the Fire because of [a] cat.

segments.arabic: وَإِن الرجل ليَتَكَلَّم بِالْكَلِمَةِ لَا يلقِي لَهَا بَالا
segments.english: And indeed [a] man may speak [a] word, paying no attention to it,

segments.arabic: يهوي بهَا فِي النَّار أبعد مَا بَين الْمشرق وَالْمغْرب
segments.english: [and] he falls by it into the Fire [a distance] further than [what is] between the east and the west.

segments.arabic: وَإِن الرجل ليعْمَل بِطَاعَة الله سِتِّينَ سنة
segments.english: And indeed [a] man may work in obedience to God for sixty years,

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَ عِنْد الْمَوْت جَار فِي الْوَصِيَّة
segments.english: then when he [is] at death, he acts unjustly in [his] bequest,

segments.arabic: فيختم لَهُ بِسوء عمله فَيدْخل النَّار
segments.english: so [it is] sealed for him with the evil of his deed, and he enters the Fire.

segments.arabic: الْعُمر بآخره وَالْعَمَل بخاتمته
segments.english: [A] lifetime [is judged] by its end, and [a] deed by its conclusion.

segments.arabic: من أحدث قبل السَّلَام بَطل مَا مضى من صلَاته
segments.english: Whoever breaks [his] ablution before the salaam, what passed of his prayer [is] nullified.

segments.arabic: وَمن أفطر قبل غرُوب الشَّمْس ذهب صِيَامه ضائعا
segments.english: And whoever breaks [his] fast before sunset, his fasting goes wasted.

segments.arabic: وَمن أَسَاءَ فِي آخر عمره لقى ربه فِي ذَلِك الْوَجْه
segments.english: And whoever does evil at the end of his life meets his Lord in that state.

segments.arabic: لَو قدمت لقْمَة وَجدتهَا
segments.english: If you had sent ahead [a] morsel, you would have found it.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن يُؤْذِيك الشره
segments.english: But greed harms you.

segments.arabic: كم جَاءَ الثَّوَاب يسْعَى إِلَيْك فَوقف بِالْبَابِ
segments.english: How often [has] reward come rushing to you and stood at the door,

segments.arabic: فَرده بواب سَوف وَلَعَلَّ وَعَسَى
segments.english: but the gatekeeper of 'later,' 'maybe,' and 'perhaps' turned it away.

segments.arabic: كَيفَ الْفَلاح
segments.english: How [can there be] success?

headings.arabic: فصل كان أول المخلوقات القلم ليكتب المقادير قبل كونها وجعل آدم وآخر
headings.english: Chapter: The first of created things was the Pen to write the decrees before their existence, and He made Adam the last

segments.arabic: بَين إِيمَان نَاقص وأمل زَائِد
segments.english: between [a] deficient faith and [an] excessive hope,

segments.arabic: وَمرض لَا طَبِيب لَهُ وَلَا عَائِد
segments.english: and [a] sickness [that] has no doctor for it and no visitor,

segments.arabic: وَهوى مستيقظ وعقل رَاقِد
segments.english: and [a] desire [that is] awake and [a] mind [that is] asleep,

segments.arabic: سَاهِيا فِي غمرته عَمها فِي سكرته
segments.english: neglectful in his engrossment, blind in his intoxication,

segments.arabic: سابحا فِي لجّة جَهله
segments.english: swimming in the depths of his ignorance,

segments.arabic: مستوحشا من ربه مستأنسا بخلقه
segments.english: estranged from his Lord, comfortable with His creation.

segments.arabic: ذكر النَّاس فاكهته وقوته
segments.english: Talk of people [is] his entertainment and his sustenance,

segments.arabic: وَذكر الله حَبسه وَمَوته
segments.english: and remembrance of God [is] his prison and his death.

segments.arabic: لله مِنْهُ جُزْء يسير من ظَاهره
segments.english: For God from him [is] a small portion of his outward [appearance],

segments.arabic: وَقَلبه ويقينه لغيره
segments.english: and his heart and his certainty [are] for other than Him.

segments.arabic: لَا كَانَ من سواك فِيهِ بَقِيَّة ... يجد السَّبِيل بهَا إِلَيْهِ العذل
segments.english: May there not remain in him any trace of other than You… through which blame finds [a] way to him.

segments.arabic: كَانَ أول الْمَخْلُوقَات الْقَلَم ليكتب الْمَقَادِير قبل كَونهَا
segments.english: The first of created things was the Pen, to write the decrees before their existence,

segments.arabic: وَجعل آدم وَآخر الْمَخْلُوقَات
segments.english: and He made Adam the last of created things.

segments.arabic: وَفِي ذَلِك حكم
segments.english: And in that [are] wisdoms.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا تمهيد الدَّار قبل السَّاكِن
segments.english: The first of them: preparing the abode before the inhabitant.

segments.arabic: الثَّانِيَة أَنه الْغَايَة الَّتِي خلق لأَجلهَا مَا سواهُ
segments.english: The second: that he [is] the purpose for which everything other than him was created —

segments.arabic: من السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض وَالشَّمْس وَالْقَمَر وَالْبر وَالْبَحْر
segments.english: of the heavens and the earth and the sun and the moon and the land and the sea.

segments.arabic: الثَّالِثَة أَن أحذق الصنّاع يخْتم عمله بأحسنه وغايته
segments.english: The third: that the most skilled of craftsmen seals his work with its finest [part] and its purpose,

segments.arabic: كَمَا يبدؤه بأساسه ومبادئه
segments.english: just as he begins it with its foundation and its starting points.

segments.arabic: الرَّابِعَة أَن النُّفُوس متطلعة إِلَى النهايات والأواخر دَائِما
segments.english: The fourth: that souls [are] always looking toward endings and conclusions.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَ مُوسَى للسحرة
segments.english: And for this [reason] Moses said to the sorcerers:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَلْقُوا مَا أَنْتُمْ ملقون﴾
segments.english: "Cast what you [are] going to cast."

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا رأى النَّاس فعلهم تطلعوا إِلَى مَا يَأْتِي بعده
segments.english: So when the people saw their action, they looked forward to what would come after it.

segments.arabic: الْخَامِسَة أَن الله سُبْحَانَهُ أخّر أفضل الْكتب والأنبياء والأمم إِلَى آخر الزَّمَان
segments.english: The fifth: that God — glorified [is] He — delayed the best of books and prophets and nations to the end of time,

segments.arabic: وَجعل الْآخِرَة خيرا من الأولى
segments.english: and made the Hereafter better than the first [life],

segments.arabic: والنهايات أكمل من البدايات
segments.english: and the endings more complete than the beginnings.

segments.arabic: فكم بَين قَول الْملك للرسول اقْرَأ فَيَقُول مَا أَنا بقارىء
segments.english: So how [vast is the distance] between the angel's saying to the Messenger, "Read!" and he says, "I [am] not [a] reader,"

segments.arabic: وَبَين قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: and [God] Most High's saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دينكُمْ﴾
segments.english: "Today I have completed for you your religion."

segments.arabic: السَّادِسَة ان سُبْحَانَهُ جمع مَا فرقه فِي الْعَالم فِي آدم
segments.english: The sixth: that He — glorified [is] He — gathered what He scattered throughout the world in Adam.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ الْعَالم الصَّغِير وَفِيه مَا فِي الْعَالم الْكَبِير
segments.english: So he [is] the small world, and in him [is] what [is] in the great world.

segments.arabic: السَّابِعَة ان خُلَاصَة الْوُجُود وثمرته
segments.english: The seventh: that he [is] the essence of existence and its fruit,

segments.arabic: فَنَاسَبَ أَن يكون خلقه بعد الموجودات
segments.english: so it was fitting that his creation [be] after [all other] existing things.

segments.arabic: الثَّامِنَة أَن من كرامته على خالقه أَنه هيأ لَهُ مَصَالِحه وحوائجه
segments.english: The eighth: that from his honor with his Creator [is] that He prepared for him his needs and necessities,

segments.arabic: وآلات معيشته وَأَسْبَاب حَيَاته
segments.english: and the tools of his livelihood and the means of his life.

segments.arabic: فَمَا رفع رَأسه إِلَّا وَذَلِكَ كُله حَاضر عتيد
segments.english: So he did not raise his head except [to find] all of that present [and] ready.

segments.arabic: التَّاسِعَة أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ أَرَادَ أَن يظْهر شرفه وفضله على سَائِر الْمَخْلُوقَات
segments.english: The ninth: that He — glorified [is] He — wanted to show his honor and his superiority over the rest of created things,

segments.arabic: فَقَدمهَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْخلق
segments.english: so He put them before him in creation.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَت الْمَلَائِكَة ليخلق رَبنَا مَا شَاءَ فَلَنْ يخلق خلقا أكْرم عَلَيْهِ منا
segments.english: And for this [reason] the angels said: "Let our Lord create whatever He wills, for He will never create [a] creation more honored by Him than us."

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا خلق آدم وَأمرهمْ بِالسُّجُود لَهُ
segments.english: So when He created Adam and commanded them to prostrate to him,

segments.arabic: ظهر فَضله وشرفه عَلَيْهِم بِالْعلمِ والمعرفة
segments.english: his superiority and honor over them became clear through knowledge and understanding.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا وَقع فِي الذَّنب ظنت الْمَلَائِكَة أَن ذَلِك الْفضل
segments.english: Then when he fell into sin, the angels thought that that superiority —

segments.arabic: قد نسخ وَلم تطلع على عبودية التَّوْبَة الكامنة
segments.english: [it] had been abrogated, and you did not know of the hidden servitude of repentance.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَابَ إِلَى ربه وأنى بِتِلْكَ الْعُبُودِيَّة
segments.english: So when he repented to his Lord and brought that servitude,

segments.arabic: علمت الْمَلَائِكَة أَن لله فِي خلقه سرا لَا يُعلمهُ سواهُ
segments.english: the angels knew that God has in His creation a secret that none knows but Him.

segments.arabic: الْعَاشِرَة
segments.english: The tenth [point]:

segments.arabic: أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ لما افْتتح خلق هَذَا الْعَالم بالقلم
segments.english: that He — glorified [is] He — when He began the creation of this world with the Pen,

segments.arabic: من أحسن الْمُنَاسبَة أَن يختمه بِخلق الْإِنْسَان
segments.english: [it is] from the best of fittingness that He concludes it with the creation of the human being.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْقَلَم آلَة الْعلم وَالْإِنْسَان هُوَ الْعَالم
segments.english: For the Pen [is] the tool of knowledge, and the human being — he [is] the knower.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا أظهر سُبْحَانَهُ فضل آدم على الْمَلَائِكَة بِالْعلمِ الَّذِي خُصّ بِهِ دونهم
segments.english: And for this, He — glorified [is] He — showed the virtue of Adam over the angels through the knowledge that he was singled out with, apart from them.

segments.arabic: وَتَأمل كَيفَ كتب سُبْحَانَهُ عذر آدم قبل هُبُوطه إِلَى الأَرْض
segments.english: And reflect [on] how He — glorified [is] He — wrote the excuse of Adam before his descent to the earth,

segments.arabic: وَنبهَ الْمَلَائِكَة على فَضله وشرفه
segments.english: and alerted the angels to his virtue and his honor,

segments.arabic: ونوه باسمه قبل إيجاده بقوله
segments.english: and mentioned his name before bringing him into existence, by His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنِّي جَاعِلٌ فِي الأَرْض خَليفَة﴾
segments.english: "Indeed I [am] placing on the earth a successor."
segments.sahih_international: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?" Allah said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."

segments.arabic: وَتَأمل كَيفَ وسمه بالخلافة وَتلك ولَايَة لَهُ قبل وجوده
segments.english: And reflect [on] how He marked him with succession — and that [is] a guardianship for him before his existence.

segments.arabic: وَأقَام عذره قبل الهبوط بقوله ﴿فِي الأَرْض﴾
segments.english: And He established his excuse before the descent by His saying: "on the earth."

segments.arabic: والمحب يُقيم عذر المحبوب قبل جِنَايَته
segments.english: And the lover establishes the excuse of the beloved before his crime.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا صوره أَلْقَاهُ على بَاب الْجنَّة أَرْبَعِينَ سنة
segments.english: So when He formed him, He placed him at the gate of Paradise [for] forty years,

segments.arabic: لِأَن دأب الْمُحب الْوُقُوف على بَاب الحبيب
segments.english: because the habit of the lover [is] standing at the door of the beloved.

segments.arabic: رمى بِهِ فِي طَرِيق ذل
segments.english: He cast him on [a] path of lowliness —

segments.arabic: ﴿لَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْئا﴾
segments.english: "he was not [a] thing"

segments.arabic: لِئَلَّا يعجب يَوْم اسجدوا
segments.english: so that he would not be amazed on the day of "Prostrate!"

segments.arabic: كَانَ إِبْلِيس يمر على جسده فيعجب مِنْهُ
segments.english: Iblis used to pass by his body and marvel at it,

segments.arabic: وَيَقُول لأمر قد خلقت
segments.english: and [he would] say: "For [a great] matter you have been created."

segments.arabic: ثمَّ يدْخل من فِيهِ وَيخرج من دبره
segments.english: Then he would enter from his mouth and exit from his back,

segments.arabic: وَيَقُول لَئِن سلطت عَلَيْك لأهلكنك
segments.english: and say: "If I [am] given power over you, I will surely destroy you,

segments.arabic: وَلَئِن سلطت عَليّ لأعصينك
segments.english: and if you [are] given power over me, I will surely disobey you."

segments.arabic: وَلم يعلم أَن هَلَاكه على يَده
segments.english: And he did not know that his own destruction [would be] at his hands.

segments.arabic: رأى طينا مجموعا فاحتقر
segments.english: He saw clay gathered together, so he looked down [upon it].

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا صور الطين صُورَة دب فِيهِ دَاء الْحَسَد
segments.english: So when the clay was formed [into a] shape, the disease of envy crept into him.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا نفخ فِيهِ الرّوح مَاتَ الْحَاسِد
segments.english: So when the spirit was breathed into him, the envious one died.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا بسط لَهُ بِسَاط الْعِزّ
segments.english: So when the carpet of honor was spread for him,

segments.arabic: عرضت عَلَيْهِ الْمَخْلُوقَات فَاسْتَحْضر مدعي وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّح إِلَى حَاكم أَنْبِئُونِي
segments.english: the creatures were presented before him, and the claimants of "and we glorify" were summoned to [a] judge: "Inform Me!"

segments.arabic: وَقد أخْفى الْوَكِيل عَنهُ بَيِّنَة
segments.english: And the Agent had hidden the evidence from him.

segments.arabic: وَعَلَّمَ فنكسوا رُؤُوس الدَّعَاوَى على صُدُور الْإِقْرَار
segments.english: And He taught [Adam], so they lowered the heads of [their] claims upon the chests of admission.

segments.arabic: فَقَامَ مُنَادِي التَّفْضِيل فِي أندية الْمَلَائِكَة يُنَادي اسجدوا
segments.english: So the caller of preference stood in the assemblies of the angels, calling: "Prostrate!"

segments.arabic: فتطهروا من حَدِيث دَعْوَى وَنَحْن بِمَاء الْعذر فِي آنِية
segments.english: So they purified themselves from the talk of the claim "and we" with the water of excuse, in the vessel of:

segments.arabic: ﴿لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا﴾
segments.english: "[There is] no knowledge for us."

segments.arabic: فسجدوا على طَهَارَة التَّسْلِيم
segments.english: So they prostrated upon the purity of submission.

segments.arabic: وَقَامَ إِبْلِيس نَاحيَة لم يسْجد
segments.english: And Iblis stood aside — he did not prostrate,

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ خبث وَقد تلون بِنَجَاسَة الِاعْتِرَاض
segments.english: because he [was] filthy, having been stained with the impurity of objection.

segments.arabic: وَمَا كَانَت نَجَاسَته تتلافى بالتطهير لِأَنَّهَا عَيْنِيَّة
segments.english: And his impurity could not be fixed by purification, because it [was] of the substance itself.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا تمّ كَمَال آدم قَالَ لَا بُد من خَال جمال على وَجه اسْجُدُوا
segments.english: So when Adam's perfection was complete, He said: there must be a beauty mark on the face of "Prostrate!"

segments.arabic: فَجرى الْقدر بالذنب ليتبين أثر الْعُبُودِيَّة فِي الذل
segments.english: So the decree ran with the sin, so that the trace of servitude would appear in humility.

segments.arabic: يَا آدم لَو عفى لَك عَن تِلْكَ اللُّقْمَة
segments.english: O Adam, if you had been pardoned for that morsel,

segments.arabic: لقَالَ الحاسدون كَيفَ فضل ذُو شَره لم يصبر على شَجَرَة
segments.english: the envious ones would have said: "How [was] one with greed preferred — [he who] could not be patient with [a single] tree?"

segments.arabic: لَوْلَا نزولك مَا تصاعدت صعداء الأنفاس
segments.english: Were it not for your descent, the sighing breaths would not have risen,

segments.arabic: وَلَا نزلت رسائل هَل من وَسَائِل
segments.english: nor would the messages of "Are there [any] means?" have come down,

segments.arabic: وَلَا فاحت
segments.english: nor would [they] have spread [their] fragrance.

headings.arabic: فصل لما سلم لآدم أصل العبودية لم يقدح فيه الذنب ابن آدم لو
headings.english: Section: When the Foundation of Servitude Was Sound for Adam, the Sin Did Not Damage It

segments.arabic: رَوَائِح ولخلوف فَم الصَّائِم
segments.english: fragrances, and the breath of the fasting person's mouth.

segments.arabic: فَتبين حِينَئِذٍ أَن ذَلِك التَّنَاوُل لم يكن عَن شَرَهٍ
segments.english: So it became clear then that that eating was not out of greed.

segments.arabic: يَا آدم ضحكك فِي الْجنَّة لَك وبكاؤك فِي دَار التَّكْلِيف لنا
segments.english: O Adam, your laughter in Paradise [was] for you, and your weeping in the abode of obligation [is] for Us.

segments.arabic: مَا ضرّ من كَسره عزي إِذا جبره فضلي
segments.english: What harm [comes to] one whom My glory broke, when My grace restored him?

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا تلِيق خلعة الْعِزّ ببدن الانكسار
segments.english: The robe of honor only suits the body of brokenness.

segments.arabic: أَنا عِنْد المنكسرة قُلُوبهم من أَجلي
segments.english: I [am] with those whose hearts are broken for My sake.

segments.arabic: مازالت تِلْكَ الْأكلَة تعاده حَتَّى استولى داؤه على أَوْلَاده
segments.english: That bite kept afflicting him until his illness overtook his children.

segments.arabic: فَأرْسل إِلَيْهِم اللَّطِيف الْخَبِير الدَّوَاء على أَيدي أطباء الْوُجُود
segments.english: So the Subtle, the All-Aware sent to them the cure through the hands of the physicians of existence.

segments.arabic: فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ مِنِّي هُدىً فَمن تبع هُدَايَ فَلا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يشقى
segments.english: If there comes to you from Me guidance, then whoever follows My guidance [will] not go astray and not suffer.
segments.sahih_international: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].

segments.arabic: فحماهم الطَّبِيب بالمناهي
segments.english: So the Physician protected them with the prohibitions,

segments.arabic: وَحفظ الْقُوَّة بالأوامر
segments.english: and preserved [their] strength with the commands,

segments.arabic: واستفرغ أخلاطهم الرَّديئَة بِالتَّوْبَةِ
segments.english: and purged their bad mixtures with repentance.

segments.arabic: فَجَاءَت الْعَافِيَة من كل نَاحيَة
segments.english: So well-being came from every direction.

segments.arabic: فيا من ضيّع الْقُوَّة وَلم يحفظها
segments.english: O you who wasted [your] strength and did not preserve it,

segments.arabic: وخلط فِي مَرضه وَمَا احتمى
segments.english: and mixed [harmful things] during his illness and did not take precaution,

segments.arabic: وَلَا صَبر على مرَارَة الاستفراغ
segments.english: and did not have patience with the bitterness of the purge —

segments.arabic: لَا تنكر قرب الْهَلَاك فالداء مترام إِلَى الْفساد
segments.english: do not deny the nearness of ruin, for the disease [is] spreading toward corruption.

segments.arabic: لَو ساعد الْقدر فأعنت الطَّبِيب على نَفسك بالحمية من شَهْوَة خسيسة
segments.english: If destiny helped and you assisted the Physician against yourself with [a] diet from lowly desire,

segments.arabic: ظَفرت بأنواع اللَّذَّات وأصناف المشتهيات
segments.english: you would have won all kinds of pleasures and varieties of delights.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن بخار الشَّهْوَة غطى عين البصيرة
segments.english: But the steam of desire covered the eye of insight,

segments.arabic: فَظَنَنْت أَن الحزم بيع الْوَعْد بِالنَّقْدِ
segments.english: so you thought that wisdom [was] selling the promise for [what is] in hand.

segments.arabic: يالها بَصِيرَة عمياء
segments.english: What [a] blind insight!

segments.arabic: جزعت من صَبر سَاعَة واحتملت ذل الْأَبَد
segments.english: [It] panicked from an hour's patience and bore the humiliation of eternity.

segments.arabic: سَافَرت فِي طلب الدُّنْيَا وَهِي عَنْهَا زائلة
segments.english: [You] traveled seeking this world while it [is] departing from you,

segments.arabic: وَقَعَدت عَن السّفر إِلَى الْآخِرَة وَهِي إِلَيْهَا رَاحِلَة
segments.english: and sat idle from traveling to the Hereafter while it [is] journeying toward you.

segments.arabic: إِذا رَأَيْت الرجل يَشْتَرِي الخسيس بالنفيس وَيبِيع الْعَظِيم بالحقير
segments.english: If you see [a] man buying the worthless with the precious and selling the great for the lowly,

segments.arabic: فَاعْلَم بِأَنَّهُ سَفِيه
segments.english: then know that he [is] foolish.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Section

segments.arabic: لما سلم لآدَم أصل الْعُبُودِيَّة لم يقْدَح فِيهِ الذَّنب
segments.english: When the foundation of servitude was sound for Adam, the sin did not damage it.

segments.arabic: ابْن آدم لَو لقيتني بقراب الأَرْض خَطَايَا
segments.english: O son of Adam, if you met Me with [an] earth-full of sins,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ لقيتني لَا تشرك بِي شَيْئا
segments.english: then met Me not associating anything with Me,

segments.arabic: لقيتك بقرابها مغْفرَة
segments.english: I would meet you with its fill of forgiveness.

segments.arabic: لما علم السَّيِّد أَن ذَنْب عَبده لم يكن قصدا لمُخَالفَته وَلَا قدحا فِي حكمته
segments.english: When the Master knew that His servant's sin was not intended as disobedience to Him, nor [as] a challenge to His wisdom,

segments.arabic: علمه كَيفَ يعْتَذر إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: He taught him how to apologize to Him.

segments.arabic: فَتَلَقَّى آدَمُ مِن رَبِّهِ كَلِمَاتٍ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: Then Adam received from his Lord words, and He turned [in forgiveness] upon him.
segments.sahih_international: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: العَبْد لَا يُرِيد بمعصيته مُخَالفَة سَيّده وَلَا الجرأة على مَحَارمه
segments.english: The servant does not intend by his disobedience [to] oppose his master, nor [to show] boldness toward his forbidden things,

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن غلبات الطَّبْع وتزيين النَّفس والشيطان
segments.english: but [rather it is] the overpowering of nature, and the beautifying of the self and Satan,

segments.arabic: وقهر الْهوى والثقة بِالْعَفو ورجاء الْمَغْفِرَة
segments.english: and the force of desire, and trust in pardon, and hope for forgiveness.

segments.arabic: هَذَا من جَانب العَبْد
segments.english: This [is] from the servant's side.

segments.arabic: وَأما من جَانب الربوبية
segments.english: And as for from the side of Lordship,

segments.arabic: فجريان الحكم وَإِظْهَار عز الربوبية وذل الْعُبُودِيَّة
segments.english: [it is] the running of the [divine] decree, and the showing of the glory of Lordship and the lowliness of servitude,

segments.arabic: وَكَمَال الِاحْتِيَاج وَظُهُور آثَار الْأَسْمَاء الْحسنى
segments.english: and the completeness of need, and the appearance of the effects of the Beautiful Names.

segments.arabic: كالعفو والغفور والتوّاب والحليم لمن جَاءَ تَائِبًا نَادِمًا
segments.english: like the Pardoner, the Forgiving, the Accepter of Repentance, and the Forbearing — for whoever came repentant [and] remorseful

segments.arabic: والمنتقم وَالْعدْل وَذي الْبَطْش الشَّديد لمن أصر وَلزِمَ المجرة
segments.english: and the Avenger, the Just, and the Possessor of severe grip — for whoever persisted and clung to wrongdoing

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يُرِيد أَن يرى عَبده تفرده بالكمال
segments.english: So He — glorified [is] He — wants His servant to see His uniqueness in perfection

segments.arabic: وَنقص العَبْد وَحَاجته إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and the deficiency of the servant and his need for Him

segments.arabic: ويشهده كَمَال قدرته وعزته
segments.english: and to make him witness the perfection of His power and His might

segments.arabic: وَكَمَال مغفرته وعفوه وَرَحمته
segments.english: and the perfection of His forgiveness, His pardon, and His mercy

segments.arabic: وَكَمَال بره وستره وحلمه وتجاوزه وصفحه
segments.english: and the perfection of His goodness, His covering, His forbearance, His overlooking, and His pardoning

segments.arabic: وَأَن رَحمته بِهِ إِحْسَان إِلَيْهِ لَا مُعَارضَة
segments.english: and that His mercy toward him [is] kindness to him, not [an] exchange

segments.arabic: وَأَنه إِن لم يتغمّده برحمته وفضله فَهُوَ هَالك لَا محَالة
segments.english: and that if He does not cover him with His mercy and grace, then he [is] ruined without doubt

segments.arabic: فَللَّه كم من تَقْدِير الذَّنب من حِكْمَة
segments.english: So by God, how much wisdom [there is] in the decree of sin!

segments.arabic: وَكم فِيهِ مَعَ تَحْقِيق التَّوْبَة للْعَبد من مصلحَة وَرَحْمَة
segments.english: And how much benefit and mercy [there is] in it, along with the achievement of repentance for the servant!

segments.arabic: التَّوْبَة من الذَّنب كشرب الدَّوَاء للعليل
segments.english: Repentance from sin [is] like the drinking of medicine for the sick person

segments.arabic: وَرب عِلّة كَانَت سَبَب الصِّحَّة
segments.english: and many an illness was the cause of health

segments.arabic: لَعَلَّ عتبك مَحْمُود عواقبه ... وَرُبمَا صحت الأجساد بالعلل
segments.english: Perhaps your reproach [has] praiseworthy outcomes / and perhaps bodies are healed through illnesses

segments.arabic: لَوْلَا تَقْدِير الذَّنب هلك ابْن آدم من الْعجب
segments.english: Were it not for the decree of sin, the son of Adam [would have] perished from self-admiration

segments.arabic: ذَنْب يذل بِهِ أحب إِلَيْهِ من طَاعَة يدل بهَا عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: A sin by which he [is] humbled [is] more beloved to Him than obedience by which he acts arrogantly before Him

segments.arabic: شمعة النَّصْر إِنَّمَا تنزل فِي شمعدان الانكسار
segments.english: The candle of victory only descends into the candlestick of brokenness

segments.arabic: لَا يكرم العَبْد نَفسه بِمثل إهانتها
segments.english: The servant does not honor his self with [anything] like humbling it

segments.arabic: وَلَا يعزها بِمثل ذلها
segments.english: and does not strengthen it with [anything] like lowering it

segments.arabic: وَلَا يريحها بِمثل تعبها
segments.english: and does not give it rest with [anything] like tiring it

segments.arabic: كَمَا قيل سأتعب نَفسِي أَو أصادف رَاحَة ... فإن هوان النَّفس فِي كرم النَّفس
segments.english: as it was said: "I will tire myself or find rest / for the humbling of the self [is] in the honoring of the self"

segments.arabic: وَلَا يشبعها بِمثل جوعها
segments.english: And he does not satisfy it with [anything] like its hunger

segments.arabic: وَلَا يؤمنها بِمثل خوفها
segments.english: and does not secure it with [anything] like its fear

segments.arabic: وَلَا يؤنسها بِمثل وحشتها من كل مَا سوى فاطرها وبارئها
segments.english: and does not bring it comfort with [anything] like its loneliness from everything other than its Creator and Maker

segments.arabic: وَلَا يُحْيِيهَا بِمثل إماتتها
segments.english: and does not give it life with [anything] like causing it to die

segments.arabic: كَمَا قيل موت النُّفُوس حياتها ... من شَاءَ أَن يحيا يَمُوت
segments.english: as it was said: "The death of souls [is] their life / whoever wishes to live, let him die"

segments.arabic: شراب الْهوى حُلْو وَلكنه يُورث الشرق
segments.english: The drink of desire [is] sweet, but it causes choking

segments.arabic: من تذكر خنق الفخ هان عَلَيْهِ هجران الْحبَّة
segments.english: Whoever remembers the strangling of the trap, abandoning the grain becomes easy for him

segments.arabic: يَا معرقلًا فِي شرك الْهوى جمزة عزم وَقد خرقت الشبكة
segments.english: O you [who are] entangled in the snare of desire — [just] one leap of determination, and you [will] have torn the net!

segments.arabic: لَا بُد من نُفُوذ الْقدر فاجنح للسلم
segments.english: The decree must come to pass, so incline toward surrender

segments.arabic: لله ملك السَّمَوَات والأرض
segments.english: To God [belongs] the kingdom of the heavens and the earth

segments.arabic: واستقرض مِنْك حَبَّة فبخلت بهَا
segments.english: and He asked you for [a] loan of [a] grain, and you were stingy with it

segments.arabic: وَخلق سَبْعَة أبحر وَأحب مِنْك دمعة فقحطت عَيْنك بهَا
segments.english: and He created seven seas, and He wanted from you [a] tear, but your eye dried up

segments.arabic: إِطْلَاق الْبَصَر ينقش في الْقلب صُورَة المنظور
segments.english: Letting the gaze loose carves in the heart the image of what [is] seen

segments.arabic: وَالْقلب كعبة والمعبود لَا يرضى بمزاحمة
segments.english: and the heart [is] [a] Ka'ba, and the One worshipped does not accept rivalry

segments.arabic: الْأَصْنَام لذات الدُّنْيَا كسوداء وَقد غلبت عَلَيْك
segments.english: the idols of the pleasures of this world [are] like [a] dark [slave woman], and she has overcome you

segments.arabic: والحور الْعين يعجبن من سوء اختيارك عَلَيْهِنَّ
segments.english: and the wide-eyed houris [are] amazed at your poor choice over them

segments.arabic: غير أَن زَوْبَعَة الْهوى إِذا ثارت سفت فِي عين البصيرة فخفيت الجادة
segments.english: except that the whirlwind of desire, when it rises, blows dust in the eye of insight, so the path becomes hidden

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الله تزينت الْجنَّة للخُطَّاب فجَدُّوا فِي تَحْصِيل الْمهْر
segments.english: Glorified [is] God! Paradise adorned itself for the suitors, so they worked hard in earning the dowry

segments.arabic: وتعرّف رب الْعِزَّة إِلَى المحبين بأسمائه وَصِفَاته فعملوا على اللِّقَاء
segments.english: And the Lord of Might made Himself known to the lovers through His names and attributes, so they worked toward the meeting

segments.arabic: وَأَنت مَشْغُول بالجيف
segments.english: while you [are] busy with carcasses

segments.arabic: لَا كَانَ من لسواك مِنْهُ قلبه ... وَلَك اللِّسَان مَعَ الوداد الْكَاذِب
segments.english: May he not exist — the one whose heart [is] for other than You, / while for You [is only] the tongue with [its] false affection

segments.arabic: الْمعرفَة بِسَاط لَا يطَأ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا مقرب
segments.english: Knowledge [of God] [is] a carpet that none steps on except one brought near

segments.arabic: والمحبة نشيد لَا يطرب عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا محب مغرم
segments.english: and love [is] a song that none delights in except [a] passionate lover

segments.arabic: الْحبّ غَدِير فِي صحراء لَيست عَلَيْهِ جادة فَلهَذَا قل وارده
segments.english: Love [is] a pond in [a] desert with no road [leading] to it, so for this [reason] its visitors [are] few

segments.arabic: الْمُحب يهرب إِلَى الْعُزْلَة وَالْخلْوَة بمحبوبه والأنس بِذكرِهِ
segments.english: The lover flees to seclusion and privacy with his beloved and comfort in His remembrance

segments.arabic: كهرب الْحُوت إِلَى المَاء والطفل إِلَى أمه
segments.english: like the fleeing of the fish to water and the child to his mother

segments.arabic: وَأخرج من بَين الْبيُوت لعلني ... أحدث عَنْك الْقلب بالسر خَالِيا
segments.english: And I go out from among the houses, so that perhaps / I [may] tell [my] heart about You in secret, alone

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ للعابد مستراح إِلَّا تَحت شَجَرَة طُوبَى
segments.english: There [is] no resting place for the worshiper except under the tree of Tuba

segments.arabic: وَلَا للمحب قَرَار إِلَّا يَوْم الْمَزِيد
segments.english: and no rest for the lover except [on] the Day of Increase

segments.arabic: اشْتغل بِهِ فِي الْحَيَاة يكفك مَا بعد الْمَوْت
segments.english: Busy yourself with Him in [this] life, [and] He will take care of you [in] what [comes] after death

segments.arabic: يَا منفقا بضَاعَة الْعُمر فِي مُخَالفَة حَبِيبه والبعد مِنْهُ
segments.english: O you who spend the goods of [your] lifetime in disobeying your Beloved and [in] distance from Him

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ فِي أعدائك أضرّ عَلَيْك مِنْك
segments.english: there [is] no one among your enemies more harmful to you than yourself

segments.arabic: مَا تبلغ الْأَعْدَاء من جَاهِل ... من يبلغ الْجَاهِل من نَفسه
segments.english: The enemies cannot do to [a] foolish [person] / what the foolish [person] does to himself

segments.arabic: الهمة العليّة من استعد صَاحبهَا للقاء الحبيب
segments.english: The high ambition [is that of one] whose owner prepared for the meeting of the Beloved

segments.arabic: وَقدم التقادم بَين يَدي الْمُلْتَقى فَاسْتَبْشَرَ عِنْد الْقدوم
segments.english: and presented gifts before the meeting, so he rejoiced upon arrival

segments.arabic: ﴿وَقدمُوا لأنفسكم وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّكُمْ مُلاقُوهُ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤمنِينَ﴾
segments.english: And send forth [good deeds] for yourselves, and be conscious of God, and know that you [will] meet Him, and give glad tidings to the believers
segments.sahih_international: Your wives are a place of sowing of seed for you, so come to your place of cultivation however you wish and put forth [righteousness] for yourselves. And fear Allah and know that you will meet Him. And give good tidings to the believers.

segments.arabic: تالله مَا عدا عَلَيْك الْعَدو إِلَّا بعد أَن تولى عَنْك الْوَلِيّ
segments.english: By God, the enemy did not attack you except after the Protector turned away from you

segments.arabic: فَلَا تظن أَن الشَّيْطَان غلب وَلَكِن الْحَافِظ أعرض
segments.english: So do not think that Satan [has] overcome [you], but [rather] the Guardian turned away

segments.arabic: احذر نَفسك فَمَا أَصَابَك بلَاء قطّ إِلَّا مِنْهَا
segments.english: Beware of yourself, for no affliction has ever struck you except from it

segments.arabic: وَلَا تهادنها فوَاللَّه مَا أكرمها من لم يهنها
segments.english: And do not make peace with it, for by God, no one honored it who did not humiliate it

segments.arabic: وَلَا أعزها من لم يذلها
segments.english: and no one strengthened it who did not humble it

segments.arabic: وَلَا جبرها من لم يكسرها
segments.english: and no one mended it who did not break it

segments.arabic: وَلَا أراحها من لم يتبعهَا
segments.english: and no one gave it rest who did not tire it

segments.arabic: وَلَا أمنها من لم يخوفها
segments.english: and no one gave it safety who did not frighten it

segments.arabic: وَلَا فرحها من لم يحزنها
segments.english: and no one gave it joy who did not grieve it

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الله ظاهرك متجمل بلباس التَّقْوَى وباطنك باطية
segments.english: Glorified [is] God! Your outside [is] beautified with the clothing of God-consciousness, while your inside [is] [a] wine jug

segments.arabic: وَالْغَضَب والسخط والعقوبة انقمعت النَّفس الأمارة وَبَطلَت أَو ضعفت قواها من الشَّهْوَة وَالْغَضَب وَاللَّهْو واللعب والحرص على الْمُحرمَات
segments.english: and [His] anger and displeasure and punishment — the commanding self [is] suppressed, and its powers of desire and anger and distraction and play and greed for forbidden things [are] cancelled or weakened,

segments.arabic: وانقبضت أَعِنَّة رعوناتها فأحضرت المطية حظها من الْخَوْف والخشية والحذر
segments.english: and the reins of its recklessness [are] pulled back, so the mount brings forth its share of fear and awe and caution.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا تجلى بِصِفَات الْأَمر وَالنَّهْي والعهد وَالْوَصِيَّة وإرسال الرُّسُل وإنزال الْكتب شرع الشَّرَائِع
segments.english: And when He manifests [Himself] with the attributes of command and prohibition and covenant and instruction and sending of messengers and revealing of books [and] legislating of laws,

segments.arabic: انبعثت مِنْهَا قُوَّة الِامْتِثَال والتنفيذ لأوامره والتبليغ لَهَا والتواصي بهَا
segments.english: there springs from it [a] power of obedience and carrying out of His commands and conveying them and mutually advising [one another] with them,

segments.arabic: وَذكرهَا وتذكرها والتصديق بالْخبر والامتثال للطلب والاجتناب للنَّهْي
segments.english: and mentioning them and remembering them, and believing [in] the reports and obeying the requests and avoiding the prohibitions.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا تجلى بِصفة السّمع وَالْبَصَر وَالْعلم انْبَعَثَ من العَبْد قُوَّة الْحيَاء
segments.english: And when He manifests [Himself] with the attributes of hearing and sight and knowledge, there springs from the servant [a] power of shyness,

segments.arabic: فيستحي ربه أَن يرَاهُ على مَا يكره أَو يسمع مِنْهُ مَا يكره أَو يخفي فِي سَرِيرَته مَا يمقته عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: so he feels shy before his Lord that He would see him doing what He dislikes, or hear from him what He dislikes, or [that] he would hide in his inner self what [God] detests him for.

segments.arabic: فَتبقى حركاته وأقواله وخواطره موزونة بميزان الشَّرْع غير مُهْملَة وَلَا مُرْسلَة تَحت حكم الطبيعة والهوى
segments.english: So his movements and words and thoughts remain weighed by the scale of the Sacred Law, not neglected nor left loose under the rule of nature and desire.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا تجلى بِصِفَات الْكِفَايَة والحسب وَالْقِيَام بمصالح الْعباد وسوق أَرْزَاقهم إِلَيْهِم وَدفع المصائب عَنْهُم
segments.english: And when He manifests [Himself] with the attributes of sufficiency and being enough and taking care of the interests of [His] servants and driving their provision to them and warding off calamities from them,

segments.arabic: وَنَصره لأوليائه وحمايته لَهُم ومعيته الْخَاصَّة لَهُم
segments.english: and His support for His close ones and His protection of them and His special closeness to them —

segments.arabic: انبعثت من العَبْد قُوَّة التَّوَكُّل عَلَيْهِ والتفويض إِلَيْهِ وَالرِّضَا بِهِ
segments.english: there springs from the servant [a] power of reliance [on God] upon Him and entrusting [affairs] to Him and contentment with Him,

segments.arabic: وَمَا فِي كل مَا يجريه على عَبده ويقيمه مِمَّا يرضى بِهِ هُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: and [contentment] with everything He causes to happen to His servant and establishes, from what He — glorified [is] He — [is] pleased with.

segments.arabic: والتوكل معنى يلتئم من علم العَبْد بكفاية الله وَحسن اخْتِيَاره لعَبْدِهِ وثقته بِهِ وَرضَاهُ بِمَا يَفْعَله بِهِ ويختاره لَهُ
segments.english: And reliance [on God] [is] [a] meaning that comes together from the servant's knowledge of God's sufficiency and the goodness of His choosing for His servant, and his trust in Him and his contentment with what He does to him and chooses for him.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا تجلى بِصِفَات الْعِزّ والكبرياء أَعْطَتْ نَفسه المطمئنة مَا وصلت إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And when He manifests [Himself] with the attributes of might and majesty, his tranquil self gives what it has reached

segments.arabic: من الذل لعظمته والانكسار لعزته والخضوع لكبريائه وخشوع الْقلب والجوارح لَهُ
segments.english: of lowliness before His greatness and brokenness before His might and submission before His majesty and humility of the heart and limbs before Him.

segments.arabic: فتعلوه السكينَة وَالْوَقار فِي قلبه وَلسَانه وجوارحه وسمته وَيذْهب طيشه وقوته وحدته
segments.english: So calmness and dignity cover him in his heart and tongue and limbs and appearance, and his restlessness and roughness and sharpness go away.

segments.arabic: وجماع ذَلِك أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ يتعرف إِلَى العَبْد بِصِفَات إلهيته تارّة وبصفات ربوبيته تَارَة
segments.english: And the sum of that [is] that He — glorified [is] He — makes Himself known to the servant through the attributes of His divinity at times, and through the attributes of His lordship at [other] times.

segments.arabic: فَيُوجب لَهُ شُهُود صِفَات الإلهية الْمحبَّة الْخَاصَّة والشوق إِلَى لِقَائِه والأنس والفرح بِهِ
segments.english: So witnessing the attributes of divinity brings about for him [a] special love and longing to meet Him and intimacy and joy with Him,

segments.arabic: وَالسُّرُور بخدمته والمنافسة فِي قربه والتودد إِلَيْهِ بِطَاعَتِهِ واللهج بِذكرِهِ والفرار من الْخلق إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and happiness in serving Him and competing for His closeness and drawing near to Him through obedience to Him and being constant in remembrance of Him and fleeing from creation to Him.

segments.arabic: وَيصير هُوَ وَحده همه دون مَا سواهُ
segments.english: And He alone becomes his concern, apart from anything other than Him.

segments.arabic: وَيُوجب لَهُ شُهُود صِفَات الربوبية التَّوَكُّل عَلَيْهِ والافتقار إِلَيْهِ والاستعانة بِهِ والذل والخضوع والانكسار لَهُ
segments.english: And witnessing the attributes of lordship brings about for him reliance [on God] upon Him and neediness toward Him and seeking help from Him and lowliness and submission and brokenness before Him.

segments.arabic: وَكَمَال ذَلِك أَن يشْهد ربوبيته فِي إلهيته وإلهيته فِي ربوبيته وحمده فِي ملكه وعزه فِي عَفوه
segments.english: And the perfection of that [is] that he witnesses His lordship in His divinity and His divinity in His lordship, and His praise in His dominion and His might in His pardon.

headings.arabic: فصل لما بايع الرسول أهل العقبة أمر أصحابه بالهجرة إلى المدينة
headings.english: Chapter: When the Messenger pledged with the people of al-Aqaba, he commanded his companions to migrate to Medina

segments.arabic: وحكمته فِي قَضَائِهِ وَقدره وَنعمته فِي بلائه وعطاءه فِي مَنعه
segments.english: and His wisdom in His decree and [His] destiny, and His blessing in His trial, and His giving in His withholding,

segments.arabic: وبره ولطفه وإحسانه وَرَحمته فِي قيوميته وعذله فِي انتقامه
segments.english: and His goodness and [His] gentleness and [His] kindness and [His] mercy in His sustaining, and His justice in His retribution,

segments.arabic: وجوده وَكَرمه فِي مغفرته وستره وتجاوزه
segments.english: and His generosity and [His] nobility in His forgiveness and His concealing and His pardoning.

segments.arabic: وَيشْهد حكمته وَنعمته فِي أمره وَنَهْيه وعزه فِي رِضَاهُ وغضبه
segments.english: And [he] witnesses His wisdom and His blessing in His command and His prohibition, and His might in His pleasure and His anger,

segments.arabic: وحلمه فِي إمهاله وَكَرمه فِي إقباله وغناه فِي إعراضه
segments.english: and His forbearance in His granting respite, and His nobility in His turning toward [them], and His self-sufficiency in His turning away.

segments.arabic: وَأَنت إِذا تدبرت الْقُرْآن وأجرته من التحريف وَأَن تقضي عَلَيْهِ بآراء الْمُتَكَلِّمين وأفكار المتكلفين
segments.english: And you — if you reflect on the Quran and protect it from distortion, and from judging it by the opinions of the theologians and the ideas of the pretentious ones —

segments.arabic: أشهدك ملكا قيوما فَوق سماواته على عَرْشه يدبر أَمر عباده
segments.english: it [will] show you [a] King, [the] Self-Sustaining, above His heavens, upon His Throne, managing the affair of His servants.

segments.arabic: يَأْمر وَيُنْهِي وَيُرْسل الرُّسُل وَينزل الْكتب
segments.english: [He] commands and forbids, and sends the messengers, and sends down the books,

segments.arabic: ويرضى ويغضب ويثيب ويعاقب
segments.english: and [is] pleased and [is] angry, and rewards and punishes,

segments.arabic: وَيُعْطِي وَيمْنَع ويعز ويذل ويخفض وَيرْفَع
segments.english: and gives and withholds, and honors and humbles, and lowers and raises.

segments.arabic: يرى من فَوق سبع وَيسمع وَيعلم السِّرّ وَالْعَلَانِيَة
segments.english: [He] sees from above seven [heavens] and hears, and knows the secret and the open.

segments.arabic: فعّال لما يُرِيد مَوْصُوف بِكُل كَمَال منزه عَن كل عيب
segments.english: [He is the] Doer of whatever He wills, described with every perfection, far above every flaw.

segments.arabic: لَا تتحرك ذرّة فَمَا فَوْقهَا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ
segments.english: Not [a] single atom moves, nor [anything] above it, except by His permission,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تسْقط ورقة إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ
segments.english: and no leaf falls except by His knowledge,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يشفع أحد عِنْده إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ
segments.english: and no one intercedes with Him except by His permission.

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ لِعِبَادِهِ من دونه ولي وَلَا شَفِيع
segments.english: His servants have no protector besides Him, and no intercessor.

segments.arabic: فصل لما بَايع الرَّسُول أهل الْعقبَة أَمر أَصْحَابه بِالْهِجْرَةِ إِلَى الْمَدِينَة
segments.english: Chapter: When the Messenger pledged with the people of al-Aqaba, he commanded his companions to migrate to Medina.

segments.arabic: فَعلمت قُرَيْش أَن أَصْحَابه قد كَثُرُوا وَأَنَّهُمْ سيمنعونه
segments.english: So Quraysh learned that his companions had become many, and that they would protect him.

segments.arabic: فاعلمت آراءها فِي اسْتِخْرَاج الْحِيَل
segments.english: So they put their minds to work devising schemes.

segments.arabic: فَمنهمْ من رأى الْحَبْس وَمِنْهُم من رأى النَّفْي
segments.english: Among them [were those who] suggested imprisonment, and among them [were those who] suggested exile.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ اجْتمع رَأْيهمْ على الْقَتْل
segments.english: Then their opinion united on killing [him].

segments.arabic: فجَاء الْبَرِيد بالْخبر من السَّمَاء وَأمره أَن يُفَارق المضجع
segments.english: So the message came with the news from the sky, and [God] commanded him to leave [his] bed.

segments.arabic: فَبَاتَ عَليّ مَكَانَهُ ونهض الصِّدِّيق لرفقة السّفر
segments.english: So Ali spent the night in his place, and al-Siddiq rose for the companionship of the journey.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا فارقا بيُوت مَكَّة اشْتَدَّ الحذر بالصدّيق
segments.english: And when they [both] left the houses of Mecca, caution grew strong in al-Siddiq.

segments.arabic: فَجعل يذكر الرصد فيسير أَمَامه
segments.english: So he would think of [those] watching ahead and walk in front of him,

segments.arabic: وَتارَة يذكر الطّلب فَيتَأَخَّر وَرَاءه
segments.english: and sometimes he would think of [those] pursuing, so he would fall back behind him,

segments.arabic: وَتارَة عَن يَمِينه وَتارَة عَن شِمَاله
segments.english: and sometimes [he would walk] to his right, and sometimes to his left,

segments.arabic: إِلَى أَن انتهيا إِلَى الْغَار
segments.english: until they reached the cave.

segments.arabic: فَبَدَأَ الصدّيق بِدُخُولِهِ ليَكُون وقاية لَهُ إِن كَانَ ثَمَّ موذ
segments.english: So al-Siddiq began by entering it, to be [a] shield for him in case there was [something] harmful there.

segments.arabic: وَأنْبت الله شَجَرَة لم تكن قبل
segments.english: And God grew [a] tree that had not been [there] before,

segments.arabic: فأظلّت الْمَطْلُوب وأضلّت الطَّالِب
segments.english: so it shaded the one sought and misled the seeker.

segments.arabic: وَجَاءَت عنكبوت فحازت وَجه الْغَار
segments.english: And [a] spider came and took over the face of the cave,

segments.arabic: فحاكت ثوب نسجها على منوال السّتْر
segments.english: and wove the garment of its web on the loom of concealment.

segments.arabic: فأحكمت الشقة حَتَّى عمي على الْقَائِف الْمطلب
segments.english: So it sealed the covering until the search was hidden from the tracker.

segments.arabic: وَأرْسل حَمَامَتَيْنِ فاتخذتا هُنَاكَ عشا جعل
segments.english: And [God] sent two doves, and they made [a] nest there —

segments.arabic: على أبصار الطالبين غشاوة
segments.english: upon the eyes of the seekers [was] [a] covering.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا أبلغ فِي الإعجاز من مقاومة الْقَوْم بالجنود
segments.english: And this [is] more powerful in [its] miraculous nature than resisting the people with armies.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا وقف الْقَوْم على رؤوسهم وَصَارَ كَلَامهم بسمع الرَّسُول والصدّيق
segments.english: So when the people stood over their heads, and their speech [was] within hearing of the Messenger and the Truthful One,

segments.arabic: قَالَ الصدّيق وَقد اشْتَدَّ بِهِ القلق
segments.english: the Truthful One said — and worry had overcome him —

segments.arabic: يَا رَسُول الله لَو أَن أحدهم نظر إِلَى مَا تَحت قَدَمَيْهِ لَأَبْصَرنَا تَحت قَدَمَيْهِ
segments.english: "O Messenger of God, if one of them looked at what [is] beneath his feet, he would see us beneath his feet!"

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ رَسُول الله يَا أَبَا بكر مَا ظَنك بِاثْنَيْنِ الله ثالثهما
segments.english: So the Messenger of God said, "O Abu Bakr, what do you think of two [whose] third [is] God?"

segments.arabic: لما رأى الرَّسُول حزنه قد اشْتَدَّ لاكن على نَفسه قوي قلبه بِبِشَارَة
segments.english: When the Messenger saw that his grief had grown strong — but [it was grief] over him, not himself — [he] strengthened his heart with [a] glad tiding:

segments.arabic: ﴿لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعنا﴾
segments.english: "Do not grieve; indeed God [is] with us."
segments.sahih_international: If you do not aid the Prophet - Allah has already aided him when those who disbelieved had driven him out [of Makkah] as one of two, when they were in the cave and he said to his companion, "Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us." And Allah sent down his tranquillity upon him and supported him with angels you did not see and made the word of those who disbelieved the lowest, while the word of Allah - that is the highest. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.

segments.arabic: فَظهر سر هَذَا الاقتران فِي الْمَعِيَّة لفظا كَمَا ظهر حكما وَمعنى
segments.english: So the secret of this pairing appeared in [the word] "with us" — in wording, just as it appeared in ruling and meaning.

segments.arabic: اذا يُقَال رَسُول الله وَصَاحب رَسُول الله
segments.english: For [it was] said: "the Messenger of God" and "the Companion of the Messenger of God."

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا مَاتَ قيل خَليفَة رَسُول الله
segments.english: And when [he] died, [it was] said: "the Successor of the Messenger of God."

segments.arabic: ثمَّ انْقَطَعت إِضَافَة الْخلَافَة بِمَوْتِهِ فَقيل أَمِير الْمُؤمنِينَ
segments.english: Then the linking of the succession [to the Messenger] ended with his death, and [it was] said [instead]: "Commander of the Believers."

segments.arabic: فأقاما فِي الْغَار ثَلَاثًا ثمَّ خرجا مِنْهُ
segments.english: So the two of them stayed in the cave [for] three [nights], then they left it.

segments.arabic: ولسان الْقدر يَقُول لتدخلنها دُخُولا لم يدْخلهُ أحد قبلك وَلَا يَنْبَغِي لأحد من بعْدك
segments.english: And the tongue of destiny [was] saying: "You will surely enter it with an entering that no one entered before you, and [it is] not fitting for anyone after you."

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا استقلا على الْبَيْدَاء لحقهما سراقَة بن مَالك
segments.english: So when the two of them set out upon the open desert, Suraqah ibn Malik caught up with them.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا شَارف الظفر أرسل عَلَيْهِ الرَّسُول سَهْما من سِهَام الدُّعَاء
segments.english: And when he neared victory, the Messenger sent upon him an arrow from the arrows of supplication.

segments.arabic: فساخت قَوَائِم فرسه فِي الأَرْض إِلَى بَطنهَا
segments.english: So the legs of his horse sank into the ground up to its belly.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا علم أَنه لَا سَبِيل لَهُ عَلَيْهِمَا أَخذ يعرض المَال على من قد رد مَفَاتِيح الْكُنُوز
segments.english: So when he knew that he had no way [to reach] them, he began offering wealth to the one who had [already] turned back the keys of [all] treasures,

segments.arabic: وَيقدم الزَّاد إِلَى شبعان أَبيت عِنْد رَبِّي يطعمني ويسقيني
segments.english: and presenting provisions to one [who was] full — "I spend the night with my Lord; He feeds me and gives me drink."

segments.arabic: كَانَ تحفة ثَانِي اثْنَيْنِ مدخرة للصديق دون الْجَمِيع
segments.english: [The honor of being] the second of two [was] a gift stored for the Truthful One, apart from everyone else.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ الثَّانِي فِي الْإِسْلَام وَفِي بذل النَّفس وَفِي الزّهْد وَفِي الصُّحْبَة وَفِي الْخلَافَة وَفِي الْعُمر وَفِي سَبَب الْمَوْت
segments.english: So he [was] the second in Islam, and in sacrificing [his] self, and in detachment [from this world], and in companionship, and in succession, and in age, and in the cause of death —

segments.arabic: لِأَن الرَّسُول مَاتَ عَن أثر السم وَأَبُو بكر سم فَمَاتَ
segments.english: because the Messenger died from the effect of poison, and Abu Bakr [was] poisoned and died.

segments.arabic: أسلم على يَدَيْهِ من الْعشْرَة عُثْمَان وَطَلْحَة وَالزُّبَيْر وَعبد الرَّحْمَن بن عَوْف وَسعد بن أبي وقّاص
segments.english: [Those who] accepted Islam at his hands from the Ten [were]: Uthman, Talhah, al-Zubayr, Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, and Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas.

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ عِنْده يَوْم أسلم أَرْبَعُونَ ألف دِرْهَم فأنفقها أحْوج مَا كَانَ الْإِسْلَام إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: And he had on the day he accepted Islam forty thousand dirhams, and he spent them [at the time] when Islam was most in need of them.

segments.arabic: فَلهَذَا اجلبت نَفَقَته عَلَيْهِ مَا نَفَعَنِي مَال مَا نَفَعَنِي مَال أبي بكر
segments.english: And for this reason his spending earned [for] him: "No wealth has benefited me as the wealth of Abu Bakr has benefited me."

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ خير من مُؤمن آل فِرْعَوْن لِأَن ذَلِك كَانَ يكتم إيمَانه والصدّيق أعلن بِهِ
segments.english: So he [is] better than the believer of the family of Pharaoh, because that one used to hide his faith, while the Truthful One declared it openly.

segments.arabic: وَخير من مُؤمن آل ياسين لِأَن ذَلِك جَاهد سَاعَة وَالصديق جَاهد سِنِين
segments.english: And [he is] better than the believer of the people of Yasin, because that one struggled [for] an hour, while the Truthful One struggled [for] years.

segments.arabic: عاين طَائِر الْفَاقَة يحوم حول حب الإيثار
segments.english: He watched the bird of neediness circling around the grain of selflessness,

segments.arabic: ويصيح من ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حسنا
segments.english: and [it was] crying out: "Who [is] the one who [will] lend God [a] good loan?"

segments.arabic: فَألْقى لَهُ حب المَال على روض الرِّضَا واستلقى على فرَاش الْفقر
segments.english: So he cast for it the grain of [his] wealth upon the meadow of contentment, and lay down upon the bed of poverty.

segments.arabic: فَنقل الطَّائِر الْحبّ إِلَى حوصلة المضاعفة ثمَّ علا على أفنان شَجَرَة الصدْق يغرد
segments.english: So the bird carried the grain to the pouch of multiplication, then rose upon the branches of the tree of truthfulness, singing.

segments.arabic: بفنون الْمَدْح
segments.english: with [all] types of praise.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ قَالَ فِي محاريب الْإِسْلَام يَتْلُو
segments.english: Then he said — in the prayer niches of Islam he recites:

segments.arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْأَتْقَى الَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يتزكى
segments.english: And the most God-conscious [will be] kept away from it — the one who gives his wealth to purify [himself].
segments.sahih_international: But the righteous one will avoid it -

segments.arabic: نطقت بفضله الْآيَات وَالْأَخْبَار
segments.english: The verses and the reports [have] spoken of his merit,

segments.arabic: وَاجْتمعَ على بيعَته الْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَالْأَنْصَار
segments.english: and the Emigrants and the Helpers gathered upon his pledge of allegiance.

segments.arabic: فيا مبغضيه فِي قُلُوبكُمْ من ذكره نَار
segments.english: O you who hate him — in your hearts from his mention [there is a] fire!

segments.arabic: كلما تليت فضائله علا عَلَيْهِم الصغار
segments.english: Whenever his virtues [are] recited, humiliation rises over them.

segments.arabic: أَتَرَى لم يسمع الروافض الكفّار
segments.english: Do you think the disbelieving Rafidites [have] not heard:

segments.arabic: ثَانِيَ اثْنَيْنِ إِذْ هُمَا فِي الْغَار
segments.english: the second of two, when they were both in the cave?
