segments.sahih_international: If you do not aid the Prophet - Allah has already aided him when those who disbelieved had driven him out [of Makkah] as one of two, when they were in the cave and he said to his companion, "Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us." And Allah sent down his tranquillity upon him and supported him with angels you did not see and made the word of those who disbelieved the lowest, while the word of Allah - that is the highest. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.

segments.arabic: دعِي إِلَى الْإِسْلَام فَمَا تلعثم وَلَا أَبى
segments.english: He [was] called to Islam and he did not hesitate nor refuse,

segments.arabic: وَسَار على المحجة فَمَا زل وَلَا كبا
segments.english: and he walked upon the clear path and did not slip nor stumble,

segments.arabic: وصبر فِي مدَّته من مدى العدى على وَقع الشبا
segments.english: and he endured during his time, against the reach of the enemies, the strike of blades,

segments.arabic: وَأكْثر فِي الْإِنْفَاق فَمَا قلل حَتَّى تخَلّل بالعبا
segments.english: and he spent generously and did not hold back, until he wore [only a] cloak.

segments.arabic: تالله لقد زَاد على السبك فِي كل دِينَار دِينَار
segments.english: By God, he added to the mold — for every gold coin, [another] gold coin!

segments.arabic: ثَانِيَ اثْنَيْنِ إِذْ هُمَا فِي الْغَار
segments.english: The second of two, when they were both in the cave.

segments.arabic: من كَانَ قرين النَّبِي فِي شبابه
segments.english: Who was the companion of the Prophet in his youth?

segments.arabic: من ذَا الَّذِي سبق إِلَى الْإِيمَان من أَصْحَابه
segments.english: Who [is] the one that was first to faith among his Companions?

segments.arabic: من الَّذِي أفتى بِحَضْرَتِهِ سَرِيعا فِي جَوَابه
segments.english: Who [is] the one that gave rulings in his presence, quick in his answers?

segments.arabic: من أوّل من صلى مَعَه
segments.english: Who [was] the first to pray with him?

segments.arabic: من آخر من صلّى بِهِ
segments.english: Who [was] the last to lead prayer for him?

segments.arabic: من الَّذِي ضاجعه بعد الْمَوْت فِي ترابه
segments.english: Who [is] the one that lay beside him after death in his soil?

segments.arabic: فاعرفوا حق الْجَار
segments.english: So know the right of the neighbor!

segments.arabic: نَهَضَ يَوْم الرِّدَّة بفهم واستيقاظ
segments.english: He rose on the Day of Apostasy with understanding and alertness,

segments.arabic: وَأَبَان من نَص الْكتاب معنى دق عَن حَدِيد الإلحاظ
segments.english: and he made clear from the text of the Book [a] meaning [that was] too subtle for the sharpest gazes.

segments.arabic: فالمحب يفرح بفضائله والمبغض يغتاظ
segments.english: So the lover rejoices at his virtues, and the hater [is] enraged.

segments.arabic: حسرة الرافضي أَن يفر من مجْلِس ذكره وَلَكِن أَيْن الْفِرَار
segments.english: The anguish of the Rafidite [is] that he [wants to] flee from the gathering of his mention — but where [is] the escape?

segments.arabic: كم وقى الرَّسُول بِالْمَالِ وَالنَّفس
segments.english: How much he shielded the Messenger with [his] wealth and [his] self!

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ أخص بِهِ فِي حَيَاته وَهُوَ ضجيعه فِي الرمس
segments.english: And he was the closest to him in his life, and he [is] his companion in the grave.

segments.arabic: فضائله جليلة وَهِي خليّة عَن اللّبْس
segments.english: His virtues [are] great, and they [are] free from doubt.

segments.arabic: ياعجبا من يُغطي عين ضوء الشَّمْس فِي نصف النَّهَار
segments.english: How strange [is] the one who covers the very light of the sun at midday!

segments.arabic: لقد دخلا غارا لَا يسكنهُ لابث
segments.english: They both entered [a] cave that no one dwelt in,

segments.arabic: فاستوحش الصّديق من خوف الْحَوَادِث
segments.english: and al-Siddiq felt uneasy out of fear of [what might] happen.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ الرَّسُول مَا ظَنك بِاثْنَيْنِ وَالله الثَّالِث
segments.english: So the Messenger said: "What do you think of two, [when] God [is] the third?"

segments.arabic: فَنزلت السكينَة فارتفع خوف الْحَادِث
segments.english: So the tranquility descended, and the fear of [what might] happen was lifted,

segments.arabic: فَزَالَ القلق وطاب عَيْش الماكث
segments.english: and the worry vanished, and the life of the one staying [there] became pleasant.

segments.arabic: فَقَامَ مُؤذن النَّصْر يُنَادي على رُؤُوس منائر الْأَمْصَار
segments.english: Then the caller of victory rose, calling out from atop the minarets of the cities:

segments.arabic: ثَانِيَ اثْنَيْنِ إِذْ هُمَا فِي الْغَار
segments.english: The second of two, when they were both in the cave!

segments.arabic: حبه وَالله رَأس الحنيفة
segments.english: Love of him — by God — [is] the head of the true religion,

segments.arabic: وبغضه يدل على خبث الطوية
segments.english: and hatred of him points to [a] corrupt inner [nature].

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ خير الصَّحَابَة والقرابة وَالْحجّة على ذَلِك قَوِيَّة
segments.english: For he [is] the best of the Companions and the relatives, and the proof for that [is] strong.

segments.arabic: لَوْلَا صِحَة مامته مَا قيل ابْن الحنيفة
segments.english: Were it not for the soundness of his leadership, he would not [have been] called Ibn al-Hanifiyyah.

segments.arabic: مهلا فَأن ذمّ الروافض قد فار
segments.english: Hold on — for the blame of the Rafidites [has] boiled over!

segments.arabic: وَالله مَا أحببناه لهوانا
segments.english: By God, we did not love him out of [our own] desire,

segments.arabic: وَلَا نعتقد فِي غَيره هوانا
segments.english: nor do we believe in other than him out of [our own] desire,

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن أَخذنَا بقول عَليّ وكفانا
segments.english: but we took [it] from the word of Ali, and that sufficed us:

segments.arabic: رضيك رَسُول الله لديننا أَفلا نرضاك لدنيانا
segments.english: "The Messenger of God was pleased with you for our religion — shall we not [then] be pleased with you for our worldly life?"

segments.arabic: تالله لقد أخذت من الروافض بالثأر
segments.english: By God, you [have] taken revenge against the Rafidites!

headings.arabic: تَنْبِيه
headings.english: Notice

headings.arabic: تَنْبِيه
headings.english: Notice

segments.arabic: تالله لقد وَجب حق الصدّيق علينا
segments.english: By God, the right of al-Siddiq [has] become obligated upon us,

segments.arabic: فَنحْن نقضي بمدائحه وَنَفر بِمَا نقر بِهِ من السنى عينا
segments.english: so we fulfill [our duty] with his praises, and we delight — in what we acknowledge of [his] radiance — [in] eye.

segments.arabic: فَمن كَانَ رَافِضِيًّا فَلَا يعد إِلَيْنَا
segments.english: So whoever was a Rafidi, let him not return to us,

segments.arabic: وَليقل لي أعذار
segments.english: and let him say to me [his] excuses.

segments.arabic: اجْتنب من يعادي أهل الْكتاب وَالسّنة لِئَلَّا يعديك خسرانه
segments.english: Avoid whoever opposes the people of the Book and the Sunnah, lest his loss infect you.

segments.arabic: احْتَرز من عدوين هلك بهما أَكثر الْخلق
segments.english: Beware of two enemies through whom most of creation perished:

segments.arabic: صادّ عَن سَبِيل الله بشبهاته وزخرف قَوْله
segments.english: [one who] blocks [people] from the path of God with his doubts and the decoration of his speech,

segments.arabic: ومفتون بدنياه ورئاسته
segments.english: and [one who is] tempted by his worldly life and his leadership.

segments.arabic: من خلق فِيهِ قُوَّة واستعداد لشَيْء كَانَت لذته فِي اسْتِعْمَال تِلْكَ الْقُوَّة فِيهِ
segments.english: Whoever was created with [a] strength and readiness for [a] thing, his pleasure [is] in using that strength in it.

segments.arabic: فلذة من خلقت مِنْهُ قُوَّة واستعداد للجماع اسْتِعْمَال قوته فِيهِ
segments.english: So the pleasure of whoever was created with [a] strength and readiness for intercourse [is] using his strength in it.

segments.arabic: ولذة من خلقت فِيهِ قُوَّة الْغَضَب وَالثَّوَاب بِاسْتِعْمَال قوته الغضبية فِي متعلقها
segments.english: And the pleasure of whoever was created with [a] strength of anger and aggression [is] in using his angry strength in its object.

segments.arabic: وَمن خلقت فِيهِ قُوَّة الْأكل وَالشرب فلذته بِاسْتِعْمَال قوته فيهمَا
segments.english: And whoever was created with [a] strength for eating and drinking, his pleasure [is] in using his strength in them both.

segments.arabic: وَمن خلقت فِيهِ قُوَّة الْعلم والمعرفة فلذته بِاسْتِعْمَال قوته وصرفها إِلَى الْعلم
segments.english: And whoever was created with [a] strength for knowledge and understanding, his pleasure [is] in using his strength and directing it toward knowledge.

segments.arabic: وَمن خلقت فِيهِ قُوَّة الْحبّ لله والإنابة إِلَيْهِ والعكوف بِالْقَلْبِ عَلَيْهِ والشوق إِلَيْهِ والأنس بِهِ
segments.english: And whoever was created with [a] strength of love for God, and turning back to Him, and devotion of the heart to Him, and longing for Him, and closeness with Him —

segments.arabic: فلذته ونعيمه اسْتِعْمَال هَذِه الْقُوَّة فِي ذَلِك
segments.english: his pleasure and his bliss [are in] using this strength in that.

segments.arabic: وَسَائِر اللَّذَّات دون هَذِه اللَّذَّة مضمحلة فانية
segments.english: And all [other] pleasures besides this pleasure [are] fading [and] passing away.

segments.arabic: وَأحمد عَاقبَتهَا أَن تكون لَا لَهُ وَلَا عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And the best outcome of them [is] that they [are] neither for him nor against him.

segments.arabic: يَا أَيهَا الأعزل احذر فراسة المتقى
segments.english: O defenseless one, beware [of] the insight of the God-conscious person,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ يرى عَورَة عَمَلك من وَرَاء ستر
segments.english: for he sees the flaw of your deed from behind [a] veil.

segments.arabic: اتَّقوا فراسة الْمُؤمن
segments.english: Fear the insight of the believer.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الله فِي النَّفس كِبر إِبْلِيس وحسد قابيل
segments.english: Glory [be] to God! In the self [is] the arrogance of Iblis, and the envy of Cain,

segments.arabic: وعتو عَاد وطغيان ثَمُود وجرأة نمْرُود
segments.english: and the defiance of 'Ad, and the tyranny of Thamud, and the boldness of Nimrod,

segments.arabic: واستطالة فِرْعَوْن وبغي قَارون وقحّة هامان
segments.english: and the overbearing of Pharaoh, and the transgression of Qarun, and the shamelessness of Haman.

segments.arabic: وَهوى بلعام وحيل أَصْحَاب السبت وتمرد الوليد وَجَهل أبي جهل
segments.english: and the desire of Balaam, and the tricks of the people of the Sabbath, and the rebellion of al-Walid, and the ignorance of Abu Jahl.

segments.arabic: وفيهَا من أَخْلَاق الْبَهَائِم حرص الْغُرَاب وشره الْكَلْب ورعونة الطاووس ودناءة الْجعل
segments.english: And in it, from the traits of animals: the greed of the crow, the gluttony of the dog, the vanity of the peacock, and the lowliness of the dung beetle,

segments.arabic: وعقوق الضَّب وحقد الْجمل ووثوب الفهد وصولة الْأسد
segments.english: and the disobedience of the lizard, and the grudge of the camel, and the pouncing of the leopard, and the attack of the lion,

segments.arabic: وَفسق الْفَأْرَة وخبث الْحَيَّة وعبث القرد وَجمع النملة
segments.english: and the wickedness of the mouse, and the venom of the snake, and the mischief of the monkey, and the hoarding of the ant,

segments.arabic: ومكر الثَّعْلَب وخفة الْفراش ونوم الضبع
segments.english: and the cunning of the fox, and the flightiness of the moth, and the sleep of the hyena.

segments.arabic: غير أَن الرياضة والمجاهدة تذْهب ذَلِك
segments.english: However, discipline and striving remove all of that.

segments.arabic: فَمن استرسل مَعَ طبعه فَهُوَ من هَذَا الْجند
segments.english: So whoever gives in to his nature, then he [is] from this army,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تصلح سلْعَته لعقد
segments.english: and his goods [are] not fit for the contract of:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ اشْتَرَى مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾
segments.english: "Indeed God has purchased from the believers their selves."
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, Allah has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties [in exchange] for that they will have Paradise. They fight in the cause of Allah, so they kill and are killed. [It is] a true promise [binding] upon Him in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur'an. And who is truer to his covenant than Allah? So rejoice in your transaction which you have contracted. And it is that which is the great attainment.

segments.arabic: فَمَا اشْترى إِلَّا سلْعَة هذبها الْإِيمَان
segments.english: He only purchased goods that faith had refined,

segments.arabic: فَخرجت من طبعها إِلَى بلد سكانه التائبون العابدون
segments.english: so they came out from their [raw] nature to [a] land whose inhabitants [are] the repentant, the worshippers.

segments.arabic: سلم الْمَبِيع قبل أَن يتْلف فِي يدك فَلَا يقبله المُشْتَرِي
segments.english: Hand over what [was] sold before it perishes in your hand, for [then] the Buyer [will] not accept it.

segments.arabic: قد علم المُشْتَرِي بِعَيْب السّلْعَة قبل أَن يَشْتَرِيهَا
segments.english: The Buyer already knew of the defect of the goods before He purchased them,

segments.arabic: فسلمها وَلَك الْأمان من الرَّد
segments.english: so hand them over, and you [will] have safety from return.

segments.arabic: قدر السّلْعَة يعرف بِقدر مشتريها وَالثمن المبذول فِيهِ والمنادي عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: The value of the goods [is] known by the worth of their buyer, and the price paid for them, and the one calling out over them.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَ الْمُشْتَرى عَظِيما وَالثمن خطيرا والمنادي جَلِيلًا كَانَت السّلْعَة نفيسة
segments.english: So if the buyer [was] great, and the price [was] immense, and the caller [was] majestic, then the goods [were] precious.

segments.arabic: يَا بَائِعا نَفسه بيع الهوان
segments.english: O seller of his self [for] the sale of humiliation —

segments.arabic: لَو استرجعت ذَا البيع قبل الْفَوْت لم تخب
segments.english: if you took back this sale before [it is] too late, you would not lose.

segments.arabic: وبائعا طيب عَيْش مَا لَهُ خطر
segments.english: And [O] seller of [a] good life whose worth has no equal —

segments.arabic: بطيف عَيْش من الآلام منتهب
segments.english: for [a] phantom of [a] life, seized by pains.

segments.arabic: غبنت وَالله غبنا فَاحِشا
segments.english: You were cheated, by God, [a] terrible cheating —

segments.arabic: ولدى يَوْم التغابن تلقى غَايَة الْحَرْب
segments.english: and on the Day of Mutual Loss you [will] meet the peak of struggle.

segments.arabic: وواردا صفو عَيْش كُله كدر
segments.english: And [O] one approaching the clearness of [a] life [that is] all murky —

segments.arabic: أمامك الْورْد حَقًا لَيْسَ بِالْكَذِبِ
segments.english: before you [is] the arrival truly, not [a] lie.

segments.arabic: وحاطب اللَّيْل فِي الظلماء منتصبا
segments.english: And [O] gatherer of firewood at night, standing in the darkness —

segments.arabic: لكل داهية تدني من العطب
segments.english: for every disaster that brings [you] near to ruin.

segments.arabic: ترجوا الشِّفَاء بأحداق بهَا مرض
segments.english: You hope for healing through eyes that have sickness —

segments.arabic: فَهَل سَمِعت ببرء جَاءَ من عطب
segments.english: have you [ever] heard of [a] cure that came from ruin?

segments.arabic: ومفنيا نَفسه فِي أثر أقبحهم
segments.english: And [O] one wasting his self in pursuit of the ugliest of them —

segments.arabic: وصفه اللطخ جمال فِيهِ مستلب
segments.english: whose quality [is] blemish, beauty in him [is] stolen away.

segments.arabic: وواهبا نَفسه من مثل ذَا سفها
segments.english: And [O] one giving his self to the likes of this [out of] foolishness —

segments.arabic: لَو كنت تعرف قدر النَّفس لم تهب
segments.english: if you knew the worth of the self, you would not give [it away].

segments.arabic: شَاب الصِّبَا والتصابي لم يشب
segments.english: Youth has grown gray, yet acting youthful has not aged —

segments.arabic: وَضاع وقتك بَين اللَّهْو واللعب
segments.english: and your time [was] wasted between amusement and play.

segments.arabic: وشمس عمرك قد حَان الْغُرُوب لَهَا
segments.english: And the sun of your life — its setting has come due —

segments.arabic: والفيء فِي الْأُفق الشَّرْقِي لم يغب
segments.english: yet the shadow on the eastern horizon has not faded.

segments.arabic: وفاز بالوصل من قد جدوا انقشعت ... عَن أفقه ظلمات اللَّيْل والسحب
segments.english: And [those] who strived won the union — [there] cleared away ... from his horizon the darknesses of the night and the clouds

segments.arabic: كم ذَا التَّخَلُّف وَالدُّنْيَا قد ارتحلت ... ورسل رَبك قد وافتك فِي الطّلب
segments.english: How long [will] this falling behind [last] while this world has departed ... and the messengers of your Lord have come to you in the pursuit?

segments.arabic: مَا فِي الديار وَقد سَارَتْ ركائب من ... تهواه للصب من شكر وَلَا أرب
segments.english: There [is] nothing in the dwellings — and the caravans of the one ... you love have departed — for the longing one, no gratitude and no desire

segments.arabic: فافرش الخد ذياك التُّرَاب وَقل ... مَا قَالَه صَاحب الأشواق والحقب
segments.english: So spread [your] cheek on that dust, and say ... what the companion of longings and ages said:

segments.arabic: مَا ربع مية محفوفا يطِيف بِهِ ... غيلَان أشهى لَهُ من ربعك الخرب
segments.english: The abode of Mayya, surrounded, with Ghaylan circling it ... [is] not more desirable to him than your ruined abode

segments.arabic: منازلا كَانَ يهواها ويألفها ... أَيَّام كَانَ منال الْوَصْل عَن كثب
segments.english: Dwellings he used to love and feel at home in ... [in] the days when attaining union [was] within reach

segments.arabic: وَلَا الخدود وَلَو أدمين من ضرج ... أشهى إِلَى ناظري من ربعك الخرب
segments.english: Nor [are] the cheeks, even if reddened with blush ... more desirable to my eyes than your ruined abode

segments.arabic: وَكلما جليت تِلْكَ الربوع لَهُ ... يهوى إِلَيْهَا هوى المَاء فِي الصبب
segments.english: And whenever those grounds [are] revealed to him ... he falls toward them [like] the falling of water on [a] slope

segments.arabic: أحيي لَهُ الشوق تذكار العهود بهَا ... فَلَو دعِي الْقلب للسلوان لم يجب
segments.english: The remembrance of the times there revived longing in him ... and if the heart [were] called to consolation, it would not answer

segments.arabic: هَذَا وَكم منزل فِي الأَرْض يألفه ... وَمَاله فِي سواهَا الدَّهْر من رغب
segments.english: This — and how many [a] dwelling in the earth he feels at home in ... while he has no desire ever in anything other than it

segments.arabic: مَا فِي الْخيام أَخُو وجدير يحك إِن ... بثثته بعض شَأْن الْحبّ فاغترب
segments.english: There [is] not in the tents [a] brother of deep feeling who [would be] moved if ... you confided to him some of the affair of love — so go far away

segments.arabic: وَأسر فِي غَمَرَات اللَّيْل متهديا ... بنفحة الطّيب لَا بِالْعودِ والحطب
segments.english: And travel in the depths of the night, guided ... by the breeze of fragrance, not by the [fire]wood and firewood

segments.arabic: وَعَاد كل أخي جبن ومعجزة ... وَحَارب النَّفس لَا تلقيك فِي الْحَرْب
segments.english: And oppose every brother of cowardice and weakness ... and fight the self — do not let it meet you in battle

segments.arabic: وَخذ لنَفسك نورا تستضيء بِهِ ... يَوْم اقتسام الورى الْأَنْوَار بالرتب
segments.english: And take for yourself [a] light to illuminate [your way] by ... [on] the day people divide the lights by ranks

segments.arabic: إِن كَانَ يُوجب صبري رَحْمَتي فرضا ... بِسوء حَالي وَحل للضنا بدني
segments.english: If my patience necessitates Your mercy — then [I am] content ... with the bad state of my condition, and illness has settled in my body

segments.arabic: منحتك الرّوح لَا أبغي لَهَا ثمنا ... إِلَّا رضاك ووافقري الا الثّمن
segments.english: I granted You the soul, not seeking for it [a] price ... except Your pleasure — and how generous [is] that price!

segments.arabic: أحن بأطراف النَّهَار صبَابَة ... وبالليل يدعوني الْهوى فَأُجِيب
segments.english: I yearn at the edges of the day [out of] longing ... and at night, love calls me and I answer

segments.arabic: وَإِذا لم يكن من الْعِشْق بُد ... فَمن عجز عشق غير الْجَمِيل
segments.english: And if there [is] no escape from passionate love ... then [it is] from weakness to love other than the Beautiful

segments.arabic: فَلَو أَن مَا أسعى لعيش معجل ... كفاني مِنْهُ بعض مَا أَنا فِيهِ
segments.english: If what I strive for [were] [a] hastened life... some of what I [am already] in would have sufficed me of it

segments.arabic: ولكنما أسمى لملك مخلد ... فوا أسفا إِن لم أكن بملاقيه
segments.english: But rather I aspire to [an] eternal kingdom... so what grief if I [am] not to meet it!

segments.arabic: يَا من هُوَ من أَرْبَاب الْخِبْرَة هَل عرفت قيمَة نَفسك
segments.english: O you who [are] among the people of experience — have you known the value of yourself?

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا خلقت الأكوان كلهَا لَك
segments.english: The worlds were all only created for you.

segments.arabic: يَا من غذى بلبان الْبر وقلب بأيدي الألطاف
segments.english: O you who [was] nourished with the milk of goodness and turned over by the hands of [divine] kindness!

segments.arabic: كل الْأَشْيَاء شَجَرَة وَأَنت الثَّمَرَة
segments.english: Everything [is a] tree, and you [are] the fruit.

segments.arabic: وَصُورَة وَأَنت الْمَعْنى
segments.english: And [a] form, and you [are] the meaning.

segments.arabic: وصدف وَأَنت الدّرّ
segments.english: And [a] shell, and you [are] the pearl.

segments.arabic: ومخيض وَأَنت الزّبد
segments.english: And [a] churn, and you [are] the butter.

segments.arabic: منشور اختيارنا لَك وَاضح الْخط وَلَكِن استخراجك ضَعِيف
segments.english: The decree of Our choosing you [is] clear [in its] writing, but your drawing [it] out [is] weak.

segments.arabic: مَتى رمت طلبي فاطلبني عنْدك
segments.english: Whenever you seek to find Me, then seek Me within yourself.

segments.arabic: اطلبني مِنْك تجدني قَرِيبا وَلَا تطلبني من غَيْرك فَأَنا أقرب إِلَيْك مِنْهُ
segments.english: Seek Me from yourself [and] you [will] find Me near, and do not seek Me from other than yourself, for I [am] closer to you than he [is].

segments.arabic: لَو عرفت قدر نَفسك عندنَا مَا أهنتها بِالْمَعَاصِي
segments.english: If you knew the worth of yourself with Us, you would not have humiliated it with sins.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا أبعدنا إِبْلِيس إِذْ لم يسْجد لَك وَأَنت فِي صلب أَبِيك
segments.english: We only cast away Iblis because he did not prostrate to you — while you [were still] in the backbone of your father.

segments.arabic: فوا عجبا كَيفَ صالحته وَتَرَكتنَا
segments.english: So how strange — how [did] you make peace with him and leave Us!

segments.arabic: لَو كَانَ فِي قَلْبك محبَّة لبان أَثَرهَا على جسدك
segments.english: If there were love in your heart, its effect would have shown on your body.

segments.arabic: وَلما ادعيت الْحبّ قَالَت كذبتي ... أَلَسْت أرى الْأَعْضَاء مِنْك كواسيا
segments.english: And when I claimed love, she said: 'You lie! Do I not see your limbs [are] well-clothed?'

segments.arabic: لَو تغذى الْقلب بالمحبة لذهبت عَنهُ بطنة الشَّهَوَات
segments.english: If the heart were nourished with love, the bloating of desires would have left it.

segments.arabic: وَلَو كنت عُذْري الصبابة لم تكن ... بطينا وأنساك الْهوى كَثْرَة الْأكل
segments.english: And if you were pure in longing, you would not have been stuffed — and excessive eating [has] made you forget desire.

segments.arabic: لَو صحّت محبتك لاستوحشت مِمَّن لَا يذكرك بالحبيب
segments.english: If your love were true, you would feel uneasy with whoever does not remind you of the Beloved.

segments.arabic: وَاعجَبا لمن يَدعِي الْمحبَّة وَيحْتَاج إِلَى من يذكرهُ بمحبوبه
segments.english: And how strange [is] the one who claims love yet needs someone to remind him of his beloved!

segments.arabic: فَلَا يذكرهُ إِلَّا بمذكر
segments.english: So he does not remember Him except with [a] reminder.

segments.arabic: أقل مَا فِي الْمحبَّة أَنَّهَا لَا تنسيك تذكر المحبوب
segments.english: The least [thing] in love [is] that it does not make you forget to remember the beloved.

segments.arabic: ذكرتك لَا أَنِّي نستك سَاعَة ... وأيسر مَا فِي الذّكر ذكر لساني
segments.english: I mentioned you — not that I forgot you [for a] moment... and the easiest [thing] in remembrance [is] the mention of my tongue.

segments.arabic: إِذا سَافر الْمُحب للقاء محبوبه ركبت جُنُوده مَعَه
segments.english: When the lover travels to meet his beloved, his soldiers ride with him.

segments.arabic: فَكَانَ الْحبّ فِي مُقَدّمَة الْعَسْكَر
segments.english: And love [was] at the front of the army,

segments.arabic: والرجاء يَحْدُو بالمطى والشوق يَسُوقهَا
segments.english: and hope [was] driving the camels, and longing [was] pushing them forward,

segments.arabic: وَالْخَوْف يجمعها على الطَّرِيق
segments.english: and fear [was] keeping them together on the road.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا شَارف قدوم بلد الْوَصْل خرجت تقادم الحبيب باللقاء
segments.english: And when he neared arrival at the land of union, the gifts of the Beloved came out with the meeting.

segments.arabic: فداو سقما بجسم أَنْت متلفه ... وأبرد غراما بقلب أَنْت مضرمه
segments.english: So heal [a] sickness in [a] body that You [are] destroying... and cool [a] passion in [a] heart that You [are] setting ablaze.

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَكِلنِي على بعد الديار إِلَى ... صبري الضَّعِيف فصبري أَنْت تعلمه
segments.english: And do not leave me, with the distance of homes, to... my weak patience, for my patience — You know it.

segments.arabic: تلقى قلبه فقد أَرْسلتهُ عجلا ... إِلَى لقائك والأشواق تقدمه
segments.english: Receive his heart, for I have sent it in haste... to meet you, and the longings go before it.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا دخل على الحبيب أفيضت عَلَيْهِ الْخلْع من كل نَاحيَة
segments.english: So when he entered upon the Beloved, robes of honor [were] poured upon him from every side,

segments.arabic: ليمتحن أيسكن إِلَيْهَا فَتكون حَظه أم يكون التفاته إِلَى من ألبسهُ إِيَّاهَا
segments.english: to test [him] — would he settle with them so they become his portion, or would his attention [be] toward the One who clothed him in them?

segments.arabic: ملأوا مراكب الْقُلُوب مَتَاعا لَا تنْفق إِلَّا على الْملك
segments.english: They filled the ships of the hearts [with] goods that [are] only spent on the King.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا هبت ريَاح السحر أقلعت تِلْكَ المراكب
segments.english: So when the winds of the pre-dawn blew, those ships set sail.

segments.arabic: فَمَا طلع الْفجْر الا وَهِي بالمينا
segments.english: And dawn did not rise except [that] they [were already] at the harbor.

segments.arabic: قطعُوا بادية الْهوى بأقدام الْجد
segments.english: They crossed the desert of desire with the feet of seriousness.

segments.arabic: فَمَا كَانَ إِلَّا الْقَلِيل حَتَّى قدمُوا من السّفر
segments.english: And it was only [a] little [while] until they arrived from the journey.

segments.arabic: فأعقبهم الرَّاحَة فِي طَرِيق التلقي
segments.english: And [it] brought them rest on the path of meeting.

segments.arabic: فَدَخَلُوا بلد الْوَصْل وَقد حَاز ربح الْأَبَد
segments.english: So they entered the land of union, having gained the profit of eternity.

segments.arabic: فرّغ الْقَوْم قُلُوبهم من الشواغل
segments.english: The people emptied their hearts of distractions,

segments.arabic: فَضربت فِيهَا سرادقات الْمحبَّة
segments.english: so the pavilions of love [were] pitched in them.

segments.arabic: فأقاموا الْعُيُون تحرس تَارَة وترش أُخْرَى
segments.english: And they set up the eyes — guarding at times and sprinkling [tears] at others.

segments.arabic: سرادق الْمحبَّة لَا يضْرب إِلَّا فِي قاع نزه فارغ
segments.english: The pavilion of love [is] not pitched except in [a] clean, empty ground.

segments.arabic: نزّه فُؤَادك من سوانا والقنا ... فنجنابنا حل لكل منزّه
segments.english: Purify your heart from [all] other than us, and be content... for our vicinity [is a] place for every purified one.

segments.arabic: الصَّبْر طلسم لكنز وصالنا ... من حل ذَا الطلسم فَازَ بكنزه
segments.english: Patience [is the] talisman for the treasure of our union... whoever solved this talisman won its treasure.

segments.arabic: اعرف قدر مَا ضَاعَ مِنْك
segments.english: Know the worth of what [was] lost from you,

segments.arabic: وابك بكاء من يدْرِي مِقْدَار الْفَائِت
segments.english: and weep the weeping of one who knows the measure of what [has] passed.

segments.arabic: لَو تَخَيَّلت قرب الأحباب لأقمت المأتم على بعْدك
segments.english: If you [had] imagined the nearness of the loved ones, you [would have] held [a] funeral over your distance.

segments.arabic: لَو استنشقت ريح الأسحار لأفاق مِنْك قَلْبك المخمور
segments.english: If you [had] breathed in the breeze of the pre-dawns, your intoxicated heart would have awakened.

segments.arabic: من استطال الطَّرِيق ضعف مَشْيه
segments.english: Whoever [found] the path [too] long — his walking weakened.

segments.arabic: وَمَا أَنْت بالمشتاق إِن قلت بَيْننَا ... طوال اللَّيَالِي أَو بعيد المفاوز
segments.english: You [are] not the longing one if you said: between us [are] long nights or distant wilderness.

segments.arabic: أما علمت أَن الصَّادِق إِذا هم ألْقى بَين عَيْنَيْهِ عزمه
segments.english: Did you not know that the truthful one, when he resolves, casts his determination before his eyes?

segments.arabic: إِذا نزل آب فِي الْقلب حل آذار فِي الْعين
segments.english: When the heat of August descends in the heart, the rain of March arrives in the eye.

segments.arabic: هان سهر الحرّاس لما علمُوا أَن أَصْوَاتهم بسمع الْملك
segments.english: The sleeplessness of the guards became easy when they knew that their voices [were] within the hearing of the King.

segments.arabic: من لَاحَ لَهُ حَال الْآخِرَة هان عَلَيْهِ فِرَاق الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: Whoever [saw] the state of the Hereafter appear to him — leaving this world became easy for him.

segments.arabic: إِذا لَاحَ للباشق الصَّيْد نسي مألوف الْكَفّ
segments.english: When the prey appears to the hawk, it forgets the comfort of the hand.

segments.arabic: يَا أَقْدَام الصَّبْر احملي بَقِي الْقَلِيل
segments.english: O feet of patience, carry on — only [a] little remains!

segments.arabic: تذكر حلاوة الْوِصَال يهن عَلَيْك مر المجاهدة
segments.english: Remember the sweetness of union, [and] the bitterness of striving [will] become easy for you.

segments.arabic: قد علمت أَيْن الْمنزل فاحد لَهَا تسر
segments.english: You already know where the destination [is], so drive toward it — you [will] be delighted.

segments.arabic: أَعلَى الهمم همة من استعد صَاحبهَا للقاء الحبيب
segments.english: The highest of ambitions [is the] ambition whose owner prepared for meeting the Beloved.

segments.arabic: قدم التقادم بَين يَدي الْمُلْتَقى فَاسْتَبْشَرَ بِالرِّضَا عِنْد الْقدوم
segments.english: Present the gifts before the meeting place, and receive glad tidings of pleasure upon arrival.

segments.arabic: وَقدمُوا لانفسهم
segments.english: And they sent forth for themselves.

segments.arabic: الْجنَّة ترْضى مِنْك بأَدَاء الْفَرَائِض وَالنَّار تنْدَفع
segments.english: Paradise [is] satisfied from you with [the] performing of the obligations, and the Fire [is] repelled.

headings.arabic: فصل علمت كلبك فهو يترك شهوته في تناول ما صاده احتراما لنعمتك وخوفا
headings.english: Section: You trained your dog, and it leaves its desire to eat what it caught, out of respect for your blessing and fear

segments.arabic: عَنْك بترك الْمعاصِي
segments.english: from you by leaving sins.

segments.arabic: والمحبة لَا تقنع مِنْك إِلَّا ببذل الرّوح
segments.english: And love [is] not satisfied from you except by giving up the soul.

segments.arabic: لله مَا أحلى زمَان تسْعَى فِيهِ أَقْدَام الطَّاعَة على أَرض الاشتياق
segments.english: By God, how sweet [is] a time in which the feet of obedience walk upon the ground of longing!

segments.arabic: لما سلم القوم النُّفُوس إِلَى رائض الشَّرْع
segments.english: When the people handed over [their] souls to the trainer of the Sacred Law,

segments.arabic: علمهَا الْوِفَاق فِي خلاف الطَّبْع
segments.english: he taught them harmony in going against [their] nature.

segments.arabic: فاستقامت مَعَ الطَّاعَة كَيفَ دارت دارت مَعهَا
segments.english: So they became upright with obedience — whichever way it turned, they turned with it.

segments.arabic: وَإِنِّي إِذا اصطكت رِقَاب مطيهم ... وثور حاد بالرفاق عجول
segments.english: And when the necks of their mounts press together... and [a] hasty driver urges the companions on,

segments.arabic: أُخَالِف بَين الراحتين على الحشا ... وَأنْظر أَنِّي ملثم فأميل
segments.english: I press one palm over the other on my chest... and I look [for] where to kiss [their traces], and I lean [toward them].

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Section

segments.arabic: علمت كلبك فَهُوَ يتْرك شَهْوَته فِي تنَاول مَا صَاده احتراما لنعمتك وخوفا من سطوتك
segments.english: You trained your dog, and it leaves its desire to eat what it caught, out of respect for your blessing and fear of your power.

segments.arabic: وَكم علمك معلم الشَّرْع وَأَنت لَا تقبل
segments.english: And how much has the teacher of the Sacred Law taught you, yet you do not accept!

segments.arabic: حرم صيد الْجَاهِل والممسك لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: The hunt of the untrained [dog] and the one that holds [the prey] for itself [is] forbidden.

segments.arabic: فَمَا ظن الْجَاهِل الَّذِي أَعماله لهوى نَفسه
segments.english: So what does the ignorant one think — the one whose deeds [are] for the desire of his self?

segments.arabic: جمع فِيك عقل الْملك وشهوة الْبَهِيمَة وَهوى الشَّيْطَان
segments.english: [God] gathered in you the intellect of the angel, the appetite of the animal, and the desire of the devil.

segments.arabic: وَأَنت للْغَالِب عَلَيْك من الثَّلَاثَة
segments.english: And you belong to whichever of the three overcomes you.

segments.arabic: إِن غلبت شهوتك وهواك زِدْت على مرتبَة ملك
segments.english: If you overcome your appetite and your desire, you rise above the rank of [an] angel.

segments.arabic: وَإِن غلبك هَوَاك وشهوتك نقصت عَن مرتبَة كلب
segments.english: And if your desire and appetite overcome you, you fall below the rank of [a] dog.

segments.arabic: لما صَاد الْكَلْب لرَبه أُبِيح صَيْده وَلما أمسك على نَفسه حرم مَا صَاده
segments.english: When the dog hunted for its master, its catch was made lawful. And when it held [the prey] for itself, what it caught was forbidden.

segments.arabic: مصدر مَا فِي العَبْد من الْخَيْر وَالشَّر وَالصِّفَات الممدوحة والمذمومة من صفة الْمُعْطِي الْمَانِع
segments.english: The source of what [is] in the servant of good and evil, and praiseworthy and blameworthy qualities, [is] from the attribute of the Giver, the Withholder.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يصرّف عباده بَين مُقْتَضى هذَيْن الاسمين
segments.english: For He — glorified [is] He — directs His servants between the demands of these two names.

segments.arabic: فحظ العَبْد الصَّادِق من عبوديته بهما الشُّكْر عِنْد الْعَطاء والافتقار عِنْد الْمَنْع
segments.english: So the share of the truthful servant from his servitude through them [is] gratitude at the time of giving, and neediness at the time of withholding.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يُعْطِيهِ ليشكره ويمنعه ليفتقر إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: For He — glorified [is] He — gives him so that he thanks Him, and withholds from him so that he [shows] need of Him.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يزَال شكُورًا فَقِيرا
segments.english: So he never ceases [to be] grateful [and] needy.

segments.arabic: قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلَى رَبِّهِ ظهيرا
segments.english: And the disbeliever [is] ever against his Lord [a] helper [to his enemies].
segments.sahih_international: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].

segments.arabic: هَذَا من ألطف خطاب الْقُرْآن وأشرف مَعَانِيه
segments.english: This [is] from the most subtle address of the Quran and its most noble meanings.

segments.arabic: وَأَن الْمُؤمن دَائِما مَعَ الله على نَفسه وهواه وشيطانه وعدو ربه
segments.english: And that the believer [is] always with God against his self, his desire, his devil, and the enemy of his Lord.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا معنى كَونه من حزب الله وجنده وأوليائه
segments.english: And this [is] the meaning of him being from the party of God, His soldiers, and His allies.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مَعَ الله على عدوه الدَّاخِل فِيهِ وَالْخَارِج عَنهُ
segments.english: So he [is] with God against his enemy — the one inside him and the one outside him.

segments.arabic: يحاربهم ويعاديهم ويغضبهم لَهُ سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: He fights them, opposes them, and angers them for His sake — glorified [is] He.

segments.arabic: كَمَا يكون خَواص الْملك مَعَه على حَرْب أعدائه
segments.english: Just as the close companions of [a] king [are] with him in war against his enemies,

segments.arabic: والبعيدون مِنْهُ فارغون من ذَلِك غير مهتمين بِهِ
segments.english: while those far from him [are] free from that, not concerned with it.

segments.arabic: وَالْكَافِر مَعَ شَيْطَانه وَنَفسه وهواه على ربه
segments.english: And the disbeliever [is] with his devil and his self and his desire against his Lord.

segments.arabic: وعبارات السّلف على هَذِه تَدور
segments.english: And the expressions of the early scholars revolve around this [meaning].

segments.arabic: ذكر بن أبي حَاتِم عَن عَطاء بن دِينَار عَن سعيد بن جُبَير قَالَ عونا للشَّيْطَان على ربه بالعداوة والشرك
segments.english: Ibn Abi Hatim mentioned, from Ata ibn Dinar, from Said ibn Jubayr, [who] said: [a] helper to the devil against his Lord through hostility and associating partners [with God].

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ لَيْث عَن مُجَاهِد قَالَ يظاهر الشَّيْطَان على مَعْصِيّة الله يُعينهُ عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: And Layth said, from Mujahid, [who] said: he backs the devil in disobedience [to] God, helping him in it.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ زيد بن أسلم ظهيرا أَي مواليا
segments.english: And Zayd ibn Aslam said: 'a supporter' — meaning [a] loyal ally.

segments.arabic: وَالْمعْنَى أَنه يوالي عدوه على مَعْصِيَته والشرك بِهِ
segments.english: And the meaning [is] that he allies with His enemy in disobedience [to] Him and associating partners with Him.

segments.arabic: فَيكون مَعَ عدوه معينا لَهُ على مساخط ربه
segments.english: So he becomes with His enemy, [a] helper to him in what angers his Lord.

segments.arabic: فالمعية الْخَاصَّة لتي لِلْمُؤمنِ مَعَ ربه وإله قد صَارَت لهَذَا الْكَافِر والفاجر مَعَ الشَّيْطَان
segments.english: So the special togetherness that the believer [has] with his Lord and his God — it has become, for this disbeliever and sinner, with the devil

segments.arabic: وَمَعَ نَفسه وهواه وقربانه
segments.english: and with his self and his desire and his offerings.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا صدّر الْآيَة بقوله
segments.english: And for this [reason], He began the verse with His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ الله مَا لَا يَنْفَعهُمْ وَلَا يضرهم﴾
segments.english: And they worship besides God what does not benefit them and does not harm them.
segments.sahih_international: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه الْعِبَادَة هِيَ الْمُوَالَاة والمحبة وَالرِّضَا بمعبوديهم المتضمنة لمعيتهم الْخَاصَّة
segments.english: And this worship — it [is] the loyalty and the love and the satisfaction with their objects of worship, which includes their special togetherness [with them].

segments.arabic: فظاهروا أَعدَاء الله على معاداته ومخالفته ومساخطه
segments.english: So they backed the enemies of God in showing hostility [to] Him and opposing Him and [doing] what angers Him,

segments.arabic: بِخِلَاف وليه سُبْحَانَهُ فَإِنَّهُ مَعَه على نَفسه وشيطانه وهواه
segments.english: unlike His ally — glorified [is] He — for he [is] with Him against his self and his devil and his desire.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا الْمَعْنى من كنوز الْقُرْآن لمن فهمه وعقله وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And this meaning [is] from the treasures of the Quran for whoever understands it and grasps it. And with God [is] success.

segments.arabic: قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High's saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا بِآياتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا عَلَيْهَا صمًّا وعميانا﴾
segments.english: And those who, when they [are] reminded with the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
segments.sahih_international: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.

segments.arabic: قَالَ مقَاتل إِذا وعظوا بِالْقُرْآنِ لم يقعوا عَلَيْهِ صمًّا لم يسمعوه وعميانا لم يبصروه
segments.english: Muqatil said: when they [are] advised with the Quran, they do not fall upon it deaf — not hearing it — and blind — not seeing it.

segments.arabic: وَلَكنهُمْ سمعُوا وأبصروا وأيقنوا بِهِ
segments.english: But they heard and saw and had certainty in it.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ ابْن عَبَّاس لم يَكُونُوا عَلَيْهَا صمًّا وعميانا بل كَانُوا خَائِفين خاشعين
segments.english: And Ibn Abbas said: they were not upon them deaf and blind; rather they were fearful [and] humble.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ الْكَلْبِيّ يخرّون عَلَيْهَا سمعا وبصَرا
segments.english: And al-Kalbi said: they fall upon them hearing and seeing.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ الْفراء اذا تلِي عَلَيْهِم الْقُرْآن لم يقعدوا على حَالهم الأولى كَأَنَّهُمْ لم يسمعوه فَذَلِك الخرور
segments.english: And al-Farra said: when the Quran [is] recited to them, they do not remain in their former state as if they did not hear it — and that [is] the meaning of 'falling.'

segments.arabic: وَسمعت الْعَرَب تَقول قعد يَشْتمنِي كَقَوْلِك قَامَ يَشْتمنِي وَأَقْبل يَشْتمنِي
segments.english: And I heard the Arabs say 'he sat insulting me,' like your saying 'he stood insulting me' and 'he went on insulting me.'

segments.arabic: وَالْمعْنَى على مَا ذكر لم يصيروا عِنْدهَا صمًّا وعميانا
segments.english: And the meaning, based on what [was] mentioned, [is that] they did not become, upon [hearing] them, deaf and blind.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ الزّجاج الْمَعْنى إِذا تليت عَلَيْهِم خروا سجدا وبكيا سَامِعين مبصرين كَمَا أمروا بِهِ
segments.english: And al-Zajjaj said: the meaning [is that] when [the verses] [are] recited to them, they fall in prostration and weeping, hearing [and] seeing, as they were commanded.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ ابْن قُتَيْبَة أَي لم يتغافلوا عَنْهَا كَأَنَّهُمْ صم لم يسمعوها وَعمي لم يروها
segments.english: And Ibn Qutayba said: meaning they did not ignore them as if they [were] deaf [and] did not hear them, and blind [and] did not see them.

segments.arabic: قلت هَهُنَا أَمْرَانِ ذكر الخرور وتسليط النَّفْي عَلَيْهِ وَهل هُوَ خرور الْقلب أَو خرور الْبدن
segments.english: I say: here [there are] two matters — the mention of 'falling' and the directing of the negation upon it, and whether it [is the] falling of the heart or [the] falling of the body.

segments.arabic: للسُّجُود وَهل لِمَعْنى لم يكن خرورهم عَن صمم وَعَمه
segments.english: for prostration. And [does it] mean [that] their falling [was] not from deafness and blindness?

segments.arabic: فَلهم عَلَيْهَا خرورا بِالْقَلْبِ خضوعا أَو بِالْبدنِ سجودا
segments.english: So they had upon them [a] falling — with the heart [in] submission, or with the body [in] prostration.

segments.arabic: أَو لَيْسَ هُنَاكَ خرور وَعبر بِهِ عَن الْقعُود
segments.english: Or there [is] no falling [at all], and [it] expressed by it remaining.

segments.arabic: أصُول الْمعاصِي كلهَا كِبَارهَا وصغارها ثَلَاثَة
segments.english: The roots of sins — all of them, their major and minor ones — [are] three:

segments.arabic: تعلق الْقلب بِغَيْر الله وَطَاعَة الْقُوَّة الغضبية وَالْقُوَّة الشهوانية
segments.english: the heart's attachment to other than God, obedience to the angry force, and the lustful force.

segments.arabic: وَهِي الشّرك وَالظُّلم وَالْفَوَاحِش
segments.english: And they [are] associating partners [with God], injustice, and immorality.

segments.arabic: فغاية التَّعَلُّق بِغَيْر الله شرك وَأَن يدعى مَعَه إِلَه آخر
segments.english: So the ultimate [end] of attachment to other than God [is] associating partners [with God] — that [a] god other [than Him] [is] called upon alongside Him.

segments.arabic: وَغَايَة طَاعَة الْقُوَّة الغضبية الْقَتْل
segments.english: And the ultimate [end] of obeying the angry force [is] killing.

segments.arabic: وَغَايَة الْقُوَّة الشهوانية الزِّنَا
segments.english: And the ultimate [end] of the lustful force [is] adultery.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا جمع الله سُبْحَانَهُ بَين الثَّلَاثَة فِي قَوْله
segments.english: And for this [reason], God — glorified [is] He — combined the three in His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ الله إِلَهًا آخر وَلا يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلا يَزْنُونَ﴾
segments.english: And those who do not call upon with God [a] god other [than Him], and do not kill the soul that God [has] forbidden except by right, and do not commit adultery.
segments.sahih_international: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه الثَّلَاثَة يَدْعُو بَعْضهَا إِلَى بعض
segments.english: And these three — each of them calls to the other.

segments.arabic: فالشرك يَدْعُو إِلَى الظُّلم وَالْفَوَاحِش
segments.english: So associating partners [with God] calls to injustice and immorality,

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن الْإِخْلَاص والتوحيد يصرفهما عَن صَاحبه
segments.english: just as sincerity and monotheism turn them both away from their companion.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿كَذَلِكَ لِنَصْرِفَ عَنْهُ السُّوءَ وَالْفَحْشَاءَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾
segments.english: Thus, [it was] so that We turn away from him the evil and the immorality. Indeed he [was] from Our sincere servants.
segments.sahih_international: And she certainly determined [to seduce] him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof of his Lord. And thus [it was] that We should avert from him evil and immorality. Indeed, he was of Our chosen servants.

segments.arabic: فالسوء الْعِشْق والفحشاء الزِّنَا
segments.english: So 'the evil' [is] infatuation, and 'the immorality' [is] adultery.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ الظُّلم يَدْعُو إِلَى الشّرك والفاحشة
segments.english: And likewise, injustice calls to associating partners [with God] and immorality.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الشّرك أظلم الظلم
segments.english: For associating partners [with God] [is] the greatest of injustice,

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن أعدل الْعدْل التَّوْحِيد
segments.english: just as the most just of justice [is] monotheism.

segments.arabic: فالعدل قرين التَّوْحِيد وَالظُّلم قرين الشّرك
segments.english: So justice [is] the companion of monotheism, and injustice [is] the companion of associating partners [with God].

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا يجمع سُبْحَانَهُ بَينهمَا
segments.english: And for this [reason], glorified [is] He, He combines between them.

segments.arabic: أما الأول فَفِي قَوْله شهد الله أنه لَا إِلَه إِلَّا هُوَ وَالْمَلائِكَةُ وَأُولُو الْعِلْمِ قَائِمًا بِالْقِسْطِ
segments.english: As for the first, [it is] in His saying: 'God testified that there [is] no god except Him, and the angels and the people of knowledge, [He is] upholding justice.'

segments.arabic: وَأما الثَّانِي فكقوله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And as for the second, [it is] like the saying of [God] Most High:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ﴾
segments.english: Indeed associating partners [with God] [is] surely [a] great injustice.

segments.arabic: والفاحشة تَدْعُو إِلَى الشّرك وَالظُّلم
segments.english: And immorality calls to associating partners [with God] and injustice,

segments.arabic: وَلَا سِيمَا إِذا قويت إرادتها وَلم تحصل إِلَّا بِنَوْع من الظُّلم
segments.english: especially when its desire grows strong and [it] cannot be obtained except through [a] type of injustice,

segments.arabic: والاستعانة بِالسحرِ والشيطان
segments.english: and seeking help from sorcery and the devil.

segments.arabic: وَقد جمع سُبْحَانَهُ بَين الزِّنَا والشرك فِي قَوْله
segments.english: And glorified [is] He, He combined between adultery and associating partners [with God] in His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿الزَّانِي لَا يَنْكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَالزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنْكِحُهَا إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ وَحُرِّمَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾
segments.english: The male adulterer does not marry except [a] female adulterer or [a] female polytheist, and the female adulterer — none marries her except [a] male adulterer or [a] male polytheist. And that [was] forbidden upon the believers.
segments.sahih_international: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that has been made unlawful to the believers.

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ الثَّلَاثَة يجر بَعْضهَا إِلَى بعض وَيَأْمُر بَعْضهَا بِبَعْض
segments.english: So these three — each of them drags to the other, and each of them commands the other.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كلما كَانَ الْقلب أَضْعَف توحيدا وَأعظم شركا
segments.english: And for this [reason], whenever the heart [was] weaker in monotheism and greater in associating partners [with God],

segments.arabic: كَانَ أَكثر فَاحِشَة وَأعظم تعلقا بالصور وعشقا لَهَا
segments.english: [it] was more [given to] immorality, and greater in attachment to images and infatuation with them.

segments.arabic: وَنَظِير هَذَا قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And similar to this [is] the saying of [God] Most High:

segments.arabic: وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: And whatever you [have] been given of anything, [it is but] enjoyment of the life of this world.

segments.arabic: وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَى لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
segments.english: And what [is] with God [is] better and more lasting, for those who believed and upon their Lord [they] rely.

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْأِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ
segments.english: And those who avoid the major sins and immorality, and when they become angry, they forgive.

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر أَن مَا عِنْده خير لمن آمن بِهِ وتوكل عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: So He informed that what [is] with Him [is] better for whoever believed in Him and relied upon Him,

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا هُوَ التَّوْحِيد
segments.english: and this — it [is] monotheism.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ قَالَ
segments.english: Then He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْأِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ﴾
segments.english: And those who avoid the major sins and immorality.
segments.sahih_international: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا اجْتِنَاب دَاعِي الْقُوَّة الشهوانية
segments.english: So this [is] avoiding the caller of the lustful force.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ قَالَ
segments.english: Then He said:

headings.arabic: فائدة هجر القرآن أنواع أحدها هجر سماعه والإيمان به والإصغاء إليه
headings.english: Benefit: Abandoning the Quran [is of several] types — the first being abandoning listening to it, having faith in it, and paying attention to it

segments.arabic: ﴿وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ﴾
segments.english: And when they become angry, they forgive
segments.sahih_international: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا مُخَالفَة الْقُوَّة الغضبية
segments.english: So this [is] opposing the power of anger

segments.arabic: فَجمع بَين التَّوْحِيد والعفة وَالْعدْل الَّتِي هِيَ جماع الْخَيْر كُله
segments.english: So [He] combined between monotheism, chastity, and justice — which [is] the sum of all goodness

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة هجر الْقُرْآن أَنْوَاع
segments.english: Benefit: Abandoning the Quran [is of several] types

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا هجر سَمَاعه وَالْإِيمَان بِهِ والإصغاء إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: The first of them [is] abandoning listening to it, having faith in it, and paying attention to it

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي هجر الْعَمَل بِهِ وَالْوُقُوف عِنْد حَلَاله وَحَرَامه وَإِن قَرَأَهُ وآمن بِهِ
segments.english: And the second [is] abandoning acting upon it and stopping at its lawful and forbidden [rulings], even if he read it and believed in it

segments.arabic: وَالثَّالِث هجر تحكيمه والتحاكم إِلَيْهِ فِي أصُول الدّين وفروعه
segments.english: And the third [is] abandoning ruling by it and referring judgment to it in the foundations of the religion and its branches

segments.arabic: واعتقاد أَنه لَا يُفِيد الْيَقِين وَأَن أدلته لفظية لَا تحصّل الْعلم
segments.english: and believing that it does not give certainty, and that its proofs [are merely] verbal [and] do not produce knowledge

segments.arabic: وَالرَّابِع هجر تدبّره وتفهّمه وَمَعْرِفَة مَا أَرَادَ الْمُتَكَلّم بِهِ مِنْهُ
segments.english: And the fourth [is] abandoning reflecting on it, understanding it, and knowing what the Speaker intended by it

segments.arabic: وَالْخَامِس هجر الِاسْتِشْفَاء والتداوي بِهِ فِي جَمِيع أمراض الْقلب وأدوائها
segments.english: And the fifth [is] abandoning seeking healing and treating [oneself] with it for all the diseases of the heart and its ailments

segments.arabic: فيطلب شِفَاء دائه من غَيره ويهجر التَّدَاوِي بِهِ
segments.english: so he seeks the cure for his illness from other than it, and abandons treating [himself] with it

segments.arabic: وكل هَذَا دَاخل فِي قَوْله
segments.english: And all of this falls under His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا﴾
segments.english: And the Messenger said, 'O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Quran [as something] abandoned'
segments.sahih_international: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ بعض الهجر أَهْون من بعض
segments.english: even though some [types of] abandonment [are] lighter than others

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ الحرج الَّذِي فِي الصُّدُور مِنْهُ
segments.english: And likewise the discomfort that [is] in the chests regarding it

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ تَارَة يكون حرجا من إنزاله وَكَونه حَقًا من عِنْد الله
segments.english: for sometimes it [is] discomfort about its being sent down and it being truth from God

segments.arabic: وَتارَة يكون من جِهَة المتكلم بِهِ أَو كَونه مخلوقا من بعض مخلوقاته ألهم غَيره أَن تكلم بِهِ
segments.english: and sometimes it [is] from the side of the One who spoke it — or [the claim] that it [is] created by some of His creation, [that] He inspired other than Himself to speak it

segments.arabic: وَتارَة يكون من جِهَة كِفَايَته وَعدمهَا وَأَنه لَا يَكْفِي الْعباد
segments.english: and sometimes it [is] from the side of its sufficiency or lack of it, and that it does not suffice the servants

segments.arabic: بل هم محتاجون مَعَه إِلَى المعقولات والأقيسة أَو الآراء أَو السياسات
segments.english: rather they [are] in need, along with it, of rational arguments, analogies, opinions, or policies

segments.arabic: وَتارَة يكون من جِهَة دلَالَته وَمَا أُرِيد بِهِ
segments.english: and sometimes it [is] from the side of its meanings and what [was] intended by it —

segments.arabic: حقائقه المفهومة مِنْهُ عِنْد الْخطاب أَو أُرِيد بِهِ تَأْوِيلهَا وإخراجها عَن حقائقها إِلَى تأويلات مستكرهة مُشْتَركَة
segments.english: [whether] its realities [are] understood from it as addressed, or [whether] what [was] intended [is] reinterpreting them and removing them from their realities into far-fetched, ambiguous interpretations

segments.arabic: وَتارَة يكون من جِهَة كَون تِلْكَ الْحَقَائِق وَإِن كَانَت مُرَادة فَهِيَ ثَابِتَة فِي نفس الْأَمر
segments.english: and sometimes it [is] from the side of [whether] those realities — even if they [are] intended — [are] established in reality

segments.arabic: أَو أوهم أَنَّهَا مُرَادة لضرب من الْمصلحَة
segments.english: or [whether He] gave the impression that they [are] intended for some type of benefit

segments.arabic: فَكل هَؤُلَاءِ فِي صُدُورهمْ حرج من الْقُرْآن
segments.english: So all of these [people] — in their chests [there is] discomfort from the Quran

segments.arabic: وهم يعلمُونَ ذَلِك من نُفُوسهم ويجدونه فِي صُدُورهمْ
segments.english: and they know that from themselves and find it in their chests

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَجِد مبتدعا فِي دينه قطّ إِلَّا وَفِي قلبه حرج من الْآيَات الَّتِي تخَالف بدعته
segments.english: And you will never find [a person of] innovation in his religion except that in his heart [there is] discomfort from the verses that contradict his innovation

segments.arabic: كَمَا أنك لَا تَجِد ظَالِما فَاجِرًا إِلَّا وَفِي صَدره حرج من الْآيَات الَّتِي تحول بَينه وَبَين إِرَادَته
segments.english: just as you will not find [a] wrongdoing sinner except that in his chest [there is] discomfort from the verses that stand between him and his desire

segments.arabic: فَتدبر هَذَا المَعْنَى ثمَّ ارْض لنَفسك بِمَا تشَاء
segments.english: So reflect on this meaning, then choose for yourself whatever you wish

headings.arabic: فائدة كمال النفس المطلوب ما تضمن أمرين أحدهما أن يصير هيئة راسخة وصفة
headings.english: A benefit: The perfection of the self [that is] sought [is] what includes two matters, one of them [is] that it becomes a firm disposition and quality

segments.arabic: كَمَال النَّفس الْمَطْلُوب مَا تضمن أَمريْن
segments.english: The perfection of the self [that is] sought [is] what includes two matters.

segments.arabic: أَحدهمَا أَن يصير هَيْئَة راسخة وَصفَة لَازِمَة لَهُ
segments.english: One of them [is] that it becomes a firm disposition and a permanent quality for him.

segments.arabic: الثَّانِي أَن يكون صفة كَمَال فِي نَفسه
segments.english: The second [is] that it [is] a quality of perfection in itself.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا لم يكن كَذَلِك لم يكن كمالا
segments.english: So if it [is] not like that, it [is] not perfection.

segments.arabic: فلا يَلِيق بِمن يسْعَى فِي كَمَال نَفسه المنافسة عَلَيْهِ وَلَا الأسف على فَوته
segments.english: So it [does] not suit whoever strives for the perfection of his self to compete for it or to grieve over missing it.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ لَيْسَ إِلَّا معرفَة بارئها وفاطرها ومعبودها وإلهها الحق
segments.english: And that [is] nothing but knowing its Creator, its Originator, its object of worship, and its true God —

segments.arabic: الَّذِي لَا صَلَاح لَهَا وَلَا نعيم وَلَا لَذَّة إِلَّا بمعرفته
segments.english: [the One] for whom there [is] no soundness for it, no bliss, and no pleasure except by knowing Him,

segments.arabic: وَإِرَادَة وَجهه وسلوك الطَّرِيق الموصلة إِلَيْهِ وَإِلَى رِضَاهُ وكرامته
segments.english: and wanting His face, and traveling the path that leads to Him and to His pleasure and His honor,

segments.arabic: وَأَن تعتاد ذَلِك فَيصير لَهَا هَيْئَة راسخة لَازِمَة
segments.english: and that it becomes accustomed to that so it becomes for it a firm and permanent disposition.

segments.arabic: وَمَا عدا ذَلِك من الْعُلُوم والإرادات والأعمال
segments.english: And whatever [is] besides that — of knowledge, desires, and actions —

segments.arabic: فَهِيَ بَين مَالا ينفعها وَلَا يكملها
segments.english: it [is] between what does not benefit it and does not perfect it,

segments.arabic: وَمَا يعود بضررها ونقصها وألمها
segments.english: and what brings about its harm, its deficiency, and its pain.

segments.arabic: وَلَا سِيمَا إِذا صَار هَيْئَة راسخة لَهَا
segments.english: Especially if it becomes a firm disposition for it,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا تعذب وتتألم بِهِ بِحَسب لُزُومه لَهَا
segments.english: for it [is] tormented and pained by it according to how attached it [is] to it.

segments.arabic: وَأما الْفَضَائِل الْمُنْفَصِلَة عَنْهَا كالملابس والمراكب والمساكن والجاه وَالْمَال
segments.english: As for the external virtues separate from it — like clothing, vehicles, homes, status, and wealth —

segments.arabic: فَتلك فِي الْحَقِيقَة عوار أعيرتها مُدَّة
segments.english: those [are] in reality borrowed things lent to it for [a] time,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ يرجع فِيهَا الْمُعير
segments.english: then the lender takes them back.

segments.arabic: فتتألم وتتعذب بِرُجُوعِهِ فِيهَا بِحَسب تعلقهَا بهَا
segments.english: So it [is] pained and tormented by his taking them back according to its attachment to them.

segments.arabic: وَلَا سِيمَا إِذا كَانَت هِيَ غَايَة كمالها
segments.english: Especially if they were the limit of its perfection,

segments.arabic: فَإِذا سلبتها أحضرت أعظم النَّقْص والألم وَالْحَسْرَة
segments.english: so when they [are] stripped from it, [there] comes the greatest deficiency, pain, and regret.

segments.arabic: فليتدبر من يُرِيد سَعَادَة نَفسه ولذتها هَذِه النُّكْتَة
segments.english: So let whoever wants the happiness of his self and its pleasure reflect on this point.

segments.arabic: فَأكْثر هَذَا الْخلق إِنَّمَا يسعون فِي حرمَان نُفُوسهم وألمها وحسرتها ونقصها
segments.english: For most of these people only strive for the deprivation of their selves, and their pain, and their regret, and their deficiency,

segments.arabic: من حَيْثُ يظنون أَنهم يُرِيدُونَ سعادتها وَنَعِيمهَا
segments.english: while they think that they want their happiness and their bliss.

segments.arabic: فلذتها بِحَسب مَا حصل لَهَا من تِلْكَ الْمعرفَة والمحبة والسلوك
segments.english: So its pleasure [is] according to what it gained of that knowledge, love, and traveling [the path],

segments.arabic: وألمها وحسرتها بِحَسب مَا فاتها من ذَلِك
segments.english: and its pain and regret [are] according to what it missed of that.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى عدم ذَلِك وخلا مِنْهُ
segments.english: And whenever that [is] absent and [one is] empty of it,

segments.arabic: لم يبْق فِيهِ إِلَّا القوى الْبَدَنِيَّة النفسانية
segments.english: there remains in him nothing but the bodily, animal powers

segments.arabic: الَّتِي بهَا يَأْكُل وَيشْرب وينكح ويغضب
segments.english: by which he eats and drinks and has relations and gets angry

segments.arabic: وينال سَائِر لذاته ومرافق حَيَاته
segments.english: and attains the rest of his pleasures and comforts of his life.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يلْحقهُ من جِهَتهَا شرف وَلَا فَضِيلَة بل خساسة ومنقصة
segments.english: And no honor or virtue comes to him from them, but [rather] lowliness and deficiency,

segments.arabic: إِذْ كَانَ إِنَّمَا يُنَاسب بِتِلْكَ القوى الْبَهَائِم ويتصل بجنسها
segments.english: since by those powers he only resembles the animals and connects to their kind,

segments.arabic: وَيدخل فِي جُمْلَتهَا وَيصير كأحدها
segments.english: and enters among them and becomes like one of them.

segments.arabic: وَرُبمَا زَادَت فِي تنَاولهَا عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And perhaps they surpass him in what they attain,

segments.arabic: واختصت دونه بسلامة عَافِيَتهَا والأمن من جلب الضَّرَر عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: and they [are] distinguished from him by the safety of their well-being and [the] security from bringing harm upon themselves.

segments.arabic: فكمالٌ تشاركك فِيهِ الْبَهَائِم وتزيد عَلَيْك
segments.english: So [a] perfection that the animals share with you in and surpass you in,

segments.arabic: وتختص عَنْك فِيهِ بسلامة الْعَاقِبَة
segments.english: and [are] distinguished from you in by [the] safety of [their] outcome —

segments.arabic: حقيق أَن تهجره إِلَى الْكَمَال الْحَقِيقِيّ الَّذِي لَا كَمَال سواهُ
segments.english: [it is] deserving that you abandon it for the true perfection, which — there [is] no perfection besides it.

segments.arabic: وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And with God [is] success.

headings.arabic: فائدة جليلة
headings.english: [A] Noble Benefit

headings.arabic: فائدة العلم نقل صورة المعلوم من الخارج وإثباتها في النفس والعمل نقل
headings.english: [A] Benefit: Knowledge [Is] Transferring the Image of the Known from the Outside and Establishing It in the Self, and Action [Is] Transferring

segments.arabic: إِذا أصبح العَبْد وَأمسى وَلَيْسَ همه إِلَّا الله وَحده
segments.english: When the servant wakes in the morning and reaches the evening, and his only concern [is] God alone,

segments.arabic: تحمل الله سُبْحَانَهُ حَوَائِجه كلهَا وَحمل عَنهُ كل مَا أهمه
segments.english: God, glorified [is] He, carries all his needs and bears from him everything that worries him,

segments.arabic: وَفرغ قلبه لمحبته وَلسَانه لذكره وجوارحه لطاعته
segments.english: and frees his heart for His love, and his tongue for His remembrance, and his limbs for His obedience.

segments.arabic: وَإِن أصبح وَأمسى وَالدُّنْيَا همه
segments.english: And if he wakes and reaches the evening, and this world [is] his concern,

segments.arabic: حمله الله همومها وغمومها وأنكادها ووكله إِلَى نَفسه
segments.english: God loads him with its worries, its sorrows, and its troubles, and leaves him to himself.

segments.arabic: فشغل قلبه عَن محبته بمحبة الْخلق وَلسَانه عَن ذكره بذكرهم
segments.english: So his heart [is] busy away from His love with love of creation, and his tongue away from His remembrance with their remembrance,

segments.arabic: وجوارحه عَن طَاعَته بخدمتهم وأشغالهم
segments.english: and his limbs away from His obedience with serving them and their affairs.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ يكدح كدح الْوَحْش فِي خدمَة غَيره
segments.english: So he toils [the] toiling of [a] wild beast in the service of others,

segments.arabic: كالكير ينْفخ بَطْنه ويعصر أضلاعه فِي نفع غَيره
segments.english: like the bellows — its belly [is] blown and its sides [are] squeezed for the benefit of others.

segments.arabic: كل من أعرض عَن عبودية الله وطاعته ومحبته بلي بعبودية المخلوق ومحبته وخدمته
segments.english: Everyone who turns away from the servitude of God, and His obedience, and His love, [is] afflicted with servitude to [a] created being, and love of him, and service to him.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَمَنْ يَعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَانًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ﴾
segments.english: And whoever turns blind from the remembrance of the Most Merciful, We appoint for him [a] devil, and he [is] for him [a] companion.
segments.sahih_international: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.

segments.arabic: قَالَ سُفْيَان بن عُيَيْنَة لَا تأتون بِمثل مَشْهُور للْعَرَب إِلَّا جِئتُكُمْ بِهِ من الْقُرْآن
segments.english: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah said: You do not bring [a] famous proverb of the Arabs except [that] I [will] bring you its [match] from the Quran.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُ قَائِل فَأَيْنَ فِي الْقُرْآن أعْط أَخَاك تَمْرَة فَإِن لم يقبل فأعطه جَمْرَة
segments.english: So someone said to him: Then where in the Quran [is]: 'Give your brother [a] date, and if he does not accept, then give him [a] burning coal'?

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ فِي قَوْله ﴿وَمَنْ يَعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَانًا﴾ الْآيَة
segments.english: So he said: In His saying: 'And whoever turns blind from the remembrance of the Most Merciful, We appoint for him [a] devil' — the [rest of the] verse.

segments.arabic: الْعلم نقل صُورَة الْمَعْلُوم من الْخَارِج وإثباتها فِي النَّفس
segments.english: Knowledge [is] transferring the image of the known from the outside and establishing it in the self.

segments.arabic: والعمل نقل صُورَة علمية من النَّفس وإثباتها فِي الْخَارِج
segments.english: And action [is] transferring [a] knowledge-based image from the self and establishing it in the outside.

segments.arabic: فَإِن كَانَ الثَّابِت فِي النَّفس مطابقا للْحَقِيقَة فِي نَفسهَا فَهُوَ علم صَحِيح
segments.english: So if what [is] established in the self matches reality in itself, then it [is] correct knowledge.

segments.arabic: وَكَثِيرًا مَا يثبت فِي النَّفس صور لَيْسَ لَهَا وجود حقيقي
segments.english: And often there [are] established in the self images that have no real existence,

segments.arabic: فيظنها الَّذِي قد أثبتها فِي نَفسه علما وَإِنَّمَا هِيَ مقدرَة لَا حَقِيقِيَّة لَهَا
segments.english: and the one who established them in his self assumes them [to be] knowledge, but they [are] only imagined — they have no reality.

segments.arabic: وَأكْثر عُلُوم النَّاس من هَذَا الْبَاب
segments.english: And most of people's knowledge [is] of this type.

segments.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ مِنْهَا مطابقا للْحَقِيقَة فِي الْخَارِج فَهُوَ نَوْعَانِ
segments.english: And whatever of it matches reality in the outside, it [is] two types:

segments.arabic: نوع تكمل النَّفس بإدراكه وَالْعلم بِهِ
segments.english: [a] type [by which] the self [is] perfected by perceiving it and knowing it,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ الْعلم بِاللَّه وأسمائه وَصِفَاته وأفعاله وَكتبه وَأمره وَنَهْيه
segments.english: and that [is] knowledge of God, and His names, and His attributes, and His actions, and His books, and His commands, and His prohibitions.

segments.arabic: وَنَوع لَا يحصل بِهِ للنَّفس كَمَال
segments.english: And [a] type [by which] no perfection [is] gained for the self,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ كل علم لَا يضر الْجَهْل بِهِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا ينفع الْعلم بِهِ
segments.english: and that [is] every knowledge [where] ignorance of it does not harm, for knowing it does not benefit.

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ النَّبِي يستعيذ بِاللَّه من علم لَا ينفع
segments.english: And the Prophet used to seek refuge in God from knowledge that does not benefit.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا حَال أَكثر العلوم الصَّحِيحَة الْمُطَابقَة الَّتِي لَا يضر الْجَهْل بهَا شَيْئا كَالْعلمِ بالفلك
segments.english: And this [is] the case with most of the correct, matching knowledge that ignorance of it does not harm at all, like knowledge of astronomy.

headings.arabic: قاعدة الإيمان له ظاهر وباطن وظاهره قول اللسان وعمل الجوارح وباطنه
headings.english: [A] Principle: Faith has an outward and an inward [aspect]; its outward [is] the speech of the tongue and the action of the limbs, and its inward [is]

segments.arabic: ودقائقه ودرجاته وَعدد الْكَوَاكِب ومقاديرها
segments.english: and its fine details, and its degrees, and the number of the stars and their sizes,

segments.arabic: وَالْعلم بِعَدَد الْجبَال وألوانها ومساحتها وَنَحْو ذَلِك
segments.english: and knowledge of the number of mountains and their colors and their areas, and the like of that —

segments.arabic: فشرف الْعلم بِحَسب شرف معلومه وَشدَّة الْحَاجة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: so the honor of knowledge [is] according to the honor of what [is] known and the intensity of the need for it.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ ذَلِك إِلَّا الْعلم بِاللَّه وتوابع ذَلِك
segments.english: And that [is] nothing but the knowledge of God, and what follows from that.

segments.arabic: وَأما الْعلم فآفته عدم مطابقته لمراد الله الديني الَّذِي يُحِبهُ الله ويرضاه
segments.english: As for knowledge, its flaw [is] its failure to match God's religious intent — that which God loves and [is] pleased with.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ يكون من فَسَاد الْعلم تَارَة وَمن فَسَاد الْإِرَادَة تَارَة
segments.english: And that comes from corruption of knowledge sometimes, and from corruption of intention sometimes.

segments.arabic: ففساد من جِهَة الْعلم أَن يعْتَقد أَن هَذَا مَشْرُوع مَحْبُوب لله وَلَيْسَ كَذَلِك
segments.english: So corruption from the side of knowledge [is] that [a person] believes that this [is] legislated [and] loved by God, while it [is] not so,

segments.arabic: أَو يعْتَقد أَنه يقر بِهِ إِلَى الله وَإِن لم يكن مَشْرُوعا
segments.english: or [he] believes that [he] draws near to God through it, even if it [is] not legislated.

segments.arabic: فيظن أَنه يتَقرَّب إِلَى الله بِهَذَا الْعَمَل وَإِن لم يعلم أَنه مَشْرُوع
segments.english: So he thinks that he draws close to God through this action, even though he does not know that it [is] legislated.

segments.arabic: وَأما فَسَاده من جِهَة الْقَصْد فان لَا يقْصد بِهِ وَجه الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة
segments.english: And as for its corruption from the side of intention, [it is] that he does not intend by it the face of God and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: بل يقْصد بِهِ الدُّنْيَا والخلق
segments.english: but rather he intends by it this world and [the approval of] people.

segments.arabic: وَهَاتَانِ الآفتان فِي الْعلم وَالْعَمَل لَا سَبِيل إِلَى السَّلامَة مِنْهُمَا
segments.english: And these two flaws in knowledge and action — there [is] no way to safety from them

segments.arabic: إِلَّا بِمَعْرِفَة مَا جَاءَ بِهِ الرَّسُول فِي بَاب الْعلم والمعرفة
segments.english: except through knowing what the Messenger came with in the area of knowledge and understanding,

segments.arabic: وَإِرَادَة وَجه الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة فِي بَاب الْقَصْد والإرادة
segments.english: and intending the face of God and the Hereafter in the area of purpose and intention.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى خلا من هَذِه الْمُعَرّف وَهَذِه الْإِرَادَة فسد علمه وَعَمله
segments.english: So whenever [he is] empty of this knowledge and this intention, his knowledge and his action become corrupt.

segments.arabic: وَالْإِيمَان وَالْيَقِين يورثان صِحَة الْمعرفَة وَصِحَّة الْإِرَادَة
segments.english: And faith and certainty produce soundness of knowledge and soundness of intention,

segments.arabic: يورثان الْإِيمَان ويمدانه
segments.english: [and they] produce faith and strengthen it.

segments.arabic: وَمن هُنَا يتَبَيَّن انحراف أَكثر النَّاس عَن الْأَيْمَان
segments.english: And from here [it] becomes clear [that] the deviation of most people from faith

segments.arabic: ولانحرافهم عَن صِحَة الْمعرفَة وَصِحَّة الْإِرَادَة
segments.english: [is due] to their deviation from soundness of knowledge and soundness of intention.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يتم الْإِيمَان إِلَّا بتلقي الْمعرفَة من مشكاة النُّبُوَّة
segments.english: And faith [is] not complete except by receiving knowledge from the lamp-niche of prophethood,

segments.arabic: وَتَجْرِيد الْإِرَادَة عَن شوائب الْهوى وَإِرَادَة الْخلق
segments.english: and stripping the intention of the impurities of desire and [the] seeking [of approval from] people.

segments.arabic: فَيكون علمه مقتبسا من مشكاة الْوَحْي وإرادته لله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة
segments.english: So his knowledge [is] taken from the lamp-niche of revelation, and his intention [is] for God and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا أصح النَّاس علما وَعَملا
segments.english: So this [person is] the soundest of people in knowledge and action,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ من الْأَئِمَّة الَّذين يهْدُونَ بِأَمْر الله
segments.english: and he [is] among the leaders who guide by the command of God,

segments.arabic: وَمن خلفاء رَسُوله فِي أمته
segments.english: and among the successors of His Messenger in his nation.

segments.arabic: قَاعِدَة
segments.english: [A] Principle:

segments.arabic: الْإِيمَان لَهُ ظَاهر وباطن
segments.english: Faith has an outward [aspect] and an inward [aspect].

segments.arabic: وَظَاهره قَول اللِّسَان وَعمل الْجَوَارِح
segments.english: And its outward [is] the speech of the tongue and the action of the limbs,

segments.arabic: وباطنه تَصْدِيق الْقلب وانقياده ومحبته
segments.english: and its inward [is] the belief of the heart, and its submission, and its love.

segments.arabic: فَلَا ينفع ظَاهر لَا بَاطِن لَهُ
segments.english: So an outward [aspect] with no inward [reality] to it does not benefit,

segments.arabic: وَإِن حقن بِهِ الدِّمَاء وعصم بِهِ المَال والذريّة
segments.english: even if through it blood [is] protected, and wealth and family [are] safeguarded.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يجزىء بَاطِن لَا ظَاهر لَهُ إِلَّا إِذا تعذّر بعجز أَو إِكْرَاه وَخَوف هَلَاك
segments.english: And an inward [aspect] with no outward [expression] does not suffice, except when [it is] made impossible by inability, or force, or fear of death.

segments.arabic: فَتخلف الْعَمَل ظَاهرا مَعَ عدم الْمَانِع دَلِيل على فَسَاد الْبَاطِن وخلوّه من الْإِيمَان
segments.english: So the absence of action outwardly, with no obstacle, [is] proof of the corruption of the inward [state] and its emptiness of faith.

segments.arabic: ونقصه دَلِيل نَقصه وقوته دَلِيل قوته
segments.english: And its decrease [is] proof of its decrease, and its strength [is] proof of its strength.

segments.arabic: فالإيمان قلب الْإِسْلَام ولبه
segments.english: So faith [is] the heart of Islam and its core.

headings.arabic: قاعدة التوكل على الله نوعان أحدهما توكل عليه في جلب حوائج العبد
headings.english: A Principle: Reliance [on God] [is] Two Types, One of Them [is] Reliance on Him in Bringing the Needs of the Servant

segments.arabic: وَالْيَقِين قلب الْإِيمَان ولبه
segments.english: And certainty [is] the heart of faith and its core.

segments.arabic: وكل علم وَعمل لَا يزِيد الْإِيمَان وَالْيَقِين قُوَّة فمدخول
segments.english: And every knowledge and action [that] does not increase faith and certainty [in] strength, [is] flawed.

segments.arabic: وكل إِيمَان لَا يبْعَث على الْعَمَل فمدخول
segments.english: And every faith [that] does not drive to action, [is] flawed.

segments.arabic: قَاعِدَة التَّوَكُّل على الله نَوْعَانِ
segments.english: A principle: reliance [on God] upon God [is] two types.

segments.arabic: أَحدهمَا توكل عَلَيْهِ فِي جلب حوائج العَبْد وحظوظه الدُّنْيَوِيَّة أَو دفع مكروهاته ومصائبه الدُّنْيَوِيَّة
segments.english: The first of them [is] reliance on Him in bringing the needs of the servant and his worldly gains, or repelling his disliked things and his worldly misfortunes.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي التَّوَكُّل عَلَيْهِ فِي حُصُول مَا يُحِبهُ هُوَ ويرضاه من الْإِيمَان وَالْيَقِين وَالْجهَاد والدعوة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And the second [is] reliance on Him in attaining what He loves and [is] pleased with, of faith and certainty and striving and calling to Him.

segments.arabic: وَبَين النَّوْعَيْنِ من الْفضل مَا لَا يُحْصِيه إِلَّا الله
segments.english: And between the two types in superiority [is] what none can count except God.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى توكل عَلَيْهِ العَبْد فِي النَّوْع الثَّانِي حق توكله كَفاهُ النَّوْع الأول تَمام الْكِفَايَة
segments.english: So whenever the servant relies on Him in the second type, [with] the true reliance on Him, He suffices him the first type completely.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى توكل عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّوْع الأول دون الثَّانِي كَفاهُ أَيْضا
segments.english: And whenever he relies on Him in the first type without the second, He suffices him also.

segments.arabic: لَكِن لَا يكون لَهُ عَاقِبَة المتَوَكل عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا يُحِبهُ ويرضاه
segments.english: But he [will] not have the outcome of the one who relies on Him in what He loves and [is] pleased with.

segments.arabic: فأعظم التَّوَكُّل عَلَيْهِ التَّوَكُّل فِي الْهِدَايَة وَتَجْرِيد التَّوْحِيد ومتابعة الرَّسُول وَجِهَاد أهل الْبَاطِل
segments.english: So the greatest reliance on Him [is] reliance in [attaining] guidance and purifying monotheism and following the Messenger and striving against the people of falsehood.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا توكل الرُّسُل وخاصة أتباعهم
segments.english: For this [is] the reliance of the messengers and the elite of their followers.

segments.arabic: التَّوَكُّل تَارَة يكون توكل اضطرار وإلجاء
segments.english: Reliance [on God] sometimes [is] [a] reliance of desperation and compulsion,

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ لَا يجد العَبْد ملْجأ وَلَا وزرا إِلَّا التَّوَكُّل
segments.english: such that the servant finds no refuge and no shelter except reliance [on God],

segments.arabic: كَمَا إِذا ضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْأَسْبَاب وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِ نَفسه
segments.english: as when the means become tight upon him and his self becomes tight upon him,

segments.arabic: وَظن أَن لَا ملْجأ من الله إِلَّا إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and he realizes that [there is] no refuge from God except to Him.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا لَا يتَخَلَّف عَنهُ الْفرج والتيسير الْبَتَّةَ
segments.english: And this — relief and ease never fail to come from it, ever.

segments.arabic: وَتارَة يكون توكل اخْتِيَار
segments.english: And sometimes [it] [is] [a] reliance of choice.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ التَّوَكُّل مَعَ وجود السَّبَب المفضي إِلَى المُرَاد
