segments.english: And that [is] reliance along with the existence of the means leading to what [is] desired.

segments.arabic: فَإِن كَانَ السَّبَب مَأْمُورا بِهِ ذمّ على تَركه
segments.english: So if the means [was] commanded, he [is] blamed for leaving it.

segments.arabic: وَإِن قَامَ السَّبَب وَترك التَّوَكُّل ذمّ على تَركه أَيْضا
segments.english: And if he took up the means and left reliance [on God], he [is] blamed for leaving it also.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ وَاجِب بِاتِّفَاق الْأمة وَنَصّ الْقُرْآن
segments.english: For it [is] obligatory by the agreement of the nation and the text of the Quran.

segments.arabic: وَالْوَاجِب الْقيام بهما وَالْجمع بَينهمَا
segments.english: And the obligation [is] to uphold both of them and combine between them.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ السَّبَب محرما حرم عَلَيْهِ مُبَاشَرَته
segments.english: And if the means [was] forbidden, [then] engaging in it [is] forbidden upon him.

segments.arabic: وتوحد السَّبَب فِي حَقه فِي التَّوَكُّل فَلم يبْق سَبَب سواهُ
segments.english: And the means becomes singular in his case — [it is] reliance [on God] — so no means remains other than it.

segments.arabic: فَإِن التَّوَكُّل من أقوى الْأَسْبَاب فِي حُصُول المُرَاد وَدفع الْمَكْرُوه
segments.english: For reliance [on God] [is] among the strongest means in attaining what [is] desired and repelling what [is] disliked.

segments.arabic: بل هُوَ أقوى الْأَسْبَاب على الْإِطْلَاق
segments.english: Rather, it [is] the strongest of means absolutely.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ السَّبَب مُبَاحا نظرت هَل يضعف قيامك بِهِ التَّوَكُّل أَو لَا يُضعفهُ
segments.english: And if the means [was] permissible, you look: does your taking it weaken [your] reliance [on God] or not weaken it?

segments.arabic: فَإِن أضعفه وَفرق عَلَيْك قَلْبك وشتت همك فَتَركه أولى
segments.english: So if it weakens it and scatters your heart and disperses your focus, then leaving it [is] better.

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم يُضعفهُ فمباشرته أولى
segments.english: And if it does not weaken it, then engaging in it [is] better.

segments.arabic: لِأَن حِكْمَة أحكم الْحَاكِمين اقْتَضَت ربط الْمُسَبّب بِهِ فَلَا تعطل حكمته
segments.english: Because the wisdom of the wisest of judges required linking the effect to it, so do not neglect His wisdom.

headings.arabic: فائدة الجاهل يشكو الله إلى الناس وهذا غاية الجهل بالمشكو والمشكو
headings.english: Benefit: The ignorant [person] complains about God to people, and this [is] the height of ignorance about the One complained about and the one complained [to]

segments.arabic: مهما أمكنك الْقيام بهَا
segments.english: whenever you [are] able to carry them out

segments.arabic: وَلَا سِيمَا إِذا فعلته عبودية
segments.english: especially if you did it [as an act of] worship

segments.arabic: فَتكون قد أتيت بعبودية الْقلب بالتوكل
segments.english: then you would have brought the worship of the heart through reliance [on God]

segments.arabic: وعبودية الْجَوَارِح بِالسَّبَبِ الْمَنوِي بِهِ الْقرْبَة
segments.english: and the worship of the limbs through the means by which closeness [to God] [is] intended

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِي يُحَقّق التوكل الْقيام بالأسباب الْمَأْمُور بهَا
segments.english: And what makes reliance [on God] true [is] carrying out the means that [are] commanded

segments.arabic: فَمن عطلها لم يَصح توكله
segments.english: So whoever neglects them, his reliance [on God] [is] not sound

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن الْقيام بالأسباب المفضية إِلَى حُصُول الْخَيْر يُحَقّق رَجَاءَهُ
segments.english: just as carrying out the means that lead to obtaining good makes his hope true

segments.arabic: فَمن لم يقم بهَا كَانَ رجاؤه تمنيّا
segments.english: So whoever does not carry them out, his hope [is merely] wishful thinking

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن من عطّلها يكون توكله عَجزا وعجزه توكلا
segments.english: just as whoever neglects them — his reliance [on God] becomes helplessness, and his helplessness [becomes his] reliance [on God]

segments.arabic: وسر التَّوَكُّل وَحَقِيقَته هُوَ اعْتِمَاد الْقلب على الله وَحده
segments.english: And the secret of reliance [on God] and its reality — it [is] the dependence of the heart on God alone

segments.arabic: فَلَا يضرّهُ مُبَاشرَة الْأَسْبَاب مَعَ خلو الْقلب من الِاعْتِمَاد عَلَيْهَا والركون إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: so taking up means does not harm him, as long as the heart [is] free from depending on them and leaning on them

segments.arabic: كَمَا لَا يَنْفَعهُ قَوْله توكلت على الله مَعَ اعْتِمَاده على غَيره وركونه إِلَيْهِ وثقته بِهِ
segments.english: just as his saying 'I rely on God' does not benefit him while he depends on other than Him, leans on it, and trusts in it

segments.arabic: فتوكل اللِّسَان شَيْء وتوكل الْقلب شَيْء
segments.english: So the reliance of the tongue [is one] thing, and the reliance of the heart [is another] thing

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن تَوْبَة اللِّسَان مَعَ إِصْرَار الْقلب شَيْء
segments.english: just as the repentance of the tongue while the heart persists [in sin is one] thing

segments.arabic: وتوبة الْقلب وَإِن لم ينْطق اللِّسَان شَيْء
segments.english: and the repentance of the heart — even if the tongue does not speak — [is another] thing

segments.arabic: فَقَوْل العَبْد توكلت على الله مَعَ اعْتِمَاد قلبه على غَيره
segments.english: So the servant's saying 'I rely on God' while his heart depends on other than Him

segments.arabic: مثل قَوْله تبت إِلَى الله وَهُوَ مصر على مَعْصِيَته مرتكب لَهَا
segments.english: [is] like his saying 'I repent to God' while he [is] persisting in his disobedience, committing it

segments.arabic: الْجَاهِل يشكو الله إِلَى النَّاس
segments.english: The ignorant [person] complains about God to people

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا غَايَة الْجَهْل بالمشكو والمشكو إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and this [is] the height of ignorance about the One complained about and the one complained to

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لَو عرف ربه لما شكاه
segments.english: For if he knew his Lord, he would not have complained about Him

segments.arabic: وَلَو عرف النَّاس لما شكا إِلَيْهِم
segments.english: and if he knew people, he would not have complained to them

segments.arabic: وَرَأى بعض السّلف رجلا يشكو إِلَى رجل فاقته وضرورته
segments.english: And one of the early [scholars] saw a man complaining to [another] man about his poverty and need

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ يَا هَذَا وَالله مَا زِدْت على أَن شَكَوْت من يَرْحَمك
segments.english: So he said: 'O you! By God, you have done nothing more than complain about the One who has mercy on you'

segments.arabic: وَفِي ذَلِك قيل
segments.english: And regarding that, it was said:

segments.arabic: اذا شَكَوْت إِلَى ابْن آدم إِنَّمَا تَشْكُو الرَّحِيم إِلَى الَّذِي لَا يرحم
segments.english: If you complain to a son of Adam, you [are] only complaining about the Most Merciful to one who does not show mercy

segments.arabic: والعارف إِنَّمَا يشكو إِلَى الله وَحده
segments.english: And the knower only complains to God alone

segments.arabic: وَأعرف العارفين من جعل شكواه إِلَى الله من نَفسه لَا من النَّاس
segments.english: And the most knowledgeable of the knowers [is] the one who makes his complaint to God about himself, not about people

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ يشكو من مُوجبَات تسليط النَّاس عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: So he complains about the causes of people being given power over him

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ نَاظر إِلَى قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: So he [is] looking at the saying of [God] Most High:

segments.arabic: وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فَمَا كسبت أَيْدِيكُم
segments.english: And whatever disaster strikes you, [it is] because of what your hands have earned
segments.sahih_international: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: and His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَمَا أَصَابَكَ مِنْ سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِنْ نَفسك﴾
segments.english: and whatever bad strikes you, [it is] from yourself
segments.sahih_international: What comes to you of good is from Allah, but what comes to you of evil, [O man], is from yourself. And We have sent you, [O Muhammad], to the people as a messenger, and sufficient is Allah as Witness.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: and His saying:

segments.arabic: أَوَلَمَّا أَصَابَتْكُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ قَدْ أَصَبْتُمْ مِثْلَيْهَا قُلْتُمْ أَنَّى هَذَا
segments.english: And when [a] disaster struck you — [while] you had struck [them with] twice [the] like of it — you said: 'How [is] this?'
segments.sahih_international: Why [is it that] when a [single] disaster struck you [on the day of Uhud], although you had struck [the enemy in the battle of Badr] with one twice as great, you said, "From where is this?" Say, "It is from yourselves." Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

headings.arabic: قاعدة جليلة قال الله تعالى
headings.english: A Grand Principle — [God] Most High Said

segments.arabic: ﴿قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْد أَنفسكُم﴾
segments.english: "Say: it [is] from yourselves"
segments.sahih_international: Why [is it that] when a [single] disaster struck you [on the day of Uhud], although you had struck [the enemy in the battle of Badr] with one twice as great, you said, "From where is this?" Say, "It is from yourselves." Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

segments.arabic: فالمراتب ثَلَاثَة أخسها أَن تَشْكُو الله إِلَى خلقه
segments.english: So the ranks [are] three: the lowest of them [is] that you complain about God to His creation,

segments.arabic: وأعلاها أَن تَشْكُو نَفسك إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and the highest of them [is] that you complain about yourself to Him,

segments.arabic: وأوسطها أَن تَشْكُو خلقه إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and the middle of them [is] that you complain about His creation to Him.

segments.arabic: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتجِيبُوا لله وَالرَّسُول إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يحيكم
segments.english: "O you who believe, respond to God and the Messenger when he calls you to what gives you life,
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered.

segments.arabic: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلبه وَأَنه إِلَيْهِ تحشرون﴾
segments.english: and know that God comes between a person and his heart, and that to Him you [will be] gathered."

segments.arabic: فتضمنت هَذِه الْآيَة أمورا
segments.english: This verse contained [several] matters.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا أَن الْحَيَاة النافعة إِنَّمَا تحصل بالاستجابة لله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: The first of them: that the beneficial life [is] only obtained by responding to God and His Messenger.

segments.arabic: فَمن لم تحصل لَهُ هَذِه الاستجابة فَلَا حَيَاة لَهُ
segments.english: So whoever does not achieve this response, [there is] no life for him,

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَت لَهُ حَيَاة بهيمية مُشْتَركَة بَينه وَبَين أرذل الْحَيَوَانَات
segments.english: even if he has an animal life shared between him and the lowest of animals.

segments.arabic: فالحياة الْحَقِيقِيَّة الطّيبَة هِيَ حَيَاة من اسْتَجَابَ لله وَالرَّسُول ظَاهرا وَبَاطنا
segments.english: So the true, good life — it [is] the life of whoever responded to God and the Messenger, outwardly and inwardly.

segments.arabic: فَهَؤُلَاءِ هم الْأَحْيَاء وَإِن مَاتُوا
segments.english: So these — they [are] the living ones, even if they died,

segments.arabic: وَغَيرهم أموات وَإِن كَانُوا أَحيَاء الْأَبدَان
segments.english: and others [are] dead, even if they [were] alive in body.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كَانَ أكمل النَّاس حَيَاة أكملهم استجابة لدَعْوَة الرَّسُول
segments.english: And for this [reason], the most complete of people in life [was] the most complete of them in responding to the call of the Messenger.

segments.arabic: فَإِن كل مَا دَعَا إِلَيْهِ فَفِيهِ الْحَيَاة
segments.english: For indeed, everything he called to — in it [is] life.

segments.arabic: فَمن فَاتَهُ جُزْء مِنْهُ فَاتَهُ جُزْء من الْحَيَاة
segments.english: So whoever missed a part of it, [he] missed a part of life,

segments.arabic: وَفِيه من الْحَيَاة بِحَسب مَا اسْتَجَابَ للرسول
segments.english: and in him [is] life according to what he responded to the Messenger [with].

segments.arabic: قَالَ مُجَاهِد لِمَا يحيكم يَعْنِي للحق
segments.english: Mujahid said: 'to what gives you life' means: to the truth.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ قَتَادَة هُوَ هَذَا الْقُرْآن فِيهِ الْحَيَاة والثقة والنجاة والعصمة فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: And Qatadah said: it [is] this Quran — in it [is] life, trust, salvation, and protection in this world and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ السّديّ هُوَ الْإِسْلَام أحياهم بِهِ بعد مَوْتهمْ بالْكفْر
segments.english: And al-Suddi said: it [is] Islam — He gave them life through it after their death by disbelief.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ ابْن إِسْحَق وَعُرْوَة بن الزبير وَاللَّفْظ لَهُ لِمَا يحيكم يَعْنِي للحرب الَّتِي أعزكم الله بهَا بعد الذل
segments.english: And Ibn Ishaq and Urwah ibn al-Zubayr said — and the wording [is] his — 'to what gives you life' means: to the war by which God honored you after humiliation,

segments.arabic: وقوّاكم بعد الضعْف ومنعكم بهَا من عَدوكُمْ بعد الْقَهْر مِنْهُم لكم
segments.english: and strengthened you after weakness, and protected you through it from your enemy after their overpowering of you.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه كلها عِبَارَات عَن حَقِيقَة وَاحِدَة وَهِي الْقيام بِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ الرَّسُول ظَاهرا وَبَاطنا
segments.english: And these [are] all expressions of one reality, which [is]: acting upon what the Messenger came with, outwardly and inwardly.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الواحدي وَالْأَكْثَرُونَ على أَن معنى قَوْله لما يحيكم هُوَ الْجِهَاد
segments.english: Al-Wahidi said: and most [scholars hold] that the meaning of His saying 'to what gives you life' [is] striving [in God's cause].

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ قَول ابْن إِسْحَق وَاخْتِيَار أَكثر أهل الْمعَانِي
segments.english: And it [is] the opinion of Ibn Ishaq and the choice of most of the scholars of meaning.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْفراء إِذا دعَاكُمْ إِلَى إحْيَاء أَمركُم بجهاد عَدوكُمْ
segments.english: Al-Farra' said: 'when he calls you' to reviving your affair through striving against your enemy —

segments.arabic: يُرِيد أَن أَمرهم إِنَّمَا يُقَوي بِالْحَرْبِ وَالْجهَاد
segments.english: he means that their affair [is] only strengthened through war and striving.

segments.arabic: فَلَو تركُوا الجهاد ضعف أَمرهم واجترأ عَلَيْهِم عدوهم
segments.english: So if they abandoned striving, their affair [would] weaken and their enemy [would] grow bold against them.

segments.arabic: قلت الْجِهَاد من أعظم مَا يحيهم بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَفِي البرزخ وَفِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: I say: striving [is] among the greatest of what gives them life — in this world, in the intermediate realm, and in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: أما فِي الدُّنْيَا فَإِن قوتهم وقهرهم لعدوهم بِالْجِهَادِ
segments.english: As for in this world, [it is] because their strength and their overpowering of their enemy [is] through striving.

segments.arabic: وَأما فِي البرزخ فقد قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And as for in the intermediate realm, [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَلا تَحْسَبَنَّ﴾
segments.english: "And do not think..."

segments.arabic: ﴿الَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَمْوَاتًا بَلْ أَحْيَاءٌ عِنْدَ رَبهم يرْزقُونَ﴾
segments.english: those who were killed in the path of God [as] dead — rather, [they are] alive with their Lord, [being] provided for
segments.sahih_international: And never think of those who have been killed in the cause of Allah as dead. Rather, they are alive with their Lord, receiving provision,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا فِي الْآخِرَة فَإِن حَظّ الْمُجَاهدين وَالشُّهَدَاء من حَيَاتهَا وَنَعِيمهَا أعظم من حَظّ غَيرهم
segments.english: And as for the Hereafter, then the share of the fighters and the martyrs of its life and its bliss [is] greater than the share of others.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَ ابْن قُتَيْبَة لما يحيكم يَعْنِي الشَّهَادَة
segments.english: And for this [reason], Ibn Qutaybah said: "to what gives you life" — meaning martyrdom.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ بعض الْمُفَسّرين لما يحيكم يَعْنِي الْجنَّة فَإِنَّهَا دَار الْحَيَوَان وفيهَا الْحَيَاة الدائمة الطّيبَة
segments.english: And some of the commentators said: "to what gives you life" — meaning Paradise, for it [is] the abode of [true] life, and in it [is] the lasting, good life.

segments.arabic: حَكَاهُ أَبُو عَليّ الْجِرْجَانِيّ
segments.english: Abu Ali al-Jurjani related this.

segments.arabic: وَالْآيَة تتَنَاوَل هَذَا كُله
segments.english: And the verse covers all of this.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْإِيمَان وَالْإِسْلَام وَالْقُرْآن وَالْجهَاد يحي الْقُلُوب الْحَيَاة الطّيبَة
segments.english: For faith, Islam, the Quran, and striving give the hearts the good life.

segments.arabic: وَكَمَال الْحَيَاة فِي الْجنَّة
segments.english: And the completeness of life [is] in Paradise.

segments.arabic: وَالرَّسُول دَاع إِلَى الْإِيمَان وَإِلَى الْجنَّة فَهُوَ دَاع إِلَى الْحَيَاة فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: And the Messenger [is a] caller to faith and to Paradise, so he [is a] caller to life in this world and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَالْإِنْسَان مُضْطَر إِلَى نَوْعَيْنِ من الْحَيَاة
segments.english: And the human being [is] in need of two types of life:

segments.arabic: حَيَاة بدنه الَّتِي بهَا يدْرك النافع والضار ويؤثر مَا يَنْفَعهُ على مَا يضرّه
segments.english: the life of his body, by which he perceives what [is] beneficial and what [is] harmful, and prefers what benefits him over what harms him.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى نقصت فِيهِ هَذِه الْحَيَاة ناله من الْأَلَم والضعف بِحَسب ذَلِك
segments.english: And whenever this life decreased in him, pain and weakness reached him according to that.

segments.arabic: وَلذَلِك كَانَت حَيَاة الْمَرِيض والمحزون وَصَاحب الْهم وَالْغَم وَالْخَوْف والفقر والذل دون حَيَاة من هُوَ معافى من ذَلِك
segments.english: And for that [reason], the life of the sick person, the grieving one, and the one with worry, sorrow, fear, poverty, and humiliation [was] less than the life of one who [is] free from that.

segments.arabic: وحياة قلبه وروحه الَّتِي بهَا يُمَيّز بَين الْحق وَالْبَاطِل والغي والرشاد والهوى والضلال
segments.english: And [the second is] the life of his heart and his spirit, by which he distinguishes between truth and falsehood, misguidance and right guidance, desire and straying.

segments.arabic: فيختار الْحق على ضِدّه
segments.english: So he chooses the truth over its opposite.

segments.arabic: فتفيده هَذِه الْحَيَاة قُوَّة التميز بَين النافع والضار فِي الْعُلُوم والإرادات والأعمال
segments.english: So this life gives him the strength of distinguishing between what [is] beneficial and what [is] harmful in knowledge, intentions, and actions.

segments.arabic: وتفيده قُوَّة الْإِيمَان والإرادة وَالْحب للحق وَقُوَّة البغض وَالْكَرَاهَة للباطل
segments.english: And it gives him strength of faith, will, and love for the truth, and strength of hatred and dislike for falsehood.

segments.arabic: فشعوره وتمييزه وحبه ونفرته بِحَسب نصِيبه من هَذِه الْحَيَاة
segments.english: So his feeling, his distinguishing, his love, and his aversion [are] according to his share of this life.

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن الْبدن الْحَيّ يكون شعوره وإحساسه بالنافع والمؤلم أتم
segments.english: Just as the living body — its feeling and its sensation of what [is] beneficial and what [is] painful [are] more complete,

segments.arabic: وَيكون ميله إِلَى النافع ونفرته عَن المؤلم أعظم
segments.english: and its inclination toward what [is] beneficial and its aversion from what [is] painful [are] greater.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا بِحَسب حَيَاة الْبدن وَذَاكَ بِحِسَاب حَيَاة الْقلب
segments.english: So this [is] according to the life of the body, and that [is] according to the life of the heart.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا بطلت حَيَاته بَطل تَمْيِيزه
segments.english: So when its life ceases, its distinguishing ceases.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ لَهُ نوع تَمْيِيز لم يكن فِيهِ قُوَّة يُؤثر بهَا النافع على الضار
segments.english: And even if it had some type of distinguishing, it would not have the strength by which it prefers what [is] beneficial over what [is] harmful.

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن الْإِنْسَان لَا حَيَاة لَهُ حَتَّى ينْفخ فِيهِ الْملك الَّذِي هُوَ رَسُول الله من روحه
segments.english: Just as the human has no life until the angel — who [is] the messenger of God — breathes into him from his spirit,

segments.arabic: فَيصير حَيا بذلك النفخ وان كَانَ قبل ذَلِك من جملَة الْأَمْوَات
segments.english: so he becomes alive by that breathing, even though before that he was among the dead.

segments.arabic: فَكَذَلِك لَا حَيَاة لروحه وَقَلبه حَتَّى ينْفخ فِيهِ الرَّسُول من الرّوح الَّذِي ألْقى إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: Likewise, there [is] no life for his spirit and his heart until the Messenger breathes into him from the spirit that was cast upon him.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿يُنَزِّلُ الْمَلائِكَةَ بِالرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ من عباده﴾
segments.english: He sends down the angels with the spirit from His command upon whoever He wills of His servants.
segments.sahih_international: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَى من يَشَاء من عباده﴾
segments.english: He casts the spirit from His command upon whoever He wills of His servants.
segments.sahih_international: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا مَا كُنْتَ تَدْرِي مَا الْكِتَابُ وَلَا الايمان وَلَكِنْ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُورًا نَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ نَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا
segments.english: And likewise We revealed to you [a] spirit from Our command. You did not know what the Book [was] nor faith, but We made it [a] light by which We guide whoever We will of Our servants.
segments.sahih_international: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path -

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر أَن وحيه روح وَنور
segments.english: So He informed that His revelation [is a] spirit and [a] light.

segments.arabic: فالحياة والاستنارة مَوْقُوفَة على نفخ الرَّسُول
segments.english: So life and illumination [are] dependent on the breathing of the Messenger.

segments.arabic: الملكي فَمن أَصَابَهُ نفخ الرَّسُول الملكي وَنفخ الرَّسُول البشري حصلت لَهُ الحياتان
segments.english: the angelic [one]. So whoever [was] reached by the blowing of the angelic messenger and the blowing of the human messenger, the two lives were achieved for him.

segments.arabic: وَمن حصل لَهُ نفخ الْملك دون نفخ الرَّسُول حصلت لَهُ إِحْدَى الحياتين وفاتته الْأُخْرَى
segments.english: And whoever achieved the blowing of the angel without the blowing of the Messenger, one of the two lives was achieved for him and the other escaped him.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَو من كَانَ مَيْتًا فَأَحْيَيْنَاهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُ نُورًا يَمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ كَمَنْ مَثَلُهُ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ لَيْسَ بِخَارِج مِنْهَا﴾
segments.english: Is the one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him [a] light he walks with among the people, like the one whose example [is] in the darknesses, not coming out of them?
segments.sahih_international: And is one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him light by which to walk among the people like one who is in darkness, never to emerge therefrom? Thus it has been made pleasing to the disbelievers that which they were doing.

segments.arabic: فَجمع لَهُ بَين النُّور والحياة
segments.english: So He combined for him between light and life,

segments.arabic: كَمَا جمع لمن أعرض عَن كِتَابه بَين الْمَوْت والظلمة
segments.english: just as He combined for whoever turned away from His Book between death and darkness.

segments.arabic: قَالَ ابْن عَبَّاس وَجَمِيع الْمُفَسّرين كَانَ كَافِرًا ضَالًّا فهديناه
segments.english: Ibn Abbas and all the interpreters said: [he] was [a] disbeliever, astray, so We guided him.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُ نُورًا يَمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ﴾ يتَضَمَّن أمورا
segments.english: And His saying: "and We made for him [a] light he walks with among the people" includes [several] matters.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا أَنه يمشي فِي النَّاس بِالنورِ وهم فِي الظلمَة
segments.english: The first of them [is] that he walks among the people with the light while they [are] in darkness.

segments.arabic: فَمثله وَمثلهمْ كَمثل قوم أظلم عَلَيْهِم اللَّيْل فضلوا وَلم يهتدوا للطريق
segments.english: So his example and their example [is] like [a] people [upon whom] the night darkened, so they went astray and could not find the road.

segments.arabic: وَآخر مَعَه نور يمشي بِهِ فِي الطَّرِيق ويراها وَيرى مَا يحذرهُ فِيهَا
segments.english: And another [person] — with him [is a] light he walks with on the road, seeing it and seeing what to beware of on it.

segments.arabic: وَثَانِيها أَنه يمشي فيهم بنوره فهم يقتبسون مِنْهُ لحاجتهم إِلَى النُّور
segments.english: And the second [is] that he walks among them with his light, so they take from it due to their need for the light.

segments.arabic: وَثَالِثهَا أَنه يمشي بنوره يَوْم الْقِيَامَة على الصِّرَاط
segments.english: And the third [is] that he walks with his light on the Day of Judgment on the Bridge,

segments.arabic: إِذا بَقِي أهل الشّرك والنفاق فِي ظلمات شركهم ونفاقهم
segments.english: when the people of associating partners [with God] and hypocrisy remain in the darknesses of their association and hypocrisy.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يحؤل بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ
segments.english: And His saying: "And know that God comes between [a] person and his heart."

segments.arabic: الْمَشْهُور فِي الْآيَة أَنه يحول بَين الْمُؤمن وَبَين الْكفْر وَبَين الْكَافِر وَبَين الْإِيمَان
segments.english: The well-known [interpretation] of the verse [is] that He comes between the believer and disbelief, and between the disbeliever and faith,

segments.arabic: ويحول بَين أهل طَاعَته وَبَين مَعْصِيَته وَبَين أهل مَعْصِيَته وَبَين طَاعَته
segments.english: and He comes between the people of His obedience and His disobedience, and between the people of His disobedience and His obedience.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا قَول ابْن عَبَّاس وَجُمْهُور الْمُفَسّرين
segments.english: And this [is] the saying of Ibn Abbas and the majority of the interpreters.

segments.arabic: وَفِي الْآيَة قَول آخر أَن الْمَعْنى أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ قريب من قلبه لَا تخفى عَلَيْهِ خافية
segments.english: And regarding the verse [there is] another saying: that the meaning [is] that He, glorified [is] He, [is] close to his heart — nothing hidden [is] concealed from Him.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ بَينه وَبَين قلبه
segments.english: So He [is] between him and his heart.

segments.arabic: ذكره الواحدي عَن قَتَادَة
segments.english: Al-Wahidi mentioned it from Qatadah.

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ هَذَا أنسب بالسياق
segments.english: And this was more fitting with the context,

segments.arabic: لِأَن الاستجابة أَصْلهَا بِالْقَلْبِ فَلَا تَنْفَع الاستجابة بِالْبدنِ دون الْقلب
segments.english: because response — its root [is] in the heart, so response with the body without the heart does not benefit.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الله سُبْحَانَهُ بَين العَبْد وَبَين قلبه فَيعلم هَل اسْتَجَابَ لَهُ قلبه
segments.english: For God, glorified [is] He, [is] between the servant and his heart, so He knows whether his heart responded to Him

segments.arabic: وَهل أضمر ذَلِك أَو أضمر خِلَافه
segments.english: and whether he concealed that or concealed its opposite.

segments.arabic: وعَلى القَوْل الأول فَوجه الْمُنَاسبَة
segments.english: And according to the first saying, the point of connection [is]:

segments.arabic: أَنكُمْ إِن تثاقلتم عَن الاستجابة وأبطأتم عَنْهَا
segments.english: that if you [are] sluggish about responding and slow about it,

segments.arabic: فَلَا تأمنوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنكُم وَبَين قُلُوبكُمْ
segments.english: then do not feel safe that God [will] come between you and your hearts,

segments.arabic: فَلَا يمكنكم بعد ذَلِك من الاستجابة عُقُوبَة لكم على تَركهَا
segments.english: and He [will] not enable you after that to respond — [as a] punishment for you for abandoning it

segments.arabic: بعد وضوح الْحق واستبانته
segments.english: after the truth became clear and evident.

segments.arabic: فَيكون كَقَوْلِه
segments.english: So it would be like His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفْئِدَتَهُمْ وَأَبْصَارَهُمْ كَمَا لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ﴾
segments.english: And We turn their hearts and their eyes, just as they did not believe in it the first time.
segments.sahih_international: And We will turn away their hearts and their eyes just as they refused to believe in it the first time. And We will leave them in their transgression, wandering blindly.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿فَلَمَّا زَاغُوا أَزَاغَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ﴾
segments.english: So when they deviated, God made their hearts deviate.
segments.sahih_international: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allah to you?" And when they deviated, Allah caused their hearts to deviate. And Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

headings.arabic: فائدة جليلة قوله تعالى
headings.english: A Great Benefit — [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿فَمَا كَانُوا لِيُؤْمِنُوا بِمَا كَذَّبُوا مِنْ قبل﴾
segments.english: So they were not [going] to believe in what they had denied before.
segments.sahih_international: Those cities - We relate to you, [O Muhammad], some of their news. And certainly did their messengers come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. Thus does Allah seal over the hearts of the disbelievers.

segments.arabic: فَفِي الْآيَة تحذير عَن ترك الاستجابة بِالْقَلْبِ وان اسْتَجَابَ بالجوارح
segments.english: So in the verse [there is] a warning against leaving off responding with the heart, even if [one] responds with the limbs.

segments.arabic: وَفِي الْآيَة سر آخر وَهُوَ أَنه جمع لَهُم بَين الشَّرْع وَالْأَمر بِهِ وَهُوَ الاستجابة
segments.english: And in the verse [there is] another secret, which [is] that He combined for them between the divine law and the command to [follow] it — which [is] responding —

segments.arabic: وَبَين الْقدر وَالْإِيمَان بِهِ
segments.english: and between divine decree and faith in it.

segments.arabic: فَهِيَ كَقَوْلِه
segments.english: So it [is] like His saying:

segments.arabic: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَسْتَقِيمَ
segments.english: for whoever wills among you to be upright.
segments.sahih_international: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

segments.arabic: وَمَا تشاؤن إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ الله رب الْعَالمين
segments.english: And you [do] not will except that God wills, [the] Lord of the worlds.
segments.sahih_international: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿فَمَنْ شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ
segments.english: So whoever wills [shall] remember it.

segments.arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ الله﴾
segments.english: And they [will] not remember except that God wills.
segments.sahih_international: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.

segments.arabic: وَالله أعلم
segments.english: And God knows best.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة جليلة قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: [A] great benefit. [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَكُمْ
segments.english: Fighting [has been] prescribed upon you, and it [is] hateful to you.
segments.sahih_international: Fighting has been enjoined upon you while it is hateful to you. But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allah Knows, while you know not.

segments.arabic: وَعَسَى أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَعَسَى أَنْ تُحِبُّوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَكُمْ
segments.english: And perhaps you hate [a] thing and it [is] good for you, and perhaps you love [a] thing and it [is] bad for you.

segments.arabic: وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تعلمُونَ﴾
segments.english: And God knows, and you [do] not know.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله ﷿
segments.english: And His saying, Most High:

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَرِهْتُمُوهُنَّ فَعَسَى أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَيَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ خَيْرًا كثيرا
segments.english: And if you hate them, then perhaps you hate [a] thing and God places in it much good.
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, it is not lawful for you to inherit women by compulsion. And do not make difficulties for them in order to take [back] part of what you gave them unless they commit a clear immorality. And live with them in kindness. For if you dislike them - perhaps you dislike a thing and Allah makes therein much good.

segments.arabic: فالآية الأولى فِي الْجِهَاد الَّذِي هُوَ كَمَال الْقُوَّة الغضبية
segments.english: So the first verse [is] about striving, which [is] the perfection of the power of anger.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانيَِة فِي النِّكَاح الَّذِي هُوَ كَمَال الْقُوَّة الشهوانية
segments.english: And the second [is] about marriage, which [is] the perfection of the power of desire.

segments.arabic: فَالْعَبْد يكره مُوَاجهَة عدوه بقوته الغضبية خشيَة على نَفسه مِنْهُ
segments.english: So the servant dislikes facing his enemy with his aggressive strength, out of fear for himself from him.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا الْمَكْرُوه خير لَهُ فِي معاشه ومعاده
segments.english: And this disliked [thing is] good for him in his worldly life and his Return.

segments.arabic: وَيُحب الْمُوَادَعَة والمتاركة وَهَذَا المحبوب شَرّ لَهُ فِي معاشه ومعاده
segments.english: And he loves making peace and leaving [things] alone, and this loved [thing is] bad for him in his worldly life and his Return.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ يكره الْمَرْأَة لوصف من أوصافها وَله فِي إِمْسَاكهَا خير كثير لَا يعرفهُ
segments.english: And likewise, he dislikes [a] woman for [a] trait of her traits, yet for him in keeping her [there is] much good that he [does] not know.

segments.arabic: وَيُحب الْمَرْأَة لوصف من أصافها وَله فِي إِمْسَاكهَا شَرّ كثير لَا يعرفهُ
segments.english: And he loves [a] woman for [a] trait of her traits, yet for him in keeping her [there is] much bad that he [does] not know.

segments.arabic: لانسان كَمَا وَصفه وَصفه بِهِ خالقه ظلوم جهول
segments.english: The human, as his Creator described him, [is] very unjust, very ignorant.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يَنْبَغِي أَن يَجْعَل المعيار على مَا يصره وينفعه ميله وحبه ونفرته وبغضه
segments.english: So he should not make his inclination, his love, his aversion, and his hatred the standard for what harms him and [what] benefits him.

segments.arabic: بل المعيار على ذَلِك مَا اخْتَارَهُ الله لَهُ بأَمْره وَنَهْيه
segments.english: Rather, the standard for that [is] what God chose for him through His command and His prohibition.

segments.arabic: فأنفع الْأَشْيَاء لَهُ على الْإِطْلَاق طَاعَة ربه بِظَاهِرِهِ وباطنه
segments.english: So the most beneficial of things for him, absolutely, [is] obeying his Lord outwardly and inwardly.

segments.arabic: وأضر الْأَشْيَاء عَلَيْهِ على الْإِطْلَاق مَعْصِيَته بِظَاهِرِهِ وباطنه
segments.english: And the most harmful of things for him, absolutely, [is] disobeying Him outwardly and inwardly.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا قَامَ بِطَاعَتِهِ وعبوديته مخلصا لَهُ فَكل مَا يجْرِي عَلَيْهِ مِمَّا يكرههُ يكون خيرا لَهُ
segments.english: So if he stands firm in His obedience and servitude, sincere to Him, then everything that happens to him of what he dislikes [will] be good for him.

segments.arabic: وَذَا تخلى عَن طَاعَته وعبوديته فَكل مَا هُوَ فِيهِ من مَحْبُوب هُوَ شَرّ لَهُ
segments.english: And if he abandons His obedience and servitude, then everything he [is] in of [what is] loved — it [is] bad for him.

segments.arabic: فَمن صحت لَهُ معرفَة ربه وَالْفِقْه فِي أَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاته
segments.english: So whoever has sound knowledge of his Lord and understanding of His names and attributes,

segments.arabic: علم يَقِينا أَن المكروهات الَّتِي تصيبه والمحن لتي تنزل بِهِ فِيهَا
segments.english: [he] knows with certainty that the disliked things that strike him and the trials that descend upon him — in them [is]

segments.arabic: ضروب من الْمصَالح وَالْمَنَافِع الَّتِي لَا يحصيها علمه وَلَا فكرته
segments.english: types of benefits and advantages that his knowledge and thought cannot count

segments.arabic: بل مصلحَة العَبْد فِيمَا يكره أعظم مِنْهَا فِيمَا يحب
segments.english: rather, the benefit of the servant in what he dislikes [is] greater than it in what he likes

segments.arabic: فعامة مصَالح النُّفُوس فِي مكروهاتها
segments.english: so most of the benefits of souls [are] in what they dislike

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن عَامَّة مضارها وَأَسْبَاب هلكتها فِي محبوباتها
segments.english: just as most of their harms and the causes of their destruction [are] in what they love

segments.arabic: فَانْظُر إِلَى غارس جنَّة من الجنات خَبِير بالفلاحة
segments.english: so look at [a] planter of [a] garden from among gardens, skilled in farming

segments.arabic: غرس جنَّة وتعاهدها بالسقي والإصلاح حَتَّى أثمرت أشجارها
segments.english: [he] planted [a] garden and tended it with watering and care until its trees bore fruit

segments.arabic: فَأقبل عَلَيْهَا يفصل أوصالها وَيقطع أَغْصَانهَا
segments.english: then he turned to it, separating its joints and cutting its branches

segments.arabic: لعلمه أَنَّهَا لَو خليّت على حَالهَا لم تطب ثَمَرَتهَا
segments.english: because he knew that if [they] were left in their state, their fruit would not be good

segments.arabic: فيطعمها من شَجَرَة طيبَة الثَّمَرَة
segments.english: so he grafts them from [a] tree [with] good fruit

segments.arabic: حَتَّى إِذا التحمت بهَا واتحدت وأعطت ثَمَرَتهَا
segments.english: until when [the graft] joined with it and merged and gave its fruit

segments.arabic: أقبل يقلمها وَيقطع أَغْصَانهَا الضعيفة الَّتِي تذْهب قوتها
segments.english: he turned to pruning it and cutting its weak branches that drain its strength

segments.arabic: ويذيقها ألم الْقطع وَالْحَدِيد لمصلحتها وكمالها
segments.english: and he makes it taste the pain of cutting and iron for its benefit and perfection

segments.arabic: لتصلح ثَمَرَتهَا أَن تكون بِحَضْرَة الْمُلُوك
segments.english: so that its fruit becomes fit to be in the presence of kings

segments.arabic: ثمَّ لَا يَدعهَا ودواعي طبعها من الشّرْب كل وَقت
segments.english: then he does not leave it to the urges of its nature — drinking at every moment

segments.arabic: بل يعطشها وقتا ويسقيها وقتا
segments.english: rather he makes it thirst [for a] time and waters it [for a] time

segments.arabic: وَلَا يتْرك المَاء عَلَيْهَا دَائِما وَإِن كَانَ ذَلِك أَنْضَرُ لورقها وأسرع لنباتها
segments.english: and he does not leave the water on it constantly, even though that [would be] fresher for its leaves and faster for its growth

segments.arabic: ثمَّ يعمد إِلَى تِلْكَ الزِّينَة الَّتِي زينت بهَا من الأوراق فيلقي عَنْهَا كثيرا مِنْهَا
segments.english: then he goes to that adornment that it was decorated with — the leaves — and strips away many of them from it

segments.arabic: لِأَن تِلْكَ الزِّينَة تحول بَين ثَمَرَتهَا وَبَين كَمَال نضجها واستوائها
segments.english: because that adornment stands between its fruit and the completeness of its ripening and evenness

segments.arabic: كَمَا فِي شجر الْعِنَب وَنَحْوه
segments.english: as [is the case] with grapevines and the like

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ يقطع أعضاءها بالحديد ويلقي عَنْهَا كثيرا من زينتها
segments.english: so he cuts its limbs with iron and strips away much of its adornment

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ عين مصلحتها
segments.english: and that [is] the very essence of its benefit

segments.arabic: فَلَو أَنَّهَا ذَات تَمْيِيز وَإِدْرَاك كالحيوان
segments.english: so if it had awareness and perception like [an] animal

segments.arabic: لتوهمت أَن ذَلِك إِفْسَاد لَهَا وإضرار بهَا
segments.english: it would have imagined that this [was] corruption of it and harm to it

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ عين مصلحتها
segments.english: but it [is] the very essence of its benefit

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ الْأَب الشفيق على وَلَده الْعَالم بمصلحته
segments.english: and likewise the father [who is] compassionate toward his child, [and] knowing of what benefits him

segments.arabic: إِذا رأى مصْلحَته فِي إِخْرَاج الدَّم الْفَاسِد عَنهُ بضع جلده وَقطع عروقه وأذاقه الْأَلَم الشَّديد
segments.english: when he sees his benefit in removing the bad blood from him, he cuts his skin and opens his veins and makes him taste severe pain

segments.arabic: وَإِن رأى شفاءه فِي قطع عُضْو من أَعْضَائِهِ أبانه عَنهُ
segments.english: and if he sees his cure in cutting off [a] limb from his limbs, he separates it from him

segments.arabic: كَانَ ذَلِك رَحْمَة بِهِ وشفقة عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: that [was] mercy toward him and compassion for him

segments.arabic: وَإِن رأى مصْلحَته فِي أَن يمسك عَنهُ الْعَطاء لم يُعْطه وَلم يُوسع عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and if he sees his benefit in withholding [the] giving from him, he does not give him and does not spend freely on him

segments.arabic: لعلمه أَن ذَلِك أكبر الْأَسْبَاب إِلَى فَسَاده وهلاكه
segments.english: because he knows that this [is] the greatest of causes leading to his corruption and destruction

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ يمنعهُ كثيرا من شهواته حمية لَهُ ومصلحة لَا بخلا عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and likewise he prevents him from many of his desires — [as] protection for him and [a] benefit, not [out of] stinginess toward him

segments.arabic: فأحكم الْحَاكِمين وأرحم الرَّاحِمِينَ وَأعلم الْعَالمين
segments.english: so the wisest of judges, the most merciful of those who show mercy, and the most knowing of the knowledgeable

segments.arabic: الَّذِي هُوَ أرْحم بعباده مِنْهُم بِأَنْفسِهِم وَمن آبَائِهِم وأمهاتهم
segments.english: the One who [is] more merciful to His servants than they [are] to themselves, and [more] than their fathers and mothers

segments.arabic: إِذا أنزل بهم مَا يكْرهُونَ كَانَ خيرا لَهُم من أَن لَا ينزله بهم
segments.english: when He sends down upon them what they dislike, it [is] better for them than [if] He did not send it down upon them

segments.arabic: نظرا مِنْهُ لَهُم وإحسانا إِلَيْهِم ولطفا بهم
segments.english: [as] care from Him for them, and kindness to them, and gentleness with them

segments.arabic: وَلَو مكنوا من الاختيار لأَنْفُسِهِمْ
segments.english: and if they were given the choice for themselves

segments.arabic: لعجزوا عَن الْقيام بمصالحهم علما وَإِرَادَة وَعَملا
segments.english: they would have been unable to manage their own interests — in knowledge, will, and action.

segments.arabic: لكنه سُبْحَانَهُ تولى تَدْبِير أُمُورهم بِمُوجب علمه وحكمته وَرَحمته
segments.english: But He, glorified [is] He, took charge of managing their affairs according to His knowledge, His wisdom, and His mercy —

segments.arabic: أَحبُّوا أم كَرهُوا
segments.english: whether they liked [it] or disliked [it].

segments.arabic: فَعرف ذَلِك الموقنون بأسمائه وَصِفَاته
segments.english: So those with certainty in His names and attributes recognized that,

segments.arabic: فَلم يتهموه فِي شَيْء من أَحْكَامه
segments.english: and they did not accuse Him in anything of His rulings.

segments.arabic: وخفي ذَلِك على الْجَهْل بِهِ وبأسمائه وَصِفَاته
segments.english: And that was hidden from those ignorant of Him and of His names and attributes,

segments.arabic: فنازعوه تَدْبيره وقدحوا فِي حكمته
segments.english: so they disputed His management and criticized His wisdom,

segments.arabic: وَلم ينقادوا لحكمه وعارضوا حكمه بعقولهم الْفَاسِدَة وآرائهم الْبَاطِلَة وسياساتهم الجائرة
segments.english: and they did not submit to His ruling, and they opposed His ruling with their corrupt minds, their false opinions, and their unjust policies.

segments.arabic: فَلَا لرَبهم عرفُوا وَلَا لمصالحهم حصلوا
segments.english: So neither did they know their Lord, nor did they achieve their interests.

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُوفق
segments.english: And God [is] the One who grants success.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى ظفر العَبْد بِهَذِهِ الْمعرفَة
segments.english: And whenever the servant attains this knowledge,

segments.arabic: سكن فِي الدُّنْيَا قبل الْآخِرَة فِي جنَّة لَا يشبه فِيهَا إِلَّا نعيم الْآخِرَة
segments.english: he dwells in this world before the Hereafter in [a] paradise that nothing resembles except the bliss of the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لَا يزَال رَاضِيا عَن ربه
segments.english: For he never ceases [being] pleased with his Lord.

segments.arabic: وَالرِّضَا جنَّة الدُّنْيَا ومستراح العارفين
segments.english: And contentment [is] the paradise of this world and the resting place of the knowers.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ طيب النَّفس بِمَا يجْرِي عَلَيْهِ من الْمَقَادِير الَّتِي هِيَ عين اخْتِيَار الله لَهُ
segments.english: For it [is] the ease of the self with what befalls him of the decrees, which [are] the very choice of God for him,

segments.arabic: وطمأنينتها إِلَى أَحْكَامه الدِّينِيَّة
segments.english: and its tranquility toward His religious rulings.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا هُوَ الرِّضَا بِاللَّه رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دينا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولا
segments.english: And this — it [is] contentment with God [as] Lord, with Islam [as] religion, and with Muhammad [as] messenger.

segments.arabic: وَمَا ذاق طعم الْإِيمَان من لم يحصل لَهُ ذَلِك
segments.english: And [he has] not tasted the taste of faith — whoever has not achieved that.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا الرِّضَا هُوَ بِحَسب مَعْرفَته بِعدْل الله وحكمته وَرَحمته وَحسن اخْتِيَاره
segments.english: And this contentment — it [is] according to his knowledge of the justice of God, His wisdom, His mercy, and the goodness of His choice.

segments.arabic: فَكلما كَانَ بذلك أعرف كَانَ بِهِ أرْضى
segments.english: So the more he knew of that, the more he [was] content with Him.

segments.arabic: فقضاء الرب سُبْحَانَهُ فِي عَبده دائر بَين الْعدْل والمصلحة وَالْحكمَة وَالرَّحْمَة
segments.english: So the decree of the Lord, glorified [is] He, concerning His servant revolves between justice, benefit, wisdom, and mercy.

segments.arabic: لَا يخرج عَن ذَلِك الْبَتَّةَ
segments.english: [It] never departs from that at all.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ فِي الدُّعَاء الْمَشْهُور
segments.english: As he ﷺ said in the well-known supplication:

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبدك ابْن عَبدك ابْن أمتك
segments.english: "O God, I [am] Your servant, [the] son of Your servant, [the] son of Your female servant.

segments.arabic: ناصيتي بِيَدِك مَاض فِيَّ حكمك عدل فِيَّ قضاؤك
segments.english: My forelock [is] in Your hand, Your ruling over me [is] effective, Your decree concerning me [is] just.

segments.arabic: أَسأَلك بِكُل اسْم هُوَ لَك سميت بِهِ نَفسك أَو أنزلته فِي كتابك
segments.english: I ask You by every name that [is] Yours — [that] You named Yourself with, or sent [it] down in Your Book,

segments.arabic: أَو علّمته أحدا من خلقك أَو استأثرت بِهِ فِي علم الْغَيْب عنْدك
segments.english: or taught [it to] anyone of Your creation, or kept [it] exclusively in the knowledge of the unseen with You —

segments.arabic: أَن تجْعَل الْقُرْآن ربيع قلبِي وَنور صَدْرِي وجلاء حزني وَذَهَاب همي وغمي
segments.english: that You make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the removal of my sadness, and the departure of my worry and grief."

segments.arabic: مَا قَالَهَا أحد قطّ إِلَّا أذهب الله همه وغمه وأبدله مَكَانَهُ فرجا
segments.english: No one ever said it except [that] God removed his worry and grief, and replaced [them] in their place [with] relief.

segments.arabic: قَالُوا أَفلا نتعلمهن يَا رَسُول الله
segments.english: They said: "Should we not learn them, O Messenger of God?"

segments.arabic: قَالَ بلى يَنْبَغِي لمن يسمعهن أَن يتعلمهن
segments.english: He said: "Yes indeed! It [is] fitting for whoever hears them to learn them."

segments.arabic: وَالْمَقْصُود قَوْله عدل فِيَّ قضاؤك
segments.english: And the point [is] his saying: "Your decree concerning me [is] just."

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يتَنَاوَل كل قَضَاء يَقْضِيه على عَبده من عُقُوبَة أَو ألم وَسبب ذَلِك
segments.english: And this covers every decree He decrees upon His servant — of punishment or pain — and the cause of that.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ الَّذِي قضى بِالسَّبَبِ وَقضى بالمسبب
segments.english: For He [is] the One who decreed the cause and decreed the effect,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ عدل فِي هَذَا الْقَضَاء
segments.english: and He [is] just in this decree.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا الْقَضَاء خير لِلْمُؤمنِ
segments.english: And this decree [is] good for the believer,

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ وَالَّذِي نَفسِي بِيَدِهِ لَا يقْضِي الله لِلْمُؤمنِ قَضَاء إِلَّا كَانَ خيرا لَهُ
segments.english: as he ﷺ said: "By the One in whose hand [is] my soul, God does not decree [a] decree for the believer except [that] it [is] good for him,

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ ذَلِك إِلَّا لِلْمُؤمنِ
segments.english: and that [is] only for the believer."

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْعَلامَة ابْن الْقيم فَسَأَلت شَيخنَا هَل يدْخل فِي ذَلِك قَضَاء الذَّنب
segments.english: The scholar Ibn al-Qayyim said: "I asked our teacher: does the decree of sin fall under that?"

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ نعم بِشَرْطِهِ
segments.english: He said: "Yes, with its condition."

segments.arabic: إِمَّا من فَسَاد فِي الْإِيمَان وَإِمَّا من فَسَاد فِي الْعقل
segments.english: either from corruption in faith, or from corruption in the mind.

segments.arabic: وَمَا أَكثر مَا يكون مِنْهُمَا
segments.english: And how often it [is] from both of them!

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا نبذها رَسُول الله وَرَاء ظَهره هُوَ وَأَصْحَابه
segments.english: And for this [reason], the Messenger of God threw it behind his back — he and his companions —

segments.arabic: وصرفوا عَنْهَا قُلُوبهم وأطرحوها
segments.english: and they turned their hearts away from it and cast it aside,

segments.arabic: وَلم يألفوها وهجروها وَلم يميلوا إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: and they did not grow attached to it, and they abandoned it, and they did not lean toward it,

segments.arabic: وعدّوها سجنا لَا جنّة
segments.english: and they considered it [a] prison, not [a] garden.

segments.arabic: فزهدوا فِيهَا حَقِيقَة الزّهْد
segments.english: So they renounced it with true renunciation.

segments.arabic: وَلَو أرادوها لنالوا مِنْهَا كل مَحْبُوب
segments.english: And had they wanted it, they would have gained from it every beloved [thing],

segments.arabic: لوصلوا مِنْهَا إِلَى كل مَرْغُوب
segments.english: [and] they would have reached through it every desired [thing].

segments.arabic: فقد عرضت عَلَيْهِ مَفَاتِيح كنوزها فردّها
segments.english: For the keys of its treasures were offered to him, but he refused them.

segments.arabic: وفاضت على أَصْحَابه فآثروا بهَا وَلم يبيعوا حظهم من الْآخِرَة بهَا
segments.english: And it overflowed upon his companions, so they gave it away and did not sell their share of the Hereafter for it.

segments.arabic: وَعَلمُوا أَنَّهَا معبر وممر لَا دَار مقَام ومستقر
segments.english: And they knew that it [is] [a] crossing and [a] passage, not [a] place of staying and settling,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهَا دَار عبور لَا دَار سرُور
segments.english: and that it [is] [a] place of passing, not [a] place of joy,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهَا سَحَابَة صيف تنقشع عَن قَلِيل
segments.english: and that it [is] [a] summer cloud that clears away after [a] short while,

segments.arabic: وخيال طيف مَا استتم الزِّيَارَة حَتَّى آذن بالرحيل
segments.english: and [a] shadow of [a] phantom that did not complete [its] visit before announcing departure.

segments.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِي مَالِي وللدنيا
segments.english: The Prophet said: "What [have] I [to do] with this world?

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَنا كراكب قَالَ فِي ظلّ شَجَرَة ثمَّ رَاح وَتركهَا
segments.english: I [am] only like [a] rider [who] rested in the shade of [a] tree, then left and abandoned it."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ مَا الدُّنْيَا فِي الْآخِرَة إِلَّا كَمَا يدْخل أحدكُم إصبعه فِي اليم
segments.english: And he said: "This world compared to the Hereafter [is] nothing but like when one of you dips his finger in the sea —

segments.arabic: فَلْينْظر بِمَا ترجع
segments.english: so let him see what it comes back with."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ خَالِقهَا سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: And its Creator, glorified [is] He, said:

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا مثل حَيَاة الدُّنْيَا كَمَاءٍ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ النَّاسُ وَالْأَنْعَامُ
segments.english: The example of the life of this world [is] only like water [that] We sent down from the sky, so the plants of the earth mixed with it — from what people and livestock eat —
segments.sahih_international: The example of [this] worldly life is but like rain which We have sent down from the sky that the plants of the earth absorb - [those] from which men and livestock eat - until, when the earth has taken on its adornment and is beautified and its people suppose that they have capability over it, there comes to it Our command by night or by day, and We make it as a harvest, as if it had not flourished yesterday. Thus do We explain in detail the signs for a people who give thought.

segments.arabic: حَتَّى إِذَا أَخَذَتِ الْأَرْضُ زُخْرُفَهَا وَازَّيَّنَتْ وَظَنَّ أَهْلُهَا أَنَّهُمْ قَادِرُونَ عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: until when the earth took on its beauty and [was] adorned, and its people thought that they [were] in control of it —

segments.arabic: أَتَاهَا أَمْرُنَا لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًا فَجَعَلْنَاهَا حَصِيدًا كَأَنْ لَمْ تَغْنَ بِالْأَمْسِ
segments.english: Our command came to it by night or by day, and We made it [a] harvest as if it had not flourished yesterday.

segments.arabic: كَذَلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْآياتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
segments.english: Like that We explain the signs for [a] people who reflect.

segments.arabic: وَاللَّهُ يَدْعُو إِلَى دَار السَّلَام وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
segments.english: And God calls to the Abode of Peace, and He guides whom He wills to [a] straight path.
segments.sahih_international: And Allah invites to the Home of Peace and guides whom He wills to a straight path

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر عَن خسة الدُّنْيَا وزهَّد فِيهَا
segments.english: So He told about the lowliness of this world and [made people] renounce it,

segments.arabic: وَأخْبر عَن دَار السَّلَام ودعا إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: and He told about the Abode of Peace and called [people] to it.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَثَلَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَاءٍ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ
segments.english: And strike for them the example of the life of this world: like water [that] We sent down from the sky, so the plants of the earth mixed with it,
segments.sahih_international: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allah is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability.

segments.arabic: فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ الرِّيَاحُ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ على كل شَيْء مُقْتَدِرًا
segments.english: then it became dry debris [that] the winds scatter. And God [is] over everything fully capable.

segments.arabic: الْمَالُ وَالْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: Wealth and children [are] the beauty of the life of this world,
segments.sahih_international: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope.

segments.arabic: وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخير أملا
segments.english: but the lasting good deeds [are] better with your Lord in reward and better in hope.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: اعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلادِ
segments.english: Know that the life of this world [is] only play and amusement and beauty and boasting among you and competition in wealth and children —
segments.sahih_international: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.

segments.arabic: كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ الْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَامًا
segments.english: like the example of [a] rain whose plants amazed the farmers, then it dries up and you see it turning yellow, then it becomes broken debris.

segments.arabic: وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانٌ
segments.english: And in the Hereafter [there is] severe punishment and forgiveness from God and [His] pleasure.

segments.arabic: وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَتَاع الْغرُور
segments.english: And the life of this world [is] nothing but the enjoyment of delusion.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وزين لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ الشَّهَوَاتِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ وَالْبَنِينَ وَالْقَنَاطِيرِ الْمُقَنْطَرَةِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ
segments.english: Beautified for people [is] the love of desires: of women and children and heaped-up piles of gold and silver,
segments.sahih_international: Beautified for people is the love of that which they desire - of women and sons, heaped-up sums of gold and silver, fine branded horses, and cattle and tilled land. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, but Allah has with Him the best return.

segments.arabic: وَالْخَيْلِ الْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ وَالْحَرْثِ ذَلِكَ مَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: and fine horses and livestock and farmland. That [is] the enjoyment of the life of this world,

segments.arabic: وَالله وَعِنْده حُسْنُ
segments.english: but God — with Him [is] the best

segments.arabic: المآب
segments.english: the [place of] return.

segments.arabic: قل أؤنتبكم بِخَير مِنْكُم
segments.english: Say, "Shall I inform you of [something] better than that?"

segments.arabic: لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا
segments.english: For those who [were] God-conscious, with their Lord [are] gardens beneath which rivers flow, dwelling in them forever,
segments.sahih_international: Say, "Shall I inform you of [something] better than that? For those who fear Allah will be gardens in the presence of their Lord beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally, and purified spouses and approval from Allah. And Allah is Seeing of [His] servants -

segments.arabic: وَأَزْوَاجٌ مُطَهَّرَةٌ وَرِضْوَانٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بالعباد
segments.english: and purified spouses, and pleasure from God. And God [is] All-Seeing of the servants.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَفَرِحُوا بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا الْحَيَاة الدُّنْيَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَاعٌ﴾
segments.english: "And they rejoiced in the life of this world, and the life of this world compared to the Hereafter [is] nothing but [a passing] enjoyment."
segments.sahih_international: Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment.

segments.arabic: وَقد توعّد سُبْحَانَهُ أعظم الْوَعيد لمن رَضِي بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَاطْمَأَنَّ بهَا
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, [has] made the greatest threat to whoever [is] pleased with the life of this world and [is] settled in it,

segments.arabic: وغفل عَن آيَاته وَلم يرج لقاءه فَقَالَ
segments.english: and [is] heedless of His signs and does not hope for His meeting. So He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا وَرَضُوا بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَاطْمَأَنُّوا بِهَا وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ آيَاتِنَا غَافِلُونَ
segments.english: "Indeed, those who do not hope for Our meeting and [are] pleased with the life of this world and [are] settled in it, and those who — they [are] heedless of Our signs —"
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, those who do not expect the meeting with Us and are satisfied with the life of this world and feel secure therein and those who are heedless of Our signs

segments.arabic: أُولَئِكَ مَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ﴾
segments.english: "those — their refuge [is] the Fire because of what they used to earn."
segments.sahih_international: For those their refuge will be the Fire because of what they used to earn.

segments.arabic: وعيّر سُبْحَانَهُ من رَضِي بالدنيا من الْمُؤمنِينَ فَقَالَ
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, rebuked whoever [was] pleased with this world among the believers, so He said:

segments.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مالكم إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمُ انْفِرُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ اثَّاقَلْتُمْ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ
segments.english: "O you who believe, what [is wrong] with you? When it [was] said to you, 'March forth in the way of God,' you clung heavily to the ground."
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, what is [the matter] with you that, when you are told to go forth in the cause of Allah, you adhere heavily to the earth? Are you satisfied with the life of this world rather than the Hereafter? But what is the enjoyment of worldly life compared to the Hereafter except a [very] little.

segments.arabic: أَرَضِيتُمْ بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا مِنَ الْآخِرَةِ فَمَا مَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا فِي الْآخِرَة الا قَلِيل
segments.english: "[Are] you pleased with the life of this world instead of the Hereafter? The enjoyment of the life of this world compared to the Hereafter [is] nothing but little."

segments.arabic: وعَلى قدر رَغْبَة العَبْد فِي الدُّنْيَا وَرضَاهُ بهَا يكون تثاقله عَن طَاعَة الله وَطلب الْآخِرَة
segments.english: And to the degree of the servant's desire for this world and his contentment with it [will be] his heaviness in obeying God and seeking the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَيَكْفِي فِي بالزهد فِي الدُّنْيَا قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And sufficient regarding renouncing this world [is] the saying of [God] Most High:

segments.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ مَتَّعْنَاهُمْ سِنِينَ
segments.english: "Have you seen — if We let them enjoy [themselves] for years,"

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ جَاءَهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ
segments.english: "then there came to them what they used to be promised —"
segments.sahih_international: And then there came to them that which they were promised?

segments.arabic: مَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يتمتعون
segments.english: "what [would] it benefit them, what they used to enjoy?"
segments.sahih_international: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: وَيَوْم نحشرهم كَأَنْ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا سَاعَة من النَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ
segments.english: "And [on] the day We gather them, [it will be] as if they had not stayed except [for] an hour of the day, recognizing one another."
segments.sahih_international: And on the Day when He will gather them, [it will be] as if they had not remained [in the world] but an hour of the day, [and] they will know each other. Those will have lost who denied the meeting with Allah and were not guided

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لم يلبثوا إِلَّا سَاعَة من نَهَارٍ
segments.english: "As if they, the day they see what they [are] promised, had not stayed except [for] an hour of [a] day."
segments.sahih_international: So be patient, [O Muhammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?

segments.arabic: بَلاغٌ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ
segments.english: "[This is] a message. So will any be destroyed except the disobedient people?"

segments.arabic: وَقَوله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And His saying, Most High:

segments.arabic: يَسْأَلونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا
segments.english: "They ask you about the Hour — when [is] its arrival?"
segments.sahih_international: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

segments.arabic: فِيمَ أَنْتَ مِنْ ذِكْرَاهَا
segments.english: "What [have] you [to do] with mentioning it?"

segments.arabic: إِلَى رَبِّكَ مُنْتَهَاهَا
segments.english: "To your Lord [is] its final end."

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُنْذِرُ مَنْ يَخْشَاهَا
segments.english: "You [are] only [a] warner of whoever fears it."
segments.sahih_international: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

segments.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا الا عَشِيَّة اوضحاها
segments.english: "As if they, the day they see it, had not stayed except [for] an evening or its morning."
segments.sahih_international: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوا غَيْرَ سَاعَة﴾
segments.english: "And [on] the day the Hour arrives, the criminals [will] swear they had not stayed more than an hour."
segments.sahih_international: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
segments.english: "He [will] say, 'How many years did you stay on the earth?'"
segments.sahih_international: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"

segments.arabic: قَالُوا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فاسْأَلِ العادِّين
segments.english: "They [will] say, 'We stayed [for] a day or part of a day, so ask those who count.'"
segments.sahih_international: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."

segments.arabic: قَالَ إِنْ لَبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تعلمُونَ﴾
segments.english: "He [will] say, 'You stayed only [a] little — if only you had known.'"
segments.sahih_international: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ وَنَحْشُرُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ زُرْقًا
segments.english: "The trumpet [will be] blown, and We [will] gather the criminals that day, blue-eyed."
segments.sahih_international: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.

segments.arabic: يَتَخَافَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِنْ لَبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًا
segments.english: "They [will] whisper among themselves, 'You stayed only ten [days].'"
segments.sahih_international: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."

segments.arabic: نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِنْ لَبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا
segments.english: "We [are] most knowing of what they say, when the most upright of them in way says, 'You stayed only [a] day.'"
segments.sahih_international: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان وَعَلِيهِ التكلان
segments.english: And God [is] the One from whom help [is] sought, and upon Him [is] reliance.

headings.arabic: قاعدة أساس كل خير أن تعلم أن ما شاء الله كان وما لم
headings.english: A Principle: The Foundation of Every Good [Is] That You Know That Whatever God Willed [Will] Happen and Whatever He Did Not

segments.arabic: قَاعِدَة أساس كل خير أَن تعلم أَن مَا شَاءَ الله كَانَ وَمَا لم يَشَأْ لم يكن
segments.english: [A] principle: the foundation of every good [is] that you know that whatever God willed [will] happen, and whatever He did not will [will] not happen.

segments.arabic: فتيقن حِينَئِذٍ أَن الْحَسَنَات من نعمه فتشكره عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: So be certain then that good deeds [are] from His blessings, and you thank Him for them,

segments.arabic: وتتضرّع إِلَيْهِ أَن لَا يقطعهَا عَنْك
segments.english: and humbly ask Him not to cut them off from you,

segments.arabic: وَأَن السَّيِّئَات من خذلانه وعقوبته
segments.english: and [know] that bad deeds [are] from His abandonment and His punishment,

segments.arabic: فتبتهل إِلَيْهِ أَن يحول بَيْنك وَبَينهَا
segments.english: so you plead to Him to come between you and them,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يكلك فِي فعل الْحَسَنَات وَترك السَّيِّئَات إِلَى نَفسك
segments.english: and not leave you to yourself in doing good deeds and leaving bad deeds.

segments.arabic: وَقد أجمع العارفون على أَن كل خير فأصله بِتَوْفِيق الله للْعَبد
segments.english: And the knowers have agreed that every good — its origin [is] by God's granting success to the servant,

segments.arabic: وكل شَرّ فأصله خذلانه لعَبْدِهِ
segments.english: and every evil — its origin [is] His abandonment of His servant.

segments.arabic: وَأَجْمعُوا أَن التَّوْفِيق أَن لَا يكلك الله نفسك
segments.english: And they agreed that [divine] success [is] that God does not leave you to yourself,

segments.arabic: وان الخذلان أَن يخلي بَيْنك وَبَين نَفسك
segments.english: and that abandonment [is] that He leaves you alone with yourself.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَ كل خير فأصله التَّوْفِيق وَهُوَ بيد الله لَا بيد العَبْد
segments.english: So if every good — its origin [is] [divine] success, and it [is] in God's hand, not in the servant's hand,

segments.arabic: فمفتاحه الدُّعَاء والافتقار وَصدق اللجأ وَالرَّغْبَة والرهبة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: then its key [is] supplication, neediness, sincere turning [to Him], hope, and fear of Him.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى أعْطى العَبْد هَذَا الْمِفْتَاح فقد أَرَادَ أَن يفتح لَهُ
segments.english: So whenever the servant [is] given this key, [God] has intended to open for him,

segments.arabic: وَمَتى أضلّه عَن الْمِفْتَاح بَقِي بَاب الْخَيْر مُرْتَجًا دونه
segments.english: and whenever He leads him away from the key, the door of good remains shut before him.

segments.arabic: قَالَ أَمِير الْمُؤمنِينَ عمر بن الْخطاب
segments.english: The Commander of the Believers, Umar ibn al-Khattab, said:

segments.arabic: إِنِّي لَا أحمل هم الْإِجَابَة وَلَكِن هم الدُّعَاء
segments.english: "I do not carry the worry of [the] answer, but [rather] the worry of supplication.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا ألهمت الدُّعَاء فَإِن الْإِجَابَة مَعَه
segments.english: For if I [am] inspired [with] supplication, then the answer [is] with it."

segments.arabic: وعَلى قدر نية العَبْد وهمته وَمرَاده ورغبته فِي ذَلِك يكون توفيقه سُبْحَانَهُ وإعانته
segments.english: And according to the measure of the servant's intention, determination, aim, and desire in that [is] His — glorified [is] He — granting success and His help.

segments.arabic: فالمعونة من الله تنزل على الْعباد على قدر هممهم وثباتهم ورغبتهم ورهبتهم
segments.english: So help from God descends upon the servants according to the measure of their determination, steadfastness, hope, and fear,

segments.arabic: والخذلان ينزل عَلَيْهِم على حسب ذَلِك
segments.english: and abandonment descends upon them according to that.

segments.arabic: فَالله سُبْحَانَهُ أحكم الْحَاكِمين وَأعلم الْعَالمين
segments.english: For God — glorified [is] He — [is] the wisest of judges and the most knowing of [all] who know.

segments.arabic: يضع التَّوْفِيق فِي موَاضعه اللائقة بِهِ والخذلان فِي موَاضعه اللائقة بِهِ
segments.english: He places [divine] success in its fitting places, and abandonment in its fitting places.

segments.arabic: هُوَ الْعَلِيم الْحَكِيم
segments.english: He [is] the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

segments.arabic: وَمَا أُتِي من أُتِي إِلَّا من قِبَل إِضَاعَة الشُّكْر وإهمال الافتقار وَالدُّعَاء
segments.english: And no one who was ruined [was] ruined except because of wasting gratitude and neglecting neediness and supplication.

segments.arabic: وَلَا ظفر من ظفر بِمَشِيئَة الله وعونه إِلَّا بقيامه بالشكر وَصدق الافتقار وَالدُّعَاء
segments.english: And no one who succeeded — by God's will and help — succeeded except by upholding gratitude and sincere neediness and supplication.

segments.arabic: وملاك ذَلِك الصَّبْر
segments.english: And the foundation of that [is] patience,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ من الْإِيمَان بِمَنْزِلَة الرَّأْس من الْجَسَد
segments.english: for it [is] to faith like the position of the head to the body.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا قطع الرَّأْس فَلَا بَقَاء للجسد
segments.english: And if the head [is] cut off, there [is] no survival for the body.

segments.arabic: مَا ضرب عبد بعقوبة أعظم من قسوة الْقلب والبعد عَن الله
segments.english: No servant [is] struck with [a] punishment greater than hardness of the heart and distance from God.

segments.arabic: خلقت النَّار لإذابة الْقُلُوب القاسية
segments.english: The Fire was created to melt the hard hearts.

segments.arabic: أبعد الْقُلُوب من الله الْقلب القاسي
segments.english: The farthest of hearts from God [is] the hard heart.

segments.arabic: إِذا قسي الْقلب قحطت الْعين
segments.english: When the heart hardens, the eye dries up.

segments.arabic: قسوة الْقلب من أَرْبَعَة أَشْيَاء إِذا جَاوَزت قدر الْحَاجة الْأكل وَالنَّوْم وَالْكَلَام والمخالطة كَمَا
segments.english: Hardness of the heart [is] from four things when they exceed the measure of need: eating, sleeping, talking, and socializing. Just as —

segments.arabic: أَن الْبدن إِذا مرض لم ينفع فِيهِ الطَّعَام وَالشرَاب
segments.english: That the body, when it gets sick, food and drink do not benefit it.

segments.arabic: فَكَذَلِك الْقلب إِذا مرض بالشهوات لم تنجع فِيهِ المواعظ
segments.english: So likewise the heart, when it gets sick with desires, reminders do not take effect in it.

segments.arabic: وَمن أَرَادَ صفاء قلبه فليؤثر الله على شَهْوَته
segments.english: And whoever wants the purity of his heart, let him prefer God over his desire.

segments.arabic: الْقُلُوب الْمُتَعَلّقَة بالشهوات محجوبة عَن الله بِقدر تعلقهَا بهَا
segments.english: Hearts attached to desires [are] veiled from God to the extent of their attachment to them.

segments.arabic: الْقُلُوب آنِية الله فِي أرضه
segments.english: Hearts [are] the vessels of God on His earth.

segments.arabic: فأحبها إِلَيْهِ أرقها وأصلبها وأصفاها
segments.english: So the most beloved of them to Him [are] the softest, the firmest, and the purest of them.

segments.arabic: شغلوا قُلُوبهم بالدنيا
segments.english: They busied their hearts with this world.

segments.arabic: وَلَو شغلوها بِاللَّه وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة لجالت فِي مَعَاني كَلَامه وآياته المشهودة
segments.english: And had they busied them with God and the abode of the Hereafter, they would have roamed through the meanings of His words and His witnessed signs,

segments.arabic: وَرجعت إِلَى أَصْحَابهَا بِغَرَائِب الحكم وطرف الْفَوَائِد
segments.english: and returned to their owners with rare wisdoms and wonderful benefits.

segments.arabic: إِذا غذي الْقلب بالتذكر وَسقي بالتفكّر ونقي من الدغل
segments.english: When the heart [is] nourished with remembrance and watered with reflection and cleansed of impurity,

segments.arabic: رأى الْعَجَائِب وألهم الْحِكْمَة
segments.english: it sees wonders and [is] inspired [with] wisdom.

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ كل من تحلى بالمعرفة وَالْحكمَة وانتحلها كَانَ من أَهلهَا
segments.english: Not everyone who adorned himself with knowledge and wisdom and claimed it [for himself] was from its people.

segments.arabic: بل أهل الْمعرفَة وَالْحكمَة الَّذين أحيوا قُلُوبهم بقتل الْهوى
segments.english: Rather, the people of knowledge and wisdom [are] those who brought their hearts to life by killing desire.

segments.arabic: وَأما من قتل قلبه فأحيى الْهوى فَالْمعرفَة وَالْحكمَة عَارِية على لِسَانه
segments.english: And as for whoever killed his heart and gave life to desire, then knowledge and wisdom [are] borrowed [words] on his tongue.

segments.arabic: خراب الْقلب من الْأَمْن والغفلة وعمارته من الخشية وَالذكر
segments.english: The ruin of the heart [is] from [feeling] safe and heedlessness, and its flourishing [is] from fear [of God] and remembrance.

segments.arabic: إِذا زهدت الْقُلُوب فِي مَوَائِد الدُّنْيَا قعدت على مَوَائِد الْآخِرَة بَين أهل تِلْكَ الدعْوَة
segments.english: When hearts renounce the tables of this world, they sit at the tables of the Hereafter among the people of that invitation.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا رضيت بموائد الدُّنْيَا فاتتها تِلْكَ الموائد
segments.english: And when they [are] content with the tables of this world, those tables pass them by.

segments.arabic: الشوق إِلَى الله ولقائه نسيم يهب على الْقلب يروح عَنهُ وهج الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: Longing for God and meeting Him [is a] breeze that blows upon the heart, relieving it of the heat of this world.

segments.arabic: من وطّن قلبه عِنْد ربه سكن واستراح
segments.english: Whoever settled his heart with his Lord [found] peace and rest.

segments.arabic: وَمن أرْسلهُ فِي النَّاس اضْطربَ وَاشْتَدَّ بِهِ القلق
segments.english: And whoever sent it among people became restless, and anxiety grew in him.

segments.arabic: لَا تدخل محبَّة الله فِي قلب فِيهِ حب الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا كَمَا يدْخل الْجمل فِي سم الابرة
segments.english: The love of God does not enter [a] heart that has in it love of this world, except as [a] camel enters the eye of [a] needle.

segments.arabic: اذ أحب الله عبدا اصطنعه لنَفسِهِ واجتباه لمحبته واستخلصه لعبادته
segments.english: When God loves [a] servant, He takes him for Himself, and chooses him for His love, and selects him for His worship.

segments.arabic: فشغل همه بِهِ وَلسَانه بِذكرِهِ وجوارحه بخدمته
segments.english: So He busies his concern with Him, and his tongue with His remembrance, and his limbs with His service.

segments.arabic: وَالْقلب يمرض كَمَا يمرض الْبدن وشفاؤه فِي التَّوْبَة وَالْحمية
segments.english: And the heart gets sick as the body gets sick, and its cure [is] in repentance and restraint.

segments.arabic: ويصدأ كَمَا تصدأ الْمرْآة وجلاؤه بِالذكر
segments.english: And it rusts as the mirror rusts, and its polish [is] through remembrance.

segments.arabic: ويعرى كَمَا يعرى الْجِسْم وزينته التَّقْوَى
segments.english: And it becomes bare as the body becomes bare, and its adornment [is] God-consciousness.
