segments.arabic: ويجوع ويظمأ كَمَا يجوع الْبدن وَطَعَامه وَشَرَابه الْمعرفَة والمحبة والتوكل والإنابة والخدمة
segments.english: And it hungers and thirsts as the body hungers, and its food and drink [are] knowledge, love, reliance [on God], turning [to God], and service.

segments.arabic: إياك والغفلة عَمَّن جعل لحياتك أََجَلًا ولأيامك وأنفاسك أمدا
segments.english: Beware of heedlessness toward the One who made for your life [a] set term, and for your days and breaths [a] limit.

segments.arabic: وَمن كل مَا سواهُ بُد وَلَا بذلك مِنْهُ
segments.english: And from everything other than Him [there is] escape, but [there is] no escape from Him.

segments.arabic: من ترك الِاخْتِيَار وَالتَّدْبِير فِي طلب زِيَادَة دنيا أَو جاه أَو فِي خوف نُقْصَان أَو فِي التَّخَلُّص من عَدو
segments.english: Whoever leaves [his own] choosing and planning — in seeking increase of worldly [gain] or status, or in fear of loss, or in freeing himself from an enemy —

segments.arabic: توكلا على الله وثقة بتدبيره لَهُ وَحسن اخْتِيَاره لَهُ
segments.english: [out of] reliance on God and trust in His planning for him and [in] His good choosing for him,

segments.arabic: فَألْقى كنفه بَين يَدَيْهِ وَسلم الْأَمر إِلَيْهِ وَرَضي بِمَا يَقْضِيه لَهُ
segments.english: and he threw himself before Him, and surrendered the matter to Him, and [was] pleased with what He decrees for him —

segments.arabic: استراح من
segments.english: [he] found rest from…

segments.arabic: الهموم والغموم وَالْأَحْزَان
segments.english: worries and distresses and sorrows.

segments.arabic: وَمن أَبى إِلَّا تَدْبيره لنَفسِهِ وَقع فِي النكد وَالنّصب وَسُوء الْحَال والتعب
segments.english: And whoever insisted on planning for himself fell into misery and hardship and bad conditions and exhaustion.

segments.arabic: فَلَا عَيْش يصفو وَلَا قلب يفرح وَلَا عمل يزكو وَلَا أمل يقوم وَلَا رَاحَة تدوم
segments.english: So no life [is] pure, no heart [is] happy, no deed grows, no hope stands, and no rest lasts.

segments.arabic: وَالله سُبْحَانَهُ سهّل لخلقه السَّبِيل إِلَيْهِ وحجبهم عَنهُ بِالتَّدْبِيرِ
segments.english: And God, glorified [is] He, made easy for His creation the path to Him, and veiled them from Him through [their own] planning.

segments.arabic: فَمن رَضِي بتدبير الله لَهُ وَسكن إِلَى اخْتِيَاره وسلّم لحكمه أَزَال ذَلِك الْحجاب
segments.english: So whoever [was] pleased with God's planning for him, and found rest in His choice, and submitted to His judgment — removed that veil.

segments.arabic: فأفضى الْقلب إِلَى ربه وَاطْمَأَنَّ إِلَيْهِ وَسكن
segments.english: So the heart reached its Lord and found peace in Him and [was] still.

segments.arabic: المتَوَكل لَا يسْأَل غير الله وَلَا يرد على الله وَلَا يدّخر مَعَ الله
segments.english: The one who relies [on God] does not ask other than God, does not object to God, and does not store up alongside God.

segments.arabic: من شُغِل بِنَفسِهِ شُغِل عَن غَيره وَمن شُغِل بربه شُغِل عَن نَفسه
segments.english: Whoever [was] occupied with himself [was] occupied from others, and whoever [was] occupied with his Lord [was] occupied from himself.

segments.arabic: الْإِخْلَاص هُوَ مَا لَا يُعلمهُ ملك فيكتبه وَلَا عَدو فيفسده وَلَا يعجب بِهِ صَاحبه فيبطله
segments.english: Sincerity — it [is] what no angel knows so [as to] record it, no enemy [knows] so [as to] corrupt it, and its owner [is] not amazed by it so [as to] cancel it.

segments.arabic: الرِّضَا سُكُون الْقلب تَحت مجاري الْأَحْكَام
segments.english: Contentment [is] the stillness of the heart under the flow of [divine] decrees.

segments.arabic: النَّاس فِي الدُّنْيَا معذّبون على قدر هممهم بهَا
segments.english: People in this world [are] tormented according to their attachment to it.

segments.arabic: للقلب سِتَّة مَوَاطِن يجول فِيهَا لَا سَابِع لَهَا
segments.english: The heart has six places it roams in — [there is] no seventh for them.

segments.arabic: ثَلَاثَة سافلة وَثَلَاثَة عالية
segments.english: Three [are] low and three [are] high.

segments.arabic: فالسافلة دنيا تزيّن لَهُ وَنَفس تحدثه وعدو يوسوس لَهُ
segments.english: The low [ones are]: [a] world beautified for him, [a] self that talks to him, and [an] enemy that whispers to him.

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ مَوَاطِن الْأَرْوَاح السافلة الَّتِي لَا تزَال تجول فِيهَا
segments.english: So these [are] the places of the low souls that never stop roaming in them.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّلَاثَة الْعَالِيَة علم يتَبَيَّن لَهُ وعقل يرشده وإله يعبده
segments.english: And the three high [ones are]: knowledge that becomes clear to him, [a] mind that guides him, and [a] God he worships.

segments.arabic: والقلوب جوّالة فِي هَذِه المواطن
segments.english: And the hearts [are] wandering in these places.

segments.arabic: إتباع الهوى وَطول الأمل مَادَّة كل فَسَاد
segments.english: Following desire and long hopes [are] the source of every corruption.

segments.arabic: فَإِن اتِّبَاع الْهوى يعمي عَن الْحق معرفَة وقصدا
segments.english: For following desire blinds from the truth [in] knowledge and intention.

segments.arabic: وَطول الأمل ينسي الْآخِرَة ويصد عَن الاستعداد لَهَا
segments.english: And long hopes make [one] forget the Hereafter and block from preparing for it.

segments.arabic: لَا يشم عبد رَائِحَة الصدْق ويداهن نَفسه أَو يداهن غَيره
segments.english: No servant smells the scent of truthfulness while he flatters himself or flatters others.

segments.arabic: إِذا أَرَادَ الله بِعَبْد خيرا جعله معترفا بِذَنبِهِ ممسكا عَن ذَنْب غَيره
segments.english: When God wants good for [a] servant, He makes him admitting of his sin, holding back from the sin of others,

segments.arabic: جوادا بِمَا عِنْده زاهدا فِيمَا عِنْد غَيره مُحْتملا لأَذى غَيره
segments.english: generous with what he has, detached from what [others] have, bearing the harm of others.

segments.arabic: وَإِن أَرَادَ بِهِ شرا عكس ذَلِك عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And if He wants evil for him, He reverses that upon him.

segments.arabic: الهمّة العليّة لَا تزَال حائمة حول ثَلَاثَة أَشْيَاء
segments.english: The high resolve never stops circling around three things:

segments.arabic: تعرّف لصفة من الصِّفَات الْعليا تزداد بمعرفتها محبَّة وَإِرَادَة
segments.english: knowing [a] quality from the highest qualities, growing through knowing it in love and longing,

segments.arabic: وملاحظة لمنة تزداد بملاحظتها شكرا وطاعة
segments.english: and observing [a] blessing, growing through observing it in gratitude and obedience,

segments.arabic: وتذكر لذنب تزداد بتذكره تَوْبَة وخشية
segments.english: and remembering [a] sin, growing through remembering it in repentance and fear.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا تعلّقت الهمّة بسوى هَذِه الثَّلَاثَة جالت فِي أَوديَة الوساوس والخطرات
segments.english: So when the resolve attaches to other than these three, it roams in the valleys of whispers and passing thoughts.

segments.arabic: من عشق الدُّنْيَا نظرت إِلَى قدرهَا عِنْده فصيرته من خدمها وعبيدها وأذلّته
segments.english: Whoever loved this world — it looked at its worth in his [eyes], so it made him among its servants and slaves and humbled him.

segments.arabic: وَمن أعرض عَنْهَا نظرت إِلَى كبر قدره فخدمته وذلّت لَهُ
segments.english: And whoever turned away from it — it looked at the greatness of his worth, so it served him and [was] humbled before him.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا يقطع السّفر
segments.english: The journey [is] only cut

headings.arabic: فائدة جليلة كل من آثر الدنيا من أهل العلم واستحبها فلا بد أن
headings.english: A Great Benefit: Whoever from the people of knowledge prefers this world and loves it, then inevitably...

segments.arabic: ويصل الْمُسَافِر بِلُزُوم الجادّة وسير اللَّيْل
segments.english: And the traveler arrives by keeping to the main road and traveling [at] night.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا حاد الْمُسَافِر عَن الطَّرِيق ونام اللَّيْل كُله فَمَتَى يصل إِلَى مقْصده
segments.english: So if the traveler strays from the path and sleeps the entire night, then when [will] he arrive at his destination?

segments.arabic: كل من آثر الدُّنْيَا من أهل الْعلم واستحبها
segments.english: Everyone who prefers this world from the people of knowledge and loves it,

segments.arabic: فَلَا بُد أَن يَقُول على الله غير الْحق فِي فتواه وَحكمه فِي خَبره وإلزامه
segments.english: then inevitably [he will] say about God other than the truth — in his rulings and his judgments, in his reports and his demands.

segments.arabic: لِأَن أَحْكَام الرب سُبْحَانَهُ كثيرا مَا تَأتي على خلاف أغراض النَّاس
segments.english: Because the rulings of the Lord — glorified [is] He — often come contrary to the desires of people,

segments.arabic: وَلَا سِيمَا أهل الرياسة وَالَّذين يتبعُون الشُّبُهَات
segments.english: especially the people of authority and those who follow doubts.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُم لَا تتمّ لَهُم أغراضهم إِلَّا بمخالفة الْحق وَدفعه كثيرا
segments.english: For their goals [are] not fulfilled for them except by opposing the truth and pushing it away repeatedly.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَ الْعَالم وَالْحَاكِم محبين للرياسة متبعين للشهوات
segments.english: So if the scholar and the judge [are] lovers of authority, followers of desires,

segments.arabic: لم يتم لَهُمَا ذَلِك إِلَّا بِدفع مَا يضاده من الْحق
segments.english: that [will] not be fulfilled for them except by pushing away what opposes it of the truth.

segments.arabic: وَلَا سِيمَا إِذا قَامَت لَهُ شُبْهَة فتتفق الشُّبْهَة والشهوة ويثور الْهوى
segments.english: Especially if [a] doubt arises for him — then the doubt and the desire come together, and desire flares up,

segments.arabic: فيخفى الصَّوَاب وينطمس وَجه الْحق
segments.english: so the correct [path] becomes hidden and the face of the truth [is] covered over.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ الْحق ظَاهرا لَا خَفَاء بِهِ وَلَا شُبْهَة فِيهِ
segments.english: And if the truth [is] clear — with no hiddenness in it and no doubt about it —

segments.arabic: أقدم على مُخَالفَته وَقَالَ لي مخرج بِالتَّوْبَةِ
segments.english: [he] proceeds to oppose it and says, 'I have [a] way out through repentance.'

segments.arabic: وَفِي هَؤُلَاءِ وأشباههم قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And about these [people] and those like them, [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا الصَّلاةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوَات﴾
segments.english: Then [there] succeeded after them successors [who] wasted the prayer and followed desires.
segments.sahih_international: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى فيهم أَيْضا
segments.english: And [God] Most High also said about them:

segments.arabic: فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ وَرِثُوا الْكِتَابَ يَأْخُذُونَ عَرَضَ هَذَا الْأَدْنَى وَيَقُولُونَ سيغفر لنا
segments.english: Then [there] succeeded after them successors [who] inherited the Book, taking the goods of this lower [world] and saying, '[It] will be forgiven for us.'
segments.sahih_international: And there followed them successors who inherited the Scripture [while] taking the commodities of this lower life and saying, "It will be forgiven for us." And if an offer like it comes to them, they will [again] take it. Was not the covenant of the Scripture taken from them that they would not say about Allah except the truth, and they studied what was in it? And the home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear Allah, so will you not use reason?

segments.arabic: وَإِن يَأْتِيهم عَرَضٌ مِثْلُهُ يَأْخُذُوهُ
segments.english: And if goods like it come to them, they [will] take it.

segments.arabic: أَلَمْ يُؤْخَذْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِيثَاقُ الْكِتَابِ أَنْ لَا يَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ وَدَرَسُوا مَا فِيهِ
segments.english: Was not the covenant of the Book taken from them — that they should not say about God except the truth? And they studied what [is] in it.

segments.arabic: وَالدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلا تعقلون
segments.english: And the home of the Hereafter [is] better for those who [are] God-conscious. Do you not understand?

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَنهم أخذُوا الْعرض الْأَدْنَى مَعَ علمهمْ بِتَحْرِيمِهِ عَلَيْهِم
segments.english: So He — glorified [is] He — informed that they took the lower goods while knowing of its prohibition upon them.

segments.arabic: وَقَالُوا سيغفر لنا
segments.english: And they said, '[It] will be forgiven for us.'

segments.arabic: وَإِن عرض لَهُم عرض آخر أَخَذُوهُ فهم مصرون على ذَلِك
segments.english: And if another offer comes to them, they [will] take it — so they [are] persistent in that.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ هُوَ الْحَامِل لَهُم على أَن يَقُولُوا على الله غير الْحق
segments.english: And that [is] what drives them to say about God other than the truth.

segments.arabic: فَيَقُولُونَ هَذَا حكمه وشرعه وَدينه
segments.english: So they say, 'This [is] His ruling and His law and His religion,'

segments.arabic: وهم يعلمُونَ أَن دينه وشرعه وَحكمه خلاف ذَلِك
segments.english: while they know that His religion and His law and His ruling [are] the opposite of that.

segments.arabic: أَولا يعلمُونَ أَن ذَلِك دينه وشرعه وَحكمه
segments.english: Or they do not know that that [is] His religion and His law and His ruling.

segments.arabic: فَتَارَة يَقُولُونَ على الله مَالا يعلمُونَ
segments.english: So sometimes they say about God what they do not know,

segments.arabic: وَتارَة يَقُولُونَ عَلَيْهِ مَا يعلمُونَ بُطْلَانه
segments.english: and sometimes they say about Him what they know [is] false.

segments.arabic: وَأما الَّذين يَتَّقُونَ فيعلمون أَن الدَّار الْآخِرَة خير من الدُّنْيَا فَلَا يحملهم
segments.english: As for those who [are] God-conscious, they know that the home of the Hereafter [is] better than this world, so it does not drive them —

segments.arabic: حب الرياسة والشهوة على أَن يؤثروا الدُّنْيَا على الْآخِرَة
segments.english: [the] love of leadership and desire [causes them] to prefer this world over the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَطَرِيق ذَلِك أَن يَتَمَسَّكُوا بِالْكتاب وَالسّنة ويستعينوا بِالصبرِ وَالصَّلَاة
segments.english: And the way [to avoid] that [is] to hold firmly to the Book and the Sunnah, and to seek help through patience and prayer,

segments.arabic: ويتفكروا فِي الدُّنْيَا وزوالها وخستها وَالْآخِرَة وإقبالها ودوامها
segments.english: and to reflect on this world — its passing and its lowliness — and the Hereafter — its coming and its permanence.

segments.arabic: وَهَؤُلَاء لَا بُد أَن يبتدعوا فِي الدّين مَعَ الْفُجُور فِي الْعَمَل
segments.english: And these [people] will inevitably innovate in the religion, along with wickedness in [their] deeds,

segments.arabic: فيجتمع لَهُم الْأَمْرَانِ
segments.english: so both matters combine for them.

segments.arabic: فَإِن اتِّبَاع الْهوى يعمي عين الْقلب فَلَا يُمَيّز بَين السّنة والبدعة
segments.english: For following desire blinds the eye of the heart, so [he] cannot distinguish between the Sunnah and innovation,

segments.arabic: أَو ينكسه فَيرى الْبِدْعَة سنة وَالسّنة بِدعَة
segments.english: or it flips him, so [he] sees innovation [as] Sunnah and the Sunnah [as] innovation.

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ آفَة الْعلمَاء إِذا آثروا الدُّنْيَا وَاتبعُوا الرياسات والشهوات
segments.english: So this [is] the disease of the scholars when they prefer this world and follow leadership and desires.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه الْآيَات فيهم إِلَيّ قَوْله
segments.english: And these verses [are] about them, up to His saying:

segments.arabic: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ الَّذِي آتَيْنَاهُ آيَاتِنَا فَانْسَلَخَ مِنْهَا فَأَتْبَعَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ
segments.english: And recite to them the story of the one whom We gave Our signs, but he stripped himself away from them, so Satan caught up with him, and he became of the misguided.
segments.sahih_international: And recite to them, [O Muhammad], the news of him to whom we gave [knowledge of] Our signs, but he detached himself from them; so Satan pursued him, and he became of the deviators.

segments.arabic: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَرَفَعْنَاهُ بِهَا وَلَكِنَّهُ أَخْلَدَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ
segments.english: And had We willed, We [would have] raised him through them, but he clung to the earth and followed his desire.
segments.sahih_international: And if We had willed, we could have elevated him thereby, but he adhered [instead] to the earth and followed his own desire. So his example is like that of the dog: if you chase him, he pants, or if you leave him, he [still] pants. That is the example of the people who denied Our signs. So relate the stories that perhaps they will give thought.

segments.arabic: فَمَثَلُهُ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ إِنْ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْهِ يَلْهَثْ أَوْ تَتْرُكْهُ يَلْهَثْ
segments.english: So his example [is] like the example of the dog — if you chase it, it pants, or [if] you leave it, it pants.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا مثل عَالم السوء الَّذِي يعْمل بِخِلَاف علمه
segments.english: So this [is] the example of the evil scholar who acts contrary to his knowledge.

segments.arabic: وتأمّل مَا تضمنته هَذِه الْآيَة من ذمه وَذَلِكَ من وُجُوه
segments.english: And reflect on what this verse contains of his blame — and that [is] from [several] angles.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا أَنه ضل بعد الْعلم وَاخْتَارَ الْكفْر على الْإِيمَان عمدا وَلَا جهلا
segments.english: The first: that he went astray after knowledge, and chose disbelief over faith deliberately, not [out of] ignorance.

segments.arabic: وَثَانِيها أَنه فَارق الْإِيمَان مُفَارقَة من لَا يعود إِلَيْهِ أبدا
segments.english: And the second: that he left faith [with] the leaving of one who never returns to it.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ انْسَلَخَ من الْآيَات بِالْجُمْلَةِ كَمَا تنسلخ الْحَيَّة من قشرها
segments.english: For he stripped away from the signs entirely, just as [a] snake sheds its skin.

segments.arabic: وَلَو بَقِي مَعَه مِنْهَا شَيْء لم يَنْسَلِخ مِنْهَا
segments.english: And had anything of them remained with him, he [would] not [have] stripped away from them.

segments.arabic: وَثَالِثهَا أَن الشَّيْطَان أدْركهُ ولحقه بِحَيْثُ ظفر بِهِ وافترسه
segments.english: And the third: that Satan reached him and caught up with him, such that he seized him and devoured him.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ الشَّيْطَان وَلم يقل تبعه
segments.english: And for this [reason], He said "so Satan caught up with him" and did not say "followed him."

segments.arabic: فَإِن فِي معنى أتبعه أدْركهُ ولحقه وَهُوَ أبلغ من تبعه لفظا وَمعنى
segments.english: For in the meaning of "caught up with him" [is that] he reached him and overtook him, and it [is] more emphatic than "followed him" in wording and meaning.

segments.arabic: وَرَابِعهَا أَنه غوي بعد الرشد
segments.english: And the fourth: that he became misguided after [right] guidance.

segments.arabic: والغي الضلال فِي الْعلم وَالْقَصْد وَهُوَ أخص بِفساد الْقَصْد وَالْعَمَل
segments.english: And misguidance [is] straying in knowledge and intention, and it [is] more specific to corruption of intention and deed,

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن الضلال أخص فَسَاد الْعلم والاعتقاد
segments.english: just as straying [is] more specific to corruption of knowledge and belief.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أُفرد أَحدهمَا دخل فِيهِ الآخر وَإِن اقترنا فَالْفرق مَا ذكر
segments.english: So when one of them [is] mentioned alone, the other [is] included in it. And when they [are] paired, the difference [is] what [was] mentioned.

segments.arabic: وخامسها أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ لم يَشَأْ أَن يرفعهُ بِالْعلمِ فَكَانَ سَبَب هَلَاكه
segments.english: And the fifth: that He — glorified [is] He — did not will to raise him through knowledge, so it became the cause of his destruction.

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ لم رفع بِهِ فَصَارَ وبالا عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: Because he was not raised by it, so it became [a] burden upon him.

segments.arabic: فَلَو لم يكن عَالما كَانَ خيرا لَهُ وأخف لعذابه
segments.english: So had he not been [a] scholar, [it would have been] better for him and lighter for his punishment.

segments.arabic: وسادسها أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ أخبر عَن خسة همته
segments.english: And the sixth: that He — glorified [is] He — told about the lowness of his ambition,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه اخْتَار الْأَسْفَل الْأَدْنَى على الْأَشْرَف الْأَعْلَى
segments.english: and that he chose the lower [and] lesser over the nobler [and] higher.

segments.arabic: وسابعها أَن اخْتِيَاره للأدنى لم يكن عَن خاطر وَحَدِيث نفس
segments.english: And the seventh: that his choosing the lesser was not from [a passing] thought or self-talk,

segments.arabic: وَلكنه كَانَ عَن إخلاد إِلَى الأَرْض وميل بكليّته إِلَى مَا هُنَاكَ
segments.english: but rather it was from clinging to the earth and inclining entirely toward what [is] there.

segments.arabic: وأصل الإخلاد اللُّزُوم على الدَّوَام
segments.english: And the root of clinging [is] permanent attachment.

headings.arabic: فصل فهذا حال العالم المؤثر الدنيا على الآخرة وأما العابد الجاهل
headings.english: Section: This [is] the state of the scholar who prefers this world over the Hereafter, and as for the ignorant worshipper

segments.arabic: كَأَنَّهُ قيل لزم الْميل إِلَى الأَرْض
segments.english: as if it was said: he clung [to] the inclination toward the earth.

segments.arabic: وَمن هَذَا يُقَال أخلد فلَان بِالْمَكَانِ إِذا لزم الْإِقَامَة بِهِ
segments.english: And from this it [is] said: 'so-and-so settled in the place' — when he clung to staying in it.

segments.arabic: قَالَ مَالك بن نُوَيْرَة
segments.english: Malik ibn Nuwayrah said:

segments.arabic: بأبناء حَيّ من قبائل مَالك ... وَعَمْرو بن يَرْبُوع أَقَامُوا فأخلدوا
segments.english: with sons of [a] tribe from the clans of Malik... and Amr ibn Yarbu' — they stayed and settled.

segments.arabic: وعبّر عَن ميله إِلَى الدُّنْيَا بإخلاده إِلَى الأَرْض
segments.english: And He expressed his inclination toward this world by [saying] his clinging to the earth,

segments.arabic: لِأَن الدُّنْيَا هِيَ الأَرْض وَمَا فِيهَا وَمَا يسْتَخْرج مِنْهَا من الزِّينَة وَالْمَتَاع
segments.english: because this world [is] the earth and what [is] in it, and what [is] taken out from it of adornment and goods.

segments.arabic: وثامنها أَنه رغب عَن هداه وَاتبع هَوَاهُ
segments.english: And the eighth [is] that he turned away from his guidance and followed his desire,

segments.arabic: فَجعل هَوَاهُ إِمَامًا لَهُ يَقْتَدِي بِهِ ويتبعه
segments.english: so he made his desire [a] leader for him — he follows it and pursues it.

segments.arabic: وتاسعها أَنه شبهه بالكلب الَّذِي هُوَ أخس الْحَيَوَانَات همة وأسقطها نفسا وأبخلها
segments.english: And the ninth [is] that He compared him to the dog, which [is] the lowest of animals in aspiration, the most base in self, the most stingy,

segments.arabic: وأشدها كَلْبا وَلِهَذَا سمي كَلْبا
segments.english: and the fiercest in aggression — and for this [reason] it was called a dog.

segments.arabic: وعاشرها أَنه شبه لهثه على الدُّنْيَا وَعدم صبره عَنْهَا وجزعه لفقدها وحرصه على تَحْصِيلهَا
segments.english: And the tenth [is] that He compared his panting over this world, his lack of patience from it, his anxiety at losing it, and his eagerness to obtain it —

segments.arabic: بلهث الْكَلْب فِي حالتي تَركه وَالْحمل عَلَيْهِ بالطرد
segments.english: to the panting of the dog in both states: being left alone and being chased away.

segments.arabic: وَهَكَذَا هَذَا إِن ترك فَهُوَ لهثان على الدُّنْيَا وَإِن وعظ وزجر فَهُوَ كَذَلِك
segments.english: And likewise this [person] — if left [alone], he [is] panting over this world, and if advised and rebuked, he [is] the same.

segments.arabic: فاللهث لَا يُفَارِقهُ فِي كل حَال كلهث الْكَلْب
segments.english: So the panting does not leave him in any state, like the panting of the dog.

segments.arabic: قَالَ ابْن قُتَيْبَة كل شَيْء يَلْهَث فَإِنَّمَا يَلْهَث من إعياء أَو عَطش إِلَّا الْكَلْب
segments.english: Ibn Qutaybah said: everything that pants, only pants from exhaustion or thirst — except the dog,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ يَلْهَث فِي حَال الكلال وَحَال الرَّاحَة وَحَال الرّيّ وَحَال الْعَطش
segments.english: for it pants in [the] state of fatigue, [the] state of rest, [the] state of being quenched, and [the] state of thirst.

segments.arabic: فَضَربهُ الله مثلا لهَذَا الْكَافِر
segments.english: So God made it [a] parable for this disbeliever,

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ إِن وعظته فَهُوَ ضال وَإِن تركته فَهُوَ ضال
segments.english: and said: if you advise him, he [is] astray, and if you leave him, he [is] astray —

segments.arabic: كَالْكَلْبِ إِن طردته لهث وَإِن تركته على حَاله لهث
segments.english: like the dog: if you chase it, it pants, and if you leave it as it [is], it pants.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا التَّمْثِيل لم يَقع بِكُل كلب وَإِنَّمَا وَقع بالكلب اللاهث
segments.english: And this parable was not made about every dog, but rather about the panting dog,

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ أخس مَا يكون وأشنعه
segments.english: and that [is] the lowest and ugliest [state] it can be [in].

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا حَال الْعَالم الْمُؤثر الدُّنْيَا على الْآخِرَة
segments.english: So this [is] the state of the scholar who prefers this world over the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَأما العابد الْجَاهِل فآفته من إعراضه عَن الْعلم وَأَحْكَامه
segments.english: As for the ignorant worshipper, his problem [is] from his turning away from knowledge and its rulings,

segments.arabic: وَغَلَبَة خياله وذوقه ووجده وَمَا تهواه نَفسه
segments.english: and the dominance of his imagination, his taste, his feelings, and what his self desires.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَ سُفْيَان ابْن عُيَيْنَة وَغَيره
segments.english: And for this [reason], Sufyan ibn Uyaynah and others said:

segments.arabic: احْذَرُوا فتْنَة الْعَالم الْفَاجِر وفتنة العابد الْجَاهِل فَإِن فتنتهما فتْنَة لكل مفتون
segments.english: 'Beware of the trial of the sinful scholar and the trial of the ignorant worshipper, for their trial [is a] trial for every [person who is] put to trial.'

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا بجهله يصد عَن الْعلم وموجبه
segments.english: This one, by his ignorance, turns [people] away from knowledge and what it requires,

segments.arabic: وَذَاكَ بغيّه يَدْعُو إِلَى الْفُجُور
segments.english: and that one, by his wickedness, calls to sin.

segments.arabic: وَقد ضرب الله سُبْحَانَهُ مثل النَّوْع الآخر بقوله
segments.english: And God, glorified [is] He, struck [a] parable for the other type by His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿كَمَثَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِذْ قَالَ لِلْإِنْسَانِ اكْفُرْ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِنْكَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ اللَّهَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾
segments.english: like the parable of Satan, when he said to man: 'Disbelieve!' Then when he disbelieved, he said: 'I [am] free of you; I fear God, Lord of the worlds.'
segments.sahih_international: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds."

segments.arabic: ﴿فَكَانَ عَاقِبَتَهُمَا﴾
segments.english: So the end of both of them [was]...

headings.arabic: فائدة عظيمة أفضل ما اكتسبته النفوس وحصلته القلوب ونال به العبد
headings.english: A Great Benefit: The Best [Thing] That Souls Have Gained and Hearts Have Obtained, and by Which the Servant Attained

segments.arabic: أَنَّهُمَا فِي النَّارِ خلدين فِيهَا وَذَلِكَ جَزَاءُ الظَّالِمين
segments.english: that they both [will be] in the Fire, dwelling in it forever, and that [is] the reward of the wrongdoers.

segments.arabic: وقصته مَعْرُوفَة
segments.english: And his story [is] well-known.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ بنى أساس أمره على عبَادَة الله بِجَهْل
segments.english: For he built the foundation of his affair on worshipping God in ignorance.

segments.arabic: فأوقعه الشَّيْطَان بجهله وكفّره بجهله
segments.english: So Satan caused him to fall through his ignorance, and made him disbelieve through his ignorance.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا إِمَام كل عَابِد جَاهِل يكفر وَلَا يدْرِي
segments.english: So this [is] the leader of every ignorant worshipper [who] disbelieves and does not realize [it].

segments.arabic: وَذَاكَ إِمَام كل عَالم فَاجر يخْتَار الدُّنْيَا على الْآخِرَة
segments.english: And that [is] the leader of every sinful scholar [who] chooses this world over the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَقد جعل سُبْحَانَهُ رضى العَبْد بالدنيا وطمأنينته وغفلته عَن معرفَة آيَاته وتدبرها وَالْعَمَل بهَا
segments.english: And glorified [is] He, He made the servant's satisfaction with this world, his contentment, and his heedlessness of knowing His signs, reflecting on them, and acting by them —

segments.arabic: سَبَب شقائه وهلاكه
segments.english: [a] cause of his misery and his destruction.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يجْتَمع هَذَانِ أعنى الرضى بالدنيا والغفلة عَن آيَات الرب
segments.english: And these two do not come together — I mean satisfaction with this world and heedlessness of the signs of the Lord —

segments.arabic: إِلَّا فِي قلب من لَا يُؤمن بالمعاد وَلَا يَرْجُو لِقَاء رب الْعباد
segments.english: except in [a] heart of [one who] does not believe in the Return and does not hope for the meeting of the Lord of [all] servants.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا فَلَو رسخ قدمه فِي الْإِيمَان بالمعاد
segments.english: Otherwise, if his foot [were] firmly rooted in faith in the Return,

segments.arabic: لما رَضِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَا اطْمَأَن إِلَيْهَا وَلَا أعرض عَن آيَات الله
segments.english: he would not [have] been satisfied with this world, nor been content with it, nor turned away from the signs of God.

segments.arabic: وَأَنت إِذا تَأَمَّلت أَحْوَال النَّاس وجدت هَذَا الضَّرْب هُوَ الْغَالِب على النَّاس
segments.english: And you, if you reflect on the conditions of people, [you would] find this type [is] the most common among people,

segments.arabic: وهم عمّار الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: and they [are] the builders of this world.

segments.arabic: وَأَقل النَّاس عددا من هُوَ على خلاف ذَلِك
segments.english: And the fewest of people in number [are those] who [are] the opposite of that.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ من أَشد النَّاس غربَة بَينهم
segments.english: And he [is] among the most estranged of people among them.

segments.arabic: لَهُم شَأْن وَله شَأْن
segments.english: They have [a] concern and he has [a] concern.

segments.arabic: علمه غير علومهم وإرادته غير إرادتهم وَطَرِيقه غير طريقهم
segments.english: His knowledge [is] other than their knowledge, his intention [is] other than their intention, and his path [is] other than their path.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ فِي وَاد وهم فِي وَاد
segments.english: So he [is] in [a] valley and they [are] in [a] valley.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا وَرَضُوا بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَاطْمَأَنُّوا بِهَا وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ آيَاتِنَا غَافِلُونَ
segments.english: Indeed, those who do not hope for Our meeting and [are] satisfied with the life of this world and [are] content with it, and those who [are] heedless of Our signs —
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, those who do not expect the meeting with Us and are satisfied with the life of this world and feel secure therein and those who are heedless of Our signs

segments.arabic: أُولَئِكَ مَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
segments.english: those — their refuge [is] the Fire because of what they used to earn.
segments.sahih_international: For those their refuge will be the Fire because of what they used to earn.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ ذكر وصف ضد هَؤُلَاءِ ومآلهم وعاقبتهم بقوله
segments.english: Then He mentioned the description of the opposite of these [people], their outcome, and their end, in His saying:

segments.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ يَهْدِيهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِإِيمَانِهِمْ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ فِي جنَّات النَّعيم
segments.english: Indeed, those who believed and did righteous deeds — their Lord [will] guide them by their faith; rivers [will] flow beneath them in gardens of bliss.
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - their Lord will guide them because of their faith. Beneath them rivers will flow in the Gardens of Pleasure

segments.arabic: فَهَؤُلَاءِ إِيمَانهم بلقاء الله أورثهم عدم الرِّضَا بالدنيا والطمأنينة إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: So these [people] — their faith in meeting God gave them as inheritance: not being satisfied with this world nor content with it,

segments.arabic: ودوام ذكر آيَاته
segments.english: and constant remembrance of His signs.

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ مَوَارِيث الْإِيمَان بالمعاد
segments.english: So these [are] the inheritances of faith in the Return.

segments.arabic: وَتلك مَوَارِيث عدم الْإِيمَان بِهِ والغفلة عَنهُ
segments.english: And those [are] the inheritances of not having faith in it and heedlessness of it.

segments.arabic: أفضل مَا اكتسبته النُّفُوس وحصلته الْقُلُوب ونال بِهِ العَبْد الرّفْعَة فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة هُوَ الْعلم وَالْإِيمَان
segments.english: The best [thing] that souls have gained and hearts have obtained, and by which the servant attained elevation in this world and the Hereafter, [is] knowledge and faith.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قرن بَينهمَا سُبْحَانَهُ فِي قَوْله
segments.english: And for this [reason], glorified [is] He, He joined between them in His saying:

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَالْأِيمَانَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلَى يَوْم الْبَعْث
segments.english: And those who were given knowledge and faith said: You have remained, in the decree of God, until the Day of Resurrection.
segments.sahih_international: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allah 's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: يَرْفَعِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنْكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ دَرَجَات
segments.english: God raises those among you who believed, and those who were given knowledge, [by many] degrees.
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allah will make space for you. And when you are told, "Arise," then arise; Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

segments.arabic: وهؤلاء هم خُلَاصَة الْوُجُود ولبه والمؤهلون للمراتب الْعَالِيَة
segments.english: And these [are] the essence of existence and its core, and the ones qualified for the high ranks.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن أَكثر النَّاس غالطون فِي حَقِيقَة مُسَمّى الْعلم وَالْإِيمَان اللَّذين بهما
segments.english: But most people [are] mistaken about the true meaning of knowledge and faith — the two by which —

segments.arabic: السَّعَادَة والرفقة وَفِي حقيقتهما حَتَّى أَن كل طَائِفَة تظن أَن مَا مَعهَا من الْعلم وَالْإِيمَان هُوَ هَذَا الَّذِي بِهِ تنَال السَّعَادَة
segments.english: happiness and companionship, and about their true nature — such that every group thinks that what it has of knowledge and faith — it [is] that by which happiness [is] attained.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ كَذَلِك بل أَكْثَرهم لَيْسَ مَعَهم إِيمَان يُنجي وَلَا علم يرفع
segments.english: And [it is] not so. Rather, most of them do not have faith that saves, nor knowledge that elevates.

segments.arabic: بل قد سدوا على نُفُوسهم طرق الْعلم وَالْإِيمَان اللَّذين جَاءَ بهما الرَّسُول ودعا إِلَيْهِمَا الْأمة
segments.english: Rather, they have blocked upon themselves the paths of knowledge and faith that the Messenger came with and called the nation to.

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ عَلَيْهِمَا هُوَ وَأَصْحَابه من بعده وتابعوهم على منهاجهم وآثارهم
segments.english: And he and his companions after him were upon them, and those who followed them upon their way and their footsteps.

segments.arabic: فَكل طَائِفَة اعتقدت أَن الْعلم مَا مَعهَا وفرحت
segments.english: So every group believed that knowledge [is] what it has, and rejoiced.

segments.arabic: وتقطعوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لديهم فَرِحُونَ
segments.english: And they divided their affair among themselves [into] pieces; each party [is] rejoicing in what [is] with them.
segments.sahih_international: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.

segments.arabic: وَأكْثر مَا عِنْدهم كَلَام وآراء وخرص
segments.english: And most of what they have [is] talk, opinions, and guesswork.

segments.arabic: وَالْعلم وَرَاء الْكَلَام كَمَا قَالَ حمّاد بن زيد
segments.english: And knowledge [is] beyond talk, as Hammad ibn Zayd said:

segments.arabic: قلت لأيوب الْعلم الْيَوْم أَكثر أَو فِيمَا تقدّم
segments.english: I said to Ayyub: [Is] knowledge today more, or in what came before?

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ الْكَلَام الْيَوْم أَكثر وَالْعلم فِيمَا تقدم أَكثر
segments.english: So he said: Talk today [is] more, and knowledge in what came before [was] more.

segments.arabic: فَفرق هَذَا الراسخ بَين الْعلم وَالْكَلَام
segments.english: So this firmly-grounded [scholar] distinguished between knowledge and talk.

segments.arabic: فالكتب كَثِيرَة جدا وَالْكَلَام والجدال والمقدرات الذهنية كَثِيرَة
segments.english: For books [are] very many, and talk, debate, and mental exercises [are] many,

segments.arabic: وَالْعلم بمعزل عَن أَكْثَرهَا
segments.english: yet knowledge [is] far removed from most of them.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ مَا جَاءَ بِهِ الرَّسُول عَن الله
segments.english: And it [is] what the Messenger brought from God.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿فَمَنْ حَاجَّكَ فِيهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَكَ من الْعلم﴾
segments.english: So whoever argues with you about it after what came to you of knowledge.
segments.sahih_international: Then whoever argues with you about it after [this] knowledge has come to you - say, "Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then supplicate earnestly [together] and invoke the curse of Allah upon the liars [among us]."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And [He] said:

segments.arabic: وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ بَعْدَ الَّذِي جَاءَك من العلم
segments.english: And if you followed their desires after what came to you of knowledge.
segments.sahih_international: And never will the Jews or the Christians approve of you until you follow their religion. Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allah is the [only] guidance." If you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, you would have against Allah no protector or helper.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ فِي الْقُرْآن أنزلهُ بِعِلْمِهِ أَي وَفِيه علمه
segments.english: And [He] said about the Quran: He sent it down with His knowledge — meaning: and in it [is] His knowledge.

segments.arabic: وَلما بعد الْعَهْد بِهَذَا الْعلم آل الْأَمر بِكَثِير من النَّاس إِلَى أَن اتَّخذُوا هواجس الأفكار وسوانح الخواطر والآراء علما
segments.english: And when the time grew distant from this knowledge, the matter led many people to take the wanderings of thoughts, passing notions, and opinions as knowledge.

segments.arabic: وَوَضَعُوا فِيهَا الْكتب وأنفقوا فِيهَا الأنفاس
segments.english: And they wrote books about them and spent their breaths on them.

segments.arabic: فضيعوا فِيهَا الزَّمَان وملأوا بهَا الصُّحُف مدادا والقلوب سوادا
segments.english: So they wasted their time on them, and filled the pages with ink and the hearts with darkness.

segments.arabic: حَتَّى صرح كثير مِنْهُم أَنه لَيْسَ فِي الْقُرْآن وَالسّنة علم
segments.english: Until many of them openly stated that there [is] no knowledge in the Quran and the Sunnah,

segments.arabic: وَأَن أدلتها لفظية لَا تفِيد يَقِينا وَلَا علما
segments.english: and that their proofs [are] verbal — [they] do not give certainty nor knowledge.

segments.arabic: وصرخ الشَّيْطَان بِهَذِهِ الْكَلِمَة فيهم وأذَّن بهَا بَين أظهرهم
segments.english: And Satan screamed this statement among them and proclaimed it in their midst,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى أسمعها دانيهم لقاصيهم
segments.english: until those near among them made those far hear it.

segments.arabic: فانسلخت بهَا الْقُلُوب من الْعلم وَالْإِيمَان كانسلاخ الْحَيَّة من قشرها وَالثَّوْب عَن لابسه
segments.english: So the hearts were stripped by it of knowledge and faith, like [a] snake shedding its skin, and [a] garment [coming off] its wearer.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الإِمَام الْعَلامَة شمس الدّين ابْن الْقيم
segments.english: The imam, the great scholar Shams al-Din Ibn al-Qayyim said:

segments.arabic: وَلَقَد أَخْبرنِي بعض أَصْحَابنَا عَن بعض أَتبَاع أَتبَاع تلاميذ هَؤُلَاءِ
segments.english: One of our companions told me about one of the followers of the followers of the students of these [people],

segments.arabic: أَنه رَآهُ يشْتَغل فِي بعض كتبهمْ وَلم يحفظ الْقُرْآن
segments.english: that he saw him studying some of their books, while he had not memorized the Quran.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُ لَو حفظت الْقُرْآن أَولا كَانَ أولى
segments.english: So he said to him: If you had memorized the Quran first, [it] would have been more fitting.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ وَهل فِي الْقُرْآن علم
segments.english: So he said: [Is] there [even] knowledge in the Quran?

segments.arabic: قَالَ ابْن الْقيم وَقَالَ لي بعض أَئِمَّة هَؤُلَاءِ
segments.english: Ibn al-Qayyim said: And one of the leaders of these [people] said to me:

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا نسْمع الحَدِيث لأجل الْبركَة لَا لنستفيد
segments.english: We only listen to hadith for the sake of blessing, not to benefit [from it].

headings.arabic: فصل
headings.english: Section

segments.arabic: مِنْهُ الْعلم لِأَن غَيرنَا قد كفانا هَذِه المؤونة
segments.english: ...from it knowledge, because others have spared us this burden.

segments.arabic: فعمدتنا على مَا فهموه وقرروه
segments.english: So our reliance [is] on what they understood and established.

segments.arabic: وَلَا شكّ أَن من كَانَ هَذَا مبلغه من الْعلم فَهُوَ كَمَا قَالَ الْقَائِل
segments.english: And [there is] no doubt that whoever this was the extent of his knowledge, then he [is] as the poet said:

segments.arabic: نزلُوا بِمَكَّة فِي قبائل هَاشم ... وَنزلت بالبطحاء أبعد منزل
segments.english: They settled in Makkah among the tribes of Hashim... and I settled in al-Batha, the farthest dwelling.

segments.arabic: قَالَ وَقَالَ لي شَيخنَا مرّة فِي وصف هَؤُلَاءِ
segments.english: He said: and our shaykh said to me once, describing these [people],

segments.arabic: أَنهم طافوا على أَرْبَاب الْمذَاهب ففازوا بأخس المطالب
segments.english: that they went around to the masters of the schools [of thought], and [they] won the lowest of gains.

segments.arabic: وَيَكْفِيك دَلِيلا على أَن هَذَا الَّذِي عِنْدهم لَيْسَ من عِنْد الله
segments.english: And sufficient for you [as] proof that what they have [is] not from God

segments.arabic: مَا ترى فِيهِ من التناقض وَالِاخْتِلَاف ومصادمة بعضه لبَعض
segments.english: [is] what you see in it of contradiction, disagreement, and parts of it clashing with other parts.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَلَوْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ غَيْرِ اللَّهِ لَوَجَدُوا فِيهِ اخْتِلافًا كثيرا﴾
segments.english: And if it had been from other than God, they [would] have found in it much disagreement.
segments.sahih_international: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an? If it had been from [any] other than Allah, they would have found within it much contradiction.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يدل على أَن مَا كَانَ من عِنْده سُبْحَانَهُ لَا يخْتَلف
segments.english: And this shows that what was from Him — glorified [is] He — does not differ,

segments.arabic: وَأَن مَا اخْتلف وتناقض فَلَيْسَ من عِنْده
segments.english: and that what differs and contradicts [is] not from Him.

segments.arabic: وَكَيف تكون الآراء والخيالات وسوانح الأفكار دينا يدان بِهِ
segments.english: And how can opinions, fantasies, and passing thoughts become [a] religion to be followed,

segments.arabic: وَيحكم بِهِ على الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: and [by which] judgment [is] passed over God and His Messenger?

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ هَذَا بهتان عَظِيم
segments.english: Glory be to You! This [is] [a] great slander.

segments.arabic: وَقد كَانَ علم الصَّحَابَة الَّذِي يتذاكرون فِيهِ غير عُلُوم هَؤُلَاءِ الْمُخْتَلِفين الخرّاصين
segments.english: And the knowledge of the Companions which they used to discuss among themselves was other than the knowledge of these differing liars,

segments.arabic: كَمَا حكى الْحَاكِم فِي تَرْجَمَة أبي عبد الله البُخَارِيّ قَالَ
segments.english: as al-Hakim reported in the biography of Abu Abdullah al-Bukhari. He said:

segments.arabic: كَانَ أَصْحَاب رَسُول الله إِذا اجْتَمعُوا إِنَّمَا يتذاكرون كتاب رَبهم وَسنة نَبِيّهم
segments.english: The Companions of the Messenger of God, when they gathered, would only discuss the Book of their Lord and the Sunnah of their Prophet,

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ بَينهم رَأْي وَلَا قِيَاس
segments.english: [there was] no opinion among them, nor analogy.

segments.arabic: وَلَقَد أحسن الْقَائِل
segments.english: And how well the poet said:

segments.arabic: الْعلم قَالَ الله قَالَ رَسُوله ... قَالَ الصَّحَابَة لَيْسَ بالتمويه
segments.english: Knowledge [is]: God said, His Messenger said, the Companions said — not deception.

segments.arabic: مَا الْعلم نصبك للْخلاف سفاهة ... بَين الرَّسُول وَبَين رَأْي فَقِيه
segments.english: Knowledge [is] not you setting up disagreement foolishly between the Messenger and the opinion of [a] jurist.

segments.arabic: كلا وَلَا جحد الصِّفَات ونفيها ... حذرا من التَّمْثِيل والتشبيه
segments.english: No! Nor [is it] denying the [divine] attributes and negating them, out of fear of comparison and resemblance.

segments.arabic: وَأما الْإِيمَان فَأكْثر النَّاس أَو كلهم يَدعُونَهُ
segments.english: As for faith, most people — or all of them — claim it.

segments.arabic: وَمَا أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بمؤمنين
segments.english: And most people, even if you [were] eager, [are] not believers.
segments.sahih_international: And most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers.

segments.arabic: وَأكْثر الْمُؤمنِينَ إِنَّمَا عِنْدهم إِيمَان مُجمل
segments.english: And most believers only have [a] general faith.

segments.arabic: وَأما الْإِيمَان الْمفصل بِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ الرَّسُول معرفَة وعلما وإقرارا ومحبة
segments.english: But as for detailed faith in what the Messenger brought — knowledge, understanding, acknowledgment, and love,

segments.arabic: وَمَعْرِفَة بضده وكراهيته وبغضه فَهَذَا إِيمَان
segments.english: and knowledge of its opposite, and hating it and detesting it — then this [is the] faith of...

segments.arabic: خَواص الْأمة وخاصة الرَّسُول وَهُوَ إِيمَان الصدّيق وَحزبه
segments.english: [the] elite of the nation and [the] closest [people] of the Messenger, and it [is] the faith of the Siddiq and his group.

segments.arabic: وَكثير من النَّاس حظهم من الْإِيمَان الْإِقْرَار بِوُجُود الصَّانِع وَأَنه وَحده الَّذِي خلق السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض وَمَا بَينهمَا
segments.english: And many of the people — their share of faith [is] acknowledging the existence of the Maker, and that He alone [is] the One who created the heavens and the earth and what [is] between them.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا لم يكن يُنكره عبّاد الْأَصْنَام من قُرَيْش وَنَحْوهم
segments.english: And this [was] not [something] the idol-worshippers of Quraysh and their like used to deny.

segments.arabic: وَآخَرُونَ الْإِيمَان عِنْدهم هُوَ التَّكَلُّم بِالشَّهَادَتَيْنِ سَوَاء كَانَ مَعَه عمل أَو لم يكن
segments.english: And others — faith according to them [is] speaking the two testimonies, whether there [was] action with it or not,

segments.arabic: وَسَوَاء وَافق تَصْدِيق الْقلب أَو خَالفه
segments.english: and whether the belief of the heart agreed [with it] or contradicted it.

segments.arabic: وَآخَرُونَ عِنْدهم الْإِيمَان مُجَرّد تَصْدِيق الْقلب بِأَن الله سُبْحَانَهُ خَالق السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض وَأَن مُحَمَّدًا عَبده وَرَسُوله
segments.english: And others — according to them, faith [is] merely the belief of the heart that God, glorified [is] He, [is] the Creator of the heavens and the earth, and that Muhammad [is] His servant and His Messenger,

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم يقر بِلِسَانِهِ وَلم يعْمل شَيْئا
segments.english: even if he does not affirm with his tongue and does not do anything,

segments.arabic: بل وَلَو سبّ الله وَرَسُوله وأتى بِكُل عَظِيمَة
segments.english: rather, even if he cursed God and His Messenger and committed every enormous [sin],

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ يعْتَقد وحدانية الله ونبوة رَسُوله فَهُوَ مُؤمن
segments.english: while he believes in the oneness of God and the prophethood of His Messenger — then he [is] a believer.

segments.arabic: وَآخَرُونَ عِنْدهم الْإِيمَان هُوَ جحد صِفَات الرب تَعَالَى
segments.english: And others — according to them, faith [is] denying the attributes of the Lord, Most High,

segments.arabic: من علوه على عَرْشه وتكلمه بكلماته وَكتبه وسَمعه وبصره ومشيئته وَقدرته وإرادته وحبه وبغضه
segments.english: [such as] His being above His Throne, and His speaking with His words, and His books, and His hearing, and His sight, and His will, and His power, and His intent, and His love, and His hatred,

segments.arabic: وَغير ذَلِك مِمَّا وصف بِهِ نَفسه وَوَصفه بِهِ رَسُوله
segments.english: and other than that from what He described Himself with and [what] His Messenger described Him with.

segments.arabic: فالإيمان عِنْدهم إِنْكَار حقائق ذَلِك كُله وجحده
segments.english: So faith according to them [is] denying the realities of all of that and rejecting it,

segments.arabic: وَالْوُقُوف مَعَ مَا تَقْتَضِيه آراء المتهوكين وأفكار المخرصين
segments.english: and standing with what the opinions of the confused ones require and the ideas of the fabricators,

segments.arabic: الَّذين يرد بَعضهم على بعض وينقض بَعضهم قَول بعض
segments.english: those who refute one another and [whose] some of them demolish the statements of others,

segments.arabic: الَّذين هم كَمَا قَالَ عمر بن الْخطاب وَالْإِمَام أَحْمد
segments.english: those who [are] as Umar ibn al-Khattab and Imam Ahmad said:

segments.arabic: مُخْتَلفُونَ فِي الْكتاب مخالفون للْكتاب متفقون على مُفَارقَة الْكتاب
segments.english: differing about the Book, opposing the Book, [and] agreeing on abandoning the Book.

segments.arabic: وَآخَرُونَ عِنْدهم الْإِيمَان عبَادَة الله بِحكم أذواقهم ومواجيدهم وَمَا تهواه نُفُوسهم
segments.english: And others — according to them, faith [is] worshipping God according to their tastes and their ecstatic experiences and what their selves desire,

segments.arabic: من غير تَقْيِيد بِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ الرَّسُول
segments.english: without being bound by what the Messenger came with.

segments.arabic: وَآخَرُونَ الْإِيمَان عِنْدهم مَا وجدوا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَهُم وأسلافهم بِحكم الِاتِّفَاق كَائِنا مَا كَانَ
segments.english: And others — faith according to them [is] what they found their fathers and ancestors upon, by [mere] agreement, whatever it may be.

segments.arabic: بل إِيمَانهم مَبْنِيّ على مقدمتين
segments.english: Rather, their faith [is] built on two premises:

segments.arabic: إِحْدَاهمَا أَن هَذَا قَول أسلافنا وَآبَائِنَا
segments.english: the first [is] that this [is] the saying of our ancestors and our fathers,

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانيَِة أَن مَا قَالُوهُ فَهُوَ الْحق
segments.english: and the second [is] that whatever they said — it [is] the truth.

segments.arabic: وَآخَرُونَ عِنْدهم الْإِيمَان مَكَارِم الْأَخْلَاق وَحسن الْمُعَامَلَة وطلاقة الْوَجْه
segments.english: And others — according to them, faith [is] noble character, and good dealings, and [a] cheerful face,

segments.arabic: وإحسان الظَّن بِكُل أحد وتخلية النَّاس وغفلاتهم
segments.english: and thinking well of everyone, and leaving people [alone] with their heedlessness.

segments.arabic: وَآخَرُونَ عِنْدهم الْإِيمَان التجرد من الدُّنْيَا وعلائقها وتفريغ الْقلب مِنْهَا والزهد فِيهَا
segments.english: And others — according to them, faith [is] stripping [oneself] from this world and its attachments, and emptying the heart from it, and having no desire for it.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا رَأَوْا رجلا هَكَذَا جَعَلُوهُ من سَادَات أهل الْإِيمَان
segments.english: So when they saw [a] man like this, they made him [one] of the leaders of the people of faith,

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ منسلخا من الْإِيمَان علما وَعَملا
segments.english: even if he [was] stripped of faith in knowledge and action.

segments.arabic: وَأَعْلَى من هَؤُلَاءِ من جعل الْإِيمَان هُوَ مُجَرّد الْعلم وَإِن لم يقارنه عمل
segments.english: And higher than these [are] those who made faith [to be] merely knowledge, even if action does not accompany it.

segments.arabic: وكل هَؤُلَاءِ لم يعرفوا حَقِيقَة الْإِيمَان وَلَا قَامُوا بِهِ وَلَا قَامَ بهم
segments.english: And all of these [people] did not know the reality of faith, nor did they stand by it, nor did it stand in them.

segments.arabic: وهم أَنْوَاع مِنْهُم من جعل الْإِيمَان مَا يضاد الْإِيمَان وَمِنْهُم
segments.english: And they [are] [of various] types — among them [are] those who made faith [to be] what contradicts faith, and among them [are] —

headings.arabic: قاعدة جليلة قال الله تعالى
headings.english: A Great Principle — [God] Most High Said

segments.arabic: بالتوفيق ترى أَن مَا جَاءَ بِهِ الرَّسُول هُوَ الْحق الْمُوَافق لِلْعَقْلِ وَالْحكمَة
segments.english: With [God's] guidance, you see that what the Messenger came with — it [is] the truth, in agreement with reason and wisdom.

segments.arabic: والعقول المضروبة بالخذلان ترى الْمُعَارضَة بَين الْعقل وَالنَّقْل وَبَين الْحِكْمَة وَالشَّرْع
segments.english: And the minds struck with failure see [a] contradiction between reason and revelation, and between wisdom and the Sacred Law.

segments.arabic: أقرب الْوَسَائِل إِلَى الله مُلَازمَة السّنة وَالْوُقُوف مَعهَا فِي الظَّاهِر وَالْبَاطِن
segments.english: The closest means to God [are]: holding firmly to the Sunnah and standing with it in the outward and the inward,

segments.arabic: ودوام الافتقار إِلَى الله
segments.english: and constant neediness toward God,

segments.arabic: وَإِرَادَة وَجهه وَحده بالأقوال وَالْأَفْعَال
segments.english: and seeking His Face alone through words and deeds.

segments.arabic: وَمَا وصل أحد إِلَى الله إِلَّا من هَذِه الثَّلَاثَة
segments.english: And no one [has] reached God except through these three,

segments.arabic: وَمَا انْقَطع عَنهُ أحد إِلَّا بانقطاعه عَنْهَا أَو عَن أَحدهَا
segments.english: and no one [has been] cut off from Him except by being cut off from them — or from one of them.

segments.arabic: الْأُصُول الَّتِي انبنى عَلَيْهَا سَعَادَة العَبْد ثَلَاثَة
segments.english: The foundations upon which the happiness of the servant [is] built [are] three,

segments.arabic: وَلكُل وَاحِد مِنْهَا ضد فَمن فقد ذَلِك الأَصْل حصل على ضِدّه
segments.english: and each one of them has an opposite. So whoever loses that foundation falls into its opposite:

segments.arabic: التَّوْحِيد وضده الشّرك
segments.english: monotheism — and its opposite [is] associating partners [with God],

segments.arabic: وَالسّنة وضدها الْبِدْعَة
segments.english: and the Sunnah — and its opposite [is] innovation,

segments.arabic: وَالطَّاعَة وضدها الْمعْصِيَة
segments.english: and obedience — and its opposite [is] disobedience.

segments.arabic: ولهذه الثَّلَاثَة ضد وَاحِد وَهُوَ خلو الْقلب من الرَّغْبَة فِي الله وَفِيمَا عِنْده
segments.english: And these three [have] [a] single opposite, which [is]: the heart being empty of longing for God and for what [is] with Him,

segments.arabic: وَمن الرهبة مِنْهُ وَمِمَّا عِنْده
segments.english: and [empty] of fear of Him and of what [is] with Him.

segments.arabic: قَاعِدَة جليلة قَالَ الله تَعَالَى
segments.english: A great principle. [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْآياتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ الْمُجْرمين
segments.english: And likewise We explain the verses in detail, so that the way of the criminals becomes clear.
segments.sahih_international: And thus do We detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ يُشَاقِقِ الرَّسُولَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ الْهُدَى وَيَتَّبِعْ غَيْرَ سَبِيلِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ نُوَلِّهِ مَا تولى
segments.english: And whoever opposes the Messenger after guidance [has] become clear to him, and follows other than the way of the believers — We [will] turn him to what he [has] turned to.
segments.sahih_international: And whoever opposes the Messenger after guidance has become clear to him and follows other than the way of the believers - We will give him what he has taken and drive him into Hell, and evil it is as a destination.

segments.arabic: الْآيَة
segments.english: — the [full] verse.

segments.arabic: وَالله تَعَالَى قد بَين فِي كِتَابه سَبِيل الْمُؤمنِينَ مفصّلة وسبيل الْمُجْرمين مفصّلة
segments.english: And God Most High has made clear in His Book the way of the believers in detail, and the way of the criminals in detail,

segments.arabic: وعاقبة هَؤُلَاءِ مفصّلة وعاقبة هَؤُلَاءِ مفصّلة
segments.english: and the outcome of these [people] in detail, and the outcome of those [people] in detail,

segments.arabic: وأعمال هَؤُلَاءِ وأعمال هَؤُلَاءِ
segments.english: and the deeds of these and the deeds of those,

segments.arabic: وأولياء هَؤُلَاءِ وأولياء هَؤُلَاءِ
segments.english: and the allies of these and the allies of those,

segments.arabic: وخذلانه لهَؤُلَاء وتوفيقه لهَؤُلَاء
segments.english: and His abandonment of these and His guiding of those,

segments.arabic: والأسباب الَّتِي وفْق بهَا هَؤُلَاءِ والأسباب الَّتِي خذل بهَا هَؤُلَاءِ
segments.english: and the causes by which He guided these, and the causes by which He abandoned those.

segments.arabic: وجلا سُبْحَانَهُ الْأَمريْنِ فِي كِتَابه وكشفهما وأوضحهما وبيّنهما غَايَة الْبَيَان
segments.english: And He — glorified [is] He — made clear the two matters in His Book, and uncovered them, and clarified them, and explained them to the utmost explanation,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى شاهدتهما البصائر كمشاهدة الْأَبْصَار للضياء والظلام
segments.english: until the inner eyes witnessed them like the outer eyes witness light and darkness.

segments.arabic: فالعالمون بِاللَّه وَكتابه وَدينه عرفُوا سَبِيل الْمُؤمنِينَ معرفَة تفصيلية وسبيل الْمُجْرمين معرفَة تفصيلية
segments.english: So those who know God, His Book, and His religion came to know the way of the believers in detailed knowledge, and the way of the criminals in detailed knowledge.

segments.arabic: فاستبانت لَهُم السبيلان كَمَا يستيبين للسالك الطَّرِيق الْموصل إِلَى مَقْصُوده وَالطَّرِيق الْموصل إِلَى الهلكة
segments.english: So the two ways became clear to them, just as [it] becomes clear to the traveler — the road leading to his destination and the road leading to ruin.

segments.arabic: فَهَؤُلَاءِ أعلم الْخلق وأنفعهم للنَّاس وأنصحهم لَهُم وهم الأدلاء الهداة
segments.english: So these [are] the most knowledgeable of creation, the most beneficial to people, and the most sincere toward them — and they [are] the guides [who] lead [to the truth].

segments.arabic: برز الصَّحَابَة على جَمِيع من أَتَى بعدهمْ إِلَى يَوْم
segments.english: The Companions surpassed all who came after them until the Day [of Judgment] —

segments.arabic: الْقِيَامَة فَإِنَّهُم نشأوا فى سَبِيل الظلال وَالْكفْر والشرك والسبل الموصلة إِلَى الْهَلَاك
segments.english: the Resurrection — for they grew up in the path of misguidance, disbelief, associating partners [with God], and the paths leading to destruction,

segments.arabic: وعرفوها مفصّلة
segments.english: and they knew them in detail.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ جَاءَهُم الرَّسُول فَأخْرجهُمْ من تِلْكَ الظُّلُمَات إِلَى سَبِيل الْهدى وصراط الله الْمُسْتَقيم
segments.english: Then the Messenger came to them and brought them out from those darknesses to the path of guidance and the straight path of God.

segments.arabic: فَخَرجُوا من الظلمَة الشَّدِيدَة إِلَى النُّور التَّام
segments.english: So they came out from intense darkness into complete light,

segments.arabic: وَمن الشّرك إِلَى التَّوْحِيد وَمن الْجَهْل إِلَى الْعلم
segments.english: and from associating partners [with God] to monotheism, and from ignorance to knowledge,

segments.arabic: وَمن الغي إِلَى الرشاد وَمن الظُّلم إِلَى الْعدْل
segments.english: and from error to right guidance, and from wrongdoing to justice,

segments.arabic: وَمن الْحيرَة والعمى إِلَى الْهدى والبصائر
segments.english: and from confusion and blindness to guidance and clear sight.

segments.arabic: فعرفوا مِقْدَار مَا نالوه وظفروا بِهِ وَمِقْدَار مَا كَانُوا فِيهِ
segments.english: So they knew the worth of what they had gained and achieved, and the worth of what they [had] been in.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الضِّدّ يظْهر حسنه الضِّدّ
segments.english: For the opposite — its beauty [is] made clear by [its] opposite.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا تتبين الْأَشْيَاء بأضدادها
segments.english: And things [are] only made clear by their opposites.

segments.arabic: فازدادوا رَغْبَة ومحبة فِيمَا انتقلوا إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: So they increased in eagerness and love for what they had moved to,

segments.arabic: ونفرة وبغضا لما انتقلوا عَنهُ
segments.english: and in aversion and hatred for what they had moved away from.

segments.arabic: وَكَانُوا أحب النَّاس فِي التَّوْحِيد وَالْإِيمَان وَالْإِسْلَام
segments.english: And they were the most loving of people toward monotheism, faith, and Islam,

segments.arabic: وَأبْغض النَّاس فِي ضِدّه عَالمين بالسبيل على التَّفْصِيل
segments.english: and the most hateful of people toward its opposite — knowing the path in detail.

segments.arabic: وَأما من جَاءَ بعد الصَّحَابَة فَمنهمْ من نَشأ فِي الْإِسْلَام غير عَالم تَفْصِيل ضِدّه
segments.english: As for those who came after the Companions, among them [were] those who grew up in Islam without knowing the details of its opposite.

segments.arabic: فَالْتبسَ عَلَيْهِ بعض تفاصيل سَبِيل الْمُؤمنِينَ بسبيل الْمُجْرمين
segments.english: So some details of the path of the believers became confused for him with the path of the criminals.

segments.arabic: فَإِن اللّبْس إِنَّمَا يَقع إِذا ضعف الْعلم بالسبيلين أَو أَحدهمَا
segments.english: For confusion only occurs when knowledge of the two paths — or one of them — [is] weak.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ عمر بن الْخطاب إِنَّمَا تنقض عرى الْإِسْلَام عُرْوَة عُرْوَة إِذا نَشأ فِي الْإِسْلَام من لم يعرف الْجَاهِلِيَّة
segments.english: As ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb said: the bonds of Islam [will] only be undone bond by bond when [there] grows up in Islam one who does not know pre-Islamic ignorance.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا من كَمَال علم عمر ﵁
segments.english: And this [is] from the completeness of ʿUmar's knowledge, may God be pleased with him.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ إِذا لم يعرف الْجَاهِلِيَّة وَحكمهَا وَهُوَ كل مَا خَالف مَا جَاءَ بِهِ الرَّسُول
segments.english: For if he does not know pre-Islamic ignorance and its rulings — and it [is] everything that goes against what the Messenger brought —

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ من الْجَاهِلِيَّة فَإِنَّهَا منسوبة إِلَى الْجَهْل
segments.english: then it [is] from pre-Islamic ignorance, for it [is] attributed to ignorance.

segments.arabic: وكل مَا خَالف الرَّسُول فَهُوَ من الْجَهْل
segments.english: And everything that goes against the Messenger — it [is] from ignorance.

segments.arabic: فَمن لم يعرف سَبِيل الْمُجْرمين وَلم تستبن لَهُ
segments.english: So whoever does not know the path of the criminals and [it has] not become clear to him,

segments.arabic: أوشك أَن يظنّ فِي بعض سبيلهم أَنَّهَا من سَبِيل الْمُؤمنِينَ
segments.english: [he is] close to thinking about some of their path that it [is] from the path of the believers,

segments.arabic: كَمَا وَقع فِي هَذِه الْأمة من أُمُور كَثِيرَة فِي بَاب الِاعْتِقَاد وَالْعلم وَالْعَمَل
segments.english: as [has] happened in this nation — many matters in the area of belief, knowledge, and action

segments.arabic: هِيَ من سَبِيل الْمُجْرمين وَالْكفَّار وأعداء الرُّسُل
segments.english: [that] are from the path of the criminals, the disbelievers, and the enemies of the messengers.

segments.arabic: أدخلها من لم يعرف أَنَّهَا من سبيلهم فِي سَبِيل الْمُؤمنِينَ
segments.english: Those who did not know that they [were] from their path introduced them into the path of the believers,

segments.arabic: ودعا إِلَيْهَا وكفّر من خالفها واستحل مِنْهُ مَا حرمه الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: and called to them, and declared disbelievers those who opposed them, and made permissible from him what God and His Messenger had forbidden —

segments.arabic: كَمَا وَقع لأكْثر أهل الْبدع من الْجَهْمِية والقدرية والخوارج وَالرَّوَافِض وأشباههم
segments.english: as happened with most of the people of innovation: the Jahmiyyah, the Qadariyyah, the Khawārij, the Rawāfiḍ, and those like them —

segments.arabic: مِمَّن ابتدع بِدعَة ودعا إِلَيْهَا وكفّر من خالفها
segments.english: those who invented [an] innovation, called to it, and declared disbelievers those who opposed it.

segments.arabic: وَالنَّاس فِي هَذَا الْموضع أَربع فرق
segments.english: And people in this matter [are] four groups.

segments.arabic: الأولى من استبان لَهُ سَبِيل الْمُؤمنِينَ وسبيل الْمُجْرمين على التَّفْصِيل علما وَعَملا
segments.english: The first: those for whom the path of the believers and the path of the criminals became clear in detail — in knowledge and action.

segments.arabic: وَهَؤُلَاء أعلم الْخلق
segments.english: And these [are] the most knowledgeable of creation.

segments.arabic: الْفرْقَة الثَّانِيَة من
segments.english: The second group: those who

segments.arabic: عميت عَنهُ السبيلان من أشباه الْأَنْعَام
segments.english: the two paths [were] hidden from him — from those resembling cattle.

segments.arabic: وَهَؤُلَاء بسبيل الْمُجْرمين أحضر وَلها أسلك
segments.english: And these [people are] more present on the path of the criminals, and more traveled upon it.

segments.arabic: الْفرْقَة الثَّالِثَة من صرف عنايته إِلَى معرفَة سَبِيل الْمُؤمنِينَ دون ضدها
segments.english: The third group [is] whoever directed his attention to knowing the path of the believers, without [knowing] its opposite.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ يعرف ضدها من حَيْثُ الْجُمْلَة والمخالفة
segments.english: So he knows its opposite in [a] general way and [by] contrast,

segments.arabic: وَأَن كل مَا خَالف سَبِيل الْمُؤمنِينَ فَهُوَ بَاطِل
segments.english: and that everything that opposes the path of the believers [is] false,

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم يتصوره على التَّفْصِيل
segments.english: even if he does not picture it in detail.

segments.arabic: بل إِذا سمع شَيْئا مِمَّا خَالف سَبِيل الْمُؤمنِينَ صرف سَمعه عَنهُ
segments.english: Rather, when he hears something of what opposes the path of the believers, he turns his hearing away from it

segments.arabic: وَلم يشغل نَفسه بفهمه وَمَعْرِفَة وَجه بُطْلَانه
segments.english: and does not occupy himself with understanding it or knowing the reason of its falsehood.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَة من سلمت نَفسه من إِرَادَة الشَّهَوَات
segments.english: And he [is] like one whose self [was] safe from wanting desires,

segments.arabic: فَلم تخطر بِقَلْبِه وَلم تَدعه إِلَيْهَا نَفسه
segments.english: so they did not cross his heart, and his self did not call him to them —

segments.arabic: بِخِلَاف الْفرْقَة الأولى فَإِنَّهُم يعرفونها وتميل إِلَيْهَا نُفُوسهم ويجاهدونها على تَركهَا لله
segments.english: unlike the first group, for they know them and their selves incline toward them, yet they struggle against them to leave them for God.

segments.arabic: وَقد كتبُوا إِلَى عمر بن الْخطاب يسألونه عَن هَذِه المسالة
segments.english: And they wrote to Umar ibn al-Khattab asking him about this matter:

segments.arabic: أَيّمَا أفضل رجل لم تخطر لَهُ الشَّهَوَات وَلم تمر بِبَالِهِ
segments.english: which [is] better — [a] man for whom desires did not occur and did not cross his mind,

segments.arabic: أَو رجل نازعته إِلَيْهَا نَفسه فَتَركهَا لله
segments.english: or [a] man whose self pulled him toward them, yet he left them for God?

segments.arabic: فَكتب عمر أَن الَّذِي تشْتَهي نَفسه الْمعاصِي وَيَتْرُكهَا لله ﷿
segments.english: So Umar wrote that the one whose self craves sins yet leaves them for God, Mighty and Majestic,

segments.arabic: من الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَى لَهُم مغفرة وَأجر عَظِيم
segments.english: [is] from those whom God has tested their hearts for God-consciousness — for them [is] forgiveness and [a] great reward.

segments.arabic: وَهَكَذَا من عرف الْبدع والشرك وَالْبَاطِل وطرقه
segments.english: And likewise, whoever knows innovations and associating partners [with God] and falsehood and its paths,

segments.arabic: فأبغضها لله وحذرها وحذّر مِنْهَا
segments.english: and hated them for God, and was cautious of them, and warned against them,

segments.arabic: وَدفعهَا عَن نَفسه وَلم يَدعهَا تخدش وَجه إيمَانه
segments.english: and pushed them away from himself, and did not let them scratch the face of his faith,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تورثه شُبْهَة وَلَا شكا
segments.english: nor cause him doubt or uncertainty —

segments.arabic: بل يزْدَاد بمعرفتها بَصِيرَة فِي الْحق ومحبة لَهُ
segments.english: rather, he increases by knowing them [in] insight into the truth and love for it,

segments.arabic: وَكَرَاهَة لَهَا ونفرة عَنْهَا
segments.english: and hatred for them and aversion from them —

segments.arabic: أفضل مِمَّن لَا تخطر بِبَالِهِ وَلَا تمر بِقَلْبِه
segments.english: [is] better than one for whom they do not occur to his mind and do not cross his heart.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ كلما مرت بِقَلْبِه وتصورت لَهُ
segments.english: For whenever they cross his heart and become clear to him,

segments.arabic: ازْدَادَ محبَّة للحق وَمَعْرِفَة بِقَدرِهِ وسرورا بِهِ
segments.english: he increases [in] love for the truth, and knowledge of its worth, and joy in it,

segments.arabic: فيقوى إيمَانه بِهِ
segments.english: so his faith in it grows stronger.

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن صَاحب خواطر الشَّهَوَات والمعاصي كلما مرت بِهِ فَرغب عَنْهَا إِلَى ضدها
segments.english: Just as the one with thoughts of desires and sins — whenever they cross him and he turns away from them toward their opposite —

segments.arabic: ازْدَادَ محبَّة لضدها ورغبة فِيهِ وطلبا لَهُ وحرصا عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: he increases [in] love for their opposite, and longing for it, and seeking it, and eagerness for it.

segments.arabic: فَمَا ابتلى الله سُبْحَانَهُ عَبده الْمُؤمن بمحبة الشَّهَوَات والمعاصي وميل نَفسه إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: So God, glorified [is] He, did not test His believing servant with love of desires and sins and his self's inclination toward them

segments.arabic: إِلَّا ليسوقه بهَا إِلَى محبَّة مَا هُوَ أفضل مِنْهَا وَخير لَهُ وأنفع وأدوم
segments.english: except to drive him through them to the love of what [is] better than them, and more good for him, and more beneficial, and more lasting,

segments.arabic: وليجاهد نَفسه على تَركهَا لَهُ سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: and so that he struggles against his self to leave them for Him, glorified [is] He.

segments.arabic: فتورثه تِلْكَ المجاهدة الْوُصُول إِلَى المحبوب الْأَعْلَى
segments.english: And that struggle gives him arrival to the Highest Beloved.

segments.arabic: فَكلما نازعته نَفسه إِلَى تِلْكَ الشَّهَوَات وشتدت إِرَادَته لَهَا وشوقه إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: So whenever his self pulls him toward those desires, and his want for them and his longing for them grow stronger,

segments.arabic: صرف ذَلِك الشوق والإرادة والمحبة إِلَى النَّوْع العالي الدَّائِم
segments.english: he redirects that longing and want and love to the high, lasting kind.

segments.arabic: فَكَانَ طلبه لَهُ أَشد وحرصه عَلَيْهِ أتم
segments.english: So his seeking of it [was] more intense, and his eagerness for it more complete,

segments.arabic: بِخِلَاف النَّفس الْبَارِدَة الخالية من ذَلِك
segments.english: unlike the cold self, empty of that.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا وَإِن كَانَت طالبة للأعلى لَكِن بَين الطلبين فرق عَظِيم
segments.english: For even if it [was] seeking the higher, between the two seekings [there is a] great difference.

segments.arabic: أَلا ترى أَن من مَشى إِلَى محبوبه على الْجَمْر
segments.english: Do you not see that whoever walks to his beloved upon burning coals —

headings.arabic: فصل عشرة أشياء ضائعة لا ينتفع بها علم لا يعمل به وعمل لا
headings.english: Chapter: Ten Wasted Things That Bring No Benefit — Knowledge That [Is] Not Acted Upon, and Deeds That [Have] No...

segments.arabic: والشوك أعظم مِمَّن مَشى إِلَيْهِ رَاكِبًا على النجائب
segments.english: and thorns [is] greater than [the one] who walked to Him riding on fine camels.

segments.arabic: فَلَيْسَ من آثر محبوبه مَعَ مُنَازعَة نَفسه كمن آثره مَعَ عدم منازعتها إِلَى غَيره
segments.english: So [the one] who preferred his Beloved while his self resisted [is] not like [the one] who preferred Him without his self pulling toward another.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يَبْتَلِي عَبده بالشهوات
segments.english: So He, glorified [is] He, tests His servant with desires —

segments.arabic: إِمَّا حِجَابا لَهُ عَنهُ أَو حاجبا لَهُ يوصله إِلَى رِضَاهُ وقربه وكرامته
segments.english: either [as] a veil for him from Him, or [as] a barrier for him [that] leads him to His pleasure, His nearness, and His honor.

segments.arabic: الْفرْقَة الرَّابِعَة فرقة عرفت سَبِيل الشَّرّ والبدع وَالْكفْر مفصلة
segments.english: The fourth group [is] a group [that] knew the path of evil, innovation, and disbelief in detail,

segments.arabic: وسبيل الْمُؤمنِينَ مجملة
segments.english: and [knew] the path of the believers [only] in general.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا حَال كثير مِمَّن اعتنى بمقالات الْأُمَم ومقالات أهل الْبدع
segments.english: And this [is] the condition of many who concerned themselves with the doctrines of the nations and the doctrines of the people of innovation,

segments.arabic: فعرفها على التَّفْصِيل وَلم يعرف مَا جَاءَ بِهِ الرَّسُول كَذَلِك
segments.english: so they knew them in detail, but did not know what the Messenger came with in the same way.

segments.arabic: بل عرفه معرفَة مجملة وَإِن تفصلت لَهُ فِي بعض الْأَشْيَاء
segments.english: Rather, they knew it [with] a general knowledge, even if it was detailed for them in some things.

segments.arabic: وَمن تَأمل كتبهمْ رأى ذَلِك عيَانًا
segments.english: And whoever reflects on their books [will] see that clearly.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ من كَانَ عَارِفًا بطرق الشَّرّ وَالظُّلم وَالْفساد على التَّفْصِيل سالكا لَهَا
segments.english: And likewise, whoever was familiar with the paths of evil, injustice, and corruption in detail, walking upon them —

segments.arabic: إِذا تَابَ وَرجع عَنْهَا إِلَى سَبِيل الْأَبْرَار
segments.english: when he repented and turned from them to the path of the righteous,

segments.arabic: يكون علمه بهَا مُجملا غير عَارِف بهَا على التَّفْصِيل
segments.english: his knowledge of it [would be] general, not knowing it in detail —

segments.arabic: معرفَة من أفنى عمره فِي تصرفها وسلوكها
segments.english: [not] the knowledge of [the one] who spent his life practicing and walking upon it.

segments.arabic: وَالْمَقْصُود أَن الله سُبْحَانَهُ يحب أَن تعرف سَبِيل أعدائه لتجتنب تبغض
segments.english: And the point [is] that God, glorified [is] He, loves that the path of His enemies be known, so [it is] avoided and hated,

segments.arabic: كَمَا يجب أَن تعرف سَبِيل أوليائه لِتُحَبّ وتسلك
segments.english: just as the path of His close ones must be known, so [it is] loved and followed.

segments.arabic: وَفِي هَذِه الْمعرفَة من الْفَوَائِد والأسرار مَالا يُعلمهُ إِلَّا الله
segments.english: And in this knowledge [there are] benefits and secrets that none knows except God —

segments.arabic: من معرفَة عُمُوم ربوبيته سُبْحَانَهُ وحكمته وَكَمَال أَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاته
segments.english: from knowing the vastness of His lordship, glorified [is] He, and His wisdom, and the perfection of His names and attributes,

segments.arabic: وتعلقها بمتعلقاتها واقتضائها لآثارها وموجباتها
segments.english: and their connection to what they relate to, and their requiring of their effects and what they call for.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ من أعظم الدّلَالَة على ربوبيته وَملكه وإلهيته
segments.english: And that [is] among the greatest evidence of His lordship, His sovereignty, and His divinity,

segments.arabic: وحبه وبغضه وثوابه وعقابه وَالله أعلم
segments.english: and His love, His hatred, His reward, and His punishment. And God knows best.

segments.arabic: أَرْبَاب الْحَوَائِج على بَاب الْملك يسْأَلُون قَضَاء حوائجهم
segments.english: The people of needs [are] at the door of the King, asking [for] the fulfillment of their needs.

segments.arabic: وأولياؤه المحبون لَهُ الَّذين هُوَ هَمهمْ ومرادهم جُلَسَاؤُهُ وخواصه
segments.english: And His close ones who love Him, for whom He [is] their concern and their desire — [they are] His companions and His special ones.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أَرَادَ قَضَاء حَاجَة وَاحِد من أُولَئِكَ
segments.english: So when He wants to fulfill the need of one of those [people],

segments.arabic: أذن لبَعض جُلَسَائِهِ وخاصته أَن يشفع فِيهِ
segments.english: He permits some of His companions and close ones to intercede for him —

segments.arabic: رَحْمَة لَهُ وكرامة للشافع
segments.english: [as] a mercy to him and [as] an honor for the intercessor.

segments.arabic: وَسَائِر النَّاس مطرودون عَن الْبَاب مضروبون بسياط العَبْد
segments.english: And the rest of the people [are] driven away from the door, struck with the whips of the servant.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Chapter

segments.arabic: عشرَة أَشْيَاء ضائعة لَا ينْتَفع بهَا
segments.english: Ten wasted things that bring no benefit:

segments.arabic: علم لَا يعْمل بِهِ
segments.english: knowledge that [is] not acted upon,

segments.arabic: وَعمل لَا إخلاص فِيهِ وَلَا اقْتِدَاء
segments.english: and deeds [that have] no sincerity in them and no following [of guidance],

segments.arabic: وَمَال لَا ينْفق مِنْهُ فَلَا يسْتَمْتع بِهِ جَامعه فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يقدمهُ
segments.english: and wealth that [is] not spent from — so its collector does not enjoy it in this world, nor does he send it forward.

headings.arabic: فصل لله سبحانه على عبده أمر أمره به وقضاء يقضيه عليه ونعمة ينعم
headings.english: Section: God, glorified [is] He, has over His servant a command He commanded him with, a decree He decrees upon him, and a blessing He blesses him with

segments.arabic: أَمَامه إِلَى الْآخِرَة
segments.english: before him to the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: وقلب فارغ من محبَّة الله والشوق إِلَيْهِ والأنس بِهِ
segments.english: and [a] heart empty of the love of God, and longing for Him, and closeness to Him,

segments.arabic: وبدن معطل من طَاعَته وخدمته
segments.english: and [a] body idle from His obedience and His service,

segments.arabic: ومحبة لَا تتقيد برضاء المحبوب وامتثال أوامره
segments.english: and [a] love [that] does not bind itself to the pleasure of the Beloved and following His commands,

segments.arabic: وَوقت معطل عَن اسْتِدْرَاك فارطه أَو اغتنام بر وقربة
segments.english: and [a] time idle from making up what [he] missed, or seizing [a] good deed and closeness [to God],

segments.arabic: وفكر يجول فِيمَا لَا ينفع
segments.english: and [a] thought [that] wanders in what does not benefit,

segments.arabic: وخدمة من لَا تقربك خدمته إِلَى الله وَلَا تعود عَلَيْك بصلاح دنياك
segments.english: and serving one whose service does not bring you closer to God and does not return to you with benefit in this world of yours,

segments.arabic: وخوفك ورجاؤك لمن ناصيته بيد الله وَهُوَ أسير فِي قَبضته
segments.english: and your fear and your hope [being] for one whose forelock [is] in the hand of God, and he [is] a captive in His grip,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يملك لنَفسِهِ حذرا وَلَا نفعا وَلَا موتا وَلَا حَيَاة وَلَا نشورا
segments.english: and [he] does not possess for himself [any] protection, nor benefit, nor death, nor life, nor resurrection.

segments.arabic: وَأعظم هَذِه الإضاعات إضاعتان هما أصل كل إِضَاعَة
segments.english: And the greatest of these losses [are] two losses — they [are] the root of every loss:

segments.arabic: إِضَاعَة الْقلب وإضاعة الْوَقْت
segments.english: the loss of the heart and the loss of time.
