segments.arabic: فإضاعة الْقلب من إِيثَار الدُّنْيَا على الْآخِرَة
segments.english: The loss of the heart [is] from preferring this world over the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: وإضاعة الْوَقْت من طول الأمل
segments.english: and the loss of time [is] from long hopes.

segments.arabic: فَاجْتمع الْفساد كُله فِي إتباع الْهوى وَطول الأمل
segments.english: So all corruption gathered in following desire and long hopes,

segments.arabic: وَالصَّلَاح كُله فى اتِّبَاع الهدى والاستعداد للقاء
segments.english: and all righteousness [is] in following guidance and preparing for the meeting [with God].

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: And God [is] the One sought for help.

segments.arabic: الْعجب مِمَّن تعرض لَهُ حَاجَة
segments.english: [How] amazing [is the case] of one who [has] a need come to him,

segments.arabic: فَيصْرف رغبته وهمته فِيهَا إِلَى الله ليقضيها لَهُ
segments.english: so he directs his desire and his focus in it to God so that He fulfills it for him,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يتَصَدَّى للسؤال لحياة قلبه من موت الْجَهْل والإعراض
segments.english: but does not turn to asking for the life of his heart from the death of ignorance and turning away,

segments.arabic: وشفائه من دَاء الشَّهَوَات والشبهات
segments.english: and its healing from the disease of desires and doubts.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن إِذا مَاتَ الْقلب لم يشْعر بمعصيته
segments.english: But when the heart dies, [it] does not feel its disobedience.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Section

segments.arabic: لله سُبْحَانَهُ على عَبده أَمر أمره بِهِ
segments.english: God, glorified [is] He, has over His servant a command [that] He commanded him with,

segments.arabic: وَقَضَاء يَقْضِيه عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and [a] decree [that] He decrees upon him,

segments.arabic: ونعمة ينعم بهَا عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and [a] blessing [that] He blesses him with.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يَنْفَكّ من هَذِه الثَّلَاثَة
segments.english: So he [is] never free from these three.

segments.arabic: وَالْقَضَاء نَوْعَانِ إِمَّا مصائب وَإِمَّا معائب
segments.english: And the decree [is] two types: either calamities or faults.

segments.arabic: وَله عَلَيْهِ عبودية فِي هَذِه الْمَرَاتِب كلهَا
segments.english: And he owes Him servitude in all of these levels.

segments.arabic: فَأحب الْخلق إِلَيْهِ من عرف عبوديته فِي هَذِه الْمَرَاتِب ووفاها حَقّهَا
segments.english: So the most beloved of creation to Him [is] whoever knows his servitude in these levels and fulfills its right.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا أقرب الْخلق إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: So this [person is] the closest of creation to Him,

segments.arabic: وأبعدهم مِنْهُ من جهل عبوديته فِي هَذِه الْمَرَاتِب فعطلها علما وَعَملا
segments.english: and the farthest from Him [is] whoever [is] ignorant of his servitude in these levels, and neglected it in knowledge and action.

segments.arabic: فعبوديته فِي الْأَمر وامتثاله اخلاصا واقتداءا برَسُول الله
segments.english: So his servitude regarding the command [is] obeying it with sincerity and following the Messenger of God,

segments.arabic: وَفِي النَّهْي اجتنابه خوفًا مِنْهُ وإجلالا ومحبة
segments.english: and regarding the prohibition, [it is] avoiding it out of fear of Him, reverence, and love.

segments.arabic: وعبوديته فِي قَضَاء المصائب الصَّبْر عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: And his servitude regarding the decree of calamities [is] patience with them,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ الرِّضَا بهَا وَهُوَ أَعلَى مِنْهُ
segments.english: then contentment with them, and it [is] higher than it,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ الشُّكْر عَلَيْهَا وَهُوَ أَعلَى من الرِّضَا
segments.english: then gratitude for them, and it [is] higher than contentment.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا إِنَّمَا يأتى مِنْهُ إِذا تمكن حبه من قلبه
segments.english: And this only comes from him when His love takes hold of his heart,

segments.arabic: وَعلم حسن اخْتِيَاره لَهُ وبره بِهِ ولطفه بِهِ
segments.english: and he knows the goodness of His choosing for him, and His kindness to him, and His gentleness with him.

segments.arabic: وإحسانه إِلَيْهِ بالمصيبة وَإِن كره الْمُصِيبَة
segments.english: and His kindness to him through the calamity, even if he dislikes the calamity.

segments.arabic: وعبوديته فِي قَضَاء المعائب الْمُبَادرَة إِلَى التَّوْبَة مِنْهَا والتنصل
segments.english: And his servitude regarding the occurrence of faults [is] hastening to repentance from them and freeing [himself],

segments.arabic: وَالْوُقُوف فِي مقَام الِاعْتِذَار والانكسار
segments.english: and standing in the position of apology and brokenness,

segments.arabic: عَالما بِأَنَّهُ لَا يرفعها عَنهُ إِلَّا هُوَ وَلَا يَقِيه شَرها سواهُ
segments.english: knowing that none removes them from him except Him, and none protects him from their evil other than Him,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهَا إِن استمرت أبعدته من ربه وطردته من بَابه
segments.english: and that if they continue, they [would] distance him from his Lord and drive him from His door.

segments.arabic: فيراها من الضّر الَّذِي لَا يكشفه غَيره
segments.english: So he sees them as [a] harm that none removes except Him,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى انه ليراها أعظم من ضرّ الْبدن
segments.english: to the point that he sees them [as] greater than [the] harm of the body.

segments.arabic: فه عَائِذ بِرِضَاهُ من سخطه وبعفوه من عُقُوبَته وَبِه مِنْهُ
segments.english: So he [is] seeking refuge in His pleasure from His anger, and in His pardon from His punishment, and in Him from Him —

segments.arabic: مستجير وملتجىء مِنْهُ اليه
segments.english: seeking protection and taking refuge — from Him, to Him —

segments.arabic: بِعلم أَنه إِن تخلى عَنهُ وخلى بَينه وَبَين نَفسه فعده أَمْثَالهَا وَشر مِنْهَا
segments.english: with [the] knowledge that if He abandons him and leaves him to himself, he [would have] the likes of them and worse than them,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه لَا سَبِيل لَهُ إِلَى الإقلاع وَالتَّوْبَة إِلَّا بتوفيقه وإعانته
segments.english: and that he has no way to stop and [to] repent except through His guidance and His help,

segments.arabic: وَأَن ذَلِك بِيَدِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ لَا بيد العَبْد
segments.english: and that that [is] in His hand — glorified [is] He — not in the hand of the servant.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ أعجز وأضعف وَأَقل من أَن يوفق نَفسه
segments.english: For he [is] too helpless and too weak and too small to guide himself,

segments.arabic: أَو يَأْتِي بمرضاة سَيّده بِدُونِ إِذْنه ومشيئته وإعانته
segments.english: or to bring about the pleasure of his Master without His permission and His will and His help.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ ملتجىء إِلَيْهِ متضرع ذليل مِسْكين
segments.english: So he [is] taking refuge in Him, pleading, humble, [and] needy,

segments.arabic: مُلْقٍ نَفسه بَين يَدَيْهِ طريح بَابه
segments.english: casting himself before Him, lying at His door,

segments.arabic: مستخذله أذلّ شَيْء وأكسره لَهُ وأفقره وأحوجه إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: submissive to Him — the most humble thing and the most broken before Him, and the most poor and the most in need of Him,

segments.arabic: وأرغبه فِيهِ وأحبه لَهُ
segments.english: and the most desirous of Him and the most loving of Him.

segments.arabic: بدنه متصرف فِي أشغاله وَقَلبه ساجد بَين يَدَيْهِ
segments.english: His body [is] occupied in His service, and his heart [is] prostrating before Him.

segments.arabic: يعلم يَقِينا انه لَا خير فِيهِ وَلَا لَهُ وَلَا بِهِ وَلَا مِنْهُ
segments.english: He knows with certainty that [there is] no good in him, nor for him, nor through him, nor from him,

segments.arabic: وَأَن الْخَيْر كُله لله وَفِي يَدَيْهِ وَبِه وَمِنْه
segments.english: and that all good [belongs] to God, and [is] in His hands, and through Him, and from Him.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ ولي نعْمَته ومبتدئه بهَا من غير اسْتِحْقَاق
segments.english: So He [is] the owner of His blessing and the one who begins it without [any] deserving,

segments.arabic: ومجريها عَلَيْهِ مَعَ تمقته إِلَيْهِ بإعراضه وغفلته ومعصيته
segments.english: and [He] continues it upon him despite [the servant] making himself hateful to Him through his turning away and his heedlessness and his disobedience.

segments.arabic: فحظه سُبْحَانَهُ الْحَمد وَالشُّكْر وَالثنَاء
segments.english: So His share — glorified [is] He — [is] praise and thanks and commendation,

segments.arabic: وحظ العَبْد الذَّم وَالنَّقْص وَالْعَيْب
segments.english: and the share of the servant [is] blame and deficiency and fault.

segments.arabic: قد اسْتَأْثر بالمحامد والمدح وَالثنَاء
segments.english: He has taken for Himself all the praises and the lauding and the commendation,

segments.arabic: وَولى العَبْد الْمَلَامَة والنقائص والعيوب
segments.english: and given the servant the blame and the deficiencies and the faults.

segments.arabic: فَالْحَمْد كُله لَهُ وَالْخَيْر كُله فِي يَدَيْهِ
segments.english: So all praise [is] His, and all good [is] in His hands,

segments.arabic: وَالْفضل كُله لَهُ وَالثنَاء كُله لَهُ والْمنَّة كلهَا لَهُ
segments.english: and all favor [is] His, and all commendation [is] His, and all grace [is] His.

segments.arabic: فَمِنْهُ الْإِحْسَان وَمن العَبْد الْإِسَاءَة
segments.english: So from Him [is] goodness, and from the servant [is] wrongdoing.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْه التودد إِلَى العَبْد بنعمه وَمن العَبْد التبغض إِلَيْهِ بمعاصيه
segments.english: And from Him [is] drawing close to the servant with His blessings, and from the servant [is] making himself hateful to Him with his sins.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْه النصح لعَبْدِهِ وَمن العَبْد الْغِشّ لَهُ فِي مُعَامَلَته
segments.english: And from Him [is] sincere advice to His servant, and from the servant [is] deceit toward Him in his dealings.

segments.arabic: وَأما عبودية النعم فمعرفتها وَالِاعْتِرَاف بهَا أَولا
segments.english: As for the servitude of blessings, [it is] recognizing them and acknowledging them first.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ العياذ بِهِ أَن يَقع فِي قلبه نسبتها وإضافتها إِلَى سواهُ
segments.english: Then seeking refuge in Him from there falling into his heart [the] attributing of them and assigning of them to other than Him.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ سَببا من الْأَسْبَاب فَهُوَ مسببه ومقيمه
segments.english: And even if there was [a] means among the means, He [is] the one who caused it and established it.

segments.arabic: فالنعمة مِنْهُ وَحده بِكُل وَجه وَاعْتِبَار
segments.english: So the blessing [is] from Him alone in every way and regard.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ الثَّنَاء بهَا عَلَيْهِ ومحبته عَلَيْهَا وشكره
segments.english: Then praising Him for it, and loving Him for it, and thanking Him

segments.arabic: بِأَن يستعملها فِي طَاعَته
segments.english: by using it in His obedience.

segments.arabic: وَمن لطائف التَّعَبُّد بِالنعَم أَن يكثر قليلها عَلَيْهِ ويستقل كثير شكره عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: And from the subtleties of worship through blessings [is] that he regards the little of them as much upon him, and considers much of his gratitude for them [as] little.

segments.arabic: وبعلم أَنَّهَا وصلت إِلَيْهِ من سَيّده من غير ثمن بذله فِيهَا وَلَا وَسِيلَة مِنْهُ توسل
segments.english: And [he] knows that they reached him from his Master without [any] price he paid for them, and without [any] means from him [by which] he sought [them].

headings.arabic: فصل من ترك الاختيار والتدبير في رجاء زيادة أو خوف نقصان أو طلب
headings.english: Chapter: On whoever leaves choice and planning in hope of increase or fear of decrease or seeking

segments.arabic: بهَا إِلَيْهِ وَلَا اسْتِحْقَاق مِنْهُ لَهَا
segments.english: with them to Him, and no deserving from him of them,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهَا لله فِي الْحَقِيقَة لَا للْعَبد
segments.english: and that they [belong] to God in reality, not to the servant.

segments.arabic: فَلَا تزيده النعم إِلَّا انكسارا وذلا وتواضعا ومحبة للمنعم
segments.english: So blessings do not increase him except [in] brokenness, humility, lowliness, and love for the One who blessed [him].

segments.arabic: وَكلما جدد لَهُ نعْمَة أحدث لَهَا عبودية ومحبة وخضوعا وذلا
segments.english: And whenever He renewed for him [a] blessing, he produced for it servitude, love, submission, and humility.

segments.arabic: وَكلما أحدث لَهُ قبضا أحدث لَهُ رضى
segments.english: And whenever He brought about for him [a] hardship, he produced contentment.

segments.arabic: وَكلما أحدث ذَنبا أحدث لَهُ تَوْبَة وانكسارا واعتذارا
segments.english: And whenever he committed [a] sin, he produced repentance, brokenness, and seeking pardon.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا هُوَ العَبْد الكيّس
segments.english: So this — he [is] the clever servant,

segments.arabic: وَالْعَاجِز بمعزل عَن ذَلِك وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: and the helpless [one is] far removed from that. And with God [is] success.

segments.arabic: من ترك الِاخْتِيَار وَالتَّدْبِير فِي رَجَاء زِيَادَة أَو خوف نُقْصَان أَو طلب صِحَة أَو فرار من سقم
segments.english: Whoever leaves choice and planning — in hope of increase, or fear of decrease, or seeking health, or fleeing from illness —

segments.arabic: وَعلم أَن الله على كل شَيْء قدير
segments.english: and knows that God [is] capable over all things,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه المتفرد بِالِاخْتِيَارِ وَالتَّدْبِير
segments.english: and that He [is] the One alone in choice and planning,

segments.arabic: وَأَن تَدْبيره لعَبْدِهِ خير من تَدْبِير العَبْد لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: and that His planning for His servant [is] better than the servant's planning for himself,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه أعلم بمصلحته من العَبْد
segments.english: and that He [is] more knowing of what [is] good for him than the servant,

segments.arabic: وأقدر على جلبها وتحصيلها مِنْهُ
segments.english: and more capable of bringing it and achieving it than him,

segments.arabic: وأنصح للْعَبد مِنْهُ لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: and more sincere to the servant than he [is] to himself,

segments.arabic: وأرحم مِنْهُ بِنَفسِهِ وَأبر بِهِ مِنْهُ بِنَفسِهِ
segments.english: and more merciful than he [is] to himself, and more caring of him than he [is] of himself,

segments.arabic: وَعلم مَعَ ذَلِك أَنه لَا يَسْتَطِيع أَن يتَقَدَّم بَين يَدي تَدْبيره خطْوَة وَاحِدَة
segments.english: and knows along with that, that he cannot advance ahead of His planning [by] [a] single step,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يتَأَخَّر عَن تَدْبيره لَهُ خطْوَة وَاحِدَة
segments.english: nor fall behind His planning for him [by] [a] single step —

segments.arabic: فَلَا مُتَقَدم لَهُ بَين يَدي قَضَائِهِ وَقدره وَلَا يتَأَخَّر
segments.english: so there [is] no getting ahead of His decree and destiny, nor falling behind —

segments.arabic: فَألْقى نَفسه بَين يَدَيْهِ وَسلم الْأَمر كُله إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: so he threw himself before Him and surrendered the matter — all of it — to Him,

segments.arabic: وانطرح بَين يَدَيْهِ انطراح عبد مَمْلُوك ضعف بَين يَدي ملك عَزِيز قاهر
segments.english: and he fell down before Him — the falling of [a] weak owned slave before [a] mighty, overpowering king,

segments.arabic: لَهُ التَّصَرُّف فِي عَبده بِكُل مَا يَشَاء
segments.english: who has the right to deal with his slave in whatever he wills,

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ للْعَبد التَّصَرُّف فِيهِ بِوَجْه من الْوُجُوه
segments.english: and the slave has no right to deal with him in any way —

segments.arabic: فاستراح حِينَئِذٍ من الهموم والغموم والأنكاد والحسرات
segments.english: so he found rest then from the worries, sorrows, troubles, and regrets.

segments.arabic: وَحمل كُله حَوَائِجه ومصالحه من لَا يُبَالِي بحملها وَلَا يثقله وَلَا يكترث بهَا
segments.english: And the One who [is] not burdened by carrying them, nor [is] weighed down, nor troubled by them, carried all of his needs and interests.

segments.arabic: فتولاها دونه وَأرَاهُ لطفه وبره وَرَحمته وإحسانه فِيهَا
segments.english: So He took charge of them instead of him, and showed him His kindness, goodness, mercy, and generosity in them,

segments.arabic: من غير تَعب من العَبْد وَلَا نصب وَلَا اهتمام مِنْهُ
segments.english: without tiredness from the servant, nor fatigue, nor concern from him —

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ قد صرف اهتمامه كُله إِلَيْهِ وَجعله وَحده همه
segments.english: because he had directed all his concern to Him and made Him alone his focus.

segments.arabic: فصرف عَنهُ اهتمامه بحوائجه ومصالح دُنْيَاهُ وَفرغ قلبه مِنْهَا
segments.english: So He turned away from him his concern with his needs and the interests of this world, and freed his heart from them.

segments.arabic: فَمَا أطيب عيشه وَمَا أنعم قلبه وَأعظم سروره وفرحه
segments.english: So how sweet [is] his life! And how comfortable [is] his heart, and how great [is] his joy and happiness!

segments.arabic: وَإِن أَبى إِلَّا تَدْبيره لنَفسِهِ واختياره لَهَا واهتمامه بحظه دون حق ربه
segments.english: But if he insists on nothing but his own planning for himself, and his own choosing for it, and his concern with his share rather than the right of his Lord —

segments.arabic: خلاه وَمَا اخْتَارَهُ وولاه مَا تولى
segments.english: He leaves him to what he chose, and puts him in charge of what he took charge of.

segments.arabic: فحضره الْهم وَالْغَم والحزن والنكد الْخَوْف والتعب وكسف البال وَسُوء الْحَال
segments.english: So worry, grief, sadness, misery, fear, exhaustion, gloom, and [a] bad state come upon him.

segments.arabic: فَلَا قلب
segments.english: So [there is] no heart —

segments.arabic: يصفو وَلَا عمل يزكو وَلَا أمل يحصل
segments.english: [that] becomes pure, nor [any] deed [that] grows, nor [any] hope [that] [is] achieved,

segments.arabic: وَلَا رَاحَة يفوز بهَا وَلَا لَذَّة يتنعم بهَا
segments.english: nor [any] rest he wins, nor [any] pleasure he enjoys.

segments.arabic: بل قد حيل بَينه وَبَين مسرته وفرحه وقرة عينه
segments.english: Rather, [a barrier] has been placed between him and his delight, his happiness, and the coolness of his eyes.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ يكدح فِي الدُّنْيَا كدح الْوَحْش وَلَا يظفر مِنْهُ بأمل
segments.english: So he toils in this world the toiling of [a] wild animal, and does not gain from it any hope,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يتزود مِنْهَا لِمَعَاد
segments.english: nor does he gather provisions from it for [the] Return.

segments.arabic: وَالله سُبْحَانَهُ أَمر العَبْد بِأَمْر وَضمن لَهُ ضمانا
segments.english: And God, glorified [is] He, commanded the servant with [a] command and guaranteed him [a] guarantee.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قَامَ بأَمْره بالنصح والصدق وَالْإِخْلَاص وَالِاجْتِهَاد
segments.english: So if he fulfilled His command with sincerity, truthfulness, devotion, and striving,

segments.arabic: قَامَ الله سُبْحَانَهُ لَهُ بِمَا ضمنه لَهُ من الرزق والكفاية والنصر وَقَضَاء الْحَوَائِج
segments.english: God, glorified [is] He, fulfilled for him what He guaranteed him of provision, sufficiency, victory, and fulfilling [of] needs.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ ضمن الرزق لمن عَبده
segments.english: For He, glorified [is] He, guaranteed provision to whoever worshipped Him,

segments.arabic: والنصر لمن توكل عَلَيْهِ واستنصر بِهِ
segments.english: and victory to whoever relied on Him and sought His help,

segments.arabic: والكفاية لمن كَانَ هُوَ همه وَمرَاده
segments.english: and sufficiency to whoever He was his concern and his aim,

segments.arabic: وَالْمَغْفِرَة لمن استغفره
segments.english: and forgiveness to whoever sought His forgiveness,

segments.arabic: وَقَضَاء الْحَوَائِج لمن صَدَقَه فِي طلبَهَا ووثق بِهِ
segments.english: and fulfilling [of] needs to whoever was truthful with Him in seeking them, and trusted in Him,

segments.arabic: وَقَوي رجاؤه وطمعه فِي فَضله وجوده
segments.english: and whose hope and longing in His grace and generosity grew strong.

segments.arabic: فالفطن الكيّس إِنَّمَا يهتم بأَمْره وإقامته وتوفيته لَا بضمانه
segments.english: So the clever, wise [person] only concerns himself with His command, establishing it, and fulfilling it — not with His guarantee.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ الوفي الصَّادِق وَمَنْ أَوْفَى بِعَهْدِهِ مِنَ الله
segments.english: For He [is] the Faithful, the Truthful — and who [is] more faithful to his covenant than God?

segments.arabic: فَمن عَلَامَات السَّعَادَة صرف اهتمامه إِلَى أَمر الله دون ضَمَانه
segments.english: So from the signs of happiness [is] directing one's concern to the command of God, not His guarantee.

segments.arabic: وَمن عَلَامَات الحرمان فرَاغ قلبه من الاهتمام بأَمْره وحبه وخشيته
segments.english: And from the signs of deprivation [is] his heart being empty of concern for His command, His love, and fear of Him,

segments.arabic: والاهتمام بضمانه وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: and [instead] being concerned with His guarantee. And God [is] the One whose help [is] sought.

segments.arabic: قَالَ بشر بن الْحَارِث أهل الْآخِرَة ثَلَاثَة عَابِد وزاهد وصِدِّيق
segments.english: Bishr ibn al-Harith said: the people of the Hereafter [are] three — [a] worshipper, [an] ascetic, and [a] truthful one.

segments.arabic: فالعابد يعبد الله مَعَ العلائق
segments.english: The worshipper worships God while [having] attachments,

segments.arabic: والزاهد يعبده على ترك العلائق
segments.english: and the ascetic worships Him upon leaving attachments,

segments.arabic: وَالصديق يعبده على الرِّضَا والموافقة
segments.english: and the truthful one worships Him upon contentment and agreement.

segments.arabic: إِن أرَاهُ أَخذ الدُّنْيَا أَخذهَا وَإِن أرَاهُ تَركهَا تَركهَا
segments.english: If He showed him [to] take this world, he took it; and if He showed him [to] leave it, he left it.

segments.arabic: إِذا كَانَ الله وَرَسُوله فِي جَانب فاحذر أَن تكون فِي الْجَانِب الآخر
segments.english: When God and His Messenger [are] on one side, beware of being on the other side.

segments.arabic: فَإِن ذَلِك يُفْضِي إِلَى المشاقة والمحادّة
segments.english: For that leads to opposition and hostility.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا أَصْلهَا وَمِنْه اشتقاقها
segments.english: And this [is] their root, and from it [is] their derivation.

segments.arabic: فَإِن المشاقة أَن يكون فِي شقّ وَمن يُخَالِفهُ فِي شقّ
segments.english: For opposition [means] that he [is] on one side, and whoever disagrees with him [is] on [another] side.

segments.arabic: والمحادة ان يكون حد وَهُوَ فِي حد
segments.english: And hostility [means that one is] on one edge, and he [is] on [another] edge.

segments.arabic: وَلَا تستسهل هَذَا فَإِن مبادئه تجر إِلَى غَايَته وقليله يَدْعُو إِلَى كَثِيره
segments.english: And do not take this lightly, for its beginnings drag [one] to its end, and its little calls to its much.

segments.arabic: وَكن فِي الْجَانِب الَّذِي يكون فِيهِ الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: And be on the side on which God and His Messenger [are],

segments.arabic: وان كَانَ النَّاس كلهم فِي الْجَانِب الآخر
segments.english: even if all the people [are] on the other side.

segments.arabic: فَإِن لذَلِك عواقب هِيَ أَحْمد العواقب وأفضلها
segments.english: For that has outcomes [that] [are] the most praiseworthy of outcomes and the best of them.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ للْعَبد أَنْفَع من ذَلِك فِي دُنْيَاهُ قبل آخرته
segments.english: And there [is] nothing more beneficial for the servant than that in his worldly life, before his Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَأكْثر الْخلق إِنَّمَا يكونُونَ من الْجَانِب الآخر
segments.english: And most of creation [are] only on the other side,

segments.arabic: ولاسيما إِذا قويت الرَّغْبَة والرهبة
segments.english: especially when desire and fear grow strong.

segments.arabic: فهناك لَا تكَاد تَجِد أحدا فِي الْجَانِب الَّذِي فِيهِ الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: Then you will hardly find anyone on the side on which God and His Messenger [are].

segments.arabic: بل يعدّه النَّاس نَاقص الْعقل سيء الِاخْتِيَار لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: Rather, people consider him lacking in intellect, poor in his choice for himself,

segments.arabic: وَرُبمَا نسبوه إِلَى الْجُنُون
segments.english: and perhaps they attribute madness to him.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ من مَوَارِيث أَعدَاء الرُّسُل
segments.english: And that [is] from the inheritance of the enemies of the messengers,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُم نسبوهم إلى الْجُنُون لما كَانُوا فِي شقّ
segments.english: for they attributed madness to them because they were on [a different] side.

headings.arabic: نصيحة
headings.english: Advice

segments.arabic: وجانب وَالنَّاس فِي شقّ وجانب آخر
segments.english: and [on one] side, while the people [are] in [another] direction and another side.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن من وطّن نَفسه على ذَلِك فَإِنَّهُ يحْتَاج إِلَى علم راسخ بِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ الرَّسُول
segments.english: But whoever prepares himself for that, then he needs firm knowledge of what the Messenger came with,

segments.arabic: يكون يَقِينا لَهُ لَا ريب عِنْده فِيهِ
segments.english: [that] is certainty for him, [with] no doubt in him about it.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَى صَبر تَامّ على معاداة من عَادَاهُ ولومة من لامه
segments.english: And [he needs] complete patience against the hostility of whoever opposes him, and the blame of whoever blames him.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يتم لَهُ ذَلِك إِلَّا برغبة قَوِيَّة فِي الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة
segments.english: And that [is] not complete for him except with [a] strong desire for God and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ تكون الْآخِرَة أحب إِلَيْهِ من الدُّنْيَا وآثر عِنْده مِنْهَا
segments.english: such that the Hereafter [is] more beloved to him than this world, and more preferred by him than it.

segments.arabic: وَيكون الله وَرَسُوله أحب إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا سواهُمَا
segments.english: And God and His Messenger [are] more beloved to him than anything other than them.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ شَيْء أصعب على الْإِنْسَان من ذَلِك فِي مبادىء الْأَمر
segments.english: And nothing [is] harder on [a] person than that at the beginning of the matter.

segments.arabic: فَإِن نَفسه وهواه وطبعه وشيطانه وإخوانه ومعاشيره من ذَلِك الْجَانِب يدعنه إِلَى العاجل
segments.english: For his self, his desire, his nature, his devil, his brothers, and his companions from that side call him to the immediate [world].

segments.arabic: فَإِذا خالفوهم تصدوا الحربة
segments.english: So when he opposes them, they confront [him with] hostility.

segments.arabic: فَإِن صَبر وَثَبت جَاءَهُ العون من الله
segments.english: So if he [is] patient and stands firm, help comes to him from God.

segments.arabic: وَصَارَ ذَلِك الصعب سهلا وَذَلِكَ الْأَلَم لَذَّة
segments.english: And that difficulty becomes easy, and that pain [becomes] pleasure.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الرب شكور فَلَا بُد أَن يذيقه لَذَّة تحيزه إِلَى الله وَإِلَى رَسُوله
segments.english: For the Lord [is] Grateful, so He must let him taste the pleasure of his taking the side of God and His Messenger.

segments.arabic: ويريه كَرَامَة ذَلِك
segments.english: And He shows him the honor of that.

segments.arabic: فيشتد بِهِ سروره وغبطته ويبتهج بِهِ قلبه
segments.english: So his joy and happiness grow strong through it, and his heart rejoices in it.

segments.arabic: ويظفر بقوته وفرحه وسروره
segments.english: And he attains strength, gladness, and joy.

segments.arabic: وَيبقى من كَانَ مُحَاربًا لَهُ على ذَلِك بَين هائب لَهُ مسالم لَهُ ومساعد وتارك
segments.english: And those who were fighting him over that remain [divided] between [one] fearing him, [one] making peace with him, [one] helping [him], and [one] leaving [him alone].

segments.arabic: ويقوى جنده ويضعف جند الْعَدو
segments.english: And his army grows strong, and the army of the enemy grows weak.

segments.arabic: وَلَا تستصعب مُخَالفَة النَّاس والتحيز إِلَى الله وَرَسُوله وَلَو كنت وَحدك
segments.english: And do not find [it] difficult [to] oppose the people and take the side of God and His Messenger, even if you [are] alone.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الله مَعَك وَأَنت بِعَيْنِه وكلاءته وَحفظه لَك
segments.english: For God [is] with you, and you [are] under His watch, His care, and His protection of you.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا امتحن يقينك وصبرك
segments.english: He only tested your certainty and your patience.

segments.arabic: اعظم الأعوان لَك على بعد عون الله هَذَا بعون اله التجرد من الطمع والفزع
segments.english: The greatest of helpers for you in [this] — after God's help — [is] freeing [yourself] from greed and fear.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى تجردت مِنْهُمَا هان عَلَيْك التحيز إِلَى الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: So whenever you free yourself from them, taking the side of God and His Messenger becomes easy for you.

segments.arabic: وَكنت دَائِما فِي الْجَانِب الَّذِي فِيهِ الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: And you [will] always be on the side on which [are] God and His Messenger.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى قَامَ بك الطمع فَلَا تطمع فِي هَذَا الْأَمر وَلَا تحدث نَفسك بِهِ
segments.english: And whenever greed takes hold of you, then do not hope for this matter, and do not let yourself think about it.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قلت فَبِأَي شَيْء أستعين على التجرد من الطمع وَمن الْفَزع
segments.english: So if you say: 'With what thing [can] I seek help to free [myself] from greed and from fear?'

segments.arabic: قلت بِالتَّوْحِيدِ والتوكل والثقة بِاللَّه
segments.english: I say: with monotheism, reliance [on God], and trust in God.

segments.arabic: وعلمك بِأَنَّهُ لَا يَأْتِي بِالْحَسَنَاتِ إِلَّا هُوَ وَلَا يذهب بالسيآت إِلَّا هُوَ
segments.english: And your knowledge that none brings good things except Him, and none removes bad things except Him.

segments.arabic: وَأَن الْأَمر كُله لله لَيْسَ لأحد مَعَ الله شَيْء
segments.english: And that the matter entirely [belongs] to God — no one has anything alongside God.

segments.arabic: هَلُمَّ إِلَى الدُّخُول على الله ومجاورته فِي دَار السَّلَام بِلَا نصيب وَلَا تَعب وَلَا عناء
segments.english: Come to entering upon God and being His neighbor in the Abode of Peace, without toil, nor fatigue, nor trouble.

segments.arabic: بل من أقرب الطّرق وأسهلها
segments.english: Rather, by the nearest of paths and the easiest of them.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ أَنَّك فِي وَقت بَين وَقْتَيْنِ وَهُوَ فِي الْحَقِيقَة
segments.english: And that [is] that you [are] in [a] time between two times, and it [is] in reality

headings.arabic: فصل علامة صحة الإرادة أن يكون هم المريد رضا ربه واستعداده للقائه
headings.english: Chapter: The sign of [a] sound will [is] that the seeker's concern [is] his Lord's pleasure and his readiness to meet Him

segments.arabic: عمرك وَهُوَ وقتك الْحَاضِر بَين مَا مضى وَمَا يسْتَقْبل
segments.english: Your lifetime — it [is] your present moment, between what has passed and what [is] to come.

segments.arabic: فَالَّذِي مضى تصلحه بِالتَّوْبَةِ والندم وَالِاسْتِغْفَار
segments.english: So what has passed, you rectify [it] with repentance, regret, and seeking forgiveness.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ شَيْء لَا تَعب عَلَيْك فِيهِ وَلَا نصب وَلَا معاناة عمل شاق
segments.english: And that [is] something [with] no hardship on you in it, no fatigue, and no struggle of difficult work.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا هُوَ عمل قلب
segments.english: It [is] only [a] work of the heart.

segments.arabic: وتمتنع فِيمَا يسْتَقْبل من الذُّنُوب
segments.english: And you hold back in what [is] to come from sins.

segments.arabic: وامتناعك ترك وراحة لَيْسَ هُوَ عملا بالجوارح يشق عَلَيْك معاناته
segments.english: And your holding back [is] leaving [things] and rest — it [is] not [a] work of the limbs whose struggle [is] hard on you.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ عزم وَنِيَّة جازمة تريح بدنك وقلبك وسرك
segments.english: Rather, it [is] [a] firm resolve and intention [that] gives rest to your body, your heart, and your innermost [self].

segments.arabic: فَمَا مضى تصلحه بِالتَّوْبَةِ وَمَا يسْتَقْبل تصلحه بالامتناع والعزم وَالنِّيَّة
segments.english: So what has passed, you rectify [it] with repentance, and what [is] to come, you rectify [it] with holding back, resolve, and intention.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ للجوارح فِي هذَيْن نصب وَلَا تَعب
segments.english: And [there is] no fatigue or hardship for the limbs in these two.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن الشَّأْن فِي عمرك وَهُوَ وقتك الَّذِي بَين الْوَقْتَيْنِ
segments.english: But the real matter [is] your lifetime — it [is] your time that [is] between the two times.

segments.arabic: فَإِن أضعته أضعت سعادتك ونجاتك
segments.english: So if you waste it, you [have] wasted your happiness and your salvation.

segments.arabic: وَإِن حفظته مَعَ إصْلَاح الْوَقْتَيْنِ اللَّذين قبله وَبعده بِمَا ذكرت نجوت وفزت بالراحة واللذة وَالنَّعِيم
segments.english: And if you guard it, along with rectifying the two times before it and after it with what [I have] mentioned, you [will] be saved and [will] win rest, pleasure, and bliss.

segments.arabic: وَحفظه أشق من إصْلَاح مَا قبله وَمَا بعده
segments.english: And guarding it [is] harder than rectifying what [is] before it and what [is] after it.

segments.arabic: فَإِن حفظه أَن تلْزم نَفسك بِمَا هُوَ أولى بهَا وأنفع لَهَا وَأعظم تحصيلا لسعادتها
segments.english: For guarding it [is] that you bind yourself to what [is] most fitting for it, most beneficial for it, and greatest in achieving its happiness.

segments.arabic: وَفِي هَذَا تفَاوت النَّاس أعظم تفَاوت
segments.english: And in this, people differ the greatest difference.

segments.arabic: فَهِيَ وَالله أيامك الخالية الَّتِي تجمع فِيهَا الزَّاد لمعادك
segments.english: So they [are], by God, your fleeting days in which you gather provision for your Return —

segments.arabic: إِمَّا إِلَى الْجنَّة إِمَّا إِلَى النَّار
segments.english: either to Paradise or to the Fire.

segments.arabic: فَإِن اتَّخذت إِلَيْهَا سَبِيلا إِلَى رَبك بلغت السَّعَادَة الْعُظْمَى والفوز الْأَكْبَر
segments.english: So if you take in them [a] path to your Lord, you [will] reach the greatest happiness and the greatest success,

segments.arabic: فِي هَذِه الْمدَّة الْيَسِيرَة الَّتِي لَا نِسْبَة لَهَا إِلَى الْأَبَد
segments.english: in this short period that has no comparison to eternity.

segments.arabic: وَإِن آثرت الشَّهَوَات والراحات وَاللَّهْو واللعب
segments.english: And if you prefer desires, comforts, amusement, and play,

segments.arabic: انْقَضتْ عَنْك بِسُرْعَة
segments.english: [they will] pass from you quickly,

segments.arabic: وأعقبتك الْأَلَم الْعَظِيم الدَّائِم
segments.english: and [will] leave you with the great, lasting pain,

segments.arabic: الَّذِي مقاساته ومعاناته أشق وأصعب وأدوم
segments.english: whose enduring and suffering [is] harder, more difficult, and longer lasting

segments.arabic: من معاناة الصَّبْر عَن محارم الله وَالصَّبْر على طَاعَته وَمُخَالفَة الْهوى لأَجله
segments.english: than the struggle of patience from what God has forbidden, patience upon His obedience, and opposing desire for His sake.

segments.arabic: وحزنه على وَقت مر فِي غير مرضاته
segments.english: and his sadness over [a] time that passed not in His pleasure,

segments.arabic: وأسفه على قربه والأنس بِهِ
segments.english: and his grief over [losing] closeness to Him and intimacy with Him.

segments.arabic: وجماع ذَلِك أَن يصبح ويمسي وَلَيْسَ لَهُ هم غَيره
segments.english: And the sum of all that [is] that he wakes and sleeps with no concern other than Him.

headings.arabic: فصل الزهد أقسام زهد في الحرام وهو فرض عين وزهد في الشبهات وهو
headings.english: Section: Asceticism [has] categories — asceticism regarding the forbidden, and it [is] an individual obligation, and asceticism regarding doubtful matters, and it [is]

segments.arabic: فصل إِذا اسْتغنى النَّاس بالدنيا فاستغن أَنْت بِاللَّه
segments.english: Section: If people seek sufficiency in this world, then seek your sufficiency in God.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا فرحوا بالدنيا فافرح أَنْت بِاللَّه
segments.english: And if they rejoice in this world, then rejoice in God.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا أنسوا بأحبابهم فَاجْعَلْ أنسك بِاللَّه
segments.english: And if they find comfort in their loved ones, then make your comfort in God.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا تعرفوا إِلَى مُلُوكهمْ وكبرائهم وتقربوا إِلَيْهِم لينالوا بهم الْعِزَّة والرفعة
segments.english: And if they introduce themselves to their kings and their leaders, and draw close to them to gain through them honor and elevation,

segments.arabic: فتعرف أَنْت إِلَى الله وتودد إِلَيْهِ تنَلْ بذلك غَايَة الْعِزّ والرفعة
segments.english: then introduce yourself to God and show love toward Him — [and] you [will] gain by that the utmost honor and elevation.

segments.arabic: قَالَ بعض الزهاد مَا علمت أَن أحدا سمع بِالْجنَّةِ وَالنَّار
segments.english: One of the ascetics said: I [do] not know [of] anyone [who] heard of Paradise and the Fire

segments.arabic: تَأتي عَلَيْهِ سَاعَة لَا يُطِيع الله فِيهَا بذكر أَو صَلَاة أَو قراءة أَو إِحْسَان
segments.english: [and then] an hour passes over him in which he [does] not obey God — with remembrance, or prayer, or recitation, or good deeds.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُ رجل إِنِّي أَكثر الْبكاء
segments.english: So [a] man said to him: I cry much.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنَّك إِن تضحك وَأَنت مقرّ بخطيئتك خير من أَن تبْكي وَأَنت مدل بعملك
segments.english: So he said: If you laugh while you acknowledge your sin, [that is] better than crying while you [are] proud of your deeds.

segments.arabic: وَإِن المدل لَا يصعد عمله فَوق رَأسه
segments.english: And the proud one — his deeds [do] not rise above his head.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ أوصني
segments.english: So he said: Advise me.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ دع الدُّنْيَا لأَهْلهَا كَمَا تركوهم الْآخِرَة لأَهْلهَا
segments.english: So he said: Leave this world to its people, just as they left the Hereafter to its people.

segments.arabic: وَكن فِي الدُّنْيَا كالنحلة إِن أكلت أكلت طيبا وَإِن أطعمت أطعمت طيبا
segments.english: And be in this world like the bee — if it eats, it eats [what is] good, and if it feeds [others], it feeds [them what is] good,

segments.arabic: وَإِن سَقَطت على شَيْء لم تكسره وَلم تخدشه
segments.english: and if it lands on something, it [does] not break it and [does] not scratch it.

segments.arabic: الزّهْد أَقسَام زهد فِي الْحَرَام وَهُوَ فرض عين
segments.english: Asceticism [has] categories: asceticism regarding the forbidden — and it [is] an individual obligation.

segments.arabic: وزهد فِي الشُّبُهَات وَهُوَ بِحَسب مَرَاتِب الشُّبْهَة
segments.english: And asceticism regarding doubtful matters — and it [is] according to the levels of the doubt.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قويت التحقت بِالْوَاجِبِ وَإِن ضعفت كَانَ مُسْتَحبا
segments.english: So if it [is] strong, it joins the obligatory, and if it [is] weak, it [is] recommended.

segments.arabic: وزهد فِي الفضول
segments.english: And asceticism regarding excess.

segments.arabic: وزهد فِيمَا لَا يَعْنِي من الْكَلَام وَالنَّظَر وَالسُّؤَال واللقاء وَغَيره
segments.english: And asceticism regarding what [does] not concern [you] — of speech, looking, asking, meeting [people], and the like.

segments.arabic: وزهد فِي النَّاس
segments.english: And asceticism regarding people.

segments.arabic: وزهد فِي النَّفس بِحَيْثُ تهون عَلَيْهِ نَفسه فِي الله
segments.english: And asceticism regarding the self — such that his self becomes easy for him [to sacrifice] for God.

segments.arabic: وزهد جَامع لذَلِك كُله وَهُوَ الزّهْد فِيمَا سوى الله وَفِي كل مَا شغلك عَنهُ
segments.english: And [a] comprehensive asceticism [that] gathers all of that — and it [is] asceticism regarding everything other than God, and everything that distracts you from Him.

segments.arabic: وَأفضل الزّهْد إخفاء الزّهْد
segments.english: And the best asceticism [is] hiding [your] asceticism.

segments.arabic: وأصعبه الزّهْد فِي الحظوظ
segments.english: And the hardest of it [is] asceticism regarding [one's] fortunes.

segments.arabic: وَالْفرق بَينه وَبَين الْوَرع أَن الزّهْد ترك مَالا ينفع فِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: And the difference between it and caution [is] that asceticism [is] leaving what [does] not benefit in the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: والورع ترك مَا يخْشَى ضَرَره فِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: and caution [is] leaving what one fears its harm in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَالْقلب الْمُعَلق بالشهوات لَا يَصح لَهُ زهد وَلَا ورع
segments.english: And the heart attached to desires — asceticism [does] not become sound for it, nor caution.

headings.arabic: فائدة جليلة قال سهل بن عبد الله ترك الأمر عند الله أعظم من
headings.english: [A] Great Benefit — Sahl ibn Abdullah said: abandoning the command [is], with God, greater than

segments.arabic: قَالَ يحيى بن معَاذ عجبت من ثَلَاث
segments.english: Yahya ibn Mu'adh said: I [am] amazed at three [types]:

segments.arabic: رجل يرائي بِعَمَلِهِ مخلوقا مثله وَيتْرك أَن يعمله لله
segments.english: [a] man [who] shows off with his deeds to [a] created being like him, and abandons doing them for God.

segments.arabic: وَرجل يبخل بِمَالِه وربه يستقرضه مِنْهُ فَلَا يقْرضهُ مِنْهُ شَيْئا
segments.english: And [a] man [who is] stingy with his wealth, while his Lord asks him for [a] loan from it, yet he does not lend Him anything from it.

segments.arabic: وَرجل يرغب فِي صُحْبَة المخلوقين ومودتهم وَالله يَدعُوهُ إِلَى صحبته ومودته
segments.english: And [a] man [who] desires the company of created beings and their friendship, while God calls him to His company and His friendship.

segments.arabic: قَالَ سهل بن عبد الله ترك الْأَمر عِنْد الله أعظم من ارْتِكَاب النَّهْي
segments.english: Sahl ibn Abdullah said: abandoning the command [is], with God, greater than committing the prohibition.

segments.arabic: لِأَن آدم نهي عَن أكل الشَّجَرَة فَأكل مِنْهَا فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: Because Adam [was] forbidden from eating [from] the tree, and he ate from it, so [God] accepted his repentance.

segments.arabic: وإبليس أَمر أَن يسْجد لآدَم فَلم يسْجد فَلم يتب عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And Iblis [was] commanded to prostrate to Adam, but he did not prostrate, so [God] did not accept his repentance.

segments.arabic: قلت هَذِه مَسْأَلَة عَظِيمَة لَهَا شَأْن
segments.english: I say: this [is] [a] great matter of importance.

segments.arabic: وَهِي أَن ترك الْأَوَامِر أعظم عِنْد الله من ارْتِكَاب المناهي
segments.english: And it [is] that abandoning the commands [is] greater with God than committing the prohibitions.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ من وُجُوه عديدة
segments.english: And that [is] for many reasons.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا مَا ذكره سهل من شَأْن آدم وعدو الله إِبْلِيس
segments.english: The first [is] what Sahl mentioned regarding the matter of Adam and the enemy of God, Iblis.

segments.arabic: الثَّانِي أَن ذَنْب ارْتِكَاب النَّهْي مصدره فِي الْغَالِب الشَّهْوَة وَالْحَاجة
segments.english: The second [is] that the sin of committing the prohibition — its source [is] usually desire and need.

segments.arabic: وذنب ترك الْأَمر مصدره فِي الْغَالِب الْكبر والعزة
segments.english: And the sin of abandoning the command — its source [is] usually arrogance and pride.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يدْخل الْجنَّة من فِي قلبه مِثْقَال ذرة من كبر
segments.english: And [one who] has in his heart [the] weight of [a] speck of arrogance will not enter Paradise.

segments.arabic: ويدخلها من مَاتَ على التَّوْحِيد وَإِن زنى وسرق
segments.english: But [one who] died upon monotheism will enter it, even if he committed adultery and stole.

segments.arabic: الثَّالِث أَن فعل الْمَأْمُور أحب إِلَى الله من ترك الْمنْهِي كَمَا دلّ على ذَلِك النُّصُوص
segments.english: The third [is] that doing what [is] commanded [is] more beloved to God than leaving what [is] prohibited, as the texts have shown.

segments.arabic: كَقَوْلِه أحب الْأَعْمَال إِلَى الله الصَّلَاة على وَقتهَا
segments.english: Such as his saying: "The most beloved deeds to God [are] prayer at its [proper] time."

segments.arabic: وَقَوله أَلا أنبئكم بِخَير أَعمالكُم وأزكاها عِنْد مليككم وأرفعها فِي درجاتكم
segments.english: And his saying: "Shall I not tell you of the best of your deeds, and the purest of them with your King, and the highest of them in your ranks,

segments.arabic: وَخير لكم من أَن تلقوا عَدوكُمْ فتضربوا أَعْنَاقهم ويضربوا أَعْنَاقكُم
segments.english: and better for you than meeting your enemy and striking their necks and they strike your necks?"

segments.arabic: قَالُوا بلَى يَا رَسُول الله قَالَ ذكر الله
segments.english: They said: "Yes, O Messenger of God." He said: "The remembrance of God."

segments.arabic: وَقَوله اعلموا أَن خير أَعمالكُم الصَّلَاة وَغير ذَلِك من النُّصُوص
segments.english: And his saying: "Know that the best of your deeds [is] prayer." And other such texts.

segments.arabic: وَترك المناهي عمل فَإِنَّهُ كف النَّفس عَن الْفِعْل
segments.english: And leaving the prohibitions [is] [a] deed, for it [is] restraining the self from action.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا علّق سُبْحَانَهُ الْمحبَّة بِفعل الْأَوَامِر
segments.english: And for this reason, glorified [is] He, He attached love to doing the commands.

segments.arabic: كَقَوْلِه
segments.english: Such as His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ صفا﴾
segments.english: "Indeed God loves those who fight in His path in [a] row."
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, Allah loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly.

segments.arabic: ﴿وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾
segments.english: "And God loves those who do good."

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَأَقْسِطُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ﴾
segments.english: "And be just; indeed God loves those who are just."
segments.sahih_international: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.

segments.arabic: ﴿وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾
segments.english: "And God loves the patient."

segments.arabic: وَأما فِي جَانب المناهي فَأكْثر مَا جَاءَ النَّفْي للمحبة
segments.english: And as for the side of prohibitions, what came most [was] the negation of love.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَاللَّهُ لَا يحب الْفساد﴾
segments.english: "And God does not love corruption."

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فخور﴾
segments.english: "And God does not love every boastful showoff."
segments.sahih_international: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَلا تَعْتَدُوا إِن الله لَا يحب الْمُعْتَدِينَ﴾
segments.english: "And do not transgress; indeed God does not love the transgressors."
segments.sahih_international: Fight in the way of Allah those who fight you but do not transgress. Indeed. Allah does not like transgressors.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿لَا يُحِبُّ اللَّهُ الْجَهْرَ بِالسُّوءِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ إِلَّا من ظلم﴾
segments.english: "God does not love open [speech] of evil in words, except from [one who] has been wronged."
segments.sahih_international: Allah does not like the public mention of evil except by one who has been wronged. And ever is Allah Hearing and Knowing.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَنْ﴾
segments.english: "Indeed God does not love whoever…"
segments.sahih_international: Worship Allah and associate nothing with Him, and to parents do good, and to relatives, orphans, the needy, the near neighbor, the neighbor farther away, the companion at your side, the traveler, and those whom your right hands possess. Indeed, Allah does not like those who are self-deluding and boastful.

segments.arabic: ﴿كَانَ مُخْتَالًا فَخُورًا﴾
segments.english: "[he] was arrogant, boastful"

segments.arabic: ونظائره وَأخْبر فِي مَوضِع آخر أَنه يكرهها ويسخطها
segments.english: and similar [verses]. And He informed in another place that He hates them and [is] displeased with them,

segments.arabic: كَقَوْلِه
segments.english: as in His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿كُلُّ ذَلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ مَكْرُوها﴾
segments.english: "All of that — its evil was, in the sight of your Lord, hated"
segments.sahih_international: All that - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: and His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوا مَا أَسْخَطَ الله﴾
segments.english: "That [is] because they followed what displeased God"
segments.sahih_international: That is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

segments.arabic: إِذا عرف هَذَا فَفعل مَا يُحِبهُ سُبْحَانَهُ مَقْصُود بِالذَّاتِ
segments.english: If this [is] understood, then doing what He — glorified [is] He — loves [is] intended in itself.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا يقدر مَا يكرههُ ويسخطه لإفضائه إِلَى مَا يحب
segments.english: And for this reason, He decrees what He hates and [is] displeased with because it leads to what He loves,

segments.arabic: كَمَا قدر الْمعاصِي وَالْكفْر والفسوق
segments.english: just as He decreed sins and disbelief and wickedness

segments.arabic: لما ترَتّب على تقديرها مِمَّا يُحِبهُ من لوازمها
segments.english: because of what results from decreeing them of things He loves from their consequences:

segments.arabic: من الْجِهَاد واتخاذ الشُّهَدَاء وَحُصُول التَّوْبَة من العَبْد
segments.english: such as struggle, taking of martyrs, the occurrence of repentance from the servant,

segments.arabic: والتضرّع إِلَيْهِ والاستكانة
segments.english: humble pleading to Him, and submission,

segments.arabic: وَإِظْهَار عدله وعفوه وانتقامه وعزه
segments.english: and the showing of His justice, His pardon, His punishment, and His might,

segments.arabic: وَحُصُول المولاة والمعاداة لأَجله وَغير ذَلِك من الْآثَار
segments.english: and the occurrence of loyalty and enmity for His sake, and other such effects

segments.arabic: الَّتِي وجودهَا بِسَبَب تَقْدِيره مَا يكره أحب إِلَيْهِ من ارتفاعها بارتفاع أَسبَابهَا
segments.english: whose existence — because of His decreeing what He hates — [is] more loved by Him than their absence by the absence of their causes.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ لَا يقدر مَا يحب لإفضائه إِلَى حُصُول مَا يكرههُ ويسخطه
segments.english: And He — glorified [is] He — does not decree what He loves [if it leads] to the occurrence of what He hates and [is] displeased with,

segments.arabic: كَمَا يقدر مَا يكرههُ لإفضائه إِلَى مَا يُحِبهُ
segments.english: as He decrees what He hates because it leads to what He loves.

segments.arabic: فَعلم أَن فعل مَا يُحِبهُ أحب إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا يكرههُ
segments.english: So it [is] known that doing what He loves [is] more loved by Him than what He hates.

segments.arabic: يُوضحهُ الْوَجْه الرَّابِع
segments.english: The fourth point clarifies this:

segments.arabic: أَن فعل الْمَأْمُور مَقْصُود لذاته وَترك الْمنْهِي مَقْصُود لتكميل فعل الْمَأْمُور
segments.english: that doing what [is] commanded [is] intended for its own sake, and leaving what [is] forbidden [is] intended to complete the doing of what [is] commanded.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مَنْهِيّ عَنهُ لأجل كَونه يخل بِفعل الْمَأْمُور أَو يُضعفهُ وينقصه
segments.english: So it [is] forbidden because it harms the doing of what [is] commanded, or weakens it and reduces it,

segments.arabic: كَمَا نبه سُبْحَانَهُ على ذَلِك فِي النَّهْي عَن الْخمر وَالْميسر
segments.english: as He — glorified [is] He — pointed to this in the prohibition of wine and gambling,

segments.arabic: بكونهما يصدان عَن ذكر الله وَعَن الصَّلَاة
segments.english: because they block [one] from the remembrance of God and from prayer.

segments.arabic: فالمنهيات قواطع وموانع صادة عَن فعل المأمورات أَو عَن كمالها
segments.english: So the forbidden things [are] obstacles and barriers blocking [one] from doing the commanded things or from their perfection.

segments.arabic: فالنهي عَنْهَا من بَاب الْمَقْصُود لغيره وَالْأَمر بالواجبات من بَاب الْمَقْصُود لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: So the prohibition of them [is] from the category of what [is] intended for something else, and the command of duties [is] from the category of what [is] intended for itself.

segments.arabic: يُوضحهُ الْوَجْه الْخَامِس
segments.english: The fifth point clarifies this:

segments.arabic: أَن فعل المأمورات من بَاب حفظ قُوَّة الْإِيمَان وبقائها
segments.english: that doing the commanded things [is] from the category of preserving the strength of faith and its continuation,

segments.arabic: وَترك المنهيات من بَاب الحمية عَمَّا يشوش قُوَّة الْإِيمَان ويخرجها عَن الِاعْتِدَال
segments.english: and leaving the forbidden things [is] from the category of protecting against what disturbs the strength of faith and takes it out of balance.

segments.arabic: وَحفظ الْقُوَّة مقدم على الحمية
segments.english: And preserving strength [is] put before protection,

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْقُوَّة كلما قويت دفعت الْموَاد الْفَاسِدَة
segments.english: for whenever the strength grows strong, it pushes away the corrupt elements,

segments.arabic: وَإِذا ضعفت غلبت الْموَاد الْفَاسِدَة
segments.english: and when it weakens, the corrupt elements overcome [it].

segments.arabic: فالحمية مُرَاد لغَيْرهَا وَهُوَ حفظ الْقُوَّة وزيادتها وبقاؤها
segments.english: So protection [is] desired for something other than itself, which [is] preserving the strength, increasing it, and keeping it.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كلما قويت قُوَّة الْإِيمَان دفعت الْموَاد الرَّديئَة ومنعت من غلبتها وَكَثْرَتهَا بِحَسب الْقُوَّة وضعفها
segments.english: And for this reason, whenever the strength of faith grows strong, it pushes away the bad elements and prevents them from overcoming and spreading — according to [that] strength and [its] weakness.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا ضعفت غلبت الْموَاد الْفَاسِدَة
segments.english: And when it weakens, the corrupt elements overcome [it].

segments.arabic: فَتَأمل هَذَا الْوَجْه
segments.english: So reflect on this point.

segments.arabic: الْوَجْه السَّادِس أَن فعل المأمورات حَيَاة الْقلب وغذاؤه وزينته وسروره وقرة عينه ولذته ونعيمه
segments.english: The sixth point: doing the commanded things [is] the life of the heart, its nourishment, its beauty, its joy, the delight of its eye, its pleasure, and its bliss.

segments.arabic: وَترك المنهيات بِدُونِ ذَلِك لَا يحصل لَهُ شَيْئا من ذَلِك
segments.english: And leaving the forbidden things without that does not bring it any of that.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لَو ترك جَمِيع المنهيات وَلم
segments.english: For if [one] left all the forbidden things and did not —

segments.arabic: يَأْتِ بِالْإِيمَان والأعمال الْمَأْمُور بهَا لم يَنْفَعهُ ذَلِك التّرْك شَيْئا
segments.english: bring faith and the deeds commanded with, that leaving [would] not benefit him [in] anything.

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ خَالِدا فِي النَّار
segments.english: And he was dwelling forever in the Fire.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يتَبَيَّن بِالْوَجْهِ السَّابِع
segments.english: And this [is] made clear by the seventh point:

segments.arabic: أَن من فعل المأمورات والمنهيات فَهُوَ إِمَّا نَاجٍ مُطلقًا إِن غلبت حَسَنَاته سيئاته
segments.english: that whoever did the commanded [acts] and the forbidden [acts], then he [is] either saved completely if his good deeds outweighed his bad deeds,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا نَاجٍ بعد أَن يُؤْخَذ مِنْهُ الْحق ويعاقب على سيئاته
segments.english: or saved after the right [is] taken from him and he [is] punished for his bad deeds.

segments.arabic: فمآله إِلَى النجَاة وَذَلِكَ بِفعل الْمَأْمُور
segments.english: So his end [is] toward salvation, and that [is] by doing what [was] commanded.

segments.arabic: وَمن ترك المأمورات والمنهيات فَهُوَ هَالك غير نَاجٍ
segments.english: And whoever left the commanded [acts] and the forbidden [acts], then he [is] ruined, not saved.

segments.arabic: وَلَا ينجو إِلَّا بِفعل الْمَأْمُور وَهُوَ التَّوْحِيد
segments.english: And he [will] not be saved except by doing what [was] commanded, and that [is] monotheism.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قيل فَهُوَ إِنَّمَا هلك بارتكاب الْمَحْظُور وَهُوَ الشّرك
segments.english: So if it [is] said: he only perished by committing the forbidden, which [is] associating partners [with God] —

segments.arabic: قيل يَكْفِي فِي الْهَلَاك ترك نفس التَّوْحِيد الْمَأْمُور بِهِ وَإِن لم يَأْتِ بضد وجودي من الشّرك
segments.english: [it is] said: it [is] enough for ruin [to] leave monotheism itself that [was] commanded, even if he did not bring [an] existing opposite of associating partners [with God].

segments.arabic: بل مَتى خلا قلبه من التَّوْحِيد رَأْسا فَلم يوحد الله فَهُوَ هَالك
segments.english: Rather, whenever his heart [was] empty of monotheism entirely and he did not declare God's oneness, then he [is] ruined,

segments.arabic: وان لم يعبد مَعَه غَيره
segments.english: even if he did not worship besides Him another.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا انضاف إِلَيْهِ عبَادَة غَيره عذب على ترك التَّوْحِيد الْمَأْمُور بِهِ وَفعل الشّرك الْمنْهِي عَنهُ
segments.english: So if worshipping another [was] added to it, he [would be] punished for leaving monotheism that [was] commanded and [for] doing the associating partners [with God] that [was] forbidden.

segments.arabic: يُوضحهُ الْوَجْه الثَّامِن
segments.english: The eighth point makes [this] clear:

segments.arabic: أَن الْمَدْعُو إِلَى الْإِيمَان إِذا قَالَ لَا أصدق وَلَا أكذب وَلَا أحب وَلَا أبْغض وَلَا أعبده وَلَا أعبد غَيره
segments.english: that the one called to faith, if he said: I [will] not believe and not deny, and not love and not hate, and not worship Him and not worship another —

segments.arabic: كَانَ كَافِرًا بِمُجَرَّد التّرْك والإعراض
segments.english: he was [a] disbeliever by mere leaving and turning away.

segments.arabic: بِخِلَاف مَا إِذا قَالَ أَنا أصدق الرَّسُول وأحبه وَأُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وأفعل مَا أَمرنِي
segments.english: Unlike when he said: I believe the Messenger and love him and have faith in him and do what he commanded me,

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن شهوتي وإرادتي وطبعي حاكمة عَليّ لَا تدعني أترك مَا نهاني عَنهُ
segments.english: but my desire and my will and my nature [are] ruling over me — they do not let me leave what he forbade me from.

segments.arabic: وَأَنا أعلم أَنه قد نهاني وَكره لي فعل الْمنْهِي وَلَكِن لَا صَبر لي عَنهُ
segments.english: And I know that he forbade me and disliked for me doing the forbidden, but I have no patience [to stay away] from it.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا لَا يعد كَافِرًا بذلك وَلَا حكمه حكم الأول
segments.english: So this one [is] not counted [as a] disbeliever for that, and his ruling [is] not the ruling of the first one.

segments.arabic: فَإِن هَذَا مُطِيع من وَجه وتارك الْمَأْمُور جملَة لَا يعد مُطيعًا بِوَجْه
segments.english: For this one [is] obedient in one way, while the one who left what [was] commanded entirely [is] not counted [as] obedient in any way.

segments.arabic: يُوضحهُ الْوَجْه التَّاسِع
segments.english: The ninth point makes [this] clear:

segments.arabic: أَن الطَّاعَة وَالْمَعْصِيَة إِنَّمَا تتَعَلَّق بِالْأَمر أصلا وبالنهي تبعا
segments.english: that obedience and disobedience [are] only connected to commands as [a] root, and to prohibitions as [a] branch.

segments.arabic: فالمطيع ممتثل الْمَأْمُور والعاصي تَارِك الْمَأْمُور
segments.english: So the obedient one [is the one] carrying out the command, and the disobedient one [is the one] leaving the command.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿لَا يَعْصُونَ اللَّهَ مَا أَمرهم﴾
segments.english: They do not disobey God [in] what He commanded them.
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allah in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ مُوسَى لِأَخِيهِ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتهمْ ضلوا أَن لَا تتبعني أفعصيت أمرى
segments.english: And Musa said to his brother: What prevented you, when you saw them go astray, from following me? Did you disobey my command?

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ عَمْرو بن الْعَاصِ عِنْد مَوته أَنا الَّذِي أَمرتنِي فعصيت وَلَكِن لَا إِلَه إِلَّا أَنْت
segments.english: And Amr ibn al-As said at his death: I [am] the one You commanded, and I disobeyed — but there [is] no god except You.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ الشَّاعِر أَمرتك أمرا جَازِمًا فعصيتني
segments.english: And the poet said: I commanded you [with a] firm command, and you disobeyed me.

segments.arabic: وَالْمَقْصُود من إرْسَال الرُّسُل طَاعَة الْمُرْسل
segments.english: And the purpose of sending the Messengers [is] obedience to the One who sent [them].

segments.arabic: وَلَا تحصل إِلَّا بامتثال أوامره
segments.english: And [this] [is] not achieved except by carrying out His commands.

segments.arabic: وَاجْتنَاب المناهي من تَمام امْتِثَال الْأَوَامِر ولوازمه
segments.english: And avoiding the prohibitions [is] from the completeness of carrying out the commands and its requirements.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا لَو اجْتنب المناهي وَلم يفعل مَا أَمر بِهِ لم يكن مُطيعًا وَكَانَ عَاصِيا
segments.english: And for this [reason], if he avoided the prohibitions but did not do what he [was] commanded with, he would not be obedient and would be disobedient.

segments.arabic: بِخِلَاف مَا لَو أَتَى بالمأمورات وارتكب
segments.english: Unlike if he came with the commanded [acts] and committed —

segments.arabic: المناهي فَإِنَّهُ وَإِن عد عَاصِيا مذنبا
segments.english: the prohibitions — for indeed he, even if [he is] counted [as] disobedient [and] sinful,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ مُطِيع بامتثال الْأَمر عَاص بارتكاب النَّهْي
segments.english: he [is] obedient by carrying out the command, [and] disobedient by committing the prohibition.

segments.arabic: بِخِلَاف تَارِك الْأَمر فَإِنَّهُ لَا يعد مُطيعًا باجتناب المنهيات خَاصَّة
segments.english: Unlike the one who abandons the command — for indeed he [is] not counted [as] obedient by avoiding the prohibitions alone.

segments.arabic: الْوَجْه الْعَاشِر أَن امْتِثَال الْأَمر عبودية وتقرب وخدمة
segments.english: The tenth point: that carrying out the command [is] servitude, drawing near [to God], and service.

segments.arabic: وَتلك الْعِبَادَة الَّتِي خلق لأَجلهَا الْخلق
segments.english: And that [is] the worship for which creation was created,

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: as [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْأِنْسَ إِلَّا ليعبدون﴾
segments.english: "And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me."
segments.sahih_international: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَنه إِنَّمَا خلقهمْ لِلْعِبَادَةِ
segments.english: So He — glorified [is] He — told that He only created them for worship.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ إِنَّمَا أرسل إِلَيْهِم رسله وَأنزل عَلَيْهِم كتبه ليعبدوه
segments.english: And likewise, He only sent to them His messengers and sent down upon them His books so that they would worship Him.

segments.arabic: فالعبادة هِيَ الْغَايَة الَّتِي خلقُوا لَهَا
segments.english: So worship — it [is] the purpose for which they were created.

segments.arabic: وَلم يخلقوا لمُجَرّد التّرْك فَإِنَّهُ أَمر عدمي لَا كَمَال فِيهِ من حَيْثُ هُوَ عدم
segments.english: And they were not created for mere abstaining, for it [is] [a] non-existent matter — [there is] no perfection in it insofar as it [is] non-existence.

segments.arabic: بِخِلَاف امْتِثَال الْمَأْمُور فَإِنَّهُ أَمر وجودي مَطْلُوب الْحُصُول
segments.english: Unlike carrying out the command, for it [is] [a] positive matter whose fulfillment [is] sought.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يتَبَيَّن بِالْوَجْهِ الْحَادِي عشر
segments.english: And this becomes clear through the eleventh point,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أَن الْمَطْلُوب بِالنَّهْي عدم الْفِعْل وَهُوَ أَمر عدمي
segments.english: which [is] that what [is] sought by the prohibition [is] the non-doing of the act, and it [is] [a] non-existent matter.

segments.arabic: وَالْمَطْلُوب بِالْأَمر إِيجَاد فعل وَهُوَ أَمر وجودي
segments.english: And what [is] sought by the command [is] the bringing about of [an] act, and it [is] [a] positive matter.

segments.arabic: فمتعلق الْأَمر الايجاد ومتعلق النَّهْي الإعدام أَو الْعَدَم
segments.english: So the concern of the command [is] bringing into existence, and the concern of the prohibition [is] removal or non-existence.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أَمر لَا كَمَال فِيهِ إِلَّا إِذا تضمن أمرا وجوديا
segments.english: And it [is] [a] matter [in which there is] no perfection, except if it contains [a] positive matter.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْعَدَم من حَيْثُ هُوَ عدم لَا كَمَال فِيهِ وَلَا مصلحَة
segments.english: For indeed non-existence, insofar as it [is] non-existence, [has] no perfection in it and no benefit,

segments.arabic: إِلَّا إِذا تضمن أمرا وجوديا مُطلقًا
segments.english: except if it contains [a] positive matter absolutely.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ الْأَمر الوجودي مَطْلُوب مَأْمُور بِهِ
segments.english: And that positive matter [is] sought [and] commanded.

segments.arabic: فَعَادَت حَقِيقَة النَّهْي إِلَى الْأَمر
segments.english: So the reality of the prohibition returns to the command,

segments.arabic: وَأَن الْمَطْلُوب بِهِ مَا فِي ضمن النَّهْي من الْأَمر الوجودي الْمَطْلُوب بِهِ
segments.english: and that what [is] sought by it [is] what [is] contained within the prohibition of the positive matter that [is] sought by it.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يَتَّضِح بِالْوَجْهِ الثَّانِي عشر
segments.english: And this becomes clear through the twelfth point,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أَن النَّاس اخْتلفُوا فِي الْمَطْلُوب بِالنَّهْي على أَقْوَال
segments.english: which [is] that people differed regarding what [is] sought by the prohibition, into [several] opinions.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا أَن الْمَطْلُوب بِهِ كف النَّفس عَن الْفِعْل وحبسها عَنهُ وَهُوَ أَمر وجودي
segments.english: The first of them: that what [is] sought by it [is] restraining the self from the act and holding it back from it, and it [is] [a] positive matter.

segments.arabic: قَالُوا لِأَن التَّكْلِيف إِنَّمَا يتَعَلَّق بالمقدور
segments.english: They said: because legal obligation only relates to what [is] within [one's] ability,

segments.arabic: والعدم الْمَحْض غير مَقْدُور
segments.english: and pure non-existence [is] not within [one's] ability.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا قَول الْجُمْهُور
segments.english: And this [is] the opinion of the majority.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ أَبُو هَاشم وَغَيره بل الْمَطْلُوب عدم الْفِعْل
segments.english: And Abu Hashim and others said: rather, what [is] sought [is] the non-doing of the act.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا يحصل الْمَقْصُود من بَقَائِهِ على الْعَدَم وَإِن لم يخْطر بِبَالِهِ الْفِعْل
segments.english: And for this [reason], the purpose [is] achieved by his remaining upon non-doing, even if the act did not cross his mind,

segments.arabic: فضلا أَن يقْصد الْكَفّ عَنهُ
segments.english: let alone that he intend to restrain [himself] from it.

segments.arabic: وَلَو كَانَ الْمَطْلُوب الْكَفّ لَكَانَ عَاصِيا إِذا لم يَأْتِ بِهِ
segments.english: And if what [was] sought [were] restraint, he would be disobedient if he did not produce it.

segments.arabic: وَلِأَن النَّاس يمدحون بِعَدَمِ فعل الْقَبِيح من لم يخْطر بِبَالِهِ فعله والكف عَنهُ
segments.english: And because people praise — for not doing the ugly [act] — the one whom neither doing it nor restraining from it [even] crossed his mind.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا أحد قولي القَاضِي أبي بكر
segments.english: And this [is] one of the two opinions of Judge Abu Bakr.

segments.arabic: ولأجله الْتزم أَن عدم الْفِعْل مَقْدُور للْعَبد وداخل تَحت الْكسْب
segments.english: And because of it, he held that non-doing of the act [is] within the ability of the servant and falls under acquisition.

segments.arabic: قَالَ وَالْمَقْصُود بِالنَّهْي الْإِبْقَاء على الْعَدَم الْأَصْلِيّ وَهُوَ مَقْدُور
segments.english: He said: and the purpose of the prohibition [is] maintaining the original state of non-existence, and it [is] within [one's] ability.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَت طَائِفَة الْمَطْلُوب بِالنَّهْي فعل الضِّدّ
segments.english: And [a] group said: what [is] sought by the prohibition [is] doing the opposite.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ هُوَ الْمَقْدُور وَهُوَ الْمَقْصُود للناهي
segments.english: For indeed it — it [is] what [is] within ability, and it [is] what [is] intended by the one who prohibits.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ إِنَّمَا نَهَاهُ عَن الْفَاحِشَة طلبا
segments.english: For indeed he only forbade him from indecency, seeking

segments.arabic: للعفة وَهِي الْمَأْمُور بهَا
segments.english: for chastity, and it [is] what [is] commanded with,

segments.arabic: وَنَهَاهُ عَن الظُّلم طلبا للعدل الْمَأْمُور بِهِ
segments.english: and He forbade him from injustice, seeking the justice that [is] commanded with,

segments.arabic: وَعَن الْكَذِب طلبا للصدق الْمَأْمُور بِهِ
segments.english: and from lying, seeking the truthfulness that [is] commanded with.

segments.arabic: وَهَكَذَا جَمِيع المنهيات
segments.english: And likewise [with] all the prohibitions.

segments.arabic: فَعِنْدَ هَؤُلَاءِ أَن حَقِيقَة النَّهْي الطّلب لضد المنهى عَنهُ
segments.english: So according to these [people], the reality of prohibition [is] the seeking of the opposite of what [is] prohibited.

segments.arabic: فَعَاد الْأَمر إِلَى أَن الطّلب إِنَّمَا تعلق بِفعل الْمَأْمُور
segments.english: So the matter returns to [the conclusion] that the seeking only attached to doing what [is] commanded.

segments.arabic: وَالتَّحْقِيق أَن الْمَطْلُوب نَوْعَانِ
segments.english: And the correct [view is] that what [is] sought [is of] two types:

segments.arabic: مَطْلُوب لنَفسِهِ وَهُوَ الْمَأْمُور بِهِ
segments.english: [something] sought for itself, and it [is] what [is] commanded with,

segments.arabic: ومطلوب إعدامه لمضادته الْمَأْمُور بِهِ وَهُوَ الْمنْهِي عَنهُ
segments.english: and [something] whose removal [is] sought because it opposes what [is] commanded with — and it [is] what [is] prohibited,

segments.arabic: لما فِيهِ من الْمفْسدَة المضادة للْمَأْمُور بِهِ
segments.english: because of the harm in it that opposes what [is] commanded with.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا لم يخْطر ببال الْمُكَلف وَلَا دَعَتْهُ نَفسه إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: So if [the prohibited act] did not cross the mind of the legally responsible person, and his self did not call him to it,

segments.arabic: بل اسْتمرّ على الْعَدَم الْأَصْلِيّ لم يثب على تَركه
segments.english: but rather he continued upon the original state of non-action — he [is] not rewarded for leaving it.

segments.arabic: وَإِن خطر بِبَالِهِ وكف نَفسه عَنهُ لله وَتَركه اخْتِيَارًا أثيب على كف نَفسه وامتناعه
segments.english: And if it crossed his mind and he held his self back from it for God's sake and left it by choice, he [is] rewarded for holding back his self and his refusal,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ فعل وجودي
segments.english: for it [is] [a] real action.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّوَاب إِنَّمَا يَقع على الْأَمر الوجودي دون الْعَدَم الْمَحْض
segments.english: And reward only falls upon [a] real matter, not upon pure non-existence.

segments.arabic: وَإِن تَركه مَعَ عزمه الْجَازِم على فعله لَكِن تَركه عَجزًا
segments.english: And if he left it while having firm resolve to do it, but [only] left it [out of] inability —

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا وَإِن لم يُعَاقب عُقُوبَة الْفَاعِل
segments.english: then this [person], even if he [is] not punished [with] the punishment of the doer,

segments.arabic: لَكِن يُعَاقب على عزمه وإرادته الجازمة
segments.english: he [is] still punished for his resolve and his firm intention

segments.arabic: الَّتِي إِنَّمَا تخلف مرادها عَجزًا
segments.english: that only failed [to achieve] its goal [out of] inability.

segments.arabic: وَقد دلّت على ذَلِك النُّصُوص الْكَثِيرَة فَلَا يلْتَفت إِلَى مَا خالفها
segments.english: And many texts have indicated this, so no attention should be paid to what contradicts them.

segments.arabic: كَقَوْلِه تَعَالَى
segments.english: Such as the saying of [God] Most High:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَإِنْ تُبْدُوا مَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَو تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ من يَشَاء﴾
segments.english: And if you reveal what [is] in yourselves or hide it, God [will] hold you to account for it; then He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills.
segments.sahih_international: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. Whether you show what is within yourselves or conceal it, Allah will bring you to account for it. Then He will forgive whom He wills and punish whom He wills, and Allah is over all things competent.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله فِي كاتم الشَّهَادَة
segments.english: And His saying regarding the one who conceals testimony:

segments.arabic: ﴿فَإِنَّهُ آثِمٌ قلبه﴾
segments.english: then indeed he — sinful [is] his heart.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَلَكِنْ يُؤَاخِذُكُمْ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ﴾
segments.english: but He holds you accountable for what your hearts have earned.
segments.sahih_international: Allah does not impose blame upon you for what is unintentional in your oaths, but He imposes blame upon you for what your hearts have earned. And Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السرائر﴾
segments.english: [On] the Day [when] the secrets [are] tested.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله إِذا تواجه المسلمان بسيفهما فالقاتل والمقتول فِي النَّار
segments.english: And his ﷺ saying: "When two Muslims face each other with their swords, then the killer and the killed [are] in the Fire."

segments.arabic: قَالُوا هَذَا الْقَاتِل فَمَا بَال الْمَقْتُول
segments.english: They said: "This [is] the killer, but what about the killed?"

segments.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّه أَرَادَ قتل صَاحبه
segments.english: He said: "Indeed he wanted to kill his companion."

segments.arabic: وَقَوله فِي الحَدِيث الآخر
segments.english: And his saying in the other hadith:

segments.arabic: وَرجل قَالَ لَو أَن لي مَالا لعملت بِعَمَل فلَان
segments.english: "And [a] man [who] said: 'If I had wealth, I would do as so-and-so does,'

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ بنيته وهما فِي الْوزر سَوَاء
segments.english: then he [is judged] by his intention, and they are equal in sin."

segments.arabic: وَقَول من قَالَ أَن الْمَطْلُوب بِالنَّهْي فعل الضِّدّ لَيْسَ كَذَلِك
segments.english: And the claim of those who said that what [is] sought by the prohibition [is] doing the opposite — [it is] not like that.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْمَقْصُود عدم الْفِعْل والتلبس بالضدين
segments.english: For the intended [thing is] the non-doing [of the act] and being occupied with the opposite.

segments.arabic: فَإِن مَالا يتم الْوَاجِب إِلَّا بِهِ فَهُوَ غير مَقْصُود بِالْقَصْدِ الأول
segments.english: For that without which the obligation [is] not completed — it [is] not intended as [a] primary intention.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ الْمَقْصُود بِالْقَصْدِ الأول الْمَأْمُور الَّذِي نهى عَمَّا يمنعهُ ويضعفه
segments.english: And if what [is] primarily intended [is] the command — that which [He] prohibited what prevents it and weakens it —

segments.arabic: فالمنهي عَنهُ مَطْلُوب إعدامه طلب الْوَسَائِل والذرائع
segments.english: then the prohibited [thing's] removal [is] sought [with] the seeking of means and pathways,

segments.arabic: والمأمور بِهِ مَطْلُوب إيجاده طلب الْمَقَاصِد والغايات
segments.english: and the commanded [thing's] existence [is] sought [with] the seeking of goals and ends.

segments.arabic: وَقَول أبي هَاشم إِن تَارِك القبائح يحمد وَإِن لم يخْطر بِبَالِهِ كف النَّفس
segments.english: And the claim of Abu Hashim that the one who leaves ugly deeds [is] praised even if holding back the self did not cross his mind —

segments.arabic: فَإِن أَرَادَ
segments.english: if he meant...

segments.arabic: بِحَمْدِهِ أَنه لَا يذم فَصَحِيح
segments.english: with His praise — that He [is] not blamed, then [that is] correct.

segments.arabic: وَإِن أَرَادَ أَنه يثني عَلَيْهِ بذلك وَيُحب عَلَيْهِ وَيسْتَحق الثَّوَاب فَغير صَحِيح
segments.english: And if he meant that He [is] praised for that, and [is] loved for it, and deserves reward — then [that is] not correct.

segments.arabic: فَإِن النَّاس لَا يحْمَدُونَ المحبوب على ترك الزِّنَا
segments.english: For people do not praise the impotent man for leaving adultery,

segments.arabic: وَلَا الْأَخْرَس على عدم الْغَيْبَة والسب
segments.english: nor the mute person for [his] lack of backbiting and cursing.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا يحْمَدُونَ الْقَادِر الْمُمْتَنع عَن قدرَة وداع إِلَى الْفِعْل
segments.english: Rather, they praise the one who [is] capable [yet] refrains, despite [having] ability and [a] drive toward the act.

segments.arabic: وَقَول القَاضِي الْإِبْقَاء على الْعَدَم الْأَصْلِيّ مَقْدُور
segments.english: And the statement of the Judge that maintaining the original non-existence [is] within [one's] power —

segments.arabic: فَإِن أَرَادَ بِهِ كف النَّفس ومنعها فَصَحِيح
segments.english: if he meant by it restraining the self and holding it back, then [that is] correct.

segments.arabic: وَإِن أَرَادَ مجرّد الْعَدَم فَلَيْسَ كَذَلِك
segments.english: And if he meant mere non-existence, then [it is] not so.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يتَبَيَّن بِالْوَجْهِ الثَّالِث عشر
segments.english: And this becomes clear through the thirteenth point,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أَن الْأَمر بالشَّيْء نهي عَن ضِدّه من طَرِيق اللُّزُوم الْعقلِيّ لَا الْقَصْد الطلبي
segments.english: which [is] that commanding something [is a] prohibition of its opposite by way of rational necessity, not by [direct] intended demand.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْأَمر إِنَّمَا مَقْصُود فعل الْمَأْمُور
segments.english: For the command — its only purpose [is] doing what [is] commanded.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَ من لوازمه ترك الضِّدّ صَار تَركه مَقْصُودا لغيره
segments.english: So if leaving the opposite [is] among its requirements, then leaving it becomes intended for the sake of something else.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا هُوَ الصَّوَاب فِي مَسْأَلَة الْأَمر بالشَّيْء هَل هُوَ نهي عَن ضِدّه أم لَا
segments.english: And this [is] the correct [view] on the question: [is] commanding something [a] prohibition of its opposite or not?

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ نهي عَنهُ من جِهَة اللُّزُوم لَا من جِهَة الْقَصْد والطلب
segments.english: So it [is a] prohibition of it from the side of necessity, not from the side of intention and demand.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ النَّهْي عَن الشَّيْء مَقْصُود الناهي بِالْقَصْدِ الأول الِانْتِهَاء عَن الْمنْهِي عَنهُ
segments.english: And likewise, the prohibition of something — the primary intention of the one prohibiting [is] stopping the prohibited thing.

segments.arabic: وَكَونه مشتغلا بضده جَاءَ من جِهَة اللُّزُوم الْعقلِيّ
segments.english: And his being occupied with its opposite came from the side of rational necessity.

segments.arabic: لَكِن إِنَّمَا نهى عَمَّا يضاد مَا أَمر بِهِ كَمَا تقدم
segments.english: But He only prohibited what opposes what He commanded, as was mentioned before.

segments.arabic: فَكَأَن الْمَأْمُور بِهِ هُوَ الْمَقْصُود بِالْقَصْدِ الأول فِي الْمَوْضِعَيْنِ
segments.english: So it [is] as if the commanded thing [is] what [is] primarily intended in both cases.

segments.arabic: وحرف الْمَسْأَلَة أَن طلب الشَّيْء طلب لَهُ بِالذَّاتِ وَلما هُوَ من ضَرُورَته باللزوم
segments.english: And the crux of the matter [is] that demanding something [is a] demand for it in itself, and for what [is] among its requirements by necessity.

segments.arabic: وَالنَّهْي عَن الشَّيْء طلب لتَركه بِالذَّاتِ ولفعل مَا هُوَ من ضَرُورَة التّرْك باللزوم
segments.english: And the prohibition of something [is a] demand to leave it in itself, and to do what [is] among the requirements of leaving [it] by necessity.

segments.arabic: وَالْمَطْلُوب فِي الْمَوْضِعَيْنِ فعل وكف وَكِلَاهُمَا أَمر وجودي
segments.english: And what [is] demanded in both cases [is] action and restraint, and both of them [are] something real.

segments.arabic: الْوَجْه الرَّابِع عشر أَن الْأَمر وَالنَّهْي فِي بَاب الطّلب نَظِير النَّفْي وَالْإِثْبَات فِي بَاب الْخَبَر
