segments.english: The fourteenth point: command and prohibition in the area of demand [are] like negation and affirmation in the area of statements.

segments.arabic: والمدح وَالثنَاء لَا يحصلان بِالنَّفْيِ الْمَحْض إِن لم يتَضَمَّن ثبوتا
segments.english: And praise and commendation [are] not achieved by pure negation if it does not contain [an] affirmation.

segments.arabic: فَإِن النَّفْي كاسمه عدم لَا كَمَال فِيهِ وَلَا مدح
segments.english: For negation [is], as its name [suggests], non-existence — there [is] no perfection in it, and no praise.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا تضمن ثبوتا صَحَّ الْمَدْح بِهِ
segments.english: But if it contains [an] affirmation, then praising with it [is] valid —

segments.arabic: كنفي النسْيَان المستلزم لكَمَال الْعلم وَبَيَانه
segments.english: like negating forgetfulness, which requires the perfection of knowledge and its clarity,

segments.arabic: وَنفي اللغوب والإعياء والتعب المستلزم لكَمَال الْقُوَّة وَالْقُدْرَة
segments.english: and negating weariness, exhaustion, and tiredness, which requires the perfection of strength and power,

segments.arabic: وَنفي السّنة وَالنَّوْم المستلزم لكَمَال الْحَيَاة والقومية
segments.english: and negating drowsiness and sleep, which requires the perfection of life and self-sustaining,

segments.arabic: وَنفي الْوَلَد والصاحبة المستلزم لكَمَال الْغنى وَالْملك والربوبية
segments.english: and negating [having a] child and [a] wife, which requires the perfection of self-sufficiency, dominion, and lordship,

segments.arabic: وَنفي الشَّرِيك وَالْوَلِيّ وَالشَّفِيع بِدُونِ الْإِذْن المستلزم لكَمَال التَّوْحِيد والتفرّد بالكمال والإلهية وَالْملك
segments.english: and negating [a] partner, [a] protector, and [an] intercessor without [His] permission, which requires the perfection of monotheism, uniqueness in perfection, divinity, and dominion,

segments.arabic: وَنفي الظُّلم المتضمن لكَمَال الْعدْل
segments.english: and negating injustice, which contains the perfection of justice,

segments.arabic: وَنفي إِدْرَاك الْأَبْصَار لَهُ المتضمن لعظمته وَأَنه أجلّ من أَن يدْرك وَإِن رَأَتْهُ
segments.english: and negating that eyes can grasp Him, which contains [the affirmation of] His greatness — and that He [is] too great to be grasped, even if they see Him.

segments.arabic: الْأَبْصَار وَإِلَّا فَلَيْسَ فِي كَونه لَا يُرَى مَدْحٌ بِوَجْهٍ مِن الْوُجُوه
segments.english: the eyes — otherwise, there [is] no praise in [something] not being seen, in any way.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّ الْعَدَمَ الْمَحْضَ كَذَلِك
segments.english: For pure nonexistence [is] also like that.

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا عُرِفَ هَذَا فَالمَنْهِيُّ عَنْهُ إِنْ لَمْ يَتَضَمَّنْ أَمْرًا وُجُودِيًّا ثُبُوتِيًّا لَمْ يُمْدَحْ بِتَرْكِهِ
segments.english: And if this [is] understood, then the prohibited thing — if it does not contain [a] real, existing matter — [one is] not praised for leaving it,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَسْتَحِقَّ الثَّوَابَ وَالثَّنَاءَ بِمُجَرَّدِ التَّرْكِ
segments.english: and [one] does not deserve reward and praise by mere abandonment,

segments.arabic: لَا يَسْتَحِقُّ الْمَدْحَ وَالثَّنَاءَ بِمُجَرَّدِ الْوَصْفِ الْعَدَمِيِّ
segments.english: [just as one] does not deserve praise and commendation by [a] mere description of absence.

segments.arabic: الْوَجْهُ الْخَامِسَ عَشَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ سُبْحَانَهُ جَعَلَ جَزَاءَ الْمَأْمُورَاتِ عَشَرَةَ أَمْثَالِ فِعْلِهَا وَجَزَاءَ الْمَنْهِيَّاتِ مِثْلَ وَاحِدٍ
segments.english: The fifteenth point: God, glorified [is] He, made the reward of commanded deeds ten times their doing, and the reward of prohibited deeds [only] one time.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يَدُلُّ عَلَى أَنَّ فِعْلَ مَا أَمَرَ بِهِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ تَرْكِ مَا نَهَى عَنْهُ
segments.english: And this shows that doing what He commanded [is] more beloved to Him than leaving what He prohibited.

segments.arabic: وَلَوْ كَانَ الْأَمْرُ بِالْعَكْسِ لَكَانَتِ السَّيِّئَةُ بِعَشَرَةٍ وَالْحَسَنَةُ بِوَاحِدَةٍ أَوْ تَسَاوَيَا
segments.english: And if the matter were the opposite, the bad deed would [count as] ten and the good deed [as] one, or they would be equal.

segments.arabic: الْوَجْهُ السَّادِسَ عَشَرَ أَنَّ الْمَنْهِيَّ عَنْهُ الْمَقْصُودُ إِعْدَامُهُ وَأَنْ لَا يَدْخُلَ فِي الْوُجُودِ
segments.english: The sixteenth point: the prohibited thing — the goal [is] its elimination and that it not come into existence,

segments.arabic: سَوَاءٌ نَوَى ذَلِكَ أَوْ لَمْ يَنْوِهِ وَسَوَاءٌ خَطَرَ بِبَالِهِ أَوْ لَمْ يَخْطُرْ
segments.english: whether [one] intended that or did not intend it, and whether it crossed his mind or did not cross [it].

segments.arabic: فَالْمَقْصُودُ أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ
segments.english: So the goal [is] that it simply not exist.

segments.arabic: وَأَمَّا الْمَأْمُورُ بِهِ فَالْمَقْصُودُ كَوْنُهُ إِيجَادًا وَالتَّقَرُّبُ بِهِ نِيَّةً وَفِعْلًا
segments.english: But as for the commanded deed, the goal [is] its being brought into existence, and drawing near [to God] through it — [in] intention and action.

segments.arabic: وَسِرُّ الْمَسْأَلَةِ أَنَّ وُجُودَ مَا طَلَبَ إِيجَادَهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ عَدَمِ مَا طَلَبَ إِعْدَامَهُ
segments.english: And the secret of the matter [is] that the existence of what He requested to be brought about [is] more beloved to Him than the nonexistence of what He requested to be eliminated.

segments.arabic: وَعَدَمُ مَا أَحَبَّهُ أَكْرَهُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ وُجُودِ مَا يُبْغِضُهُ
segments.english: And the absence of what He loves [is] more hateful to Him than the existence of what He hates.

segments.arabic: فَمَحَبَّتُهُ لِفِعْلِ مَا أَمَرَ بِهِ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ كَرَاهَتِهِ لِفِعْلِ مَا نَهَى عَنْهُ
segments.english: So His love for the doing of what He commanded [is] greater than His hatred for the doing of what He prohibited.

segments.arabic: يُوَضِّحُهُ الْوَجْهُ السَّابِعَ عَشَرَ
segments.english: The seventeenth point makes this clear:

segments.arabic: أَنَّ فِعْلَ مَا يُحِبُّهُ وَالْإِعَانَةَ عَلَيْهِ وَجَزَاءَهُ وَمَا يَتَرَتَّبُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَدْحِ وَالثَّنَاءِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ
segments.english: that doing what He loves, and the help toward it, and its reward, and whatever follows of praise and commendation — [all of this is] from His mercy.

segments.arabic: وَفِعْلُ مَا يَكْرَهُ وَجَزَاؤُهُ وَمَا يَتَرَتَّبُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الذَّمِّ وَالْأَلَمِ وَالْعِقَابِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ
segments.english: And doing what He hates, and its punishment, and whatever follows of blame and pain and punishment — [all of this is] from His anger.

segments.arabic: وَرَحْمَتُهُ سَابِقَةٌ عَلَى غَضَبِهِ غَالِبَةٌ لَهُ
segments.english: And His mercy precedes His anger and overcomes it.

segments.arabic: وَكُلُّ مَا كَانَ مِنْ صِفَةِ الرَّحْمَةِ فَهُوَ غَالِبٌ لِمَا كَانَ مِنْ صِفَةِ الْغَضَبِ
segments.english: And everything that comes from the attribute of mercy — it overcomes what comes from the attribute of anger.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ لَا يَكُونُ إِلَّا رَحِيمًا
segments.english: For He, glorified [is] He, [is] always merciful.

segments.arabic: وَرَحْمَتُهُ مِنْ لَوَازِمِ ذَاتِهِ كَعِلْمِهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ وَحَيَاتِهِ وَسَمْعِهِ وَبَصَرِهِ وَإِحْسَانِهِ
segments.english: And His mercy [is] from the necessary [qualities] of His essence — like His knowledge, His power, His life, His hearing, His sight, and His goodness.

segments.arabic: فَيَسْتَحِيلُ أَنْ يَكُونَ عَلَى خِلَافِ ذَلِكَ
segments.english: So it [is] impossible for Him to be otherwise.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ كَذَلِكَ غَضَبُهُ فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ لَوَازِمِ ذَاتِهِ
segments.english: But His anger [is] not like that, for it [is] not from the necessary [qualities] of His essence.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يَكُونُ غَضْبَانَ دَائِمًا غَضَبًا لَا يُتَصَوَّرُ انْفِكَاكُهُ
segments.english: And He [is] not angry forever — [with] an anger [from which] separation cannot be imagined.

segments.arabic: بَلْ يَقُولُ رُسُلُهُ وَأَعْلَمُ الْخَلْقِ بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
segments.english: Rather, His messengers — and [those] most knowledgeable of creation about Him — [will] say on the Day of Judgment:

segments.arabic: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ
segments.english: "My Lord has become angry today [with] an anger — He never became angry before it with [the] like of it, and He [will] never become angry after it with [the] like of it."

segments.arabic: وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَغَضَبُهُ لَمْ يَسَعْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
segments.english: And His mercy encompasses everything, but His anger does not encompass everything.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ كَتَبَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ وَلَمْ يَكْتُبْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ الْغَضَبَ
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, wrote mercy upon Himself, but He did not write anger upon Himself.

segments.arabic: وَوَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا وَلَمْ يَسَعْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ غَضَبًا وَانْتِقَامًا
segments.english: And He encompassed everything [in] mercy and knowledge, but He did not encompass everything [in] anger and punishment.

segments.arabic: فَالرَّحْمَةُ وَمَا كَانَ بِهَا وَلَوَازِمُهَا وَآثَارُهَا غَالِبَةٌ عَلَى الْغَضَبِ
segments.english: So mercy — and what comes through it, and its necessities, and its effects — [is] dominant over anger.

headings.arabic: الْوَجْه الثَّامِن عشر
headings.english: The Eighteenth Point

headings.arabic: الْوَجْه التَّاسِع عشر
headings.english: The Nineteenth Point

segments.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ مِنْهُ وآثاره
segments.english: and what was from Him and His effects —

segments.arabic: فوجود مَا كَانَ بِالرَّحْمَةِ أحب إِلَيْهِ من وجود مَا كَانَ من لَوَازِم الْغَضَب
segments.english: so the existence of what was [done] through mercy [is] more beloved to Him than the existence of what was from the requirements of anger.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كَانَت الرَّحْمَة أحب إِلَيْهِ من الْعَذَاب وَالْعَفو أحب إِلَيْهِ من الانتقام
segments.english: And for this [reason], mercy was more beloved to Him than punishment, and forgiveness more beloved to Him than revenge.

segments.arabic: فوجود محبوبه أحب إِلَيْهِ من فَوَات مكروهه
segments.english: So the existence of what He loves [is] more beloved to Him than the absence of what He dislikes.

segments.arabic: وَلَا سِيمَا إِذا كَانَ فِي فَوَات مكروهه فَوَات مَا يُحِبهُ من لوازمه
segments.english: Especially if in the absence of what He dislikes [there is] the absence of what He loves from its requirements.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ يكره فَوَات تِلْكَ اللوازم المحبوبة كَمَا يكره وجود ذَلِك الْمَلْزُوم الْمَكْرُوه
segments.english: For He dislikes the absence of those beloved requirements just as He dislikes the existence of that disliked thing that requires them.

segments.arabic: الْوَجْه الثَّامِن عشر أَن آثَار مَا يكرههُ وَهُوَ المنهيات أسْرع زوالا بِمَا يُحِبهُ
segments.english: The Eighteenth Point: that the effects of what He dislikes — and that [is] the prohibited things — [are] quicker [in] disappearing through what He loves,

segments.arabic: من زَوَال آثَار مَا يُحِبهُ بِمَا يكرههُ
segments.english: than the disappearance of the effects of what He loves through what He dislikes.

segments.arabic: فآثار كَرَاهَته سريعة الزَّوَال
segments.english: So the effects of His displeasure [are] quick [in] disappearing.

segments.arabic: وَقد يزيلها سُبْحَانَهُ بِالْعَفو والتجاوز
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, may remove them through forgiveness and pardoning.

segments.arabic: وتزول بالتوبة وَالِاسْتِغْفَار والأعمال الصَّالِحَة والمصائب الْكَفَرَة والشفاعة
segments.english: And they disappear through repentance, seeking forgiveness, righteous deeds, expiating hardships, and intercession.

segments.arabic: والحسنات يذْهبن السيئات
segments.english: And good deeds wipe away bad deeds.

segments.arabic: وَلَو بلغت ذنُوب العَبْد عنان السَّمَاء ثمَّ استغفره غفر لَهُ
segments.english: And even if the sins of the servant reached the heights of the sky, then he sought His forgiveness, He [would] forgive him.

segments.arabic: وَلَو لقِيه بقراب الأَرْض خَطَايَا ثمَّ لقِيه لَا يُشْرك بِهِ شَيْئا لأتاه بقرابها مغْفرَة
segments.english: And even if he met Him with nearly the earth's fill of sins, then met Him not associating anything with Him, He [would] bring him its fill [in] forgiveness.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يغْفر الذُّنُوب وَإِن تعاظمت وَلَا يُبَالِي
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, forgives sins even if they [are] immense, and He does not care.

segments.arabic: فيبطلها وَيبْطل آثارها بِأَدْنَى سعي من العَبْد
segments.english: So He cancels them and cancels their effects with the least effort from the servant,

segments.arabic: وتوبة نصوح وَنَدم على مَا فعل
segments.english: and [a] sincere repentance, and regret over what he did.

segments.arabic: وَمَا ذَاك إِلَّا لوُجُود مَا يُحِبهُ من تَوْبَة العَبْد وطاعته وتوحيده
segments.english: And that [is] only because of the existence of what He loves of the servant's repentance, obedience, and monotheism.

segments.arabic: فدلّ على أَن وجود ذَلِك أحب إِلَيْهِ وأرضى لَهُ
segments.english: So this proves that the existence of that [is] more beloved to Him and more pleasing to Him.

segments.arabic: يُوضحهُ الْوَجْه التَّاسِع عشر
segments.english: What clarifies it [is] the Nineteenth Point,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ قدر مَا يبغضه ويكرهه من المنهيات
segments.english: and it [is] that He, glorified [is] He, decreed what He hates and dislikes of the prohibited things

segments.arabic: لما يَتَرَتَّب عَلَيْهَا مِمَّا يُحِبهُ ويفرح بِهِ من المأمورات
segments.english: because of what results from them of what He loves and rejoices in of the commanded things.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ أفرح بتوبة عَبده من الفاقد الْوَاجِد والعقيم الْوَالِد والظمآن الْوَارِد
segments.english: For He, glorified [is] He, [is] more joyful at His servant's repentance than the one who lost [something] then found [it], the barren [woman] who gives birth, and the thirsty one who finds water.

segments.arabic: وَقد ضرب رَسُول الله لفرحه بتوبة العَبْد مثلا لَيْسَ فِي المفروح بِهِ أبلغ مِنْهُ
segments.english: And the Messenger of God gave for His joy at the servant's repentance [a] parable — there [is] nothing among things that bring joy greater than it.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا الْفَرح إِنَّمَا كَانَ بِفعل الْمَأْمُور بِهِ وَهُوَ التَّوْبَة
segments.english: And this joy was only through doing what [is] commanded, and that [is] repentance.

segments.arabic: فَقدر الذَّنب لما يَتَرَتَّب عَلَيْهِ من هَذَا الْفَرح الْعَظِيم
segments.english: So He decreed the sin because of what results from it of this great joy,

segments.arabic: الَّذِي وجوده أحب إِلَيْهِ من فَوَاته
segments.english: whose existence [is] more beloved to Him than its absence,

segments.arabic: ووجوده بِدُونِ لَازمه مُمْتَنع
segments.english: and its existence without its requirement [is] impossible.

segments.arabic: فَدلَّ على أَن وجود مَا يحب أحب إِلَيْهِ من فَوَات مَا يكره
segments.english: So this proves that the existence of what He loves [is] more beloved to Him than the absence of what He dislikes.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ المُرَاد بذلك أَن كل فَرد من أَفْرَاد مَا يحب أحب إِلَيْهِ من فَوَات كل فَرد مِمَّا يكره
segments.english: And what [is] meant by that [is] not that every individual instance of what He loves [is] more beloved to Him than the absence of every individual instance of what He dislikes,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى تكون رَكعَتَا الضُّحَى أحب إِلَيْهِ من فَوَات قتل الْمُسلم
segments.english: such that the two units of the forenoon prayer [would be] more beloved to Him than the absence of killing [a] Muslim.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا المُرَاد أَن جنس فعل المأمورات أفضل من جنس ترك الْمَحْظُورَات
segments.english: Rather, what [is] meant [is] that the category of doing commanded things [is] better than the category of leaving prohibited things,

segments.arabic: كَمَا إِذا فضل الذّكر على الْأُنْثَى والإنسي على الْملك
segments.english: just as when the male [is] preferred over the female, and the human over the angel —

segments.arabic: فَالْمُرَاد الْجِنْس لَا عُمُوم الْأَعْيَان
segments.english: what [is] meant [is] the category, not every individual.

segments.arabic: وَالْمَقْصُود أَن هَذَا الْفَرح الَّذِي لَا فَرح يُشبههُ فعل مَأْمُور التَّوْبَة
segments.english: And the point [is] that this joy — which no joy resembles — [over] the commanded act of repentance

segments.arabic: يدل على أَن هَذَا الْمَأْمُور أحب إِلَيْهِ من فَوَات الْمَحْظُور الَّذِي تفوت بِهِ التَّوْبَة وأثرها ومقتضاها
segments.english: shows that this commanded [act is] more beloved to Him than the loss of the forbidden [thing] by which repentance, its effect, and its outcome [are] lost.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قيل إِنَّمَا فَرح بِالتَّوْبَةِ لِأَنَّهَا ترك للمنهي فَكَانَ الْفَرح بِالتّرْكِ
segments.english: If it [is] said: He only rejoiced at repentance because it [is] leaving the forbidden, so the joy [was] at the leaving —

segments.arabic: قيل لَيْسَ كَذَلِك فَإِن التّرْك الْمَحْض لَا يُوجب هَذَا الْفَرح بل وَلَا الثَّوَاب وَلَا الْمَدْح
segments.english: [it is] said: [it is] not so, for mere leaving does not bring about this joy — nor even reward, nor praise.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَت التَّوْبَة تركا وَإِن كَانَ التّرْك من لوازمها
segments.english: And repentance [is] not [mere] leaving, even if leaving [is] among its requirements.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا هِيَ فعل وجودي يتَضَمَّن إقبال التائب على ربه وإنابته إِلَيْهِ والتزام طَاعَته
segments.english: Rather, it [is] a positive act that includes the repentant one turning to his Lord, returning to Him, and committing to His obedience.

segments.arabic: وَمن لَوَازِم ذَلِك ترك مَا نهى عَنهُ
segments.english: And among the requirements of that [is] leaving what He forbade.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And for this reason [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَأَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ﴾
segments.english: And [that you should] seek forgiveness of your Lord, then repent to Him.
segments.sahih_international: And [saying], "Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, [and] He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor. But if you turn away, then indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great Day.

segments.arabic: فالتوبة رُجُوع مِمَّا يكره إِلَى مَا يحب وَلَيْسَت مُجَرّد التّرْك
segments.english: So repentance [is] a return from what He dislikes to what He loves, and [it is] not mere leaving.

segments.arabic: فَإِن من ترك الذَّنب تركا مُجَردا وَلم يرجع مِنْهُ إِلَى مَا يُحِبهُ الرب تَعَالَى لم يكن تَائِبًا
segments.english: For whoever left the sin [as] mere leaving and did not return from it to what the Lord Most High loves, [he] was not [a] repentant one.

segments.arabic: فالتوبة رُجُوع وإقبال وإنابة لَا ترك مَحْض
segments.english: So repentance [is] a return, a turning, and a coming back — not mere leaving.

segments.arabic: الْوَجْه الْعشْرُونَ أَن الْمَأْمُور بِهِ إِذا فَاتَ فَاتَت الْحَيَاة الْمَطْلُوبَة للْعَبد
segments.english: The twentieth point: that the commanded [act], when [it is] missed, the life sought by the servant [is] missed.

segments.arabic: وَهِي الَّتِي قَالَ تَعَالَى فِيهَا
segments.english: And it [is] that which [God] Most High said about:

segments.arabic: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ﴾
segments.english: O you who believe, respond to God and to the Messenger when he calls you to what gives you life.
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَو من كَانَ مَيْتًا فَأَحْيَيْنَاهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُ نُورًا يَمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ كَمَنْ مَثَلُهُ فِي الظُّلُمَات﴾
segments.english: Or [is] one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him [a] light [by which] he walks among the people, like one whose example [is] in the darkness?
segments.sahih_international: And is one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him light by which to walk among the people like one who is in darkness, never to emerge therefrom? Thus it has been made pleasing to the disbelievers that which they were doing.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ فِي حق الْكفَّار
segments.english: And He said about the disbelievers:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَمْوَاتٌ غَيْرُ أَحيَاء﴾
segments.english: [They are] dead, not alive.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّكَ لَا تسمع الْمَوْتَى﴾
segments.english: You cannot make the dead hear.

segments.arabic: وَأما الْمنْهِي عَنهُ فغايته أَن يُوجد الْمَرَض
segments.english: As for the forbidden, at most it brings about sickness.

segments.arabic: وحياة مَعَ السقم خير من موت
segments.english: And life with illness [is] better than death.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قيل وَمن الْمنْهِي عَنهُ مَا يُوجب الْهَلَاك وَهُوَ الشّرك
segments.english: If it [is] said: among the forbidden [is] what causes destruction, and that [is] associating partners [with God] —

segments.arabic: قيل الهلك إِنَّمَا حصل بِعَدَمِ التَّوْحِيد الْمَأْمُور بِهِ
segments.english: [it is] said: the destruction only came about by the absence of monotheism, which [is] the commanded [act].

segments.arabic: الْحَيَاة فَلَمَّا فقد حصل الْهَلَاك
segments.english: [It is] the [true] life, so when it was lost, destruction occurred.

segments.arabic: فَمَا هلك إِلَّا من عدم إِتْيَانه بالمأمور بِهِ وَهُوَ
segments.english: So none perished except from not fulfilling the commanded [act], and that [is]:

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا وَجه حاد وَعِشْرُونَ فِي الْمَسْأَلَة
segments.english: And this [is] the twenty-first point in the matter.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أَن فِي المأمورات مَا يجب فَوَاته الْهَلَاك والشقاء الدَّائِم
segments.english: And it [is] that among the commanded [acts is] that whose missing brings about destruction and permanent misery.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ فِي المنهيات مَا يَقْتَضِي ذَلِك
segments.english: And there [is] nothing among the forbidden [acts] that brings about that.

segments.arabic: الْوَجْه الثَّانِي وَالْعشْرُونَ أَن فعل الْمَأْمُور يتضى ترك الْمنْهِي عَنهُ
segments.english: The twenty-second point: that doing the commanded [act] leads to leaving the forbidden.

segments.arabic: إِذا فعل على وَجهه من الْإِخْلَاص والمتابعة والنصح لله فِيهِ
segments.english: When [it is] done properly — with sincerity, adherence, and devotion to God in it.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّلاةَ تَنْهَى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ﴾
segments.english: Indeed, the prayer prevents from shameful [acts] and wrongdoing.
segments.sahih_international: Recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater. And Allah knows that which you do.

segments.arabic: وَمُجَرَّد ترك الْمنْهِي لَا يَقْتَضِي فعل الْمَأْمُور وَلَا يستلزمه
segments.english: And merely leaving the forbidden does not lead to doing the commanded [act], nor does it require it.

segments.arabic: الْوَجْه الثَّالِث وَالْعشْرُونَ أَن مَا يُحِبهُ من المأمورات فَهُوَ متعلّق بصفاته
segments.english: The twenty-third point: that what He loves of the commanded [acts] — it [is] connected to His attributes.

segments.arabic: وَمَا يكرههُ من المنهيات فمتعلق بمفعولاته
segments.english: And what He dislikes of the forbidden [acts] [is] connected to His created things.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا وَجه دَقِيق يحْتَاج إِلَى بَيَان فَنَقُول
segments.english: And this [is] a subtle point that needs explanation, so we say:

headings.arabic: فصل مبنى الدين على قاعدتين الذكر والشكر قال تعالى
headings.english: Chapter: The foundation of the religion [is] upon two principles — remembrance and gratitude. [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: المنهيات شرور وتفضي الي شرور والمأمورات خير وتفضي إِلَى الْخيرَات
segments.english: The prohibited things [are] evils and lead to evils, and the commanded things [are] good and lead to good things.

segments.arabic: وَالْخَيْر بيدَيْهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَالشَّر لَيْسَ إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And good [is] in His hands, glorified [is] He, and evil [is] not attributed to Him.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الشَّرّ لَا يدْخل فِي صِفَاته وَلَا فِي أَفعاله وَلَا فِي أَسْمَائِهِ
segments.english: For evil does not enter into His attributes, nor into His actions, nor into His names.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ من المفعولات
segments.english: Rather, it [is only] from the created things.

segments.arabic: مَعَ أَنه شَرّ بِالْإِضَافَة وَالنِّسْبَة إِلَى العَبْد
segments.english: While it [is] evil in relation and comparison to the servant.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا من حَيْثُ إِضَافَته ونسبته إِلَى الْخَالِق سُبْحَانَهُ فَلَيْسَ بشر من هَذِه الْجِهَة
segments.english: Otherwise, from the perspective of its attribution and relation to the Creator, glorified [is] He, it [is] not evil from this angle.

segments.arabic: فغاية ارْتِكَاب النهى أَن يُوجب شرا بِالْإِضَافَة إِلَى العَبْد
segments.english: So the utmost [result] of committing what [is] prohibited [is] that it brings about evil in relation to the servant,

segments.arabic: مَعَ أَنه فِي نَفسه لَيْسَ بشر
segments.english: while in itself it [is] not evil.

segments.arabic: وَأما فَوَات الْمَأْمُور فَيفوت بِهِ الْخَيْر الَّذِي بفواته يحصل ضِدّه من الشَّرّ
segments.english: As for missing the commanded, then the good [is] missed by it — [the good] by whose absence its opposite of evil occurs.

segments.arabic: وَكلما كَانَ الْمَأْمُور أحب إِلَى الله سُبْحَانَهُ كَانَ الشَّرّ الْحَاصِل بفواته أعظم
segments.english: And whenever the commanded [was] more beloved to God, glorified [is] He, the evil resulting from its absence [was] greater —

segments.arabic: كالتوحيد وَالْإِيمَان
segments.english: like monotheism and faith.

segments.arabic: وسر هَذِه الْوُجُوه أَن الْمَأْمُور محبوبه والمنهي مكروهه
segments.english: And the secret of these aspects [is] that the commanded [is] what He loves, and the prohibited [is] what He hates.

segments.arabic: وَوُقُوع محبوبه أحب إِلَيْهِ من فَوَات مكروهه
segments.english: And the occurrence of what He loves [is] more beloved to Him than the absence of what He hates.

segments.arabic: وفوات محبوبه أكره إِلَيْهِ من وُقُوع مكروهه
segments.english: And the absence of what He loves [is] more hateful to Him than the occurrence of what He hates.

segments.arabic: وَالله أعلم
segments.english: And God knows best.

segments.arabic: ﴿فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلا تكفرون﴾
segments.english: So remember Me, [and] I will remember you. And be grateful to Me, and do not be ungrateful.
segments.sahih_international: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ النَّبِي لِمعَاذ وَالله إِنِّي لَأحبك
segments.english: And the Prophet said to Mu'adh: 'By God, I truly love you.

segments.arabic: فَلَا تنسى أَن تَقول دبر كل صَلَاة
segments.english: So do not forget to say after every prayer:

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أعنِّي على ذكرك وشكرك وَحسن عبادتك
segments.english: O God, help me in Your remembrance, Your gratitude, and the goodness of Your worship.'

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ المُرَاد بِالذكر مُجَرّد الذّكر اللِّسَان بل الذّكر القلبي واللساني
segments.english: And what [is] meant by remembrance [is] not merely the remembrance of the tongue, but the remembrance of the heart and the tongue.

segments.arabic: وَذكره يتَضَمَّن ذكر أَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاته وَذكر أمره وَنَهْيه وَذكره بِكَلَامِهِ
segments.english: And His remembrance includes remembering His names and attributes, remembering His commands and prohibitions, and remembering Him through His words.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ يسْتَلْزم مَعْرفَته وَالْإِيمَان بِهِ وبصفات كَمَاله ونعوت جَلَاله
segments.english: And that requires knowing Him, having faith in Him, and [faith] in the attributes of His perfection and the descriptions of His majesty.

segments.arabic: وَالثنَاء عَلَيْهِ بأنواع الْمَدْح
segments.english: And praising Him with [all] types of praise.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ لَا يتم إِلَّا بتوحيده
segments.english: And that [is] not complete except through [affirming] His oneness.

segments.arabic: فَذكره الْحَقِيقِيّ يسْتَلْزم ذَلِك كُله
segments.english: So His true remembrance requires all of that.

segments.arabic: ويستلزم ذكر نعمه وآلائه وإحسانه إِلَى خلقه
segments.english: And [it] requires remembering His blessings, His favors, and His kindness to His creation.

segments.arabic: وَأما الشُّكْر فَهُوَ الْقيام بِطَاعَتِهِ والتقرب إِلَيْهِ بأنواع محابه ظَاهرا وَبَاطنا
segments.english: As for gratitude, it [is] standing in obedience to Him and drawing near to Him through [all] types of what He loves, outwardly and inwardly.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَانِ الْأَمْرَانِ هما جماع الدّين
segments.english: And these two matters — they [are] the totality of the religion.

segments.arabic: فَذكره مُسْتَلْزم لمعرفته وشكره مُتَضَمّن لطاعته
segments.english: So His remembrance requires knowing Him, and His gratitude includes obedience to Him.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَانِ هما الْغَايَة الَّتِي خلق لأَجلهَا الْجِنّ وَالْإِنْس وَالسَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض
segments.english: And these two [are] the purpose for which the jinn, mankind, the heavens, and the earth were created.

segments.arabic: وَوضع لأَجلهَا الثَّوَاب وَالْعِقَاب وَأنزل الْكتب وَأرْسل الرُّسُل
segments.english: And for [their] sake, reward and punishment were set, the books were sent down, and the messengers were sent.

segments.arabic: وَهِي الْحق الَّذِي بِهِ خلقت
segments.english: And it [is] the truth for which [they] were created.

headings.arabic: فصل تكرر في القرآن جعل الأعمال القائمة بالقلب والجوارح سبب الهداية
headings.english: Section: [It is] repeated in the Quran [that] the deeds established in the heart and the limbs [are a] cause of guidance

segments.arabic: السَّمَاوَات وَالْأَرْض وَمَا بَينهمَا وضدها هُوَ الْبَاطِل والعبث
segments.english: the heavens and the earth and what [is] between them. And its opposite — it [is] falsehood and pointlessness

segments.arabic: الَّذِي يتعالى ويتقدس عَنهُ وَهُوَ ظن أعدائه بِهِ
segments.english: which He [is] far above and too holy for, and it [is] the assumption of His enemies about Him.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْض وَمَا بَينهمَا بَاطِلًا ذَلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذين كفرُوا
segments.english: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what [is] between them in vain; that [is] the assumption of those who disbelieved
segments.sahih_international: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض وَمَا بَينهمَا لاعِبِينَ
segments.english: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what [is] between them playing
segments.sahih_international: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

segments.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَاهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ
segments.english: We did not create them except with the truth

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض وَمَا بَينهمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ السَّاعَة لآتية
segments.english: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what [is] between them except with the truth, and the Hour [is] surely coming
segments.sahih_international: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ بعد ذكر آيَاته فِي أول سُورَة يُونُس
segments.english: And He said, after mentioning His signs at the beginning of Surah Yunus:

segments.arabic: ﴿مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ﴾
segments.english: God did not create that except with the truth
segments.sahih_international: It is He who made the sun a shining light and the moon a derived light and determined for it phases - that you may know the number of years and account [of time]. Allah has not created this except in truth. He details the signs for a people who know

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَيَحْسَبُ الْأِنْسَانُ أَنْ يُتْرَكَ سُدىً﴾
segments.english: Does man think that he [will] be left without purpose?
segments.sahih_international: Does man think that he will be left neglected?

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ﴾
segments.english: Did you then think that We created you in vain, and that you [would] not be returned to Us?
segments.sahih_international: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْأِنْسَ إِلَّا ليعبدون﴾
segments.english: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me
segments.sahih_international: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سبع سموات وَمِنَ الْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ
segments.english: [It is] God who created seven heavens, and of the earth the like of them; the command descends between them
segments.sahih_international: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.

segments.arabic: لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ على كل شَيْء قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاَطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْء علما
segments.english: so that you may know that God [is] over everything capable, and that God has encompassed everything [in] knowledge

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الْكَعْبَةَ الْبَيْتَ الْحَرَامَ قِيَامًا لِلنَّاسِ وَالشَّهْرَ الْحَرَامَ وَالْهَدْيَ وَالْقَلائِدَ
segments.english: God made the Kaaba, the Sacred House, [a] support for the people, and the sacred month, and the sacrificial animals, and the garlands
segments.sahih_international: Allah has made the Ka'bah, the Sacred House, standing for the people and [has sanctified] the sacred months and the sacrificial animals and the garlands [by which they are identified]. That is so you may know that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is in the earth and that Allah is Knowing of all things.

segments.arabic: ذَلِكَ لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَات وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْء عليم
segments.english: That [is] so that you may know that God knows what [is] in the heavens and what [is] in the earth, and that God [is] of everything knowing

segments.arabic: فَثَبت بِمَا ذكر أَن غَايَة الْخلق وَالْأَمر أَن يذكر وَأَن يشْكر
segments.english: So [it is] established by what [was] mentioned that the purpose of creation and the command [is] that He be remembered and that He be thanked.

segments.arabic: يذكر فَلَا ينسى ويشكر فَلَا يكفر
segments.english: [He is] remembered and not forgotten, and thanked and not denied.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ ذَاكر لمن ذكره شَاكر لمن شكره
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, remembers whoever remembers Him, [and is] thankful to whoever thanks Him.

segments.arabic: فَذكره سَبَب لذكره وشكره سَبَب لزيادته من فَضله
segments.english: So remembering Him [is a] cause for His remembering [you], and thanking Him [is a] cause for His increasing of His bounty.

segments.arabic: فالذكر للقلب وَاللِّسَان
segments.english: So remembrance [is] for the heart and the tongue.

segments.arabic: وَالشُّكْر للقلب محبَّة وإنابة وللسان ثناء وَحمد وللجوارح طَاعَة وخدمة
segments.english: And gratitude — for the heart [it is] love and turning [to God], for the tongue [it is] praise and thanks, and for the limbs [it is] obedience and service.

segments.arabic: تكَرر فِي الْقُرْآن جعل الْأَعْمَال الْقَائِمَة بِالْقَلْبِ والجوارح سَبَب الْهِدَايَة والإضلال
segments.english: [It is] repeated in the Quran: making the deeds established in the heart and the limbs [a] cause of guidance and misguidance.

segments.arabic: فَيقوم بِالْقَلْبِ والجوارح أَعمال تَقْتَضِي الْهدى اقْتِضَاء السَّبَب لمسببه والمؤثر لأثره
segments.english: So there stand in the heart and the limbs deeds that require guidance — the requiring of [a] cause for its effect, and [a] producer for its product.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ الضلال
segments.english: And likewise [is] misguidance.

segments.arabic: فأعمال الْبر تثمر الْهدى وَكلما ازْدَادَ مِنْهَا ازْدَادَ هدى
segments.english: So deeds of righteousness bear the fruit of guidance, and whenever [one] increases in them, [one] increases in guidance.

segments.arabic: وأعمال الْفُجُور بالضد
segments.english: And deeds of wickedness [are] the opposite.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ أَن الله سُبْحَانَهُ يحب أَعمال الْبر فيجازي عَلَيْهَا بِالْهدى والفلاح
segments.english: And that [is] because God, glorified [is] He, loves deeds of righteousness, so He rewards for them with guidance and success.

segments.arabic: وَيبغض أَعمال الْفُجُور ويجازي عَلَيْهَا بالضلال والشقاء
segments.english: And He hates deeds of wickedness and rewards for them with misguidance and misery.

segments.arabic: وَأَيْضًا فَإِنَّهُ الْبر وَيُحب أهل الْبر فَيقرب قُلُوبهم مِنْهُ بِحَسب مَا قَامُوا بِهِ من الْبر
segments.english: And also, He [loves] righteousness and loves the people of righteousness, so He draws their hearts close to Him according to what they did of righteousness.

segments.arabic: وَيبغض الْفُجُور وَأَهله فيبعد قُلُوبهم مِنْهُ بِحَسب مَا اتصفوا بِهِ من الْفُجُور
segments.english: And He hates wickedness and its people, so He distances their hearts from Him according to what they characterized themselves with of wickedness.

segments.arabic: فَمن الأَصْل الأول قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: So from the first principle [is] [God] Most High's saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿الم﴾
segments.english: Alif Lam Mim.

segments.arabic: ﴿ذَلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ هدى لِلْمُتقين﴾
segments.english: That [is] the Book — no doubt in it — [a] guidance for the God-conscious.
segments.sahih_international: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يتَضَمَّن أَمريْن
segments.english: And this contains two matters.

segments.arabic: أَحدهمَا أَنه يهدي بِهِ من اتَّقى مَا خطه قبل نزُول الْكتاب
segments.english: The first [is] that He guides by it whoever was God-conscious of what He prescribed before the revelation of the Book.

segments.arabic: فَإِن النَّاس على اخْتِلَاف مللهم ونحلهم قد اسْتَقر عِنْدهم
segments.english: For indeed people, despite the differences of their religions and creeds, it [has] become established among them

segments.arabic: أَن الله سُبْحَانَهُ يكره الظُّلم وَالْفَوَاحِش وَالْفساد فِي الأَرْض ويمقت فَاعل ذَلِك
segments.english: that God — glorified [is] He — hates injustice, shameful deeds, and corruption in the earth, and despises the doer of that.

segments.arabic: وَيُحب الْعدْل وَالْإِحْسَان والجود والصدق والإصلاح فِي الأَرْض وَيُحب فَاعل ذَلِك
segments.english: And He loves justice, goodness, generosity, truthfulness, and reform in the earth, and He loves the doer of that.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا نزل الْكتاب أثاب سُبْحَانَهُ أهل الْبر بِأَن وفقهم للْإيمَان بِهِ جَزَاء لَهُم على برهم وطاعتهم
segments.english: So when the Book was revealed, He — glorified [is] He — rewarded the people of righteousness by granting them success in faith in it, [as] a reward for them for their righteousness and obedience.

segments.arabic: وخذل أهل الْفُجُور وَالْفُحْش وَالظُّلم بِأَن حَال بَينهم وَبَين الاهتداء بِهِ
segments.english: And He abandoned the people of wickedness, obscenity, and injustice by coming between them and [being] guided by it.

segments.arabic: وَالْأَمر الثَّانِي أَن العَبْد إِذا آمن بِالْكتاب واهتدى بِهِ مُجملا
segments.english: And the second matter [is] that the servant, when he believes in the Book and [is] guided by it in general,

segments.arabic: وَقبل أوامره وَصدق بأخباره كَانَ ذَلِك سَببا لهداية أُخْرَى تحصل لَهُ على التَّفْصِيل
segments.english: and accepts its commands and believes its reports, that [was] a cause for another guidance that comes to him in detail.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْهِدَايَة لَا نِهَايَة لَهَا
segments.english: For indeed guidance has no end.

segments.arabic: وَلَو بلغ العَبْد فِيهَا مَا بلغ ففوق هدايته هِدَايَة أُخْرَى وَفَوق تِلْكَ الْهِدَايَة هِدَايَة أُخْرَى إِلَى غير غَايَة
segments.english: And even if the servant reaches whatever [level] he reaches in it, above his guidance [is] another guidance, and above that guidance [is] another guidance, without limit.

segments.arabic: فَكلما اتَّقى العَبْد ربه ارْتقى إِلَى هِدَايَة أُخْرَى
segments.english: So whenever the servant [is] God-conscious of his Lord, he rises to another guidance.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ فِي مزِيد هِدَايَة مَا دَامَ فِي مزِيد من التَّقْوَى
segments.english: So he [is] in increasing guidance as long as he [is] in increasing God-consciousness.

segments.arabic: وَكلما فوّت خطا من التَّقْوَى فَاتَهُ حَظّ من الْهِدَايَة بِحَسبِهِ
segments.english: And whenever he misses [a] step of God-consciousness, he misses [a] share of guidance in proportion to it.

segments.arabic: فَكلما اتَّقى زَاد هداه وَكلما اهْتَدَى زَادَت تقواه
segments.english: So whenever he [is] God-conscious, his guidance increases, and whenever he [is] guided, his God-consciousness increases.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ نُورٌ وَكِتَابٌ مُبِينٌ﴾
segments.english: There has come to you from God [a] light and [a] clear Book.
segments.sahih_international: O People of the Scripture, there has come to you Our Messenger making clear to you much of what you used to conceal of the Scripture and overlooking much. There has come to you from Allah a light and a clear Book.

segments.arabic: ﴿يَهْدِي بِهِ اللَّهُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ رِضْوَانَهُ سُبُلَ السَّلامِ﴾
segments.english: God guides by it whoever follows His pleasure [to] the paths of peace.
segments.sahih_international: By which Allah guides those who pursue His pleasure to the ways of peace and brings them out from darknesses into the light, by His permission, and guides them to a straight path.

segments.arabic: ﴿وَيُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾
segments.english: And He brings them out from the darknesses into the light by His permission, and He guides them to [a] straight path.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿اللَّهُ يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يُنِيبُ﴾
segments.english: God chooses to Himself whom He wills, and He guides to Himself whoever turns [back to Him].
segments.sahih_international: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allah is that to which you invite them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَنْ يَخْشَى﴾
segments.english: [He] who fears [will] remember.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُنِيبُ﴾
segments.english: And none remembers except [he] who turns [back to God].
segments.sahih_international: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ يَهْدِيهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِإِيمَانِهِمْ﴾
segments.english: Indeed those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord guides them by their faith.
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - their Lord will guide them because of their faith. Beneath them rivers will flow in the Gardens of Pleasure

segments.arabic: فهداهم أَولا للْإيمَان فَلَمَّا آمنُوا هدَاهُم بالْإيمَان هِدَايَة بعد هِدَايَة
segments.english: So He guided them first to faith, and when they believed, He guided them through [their] faith — guidance after guidance.

segments.arabic: وَنَظِير هَذَا قَوْله
segments.english: And similar to this [is] His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَيَزِيدُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اهتدوا هدى﴾
segments.english: And God increases those who [were] guided in guidance.
segments.sahih_international: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High's saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنْ تَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ فُرْقَانًا﴾
segments.english: O you who believed, if you are God-conscious of God, He [will] make for you [a] criterion.
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, if you fear Allah, He will grant you a criterion and will remove from you your misdeeds and forgive you. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty.

segments.arabic: وَمن الْفرْقَان مَا يعطيهم من النُّور الَّذِي يفرقون بِهِ بَين الْحق وَالْبَاطِل
segments.english: And from the criterion [is] what He gives them of the light by which they distinguish between the truth and falsehood.

segments.arabic: والنصر والعز الَّذِي يتمكنون بِهِ من إِقَامَة الْحق وَكسر الْبَاطِل
segments.english: And the victory and honor by which they [are] able to establish the truth and break falsehood.

segments.arabic: فسر الْفرْقَان بِهَذَا وَبِهَذَا
segments.english: The criterion [has been] explained by this and by this.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآيَةً لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُنِيبٍ﴾
segments.english: Indeed in that [is] surely [a] sign for every servant who turns [back to God].
segments.sahih_international: Then, do they not look at what is before them and what is behind them of the heaven and earth? If We should will, We could cause the earth to swallow them or [could] let fall upon them fragments from the sky. Indeed in that is a sign for every servant turning back [to Allah].

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

headings.arabic: فصل وأما الأصل الثاني وهو اقتضاء الفجور والكبر والكذب للضلال فكثير
headings.english: Section: As for the second principle — which [is] that wickedness, arrogance, and lying lead to misguidance — [it is] plentiful

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآياتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شكور﴾
segments.english: Indeed, in that [are] surely signs for every patient, grateful [person].
segments.sahih_international: And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs, [saying], "Bring out your people from darknesses into the light and remind them of the days of Allah." Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

segments.arabic: فِي سُورَة لُقْمَان وَسورَة إِبْرَاهِيم وسبأ والشورى
segments.english: [This is] in Surah Luqman, Surah Ibrahim, Saba, and Ash-Shura.

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر عَن آيَاته المشهودة العيانية أَنَّهَا إِنَّمَا ينْتَفع بهَا أهل الصَّبْر وَالشُّكْر
segments.english: So He informed about His witnessed, visible signs — that only the people of patience and gratitude benefit from them.

segments.arabic: كَمَا أخبر عَن آيَاته الإيمانية القرآنية أَنَّهَا إِنَّمَا ينْتَفع بهَا أهل التَّقْوَى والخشية والإنابة
segments.english: Just as He informed about His faith-related, Quranic signs — that only the people of God-consciousness, fear, and turning [to God] benefit from them.

segments.arabic: وَمن كَانَ قَصده اتّباع رضوانه
segments.english: And whoever whose aim [was] to follow His pleasure.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهَا يتَذَكَّر بهَا من يخشاه سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: And that only those who fear Him — glorified [is] He — take reminder from them.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ طه أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ لِتَشْقَى إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لمن يخْشَى
segments.english: As He said: 'Taha. We [did] not send down upon you the Quran for you to suffer — only [as a] reminder for whoever fears.'

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ فِي الساعة
segments.english: And He said regarding the Hour:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُنْذِرُ من يخشاها﴾
segments.english: You [are] only [a] warner [for] whoever fears it.
segments.sahih_international: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

segments.arabic: وَأما من لَا يُؤمن بهَا وَلَا يرجوها وَلَا يخشاها
segments.english: And as for whoever does not believe in it, nor hope for it, nor fear it —

segments.arabic: فَلَا تَنْفَعهُ الْآيَات العيانية وَلَا القرآنية
segments.english: the visible signs do not benefit him, nor [do] the Quranic [ones].

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا لما ذكر سُبْحَانَهُ فِي سُورَة هود عقوبات الْأُمَم المكذبين للرسل
segments.english: And for this [reason], when He — glorified [is] He — mentioned in Surah Hud the punishments of the nations who denied the messengers,

segments.arabic: وَمَا حل بهم فِي الدُّنْيَا من الخزي
segments.english: and what came upon them in this world of disgrace,

segments.arabic: قَالَ بعد ذَلِك
segments.english: He said after that:

segments.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآيَةً لِمَنْ خَافَ عَذَاب الْآخِرَة﴾
segments.english: Indeed, in that [is] surely [a] sign for whoever fears the punishment of the Hereafter.
segments.sahih_international: Indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which the people will be collected, and that is a Day [which will be] witnessed.

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر أَن عقوباته للمكذبين عِبْرَة لمن خَافَ عَذَاب الْآخِرَة
segments.english: So He informed that His punishments of the deniers [are a] lesson for whoever fears the punishment of the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَأما من لَا يُؤمن بهَا وَلَا يخَاف عَذَابهَا
segments.english: And as for whoever does not believe in it and does not fear its punishment,

segments.arabic: فَلَا يكون ذَلِك عِبْرَة وَآيَة فِي حَقه
segments.english: then that [is] not [a] lesson or [a] sign for him.

segments.arabic: اذا سمع ذَلِك قَالَ لم يزل فِي الدَّهْر الْخَيْر وَالشَّر وَالنَّعِيم والبؤس والسعادة والشقاوة
segments.english: When he hears that, he says: 'There has always been in [the course of] time good and evil, comfort and misery, happiness and wretchedness.'

segments.arabic: وَرُبمَا أحَال ذَلِك على أَسبَاب فلكية وقوى نفسانية
segments.english: And perhaps he attributes that to celestial causes and psychological forces.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا كَانَ الصَّبْر وَالشُّكْر سَببا لانتفاع صَاحبهمَا بِالْآيَاتِ
segments.english: Patience and gratitude were only [a] cause for their possessor to benefit from the signs,

segments.arabic: يَنْبَنِي على الصَّبْر وَالشُّكْر فنصفه صَبر وَنصفه شكر
segments.english: [because faith] is built upon patience and gratitude — so half of it [is] patience and half of it [is] gratitude.

segments.arabic: فعلى حسب صَبر العَبْد وشكره تكون قُوَّة إيمَانه
segments.english: So according to the servant's patience and gratitude [is] the strength of his faith.

segments.arabic: وآيات الله إِنَّمَا ينْتَفع بهَا من آمن بِاللَّه
segments.english: And the signs of God — only those who believe in God benefit from them.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يتم لَهُ الْإِيمَان إِلَّا بِالصبرِ وَالشُّكْر
segments.english: And faith [is] not complete for him except with patience and gratitude.

segments.arabic: فَإِن رَأس الشُّكْر التَّوْحِيد
segments.english: For the head of gratitude [is] monotheism,

segments.arabic: وَرَأس الصَّبْر ترك إِجَابَة دَاعِي الْهوى
segments.english: and the head of patience [is] abandoning the call of desire.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَ مُشْركًا مُتبعا هَوَاهُ لم يكن صَابِرًا وَلَا شكُورًا
segments.english: So if he was one associating partners [with God], following his desire, he [would] not be patient nor grateful.

segments.arabic: فَلَا تكون الْآيَات نافعة لَهُ وَلَا مُؤثرَة فِيهِ إِيمَانًا
segments.english: So the signs [would] not be beneficial for him, nor [would they] produce faith in him.

segments.arabic: أَيْضا فِي الْقُرْآن كَقَوْلِه تَعَالَى
segments.english: also in the Quran, like the saying of [God] Most High:

segments.arabic: ﴿يُضِلُّ بِهِ كَثِيرًا وَيَهْدِي بِهِ كَثِيرًا وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِ إِلاَّ﴾
segments.english: He misguides by it many, and He guides by it many, and He does not misguide by it except...
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, Allah is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allah intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,

segments.arabic: ﴿الْفَاسِقين الَّذين ينقضون عَهْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مِيثَاقِهِ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَنْ يُوصَلَ
segments.english: the defiantly disobedient — those who break the covenant of God after its confirmation, and cut off what God commanded to be joined,
segments.sahih_international: Who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers.

segments.arabic: وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ أُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ﴾
segments.english: and spread corruption in the earth — those [are] the losers.﴾

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ
segments.english: God makes firm those who believed with the firm word in the life of this world and in the Hereafter,
segments.sahih_international: Allah keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter. And Allah sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allah does what He wills.

segments.arabic: وَيُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الظَّالِمِينَ وَيَفْعَلُ اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاء﴾
segments.english: and God leads astray the wrongdoers, and God does what He wills.﴾

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: فَمَا لَكُمْ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ وَاللَّهُ أَرْكَسَهُمْ بِمَا كسبوا
segments.english: So what [is wrong] with you regarding the hypocrites, [that you are] two groups, when God [has] thrown them back because of what they earned?
segments.sahih_international: What is [the matter] with you [that you are] two groups concerning the hypocrites, while Allah has made them fall back [into error and disbelief] for what they earned. Do you wish to guide those whom Allah has sent astray? And he whom Allah sends astray - never will you find for him a way [of guidance].

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَقَالُوا قُلُوبنَا غلف بل لعنهم الله بكفرهم فقليلا مَا يُؤمنُونَ﴾
segments.english: And they said: "Our hearts [are] wrapped." Rather, God cursed them for their disbelief, so little [is what] they believe.﴾
segments.sahih_international: And they said, "Our hearts are wrapped." But, [in fact], Allah has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفْئِدَتَهُمْ وَأَبْصَارَهُمْ كَمَا لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ أول مرّة﴾
segments.english: And We turn their hearts and their eyes, just as they did not believe in it the first time.﴾
segments.sahih_international: And We will turn away their hearts and their eyes just as they refused to believe in it the first time. And We will leave them in their transgression, wandering blindly.

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر أَنه عاقبهم على تخلفهم عَن الْإِيمَان لما جَاءَهُم وعرفوه وأعرضوا عَنهُ
segments.english: So He informed that He punished them for their falling behind from faith when it came to them and they recognized it and turned away from it,

segments.arabic: بِأَن قلب أفئدتهم وأبصارهم وَحَال بَينهم وَبَين الْإِيمَان
segments.english: by turning their hearts and their eyes and [placing a] barrier between them and faith.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: As [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ
segments.english: O you who believed, respond to God and to the Messenger when he calls you to what gives you life,
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered.

segments.arabic: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ
segments.english: and know that God comes between [a] person and his heart.

segments.arabic: فَأَمرهمْ بالاستجابة لَهُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ حِين يَدعُوهُم إِلَى مَا فِيهِ حياتهم
segments.english: So He commanded them to respond to Him and to His Messenger when he calls them to what contains their life.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ حذّرهم من التَّخَلُّف والتأخر عَن الاستجابة
segments.english: Then He warned them against falling behind and delaying [in] responding,

segments.arabic: الَّذِي يكون سَببا لِأَن يحول بَينهم وَبَين قُلُوبهم
segments.english: which becomes [a] cause for Him [to] come between them and their hearts.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿فَلَمَّا زَاغُوا أَزَاغَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقين﴾
segments.english: So when they deviated, God caused their hearts to deviate, and God does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.﴾
segments.sahih_international: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allah to you?" And when they deviated, Allah caused their hearts to deviate. And Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿كَلَّا بَلْ رَانَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ﴾
segments.english: No indeed! Rather, what they used to earn [has] covered over their hearts.﴾
segments.sahih_international: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَن كسبهم غطى على قُلُوبهم وَحَال بَينهَا وَبَين الْإِيمَان بآياته
segments.english: So He — glorified [is] He — informed that their earning covered over their hearts and [placed a] barrier between them and faith in His signs.

segments.arabic: فَقَالُوا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
segments.english: So they said: "[These are] tales of the earlier [people]."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى فِي الْمُنَافِقين
segments.english: And [God] Most High said regarding the hypocrites:

segments.arabic: ﴿نَسُوا اللَّهَ فنسيهم﴾
segments.english: They forgot God, so He forgot them.﴾

segments.arabic: فجازاهم على نسيانهم لَهُ أَن نسيهم فَلم يذكرهم بِالْهدى وَالرَّحْمَة
segments.english: So He repaid them for their forgetting Him by forgetting them, and He did not remember them with guidance and mercy.

segments.arabic: وَأخْبر أَنه أنساهم أنفسهم فَلم يطلبوا كمالها بِالْعلمِ النافع وَالْعَمَل الصَّالح
segments.english: And He informed that He made them forget themselves, so they did not seek their perfection through beneficial knowledge and righteous deeds,

segments.arabic: وهما الْهدى وَدين الْحق
segments.english: and those two [are] guidance and the religion of truth.

segments.arabic: فأنساهم طلب ذَلِك ومحبته ومعرفته والحرص عَلَيْهِ عُقُوبَة لنسيانهم لَهُ
segments.english: So He made them forget seeking that, and loving it, and knowing it, and being eager for it — [as a] punishment for their forgetting Him.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى فِي حقّهم
segments.english: And [God] Most High said regarding them:

segments.arabic: ﴿أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ
segments.english: Those [are] the ones [whom] God sealed upon their hearts, and they followed their desires.
segments.sahih_international: And among them, [O Muhammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allah has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا زَادَهُمْ هُدىً وآتاهم تقواهم﴾
segments.english: And those who [were] guided — He increased them [in] guidance and gave them their God-consciousness.﴾
segments.sahih_international: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.

segments.arabic: فَجمع لَهُم بَين اتّباع الْهوى والضلال الَّذِي هُوَ ثَمَرَته وموجبه
segments.english: So He combined for them between following desire and misguidance, which [is] its fruit and its result,

segments.arabic: كَمَا جمع للمهتدين بَين التَّقْوَى وَالْهدى
segments.english: just as He combined for the guided ones between God-consciousness and guidance.

headings.arabic: فصل وكما يقرن سبحانه بين الهدى والتقى والضلال والغي فكذلك يقرن بين
headings.english: Chapter: As He, glorified [is] He, pairs guidance with God-consciousness and misguidance with deviance, so too He pairs between

segments.arabic: وكما يقرن سبحانه بين الهدى والتقى والضلال والغي فكذلك يقرن بين الهدى والرحمة والضلال والشقاء
segments.english: And just as He, glorified [is] He, pairs between guidance and God-consciousness, and misguidance and deviance, so too He pairs between guidance and mercy, and misguidance and misery.

segments.arabic: فمن الأول قوله
segments.english: From the first [is] His saying:

segments.arabic: أُولَئِكَ عَلَى هُدىً مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
segments.english: Those [are] upon guidance from their Lord, and those — they [are] the successful ones.
segments.sahih_international: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

segments.arabic: وقال
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: أُولَئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُونَ
segments.english: Those — upon them [are] blessings from their Lord and mercy, and those — they [are] the guided ones.
segments.sahih_international: Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy. And it is those who are the [rightly] guided.

segments.arabic: وقال عن المؤمنين
segments.english: And He said about the believers:

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
segments.english: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You [have] guided us, and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed You — You [are] the Giver.
segments.sahih_international: [Who say], "Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

segments.arabic: وقال أهل الكهف
segments.english: And the People of the Cave said:

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
segments.english: Our Lord, give us from Yourself mercy, and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
segments.sahih_international: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."

segments.arabic: وقال
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
segments.english: There certainly was in their stories [a] lesson for people of understanding.
segments.sahih_international: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was the Qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

segments.arabic: مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًا يُفْتَرَى وَلَكِنْ تَصْدِيقَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
segments.english: It was not [a] narration [to be] invented, but [a] confirmation of what [was] before it, and [a] detailed explanation of everything, and guidance and mercy for [a] people who believe.

segments.arabic: وقال
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: مَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
segments.english: We [have] not sent down upon you the Book except [for you] to make clear to them that which they differed about, and [as] guidance and mercy for [a] people who believe.
segments.sahih_international: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

segments.arabic: وقال
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ تِبْيَانًا لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةً وَبُشْرَى لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ
segments.english: We sent down upon you the Book [as] [a] clarification of everything, and guidance and mercy and glad tidings for the Muslims.
segments.sahih_international: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.

segments.arabic: وقال
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَشِفَاءٌ لِمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.english: O people, there has come to you [a] teaching from your Lord, and [a] healing for what [is] in the chests, and guidance and mercy for the believers.
segments.sahih_international: O mankind, there has to come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers.

segments.arabic: ثم أعاد سبحانه ذكرهما فقال
segments.english: Then He, glorified [is] He, mentioned them again and said:

segments.arabic: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذَلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا
segments.english: Say: in the bounty of God and in His mercy — in that let them rejoice.
segments.sahih_international: Say, "In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate."

segments.arabic: وقد تنوعت عبارات السلف في تفسير الفضل والرحمة
segments.english: And the expressions of the early scholars varied in [their] explanation of "the bounty" and "the mercy."

segments.arabic: والصحيح أنهما الهدى والنعمة ففضله هداه ورحمته نعمته
segments.english: And the correct [view] [is] that they [are] guidance and blessing. So His bounty [is] His guidance, and His mercy [is] His blessing.

segments.arabic: ولذلك يقرن بين الهدى والنعمة كقوله في سورة الفاتحة
segments.english: And for that [reason] He pairs between guidance and blessing, as in His saying in Surat al-Fatihah:

segments.arabic: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
segments.english: Guide us [to] the straight path,

segments.arabic: صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ
segments.english: the path of those You [have] blessed.

segments.arabic: ومن ذلك قوله لنبيه يذكره بنعمه عليه
segments.english: And from that [is] His saying to His Prophet, reminding him of His blessings upon him:

segments.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَآوَى
segments.english: Did He not find you [an] orphan and [then] sheltered [you]?

segments.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَى
segments.english: And found you lost, and [then] guided [you]?

segments.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَائِلًا فَأَغْنَى
segments.english: And found you poor, and [then] enriched [you]?

segments.arabic: فجمع له بين هدايته له وإنعامه عليه بإيوائه وإغنائه
segments.english: So He combined for him between His guidance to him and His blessing upon him — through sheltering him and enriching him.

segments.arabic: ومن ذلك قول نوح
segments.english: And from that [is] the saying of Noah:

segments.arabic: يَا قَوْمِ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَآتَانِي رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِهِ
segments.english: O my people, have you considered — if I [was] upon clear proof from my Lord, and He gave me mercy from Himself?
segments.sahih_international: He said, "O my people have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord while He has given me mercy from Himself but it has been made unapparent to you, should we force it upon you while you are averse to it?

segments.arabic: وقول شعيب
segments.english: And the saying of Shu'ayb:

segments.arabic: أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا
segments.english: Have you considered — if I [was] upon clear proof from my Lord, and He provided me from Himself [a] good provision?
segments.sahih_international: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...? And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allah. Upon him I have relied, and to Him I return.

segments.arabic: وقال عن الخضر
segments.english: And He said about al-Khidr:

segments.arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا آتَيْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ مِنْ لَدُنَّا عِلْمًا
segments.english: So they found [a] servant from Our servants — We gave him mercy from Us, and We taught him from Us knowledge.
segments.sahih_international: And they found a servant from among Our servants to whom we had given mercy from us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge.

segments.arabic: وقال لرسوله
segments.english: And He said to His Messenger:

segments.arabic: إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا
segments.english: Indeed We [have] opened for you [a] clear opening,
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muhammad], a clear conquest

segments.arabic: لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ
segments.english: so that God may forgive you what came before of your sin and what came after,
segments.sahih_international: That Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path

segments.arabic: وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا وَيَنْصُرَكَ
segments.english: and complete His blessing upon you, and guide you [to] [a] straight path, and help you.

headings.arabic: فصل والهدى والرحمة وتوابعها من الفضل والإنعام كله من صفة العطاء
headings.english: Chapter: Guidance, mercy, and what follows them of favor and blessing — all [is] from the quality of giving

segments.arabic: اللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا
segments.english: ...God [with] a mighty victory

segments.arabic: ﴿وَقَالَ﴾
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَعَلَّمَكَ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ تَعْلَمُ
segments.english: And God sent down upon you the Book and the Wisdom, and taught you what you did not know
segments.sahih_international: And if it was not for the favor of Allah upon you, [O Muhammad], and His mercy, a group of them would have determined to mislead you. But they do not mislead except themselves, and they will not harm you at all. And Allah has revealed to you the Book and wisdom and has taught you that which you did not know. And ever has the favor of Allah upon you been great.

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ عَظِيمًا
segments.english: and the favor of God upon you was great

segments.arabic: ﴿وَقَالَ﴾
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: وَلَوْلا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ مَا زَكَى مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ أَبَدًا
segments.english: And were it not for the favor of God upon you and His mercy, none among you would have been purified, ever
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allah purifies whom He wills, and Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

segments.arabic: ففضله هدايته وَرَحمته وإنعامه وإحسانه إِلَيْهِم وبره بهم
segments.english: So His favor [is] His guidance, His mercy, His blessing, His kindness to them, and His goodness toward them

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ مِنِّي هُدًى فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلا يَضِلُّ وَلا يَشْقَى
segments.english: If there comes to you guidance from Me, then whoever follows My guidance will not go astray and will not suffer
segments.sahih_international: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].

segments.arabic: وَالْهدى مَنعه من الضلال وَالرَّحْمَة مَنعه من الشَّقَاء
segments.english: And the guidance [is] his protection from misguidance, and the mercy [is] his protection from suffering

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا هُوَ الَّذِي ذكره فِي أوّل السُّورَة فِي قَوْله
segments.english: And this [is] what He mentioned at the beginning of the surah in His saying:

segments.arabic: طه
segments.english: Ta Ha

segments.arabic: مَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ لِتَشْقَى
segments.english: We did not send down the Quran upon you for you to suffer
segments.sahih_international: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed

segments.arabic: فَجمع لَهُ بَين إِنْزَال الْقُرْآن عَلَيْهِ وَنفى الشَّقَاء عَنهُ
segments.english: So He combined for him the sending down of the Quran upon him and the removal of suffering from him

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ فِي آخرهَا فِي حق أَتْبَاعه
segments.english: just as He said at its end regarding his followers:

segments.arabic: فَلا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَى
segments.english: he will not go astray and will not suffer

segments.arabic: فالهدى وَالْفضل وَالنعْمَة والرحمة متلازمات لَا يَنْفَكّ بَعْضهَا عَن بعض
segments.english: So guidance, favor, blessing, and mercy [are] inseparable — none of them [is] separated from the others

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن الضلال والشقاء متلازمان لَا يَنْفَكّ أَحدهمَا عَن الآخر
segments.english: just as misguidance and suffering [are] inseparable — one of them [is] not separated from the other

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي ضَلالٍ وَسُعُرٍ
segments.english: Indeed the criminals [are] in misguidance and blazing fire
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.

segments.arabic: والسعر جمع سعير وَهُوَ الْعَذَاب الَّذِي هُوَ غَايَة الشَّقَاء
segments.english: And 'the fires' [is the] plural of 'fire,' and it [is] the punishment which [is] the height of suffering

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ذَرَأْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْأِنْسِ
segments.english: And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind
segments.sahih_international: And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. They have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear. Those are like livestock; rather, they are more astray. It is they who are the heedless.

segments.arabic: لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ آذَانٌ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا
segments.english: They have hearts [with which] they do not understand, and they have eyes [with which] they do not see, and they have ears [with which] they do not hear

segments.arabic: أُولَئِكَ كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ أُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْغَافِلُونَ
segments.english: Those [are] like cattle — rather, they [are] more astray. Those — they [are] the heedless ones

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى عَنْهُم
segments.english: And [God] Most High said about them:

segments.arabic: وَقَالُوا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِي أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ
segments.english: And they said: 'Had we listened or reasoned, we would not have been among the companions of the Blaze'
segments.sahih_international: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

segments.arabic: وَمن هَذَا أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ يجمع بَين الْهدى وانشراح الصَّدْر والحياة الطيّبة
segments.english: And from this [is] that He, glorified [is] He, combines between guidance, the expansion of the chest, and the good life

segments.arabic: وَبَين الضلال وضيق الصَّدْر والمعيشة الضنك
segments.english: and between misguidance, the tightness of the chest, and the hard livelihood

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: فَمَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَهْدِيَهُ يَشْرَحْ صَدْرَهُ لِلإِسْلامِ
segments.english: So whoever God wills to guide, He expands his chest for Islam
segments.sahih_international: So whoever Allah wants to guide - He expands his breast to [contain] Islam; and whoever He wants to misguide - He makes his breast tight and constricted as though he were climbing into the sky. Thus does Allah place defilement upon those who do not believe.

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ يُرِدْ أَنْ يُضِلَّهُ يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُ ضَيِّقًا حَرَجًا
segments.english: and whoever He wills to misguide, He makes his chest tight and constricted

segments.arabic: ﴿وَقَالَ﴾
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: أَفَمَنْ شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلامِ فَهُوَ عَلَى نُورٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ
segments.english: Is then one whose chest God has expanded for Islam, and he [is] upon a light from his Lord...
segments.sahih_international: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ يجمع بَين الْهدى والإنابة وَبَين الضلال وقسوة الْقلب
segments.english: And likewise, He combines between guidance and turning back [to God], and between misguidance and hardness of the heart

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: اللَّهُ يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يُنِيبُ
segments.english: God chooses for Himself whom He wills, and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him]
segments.sahih_international: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein.
