Difficult for those who associate others with Allah is that to which you invite them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ أُولَئِكَ فِي ضَلالٍ مُبِينٍ
segments.english: So woe to those whose hearts [are] hardened against the remembrance of God — those [are] in clear misguidance

segments.arabic: والإضلال
segments.english: And misguidance...

headings.arabic: فصل إياك والكذب فإنه يفسد عليك تصور المعلومات على ما هي عليه ويفسد
headings.english: Chapter: Beware of lying, for it corrupts for you the understanding of things as they are, and it corrupts

segments.arabic: وَالْعَذَاب وتوابعها من صفة الْمَنْع
segments.english: and punishment and its consequences [are] from the attribute of withholding.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يصرف خلقه بَين عطائه وَمنعه
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, directs His creation between His giving and His withholding.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ كُله صادر عَن حِكْمَة بَالِغَة وَملك تَامّ وَحمد تَامّ
segments.english: And all of that [is] coming from [a] far-reaching wisdom, [a] complete sovereignty, and [a] complete praise.

segments.arabic: فَلَا إِلَه إِلَّا الله
segments.english: So there [is] no god but God.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Chapter

segments.arabic: إِذا رَأَيْت النُّفُوس المبطلة الفارغة من الْإِرَادَة والطلب لهَذَا الشَّأْن
segments.english: When you see the false souls, empty of will and seeking for this matter,

segments.arabic: قد تشبثت بهَا هَذَا الْعَالم السفلي وَقد تشبثت بِهِ
segments.english: [and] this lower world has clung to them and they have clung to it,

segments.arabic: فَكلهَا إِلَيْهِ فَإِنَّهُ اللَّائِق بهَا لفساد تركيبها
segments.english: then entrust them to it, for it [is] what suits them due to the corruption of their makeup.

segments.arabic: وَلَا تنقش عَلَيْهَا ذَلِك فَإِنَّهُ سريع الانحلال عَنْهَا
segments.english: And do not engrave that upon them, for it [is] quick to dissolve from them.

segments.arabic: وَيبقى تشبثها بِهِ مَعَ انْقِطَاعه عَنْهَا عذَابا عَلَيْهَا بِحَسب ذَلِك التعلّق
segments.english: And their clinging to it remains — along with it being cut off from them — [as a] punishment upon them according to that attachment.

segments.arabic: فَتبقى شهوتها وإرادتها فِيهَا وَقد حيل بَينهَا وَبَين مَا تشْتَهي
segments.english: So their desire and want remains in them, while [a] barrier [has been] placed between them and what they crave,

segments.arabic: على وَجه يئست مَعَه من حُصُول شهوتها ولذتها
segments.english: in [a] way [that] they despair with it of ever obtaining their desire and pleasure.

segments.arabic: فَلَو تصوّر الْعَاقِل مَا فِي ذَلِك من الْأَلَم وَالْحَسْرَة
segments.english: So if the wise person [were to] imagine what [is] in that of pain and regret,

segments.arabic: لبادر إِلَى قطع هَذَا التَّعَلُّق كَمَا يُبَادر إِلَى حسم مواد الْفساد
segments.english: he [would] rush to cut off this attachment, just as he rushes to remove the sources of corruption.

segments.arabic: وَمَعَ هَذَا فَإِنَّهُ ينَال نصِيبه من ذَلِك
segments.english: And despite this, he [still] obtains his share of that,

segments.arabic: وَقَلبه وهمه مُتَعَلق بالمطلب الْأَعْلَى
segments.english: while his heart and concern [are] attached to the highest goal.

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: And God [is] the One whose help [is] sought.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Chapter

segments.arabic: إياك وَالْكذب فَإِنَّهُ يفْسد عَلَيْك تصور المعلومات على مَا هِيَ عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: Beware of lying, for it corrupts for you the understanding of things as they [truly] are.

segments.arabic: وَيفْسد عَلَيْك تصورها وَتَعْلِيمهَا للنَّاس
segments.english: And it corrupts for you [your] understanding of them and [your] teaching them to people.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْكَاذِب يصور الْمَعْدُوم مَوْجُودا وَالْمَوْجُود مَعْدُوما
segments.english: For the liar pictures the non-existent [as] existing and the existing [as] non-existent,

segments.arabic: وَالْحق بَاطِلا وَالْبَاطِل حَقًا وَالْخَيْر شرا وَالشَّر خيرا
segments.english: and the truth [as] falsehood and falsehood [as] truth, and good [as] evil and evil [as] good.

segments.arabic: فَيفْسد عَلَيْهِ تصَوره وَعلمه عُقُوبَة لَهُ
segments.english: So it corrupts for him his understanding and his knowledge, [as a] punishment for him.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ يصور ذَلِك فِي نفس الْمُخَاطب المغتر بِهِ الراكن إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: Then he pictures that in the self of the one addressed — the one deceived by him, leaning on him —

segments.arabic: فَيفْسد عَلَيْهِ تصَوره وَعلمه
segments.english: so it corrupts for him his understanding and his knowledge.

segments.arabic: وَنَفس الْكَاذِب معرضة عَن الْحَقِيقَة الْمَوْجُودَة نزاعة إِلَى الْعَدَم مُؤثرَة للباطل
segments.english: And the self of the liar [is] turned away from the existing reality, drawn toward nothingness, preferring falsehood.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا فَسدتْ عَلَيْهِ قُوَّة تصَوره وَعلمه الَّتِي هِيَ مبدأ كل فعل إرادي
segments.english: And when the power of his understanding and knowledge — which [is] the starting point of every intentional action — becomes corrupted for him,

segments.arabic: فَسدتْ عَلَيْهِ تِلْكَ الْأَفْعَال وسرى حكم الْكَذِب إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: those actions become corrupted for him, and the rule of lying spreads to them.

segments.arabic: فَصَارَ صدورها عَنهُ كصدور الْكَذِب عَن اللِّسَان
segments.english: So their coming from him becomes like the coming of lies from the tongue.

segments.arabic: فَلَا ينْتَفع بِلِسَانِهِ وَلَا بِأَعْمَالِهِ
segments.english: So he does not benefit from his tongue nor from his actions.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كَانَ الْكَذِب أساس الْفُجُور
segments.english: And for this [reason], lying [has always] been the foundation of wickedness,

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ النَّبِي إِن الْكَذِب يهدي إِلَى الْفُجُور وَإِن الْفُجُور يهدي إِلَى النَّار
segments.english: as the Prophet said: lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire.

segments.arabic: وَأول مَا يسري الْكَذِب من النَّفس إِلَى اللِّسَان فيفسده
segments.english: And the first [thing] lying spreads [to] from the self [is] the tongue, corrupting it.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ يسري إِلَى الْجَوَارِح
segments.english: Then it spreads to the limbs.

headings.arabic: فصل في قوله تعالى
headings.english: Section on the saying of [God] Most High

segments.arabic: فَيفْسد عَلَيْهَا أَعمالهَا كَمَا أفسد على اللِّسَان أَقْوَاله
segments.english: so it corrupts its deeds for it, just as it corrupted the tongue's speech.

segments.arabic: فَيعم الْكَذِب أَقْوَاله وأعماله وأحواله
segments.english: So lying spreads over his speech, his deeds, and his states.

segments.arabic: فيستحكم عَلَيْهِ الْفساد ويترامى داؤه إِلَى الهلكة
segments.english: So corruption takes hold of him and his disease grows until [it reaches] destruction,

segments.arabic: إِن لم تُدْرِكهُ الله بدواء الصدْق يقْلع تِلْكَ من أَصْلهَا
segments.english: unless God reaches him with the cure of truthfulness, uprooting those [diseases] from their root.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كَانَ أصل أَعمال الْقُلُوب كلهَا الصدْق
segments.english: And for this reason, the root of all the deeds of the hearts [is] truthfulness.

segments.arabic: وأضدادها من الرِّيَاء وَالْعجب وَالْكبر وَالْفَخْر وَالْخُيَلَاء والبطر والأشر
segments.english: And their opposites — [such as] showing off, self-admiration, arrogance, boasting, vanity, ingratitude, and conceit,

segments.arabic: وَالْعجز والكسل والجبن والمهانة وَغَيرهَا أَصْلهَا الْكَذِب
segments.english: and helplessness, laziness, cowardice, humiliation, and the like — their root [is] lying.

segments.arabic: فَكل عمل صَالح ظَاهر أَو بَاطِن فمنشؤه الصدْق
segments.english: So every good deed, outward or inward, its origin [is] truthfulness.

segments.arabic: وكل عمل فَاسد ظَاهر أَو بَاطِن فمنشؤه الْكَذِب
segments.english: And every corrupt deed, outward or inward, its origin [is] lying.

segments.arabic: وَالله تَعَالَى يُعَاقب الْكذَّاب بِأَن ويقعده ويثبطه عَن مَصَالِحه ومنافعه
segments.english: And God Most High punishes the liar by making him sit back and holding him back from what benefits him and profits him.

segments.arabic: ويثيب الصَّادِق بِأَن يوفقه للْقِيَام بمصالح دُنْيَاهُ وآخرته
segments.english: And He rewards the truthful one by granting him success in taking care of the interests of his world and his Hereafter.

segments.arabic: فَمَا استجلبت مصَالح الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة بِمثل الصدْق
segments.english: So nothing brings about the good of this world and the Hereafter like truthfulness,

segments.arabic: وَلَا مفاسدها ومضارهما بِمثل الْكَذِب
segments.english: and nothing brings about their corruption and harm like lying.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَكُونُوا مَعَ الصَّادِقين
segments.english: O you who believe, fear God and be with the truthful ones.
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, fear Allah and be with those who are true.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: هَذَا يَوْمُ يَنْفَعُ الصَّادِقين صدقهم
segments.english: This [is] the Day [when] the truthful ones will be benefited by their truthfulness.
segments.sahih_international: Allah will say, "This is the Day when the truthful will benefit from their truthfulness." For them are gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them, and they with Him. That is the great attainment.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And [He] said:

segments.arabic: فَإِذَا عَزَمَ الْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوا اللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُم
segments.english: So when the matter [is] decided, if they had been truthful with God, it would have been better for them.
segments.sahih_international: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And [He] said:

segments.arabic: وَجَاءَ الْمُعَذِّرُونَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ لِيُؤْذَنَ لَهُمْ وَقَعَدَ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ
segments.english: And the excuse-makers from the Bedouins came to be given permission, and those who lied to God and His Messenger sat back.
segments.sahih_international: And those with excuses among the bedouins came to be permitted [to remain], and they who had lied to Allah and His Messenger sat [at home]. There will strike those who disbelieved among them a painful punishment.

segments.arabic: سَيُصِيبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
segments.english: [There] will strike those who disbelieved among them [a] painful punishment.

segments.arabic: وَعَسَى أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَعَسَى أَنْ تُحِبُّوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَكُمْ
segments.english: And perhaps you dislike [a] thing and it [is] good for you, and perhaps you love [a] thing and it [is] bad for you.
segments.sahih_international: Fighting has been enjoined upon you while it is hateful to you. But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allah Knows, while you know not.

segments.arabic: وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
segments.english: And God knows and you do not know.

segments.arabic: فِي هَذِه الْآيَة عدَّة حكم وأسرار ومصالح للْعَبد
segments.english: In this verse [there are] several wisdoms, secrets, and benefits for the servant.

segments.arabic: فَإِن العَبْد إِذا علم أَن الْمَكْرُوه قد يَأْتِي بالمحبوب والمحبوب قد يَأْتِي بالمكروه
segments.english: For the servant, when he knows that what [is] disliked may bring what [is] loved, and what [is] loved may bring what [is] disliked,

segments.arabic: لم يَأْمَن أَن توافيه الْمضرَّة من جَانب المسرّة
segments.english: he [would] not feel safe that harm may come to him from the side of pleasure,

segments.arabic: وَلم ييأس أَن تَأتيه المسرة من جَانب الْمضرَّة
segments.english: and he [would] not lose hope that joy may come to him from the side of harm,

segments.arabic: لعدم علمه بالعواقب فَإِن الله يعلم مِنْهَا مَالا يُعلمهُ العَبْد
segments.english: because of his lack of knowledge of the outcomes, for God knows of them what the servant does not know.

segments.arabic: وَأوجب لَهُ ذَلِك أمورا
segments.english: And this required of him [several] things.

segments.arabic: مِنْهَا أَنه لَا أَنْفَع لَهُ من امْتِثَال الْأَمر وَإِن شقّ عَلَيْهِ فِي الِابْتِدَاء
segments.english: Among them [is] that nothing [is] more beneficial for him than obeying the command, even if it [is] hard on him in the beginning,

segments.arabic: لِأَن عواقبه كلهَا خيرات ومسرات ولذات وأفراح
segments.english: because its outcomes [are] all goodness, joys, pleasures, and happiness.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كرهته نَفسه فَهُوَ خير لَهَا وأنفع
segments.english: And even if his self dislikes it, it [is] better for it and more beneficial.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ لَا شَيْء أضرّ عَلَيْهِ من
segments.english: And likewise, nothing [is] more harmful to him than —

segments.arabic: ارْتِكَاب النَّهْي وَإِن هويته نَفسه ومالت إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: committing the prohibition, even if his self desired it and inclined toward it.

segments.arabic: وَإِن عواقبه كلهَا آلام وأحزان وشرور ومصائب
segments.english: And even though its consequences [are] all pains and sorrows and evils and calamities.

segments.arabic: وخاصة الْعقل تحمل الْأَلَم الْيَسِير لما يعقبه من اللَّذَّة الْعَظِيمَة وَالْخَيْر الْكثير
segments.english: And the trait of the intellect [is] bearing the small pain for what follows it of great pleasure and abundant good,

segments.arabic: وَاجْتنَاب اللَّذَّة الْيَسِيرَة لما يعقبه من الْأَلَم الْعَظِيم وَالشَّر الطَّوِيل
segments.english: and avoiding the small pleasure for what follows it of great pain and long-lasting evil.

segments.arabic: فَنظر الْجَاهِل لَا يُجَاوز المباديء إِلَى غاياتها
segments.english: So the sight of the ignorant [person] does not go beyond the beginnings to their ends,

segments.arabic: والعاقل الكيّس دَائِما ينظر إِلَى الغايات من وَرَاء ستور مبادئها
segments.english: and the wise, sharp [person] always looks to the ends from behind the veils of their beginnings.

segments.arabic: فَيرى مَا وَرَاء تِلْكَ الستور من الغايات المحمودة والمذمومة
segments.english: So he sees what [is] behind those veils of praiseworthy and blameworthy ends.

segments.arabic: فَيرى المناهي كطعام لذيذ قد خلط فِيهِ سم قَاتل
segments.english: So he sees the prohibited things like delicious food in which [a] deadly poison has been mixed.

segments.arabic: فَكلما دعته لذته إِلَى تنَاوله نَهَاهُ مَا فِيهِ من السم
segments.english: So whenever its pleasure called him to consume it, what [is] in it of poison warned him away.

segments.arabic: وَيرى الْأَوَامِر كدواء كريه المذاق مفض إِلَى الْعَافِيَة والشفاء
segments.english: And he sees the commands like medicine bitter in taste, leading to health and healing.

segments.arabic: وَكلما نَهَاهُ كَرَاهَة مذاقه عَن تنَاوله أمره نَفعه بالتناول
segments.english: And whenever the bitterness of its taste warned him against consuming it, its benefit commanded him to consume [it].

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن هَذَا يحْتَاج إِلَى فضل علم تدْرك بِهِ الغايات من مبادئها
segments.english: But this needs extra knowledge by which the ends [are] understood from their beginnings,

segments.arabic: وَقُوَّة صَبر يوطن بِهِ نَفسه على تحمّل مشقة الطَّرِيق لما يؤول إليه عند الْغَايَة
segments.english: and strength of patience by which he settles himself upon bearing the hardship of the path, for what it leads to at the end.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا فقد الْيَقِين وَالصَّبْر تعذّر عَلَيْهِ ذَلِك
segments.english: So if he loses certainty and patience, that becomes impossible for him.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا قوي يقينه وَصَبره هان عَلَيْهِ كل مشقة يتحملها فِي طلب الْخَيْر الدَّائِم واللذة الدائمة
segments.english: And if his certainty and patience grow strong, every hardship he bears in seeking the lasting good and lasting pleasure becomes easy for him.

segments.arabic: وَمن أسرار هَذِه الْآيَة أَنَّهَا تَقْتَضِي من العَبْد التَّفْوِيض إِلَى من يعلم عواقب الْأُمُور
segments.english: And from the secrets of this verse [is] that it requires from the servant entrusting [his affairs] to the One who knows the outcomes of all matters,

segments.arabic: وَالرِّضَا بِمَا يختاره لَهُ ويقضيه لَهُ لما يَرْجُو فِيهِ من حسن الْعَاقِبَة
segments.english: and being content with what He chooses for him and decrees for him, because of what he hopes in it of [a] good outcome.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا أَنه لَا يقترح على ربه وَلَا يخْتَار عَلَيْهِ وَلَا يسْأَله مَا لَيْسَ لَهُ بِهِ علم
segments.english: And from them [is] that he does not suggest to his Lord, nor choose over Him, nor ask Him for what he has no knowledge of.

segments.arabic: فَلَعَلَّ مضرّته وهلاكه فِيهِ وَهو لا يعلم
segments.english: For perhaps his harm and destruction [are] in it while he does not know.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يخْتَار على ربه شَيْئا بل يسْأَله حسن الِاخْتِيَار لَهُ
segments.english: So he does not choose over his Lord anything, rather he asks Him [for] good choosing for him,

segments.arabic: وَأَن يرضيه بِمَا يختاره فَلَا أَنْفَع لَهُ من ذَلِك
segments.english: and that He make him content with what He chooses — for nothing [is] more beneficial for him than that.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا أَنه إِذا فوَّض إِلَى ربه وَرَضي بِمَا يختاره لَهُ أمده فِيمَا يختاره لَهُ بِالْقُوَّةِ عَلَيْهِ والعزيمة وَالصَّبْر
segments.english: And from them [is] that if he entrusts [his affairs] to his Lord and [is] content with what He chooses for him, He supports him in what He chooses for him with strength upon it, and resolve, and patience.

segments.arabic: وَصرف عَنهُ الْآفَات الَّتِي هِيَ عرضة اخْتِيَار العَبْد لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: And He turns away from him the harms that [are] the result of the servant's choosing for himself.

segments.arabic: وَأرَاهُ من حسن عواقب اخْتِيَاره لَهُ مَا لم يكن ليصل إِلَى بعضه بِمَا يختاره هُوَ لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: And He shows him from the good outcomes of His choosing for him what he would never have reached even some of by what he himself chooses for himself.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا أَنه يريحه من الأفكار المتعبة فِي أَنْوَاع الاختيارات
segments.english: And from them [is] that it relieves him from the tiring thoughts about the types of choices,

segments.arabic: ويفرغ قلبه من التقديرات والتدبيرات الَّتِي يصعد مِنْهَا فِي عقبَة وَينزل فِي أُخْرَى
segments.english: and frees his heart from the calculations and plans in which he climbs up one hill and comes down another.

segments.arabic: وَمَعَ هَذَا فَلَا خُرُوج لَهُ عَمَّا قدر عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And with all this, there [is] no escape for him from what has been decreed upon him.

segments.arabic: فَلَو رَضِي بِاخْتِيَار الله أَصَابَهُ الْقدر وَهُوَ مَحْمُود مشكور ملطوف بِهِ فِيهِ
segments.english: So if he [were] content with God's choice, the decree would reach him while he [is] praised, thankful, [and] treated gently in it.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا جرى عَلَيْهِ الْقدر وَهُوَ مَذْمُوم غير ملطوف بِهِ فِيهِ
segments.english: And otherwise the decree runs upon him while he [is] blamed, not treated gently in it —

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ مَعَ اخْتِيَاره لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: because he [is] with his choosing for himself.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى صَحَّ تفويضه وَرضَاهُ اكتنفه فِي
segments.english: And whenever his entrusting and contentment [are] sound, [it] surrounds him in —

headings.arabic: فصل لا ينتفع بنعمة الله بالإيمان والعلم إلا من عرف نفسه ووقف بها
headings.english: Section: No one benefits from God's blessing of faith and knowledge except the one who knows himself and keeps it in its place

segments.arabic: الْمَقْدُور الْعَطف عَلَيْهِ اللطف بِهِ
segments.english: the decreed [thing] — [there is] compassion toward him [and] gentleness with him,

segments.arabic: فَيصير بَين عطفه ولطفه
segments.english: so he becomes between His compassion and His gentleness.

segments.arabic: فعطفه يَقِيه مَا يحذرهُ
segments.english: His compassion protects him from what he fears,

segments.arabic: ولطفه يهوّن عَلَيْهِ مَا قدره
segments.english: and His gentleness makes easy for him what He decreed.

segments.arabic: إِذا نفذ الْقدر فِي العَبْد كَانَ من أعظم أَسبَاب نُفُوذه تحيله فِي رده
segments.english: When the decree passes through the servant, among the greatest causes of its passing through [is] his scheming to repel it.

segments.arabic: فَلَا أَنْفَع لَهُ من الاستسلام وإلقاء نَفسه بَين يَدي الْقدر طريحا كالميتة
segments.english: So nothing [is] more beneficial for him than surrender and casting himself before the decree, lying down like [a] dead [animal].

segments.arabic: فَإِن السَّبع لَا يرضى بِأَكْل الْجِيَف
segments.english: For the predator [is] not pleased with eating carrion.

segments.arabic: لَا ينْتَفع بِنِعْمَة الله بِالْإِيمَان وَالْعلم إِلَّا من عرف نَفسه ووقف بهَا عِنْد قدرهَا
segments.english: No one benefits from God's blessing of faith and knowledge except the one who knows himself and keeps it at its worth,

segments.arabic: وَلم يتجاوزه إِلَى مَا لَيْسَ لَهُ وَلم يَتَعَدَّ طوره وَلم يقل هَذَا لي
segments.english: and does not go beyond it to what [is] not his, and does not overstep his limit, and does not say 'this [is] mine.'

segments.arabic: وتيقّن أَنه لله وَبِاللَّهِ وَمن الله
segments.english: And [he is] certain that it [is] for God, by God, and from God.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ الْإِيمَان بِهِ ابْتِدَاء وإدامة
segments.english: For it [is] faith in Him — [as a] beginning and [a] continuation —

segments.arabic: لَا سَبَب من العَبْد وَلَا اسْتِحْقَاق مِنْهُ
segments.english: no cause from the servant and no deserving from him.

segments.arabic: فتذله نعم الله عَلَيْهِ وتكسره
segments.english: So God's blessings upon him humble him and break him —

segments.arabic: كسرة من لَا يرى لنَفسِهِ وَلَا فِيهَا خيرا البتّة
segments.english: the breaking of one who does not see for himself nor in himself any good at all,

segments.arabic: وَأَن الْخَيْر الَّذِي وصل إِلَيْهِ فَهُوَ لله وَبِه وَمِنْه
segments.english: and [knows] that the good that reached him — it [is] for God, by Him, and from Him.

segments.arabic: فَتحدث لَهُ النعم ذلا وانكسارا عجيبا لَا يعبر عَنهُ
segments.english: So the blessings produce in him [a] humility and [an] amazing brokenness that cannot be expressed.

segments.arabic: فَكلما جدد لَهُ نعْمَة ازْدَادَ لَهُ ذلا وانكسارا وخشوعا ومحبة وخوفا ورجاء
segments.english: So every time He renews for him [a] blessing, he increases in humility, brokenness, reverence, love, fear, and hope.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا نتيجة علمين شريفين
segments.english: And this [is] the result of two noble forms of knowledge:

segments.arabic: علمه بربه وكماله وبره وغناه وجوده وإحسانه وَرَحمته
segments.english: his knowledge of his Lord — His perfection, His goodness, His richness, His generosity, His excellence, and His mercy,

segments.arabic: وَأَن الْخَيْر كُله فِي يَدَيْهِ وَهُوَ ملكه
segments.english: and that all good [is] in His hands and it [is] His possession —

segments.arabic: يُؤْتِي مِنْهُ من يَشَاء وَيمْنَع مِنْهُ من يَشَاء
segments.english: He gives from it to whoever He wills and withholds it from whoever He wills,

segments.arabic: وَله الْحَمد على هَذَا وَهَذَا أكمل حمد وأتمه
segments.english: and to Him [is] the praise for this and that — the most complete and most perfect praise.

segments.arabic: وَعلمه بِنَفسِهِ ووقوفه على حَدهَا وقدرها ونقصها وظلمها وجهلها
segments.english: And his knowledge of himself — and his standing at its limit, its worth, its deficiency, its wrongdoing, and its ignorance,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهَا لَا خير فِيهَا الْبَتَّةَ وَلَا لَهَا وَلَا بهَا وَلَا مِنْهَا
segments.english: and that there [is] no good in it at all — not for it, not by it, and not from it,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهَا لَيْسَ لَهَا من ذَاتهَا إِلَّا الْعَدَم
segments.english: and that it has nothing from itself except nothingness.

segments.arabic: فَكَذَلِك من صفاتها وكمالها لَيْسَ لَهَا إِلَّا الْعَدَم
segments.english: And likewise regarding its qualities and perfection — it has nothing except the nothingness

segments.arabic: الَّذِي لَا شَيْء أَحْقَر مِنْهُ وَلَا أنقص
segments.english: that nothing [is] more worthless than and nothing more lacking.

segments.arabic: فَمَا فِيهَا من الْخَيْر تَابع لوجودها الَّذِي لَيْسَ إِلَيْهَا وَلَا بهَا
segments.english: So whatever good [is] in it follows from its existence, which [is] not up to it nor by it.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا صَار هَذَانِ العلمان صِيغَة لَهَا لَا صِيغَة على لسانها
segments.english: So when these two forms of knowledge become [a] deep quality in it — not [just a] phrase on its tongue —

segments.arabic: علمت حِينَئِذٍ أَن الْحَمد كُله لله وَالْأَمر كُله لَهُ وَالْخَيْر كُله فِي يَدَيْهِ
segments.english: it knows then that all praise [is] for God, all command [is] His, and all good [is] in His hands,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه هُوَ الْمُسْتَحق للحمد وَالثنَاء والمدح دونهَا
segments.english: and that He alone [is] the one deserving of praise, thanks, and glorification — not it,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّهَا هِيَ أولى بالذم وَالْعَيْب واللوم
segments.english: and that it [is] more deserving of blame, fault, and reproach.

segments.arabic: وَمن فَاتَهُ التَّحْقِيق بِهَذَيْنِ العلمين تلونت بِهِ أَقْوَاله وأعماله
segments.english: And whoever misses the realization of these two forms of knowledge — his words and deeds [will be] inconsistent.

segments.arabic: فللغضب حد وَهُوَ الشجَاعَة المحمودة والأنفة من الرذائل والنقائص وَهَذَا كَمَاله
segments.english: So anger has [a] limit, and it [is] praiseworthy courage and disdain for ugly traits and flaws — and this [is] its perfection.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا جَاوز حَده تعدى صَاحبه وجار
segments.english: So when it goes beyond its limit, its owner crosses [the line] and becomes unjust.

segments.arabic: وَإِن نقص عَنهُ جبن وَلم يأنف من الرذائل
segments.english: And if it falls short of it, [he becomes] cowardly and does not feel disdain for ugly traits.

segments.arabic: وللحرص حد وَهُوَ الْكِفَايَة فِي أُمُور الدُّنْيَا وَحُصُول الْبَلَاغ مِنْهَا
segments.english: And greed has [a] limit, and it [is] sufficiency in the affairs of this world and obtaining what [is] enough from it.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى نقص من ذَلِك كَانَ مهانة وإضاعة
segments.english: So whenever it falls short of that, it [is] humiliation and waste.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى زَاد عَلَيْهِ كَانَ شَرها ورغبة فِيمَا لَا تحمد الرَّغْبَة فِيهِ
segments.english: And whenever it exceeds it, it [is] greediness and desire for what desire [is] not praised for.

segments.arabic: وللحسد حد وَهُوَ المنافسة فِي طلب الْكَمَال والأنفة أَن يتَقَدَّم عَلَيْهِ نَظِيره
segments.english: And envy has [a] limit, and it [is] competing in seeking perfection and disdain that one's equal should get ahead of him.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى تعدى ذَلِك صَار بغيا وظلما يتَمَنَّى مَعَه زَوَال النِّعْمَة عَن الْمَحْسُود ويحرص على إيذائه
segments.english: So whenever it goes beyond that, it becomes wrongdoing and injustice, with which [one] wishes for the removal of the blessing from the envied person and strives to harm him.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى نقص عَن ذَلِك كَانَ دناءة وَضعف همة وَصغر نفس
segments.english: And whenever it falls short of that, it [is] lowliness, weakness of drive, and smallness of self.

segments.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِي لَا حسد إِلَّا فِي اثْنَيْنِ
segments.english: The Prophet said: "[There is] no envy except in two [cases]:

segments.arabic: رجل آتَاهُ الله مَالا فَسَلَّطَهُ على هَلَكته فِي الْحق
segments.english: [A] man [whom] God gave wealth, so He empowered him to spend it in [the cause of] truth,

segments.arabic: وَرجل آتَاهُ الله الْحِكْمَة فَهُوَ يقْضِي بهَا وَيعلمهَا النَّاس
segments.english: and [a] man [whom] God gave wisdom, so he judges by it and teaches it [to] people."

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا حسد مُنَافَسَة يُطَالب الْحَاسِد بِهِ نَفسه أَن يكون مثل الْمَحْسُود
segments.english: So this [is] envy of competition, by which the envier demands of himself to be like the envied person —

segments.arabic: لَا حسد مهانة يتَمَنَّى بِهِ زَوَال النِّعْمَة عَن الْمَحْسُود
segments.english: not envy of lowliness, by which [one] wishes for the removal of the blessing from the envied person.

segments.arabic: وللشهوة حد وَهُوَ رَاحَة الْقلب وَالْعقل من كد الطَّاعَة واكتساب الْفَضَائِل
segments.english: And desire has [a] limit, and it [is] rest for the heart and the mind from the toil of obedience and gaining good qualities,

segments.arabic: والاستعانة بقضائها على ذَلِك
segments.english: and seeking help through fulfilling it for that [purpose].

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى زَادَت على ذَلِك صَارَت نهمة وشبقا والتحق صَاحبهَا بِدَرَجَة الْحَيَوَانَات
segments.english: So whenever it exceeds that, it becomes excessive craving and lust, and its owner joins the level of animals.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى نقصت عَنهُ وَلم يكن فراغا فِي طلب الْكَمَال وَالْفضل كَانَت ضعفا وعجزا ومهانة
segments.english: And whenever it falls short of it and [is] not [used as] free time in seeking perfection and excellence, it [is] weakness, inability, and humiliation.

segments.arabic: وللراحة حد وَهُوَ إجمام النَّفس والقوى المدركة والفعالة للاستعداد للطاعة واكتساب الْفَضَائِل وتوفرها على ذَلِك
segments.english: And rest has [a] limit, and it [is] refreshing the self and the powers of understanding and action, to prepare for obedience and gaining good qualities, and devoting them to that,

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ لَا يضعفها الكد والتعب ويضعف أَثَرهَا
segments.english: so that hard work and tiredness do not weaken them and weaken their effect.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى زَاد على ذَلِك صَار توانيا وكسلا وإضاعة وَفَاتَ بِهِ أَكثر مصَالح العَبْد
segments.english: So whenever it exceeds that, it becomes laziness, sloth, and waste, and most of the servant's interests [are] lost by it.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى نقص عَنهُ صَار مضرا بالقوى موهنا لَهَا
segments.english: And whenever it falls short of it, it becomes harmful to the powers and weakening to them.

segments.arabic: وَرُبمَا انْقَطع بِهِ كالمنبتِّ الَّذِي لَا أَرضًا قطع وَلَا ظهر أبقى
segments.english: And perhaps [one] gets cut off by it, like the one who pushes [his mount] too hard — he neither covered [the] ground nor kept [his] mount's back [healthy].

segments.arabic: والجود لَهُ حد بَين طرفين
segments.english: And generosity has [a] limit between two extremes.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى جَاوز حَده صَار إسرافا وتبذيرا
segments.english: So whenever it goes beyond its limit, it becomes wastefulness and extravagance.

segments.arabic: أَو مَتى نقص عَنهُ كَانَ بخلا وتقتيرا
segments.english: And whenever it falls short of it, it [is] stinginess and miserliness.

segments.arabic: وللشجاعة حد مَتى جاوزته صَارَت تهوّرا
segments.english: And courage has [a] limit — whenever it goes beyond it, it becomes recklessness.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى نقصت عَنهُ صَارَت جبنا وخورا
segments.english: And whenever it falls short of it, it becomes cowardice and feebleness.

segments.arabic: وَحدهَا الْإِقْدَام فِي مَوَاضِع الْإِقْدَام والإحجام فِي مَوَاضِع الإحجام
segments.english: And its [proper] limit [is] advancing in the places of advancing, and holding back in the places of holding back.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ مُعَاوِيَة لعَمْرو بن الْعَاصِ
segments.english: As Mu'awiyah said to 'Amr ibn al-'As:

segments.arabic: أعياني أَن أعرف أشجاعا أَنْت أم جَبَانًا
segments.english: "It has tired me [out] to know whether you [are] brave or [a] coward.

segments.arabic: تقدم حَتَّى أَقُول من أَشْجَع النَّاس وتجبن حَتَّى أَقُول من أجبن النَّاس
segments.english: You advance until I say, 'Who [is] braver than [this] man!' — and you hold back until I say, 'Who [is] more cowardly than [this] man!'"

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ
segments.english: So he said:

headings.arabic: فصل قال أبو الدرداء ﵁ يا حبذا نوم الأكياس وفطرهم كيف
headings.english: Section: Abu al-Darda' (may God be pleased with him) said: How excellent [is] the sleep of the clever ones and their breaking of fast, how

segments.arabic: شُجَاع إِذا مَا أمكنتني فرْصَة ... فَإِن لم تكن لي فرْصَة فجبان
segments.english: [I am] brave when an opportunity comes to me ... but if there [is] no opportunity for me, then [I am a] coward.

segments.arabic: والغيرة لَهَا حد إِذا جاوزته صَارَت تُهْمَة وظنا سَيِّئًا بالبريء
segments.english: And jealous protectiveness has [a] limit — if one goes beyond it, it becomes accusation and bad suspicion of the innocent.

segments.arabic: وَإِن قصّرت عَنهُ كَانَت تغافلا ومبادىء دياثة
segments.english: And if one falls short of it, it becomes willful ignorance and the beginnings of shamelessness.

segments.arabic: وللتوضع حد إِذا جاوزه كَانَ ذلا ومهانة
segments.english: And humility has [a] limit — if one goes beyond it, it becomes lowliness and disgrace.

segments.arabic: وَمن قصر عَنهُ انحرف إِلَى الْكبر وَالْفَخْر
segments.english: And whoever falls short of it turns toward arrogance and boasting.

segments.arabic: وللعز حد إِذا جاوزه كَانَ كبرا وخلقا مذموما
segments.english: And honor has [a] limit — if one goes beyond it, it becomes arrogance and [a] blameworthy character trait.

segments.arabic: وَإِن قصر عَنهُ انحرف إِلَى الذل والمهانة
segments.english: And if one falls short of it, [one] turns toward humiliation and disgrace.

segments.arabic: وَضَابِط هَذَا كُله الْعدْل
segments.english: And the standard for all of this [is] justice,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ الْأَخْذ بالوسط الْمَوْضُوع بَين طرفِي الإفراط والتفريط
segments.english: and it [is] taking the middle path placed between the two extremes of excess and neglect.

segments.arabic: وَعَلِيهِ بِنَاء مصَالح الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: And upon it [is] built the well-being of this world and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: بل لَا تقوم مصلحَة الْبدن إِلَّا بِهِ
segments.english: Rather, the well-being of the body cannot stand except by it.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ مَتى خرج بعض أخلاطه عَن الْعدْل وجاوزه أَو نقص عَنهُ
segments.english: For whenever some of its humors go beyond balance and exceed it or fall short of it,

segments.arabic: ذهب من صِحَّته وقوته بِحَسب ذَلِك
segments.english: [there] goes from its health and strength according to that.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ الْأَفْعَال الطبيعية كالنوم والسهر وَالْأكل وَالشرب وَالْجِمَاع
segments.english: And likewise the natural actions — like sleep and wakefulness, eating and drinking, and sexual relations,

segments.arabic: وَالْحَرَكَة والرياضة وَالْخلْوَة والمخالطة وَغير ذَلِك
segments.english: and movement and exercise, and solitude and socializing, and other than that —

segments.arabic: إِذا كَانَت وسطا بَين الطَّرفَيْنِ المذمومين كَانَت عدلا
segments.english: when they [are] in the middle between the two blameworthy extremes, they [are] balanced.

segments.arabic: وَإِن انحرفت إِلَى أَحدهمَا كَانَت نقصا وأثمرت نقصا
segments.english: And if they turn toward either one of them, they [are a] deficiency and they produce deficiency.

segments.arabic: فَمن أشرف الْعُلُوم وأنفعها علم الْحُدُود
segments.english: So among the noblest of sciences and the most beneficial [is] the science of limits,

segments.arabic: وَلَا سِيمَا حُدُود الْمَشْرُوع الْمَأْمُور والمنهي
segments.english: especially the limits of what [is] legislated — the commanded and the forbidden.

segments.arabic: فَأعْلم النَّاس أعلمهم بِتِلْكَ الْحُدُود
segments.english: So the most knowledgeable of people [are] those most knowledgeable of those limits,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لَا يدْخل فِيهَا مَا لَيْسَ مِنْهَا وَلَا يخرج مِنْهَا مَا هُوَ دَاخل فِيهَا
segments.english: so that nothing enters into them that [is] not from them, and nothing leaves them that [is] included in them.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: الْأَعْرَابُ أَشَدُّ كُفْرًا وَنِفَاقًا وأجدر أَن لَا يَعْلَمُوا حُدُودَ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُوله
segments.english: The desert Arabs [are] more intense in disbelief and hypocrisy, and more likely not to know the limits of what God sent down upon His Messenger.
segments.sahih_international: The bedouins are stronger in disbelief and hypocrisy and more likely not to know the limits of what [laws] Allah has revealed to His Messenger. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.

segments.arabic: فأعدل النَّاس من قَامَ بحدود الْأَخْلَاق والأعمال والمشروعات معرفَة وفعلا
segments.english: So the most balanced of people [is] the one who upholds the limits of character, actions, and legislated matters — in knowledge and in practice.

segments.arabic: وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And with God [is] success.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Section

segments.arabic: قَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاء ﵁
segments.english: Abu al-Darda' — may God be pleased with him — said:

segments.arabic: يَا حبذا نوم الأكياس وفطرهم
segments.english: How excellent [is] the sleep of the clever ones and their breaking of fast!

segments.arabic: كَيفَ يغبنون بِهِ قيام الحمقى وصومهم
segments.english: How they outdo by it the night prayer of the fools and their fasting!

segments.arabic: والذرة من صَاحب تقوى أفضل من أَمْثَال الْجبَال عبَادَة من المغترّين
segments.english: And [a] tiny amount from [a] person of God-consciousness [is] better than mountains of worship from the deluded ones.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا من جَوَاهِر الْكَلَام
segments.english: And this [is] from the gems of speech,

segments.arabic: وأدله على كَمَال فقه الصَّحَابَة وتقدمهم على من بعدهمْ فِي كل خير ﵃
segments.english: and the greatest proof of the complete understanding of the Companions and their being ahead of those after them in every good — may God be pleased with them all.

segments.arabic: فَاعْلَم أَن العَبْد إِنَّمَا يقطع منَازِل السّير إِلَى الله بِقَلْبِه وهمته لَا بِبدنِهِ
segments.english: So know that the servant only crosses the stations of the journey to God with his heart and his resolve, not with his body.

segments.arabic: وَالتَّقوى فِي الْحَقِيقَة تقوى الْقُلُوب لَا تقوى الْجَوَارِح
segments.english: And God-consciousness in reality [is] the God-consciousness of the hearts, not the God-consciousness of the limbs.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ذَلِكَ وَمَنْ يُعَظِّمْ شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِ
segments.english: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols of God —
segments.sahih_international: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols of Allah - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ تَقْوَى الْقُلُوب
segments.english: for indeed it [is] from the God-consciousness of the hearts.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And [God] said:

segments.arabic: لَنْ يَنَالَ اللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلا دِمَاؤُهَا وَلَكِنْ يَنَالُهُ التَّقْوَى مِنْكُم
segments.english: Their meat [will] not reach God, nor their blood, but God-consciousness from you reaches Him.
segments.sahih_international: Their meat will not reach Allah, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allah for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ النَّبِي التَّقْوَى هَهُنَا وَأَشَارَ إِلَى صَدره
segments.english: And the Prophet said: "God-consciousness [is] here," and he pointed to his chest.

segments.arabic: فالكيّس يقطع من الْمسَافَة بِصِحَّة الْعَزِيمَة وعلو الهمة وَتَجْرِيد الْقَصْد وَصِحَّة النِّيَّة مَعَ الْعَمَل الْقَلِيل
segments.english: So the wise person covers of the distance — with soundness of resolve, loftiness of aspiration, sincerity of purpose, and correctness of intention — with little action,

segments.arabic: أَضْعَاف أَضْعَاف مَا يقطعهُ الفارغ من ذَلِك مَعَ التَّعَب الْكثير وَالسّفر الشاق
segments.english: many times over what the one empty of that covers, [even] with much effort and difficult travel.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْعَزِيمَة والمحبة تذْهب الْمَشَقَّة وتطيب السّير
segments.english: For indeed resolve and love remove the hardship and make the journey pleasant.

segments.arabic: والتقدم والسبق إِلَى الله سُبْحَانَهُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ بالهمم وَصدق الرَّغْبَة والعزيمة
segments.english: And advancement and racing to God, glorified [is] He, [is] only through aspirations, sincerity of desire, and resolve.

segments.arabic: فيتقدم صَاحب الهمة مَعَ سكونه صَاحب الْعَمَل الْكثير بمراحل
segments.english: So the person of aspiration surpasses — [even] with his stillness — the person of many deeds, by stages.

segments.arabic: فَإِن ساواه فِي همته تقدم عَلَيْهِ بِعَمَلِهِ
segments.english: And if [someone] equals him in his aspiration, [then] he surpasses him by his deeds.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا مَوضِع يحْتَاج إِلَى تَفْصِيل يُوَافق فِيهِ الْإِسْلَام وَالْإِحْسَان
segments.english: And this [is] a topic that needs detailed explanation, in which Islam and excellence [are] brought together.

segments.arabic: فأكمل الْهَدْي هدي رَسُول الله
segments.english: So the most complete guidance [is] the guidance of the Messenger of God.

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ موفيا كل وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا حَقه
segments.english: And he was giving each one of the two its right.

segments.arabic: فَكَانَ مَعَ كَمَاله وإرادته وأحواله مَعَ الله يقوم حَتَّى تَرِم قدماه
segments.english: So he was — with his perfection, his will, and his states with God — standing [in prayer] until his feet [would] swell,

segments.arabic: ويصوم حَتَّى يُقَال لَا يفْطر
segments.english: and fasting until it [was] said he [will] not break [his] fast,

segments.arabic: ويجاهد فِي سَبِيل الله ويخالط أَصْحَاب وَلَا يحتجب عَنْهُم
segments.english: and striving in the path of God, and mixing with [his] companions without hiding from them,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يتْرك شَيْئا من النَّوَافِل والأوراد لتِلْك الواردات الَّتِي تعجز عَن حملهَا قوى الْبشر
segments.english: and not leaving anything of the voluntary [prayers] and daily devotions because of those spiritual states that the powers of humans [are] unable to bear.

segments.arabic: وَالله تَعَالَى أَمر عباده أَن يقومُوا بشرائع الْإِسْلَام على ظواهرهم وحقائق الْإِيمَان على بواطنهم
segments.english: And God Most High commanded His servants to uphold the laws of Islam upon their outward [selves], and the realities of faith upon their inward [selves].

segments.arabic: وَلَا يقبل وَاحِدًا مِنْهُمَا إِلَّا بِصَاحِبِهِ وقرينه
segments.english: And He does not accept one of them except with its companion and its pair.

segments.arabic: وَفِي الْمسند مَرْفُوعا الْإِسْلَام عَلَانيَة وَالْإِيمَان فِي الْقلب
segments.english: And in the Musnad, attributed [to the Prophet]: "Islam [is] outward, and faith [is] in the heart."

segments.arabic: فَكل إِسْلَام ظَاهر لَا ينفذ صَاحبه مِنْهُ إِلَى حَقِيقَة الْإِيمَان الْبَاطِنَة فَلَيْسَ بِنَافِع
segments.english: So every outward Islam whose owner does not pass through it to the inner reality of faith [is] not beneficial,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يكون مَعَه شَيْء من الْإِيمَان الْبَاطِن
segments.english: until there [is] with it something of inner faith.

segments.arabic: وكل حَقِيقَة باطنة لَا يقوم صَاحبهَا بشرائع الْإِسْلَام الظَّاهِرَة لَا تَنْفَع وَلَو كَانَت مَا كَانَت
segments.english: And every inner reality whose owner does not uphold the outward laws of Islam does not benefit, no matter what it may be.

segments.arabic: فَلَو تمزق الْقلب بالمحبة وَالْخَوْف وَلم يتعبد بِالْأَمر وَظَاهر الشَّرْع لم ينجّه ذَلِك من النَّار
segments.english: So even if the heart [were] torn apart with love and fear, but [he] did not worship according to the command and the outward law, that [would] not save him from the Fire.

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَنه لَو قَامَ بظواهر الْإِسْلَام وَلَيْسَ فِي بَاطِنه حَقِيقَة الْإِيمَان لم ينجّه من النَّار
segments.english: Just as if he upheld the outward [forms] of Islam, but there [was] not in his inward [self] the reality of faith, [it would] not save him from the Fire.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا عرف هَذَا فالصادقون السائرون إِلَى الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة قِسْمَانِ
segments.english: And when this [is] understood, then the truthful ones journeying to God and the Hereafter [are] two groups:

segments.arabic: قسم صرفُوا مَا فضل من أوقاتهم بعد الْفَرَائِض إِلَى النَّوَافِل الْبَدَنِيَّة وجعلوها دأبهم
segments.english: [The first] group — they devoted what remained of their time after the obligations to bodily voluntary acts, and made them their constant practice,

segments.arabic: من غير حرص مِنْهُم على تَحْقِيق أَعمال الْقُلُوب ومنازلها وأحكامها
segments.english: without eagerness from them to realize the works of the hearts, their stations, and their rulings,

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم يَكُونُوا خالين من أَصْلهَا وَلَكِن هممهم مصروفة إِلَى الاستكثار من الْأَعْمَال
segments.english: even though they were not devoid of their root, but their aspirations [were] directed to increasing [their] deeds.

segments.arabic: وَقسم صرفُوا
segments.english: And [the second] group devoted

headings.arabic: فصل أصل الأخلاق المذمومة كلها الكبر والمهانة والدناءة وأصل الأخلاق
headings.english: Chapter: The Root of All Blameworthy Character [is] Arrogance, Lowliness, and Meanness — and the Root of [All Praiseworthy] Character

segments.arabic: مَا فضل من الْفَرَائِض وَالسّنَن إِلَى الاهتمام بصلاح قُلُوبهم وعكوفها على الله وَحده
segments.english: whatever [is] left over from the obligatory and recommended [acts] — to caring for the soundness of their hearts, and their hearts' devotion to God alone,

segments.arabic: والجمعية عَلَيْهِ وَحفظ الخواطر والإرادات مَعَه
segments.english: and [their] gathering [of focus] upon Him, and guarding [their] thoughts and intentions with Him,

segments.arabic: وجعلوه قُوَّة تعبده بأعمال الْقُلُوب من تَصْحِيح الْمحبَّة وَالْخَوْف والرجاء والتوكل والإنابة
segments.english: and they made it [a] strength [of] worshipping Him through the deeds of the hearts — from correcting love, fear, hope, reliance [on God], and turning [to Him].

segments.arabic: وَرَأَوا أَن أيسر نصيب من الواردات الَّتِي ترد على قُلُوبهم من الله أحب إِلَيْهِم من كثير من التطوعات الْبَدَنِيَّة
segments.english: And they saw that the smallest share of the spiritual openings that come upon their hearts from God [was] more beloved to them than many bodily voluntary acts.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا حصل لأَحَدهم جمعية ووارد أنس أَو حب أَو اشتياق أَو انكسار وذل
segments.english: So when one of them attained [a] gathering [of the heart] and [a] spiritual opening of closeness, or love, or longing, or brokenness and humility,

segments.arabic: لم يسْتَبْدل بِهِ شَيْئا سواهُ الْبَتَّةَ
segments.english: he would not exchange it for anything else whatsoever,

segments.arabic: إِلَّا أَن يَجِيء الْأَمر فيبادر إِلَيْهِ بذلك الْوَارِد إِن أمكنه
segments.english: unless [a] command [from God] came, and then he would rush to it with that spiritual opening if he could,

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا بَادر إِلَى الْأَمر وَلَو ذهب الْوَارِد
segments.english: and if not, he would rush to the command even if the spiritual opening went away.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا جَاءَت النَّوَافِل فههنا معترك التَّرَدُّد
segments.english: So when the voluntary acts came, here [is] the battleground of hesitation.

segments.arabic: فَإِن أمكن الْقيام إِلَيْهَا بِهِ فَذَاك
segments.english: So if it [was] possible to rise to them while keeping it, then that [is best].

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا نظر فِي الْأَرْجَح والأحب إِلَى الله
segments.english: And if not, he would look at what [is] more preferred and more beloved to God —

segments.arabic: هَل هُوَ الْقيام إِلَى تِلْكَ النَّافِلَة وَلَو ذهب وارده
segments.english: [is] it rising to that voluntary act even if his spiritual opening goes away,

segments.arabic: كإغاثة الملهوف وإرشاد ضال وجبر مكسور واستفادة إِيمَان وَنَحْو ذَلِك
segments.english: such as helping the distressed, guiding the lost, mending the broken, and gaining faith, and things like that?

segments.arabic: فههنا يَنْبَغِي تَقْدِيم النَّافِلَة الراجحة
segments.english: So here, the more preferred voluntary act should be given priority.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى قدمهما لله رَغْبَة فِيهِ وتقرّبا إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And whenever he put them forward for God, out of desire for Him and drawing near to Him,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ يرد عَلَيْهِ مَا فَاتَ من وارده أقوى مِمَّا كَانَ فِي وَقت آخر
segments.english: then [God] will return to him what he missed of his spiritual opening, stronger than it was, at another time.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ الْوَارِد أرجح من النَّافِلَة فالحزم لَهُ الِاسْتِمْرَار فِي وارده حَتَّى يتَوَارَى عَنهُ
segments.english: And if the spiritual opening [was] more preferred than the voluntary act, then the wise course for him [is] to continue in his spiritual opening until it fades from him,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ يفوت والنافلة لَا تفوت
segments.english: for it passes away, but the voluntary act does not pass away.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا مَوضِع يحْتَاج إِلَى فضل فقه فِي الطَّرِيق ومراتب الْأَعْمَال وَتَقْدِيم الأهم مِنْهَا فالأهم
segments.english: And this [is a] place that needs deep understanding of the path, and the ranks of deeds, and prioritizing the most important of them, then [the next] most important.

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُوفق لذَلِك لَا إِلَه غَيره وَلَا رب سواهُ
segments.english: And God [is] the One who grants success in that — there [is] no god other than Him and no Lord besides Him.

segments.arabic: فصل أصل الْأَخْلَاق المذمومة كلهَا الْكبر والمهانة والدناءة
segments.english: Chapter: The root of all blameworthy character [is] arrogance, lowliness, and meanness.

segments.arabic: وأصل الْأَخْلَاق المحمودة كلهَا الْخُشُوع وعلو الهمة
segments.english: And the root of all praiseworthy character [is] humility and high aspiration.

segments.arabic: فالفخر والبطر والأشر وَالْعجب والحسد وَالْبَغي وَالْخُيَلَاء
segments.english: So pride, arrogant joy, insolence, self-amazement, envy, oppression, and vanity,

segments.arabic: وَالظُّلم وَالْقَسْوَة والتجبر والإعراض وإباء قبُول النَّصِيحَة
segments.english: and wrongdoing, harshness, tyranny, turning away, and refusing to accept advice,

segments.arabic: والاستئثار وَطلب الْعُلُوّ وَحب الجاه والرئاسة وَأَن يحمد بِمَا لم يفعل وأمثال ذَلِك
segments.english: and selfishness, seeking superiority, love of status and leadership, and [wanting] to be praised for what he did not do, and things like that —

segments.arabic: كلهَا ناشئة من الْكبر
segments.english: all of them arise from arrogance.

segments.arabic: وَأما الْكَذِب والخسة والخيانة والرياء وَالْمَكْر والخديعة
segments.english: And as for lying, vileness, betrayal, showing off, scheming, and deception,

segments.arabic: والطمع والفزع والجبن وَالْبخل وَالْعجز والكسل والذل لغير الله واستبدال الَّذِي هُوَ
segments.english: and greed, panic, cowardice, stinginess, helplessness, laziness, humiliation before other than God, and exchanging that which [is]

headings.arabic: فصل المطلب الأعلى موقوف حصوله على همة عالية ونية صحيحة فمن فقدهما
headings.english: Section: The Highest Goal — Its Attainment Depends on High Aspiration and Sound Intention

segments.arabic: أدنى بِالَّذِي هُوَ خير وَنَحْو ذَلِك
segments.english: lesser for what [is] better — and similar to that.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا من المهانة والدناءة وَصغر النَّفس
segments.english: For indeed they [are] from humiliation, lowliness, and smallness of the self.

segments.arabic: وَأما الْأَخْلَاق الفاضلة كالصبر والشجاعة وَالْعدْل والمروءة والعفة والصيانة والجود والحلم وَالْعَفو والصفح وَالِاحْتِمَال والإيثار
segments.english: As for the noble character traits — like patience, courage, justice, chivalry, chastity, self-guarding, generosity, forbearance, pardoning, forgiveness, endurance, and selflessness,

segments.arabic: وَعزة النَّفس عَن الدناآت والتواضع والقناعة والصدق والأخلاق
segments.english: and the dignity of the self above lowly things, humility, contentment, truthfulness, and good manners,

segments.arabic: والمكافأة على الْإِحْسَان بِمثلِهِ أَو أفضل
segments.english: and repaying kindness with its like or better,

segments.arabic: والتغافل عَن زلات النَّاس وَترك الانشغال بِمَا لَا يعنيه
segments.english: and overlooking people's mistakes, and leaving [off] being busy with what does not concern him,

segments.arabic: وسلامة الْقلب من تِلْكَ الْأَخْلَاق المذمومة وَنَحْو ذَلِك
segments.english: and soundness of the heart from those blameworthy character traits, and similar to that —

segments.arabic: فَكلهَا ناشئة عَن الْخُشُوع وعلو الهمة
segments.english: all of them arise from humility and high aspiration.

segments.arabic: وَالله سُبْحَانَهُ أخبر عَن الأَرْض بِأَنَّهَا تكون خاشعة
segments.english: And God — glorified [is] He — informed about the earth that it [is] barren,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ ينزل عَلَيْهَا المَاء فتهتز وتربو وَتَأْخُذ زينتها وبهجتها
segments.english: then water comes down upon it, and it stirs and swells and takes on its beauty and splendor.

segments.arabic: فَكَذَلِك الْمَخْلُوق مِنْهَا إِذا أَصَابَهُ حَظه من التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: Likewise [is] the creature [made] from it, when his share of divine guidance reaches him.

segments.arabic: وَأما النَّار فطبعها الْعُلُوّ والإفساد
segments.english: As for fire, its nature [is] rising and corruption,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ تخمد فَتَصِير أَحْقَر شَيْء وأذله
segments.english: then it dies out and becomes the most worthless and lowest thing.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ الْمَخْلُوق مِنْهَا
segments.english: And likewise [is] the creature [made] from it.

segments.arabic: فَهِيَ دَائِما بَين الْعُلُوّ إِذا هَاجَتْ واضطربت
segments.english: For it [is] always between rising — when it rages and flares —

segments.arabic: وَبَين الخسة والدناءة إِذا خمدت وسكنت
segments.english: and between lowness and meanness — when it dies down and settles.

segments.arabic: والأخلاق المذمومة تَابِعَة للنار والخلوق مِنْهَا
segments.english: And blameworthy character traits follow fire and the creature [made] from it,

segments.arabic: والأخلاق الفاضلة تَابِعَة للْأَرْض والمخلوق مِنْهَا
segments.english: and noble character traits follow the earth and the creature [made] from it.

segments.arabic: فَمن علت همته وخشعت نَفسه اتّصف بِكُل خلق جميل
segments.english: So whoever's aspiration [is] high and whose self [is] humble — [he is] described by every beautiful trait.

segments.arabic: وَمن دنت همته وطغت نَفسه اتّصف بِكُل خلق رذيل
segments.english: And whoever's aspiration [is] low and whose self [is] rebellious — [he is] described by every ugly trait.

segments.arabic: الْمطلب الْأَعْلَى مَوْقُوف حُصُوله على همة عالية وَنِيَّة صَحِيحَة
segments.english: The highest goal — its attainment [is] dependent on [a] high aspiration and [a] sound intention.

segments.arabic: فَمن فقدهما تعذّر عَلَيْهِ الْوُصُول إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: So whoever lacks them both, reaching it becomes impossible for him.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الهمة إِذا كَانَت عالية تعلّقت بِهِ وَحده دون غَيره
segments.english: For indeed aspiration, when it [is] high, attaches to Him alone, not to other than Him.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا كَانَت النِّيَّة صَحِيحَة سلك العَبْد الطَّرِيق الموصلة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And when the intention [is] sound, the servant walks the path leading to Him.

segments.arabic: فالنية تفرد لَهُ الطَّرِيق والهمة تفرد لَهُ الْمَطْلُوب
segments.english: So the intention singles out the path for him, and the aspiration singles out the goal for him.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا توَحد مَطْلُوبه وَالطَّرِيق الموصلة إِلَيْهِ كَانَ الْوُصُول غَايَته
segments.english: So when his goal [is] unified and the path leading to it [is unified], reaching [it] was his ultimate end.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا كَانَت همته سافلة تعلّقت بالسفليات وَلم تتعلّق بالمطلب الْأَعْلَى
segments.english: And when his aspiration [is] low, it attaches to lowly things and does not attach to the highest goal.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا كَانَت النِّيَّة غير صَحِيحَة كَانَت طَرِيقه غير موصلة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And when the intention [is] not sound, his path [is] not leading to Him.

segments.arabic: فمدار الشَّأْن على همة العَبْد وَنِيَّته وهما مَطْلُوبه
segments.english: So the whole matter revolves around the servant's aspiration and his intention, and they [are] what [is] required of him.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يتم لَهُ إِلَّا بترك ثَلَاثَة أَشْيَاء
segments.english: And [this] [is] not complete for him except by leaving three things:

segments.arabic: العوائد والرسوم والأوضاع الَّتِي أحدثها النَّاس
segments.english: habits, customs, and practices that people invented.

segments.arabic: الثَّانِي هجر الْعَوَائِق الَّتِي تعوقه عَن إِفْرَاد مَطْلُوبه وَطَرِيقه
segments.english: The second: abandoning the obstacles that hold him back from singling out his goal and his path.

headings.arabic: فصل من كلام عبد الله بن مسعود ﵁ قال رجل عنده
headings.english: Chapter: From the words of Abdullah ibn Masud, may God be pleased with him — a man said in his presence

segments.arabic: وقطعها الثَّالِث قطع علائق الْقلب الَّتِي تحول بَينه وَبَين تَجْرِيد التَّعَلُّق بالمطلوب
segments.english: And the third cutting [of them is] cutting the attachments of the heart that come between him and purely devoting [his] attachment to the goal.

segments.arabic: وَالْفرق بنيها أَن الْعَوَائِق هِيَ الْحَوَادِث الخارجية
segments.english: And the difference between them [is] that the obstacles — they [are] the external events,

segments.arabic: والعلائق هِيَ التعلقات القلبية بالمباحات وَنَحْوهَا
segments.english: and the attachments — they [are] the heart's connections to permissible things and the like.

segments.arabic: وأصل ذَلِك ترك الفضول الَّتِي تشغل عَن الْمَقْصُود من الطَّعَام وَالشرَاب والمنام والخلطة
segments.english: And the root of that [is] leaving the excesses that distract from the goal — of food, drink, sleep, and socializing.

segments.arabic: فَيَأْخُذ من ذَلِك مَا يُعينهُ على طلبه ويرفض مِنْهُ مَا يقطعهُ عَنهُ أَو يضعف طلبه
segments.english: So he takes from that what helps him in his pursuit, and rejects from it what cuts him off from it or weakens his pursuit.

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: And God [is] the One whose help [is] sought.

segments.arabic: قَالَ رجل عِنْده مَا أحب أَن أكون من أَصْحَاب الْيَمين
segments.english: A man said in his presence: 'I [do] not love to be among the companions of the right —

segments.arabic: أحب أَن أكون من المقربين
segments.english: [rather] I love to be among those brought near.'

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ عبد الله لَكِن هَهُنَا رجل ود وَأَنه مَاتَ لم يبْعَث يَعْنِي نَفسه
segments.english: So Abdullah said: 'But here [is] a man [who] wished that he [had] died [and] not [been] resurrected' — meaning himself.

segments.arabic: وَخرج ذَات يَوْم فَاتبعهُ نَاس فَقَالَ لَهُم ألكم حَاجَة
segments.english: And he went out one day, and [some] people followed him, so he said to them: 'Do you have [a] need?'

segments.arabic: قَالُوا لَا وَلَكِن أردنَا أَن نمشي مَعَك
segments.english: They said: 'No, but we wanted to walk with you.'

segments.arabic: قَالَ ارْجعُوا فَإِنَّهُ ذلة للتتابع وفتنة للمتبوع
segments.english: He said: 'Go back, for it [is] humiliation for the follower and [a] trial for the one followed.'

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ لَو تعلمُونَ مني مَا أعلم من نَفسِي لحثوتم على رَأْسِي التُّرَاب
segments.english: And he said: 'If you knew about me what I know about myself, you would have thrown dust on my head.'

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ حبذا المكروهان الْمَوْت والفقر
segments.english: And he said: 'How excellent [are] the two disliked things: death and poverty!'

segments.arabic: وأيم الله إِن هُوَ إِلَّا الْغنى والفقر وَمَا أُبَالِي بِأَيِّهِمَا بليت
segments.english: By God, it [is] nothing but wealth and poverty, and I [do] not care with which of them I [am] tested.

segments.arabic: أَرْجُو الله فِي كل وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا
segments.english: I hope in God in each one of them.

segments.arabic: إِن كَانَ الْغنى إِن فِيهِ للْعَطْف
segments.english: If it [is] wealth — then in it [is room] for compassion.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ الْفقر إِن فِيهِ للصبر
segments.english: And if it [is] poverty — then in it [is room] for patience.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنَّكُم فِي ممر اللَّيْل وَالنَّهَار فِي آجل منقوصة وأعمال مَحْفُوظَة
segments.english: And he said: 'You [are] in the passage of night and day, with lifespans [being] decreased and deeds [being] recorded.'

segments.arabic: وَالْمَوْت يَأْتِي بَغْتَة
segments.english: And death comes suddenly.

segments.arabic: فَمن زرع خيرا فيوشك أَن يحصد رغبته
segments.english: So whoever planted good [is] about to harvest his desire,

segments.arabic: وَمن زرع شرا فيوشك أَن يحصد ندامة
segments.english: and whoever planted evil [is] about to harvest regret.

segments.arabic: وَلكُل زارع مثل مَا زرع
segments.english: And for every planter [is] the like of what he planted.

segments.arabic: لَا يسْبق بطيء بحظه وَلَا يدْرك حَرِيص مَا لم يقدر لَهُ
segments.english: A slow [person is] not outrun from his [destined] share, and an eager [person does] not reach what was not decreed for him.

segments.arabic: من أعْطى خيرا فَالله أعطَاهُ وَمن وقى شرا فَالله وَقَاه
segments.english: Whoever [is] given good — then God gave it [to him]; and whoever [is] protected from evil — then God protected him.

segments.arabic: المتقون سادة وَالْفُقَهَاء قادة ومجالستهم زِيَادَة
segments.english: The God-conscious [are] masters, the scholars [are] guides, and sitting with them [is an] increase.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا هما اثْنَتَانِ الْهدى وَالْكَلَام
segments.english: They are only two [things]: guidance and speech.

segments.arabic: فأفضل الْكَلَام كَلَام الله وَأفضل الْهَدْي هدي مُحَمَّد
segments.english: So the best speech [is] the speech of God, and the best guidance [is] the guidance of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: وَشر الْأُمُور محدثاتها وكل محدثة بِدعَة
segments.english: And the worst of matters [are] their newly invented ones, and every newly invented [thing is] an innovation.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يطولن عَلَيْكُم الأمد وَلَا يلهينكم الأمل
segments.english: So let not the [passage of] time grow long upon you, and let not hope distract you.

segments.arabic: فَإِن كل مَا هُوَ آتٍ قريب
segments.english: For everything that [is] coming [is] near.

segments.arabic: الأوان الْبعيد مَا لَيْسَ آتِيَا
segments.english: Indeed, the [truly] distant [is] what [is] not coming.

segments.arabic: الأوان الشقي من شقي فِي بطن أمه وَإِن السعيد من وعظ
segments.english: Indeed, the wretched [is] he who [was] wretched in his mother's womb, and the fortunate [is] he who took lesson.

segments.arabic: بِغَيْرِهِ
segments.english: with other than Him.

segments.arabic: أَلا وَإِن قتال الْمُسلم كفر وسبابه فسوق
segments.english: Indeed, fighting [a] Muslim [is] disbelief, and insulting him [is] wickedness.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يحل لمُسلم أَن يهجر أَخَاهُ فَوق ثَلَاثَة أَيَّام
segments.english: And it [is] not permissible for [a] Muslim to abandon his brother for more than three days,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يسلّم عَلَيْهِ إِذا لقِيه ويجيبه إِذا دَعَاهُ ويعوده إِذا مرض
segments.english: rather [he should] greet him when he meets him, answer him when he calls him, and visit him when he [is] sick.

segments.arabic: أَلا وَإِن شرّ الروايا روايا الْكَذِب
segments.english: Indeed, the worst of tales [are] tales of lies.

segments.arabic: أَلا وَإِن الْكَذِب لَا يصلح مِنْهُ جد وَلَا هزل
segments.english: Indeed, lying [is] not fitting — neither in seriousness nor in jest,

segments.arabic: وَلَا أَن يعد الرجل صَبِيه شَيْئا ثمَّ لَا يُنجزهُ
segments.english: nor that [a] man promises his child something then does not fulfill it.

segments.arabic: أَلا وَإِن الْكَذِب يهدي إِلَى الْفُجُور والفجور يهدي إِلَى النَّار
segments.english: Indeed, lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire.

segments.arabic: والصدق يهدي إِلَى الْبر وَالْبر يهدي إِلَى الْجنَّة
segments.english: And truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه يُقَال للصادق صدق وبر وَيُقَال للكاذب كذب وفجر
segments.english: And it [is] said of the truthful one: "[He] was truthful and righteous," and it [is] said of the liar: "[He] lied and [was] wicked."

segments.arabic: وَأَن مُحَمَّدًا حَدثنَا أَن الرجل ليصدق حَتَّى يكْتب عِنْد الله صدّيقا
segments.english: And Muhammad told us that [a] man keeps being truthful until he [is] written with God as utterly truthful,

segments.arabic: ويكذب حَتَّى يكْتب عِنْد الله كذّابا
segments.english: and [he] keeps lying until he [is] written with God as [a] great liar.

segments.arabic: إِن أصدق الحَدِيث كتاب الله وأوثق العرى كلمة التقى
segments.english: The most truthful of speech [is] the Book of God, and the firmest of handholds [is] the word of God-consciousness.

segments.arabic: وَخير الْملَّة مِلَّة إِبْرَاهِيم وَأحسن السّنَن سنة مُحَمَّد
segments.english: And the best of creeds [is] the creed of Abraham, and the finest of ways [is] the way of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: وَخير الْهَدْي هدي الْأَنْبِيَاء وأشرف الحَدِيث ذكر الله
segments.english: And the best of guidance [is] the guidance of the prophets, and the noblest of speech [is] the remembrance of God.

segments.arabic: وَخير الْقَصَص الْقُرْآن وَخير الْأُمُور عواقبها
segments.english: And the best of stories [is] the Quran, and the best of matters [are] their outcomes.

segments.arabic: وَشر الْأُمُور محدثاتها
segments.english: And the worst of matters [are] their newly invented ones.

segments.arabic: وَمَا قل وَكفى خير مِمَّا كثر وألهى
segments.english: And what [is] little and sufficient [is] better than what [is] much and distracting.

segments.arabic: وَنَفس تنجيها خير من إِمَارَة لَا تحصيها
segments.english: And [a] soul you save [is] better than [a] leadership you cannot account for.

segments.arabic: وَشر المعذرة حِين يحضر الْمَوْت وَشر الندامة ندامة يَوْم الْقِيَامَة
segments.english: And the worst excuse [is one] when death arrives, and the worst regret [is] the regret of the Day of Judgment.

segments.arabic: وَشر الضَّلَالَة الضَّلَالَة بعد الْهوى
segments.english: And the worst misguidance [is] misguidance after guidance.

segments.arabic: وَخير الْغنى غنى النَّفس وَخير الزَّاد التَّقْوَى
segments.english: And the best richness [is] the richness of the soul, and the best provision [is] God-consciousness.

segments.arabic: وَخير مَا ألقِي فِي الْقلب الْيَقِين
segments.english: And the best [thing] placed in the heart [is] certainty.

segments.arabic: والريب من الْكفْر
segments.english: And doubt [is] from disbelief.

segments.arabic: وَشر الْعَمى عمى الْقلب
segments.english: And the worst blindness [is] the blindness of the heart.

segments.arabic: وَالْخمر جماع الْإِثْم وَالنِّسَاء حبائل الشَّيْطَان
segments.english: And wine [is] the gathering of all sin, and women [are] the snares of Satan.

segments.arabic: والشباب شُعْبَة من الْجُنُون وَالنوح من عمل الْجَاهِلِيَّة
segments.english: And youth [is] [a] branch of madness, and wailing [is] from the deeds of the Age of Ignorance.

segments.arabic: وَمن النَّاس من لَا يَأْتِي الْجُمُعَة إِلَّا دبرا وَلَا يذكر الله إِلَّا هجرا
segments.english: And among people [are those] who do not come to the Friday [prayer] except late, and do not remember God except rarely.

segments.arabic: وَأعظم الْخَطَايَا الْكَذِب
segments.english: And the greatest of sins [is] lying.

segments.arabic: وَمن يعف يعف الله عَنهُ وَمن يَكْظِم الغيظ يأجره الله
segments.english: And whoever pardons, God pardons him. And whoever holds back [his] anger, God rewards him.

segments.arabic: وَمن يغْفر يغْفر الله لَهُ وَمن يصبر على الرزية يعقبه الله
segments.english: And whoever forgives, God forgives him. And whoever [is] patient through hardship, God compensates him.

segments.arabic: وَشر المكاسب كسب الرِّبَا وَشر المأكل مَال الْيَتِيم
segments.english: And the worst of earnings [is] the earning of usury, and the worst of food [is] the wealth of the orphan.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا يَكْفِي أحدكُم مَا قنعت بِهِ نَفسه
segments.english: And what suffices any of you [is] only what his self [is] content with.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا يصير إِلَى أَرْبَعَة أَذْرع
segments.english: And [he] only ends up in four arm-lengths [of ground].

segments.arabic: وَالْأَمر إِلَى آخِره وملاك الْعَمَل خواتمه
segments.english: And the matter [is judged] by its end, and the foundation of [a] deed [is] its conclusion.

segments.arabic: وأشرف الْمَوْت قتل الشُّهَدَاء
segments.english: And the noblest death [is] the killing of the martyrs.

segments.arabic: وَمن يستكبر يَضَعهُ الله وَمن يعْص الله يطع الشَّيْطَان
segments.english: And whoever [is] arrogant, God humbles him. And whoever disobeys God obeys Satan.

segments.arabic: يَنْبَغِي لحامل الْقُرْآن أَن يعرف بليله إِذا النَّاس نائمون
segments.english: It [is] fitting for the bearer of the Quran to be known by his night when people [are] sleeping,

segments.arabic: وبنهاره إِذا النَّاس مفطرون وبحزنه إِذا النَّاس يفرحون وببكائه إِذا النَّاس
segments.english: and by his day when people [are] eating, and by his sadness when people [are] rejoicing, and by his weeping when people [are]

segments.arabic: يَضْحَكُونَ وبصمته إِذا النَّاس يَخُوضُونَ وبخشوعه إِذا النَّاس يختالون
segments.english: they laugh, and by his silence when people engage [in idle talk], and by his humility when people strut proudly.

segments.arabic: وَيَنْبَغِي لحامل الْقُرْآن أَن يكون باكيا مَحْزُونا حكيما حَلِيمًا سكينا
segments.english: And it [is] fitting for the carrier of the Quran to be weeping, saddened, wise, forbearing, [and] calm.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يَنْبَغِي لحامل الْقُرْآن أَن يكون جَافيا وَلَا غافلا وَلَا سخابا وَلَا صياحا وَلَا حديدا
segments.english: And it [is] not fitting for the carrier of the Quran to be harsh, nor heedless, nor loud, nor shouting, nor sharp-tempered.

segments.arabic: من تطاول تعظّما حطّه الله وَمن تواضع تخشّعا رَفعه الله
segments.english: Whoever raises himself [out of] self-importance, God lowers him; and whoever humbles himself [out of] reverence, God raises him.

segments.arabic: وَإِن للْملك لمة وللشيطان لمة
segments.english: And indeed the angel has [a] touch, and the devil has [a] touch.

segments.arabic: الْملك إيعاد بِالْخَيرِ وتصديق بِالْحَقِّ فَإِذا رَأَيْتُمْ ذَلِك فاحمدوا الله
segments.english: The angel's [touch is a] promise of good and belief in the truth; so when you find that, then praise God.

segments.arabic: ولمة الشَّيْطَان إيعاد بِالشَّرِّ وَتَكْذيب بِالْحَقِّ فَإِذا رَأَيْتهمْ ذَلِك فتعوّذوا بِاللَّه
segments.english: And the devil's touch [is a] promise of evil and denial of the truth; so when you find that, then seek refuge in God.

segments.arabic: إِن النَّاس قد أَحْسنُوا القَوْل
segments.english: Indeed people have perfected [their] speech.

segments.arabic: فَمن وَافق قَوْله فعله فَذَاك الَّذِي أصَاب حظّه
segments.english: So whoever's speech matches his action — that [is] the one who has attained his share.

segments.arabic: وَمن خَالف قَوْله فعله فَذَاك إِنَّمَا يوبخ نَفسه
segments.english: And whoever's speech contradicts his action — that one [is] only rebuking himself.

segments.arabic: لَا أَلفَيْنِ أحدكُم جيفة ليل قطرب نَهَار
segments.english: Let me not find any of you [a] corpse [by] night [and a] restless roamer [by] day.

segments.arabic: إِنِّي لَا بغض الرجل أَن أرَاهُ فَارغًا لَيْسَ فِي شَيْء من عمل الدُّنْيَا وَلَا عمل الْآخِرَة
segments.english: Indeed I hate [it] for [a] man that I see him idle, not [engaged] in anything of the work of this world nor the work of the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَمن لم تَأمره الصَّلَاة بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَتَنْهَهُ عَن الْمُنكر لم يَزْدَدْ بهَا من الله بعدا
segments.english: And whoever [is] not commanded by his prayer to [do] good and forbidden from evil — [he] only increases in distance from God through it.

segments.arabic: من الْيَقِين أَن لَا ترضي النَّاس بسخط الله
segments.english: From certainty [is] that you do not please people by angering God,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تحمد أحدا على رزق الله وَلَا تلوم أحدا على مَا لم يؤتك الله
segments.english: and you do not praise anyone for the provision of God, and you do not blame anyone for what God did not give you.

segments.arabic: فَإِن رزق الله لَا يَسُوقهُ حرص حَرِيص وَلَا يردهُ كَرَاهَة كَارِه
segments.english: For indeed the provision of God — the greed of [a] greedy one does not drive it, nor does the dislike of one who dislikes turn it away.

segments.arabic: وَإِن الله بِقسْطِهِ وحلمه وعدله جعل الرّوح والفرح فِي الْيَقِين وَالرِّضَا
segments.english: And indeed God, by His justice, His forbearance, and His fairness, placed comfort and joy in certainty and contentment,

segments.arabic: وَجعل لَهُم والحزن فِي الشَّك والسخط
segments.english: and placed worry and sadness in doubt and displeasure.

segments.arabic: مَا دمت فِي صَلَاة فَأَنت تقرع بَاب الْملك وَمن يقرع بَاب الْملك يفتح لَهُ
segments.english: As long as you [are] in prayer, you [are] knocking [on] the door of the King; and whoever knocks [on] the door of the King — it [will be] opened for him.

segments.arabic: أَنِّي لَا حسب الرجل ينسى الْعلم كَانَ يُعلمهُ بالخطيئة يعملها
segments.english: Indeed I consider [that a] man does not forget knowledge he used to know except because of [a] sin he commits.

segments.arabic: كونُوا ينابيع الْعلم مصابيح الْهدى أحلاس الْبيُوت سرج اللَّيْل جدد الْقُلُوب خلقان الثِّيَاب
segments.english: Be springs of knowledge, lamps of guidance, [those who stay close to their] homes, lights of the night, [with] fresh hearts [and] worn-out clothes —

segments.arabic: تعرفُون فِي السَّمَاء وتخفون على أهل الأَرْض
segments.english: you [are] known in the heavens and hidden from the people of the earth.

segments.arabic: إِن للقلوب شَهْوَة وإدبارا فاغتنموها عِنْد شهوتها وإقبالها
segments.english: Indeed the hearts have eagerness and turning away; so seize them at [the time of] their eagerness and approach,

segments.arabic: ودعوها عِنْد فتفرقها وإدبارها
segments.english: and leave them at [the time of] their distraction and turning away.

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ الْعلم بِكَثْرَة الرِّوَايَة وَلَكِن الْعلم الخشية
segments.english: Knowledge [is] not [in] the abundance of narration, but rather knowledge [is] fear [of God].

segments.arabic: إِنَّكُم ترَوْنَ الْكَافِر من أصح النَّاس جسما وأمرضه قلبا
segments.english: Indeed you see the disbeliever [as] among the healthiest of people in body and the most diseased in heart,

segments.arabic: وتلقون الْمُؤمن من أصح النَّاس قلبا وأمرضه جسما
segments.english: and you find the believer [as] among the healthiest of people in heart and the most diseased in body.

segments.arabic: وأيم الله لَو مَرضت قُلُوبكُمْ وصحّت أجسامكم لكنتم أَهْون على الله من الْجعلَان
segments.english: And by God, if your hearts were sick and your bodies were healthy, you would be more worthless to God than dung beetles.

segments.arabic: لَا يبلغ العَبْد حَقِيقَة الْإِيمَان حَتَّى يحل بذروته
segments.english: The servant does not reach the reality of faith until he reaches its peak,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يحل بذروته حَتَّى يكون الْفقر أحب إِلَيْهِ من الْغنى والتواضع أحب إِلَيْهِ من الشّرف
segments.english: and he does not reach its peak until poverty [is] more beloved to him than wealth, and humility [is] more beloved to him than honor,

segments.arabic: وَحَتَّى يكون حامده وذامه وَعِنْده سواهُ
segments.english: and until the one who praises him and the one who blames him [are] equal to him.

segments.arabic: وَإِن الرجل ليخرج من بَيته وَمَعَهُ دينه فَيرجع وَمَا مَعَه مِنْهُ شَيْء
segments.english: And indeed [a] man leaves his house and with him [is] his religion, then he returns and nothing of it [is] with him.

segments.arabic: يَأْتِي الرجل وَلَا
segments.english: He comes to [a] man and [does] not —

segments.arabic: يملك لَهُ وَلَا نَفسه ضرا وَلَا نفعا
segments.english: [he] owns for him — nor [for] himself — neither harm nor benefit.

segments.arabic: فَيقسم لَهُ بِاللَّه أَنَّك لذيت وذويت
segments.english: So he swears to him by God: "You [are] such and such."

segments.arabic: فَيرجع وَمَا حبي من حَاجته بِشَيْء ويسخط الله عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: So he returns, and not [a] thing of his need has been fulfilled, and God [is] angry with him.

segments.arabic: لَو سخرت من كلب لَخَشِيت أَن أحوّل كَلْبا
segments.english: If I mocked [a] dog, I would fear being turned into [a] dog.

segments.arabic: الْإِثْم حوّاز الْقُلُوب
segments.english: Sin [is] what unsettles the hearts.

segments.arabic: مَا كَانَ من نظر فَإِن للشَّيْطَان فِيهَا مطمعا
segments.english: Whatever [it] was from [a] glance — then for Satan in it [there is] an opening.

segments.arabic: مَعَ كل فرحة ترحة
segments.english: With every joy [there is] [a] sorrow.

segments.arabic: وَمَا ملىء بَيت حبرَة الاملئ عِبْرَة
segments.english: And no house [is] filled with happiness except [it is] filled with grief.

segments.arabic: وَمَا مِنْكُم إِلَّا ضيف وَمَاله عَارِية
segments.english: And none of you [is] but [a] guest, and his wealth [is] [a] borrowed thing.

segments.arabic: فالضيف مرتحل وَالْعَارِية مُؤَدَّاة إِلَى أَهلهَا
segments.english: So the guest [will] depart, and the borrowed thing [will be] returned to its owners.

segments.arabic: يكون فِي آخر الزَّمَان أقوم أفضل أَعْمَالهم التلاوم بَينهم يسمون الأنتان
segments.english: [There] will be at the end of time peoples — the best of their deeds [is] blaming one another; they [are] called the filthy ones.

segments.arabic: إِذا أحب الرجل أَن ينصف من نَفسه فليأت إِلَى النَّاس الَّذِي يحب أَن يُؤْتى إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: If [a] man loves to be fair with himself, let him come to people [with] what he loves to be brought to him.

segments.arabic: الْحق ثقيل مريء وَالْبَاطِل خَفِيف وَبِي
segments.english: The truth [is] heavy [but] wholesome, and falsehood [is] light [but] harmful.

segments.arabic: رب شَهْوَة تورث حزنا طَويلا
segments.english: How many [a] desire brings about long sadness.

segments.arabic: مَا على وَجه الأَرْض شَيْء أحْوج إِلَى طول سجن من لِسَان
segments.english: [There is] nothing on the face of the earth more in need of long imprisonment than [a] tongue.

segments.arabic: إِذا ظهر الزِّنَا والربا فِي قَرْيَة أذن بهلاكها
segments.english: When adultery and usury appear in [a] town, [they have] invited its destruction.

segments.arabic: من اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُم أَن يَجْعَل كنزه فِي السَّمَاء حَيْثُ لَا يَأْكُلهُ السوس وَلَا يَنَالهُ السراق فَلْيفْعَل
segments.english: Whoever among you [is] able to place his treasure in the sky — where moths do not eat it and thieves do not reach it — let him do so.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قلب الرجل مَعَ كنزه
segments.english: For the heart of [a] man [is] with his treasure.

segments.arabic: لَا يقلدون أحدكُم دينه رجلا
segments.english: Let not any of you hand over his religion to [a] man.

segments.arabic: فَإِن آمن آمن وَإِن كفر كفر
segments.english: For if he believed, [he] believed, and if he disbelieved, [he] disbelieved.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كُنْتُم لَا بُد مقتدين فاقتدوا بِالْمَيتِ فَإِن الْحَيّ لَا تؤمن عَلَيْهِ الْفِتْنَة
segments.english: And if you must follow [someone], then follow the dead, for the living [is] not safe from trial.

segments.arabic: لَا يكن أحدكُم أمعة
segments.english: Let not any of you be [a] yes-man.

segments.arabic: قَالُوا وَمَا الأمعة
segments.english: They said: "And what [is] [a] yes-man?"

segments.arabic: قَالَ يَقُول أَنا مَعَ النَّاس إِن اهتدوا اهتديت وَإِن ضلوا ضللت
segments.english: He said: "[He who] says: 'I [am] with the people — if they [are] guided, I [am] guided, and if they go astray, I go astray.'"

segments.arabic: أَلا ليوطن أحدكُم نَفسه على أَنه إِن كفر النَّاس لَا يكفر
segments.english: Indeed, let each of you prepare himself — that if the people disbelieve, he [will] not disbelieve.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ لَهُ رجل عَلمنِي كَلِمَات جَوَامِع نوافع
segments.english: And [a] man said to him: "Teach me words [that are] comprehensive [and] beneficial."

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ اعبد الله لَا تشرك بِهِ شَيْئا
segments.english: So he said: "Worship God — do not associate anything with Him.

segments.arabic: وَزَل مَعَ الْقُرْآن حَيْثُ زَالَ
