segments.english: And move with the Quran wherever it moves.

segments.arabic: وَمن جَاءَك بِالْحَقِّ فاقبل مِنْهُ وَإِن كَانَ بَعيدا بغيضا
segments.english: And whoever comes to you with the truth, accept [it] from him, even if he [was] distant [and] hateful.

segments.arabic: وَمن جَاءَك بِالْبَاطِلِ فاردد عَلَيْهِ وَإِن كَانَ حبيبا قَرِيبا
segments.english: And whoever comes to you with falsehood, reject [it] from him, even if he [was] beloved [and] close."

segments.arabic: يُؤْتى بِالْعَبدِ يَوْم الْقِيَامَة فَيُقَال لَهُ أد أمانتك
segments.english: The servant [will be] brought on the Day of Judgment, and it [will be] said to him: "Return your trust."

segments.arabic: فَيَقُول يَا رب من أَيْن وَقد ذهبت الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: So he says: "O Lord, from where? This world has [already] gone."

segments.arabic: فتمثل على هيئتها يَوْم أَخذهَا فِي قَعْر جَهَنَّم
segments.english: So it [is] made to appear in its form [from] the day he took it, at the bottom of Hell.

segments.arabic: فيزل فيأخدها فَيَضَعهَا على عَاتِقه
segments.english: So he goes down and takes it and places it on his shoulder.

segments.arabic: فيصعد بهَا حَتَّى إِذا ظن أَنه خَارج بنها هوت وَهوى فِي أَثَرهَا أَبَد الآبدين
segments.english: And he climbs with it, until when he thinks he [is] coming out with it, it falls — and he falls after it for all eternity.

segments.arabic: أطلب قَلْبك فِي ثَلَاثَة مَوَاطِن
segments.english: Seek your heart in three places:

segments.arabic: عِنْد سَماع الْقُرْآن وَفِي مجَالِس الذّكر وَفِي أَوْقَات الْخلْوَة
segments.english: when hearing the Quran, and in gatherings of remembrance, and in times of solitude.

segments.arabic: فَإِن لم تَجدهُ فِي هَذِه المواطن فسل الله أَن
segments.english: And if you do not find it in these places, then ask God to —

headings.arabic: فصل لا يجتمع الإخلاص في القلب ومحبة المدح والثناء والطمع فيما عند
headings.english: Section: Sincerity does not gather in the heart [along] with love of praise, compliments, and greed for what [is] with [people]

segments.arabic: يمنّ عَلَيْك بقلب فَإِنَّهُ لَا قلب لَك
segments.english: [He] blesses you with [a] heart, for indeed you have no heart.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْجُنَيْد دخلت على شَاب فَسَأَلَنِي عَن التَّوْبَة فأجبته
segments.english: Al-Junayd said: I entered upon [a] young man, and he asked me about repentance, so I answered him.

segments.arabic: فَسَأَلَنِي عَن حَقِيقَتهَا فَقلت أَن تنصب ذَنْبك بَين عَيْنَيْك حَتَّى يَأْتِيك الْمَوْت
segments.english: Then he asked me about its reality, so I said: that you place your sin before your eyes until death comes to you.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ لي مَه مَا هَذَا حَقِيقَة التَّوْبَة
segments.english: So he said to me: Stop! This [is] not the reality of repentance.

segments.arabic: فَقلت لَهُ فَمَا حَقِيقَة التَّوْبَة عنْدك يَا فَتى
segments.english: So I said to him: Then what [is] the reality of repentance according to you, O young man?

segments.arabic: قَالَ أَن تنسى ذَنْبك وَتَرَكَنِي وَمضى
segments.english: He said: That you forget your sin. And he left me and went away.

segments.arabic: فَكيف هُوَ عنْدك يَا أَبَا قَاسم
segments.english: So how [is] it according to you, O Abu al-Qasim?

segments.arabic: فَقلت القَوْل مَا قَالَ الْفَتى
segments.english: So I said: The [correct] saying [is] what the young man said.

segments.arabic: قَالَ كَيفَ
segments.english: He said: How so?

segments.arabic: قلت إِذا كنت مَعَه فِي حَال ثمَّ نقلني من حَال الجفا إِلَى حَال الوفا
segments.english: I said: If I was with Him in [a] state, then He moved me from the state of estrangement to the state of faithfulness,

segments.arabic: فذكرني للجفا فِي حَال الوفا جَفا
segments.english: then reminding me of estrangement in the state of faithfulness [is itself] estrangement.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Section

segments.arabic: لَا يجْتَمع الْإِخْلَاص فِي الْقلب ومحبة الْمَدْح وَالثنَاء والطمع فِيمَا عِنْد النَّاس
segments.english: Sincerity does not gather in the heart [along] with love of praise and compliments, and greed for what [is] with people,

segments.arabic: إِلَّا كَمَا يجْتَمع المَاء وَالنَّار والضب والحوت
segments.english: except like water and fire gather, or the lizard and the whale.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا حدثتك نَفسك بِطَلَب الْإِخْلَاص فَأقبل على الطمع أَولا فاذبحه بسكين الْيَأْس
segments.english: So if your self tells you to seek sincerity, then turn to greed first and slaughter it with the knife of despair.

segments.arabic: وَأَقْبل على الْمَدْح وَالثنَاء فازهد فيهمَا زهد عشّاق الدُّنْيَا فِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: And turn to praise and compliments, and renounce them [as] the lovers of this world renounce the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا استقام لَك ذبح الطمع والزهد فِي الثَّنَاء والمدح سهل عَلَيْك الْإِخْلَاص
segments.english: So if the slaughtering of greed and the renouncing of compliments and praise becomes steady for you, sincerity [will] become easy for you.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قلت وَمَا الَّذِي يسهّل عَليّ ذبح الطمع والزهد فِي الثَّنَاء والمدح
segments.english: If you say: What [is it that] makes the slaughtering of greed and renouncing of compliments and praise easy for me?

segments.arabic: قلت أما ذبح الطمع فيسهله عَلَيْك علمك يَقِينا أَنه لَيْسَ من شَيْء يطْمع فِيهِ
segments.english: I say: As for slaughtering greed, what makes it easy for you [is] your knowledge with certainty that there [is] nothing that [is] desired

segments.arabic: إِلَّا وبيد الله وَحده خزائنه لَا يملكهَا غَيره
segments.english: except that its treasuries [are] in the hand of God alone — no one else possesses them,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يُؤْتى العَبْد مِنْهَا شَيْئا سواهُ
segments.english: and no one gives the servant anything from them except Him.

segments.arabic: وَأما الزهد فِي الثَّنَاء والمدح فيسهله عَلَيْك علمك أَنه لَيْسَ أحد ينفع مدحه ويزين ويضر ذمه ويشين إِلَّا الله وَحده
segments.english: As for renouncing compliments and praise, what makes it easy for you [is] your knowledge that there [is] no one whose praise benefits and beautifies, and whose blame harms and disgraces, except God alone.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ ذَلِك الْأَعرَابِي للنَّبِي إِن مدحي زين وذمي شَيْن
segments.english: As that Bedouin said to the Prophet: My praise [is a] beauty and my blame [is a] disgrace.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ ذَلِك الله ﷿
segments.english: So he said: That [is for] God, Mighty and Majestic.

segments.arabic: فازهد فِي مدح من لَا يزينك مدحه وَفِي ذمّ من لَا يشينك ذمه
segments.english: So renounce the praise of the one whose praise does not beautify you, and the blame of the one whose blame does not disgrace you.

segments.arabic: وارغب فِي مدح من كل الزين فِي مدحه وكل الشين فِي ذمه
segments.english: And desire the praise of the One in whose praise [is] all beauty and in whose blame [is] all disgrace.

segments.arabic: وَلنْ يقدر على ذَلِك إِلَّا بِالصبرِ وَالْيَقِين
segments.english: And you will never be able to do that except with patience and certainty.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى فقدت الصَّبْر وَالْيَقِين كنت كمن أَرَادَ السّفر فِي الْبَحْر فِي غير مركب
segments.english: So whenever you lose patience and certainty, you [will be] like one who wanted to travel the sea without [a] vessel.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
segments.english: So be patient; indeed the promise of God [is] true, and let not those who have no certainty make you unsteady.
segments.sahih_international: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا وَكَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
segments.english: And We made from among them leaders who guide by Our command, when they were patient and had certainty in Our signs.
segments.sahih_international: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.

headings.arabic: فصل لذة كل أحد على حسب قدره وهمته وشرف نفسه فأشرف الناس نفسا
headings.english: Chapter: The pleasure of each person [is] according to his worth, his ambition, and the nobility of his self — the noblest of people in self

segments.arabic: فَأَشْرَف النَّاس نفسا وَأَعْلَاهُمْ همّة وأرفعهم قدرا
segments.english: So the noblest of people in self, the highest of them in ambition, and the most elevated of them in worth

segments.arabic: من لذّته فِي معرفَة الله ومحبته والشوق إِلَى لِقَائِه
segments.english: [is] the one whose pleasure [is] in knowing God, loving Him, and longing to meet Him

segments.arabic: والتودد إِلَيْهِ بِمَا يُحِبهُ ويرضاه
segments.english: and drawing close to Him with what He loves and [is] pleased with

segments.arabic: فلذته فِي إقباله عَلَيْهِ وعكوف همته عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: so his pleasure [is] in turning toward Him and devoting his ambition to Him

segments.arabic: وَدون ذَلِك مَرَاتِب لَا يحصيها إِلَّا الله
segments.english: and below that [are] ranks that none can count except God

segments.arabic: حَتَّى تَنْتَهِي إِلَى من لذته فِي أخس الْأَشْيَاء من القاذورات وَالْفَوَاحِش
segments.english: until [they] reach the one whose pleasure [is] in the lowest of things — filth and shameful acts

segments.arabic: فِي كل شَيْء من الْكَلَام والفعال والأشغال
segments.english: in everything — speech, actions, and activities

segments.arabic: فَلَو عرضت عَلَيْهِ مَا يلتذ بِهِ الأول لم تسمح نَفسه بقبوله وَلَا الِالْتِفَات إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: so if what the first one takes pleasure in were offered to him, his self would not allow [itself] to accept it or pay attention to it

segments.arabic: وَرُبمَا تألمت من ذَلِك
segments.english: and perhaps [it] would feel pain from that

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن الأول إِذا عرض عَلَيْهِ مَا يلتذ بِهِ هَذَا لم تسمح نَفسه بِهِ
segments.english: just as the first one, if what this one takes pleasure in were offered to him, his self would not accept it

segments.arabic: وَلم تلْتَفت إِلَيْهِ ونفرت نَفسه مِنْهُ
segments.english: and would not turn to it, and his self would recoil from it

segments.arabic: وأكمل النَّاس لَذَّة من جمع لَهُ بَين لَذَّة الْقلب وَالروح وَلَذَّة الْبدن
segments.english: and the most complete of people in pleasure [is] the one who combined for himself the pleasure of the heart and spirit with the pleasure of the body

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ يتَنَاوَل لذاته الْمُبَاحَة على وَجه لَا ينقص حَظه من الدَّار الْآخِرَة
segments.english: so he takes his permissible pleasures in a way that does not decrease his share of the Hereafter

segments.arabic: وَلَا يقطع عَلَيْهِ لَذَّة الْمعرفَة والمحبة والأنس بربه
segments.english: and does not cut off from him the pleasure of knowing, love, and comfort with his Lord

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا مِمَّن قَالَ تَعَالَى فِيهِ
segments.english: so this [person is] among those about whom [God] Most High said

segments.arabic: قُلْ مَنْ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِ وَالطَّيِّبَاتِ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ
segments.english: Say: who [has] forbidden the adornment of God which He brought out for His servants, and the good things of provision?
segments.sahih_international: Say, "Who has forbidden the adornment of Allah which He has produced for His servants and the good [lawful] things of provision?" Say, "They are for those who believe during the worldly life [but] exclusively for them on the Day of Resurrection." Thus do We detail the verses for a people who know.

segments.arabic: قل هِيَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا خَالِصَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
segments.english: Say: they [are] for those who believed in the life of this world, purely [theirs] on the Day of Judgment

segments.arabic: وأبخسهم حظا من اللَّذَّة من تنَاولهَا على وَجه يحول بَينه وَبَين لذات الْآخِرَة
segments.english: and the most deprived of them of pleasure [is] the one who took it in a way that blocks between him and the pleasures of the Hereafter

segments.arabic: فَيكون مِمَّن يُقَال لَهُم يَوْم اسْتِيفَاء اللَّذَّات
segments.english: so he becomes among those to whom [it is] said on the day of completing [all] pleasures

segments.arabic: أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَاتِكُمْ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَاسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِهَا
segments.english: You used up your good things in your worldly life and [you] enjoyed them
segments.sahih_international: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."

segments.arabic: فَهَؤُلَاءِ تمَتَّعُوا بالطيبات وَأُولَئِكَ تمَتَّعُوا بالطيبات
segments.english: so these ones enjoyed the good things and those ones enjoyed the good things

segments.arabic: وافترقوا فِي وَجه التَّمَتُّع
segments.english: but they differed in the way of enjoyment

segments.arabic: فَأُولَئِك تمَتَّعُوا بهَا على الْوَجْه الَّذِي أذن لَهُم فِيهِ
segments.english: so those ones enjoyed them in the way that [was] permitted for them

segments.arabic: فَجمع لَهُم بَين لَذَّة الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: so [He] combined for them the pleasure of this world and the Hereafter

segments.arabic: وَهَؤُلَاء تمَتَّعُوا بهَا على الْوَجْه الَّذِي دعاهم إِلَيْهِ الْهوى والشهوة
segments.english: and these ones enjoyed them in the way that desire and appetite called them to

segments.arabic: وَسَوَاء أذن لَهُم فِيهِ أم لَا
segments.english: whether [it was] permitted for them or not

segments.arabic: فَانْقَطَعت عَنْهُم لَذَّة الدُّنْيَا وفاتتهم لَذَّة الْآخِرَة
segments.english: so the pleasure of this world was cut off from them and the pleasure of the Hereafter escaped them

segments.arabic: فَلَا لَذَّة الدُّنْيَا دَامَت لَهُم وَلَا لَذَّة الْآخِرَة حصلت لَهُم
segments.english: so neither [did] the pleasure of this world last for them, nor [did] the pleasure of the Hereafter come to them

segments.arabic: فَمن أحب اللَّذَّة ودوامها والعيش الطيّب
segments.english: so whoever loved pleasure, its lasting, and the good life

segments.arabic: فليجعل لَذَّة الدُّنْيَا موصلا لَهُ إِلَى لَذَّة الْآخِرَة
segments.english: let him make the pleasure of this world a means for him to the pleasure of the Hereafter

segments.arabic: بِأَن يَسْتَعِين بهَا على فرَاغ قلبه لله وإرادته وعبادته
segments.english: by seeking help through it to free his heart for God, [for] seeking Him, and [for] worshipping Him

segments.arabic: فيتناولها بِحكم الِاسْتِعَانَة وَالْقُوَّة على طلبه
segments.english: so he takes it with the purpose of seeking help and strength for his pursuit [of God]

segments.arabic: لَا بِحكم مُجَرّد الشَّهْوَة والهوى
segments.english: not with the purpose of mere appetite and desire

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ مِمَّن زويت عَنهُ لذات الدُّنْيَا وطيباتها
segments.english: and if he [is] among those from whom the pleasures of this world and its good things have been withheld

segments.arabic: فليجعل مَا نقص مِنْهَا زِيَادَة فِي
segments.english: let him make what decreased of them an increase in

segments.arabic: لَذَّة الْآخِرَة ويجم نَفسه هَهُنَا بِالتّرْكِ ليستوفيها كَامِلَة هُنَاكَ
segments.english: the pleasure of the Hereafter, and [he] holds back himself here by leaving [it], so that he may receive it completely there.

segments.arabic: فطيبات الدُّنْيَا ولذاتها نعم العون لمن صَحَّ طلبه لله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة وَكَانَت همه لما هُنَاكَ
segments.english: So the good things of this world and its pleasures [are] an excellent aid for whoever [has] a sound pursuit of God and the Hereafter, and [whose] concern was for what [is] there.

segments.arabic: وَبئسَ الْقَاطِع لمن كَانَت هِيَ مَقْصُوده وهمته وحولها يدندن
segments.english: And [they are] a terrible obstacle for whoever they were his goal and his concern, and around them he hovers.

segments.arabic: وفواتها فِي الدُّنْيَا نعم العون لطَالب الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة
segments.english: And missing them in this world [is] an excellent aid for the seeker of God and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: وَبئسَ الْقَاطِع النازع من الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة
segments.english: and [is] a terrible thing that pulls [one] away from God and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: فَمن أَخذ مَنَافِع الدُّنْيَا على وَجه لَا ينقص حَظه من الْآخِرَة ظفر بهما جَمِيعًا
segments.english: So whoever took the benefits of this world in a way [that] does not reduce his share of the Hereafter, [he] won them both together.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا خسرهما جَمِيعًا
segments.english: And if not, [he] lost them both together.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الله رب الْعَالمين
segments.english: Glorified [is] God, Lord of all the worlds!

segments.arabic: لَو لم يكن فِي ترك الذُّنُوب والمعاصي إِلَّا إِقَامَة الْمُرُوءَة وصون الْعرض وَحفظ الجاه
segments.english: If there were nothing in leaving sins and disobedience except upholding one's dignity, protecting one's honor, and preserving one's standing,

segments.arabic: وصيانة المَال الَّذِي جعله الله قواما لمصَالح الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: and safeguarding the wealth that God made [a] foundation for the interests of this world and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: ومحبة الْخلق وَجوَار القَوْل بَينهم وَصَلَاح المعاش وراحة الْبدن وَقُوَّة الْقلب وَطيب النَّفس ونعيم الْقلب وانشراح الصَّدْر
segments.english: and the love of [the] people, and good speech among them, and soundness of livelihood, and comfort of the body, and strength of the heart, and goodness of the self, and delight of the heart, and openness of the chest,

segments.arabic: والأمن من مخاوف الْفُسَّاق والفجار وَقلة الْهم وَالْغَم والحزن
segments.english: and safety from the fears of the sinners and the wicked, and less worry, grief, and sadness,

segments.arabic: وَعز النَّفس عَن احْتِمَال الذل وصون نور الْقلب أَن تطفئه ظلمَة الْمعْصِيَة
segments.english: and the honor of the self from bearing humiliation, and protecting the light of the heart from the darkness of sin putting it out,

segments.arabic: وَحُصُول الْمخْرج لَهُ مِمَّا ضَاقَ على الْفُسَّاق والفجار
segments.english: and finding a way out from what [is] difficult for the sinners and the wicked,

segments.arabic: وتيسر الرزق عَلَيْهِ من حَيْثُ لَا يحْتَسب
segments.english: and provision being made easy for him from where he does not expect,

segments.arabic: وتيسير مَا عسر على أَرْبَاب الفسوق والمعاصي وتسهيل الطَّاعَات عَلَيْهِ وتيسير الْعلم
segments.english: and easing of what [is] hard for the people of wickedness and disobedience, and making obedience easy for him, and easing of knowledge,

segments.arabic: وَالثنَاء الْحسن فِي النَّاس وَكَثْرَة الدُّعَاء لَهُ
segments.english: and good praise among the people, and many prayers for him,

segments.arabic: والحلاوة الَّتِي يكتسبها وَجهه المهابة الَّتِي تلقى لَهُ فِي قُلُوب النَّاس
segments.english: and the sweetness that his face gains, [and] the awe that [is] placed for him in the hearts of the people,

segments.arabic: وانتصارهم وحميتهم لَهُ إِذا أوذي وظلم وذبهم عَن عرضه إِذا اغتابه مغتاب
segments.english: and their support and defense of him when he [is] harmed and wronged, and their protection of his honor when [a] backbiter backbites him,

segments.arabic: وَسُرْعَة إِجَابَة دُعَائِهِ وَزَوَال الوحشة الَّتِي بَينه وَبَين الله
segments.english: and the quickness of his prayer being answered, and the removal of the loneliness that [is] between him and God,

segments.arabic: وَقرب الْمَلَائِكَة مِنْهُ وَبعد شياطين الْإِنْس وَالْجِنّ مِنْهُ
segments.english: and the closeness of the angels to him, and the distance of the devils of mankind and jinn from him,

segments.arabic: وتنافس النَّاس على خدمته وَقَضَاء حَوَائِجه وخطبتهم لمودته وصحبته
segments.english: and the people competing to serve him and fulfill his needs, and their seeking of his friendship and companionship,

segments.arabic: وَعدم خَوفه من الْمَوْت بل يفرح بِهِ لقدومه على ربه ولقائه لَهُ ومصيره إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and his lack of fear of death — rather he [is] happy with it, because of his coming to his Lord, and meeting Him, and his return to Him,

segments.arabic: وَصغر الدُّنْيَا فِي قلبه وَكبر الْآخِرَة عِنْده
segments.english: and the smallness of this world in his heart, and the greatness of the Hereafter in his [view],

segments.arabic: وحرصه على الْملك الْكَبِير والفوز الْعَظِيم فِيهَا
segments.english: and his eagerness for the great kingdom and the mighty success in it,

segments.arabic: وذوق حلاوة الطَّاعَة وَوجد حلاوة الْإِيمَان
segments.english: and tasting the sweetness of obedience, and finding the sweetness of faith,

segments.arabic: وَدُعَاء حَملَة الْعَرْش وَمن حوله من الْمَلَائِكَة لَهُ
segments.english: and the prayer of the bearers of the Throne and those around it from the angels for him,

segments.arabic: وَفَرح الْكَاتِبين بِهِ ودعائهم لَهُ كل وَقت
segments.english: and the joy of the recording [angels] with him, and their prayers for him at every moment,

segments.arabic: وَالزِّيَادَة فِي عقله وفهمه وإيمانه ومعرفته
segments.english: and the increase in his mind, his understanding, his faith, and his knowledge,

segments.arabic: وَحُصُول محبَّة الله لَهُ وإقباله عَلَيْهِ وفرحه بتوبته
segments.english: and the gaining of God's love for him, and His turning to him, and His joy at his repentance —

segments.arabic: وَهَكَذَا يجازيه بفرح وسرور لَا نِسْبَة لَهُ إِلَى فرحه وسروره بالمعصية بِوَجْه من الْوُجُوه
segments.english: and so He rewards him with [a] joy and happiness [that] has no comparison to his joy and happiness with sin, in any way.

headings.arabic: فصل ذكر ابن سعد في الطبقات عن عمر بن عبد العزيز أنه كان
headings.english: Section: Ibn Sa'd mentioned in al-Tabaqat about Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz that he used to —

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ بعض آثَار ترك الْمعاصِي فِي الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: So these [are] some of the effects of leaving sins in this world.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا مَاتَ تَلَقَّتْهُ الْمَلَائِكَة بالبشرى من ربه بِالْجنَّةِ
segments.english: And when he dies, the angels meet him with glad tidings from his Lord of Paradise,

segments.arabic: وَبِأَنَّهُ لَا خوف عَلَيْهِ وَلَا حزن
segments.english: and that [there is] no fear upon him and no grief.

segments.arabic: وينتقل من سجن الدُّنْيَا وضيقها إِلَى رَوْضَة من رياض الْجنَّة
segments.english: And he moves from the prison of this world and its tightness to [a] garden from the gardens of Paradise,

segments.arabic: ينعم فِيهَا إِلَى يَوْم الْقِيَامَة
segments.english: enjoying [himself] in it until the Day of Judgment.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَ يَوْم الْقِيَامَة كَانَ النَّاس فِي الْحر والعرق وَهُوَ فِي ظلّ الْعَرْش
segments.english: And when [it is] the Day of Judgment, the people [are] in the heat and the sweat, while he [is] in the shade of the Throne.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا انصرفوا من بَين يَدي الله أَخذ بِهِ ذَات الْيَمين مَعَ أوليائه الْمُتَّقِينَ وَحزبه المفلحين
segments.english: And when they depart from before God, he [is] taken to the right with His God-conscious allies and His successful party.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو فضل عَظِيم
segments.english: And that [is] the bounty of God — He gives it to whom He wills, and God [is] the possessor of [a] great bounty.
segments.sahih_international: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty.

segments.arabic: إِذا خطب على الْمِنْبَر فخاف على نَفسه الْعجب قطعه
segments.english: when he gave [a] sermon on the pulpit and feared self-admiration upon himself, he [would] cut it short.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا كتب كتابا فخاف فِيهِ الْعجب مزقه
segments.english: And when he wrote [a] letter and feared self-admiration in it, he [would] tear it up.

segments.arabic: وَيَقُول اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أعوذ بك من شَرّ نَفسِي
segments.english: And he [would] say: O God, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my self.

segments.arabic: اعْلَم أَن العَبْد إِذا شرع فِي قَول أَو عمل يَبْتَغِي فِيهِ مرضاة الله
segments.english: Know that the servant, when he begins [a] saying or [a] deed seeking in it the pleasure of God,

segments.arabic: مطالعا فِيهِ منَّة الله عَلَيْهِ بِهِ وتوفيقه لَهُ فِيهِ
segments.english: observing in it the favor of God upon him through it, and His enabling of him in it,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه بِاللَّه لَا بِنَفسِهِ وَلَا بمعرفته وفكره وَحَوله وقوته
segments.english: and that it [is] by God, not by himself, nor by his knowledge, his thinking, his ability, or his strength,

segments.arabic: بل هُوَ بِالَّذِي أنشأ لَهُ اللِّسَان وَالْقلب وَالْعين وَالْأُذن
segments.english: rather it [is] by the One who created for him the tongue, the heart, the eye, and the ear —

segments.arabic: فَالَّذِي منّ عَلَيْهِ بذلك هُوَ الَّذِي منّ عَلَيْهِ بالْقَوْل وَالْفِعْل
segments.english: so the One who favored him with that [is] the One who favored him with the speech and the action.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا لم يغب ذَلِك عَن ملاحظته وَنظر قلبه لم يحضرهُ الْعجب
segments.english: So when that does not leave his awareness and the sight of his heart, self-admiration does not come to him —

segments.arabic: الَّذِي أَصله رُؤْيَة نَفسه وغيبته عَن شُهُود منّة ربه وتوفيقه وإعانته
segments.english: which [has] its root [in] seeing himself and his absence from witnessing the favor of his Lord, His enabling, and His aid.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا غَابَ عَن تِلْكَ الملاحظة وَثَبت النَّفس وَقَامَت فِي مقَام الدَّعْوَى
segments.english: But when he [is] absent from that awareness, and the self stands firm and rises in the station of [false] claim,

segments.arabic: فَوَقع الْعجب ففسد عَلَيْهِ القَوْل وَالْعَمَل
segments.english: then self-admiration falls [upon him], and the speech and the deed [are] ruined for him.

segments.arabic: فَتَارَة يُحَال بَينه وَبَين تَمَامه وَيقطع عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: So sometimes [a barrier is] placed between him and its completion, and it [is] cut off from him,

segments.arabic: وَيكون ذَلِك رَحْمَة بِهِ حَتَّى لَا يغيب عَن مُشَاهدَة المنّة والتوفيق
segments.english: and that [is] [a] mercy for him, so that he does not become absent from witnessing the favor and the enabling.

segments.arabic: وَتارَة يتم لَهُ وَلَكِن لَا يكون لَهُ ثَمَرَة
segments.english: And sometimes it [is] completed for him, but it has no fruit.

segments.arabic: وَإِن أثمر أثمر ثَمَرَة ضَعِيفَة غير محصلة للمقصود
segments.english: And if it bears fruit, it bears [a] weak fruit that does not achieve the goal.

segments.arabic: وَتارَة يكون ضَرَره عَلَيْهِ أعظم من انتفاعه
segments.english: And sometimes its harm upon him [is] greater than its benefit,

segments.arabic: ويتولد لَهُ مِنْهُ مفاسد شتّى
segments.english: and there [are] born for him from it various corruptions,

segments.arabic: بِحَسب غيبته عَن مُلَاحظَة التَّوْفِيق والمنّة ورؤية نَفسه وَأَن القَوْل وَالْفِعْل بِهِ
segments.english: according to his absence from observing the enabling and the favor, and his seeing [of] himself — and that the speech and the action [are] by him.

segments.arabic: وَمن هَذَا الْموضع يصلح الله سُبْحَانَهُ أَقْوَال عَبده وأعماله ويعظم لَهُ ثَمَرَتهَا
segments.english: And from this point, God — glorified [is] He — corrects the words of His servant and his deeds, and makes great for him their fruit,

segments.arabic: أَو يُفْسِدهَا عَلَيْهِ ويمنعه ثَمَرَتهَا
segments.english: or ruins them for him and prevents him [from] their fruit.

segments.arabic: فَلَا شَيْء أفسد للأعمال من الْعجب ورؤية النَّفس
segments.english: So nothing [is] more ruinous to deeds than self-admiration and seeing the self.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أَرَادَ الله
segments.english: And when God wants —

headings.arabic: فصل الوصول إلى المطلوب موقوف على هجر العوائد وقطع العوائق فالعوائد
headings.english: Chapter: Reaching the goal [is] dependent on abandoning habits and cutting off obstacles. As for habits:

segments.arabic: بعده خيرا أشهده منّته وتوفيقه وإعانته لَهُ فِي كل مَا يَقُوله ويفعله فَلَا يعجب بِهِ
segments.english: after it [any] good, He shows him His favor and His guidance and His help to him in everything he says and does, so he [does] not become impressed by it.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أشهده تَقْصِيره فِيهِ وَأَنه لَا يرضى لرَبه بِهِ
segments.english: Then He shows him his falling short in it, and that he [is] not satisfied for his Lord with it,

segments.arabic: فيتوب إِلَيْهِ مِنْهُ ويستغفره ويستحي أَن يطْلب عَلَيْهِ أجرا
segments.english: so he repents to Him from it and seeks His forgiveness and [is] shy to ask for [a] reward for it.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا لم يشهده ذَلِك وغيّبه عَنهُ فَرَأى نَفسه فِي الْعَمَل وَرَآهُ بِعَين الْكَمَال وَالرِّضَا
segments.english: And if He does not show him that and hides it from him, so he sees himself in the deed and sees it with the eye of perfection and satisfaction,

segments.arabic: لم يَقع ذَلِك الْعَمَل مِنْهُ موقع الْقبُول وَالرِّضَا والمحبة
segments.english: that deed [will] not land from him [in] the place of acceptance and satisfaction and love.

segments.arabic: فالعارف يعْمل الْعَمَل لوجه مشاهدا فِيهِ منّته وفضله وتوفيقه
segments.english: So the knower does the deed for [God's] face, witnessing in it His favor and His grace and His guidance,

segments.arabic: معتذرا مِنْهُ إِلَيْهِ مستحييا مِنْهُ إِذْ لم يوفه حَقه
segments.english: apologizing for it to Him, shy of it since he did not give it its due right.

segments.arabic: وَالْجَاهِل يعْمل الْعَمَل لحظه وهواه نَاظرا فِيهِ إِلَى نَفسه
segments.english: And the ignorant one does the deed for his own share and his desire, looking in it at himself,

segments.arabic: يمنّ بِهِ على ربه رَاضِيا بِعَمَلِهِ
segments.english: showing favor with it upon his Lord, satisfied with his deed.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا لون وَذَاكَ لون آخر
segments.english: So this [is one] shade and that [is] another shade.

segments.arabic: السّكُون إِلَى الدعة والراحة وَمَا أَلفه النَّاس واعتادوه من الرسوم والأوضاع
segments.english: [They are] settling into comfort and ease, and what people have become familiar with and accustomed to of customs and practices,

segments.arabic: الَّتِي جعلوها بِمَنْزِلَة الشَّرْع المتّبع بل هِيَ عِنْدهم أعظم من الشَّرْع
segments.english: which they have made at the level of the followed sacred law — rather, they [are] to them greater than the sacred law.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُم يُنكرُونَ على من خرج عَنْهَا وخالفها مَا لَا يُنكرُونَ على من خَالف صَرِيح الشَّرْع
segments.english: For they condemn whoever goes against them and opposes them [with] what they [do] not condemn [in] whoever opposes the clear sacred law.

segments.arabic: وَرُبمَا كفّروه أَو بدّعوه وضلّلوه أَو هجروه وعاقبوه لمُخَالفَة تِلْكَ الرسوم
segments.english: And perhaps they declare him [a] disbeliever or declare him [an] innovator and declare him misguided, or they boycott him and punish him for opposing those customs.

segments.arabic: وأماتوا لَهَا السّنَن ونصبوها أندادا للرسول يوالون عَلَيْهَا ويعادون
segments.english: And they killed the prophetic traditions for their sake and set them up [as] rivals to the Messenger — they ally based on them and show enmity [based on them].

segments.arabic: فالمعروف عِنْدهم مَا وافقهم وَالْمُنكر مَا خالفها
segments.english: So the good to them [is] what agrees with them, and the wrong [is] what opposes them.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه الأوضاع والرسوم قد استولت على طوائف بني آدم
segments.english: And these practices and customs have taken over groups of the children of Adam —

segments.arabic: من الْمُلُوك والولاة وَالْفُقَهَاء والصوفية والفقراء والمطوعين والعامة
segments.english: from the kings and rulers and scholars of law and Sufis and the poor and the enforcers and the common people.

segments.arabic: فربي فِيهَا الصَّغِير وَنَشَأ عَلَيْهَا الْكَبِير واتخذت سننا
segments.english: So the young were raised in them and the old grew up on them, and they were taken [as] traditions —

segments.arabic: بل هِيَ أعظم عِنْد أَصْحَابهَا من السّنَن
segments.english: rather, they [are] greater to their people than the [prophetic] traditions.

segments.arabic: الْوَاقِف مَعهَا مَحْبُوس والمتقيّد بهَا مُنْقَطع
segments.english: The one standing with them [is] imprisoned, and the one bound by them [is] cut off.

segments.arabic: عمّ بهَا الْمُصَاب وهجر لأَجلهَا السّنة وَالْكتاب
segments.english: Affliction [has] spread through them, and the prophetic practice and the Book [have been] abandoned because of them.

segments.arabic: من استنصر بهَا فَهُوَ عِنْد الله مخذول
segments.english: Whoever seeks help through them — he [is] with God forsaken.

segments.arabic: وَمن اقْتدى بهَا دون كتاب الله وَسنة رَسُوله فَهُوَ عِنْد الله غير مَقْبُول
segments.english: And whoever follows them instead of the Book of God and the practice of His Messenger — he [is] with God not accepted.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه أعظم الْحجب والموانع بَين العَبْد وَبَين النّفُوذ إِلَى الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: And these [are] the greatest veils and barriers between the servant and between reaching God and His Messenger.

headings.arabic: فصل لما كمل الرسول مقام الافتقار إلى الله سبحانه أحوج الخلائق
headings.english: Chapter: When the Messenger Perfected the Station of Neediness to God, [God] Made All of Creation Most in Need of Him

segments.arabic: فصل وَأما الْعَوَائِق فَهِيَ أَنْوَاع المخالفات ظَاهرهَا وباطنها
segments.english: Chapter: As for the obstacles, they [are] the types of violations — their outward and inward [forms].

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا تعوق الْقلب عَن سيره إِلَى الله وتقطع عَلَيْهِ طَرِيقه
segments.english: For they obstruct the heart from its journey to God and cut off its path.

segments.arabic: وَهِي ثَلَاثَة أُمُور شرك وبدعة ومعصية
segments.english: And they [are] three things: associating partners [with God], innovation, and sin.

segments.arabic: فيزول عائق الشّرك بتجريد التَّوْحِيد
segments.english: So the obstacle of associating partners [with God] [is] removed by purifying monotheism,

segments.arabic: وعائق الْبِدْعَة بتحقيق السّنة وعائق الْمعْصِيَة بتصحيح التَّوْبَة
segments.english: and the obstacle of innovation [is removed] by holding to the Sunnah, and the obstacle of sin by correcting repentance.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه الْعَوَائِق لَا تتبين للْعَبد حتى يَأْخُذ فِي أهبة السّفر
segments.english: And these obstacles do not become clear to the servant until he takes up preparation for the journey

segments.arabic: ويتحقق بالسير إِلَى الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة
segments.english: and commits to traveling to God and the Abode of the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: فَحِينَئِذٍ تظهر لَهُ هَذِه الْعَوَائِق
segments.english: Then at that point these obstacles appear to him,

segments.arabic: وَيحسّ بتعويقها لَهُ بِحَسب قُوَّة سيره وتجرّده للسَّفر
segments.english: and he feels their obstruction of him according to the strength of his journey and his dedication to the travel.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا فَمَا دَامَ قَاعِدا لَا يظْهر لَهُ كوامنها وقواطعها
segments.english: Otherwise, as long as he [is] sitting still, their hidden [dangers] and their interruptions do not appear to him.

segments.arabic: فصل وَأما العلائق فَهِيَ كل مَا تعلق بِهِ الْقلب دون الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: Chapter: As for the attachments, they [are] everything the heart clings to besides God and His Messenger —

segments.arabic: من ملاذ الدُّنْيَا وشهواتها ورياستها وصحبة النَّاس والتعلق بهم
segments.english: from the pleasures of this world and its desires and its status, and the company of people and clinging to them.

segments.arabic: وَلَا سَبِيل لَهُ إِلَى قطع هَذِه الْأُمُور الثَّلَاثَة ورفضها إِلَّا بِقُوَّة التَّعَلُّق بالمطلب الْأَعْلَى
segments.english: And there [is] no way for him to cut off these three things and abandon them except by the strength of attachment to the highest goal.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا فقطعها عَلَيْهِ بِدُونِ تعلّقه بمطلوبه مُمْتَنع
segments.english: Otherwise, cutting them off without his attachment to what he seeks [is] impossible.

segments.arabic: فَإِن النَّفس لَا تتْرك مألوفها ومحبوبها
segments.english: For the self does not leave what it [is] used to and what it loves

segments.arabic: إِلَّا لمحبوب هُوَ أحب إِلَيْهَا مِنْهُ وآثر عِنْدهَا مِنْهُ
segments.english: except for [a] beloved that [is] more dear to it than that, and more preferred to it than that.

segments.arabic: وَكلما قوي تعلقه بمطلوبه ضعف تعلقه بِغَيْرِهِ
segments.english: And whenever his attachment to what he seeks grows stronger, his attachment to other than it grows weaker —

segments.arabic: وَكَذَا بِالْعَكْسِ
segments.english: and likewise the reverse.

segments.arabic: والتعلق بالمطلوب هُوَ شدَّة الرَّغْبَة فِيهِ
segments.english: And attachment to what [is] sought — it [is] the intensity of longing for it.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ على قدر مَعْرفَته بِهِ وشرفه وفضله على مَا سواهُ
segments.english: And that [is] according to the measure of his knowledge of it, and its nobility, and its superiority over everything else.

segments.arabic: فصل لما كمل الرَّسُول مقَام الافتقار إِلَى الله سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: Chapter: When the Messenger perfected the station of neediness to God, glorified [is] He,

segments.arabic: أحْوج الْخَلَائق كلهم إِلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: [God] made all of creation most in need of him in this world and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: أما حَاجتهم إِلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا فأشد من حَاجتهم إِلَى الطَّعَام وَالشرَاب
segments.english: As for their need for him in this world, [it is] greater than their need for food and drink

segments.arabic: وَالنَّفس الَّذِي بِهِ حَيَاة أبدانهم
segments.english: and the breath by which their bodies [have] life.

segments.arabic: وَأما حَاجتهم إِلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: And as for their need for him in the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُم يستشفعون بالرسل إِلَى الله حَتَّى يريحهم من ضيق مقامهم
segments.english: they [will] seek intercession through the messengers to God so that He relieves them from the difficulty of their standing.

segments.arabic: فكلهم يتَأَخَّر عَن الشَّفَاعَة فَيشفع لَهُم
segments.english: But all of them [will] hold back from intercession, so he intercedes for them.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يستفتح لَهُم بَاب الْجنَّة
segments.english: And he [is] the one who opens for them the gate of Paradise.

headings.arabic: فصل من أراد علو بنيانه فعليه بتوثيق أساسه وإحكامه وشدة الاعتناء به
headings.english: Chapter: Whoever wants the height of his building, then he must strengthen its foundation and perfect it and take great care of it

segments.arabic: فصل من عَلَامَات السَّعَادَة والفلاح أَن العَبْد كلما زيد فِي علمه زيد فِي تواضعه وَرَحمته
segments.english: Chapter. From the signs of happiness and success [is] that the servant, whenever he [is] increased in his knowledge, he [is] increased in his humility and mercy.

segments.arabic: وَكلما زيد فِي خَوفه وحذره
segments.english: And whenever he [is] increased in his fear and caution.

segments.arabic: وَكلما زيد فِي عمره نقص من حرصه
segments.english: And whenever he [is] increased in his age, his greed decreases.

segments.arabic: وَكلما زيد فِي مَاله زيد فِي سخائه وبذله
segments.english: And whenever he [is] increased in his wealth, he [is] increased in his generosity and giving.

segments.arabic: وَكلما زيد فِي قدره وجاهه زيد فِي قربه من النَّاس وَقَضَاء حوائجهم والتواضع لَهُم
segments.english: And whenever he [is] increased in his status and rank, he [is] increased in his closeness to people and fulfilling their needs and [being] humble to them.

segments.arabic: وعلامات الشقاوة أَنه كلما زيد فِي علمه زيد فِي كبره وتيهه
segments.english: And the signs of misery [are] that whenever he [is] increased in his knowledge, he [is] increased in his arrogance and vanity.

segments.arabic: وَكلما زيد فِي عمله زيد فِي فخره واحتقاره للنَّاس وَحسن ظَنّه بِنَفسِهِ
segments.english: And whenever he [is] increased in his deeds, he [is] increased in his pride and his looking down on people and his good opinion of himself.

segments.arabic: وَكلما زيد فِي عمره زيد في حرصه
segments.english: And whenever he [is] increased in his age, he [is] increased in his greed.

segments.arabic: وَكلما زيد فِي مَاله زيد فِي بخله وإمساكه
segments.english: And whenever he [is] increased in his wealth, he [is] increased in his stinginess and withholding.

segments.arabic: وَكلما زيد فِي قدره وجاهه زيد فِي كبره وتيهه
segments.english: And whenever he [is] increased in his status and rank, he [is] increased in his arrogance and vanity.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه الْأُمُور ابتلاء من الله وامتحان يَبْتَلِي بهَا عباده
segments.english: And these matters [are] a trial from God and a test — He tests His servants with them.

segments.arabic: فيسعد بهَا أَقوام ويشقى بهَا أَقوام
segments.english: So [some] people become happy through them and [some] people become miserable through them.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ الكرامات امتحان وابتلاء كالملك وَالسُّلْطَان وَالْمَال
segments.english: And likewise, honors [are] a test and [a] trial — like kingship and authority and wealth.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى عَن نبيه سُلَيْمَان لما رأى عرش بلقيس عِنْده
segments.english: [God] Most High said, about His prophet Sulayman when he saw the throne of Bilqis before him:

segments.arabic: هَذَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي أَأَشْكُرُ أم أكفر
segments.english: "This [is] from the grace of my Lord, to test me — will I be grateful or will I be ungrateful?"
segments.sahih_international: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."

segments.arabic: فالنعم ابتلاء من الله وامتحان يظْهر بهَا شكر الشكُور وَكفر الكفور
segments.english: So blessings [are] a trial from God and a test — through them the gratitude of the grateful appears and the ingratitude of the ungrateful.

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن المحن بلوى مِنْهُ سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: Just as hardships [are] a trial from Him, glorified [is] He.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ يَبْتَلِي بِالنعَم كَمَا يَبْتَلِي بالمصائب
segments.english: So He tests with blessings just as He tests with calamities.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: فَأَمَّا الْأِنْسَانُ إِذَا مَا ابْتَلاهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَكْرَمَنِ
segments.english: As for man, when his Lord tests him and honors him and gives him comfort, he says: "My Lord has honored me."
segments.sahih_international: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."

segments.arabic: وَأَمَّا إِذَا مَا ابْتَلاهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَهَانَنِ
segments.english: But when He tests him and restricts his provision, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me."
segments.sahih_international: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

segments.arabic: كلا
segments.english: No indeed!

segments.arabic: أَي لَيْسَ كل من وسعت عَلَيْهِ وأكرمته وَنعمته يكون ذَلِك إِكْرَاما مني لَهُ
segments.english: Meaning: not everyone whom I have expanded [provision] for and honored and given comfort — that [would] be an honoring from Me to him.

segments.arabic: وَلَا كل من ضيّقت عَلَيْهِ رزقه وابتليته يكون ذَلِك إهانة مني لَهُ
segments.english: Nor [is it that] everyone whose provision I have restricted and tested — that [would] be a humiliation from Me to him.

segments.arabic: فصل من أَرَادَ علو بُنْيَانه فَعَلَيهِ بتوثيق أساسه وإحكامه وَشدَّة الاعتناء بِهِ
segments.english: Chapter. Whoever wants the height of his building, then he must strengthen its foundation and perfect it and take great care of it.

segments.arabic: فَإِن علو الْبُنيان على قدر تَوْثِيق الأساس وإحكامه
segments.english: For the height of the building [is] according to the strengthening of the foundation and its perfection.

segments.arabic: فالأعمال والدرجات بُنيان وأساسها الْإِيمَان
segments.english: So deeds and ranks [are] a building, and their foundation [is] faith.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى كَانَ الأساس وثيقا حمل الْبُنيان واعتلى عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And whenever the foundation was strong, it carried the building and [the building] rose upon it.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا تهدم شَيْء من
segments.english: And if something of [it] collapsed—

segments.arabic: الْبُنيان سهل تَدَارُكه
segments.english: the building [is] easy [to] repair.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا كَانَ الأساس غير وثيق لم يرْتَفع الْبُنيان وَلم يثبت
segments.english: And if the foundation was not firm, the building [would] not rise and [would] not stand.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا تهدم شَيْء من الأساس سقط الْبُنيان أَو كَاد
segments.english: And if something of the foundation collapsed, the building [would] fall — or nearly so.

segments.arabic: فالعارف همّته تَصْحِيح الأساس وإحكامه
segments.english: So the knowledgeable one — his concern [is] correcting the foundation and strengthening it.

segments.arabic: وَالْجَاهِل يرفع فِي الْبناء عَن غير أساس فَلَا يلبث بُنْيَانه أَن يسْقط
segments.english: And the ignorant one raises the building without [a] foundation, so his building does not last before it falls.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: أَفَمَنْ أَسَّسَ بُنْيَانَهُ عَلَى تَقْوَى مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانٍ خَيْرٌ أَمن أَسَّسَ بُنْيَانَهُ عَلَى شَفَا جُرُفٍ هَارٍ فَانْهَارَ بِهِ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ
segments.english: Is [the] one who founded his building on God-consciousness from God and [His] pleasure better, or [the] one who founded his building on the edge of [a] crumbling cliff, so it collapsed with him into the Fire of Hell?
segments.sahih_international: Then is one who laid the foundation of his building on righteousness [with fear] from Allah and [seeking] His approval better or one who laid the foundation of his building on the edge of a bank about to collapse, so it collapsed with him into the fire of Hell? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

segments.arabic: فالأساس لبِنَاء الْأَعْمَال كالقوة لبدن الْإِنْسَان
segments.english: So the foundation for the building of deeds [is] like strength for the body of [a] person.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَت الْقُوَّة قَوِيَّة حملت الْبدن وَدفعت عَنهُ كثيرا من الْآفَات
segments.english: So if the strength was strong, it [would] carry the body and push away from it many of the harmful things.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا كَانَت الْقُوَّة ضَعِيفَة ضعف حملهَا للبدن
segments.english: And if the strength was weak, its carrying of the body [would] weaken,

segments.arabic: وَكَانَت الْآفَات إِلَيْهِ أسْرع شَيْء
segments.english: and the harmful things [would be] the quickest thing [to reach] it.

segments.arabic: فاحمل بنيانك على قُوَّة أساس الْإِيمَان
segments.english: So carry your building on the strength of the foundation of faith.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا تشعث شَيْء من أعالي الْبناء وسطحه كَانَ تَدَارُكه أسهل عَلَيْك من خراب الأساس
segments.english: So if something cracked in the upper parts of the building and its surface, repairing it [would be] easier for you than the ruin of the foundation.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا الأساس أَمْرَانِ
segments.english: And this foundation [is] two things:

segments.arabic: صِحَة الْمعرفَة بِاللَّه وَأمره وأسمائه وَصِفَاته
segments.english: the soundness of knowledge of God, and His command, and His names, and His attributes;

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي تَجْرِيد الانقياد لَهُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ دون مَا سواهُ
segments.english: and the second [is] pure submission to Him and to His Messenger, apart from anything else.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا أوثق أساس أسس العَبْد عَلَيْهِ بُنْيَانه
segments.english: So this [is] the firmest foundation the servant [can] build his building upon,

segments.arabic: وبحسبه يعتلي الْبناء مَا شَاءَ
segments.english: and according to it the building rises as [much as] it wills.

segments.arabic: فاحكم الأساس واحفظ الْقُوَّة وَدم على الحمية
segments.english: So strengthen the foundation, and preserve [your] strength, and stay on the diet,

segments.arabic: واستفرغ إِذا زَاد بك الْخَلْط
segments.english: and purge [yourself] when the bad mixture increases in you.

segments.arabic: وَالْقَصْد الْقَصْد وَقد بلغت المُرَاد
segments.english: And [keep to] moderation, moderation — and you [will] have reached what [is] desired.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا فَمَا دَامَت الْقُوَّة ضَعِيفَة والمادة الْفَاسِدَة مَوْجُودَة والاستفراغ مَعْدُوما
segments.english: Otherwise, as long as the strength [is] weak, and the corrupt matter [is] present, and purging [is] absent —

segments.arabic: فاقر السَّلَام على الْحَيَاة فَإِنَّهَا ... قد آذنتك بِسُرْعَة التوديع
segments.english: then give farewell greetings to life, for it ... has warned you of [a] quick departure.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كمل الْبناء فبيضه بِحسن الْخلق وَالْإِحْسَان إِلَى النَّاس
segments.english: So when the building [is] complete, then whiten it with good character and kindness to people.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ حَظه بسور من الحذر لَا يقتحمه عَدو وَلَا تبدو مِنْهُ الْعَوْرَة
segments.english: Then surround it with [a] wall of caution that no enemy [can] break through, and no weakness [is] exposed from it.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ ارخ الستور على أبوابه
segments.english: Then lower the curtains over its doors.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أقفل الْبَاب الْأَعْظَم بِالسُّكُوتِ عَمَّا تخشى عاقبته
segments.english: Then lock the greatest door with silence about what you fear its outcome.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ ركب لَهُ مفتاحا من ذكر الله بِهِ تفتحه وتغلقه
segments.english: Then fit for it [a] key from the remembrance of God — with it you open it and close it.

segments.arabic: فَإِن فتحت فتحت بالمفتاح وَإِن أغلقت الْبَاب أغلقته بِهِ
segments.english: So if you open, you open with the key; and if you close the door, you close it with it.

segments.arabic: فَتكون حِينَئِذٍ قد بنيت حصنا تحصنت فِيهِ من أعدائك
segments.english: Then you [will] have built [a] fortress [in which] you [have] fortified yourself from your enemies.

segments.arabic: إِذا طَاف بِهِ الْعَدو لم يجد مِنْهُ مدخلًا فييأس مِنْك
segments.english: When the enemy circles around it, he [will] not find an entrance into it, so he [will] despair of you.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ تعاهد بِنَاء الْحصن كل وَقت
segments.english: Then maintain the building of the fortress at all times,

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْعَدو إِذا لم يطْمع فِي الدُّخُول من الْبَاب نقّب عَلَيْك النقوب من بعيد بمعاول الذُّنُوب
segments.english: for the enemy, if he does not hope to enter from the door, [will] dig tunnels toward you from afar with the pickaxes of sins.

segments.arabic: فَإِن أهملت أمره وصل إِلَيْك النقب
segments.english: So if you neglect his affair, the tunnel [will] reach you,

segments.arabic: فَإِذا الْعَدو مَعَك فِي دَاخل الْحصن فيصعب عَلَيْك إِخْرَاجه
segments.english: and then the enemy [is] with you inside the fortress, and removing him [will be] difficult for you,

segments.arabic: وَتَكون مَعَه على
segments.english: and you [will] be with him upon —

headings.arabic: فصل أركان الكفر أربعة الكبر والحسد والغضب والشهوة فالكبر يمنعه
headings.english: Section: The Pillars of Disbelief [Are] Four: Arrogance, Envy, Anger, and Desire — Arrogance Prevents Him

segments.arabic: ثَلَاث خلال إِمَّا أَن يَغْلِبك على الْحصن ويستولي عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: three situations: either he overpowers you over the fortress and takes control of it,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن يساكنك فِيهِ
segments.english: or he settles in with you inside it,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن يشغلك بمقابلته عَن تَمام مصلحتك
segments.english: or he keeps you busy confronting him, [away] from completing your well-being

segments.arabic: وتعود إِلَى سد النقب وَلم شعث الْحصن
segments.english: and [from] returning to seal the breach and repair the damage of the fortress.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا دخل نقبه إِلَيْك نالك مِنْهُ ثَلَاث آفَات
segments.english: And if he enters through his tunnel to you, three harms [will] reach you from him:

segments.arabic: إِفْسَاد الْحصن والإغارة على حواصله وذخائره
segments.english: ruining the fortress, raiding its supplies and treasures,

segments.arabic: وَدلَالَة السراق من بني جنسه على عَوْرَته
segments.english: and guiding the thieves from his kind to its weak points.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يزَال يبْلى مِنْهُ بغارة حَتَّى يضعفوا قواه ويوهنوا عزمه
segments.english: So he keeps being afflicted by him with raids until they weaken his strength and break his resolve,

segments.arabic: فيتخلى عَن الْحصن ويخلي بَينهم وَبَينه
segments.english: so he abandons the fortress and leaves [the way open] between them and it.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه حَال أَكثر النُّفُوس مَعَ هَذَا الْعَدو
segments.english: And this [is] the condition of most souls with this enemy.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا تراهم يسخطون رَبهم بِرِضا أنفسهم
segments.english: And for this [reason] you see them angering their Lord to please themselves,

segments.arabic: بل بِرِضا مَخْلُوق مثلهم لَا يملك لَهُم ضرا وَلَا نفعا
segments.english: rather, to please [a] created being like them [who] does not possess for them [any] harm or benefit.

segments.arabic: ويضيعون كسب الدّين بكسب الْأَمْوَال
segments.english: And they waste the earnings of religion for the earnings of wealth,

segments.arabic: وَيهْلِكُونَ أنفسهم بِمَا لَا يبْقى لَهُم
segments.english: and they destroy themselves with what does not last for them.

segments.arabic: ويحرصون على الدُّنْيَا وَقد أَدْبَرت عَنْهُم
segments.english: And they cling to this world while it has turned away from them,

segments.arabic: ويزهدون فِي الْآخِرَة وَقد هجمت عَلَيْهِم
segments.english: and they have no interest in the Hereafter while it has come upon them.

segments.arabic: ويخالفون رَبهم باتّباع أهوائهم
segments.english: And they disobey their Lord by following their desires,

segments.arabic: ويتكلون على الْحَيَاة وَلَا يذكرُونَ الْمَوْت
segments.english: and they rely on life and do not remember death.

segments.arabic: ويذكرون شهواتهم وحظوظهم وينسون مَا عهد الله إِلَيْهِم
segments.english: And they remember their pleasures and their shares and forget what God entrusted to them.

segments.arabic: ويهتمون بِمَا ضمنه الله وَلَا يهتمون بِمَا أَمرهم بِهِ
segments.english: And they worry about what God [has] guaranteed, and do not worry about what He commanded them with.

segments.arabic: ويفرحون بالدنيا ويحزنون على فَوَات حظهم مِنْهَا
segments.english: And they rejoice in this world and grieve over missing their share of it,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يَحْزَنُونَ على فَوَات الْجنَّة وَمَا فِيهَا
segments.english: and they do not grieve over missing Paradise and what [is] in it.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يفرحون بِالْإِيمَان فَرَحهمْ بالدرهم وَالدِّينَار
segments.english: And they do not rejoice in faith [the way] they rejoice in [the] dirham and [the] dinar.

segments.arabic: ويفسدون حَقهم وهداهم بضلالهم
segments.english: And they corrupt their truth and their guidance with their misguidance,

segments.arabic: ومعروفهم بمنكرهم
segments.english: and their good with their evil,

segments.arabic: ويلبسوا إِيمَانهم بظنونهم
segments.english: and they cover their faith with their doubts,

segments.arabic: ويخلطون حلالهم بحرامهم
segments.english: and they mix their lawful with their forbidden.

segments.arabic: ويترددون فِي حيرة آرائهم وأفكارهم
segments.english: And they wander in the confusion of their opinions and their thoughts,

segments.arabic: ويتركون هدى الله الَّذِي أهداه إِلَيْهِم
segments.english: and they leave the guidance of God which He guided them to.

segments.arabic: وَمن الْعجب أَن هَذَا الْعَدو يسْتَعْمل صَاحب الْحصن فِي هدم حصنه بيدَيْهِ
segments.english: And from [the] amazement [is] that this enemy uses the owner of the fortress to demolish his fortress with his own two hands.

segments.arabic: فصل أَرْكَان الْكفْر أَرْبَعَة الْكبر والحسد وَالْغَضَب والشهوة
segments.english: Section: The pillars of disbelief [are] four: arrogance, envy, anger, and desire.

segments.arabic: فالكبر يمنعهُ الانقياد
segments.english: So arrogance prevents him [from] obedience,

segments.arabic: والحسد يمنعهُ قبُول النَّصِيحَة وبذلها
segments.english: and envy prevents him [from] accepting advice and giving it,

segments.arabic: وَالْغَضَب يمنعهُ الْعدْل
segments.english: and anger prevents him [from] justice,

segments.arabic: والشهوة تَمنعهُ التفرّغ لِلْعِبَادَةِ
segments.english: and desire prevents him [from] devoting [himself] to worship.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا انْهَدم ركن الْكبر سهل عَلَيْهِ الانقياد
segments.english: So when the pillar of arrogance [is] demolished, obedience becomes easy for him.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا انْهَدم ركن الْحَسَد سهل عَلَيْهِ قبُول النصح وبذله
segments.english: And when the pillar of envy [is] demolished, accepting advice and giving it becomes easy for him.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا انْهَدم ركن الْغَضَب سهل عَلَيْهِ الْعدْل والتواضع
segments.english: And when the pillar of anger [is] demolished, justice and humility become easy for him.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا انْهَدم ركن الشَّهْوَة سهل عَلَيْهِ الصَّبْر والعفاف وَالْعِبَادَة
segments.english: And when the pillar of desire [is] demolished, patience, self-restraint, and worship become easy for him.

segments.arabic: وَزَوَال الْجبَال عَن أماكنها
segments.english: And [the] removal of mountains from their places

segments.arabic: أيسر من زَوَال هَذِه الْأَرْبَعَة عَمَّن بلي بهَا
segments.english: easier than [the] removal of these four from whoever [is] afflicted by them

segments.arabic: وَلَا سِيمَا إِذا صَارَت هيئات راسخة وملكات وصفات ثَابِتَة
segments.english: especially if they have become deep-rooted states, settled habits, and fixed qualities

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَسْتَقِيم لَهُ مَعهَا عمل الْبَتَّةَ
segments.english: For indeed no deed [will] be upright for him alongside them, at all

segments.arabic: وَلَا تزكو نَفسه مَعَ قِيَامهَا بهَا
segments.english: and his self [will] not be purified while it clings to them

segments.arabic: وكلما اجْتهد فِي الْعَمَل أفسدته عَلَيْهِ هَذِه الْأَرْبَعَة
segments.english: And whenever he strives in [his] deeds, these four corrupt them for him

segments.arabic: وكل الْآفَات مُتَوَلّدَة مِنْهَا
segments.english: and all diseases [are] born from them

segments.arabic: وَإِذا استحكمت فِي الْقلب أرته الْبَاطِل فِي صُورَة الْحق وَالْحق فِي صُورَة الْبَاطِل
segments.english: And when they take firm hold of the heart, they show it falsehood in the form of truth, and truth in the form of falsehood

segments.arabic: وَالْمَعْرُوف فِي صُورَة الْمُنكر وَالْمُنكر فِي صُورَة الْمَعْرُوف
segments.english: and the good in the form of the evil, and the evil in the form of the good

segments.arabic: وَقربت مِنْهُ الدُّنْيَا وبعدت مِنْهُ الْآخِرَة
segments.english: and they bring this world close to him and distance the Hereafter from him

segments.arabic: وَإِذا تَأَمَّلت كفر الْأُمَم رَأَيْته ناشئا مِنْهَا
segments.english: And if you reflect on the disbelief of the nations, you [will] see it arising from them

segments.arabic: وَعَلَيْهَا يَقع الْعَذَاب
segments.english: and upon them the punishment falls

segments.arabic: وَتَكون خفته وشدته بِحَسب خفتها وشدتها
segments.english: and its lightness and severity [are] according to their lightness and severity

segments.arabic: فَمن فتحهَا على نَفسه فتح عَلَيْهِ أَبْوَاب الشرور كلهَا عَاجلا وآجلا
segments.english: So whoever opens them upon himself, [he] opens upon himself the doors of all evils, sooner and later

segments.arabic: وَمن أغلقها على نَفسه أغلق عَنهُ أَبْوَاب الشرور
segments.english: And whoever closes them upon himself, [he] closes from him the doors of evils

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا تمنع الانقياد وَالْإِخْلَاص وَالتَّوْبَة والإنابة وَقبُول الْحق ونصيحة الْمُسلمين والتواضع لله ولخلقه
segments.english: For indeed they prevent submission, sincerity, repentance, turning [to God], accepting the truth, advising the Muslims, and humility before God and His creation

segments.arabic: ومنشأ هَذِه الْأَرْبَعَة من جَهله بربه وجهله بِنَفسِهِ
segments.english: And the origin of these four [is] from his ignorance of his Lord and his ignorance of himself

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لَو عرف ربه بِصِفَات الْكَمَال ونعوت الْجلَال
segments.english: For if he knew his Lord by the attributes of perfection and the descriptions of majesty

segments.arabic: وَعرف نَفسه بالنقائص والآفات
segments.english: and knew himself by [his] flaws and diseases

segments.arabic: لم يتكبر وَلم يغْضب لَهَا
segments.english: he would not be arrogant and would not get angry for its sake

segments.arabic: وَلم يحْسد أحدا على مَا أَتَاهُ الله
segments.english: and would not envy anyone for what God gave him

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْحَسَد فِي الْحَقِيقَة نوع من معاداة الله
segments.english: For envy [is] in reality [a] type of hostility toward God

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ يكره نعْمَة الله على عَبده وَقد أحبها الله
segments.english: For he hates [the] blessing of God upon His servant, while God loved it

segments.arabic: وَأحب زَوَالهَا عَنهُ وَالله يكره ذَلِك
segments.english: and he loves its removal from him, while God hates that

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مضاد لله فِي قَضَائِهِ وَقدره ومحبته وكراهته
segments.english: So he [is] opposing God in His decree, His destiny, His love, and His hatred

segments.arabic: وَلذَلِك كَانَ إِبْلِيس عدوه حَقِيقَة لِأَن ذَنبه كَانَ عَن كبر وحسد
segments.english: And for that reason, Iblis was truly His enemy, because his sin was from arrogance and envy

segments.arabic: فَقلع هَاتين الصفتين بِمَعْرِفَة الله وتوحيده وَالرِّضَا بِهِ وَعنهُ والإنابة إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: So uproot these two qualities by knowing God, [by His] monotheism, [by] being pleased with Him and from Him, and [by] turning to Him

segments.arabic: وَقلع الْغَضَب بِمَعْرِفَة النَّفس وَأَنَّهَا لَا تسْتَحقّ أَن يغْضب لَهَا وينتقم لَهَا
segments.english: And uproot anger by knowing the self — and that it does not deserve that one gets angry for its sake and takes revenge for it

segments.arabic: فَإِن ذَلِك إِيثَار لَهَا بِالرِّضَا وَالْغَضَب على خَالِقهَا وفاطرها
segments.english: For that [is] giving it preference in pleasure and anger over its Creator and Maker

segments.arabic: وَأعظم مَا تدفع بِهِ هَذِه الآفة أَن يعوّدها أَن تغْضب لَهُ سُبْحَانَهُ وترضى لَهُ
segments.english: And the greatest thing by which you [can] repel this disease [is] to train it to be angry for His sake, glorified [is] He, and to be pleased for His sake

segments.arabic: فَكلما دَخلهَا شَيْء من الْغَضَب وَالرِّضَا لَهُ خرج مِنْهَا مُقَابِله من الْغَضَب وَالرِّضَا لَهَا
segments.english: So whenever something of anger and pleasure for Him enters it, its opposite of anger and pleasure for itself leaves it

segments.arabic: وَكَذَا بِالْعَكْسِ
segments.english: And likewise [is] the reverse

segments.arabic: وَأما الشَّهْوَة فدواؤها صِحَة الْعلم والمعرفة
segments.english: And as for desire, its cure [is] sound knowledge and awareness

segments.arabic: بِأَن إعطاءها شهواتها أعظم أَسبَاب حرمانها إِيَّاهَا
segments.english: [knowing] that giving it its desires [is] the greatest cause of depriving it of them

segments.arabic: ومنعها مِنْهَا وحميتها أعظم أَسبَاب اتصالها إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: and preventing it from them and guarding it [is] the greatest cause of reaching them

segments.arabic: فَكلما فتحت عَلَيْهَا بَاب الشَّهَوَات كنت ساعيا فِي حرمانها إِيَّاهَا
segments.english: So whenever you open upon it the door of desires, you [are] striving to deprive it of them

segments.arabic: وَكلما أغلقت عَنْهَا ذَلِك الْبَاب كنت ساعيا فِي إيصالها إِلَيْهَا على أكمل الْوُجُوه
segments.english: And whenever you close that door from it, you [are] striving to deliver it to them in the most complete of ways

headings.arabic: فصل عظيم النفع
headings.english: A Chapter of Great Benefit

segments.arabic: فالغضب مثل السَّبع إِذا أفلته صَاحبه بَدَأَ بِأَكْلِهِ
segments.english: So anger [is] like the predator — when its owner lets it loose, it begins by devouring him.

segments.arabic: والشهوة مثل النَّار إِذا أضرمها صَاحبهَا بدأت بإحراقه
segments.english: And desire [is] like fire — when its owner kindles it, it begins by burning him.

segments.arabic: وَالْكبر بِمَنْزِلَة مُنَازعَة الْملك ملكه فَإِن لم يهلكك طردك عَنهُ
segments.english: And arrogance [is] like disputing [with] the king over his kingdom — if he does not destroy you, he [will] expel you from it.

segments.arabic: والحسد بِمَنْزِلَة معاداة من هُوَ أقدر مِنْك
segments.english: And envy [is] like making an enemy of one who [is] more powerful than you.

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِي يغلب شَهْوَته وغضبه يفرق الشَّيْطَان من ظله
segments.english: And the one who overcomes his desire and his anger — Satan [is] frightened of his shadow.

segments.arabic: وَمن تغلبه شَهْوَته وغضبه يفرق من خياله
segments.english: And the one whose desire and anger overcome him — [he] [is] frightened of his [own] phantom.

segments.arabic: الْجُهَّال بِاللَّه وأسمائه وَصِفَاته المعطلون لحقائقها
segments.english: Those ignorant of God and His names and attributes, who strip away their realities —

segments.arabic: يبغضون الله إِلَى خلقه ويقطعون عَلَيْهِم طَرِيق محبته
segments.english: [they] make God hateful to His creation and cut off for them the path of loving Him

segments.arabic: والتودد إِلَيْهِ بِطَاعَتِهِ من حَيْثُ لَا يعلمُونَ
segments.english: and [the path of] drawing close to Him through obedience to Him, without [even] knowing [it].

segments.arabic: وَنحن نذْكر من ذَلِك أَمْثِلَة تحتذي عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: And we [will] mention from that examples to follow.

segments.arabic: فَمِنْهَا أَنهم يقررون فِي نفوس الضُّعَفَاء
segments.english: Among them [is] that they establish in the souls of the weak [ones]

segments.arabic: أَن الله سُبْحَانَهُ لَا تَنْفَع مَعَه طَاعَة وَإِن طَال زمانها
segments.english: that God, glorified [is] He — no obedience benefits with Him, even if its time [is] long

segments.arabic: وَبَالغ العَبْد وأتى بهَا ظَاهره وباطنه
segments.english: and the servant exerts himself and brings it [with] his outward and his inward [self].

segments.arabic: وَأَن العَبْد لَيْسَ على ثِقَة وَلَا أَمن من مكره
segments.english: And that the servant [is] not upon trust nor safety from His scheme.

segments.arabic: بل شَأْنه سُبْحَانَهُ أَن يَأْخُذ الْمُطِيع المتقي من الْمِحْرَاب إِلَى الماخور
segments.english: Rather, His way, glorified [is] He, [is] to take the obedient, God-conscious [person] from the prayer niche to the brothel

segments.arabic: وَمن التَّوْحِيد والمسبحة إِلَى الشّرك والمزمار
segments.english: and from monotheism and the prayer beads to associating partners [with God] and the flute.

segments.arabic: ويقلب قلبه من الْإِيمَان الْخَالِص إِلَى الْكفْر
segments.english: And [He] flips his heart from pure faith to disbelief.

segments.arabic: ويروون فِي ذَلِك آثَار صَحِيحَة لم يفهموها وباطلة لم يقلها الْمَعْصُوم
segments.english: And they narrate regarding that authentic reports they did not understand, and false [ones] the Infallible [Prophet] did not say.

segments.arabic: ويزعمون أَن هَذَا حَقِيقَة التَّوْحِيد
segments.english: And they claim that this [is] the reality of monotheism.

segments.arabic: ويتلون على ذَلِك قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And they recite in support of that [God] Most High's saying:

segments.arabic: لَا يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ
segments.english: He [is] not asked about what He does.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: أَفَأَمِنُوا مَكْرَ اللَّهِ فَلا يَأْمَنُ مَكْرَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
segments.english: Did they then feel safe from God's scheme? So none feels safe from God's scheme except the losing people.
segments.sahih_international: Then did they feel secure from the plan of Allah? But no one feels secure from the plan of Allah except the losing people.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: And His saying:

segments.arabic: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلبه
segments.english: And know that God comes between [a] man and his heart.
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered.

segments.arabic: ويقيمون إِبْلِيس حجَّة لَهُم على هَذِه الْمعرفَة
segments.english: And they set up Iblis [as] [a] proof for themselves regarding this knowledge,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه كَانَ طَاوُوس الْمَلَائِكَة
segments.english: and that he was the peacock of the angels,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه لم يتْرك فِي السَّمَاء رقْعَة وَلَا فِي الأَرْض بقْعَة إِلَّا وَله فِيهَا سَجْدَة أَو رَكْعَة
segments.english: and that he did not leave in the sky [a] patch nor on the earth [a] spot except that he had in it [a] prostration or [a] bow.

segments.arabic: لَكِن جنى عَلَيْهِ جاني الْقدر وسطا عَلَيْهِ الحكم
segments.english: But the criminal of destiny wronged him and the decree overpowered him,

segments.arabic: فَقلب عينه الطّيبَة وَجعلهَا أَخبث شَيْء
segments.english: so [it] flipped his good essence and made it the most wicked thing.

segments.arabic: حَتَّى قَالَ بعض عارفيهم
segments.english: Until some of their 'knowers' said

segments.arabic: أَنَّك يَنْبَغِي أَن تخَاف الله كَمَا تخَاف الْأسد الَّذِي يثب عَلَيْك بِغَيْر جرم مِنْك وَلَا ذَنْب أَتَيْته إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: that you should fear God as you fear the lion that pounces on you without [any] crime from you nor [any] sin you committed against it.

segments.arabic: ويحتجون بقول النَّبِي
segments.english: And they argue with the saying of the Prophet:

segments.arabic: إِن أحدكُم ليعْمَل بِعَمَل أهل الْجنَّة حَتَّى مَا يكون بَينه وَبَينهَا إِلَّا ذِرَاع
segments.english: One of you [will] indeed do the deeds of the people of Paradise until there [is] nothing between him and it except [a] cubit,

segments.arabic: فَيَسْبق عَلَيْهِ الْكتاب فَيعْمل بِعَمَل أهل النَّار فيدخلها
segments.english: then the decree overtakes him, so he does the deeds of the people of the Fire and enters it.

segments.arabic: ويروون عَن بعض السّلف أكبر الْكَبَائِر الأمن من مكر الله والقنوط من رَحْمَة
segments.english: And they narrate from some of the early [scholars]: the greatest of major sins [is] feeling safe from God's scheme and despairing of [God's] mercy.

segments.arabic: وَذكر الإِمَام أَحْمد عَن عون بن عبد الله أَو غَيره أَنه سمع رجلا يَدْعُو اللَّهم لَا تؤمني مكرك
segments.english: And Imam Ahmad mentioned from Awn ibn Abd Allah — or other than him — that he heard [a] man supplicating: 'O God, do not make me safe from Your scheme.'

segments.arabic: فَأنْكر ذَلِك وَقَالَ قل اللَّهُمَّ لَا تجعلني مِمَّن يَأْمَن مكرك
segments.english: So he disapproved of that and said: 'Say: O God, do not make me among those who feel safe from Your scheme.'

segments.arabic: وبنوا ذَلِك على أصلهم الْبَاطِل وَهُوَ إِنْكَار الْحِكْمَة وَالتَّعْلِيل والأسباب
segments.english: And they built that upon their false foundation, which [is] the denial of wisdom, reasoning, and causes.

segments.arabic: وَأَن الله لَا يفعل لحكمة وَلَا سَبَب وَإِنَّمَا يفعل بِمَشِيئَة مُجَرّدَة من الحكم وَالتَّعْلِيل وَالسَّبَب
segments.english: And that God does not act for [a] wisdom or [a] cause, but rather acts by [a] will stripped of wisdom, reasoning, and cause.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يفعل لشَيْء وَلَا بِشَيْء
segments.english: So He does not act for anything or by anything.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه يجوز عَلَيْهِ أَن يعذب أهل طَاعَته أَشد الْعَذَاب وينعّم أعداءه وَأهل مَعْصِيَته بجزيل الثَّوَاب
segments.english: And that it [is] conceivable for Him to punish the people of His obedience with the severest punishment, and to grant His enemies and the people of His disobedience abundant reward.

segments.arabic: وَأَن الْأَمريْنِ بِالنِّسْبَةِ إِلَيْهِ سَوَاء
segments.english: And that the two matters [are] equal with respect to Him.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يعلم امْتنَاع ذَلِك إِلَّا بِخَبَر من الصَّادِق أَنه لَا يَفْعَله
segments.english: And the impossibility of that [is] not known except through [a] report from the Truthful One that He will not do it.

segments.arabic: فَحِينَئِذٍ يعلم امْتِنَاعه لوُقُوع الْخَبَر بِأَنَّهُ لَا يكون
segments.english: So then its impossibility [is] known because the report occurred that it will not happen —

segments.arabic: لَا لِأَنَّهُ فِي نَفسه بَاطِل وظلم
segments.english: not because it [is] in itself false and unjust.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الظُّلم فِي نَفسه مُسْتَحِيل فَإِنَّهُ غير مُمكن
segments.english: For injustice [is] in itself impossible — it [is] not possible.

segments.arabic: بل هُوَ بِمَنْزِلَة جعل الْجِسْم الْوَاحِد فِي مكانين فِي آن وَاحِد
segments.english: Rather, it [is] like placing [a] single body in two places at one moment,

segments.arabic: وَالْجمع بَين اللَّيْل وَالنَّهَار فِي سَاعَة وَاحِدَة
segments.english: and combining the night and the day in [a] single hour,

segments.arabic: وَجعل الشَّيْء مَوْجُودا ومعدوما مَعًا فِي آن وَاحِد
segments.english: and making [a] thing existent and nonexistent together at one moment.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا حَقِيقَة الظُّلم عِنْدهم
segments.english: So this [is] the reality of injustice according to them.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا رَجَعَ الْعَامِل إِلَى نَفسه قَالَ
segments.english: So when the worshipper returns to himself, he says:

segments.arabic: من لَا يسْتَقرّ لَهُ أَمر وَلَا يُؤمن لَهُ مكر كَيفَ يوثق بالتقرّب إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: 'One for whom no affair [is] settled and from whom no scheme [is] safe — how can drawing near to Him be trusted?

segments.arabic: وَكَيف يعول على طاعته واتّباع أوامره
segments.english: And how can one rely on obedience to Him and following His commands?

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ لنا سوى هَذِه الْمدَّة الْيَسِيرَة
segments.english: And we have nothing but this short period.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا هجرنا فِيهَا اللَّذَّات وَتَركنَا الشَّهَوَات وتكلفنا أثقال الْعِبَادَات
segments.english: So if we abandon pleasures in it, and leave [our] desires, and burden ourselves with the weights of worship,

segments.arabic: وَكُنَّا مَعَ ذَلِك على غير ثِقَة مِنْهُ أَن يقلب علينا الْإِيمَان كفرا والتوحيد شركا
segments.english: and we [are] with all that without assurance from Him [that He will not] turn faith into disbelief upon us, and monotheism into associating partners [with God],

segments.arabic: وَالطَّاعَة مَعْصِيّة وَالْبر فجورا ويديم علينا الْعُقُوبَات
segments.english: and obedience into disobedience, and righteousness into wickedness, and continue punishment upon us —

segments.arabic: كُنَّا خاسرين فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: [then] we would be losers in this world and the Hereafter.'

segments.arabic: فَإِذا استحكم هَذَا الِاعْتِقَاد فِي قُلُوبهم وتخمّر فِي نُفُوسهم
segments.english: So when this belief takes firm hold in their hearts and ferments in their souls,

segments.arabic: صَارُوا إِذا أمروا بالطاعات وهجر اللَّذَّات بِمَنْزِلَة إِنْسَان جعل يَقُول لوَلَده
segments.english: they become — when commanded with acts of obedience and abandoning pleasures — like [a] person who keeps saying to his child:

segments.arabic: معلمك إِن كتبت وأحسنت وتأدبت وَلم تعصه رُبمَا أَقَامَ لَك حجَّة وعاقبك
segments.english: 'Your teacher — if you write well and do good and behave properly and do not disobey him — perhaps [he will] bring [a] charge against you and punish you.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كسلت وَبَطلَت وتعطلت وَتركت مَا أَمرك بِهِ رُبمَا قربك وأكرمك
segments.english: And if you [are] lazy and idle and neglectful and leave what he commanded you — perhaps [he will] bring you close and honor you.'

segments.arabic: فيودع بِهَذَا القَوْل قلب الصَّبِي مَا لَا يَثِق بعده إِلَى وَعِيد الْمعلم على الْإِسَاءَة وَلَا وعده على الْإِحْسَان
segments.english: So by this saying he deposits in the child's heart [something] after which [the child will] not trust the teacher's threat for wrongdoing, or his promise for good conduct.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كبر الصَّبِي وَصلح للمعاملات والمناصب قَالَ لَهُ
segments.english: And if the child grows up and becomes fit for dealings and positions, he says to him:

segments.arabic: هَذَا سُلْطَان بلدنا يَأْخُذ اللص من الْحَبْس فَيَجْعَلهُ وزيرا أَمِيرا
segments.english: 'This [is the] sultan of our town — he takes the thief from prison and makes him [a] minister [and] commander,

segments.arabic: وَيَأْخُذ الكيّس المحسن لشغله فيخلّده الْحَبْس ويقتله ويصلبه
segments.english: and he takes the clever one who does his work well, and locks him in prison forever and kills him and crucifies him.'

segments.arabic: فَإِذا قَالَ لَهُ ذَلِك أوحشه سُلْطَانه وَجعله على غير ثِقَة من وعده ووعيده
segments.english: So if he says that to him, [he will] make him wary of his sultan and put him without trust in his promise and his threat,

segments.arabic: وأزال محبته من قلبه وَجعله يخافه مَخَافَة الظَّالِم الَّذِي يَأْخُذ المحسن بالعقوبة
segments.english: and remove his love from his heart, and make him fear him [with] the fear [one has] of [a] tyrant who punishes the one who does good.

segments.arabic: والبريء بِالْعَذَابِ
segments.english: and the innocent [one] with punishment.

segments.arabic: فأفلس هَذَا الْمِسْكِين من اعْتِقَاد كَون الْأَعْمَال نافعة أَو ضارة
segments.english: So this poor [person] became bankrupt of [the] belief that deeds [are] beneficial or harmful.

segments.arabic: فَلَا بِفعل الْخَيْر يسْتَأْنس وَلَا بِفعل الشَّرّ يستوحش
segments.english: So neither by doing good does he find comfort, nor by doing evil does he feel uneasy.

segments.arabic: وَهل فِي التنفير عَن الله وتبغيضه إِلَى عباده أَكثر من هَذَا
segments.english: And [is] there, in driving [people] away from God and making Him hated to His servants, more than this?

segments.arabic: وَلَو اجْتهد الْمَلَاحِدَة على تبغيض الدّين والتنفير عَن الله لما أَتَوا بِأَكْثَرَ من هَذَا
segments.english: And if the atheists strove to make the religion hated and to drive [people] away from God, they would not have come up with more than this.

segments.arabic: وَصَاحب هَذِه الطَّرِيقَة يظنّ أَنه يُقرر التَّوْحِيد وَالْقدر وَيرد على أهل الْبدع وينصر الدّين
segments.english: And the follower of this path thinks that he [is] establishing monotheism and [divine] decree, and refuting the people of innovation, and supporting the religion.

segments.arabic: ولعمر الله الْعَدو الْعَاقِل أقل ضَرَرا من الصّديق الْجَاهِل
segments.english: And by God's life, the intelligent enemy [is] less harmful than the ignorant friend.

segments.arabic: وَكتب الله الْمنزلَة كلهَا وَرُسُله كلهم شَهَادَة بضد ذَلِك وَلَا سِيمَا الْقُرْآن
segments.english: And the revealed books of God — all of them — and His messengers — all of them — [are a] testimony to the opposite of that, especially the Quran.

segments.arabic: فَلَو سلك الدعاة المسلك الَّذِي دَعَا الله وَرَسُوله بِهِ النَّاس إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: So if the callers [to God] had followed the path by which God and His Messenger called people to Him,

segments.arabic: لصلح الْعَالم صلاحا لَا فَسَاد مَعَه
segments.english: the world would have been set right [with] a setting right that has no corruption with it.

segments.arabic: فَالله سُبْحَانَهُ أخبر وَهُوَ الصَّادِق الوفي
segments.english: For God — glorified [is] He — informed, and He [is] the Truthful, the Faithful,

segments.arabic: أَنه إِنَّمَا يُعَامل النَّاس بكسبهم ويجازيهم بأعمالهم
segments.english: that He only deals with people according to their earnings and rewards them according to their deeds.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يخَاف المحسن ليده ظلما وَلَا هضما
segments.english: And the doer of good does not fear, on his account, injustice nor diminishment,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يخَاف بخسا وَلَا رهقا
segments.english: nor does he fear loss nor burden.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يضيع عمل محسن أبدا
segments.english: And He never wastes the deed of [a] doer of good, ever.
