segments.arabic: وَلَا يضيع على العَبْد مِثْقَال ذرة لَا يظلمها
segments.english: And He does not waste for the servant [even] the weight of an atom — He does not wrong [even] that.

segments.arabic: وَإِن تَكُ حَسَنَة يُضَاعِفهَا وَيُؤْت من لَدنه أجرا عَظِيما
segments.english: And if it [is] a good deed, He multiplies it and gives from Himself [a] great reward.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَال حَبَّة من خَرْدَل جازاه بهَا وَلَا يضيعها عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And if it [was] the weight of [a] seed of mustard, He rewards him for it and does not waste it for him.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه يَجْزِي بِالسَّيِّئَةِ مثلهَا
segments.english: And that He repays the evil deed [with] its like,

segments.arabic: ويحبطها بِالتَّوْبَةِ والندم وَالِاسْتِغْفَار والحسنات والمصائب
segments.english: and He cancels it through repentance, regret, seeking forgiveness, good deeds, and hardships.

segments.arabic: وَيجْزِي بِالْحَسَنَة عشر أَمْثَالهَا ويضاعفها إِلَى سَبْعمِائة ضعف إِلَى أَضْعَاف كَثِيرَة
segments.english: And He rewards the good deed [with] ten times its like, and multiplies it up to seven hundred times, up to many more times.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أصلح الفاسدين وَأَقْبل بقلوب المعرضين
segments.english: And He [is] the One who reformed the corrupt and turned the hearts of those who turned away,

segments.arabic: وَتَابَ على المذنبين وَهدى الضَّالّين وأنقذ الهالكين
segments.english: and accepted the repentance of the sinners, and guided the lost, and saved the perishing,

segments.arabic: وَعلم الْجَاهِلين وبصر المتحيزين وَذكر الغافلين وآوى الشاردين
segments.english: and taught the ignorant, and gave sight to the confused, and reminded the heedless, and sheltered the wandering.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا أوقع عقَابا أوقعه بعد شدَّة التمرد والعتو عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And when He brought down [a] punishment, He brought it down after extreme rebellion and defiance against Him,

segments.arabic: ودعوة العَبْد إِلَى الرُّجُوع إِلَيْهِ وَالْإِقْرَار بربوبيته وَحقه مرّة بعد مرّة
segments.english: and [after] calling the servant to return to Him and to acknowledge His lordship and His right, time after time,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى إِذا يأس من استجابته وَالْإِقْرَار بربوبيته ووحدانيته
segments.english: until when He despaired of his response and [his] acknowledgment of His lordship and His oneness,

segments.arabic: أَخذه بِبَعْض كفره وعتوّه وتمرّده
segments.english: He seized him for some of his disbelief, his defiance, and his rebellion,

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ يعْذر العَبْد من نَفسه ويعترف بِأَنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ لم يَظْلمه
segments.english: such that the servant finds no excuse for himself and admits that He — glorified [is] He — did not wrong him,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه هُوَ الظَّالِم لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: and that he [is] the one who wronged himself.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى عَن أهل النَّار
segments.english: As [God] Most High said about the people of the Fire:

segments.arabic: فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِأَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ
segments.english: So they admitted their sin. So away with the companions of the Blaze!
segments.sahih_international: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ عَمَّن أهلكهم فِي الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: And He said about those He destroyed in this world —

segments.arabic: أَنهم لما رَأَوْا آيَاته وأحسوا بعذابه قَالُوا
segments.english: that when they saw His signs and sensed His punishment, they said:

segments.arabic: يَا وَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
segments.english: "Woe to us! Indeed we were wrongdoers!"
segments.sahih_international: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

segments.arabic: فَمَا زَالَتْ تِلْكَ دَعْوَاهُمْ حَتَّى جَعَلْنَاهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَامِدِينَ
segments.english: And that did not cease [to be] their cry, until We made them [like a] harvest, silent [and] still.
segments.sahih_international: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ أَصْحَاب الْجنَّة الَّتِي أفسدها عَلَيْهِم لما رأوها
segments.english: And the owners of the garden which He ruined for them — when they saw it —

segments.arabic: ﴿قَالُوا سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ﴾
segments.english: They said, 'Glorified [is] our Lord, indeed we were wrongdoers.'
segments.sahih_international: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْحسن لقد دخلُوا النَّار وإنّ حَمده لفي قُلُوبهم
segments.english: Al-Hasan said: they entered the Fire while His praise [was] indeed in their hearts.

segments.arabic: مَا وجدوا عَلَيْهِ حجَّة وَلَا سَبِيلا
segments.english: They found no argument against Him and no way.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And for this reason, [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾
segments.english: So the remnant of the people who wronged [was] cut off, and all praise [is] for God, Lord of the worlds.
segments.sahih_international: So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ الْجُمْلَة فِي مَوضِع الْحَال
segments.english: So this sentence [is] in the position of [a] circumstantial clause,

segments.arabic: أَي قطع دابرهم حَال كَونه سُبْحَانَهُ مَحْمُودًا على ذَلِك
segments.english: meaning: He cut off their remnant while He — glorified [is] He — [was] praised for that.

segments.arabic: فَقطع دابرهم قطعا مصاحبا لحمده
segments.english: So He cut off their remnant [with] a cutting accompanied by His praise.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ قطع وإهلاك يحمد عَلَيْهِ الرب تَعَالَى
segments.english: So it [is] a cutting and [a] destruction for which the Lord, Most High, [is] praised,

segments.arabic: لَكمَال حكمته وعدله وَوَضعه الْعقُوبَة فِي موضعهَا الَّذِي لَا يَلِيق بِهِ غَيرهَا
segments.english: due to the perfection of His wisdom and His justice, and His placing the punishment in its [proper] place which nothing else [is] fitting for.

segments.arabic: فوضعها فِي الْموضع الَّذِي يَقُول من علم الْحَال
segments.english: So He placed it in the place about which whoever knows the situation says:

segments.arabic: لَا تلِيق الْعقُوبَة إِلَّا بِهَذَا الْمحل وَلَا يَلِيق بِهِ إِلَّا الْعقُوبَة
segments.english: 'The punishment [is] not fitting except for this place, and nothing [is] fitting for it except the punishment.'

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَ عقيب إخْبَاره عَن الحكم بَين عباده
segments.english: And for this reason, He said right after His telling about the judgment between His servants

segments.arabic: ومصير أهل السَّعَادَة إِلَى الْجنَّة وَأهل الشَّقَاء إِلَى النَّار
segments.english: and the destination of the people of happiness to Paradise and the people of misery to the Fire:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ الْحَمد لله رب الْعَالَمِينَ﴾
segments.english: And it [was] judged between them in truth, and it [was] said, 'All praise [is] for God, Lord of the worlds.'
segments.sahih_international: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [Allah] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds."

segments.arabic: فَحذف فَاعل القَوْل إشعارا بِالْعُمُومِ
segments.english: So He omitted the doer of the saying to indicate universality,

segments.arabic: وَأَن الْكَوْن كُله قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
segments.english: and that the entire creation said, 'All praise [is] for God, Lord of the worlds,'

segments.arabic: لما شاهدوا من حِكْمَة الْحق وعدله وفضله
segments.english: because of what they witnessed of the wisdom of the Truth, His justice, and His grace.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَ فِي حق أهل النَّار
segments.english: And for this reason, He said regarding the people of the Fire:

segments.arabic: ﴿قِيلَ ادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّم﴾
segments.english: It [was] said, 'Enter the gates of Hell.'

segments.arabic: كَأَن الْكَوْن كُله يَقُول ذَلِك
segments.english: [It is] as if the entire creation [is] saying that,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى تَقوله أعضاؤهم وأرواحهم وأرضهم وسماؤهم
segments.english: until their limbs say it, and their souls, and their earth, and their sky.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يُخْبِرُ أَنه إِذا أهلك أعداءه أنجى أولياءه
segments.english: And He — glorified [is] He — tells that when He destroys His enemies, He saves His allies,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يعمهم بِالْهَلَاكِ بمحض الْمَشِيئَة
segments.english: and [He] does not overwhelm them [all] with destruction by mere will.

segments.arabic: وَلما سَأَلَهُ نوح نجاة ابْنه
segments.english: And when Noah asked Him [for] the rescue of his son,

segments.arabic: أخبر أَنه يغرقه بِسوء عمله وكفره
segments.english: He informed [him] that He [would] drown him because of his evil deeds and his disbelief,

segments.arabic: وَلم يقل إِنِّي أغرقه بمحض مشيئتي وإرادتي بِلَا سَبَب وَلَا ذَنْب
segments.english: and He did not say, 'I [will] drown him by mere will and desire, without [a] cause and without [a] sin.'

segments.arabic: وَقد ضمن سُبْحَانَهُ زِيَادَة الْهِدَايَة للمجاهدين فِي سبله
segments.english: And He — glorified [is] He — guaranteed increased guidance for those who strive in His paths,

segments.arabic: وَلم يخبر أَنه يضلهم وَيبْطل سَعْيهمْ
segments.english: and [He] did not say that He [would] misguide them and waste their efforts.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ ضمن زِيَادَة الْهِدَايَة لِلْمُتقين الَّذين يتبعُون رضوانه
segments.english: And likewise, He guaranteed increased guidance for the God-conscious who follow His pleasure.

segments.arabic: وَأخْبر أَنه لَا يضل إِلَّا الْفَاسِقين
segments.english: And He informed that He does not misguide except the rebellious,

segments.arabic: الَّذين ينقضون عَهده من بعد ميثاقه
segments.english: those who break His covenant after its confirmation.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه إِنَّمَا يضل من آثر الضلال وَاخْتَارَهُ على الْهدى
segments.english: And that He only misguides the one who preferred misguidance and chose it over guidance,

segments.arabic: فيطبع حِينَئِذٍ على سَمعه وَقَلبه
segments.english: so He seals at that point his hearing and his heart.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه يقلب قلب من لم يرض بهداه إِذا جَاءَهُ وَلم يُؤمن بِهِ وَدفعه وردّه
segments.english: And that He turns the heart of the one who [was] not pleased with His guidance when it came to him, and did not believe in it, and pushed it away and rejected it.

segments.arabic: فيقلب فُؤَاده وبصره عُقُوبَة لَهُ على رده وَدفعه لما تحَققه وعرفه
segments.english: So He turns his heart and his sight [as] a punishment for him, for his rejecting and pushing away what he [had] recognized and known.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه سُبْحَانَهُ لَو علم فِي تِلْكَ الْمحَال الَّتِي حكم عَلَيْهَا بالضلال والشقاء خيرا لأفهمها وهداها
segments.english: And that He — glorified [is] He — if He [had] known in those places which He ruled upon with misguidance and misery [any] good, He would have made them understand and guided them.

segments.arabic: وَلكنهَا لَا تصلح لنعمته وَلَا تلِيق بهَا كرامته
segments.english: But they [are] not fit for His blessing, and His honor [is] not fitting for them.

segments.arabic: وَقد أزاح سُبْحَانَهُ الْعِلَل وَأقَام الْحجَج ومكّن من أَسبَاب الْهِدَايَة
segments.english: And He — glorified [is] He — removed the excuses, established the proofs, and enabled the means of guidance.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه لَا يضل إِلَّا الْفَاسِقين والظالمين وَلَا يطبع
segments.english: And that He does not misguide except the rebellious and the wrongdoers, and He does not seal—

segments.arabic: إِلَّا على قُلُوب الْمُعْتَدِينَ
segments.english: except upon the hearts of the transgressors.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يركس فِي الْفِتْنَة إِلَّا الْمُنَافِقين بكسبهم
segments.english: And He does not throw back into trial except the hypocrites, because of their earning.

segments.arabic: وَأَن الرين الَّذِي غطى بِهِ قُلُوب الْكفَّار وَهُوَ عين كسبهم وأعمالهم
segments.english: And that the rust which He covered the hearts of the disbelievers with — it [is] the very [thing of] their earning and their deeds.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ
segments.english: As He said:

segments.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ رَانَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
segments.english: No! Rather, what they used to earn has rusted over their hearts.
segments.sahih_international: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ عَن أعدائه من الْيَهُود
segments.english: And He said about His enemies among the Jews:

segments.arabic: وَقَالُوا قُلُوبنَا غلف بَلْ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا بِكُفْرِهِمْ
segments.english: And they said: our hearts [are] sealed. Rather, God sealed over them because of their disbelief.
segments.sahih_international: And [We cursed them] for their breaking of the covenant and their disbelief in the signs of Allah and their killing of the prophets without right and their saying, "Our hearts are wrapped". Rather, Allah has sealed them because of their disbelief, so they believe not, except for a few.

segments.arabic: وَأخْبر أَنه لَا يضل من هداه حَتَّى يبيّن لَهُ مَا يَتَّقِي
segments.english: And He informed that He does not misguide the one He guided until He makes clear to him what to avoid.

segments.arabic: فيختار لشقوته وَسُوء طَبِيعَته الضلال على الْهدى والغي على الرشاد
segments.english: Then he chooses — because of his wretchedness and the badness of his nature — misguidance over guidance, and error over right direction.

segments.arabic: وَيكون مَعَ نَفسه وشيطانه وعدو ربه عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And he [is] with his self and his devil and the enemy of his Lord, against him.

segments.arabic: وَأما الْمَكْر الَّذِي وصف بِهِ نَفسه فَهُوَ مجازاته للماكرين بأوليائه وَرُسُله
segments.english: As for the plotting which He described Himself with, it [is] His repaying of those who plot against His allies and His messengers.

segments.arabic: فيقابل مَكْرهمْ السيء بمكره الْحسن
segments.english: So He meets their evil plotting with His good plotting.

segments.arabic: فَيكون الْمَكْر مِنْهُم أقبح شَيْء وَمِنْه أحسن شيء
segments.english: So plotting from them [is] the ugliest thing, and from Him [is] the best thing,

segments.arabic: لأنه عدل ومجازاة
segments.english: because it [is] justice and repayment.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ المخادعة مِنْهُ جَزَاء على مخادعة رسله وأوليائه
segments.english: And likewise, the outwitting from Him [is] repayment for [their] outwitting His messengers and His allies.

segments.arabic: فَلَا أحسن من تِلْكَ المخادعة وَالْمَكْر
segments.english: So nothing [is] better than that outwitting and plotting.

segments.arabic: وَأما كَون الرجل يعْمل بِعَمَل أهل الْجنَّة حَتَّى مَا يكون بَينه وَبَينهَا إِلَّا ذِرَاع
segments.english: As for the man [who] does the deeds of the people of Paradise until there [is] nothing between him and it except [a] cubit,

segments.arabic: فَيَسْبق عَلَيْهِ الْكتاب
segments.english: then the decree overtakes him —

segments.arabic: فَإِن هَذَا عمل أهل الْجنَّة فِيمَا يظْهر للنَّاس
segments.english: then this [is] the deeds of the people of Paradise in what appears to people.

segments.arabic: وَلَو كَانَ عملا صَالحا مَقْبُولًا للجنة قد أحبه الله ورضيه لم يُبطلهُ عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And if it were [a] righteous deed, accepted for Paradise, which God loved and [was] pleased with, He would not have made it worthless for him.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله لم يبْق بَينه وَبَينهَا إِلَّا ذِرَاع يشكل على هَذَا التَّأْوِيل
segments.english: And his saying "there did not remain between him and it except [a] cubit" [is] difficult for this interpretation.

segments.arabic: فَيُقَال لما كَانَ الْعَمَل بِآخِرهِ وخاتمته
segments.english: So it [is] said: since deeds [are judged] by their end and their conclusion,

segments.arabic: لم يصبر هَذَا الْعَامِل على عمله حَتَّى يتم لَهُ
segments.english: this doer did not have patience upon his deed until it [was] completed for him.

segments.arabic: بل كَانَ فِيهِ آفَة كامنة ونكتة خذل بهَا فِي آخر عمره
segments.english: Rather, there was in him [a] hidden flaw and [a] defect by which he was let down at the end of his life.

segments.arabic: فخانته تِلْكَ الآفة والداهية الباطنة فِي وَقت الْحَاجة
segments.english: So that flaw and hidden calamity betrayed him at the time of need.

segments.arabic: فَرجع إِلَى مُوجبهَا وعملت عَملهَا
segments.english: So he returned to what it required, and it did its work.

segments.arabic: وَلَو لم يكن هُنَاكَ غش وَآفَة لم يقلب الله إيمَانه
segments.english: And if there were no deception and flaw there, God would not have overturned his faith.

segments.arabic: لقد أوردهُ مَعَ صدقه فِيهِ وإخلاصه بِغَيْر سَبَب مِنْهُ يَقْتَضِي إفساده عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: Would He have brought him [to ruin] despite his truthfulness in it and his sincerity, without [a] cause from him that required ruining it for him?

segments.arabic: وَالله يعلم من سَائِر الْعباد مَا لَا يُعلمهُ بَعضهم من بعض
segments.english: And God knows about all the servants what some of them do not know about others.

segments.arabic: وَأما شَأْن إِبْلِيس فَإِن الله سُبْحَانَهُ قَالَ للْمَلَائكَة
segments.english: As for the matter of Iblis, then God — glorified [is] He — said to the angels:

segments.arabic: إِنِّي أَعْلَمُ مَالا تعلمُونَ
segments.english: I know what you do not know.

segments.arabic: فالرب تَعَالَى كَانَ يعلم مَا فِي قلب إِبْلِيس من الْكفْر وَالْكبر والحسد مَالا يُعلمهُ الْمَلَائِكَة
segments.english: So the Lord, Most High, knew what was in the heart of Iblis — of disbelief and arrogance and envy — what the angels did not know.

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا أمروا بِالسُّجُود ظهر مَا فِي قُلُوبهم من الطَّاعَة والمحبة والخشية والانقياد
segments.english: So when they were commanded to prostrate, what was in their hearts appeared — of obedience and love and awe and submission.

segments.arabic: فبادروا إِلَى الِامْتِثَال
segments.english: So they rushed to comply.

segments.arabic: وَظهر مَا فِي قلب عدوه من الْكبر والغش والحسد
segments.english: And what was in the heart of His enemy appeared — of arrogance and deception and envy.

segments.arabic: فَأبى واستكبر وَكَانَ من الْكَافرين
segments.english: So he refused and [was] arrogant, and was among the disbelievers.

headings.arabic: فصل السّنة شَجَرَة والشهور فروعها وَالْأَيَّام أَغْصَانهَا والساعات أوراقها
headings.english: Section: The year [is] [a] tree, the months [are] its branches, the days [are] its twigs, and the hours [are] its leaves

headings.arabic: فصل إذا بلغ العبد أعطى عهده الذي عهده إليه خالقه ومالكه فإذا أخذ
headings.english: Section: When the servant reaches maturity, he [is] given his covenant — the one his Creator and Owner entrusted to him — so when he takes

segments.arabic: وَأما خوف أوليائه من مكره فَحق
segments.english: As for the fear of His close servants of His plan — it [is] true.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُم يخَافُونَ أَن يخذلهم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وخطاياهم فيصيرون إِلَى الشَّقَاء
segments.english: For they fear that He [will] abandon them because of their sins and mistakes, and they [would] end up in misery.

segments.arabic: فخوفهم من ذنوبهم ورجاؤهم لِرَحْمَتِهِ
segments.english: So their fear [is] from their sins, and their hope [is] in His mercy.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله أفأمنوا مكر الله إِنَّمَا هُوَ فِي حق الْفجار وَالْكفَّار
segments.english: And His saying, 'Did they feel safe from the plan of God?' — it [is] only regarding the sinful and the disbelievers.

segments.arabic: وَمعنى الْآيَة فَلَا يعْصى ويأمن مُقَابلَة الله لَهُ على مكر السَّيِّئَات بمكره بِهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْم الخاسرون
segments.english: And the meaning of the verse [is]: no one disobeys and [then] feels safe from God repaying him for the scheming of evil deeds with His scheme against him, except the losing people.

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِي يخافه العارفون بِاللَّه من مكره أَن يُؤَخر عَنْهُم عَذَاب الْأَفْعَال
segments.english: And what those who know God fear from His plan [is] that He [may] delay from them the punishment of [their] deeds,

segments.arabic: فَيحصل مِنْهُم نوع اغترار فيأنسوا بِالذنُوبِ
segments.english: so [a] type of self-deception occurs in them, and they become comfortable with sins,

segments.arabic: فيجيئهم الْعَذَاب على غرّة وفترة
segments.english: and the punishment comes to them during [a time of] heedlessness and weakness.

segments.arabic: وَأمر آخر وَهُوَ أَن يغفلوا عَنهُ وينسوا ذكره
segments.english: And another matter — [which] [is] that they become heedless of Him and forget His remembrance,

segments.arabic: فيتخلى عَنْهُم إِذا تخلوا عَن ذكره وطاعته
segments.english: so He abandons them when they abandon His remembrance and obedience,

segments.arabic: فيسرع إِلَيْهِم الْبلَاء والفتنة
segments.english: and trial and tribulation rush toward them.

segments.arabic: فَيكون مكره بهم تخليه عَنْهُم
segments.english: So His plan against them [is] His abandoning of them.

segments.arabic: وَأمر آخر أَن يعلم من ذنوبهم وعيوبهم مَا لَا يعلمونه من نُفُوسهم
segments.english: And another matter — that He knows of their sins and faults what they do not know of themselves,

segments.arabic: فيأتيهم الْمَكْر من حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
segments.english: so the plan comes to them from where they do not sense [it].

segments.arabic: وَأمر آخر أَن يمتحنهم ويبتليهم بِمَا لَا صَبر لَهُم عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And another matter — that He tests them and tries them with what they have no patience for,

segments.arabic: فيفتنون بِهِ وَذَلِكَ مكر
segments.english: and they [are] led astray by it — and that [is] [a] plan.

segments.arabic: السّنة شَجَرَة والشهور فروعها وَالْأَيَّام أَغْصَانهَا والساعات أوراقها
segments.english: The year [is] [a] tree, and the months [are] its branches, and the days [are] its twigs, and the hours [are] its leaves,

segments.arabic: والأنفاس ثَمَرهَا
segments.english: and the breaths [are] its fruits.

segments.arabic: فَمن كَانَت أنفاسه فِي طَاعَة فثمرة شجرته طيبَة
segments.english: So whoever's breaths were in obedience, the fruit of his tree [is] good.

segments.arabic: وَمن كَانَت فِي مَعْصِيّة فثمرته حنظل
segments.english: And whoever's [breaths] were in disobedience, his fruit [is] bitter colocynth.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا يكون الجداد يَوْم الْمعَاد
segments.english: And the harvest [is] only on the Day of the Return.

segments.arabic: فَعِنْدَ الجداد يتَبَيَّن حُلْو الثِّمَار من مرّها
segments.english: So at the harvest, the sweet fruits become clear from the bitter ones.

segments.arabic: وَالْإِخْلَاص والتوحيد شَجَرَة فِي الْقلب فروعها الْأَعْمَال
segments.english: And sincerity and monotheism [are] [a] tree in the heart — its branches [are] the deeds,

segments.arabic: وَثَمَرهَا طيب الْحَيَاة فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالنَّعِيم الْمُقِيم فِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: and its fruit [is] the goodness of life in this world and the lasting bliss in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وكما أَن ثمار الْجنَّة لَا مَقْطُوعَة وَلَا مَمْنُوعَة
segments.english: And just as the fruits of Paradise [are] neither cut off nor forbidden,

segments.arabic: فثمرة التَّوْحِيد وَالْإِخْلَاص فِي الدُّنْيَا كَذَلِك
segments.english: so the fruit of monotheism and sincerity in this world [is] likewise.

segments.arabic: والشرك وَالْكذب والرياء شَجَرَة فِي الْقلب
segments.english: And associating partners [with God], lying, and showing off [are] [a] tree in the heart.

segments.arabic: ثَمَرهَا فِي الدُنْيَا الْخَوْف والهم وَالْغَم وضيق الصَّدْر وظلمة الْقلب
segments.english: Its fruit in this world [is] fear, worry, grief, tightness of the chest, and darkness of the heart.

segments.arabic: وَثَمَرهَا فِي الْآخِرَة الزقّوم وَالْعَذَاب الْمُقِيم
segments.english: And its fruit in the Hereafter [is] the zaqqum and lasting punishment.

segments.arabic: وَقد ذكر الله هَاتين الشجرتين فِي سُورَة إِبْرَاهِيم
segments.english: And God has mentioned these two trees in Surah Ibrahim.

segments.arabic: إِذا بلغ العَبْد أعْطى عَهده الَّذِي عَهده إِلَيْهِ خالقه ومالكه
segments.english: When the servant reaches maturity, he [is] given his covenant — the one his Creator and Owner entrusted to him.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أَخذ عَهده بِقُوَّة وَقبُول
segments.english: So when he takes his covenant with strength and acceptance,

segments.arabic: وعزم على تَنْفِيذ مَا فِيهِ صلح للمراتب والمناصب الَّتِي يصلح لَهَا الموفون بعهودهم
segments.english: and [he] resolved to carry out what [is] in it [of] goodness, for the ranks and positions that those who fulfill their covenants [are] fit for.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا هز نَفسه عِنْد أَخذ الْعَهْد وانتحاها
segments.english: So when he shook his self at the taking of the covenant and set it straight,

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ قد أُهِّلْت لعهد رَبِّي فَمن أولى بقبوله وفهمه وتنفيذه مني
segments.english: and said: I have been made worthy of the covenant of my Lord — so who [is] more deserving of accepting it, understanding it, and carrying it out than me?

segments.arabic: فحرص أَولا على فهم عَهده وتدبره وتعرفه وَصَايَا سَيّده لَهُ
segments.english: So he was eager first to understand his covenant, to reflect on it, and to recognize the instructions of his Master to him.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ وطّن نَفسه على امْتِثَال مَا فِي عَهده وَالْعَمَل بِهِ وتنفيذه حَسْبَمَا تضمنه عَهده
segments.english: Then he settled his self on obeying what [is] in his covenant, acting by it, and carrying it out according to what his covenant contained.

segments.arabic: فأبصر بِقَلْبِه حَقِيقَة الْعَهْد وَمَا تضمنه
segments.english: So he saw with his heart the reality of the covenant and what it contained.

segments.arabic: فاستحدث همة أُخْرَى وعزيمة غير الْعَزِيمَة الَّتِي كَانَ فِيهَا وَقت الصِّبَا قبل وُصُول الْعَهْد
segments.english: So he developed another drive and [a] resolve other than the resolve he had been in [at the] time of youth, before the arrival of the covenant.

segments.arabic: فاستقال من ظلمَة غرَّة الصِّبَا والانقياد للْعَادَة والمنشأ
segments.english: So he freed himself from the darkness of youthful ignorance and [from] following habit and upbringing.

segments.arabic: وصبر على شرف الهمة وهتك ستر الظلمَة إِلَى نور الْيَقِين
segments.english: And [he] was patient upon the nobility of [his] drive, and [he] tore the veil of darkness toward the light of certainty.

segments.arabic: فَأدْرك بِقدر صبره وَصدق اجْتِهَاده مَا وهبه الله لَهُ من فَضله
segments.english: So he attained — by the measure of his patience and the truthfulness of his striving — what God granted him from His bounty.

segments.arabic: فَأول مَرَاتِب سعادته أَن تكون لَهُ أذن وَاعِيَة وقلب يعقل مَا تعيه الْأذن
segments.english: So the first of the ranks of his happiness [is] that he has [a] receptive ear and [a] heart [that] understands what the ear takes in.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا سمع وعقل واستبانت لَهُ الجادة وَرَأى عَلَيْهَا تِلْكَ الْأَعْلَام
segments.english: So when he heard and understood, and the straight path became clear to him, and he saw upon it those markers,

segments.arabic: وَرَأى أَكثر النَّاس منحرفين عَنْهَا يَمِينا وَشمَالًا فلزمها وَلم ينحرف مَعَ المنحرفين
segments.english: and [he] saw most people turning away from it — right and left — he held firmly to it and did not turn away with those who turned away.

segments.arabic: الَّذين كَانَ سَبَب انحرافهم عدم قبُول الْعَهْد
segments.english: Those whose turning away was caused by not accepting the covenant,

segments.arabic: أَو قبلوه بكره وَلم يأخذوه بِقُوَّة وَلَا عَزِيمَة
segments.english: or [they] accepted it with reluctance and did not take it with strength or resolve,

segments.arabic: وَلَا حدثوا أنفسهم بفهمه وتدبره وَالْعَمَل بِمَا فِيهِ وتنفيذ وَصَايَاهُ
segments.english: and [they] did not tell themselves [to] understand it, reflect on it, act by what [is] in it, and carry out its instructions.

segments.arabic: بل عرض غيهم الْعَهْد وَمَعَهُمْ ضراوة الصِّبَا وَدين الْعَادة وَمَا ألفوا عَلَيْهِ الْآبَاء والأمهات
segments.english: Rather, their misguidance opposed the covenant, and with them [was] the fierceness of youth and the religion of habit and what they found their fathers and mothers upon.

segments.arabic: فتلقوا الْعَهْد تلقي من هُوَ مكتف بِمَا وجد عَلَيْهِ آباءه وسلفه وعادتهم
segments.english: So they received the covenant [with] the receiving of one who [is] satisfied with what he found his fathers, predecessors, and their customs upon.

segments.arabic: لَا تَكْفِي من يجمع همه وَقَلبه على فهم الْعَهْد وَالْعَمَل بِهِ
segments.english: [That] does not suffice for one [who] gathers his drive and his heart upon understanding the covenant and acting by it,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى كَأَن ذَلِك الْعَهْد أَتَاهُ وَحده وَقيل لَهُ تَأمل مَا فِيهِ ثمَّ اعْمَلْ بِمُوجبِه
segments.english: until [it is] as if that covenant came to him alone, and [it was] said to him: reflect on what [is] in it, then act according to what it requires.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا لم يتلق عَهده هَذَا التلقي أخلد إِلَى سير الْقَرَابَة وَمَا استمرت عَلَيْهِ عَادَة أَهله وَأَصْحَابه وجيرانه وَأهل بَلَده
segments.english: So if he did not receive his covenant [with] this [kind of] receiving, he settled into the ways of [his] relatives and what the habits of his family, companions, neighbors, and people of his town continued upon.

segments.arabic: فَإِن علت همته أخلد إِلَى مَا عَلَيْهِ سلفه وَمن تقدمه من غير الْتِفَات إِلَى تدبر الْعَهْد وفهمه
segments.english: And if his drive was high, he [still] settled into what his predecessors and those before him [were] upon, without turning to reflect on the covenant and understand it.

segments.arabic: فَرضِي لنَفسِهِ أَن يكون دينه دين الْعَادة
segments.english: So he was content for himself that his religion [would] be the religion of habit.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا شامه الشَّيْطَان وَرَأى هَذَا مبلغ همته وعزيمته
segments.english: So when Satan sensed him and saw that this [was] the extent of his drive and his resolve,

segments.arabic: رَمَاه بالعصبية وَالْحمية للآباء وسلفه
segments.english: he struck him with tribalism and zeal for [his] fathers and predecessors,

segments.arabic: وزيّن لَهُ أَن هَذَا هُوَ الْحق وَمَا خَالفه بَاطِل
segments.english: and made it seem beautiful to him that this [is] the truth and whatever opposes it [is] falsehood.

segments.arabic: وَمثل لَهُ الْهدى فِي صُورَة الضلال والضلال فِي صُورَة الْهدى
segments.english: And [he] made guidance appear to him in the image of misguidance, and misguidance in the image of guidance,

segments.arabic: بِتِلْكَ العصبية وَالْحمية الَّتِي أسست على غير علم
segments.english: through that tribalism and zeal that [were] founded upon other than knowledge.

segments.arabic: فرضاه أَن يكون مَعَ عشيرته وَقَومه لَهُ مَا لَهُم وَعَلِيهِ مَا عَلَيْهِم
segments.english: So he was content to be with his clan and his people — for him [is] what [is] for them, and upon him [is] what [is] upon them.

segments.arabic: فخذل عَن الْهدى وولاه الله مَا تولّى
segments.english: So he was abandoned from guidance, and God turned him to what he [himself] turned to.

segments.arabic: فَلَو جَاءَهُ كل هدى يُخَالف قومه وعشيرته لم يره
segments.english: So even if every [form of] guidance that opposes his people and his clan came to him, he would not see it.

segments.arabic: إِلَّا ضَلَالَة
segments.english: except misguidance.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا كَانَت همته أَعلَى من ذَلِك وَنَفسه أشرف وَقدره أَعلَى
segments.english: And if his drive was higher than that, and his self [was] nobler, and his worth [was] higher,

segments.arabic: أقبل على حفظ عَهده وفهمه وتدبره
segments.english: he turned to preserving His covenant, understanding it, and reflecting on it.

segments.arabic: وَعلم أَن لصَاحب الْعَهْد شَأْنًا لَيْسَ كشأن غَيره
segments.english: And he knew that the Owner of the covenant has [a] status unlike the status of anyone else.

segments.arabic: فَأخذ نَفسه بمعرفته من نفس الْعَهْد
segments.english: So he took it upon himself to know Him from the covenant itself.

segments.arabic: فَوَجَدَهُ قد تعرف إِلَيْهِ وعرفه نَفسه وَصِفَاته وأسماءه وأفعاله وَأَحْكَامه
segments.english: And he found that He had made Himself known to him, and introduced him to His essence, His attributes, His names, His actions, and His rulings.

segments.arabic: فَعرف من ذَلِك الْعَهْد قيوما بِنَفسِهِ مُقيما لغيره
segments.english: So he came to know from that covenant [a] Self-Sustainer by Himself, [a] Sustainer of everything else,

segments.arabic: غَنِيا عَن كل مَا سواهُ وكل مَا سواهُ فَقير إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: free of need from all that [is] besides Him, while all that [is] besides Him [is] in need of Him,

segments.arabic: مستو على عَرْشه فَوق جَمِيع خلقه
segments.english: risen over His Throne above all of His creation,

segments.arabic: يرى وَيسمع ويرضى ويغضب وَيُحب وَيبغض
segments.english: He sees, hears, [is] pleased, [is] angry, loves, and hates,

segments.arabic: وَيُدبر أَمر مَمْلَكَته وَهُوَ فَوق عَرْشه
segments.english: and He manages the affairs of His kingdom while He [is] above His Throne,

segments.arabic: مُتَكَلم آمُر ناه
segments.english: [He is] speaking, commanding, forbidding,

segments.arabic: يُرْسل رسله إِلَى أقطار مَمْلَكَته بِكَلَامِهِ الَّذِي يسمعهُ من يَشَاء من خلقه
segments.english: sending His messengers to the regions of His kingdom with His speech, which He makes heard by whoever He wills from His creation.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه قَائِم بِالْقِسْطِ مُجاز بِالْإِحْسَانِ والإساءة
segments.english: And that He [is] upholding justice, repaying [both] good and evil.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه حَلِيم غَفُور شكور جواد محسن
segments.english: And that He [is] Forbearing, Forgiving, Grateful, Generous, [and] Good-doing,

segments.arabic: مَوْصُوف بِكُل كَمَال منزه عَن كل عيب وَنقص
segments.english: described with every perfection, free from every flaw and deficiency,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه لَا مثل لَهُ
segments.english: and that there [is] nothing like Him.

segments.arabic: وَيشْهد حكمته فِي تَدْبِير مَمْلَكَته
segments.english: And he witnesses His wisdom in managing His kingdom,

segments.arabic: وَكَيف يقدر مقاديره بِمَشِيئَة غير مضادة لعدله وحكمته
segments.english: and how He sets His decrees with [a] will that does not oppose His justice and His wisdom.

segments.arabic: وتظاهر عِنْده الْعقل وَالشَّرْع والفطرة
segments.english: And reason, revealed law, and inborn nature supported one another for him,

segments.arabic: فَصدق كل مِنْهُمَا صَاحِبيهِ
segments.english: so each of them confirmed the other two.

segments.arabic: وَفهم عَن الله سُبْحَانَهُ مَا وصف بِهِ نَفسه فِي كِتَابه
segments.english: And he understood from God — glorified [is] He — what He described Himself with in His Book:

segments.arabic: من حقائق أَسْمَائِهِ الَّتِي بهَا نزل الْكتاب وَبهَا نطق
segments.english: the realities of His names, by which the Book was sent down and by which it spoke,

segments.arabic: وَلها أثبت وحقق وَبهَا تعرف إِلَّا عباده
segments.english: and for which it affirmed and confirmed, and by which He made Himself known to His servants,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى أقرّت بِهِ الْعُقُول وَشهِدت بِهِ الْفطر
segments.english: until minds accepted it and inborn natures testified to it.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا عرف بِقَلْبِه وتيقن صِفَات صَاحب الْعَهْد
segments.english: So when he knew with his heart and became certain of the attributes of the Owner of the covenant,

segments.arabic: وأشرقت أنوارها على قلبه فَصَارَت لَهُ كالمعاينة
segments.english: and their lights shone upon his heart until they became for him like direct seeing,

segments.arabic: فَرَأى حِينَئِذٍ تعلقهَا بالخلق وَالْأَمر وارتباطهما بهَا
segments.english: then he saw at that point their connection to creation and command, and their link to them,

segments.arabic: وسريان آثارهما فِي الْعَالم الْحسي والعالم الروحي
segments.english: and the flowing of their effects through the physical world and the spiritual world.

segments.arabic: وَرَأى تصرفها فِي الْخَلَائق كَيفَ عمّت وخصّت وقرّبت وأبعدت وأعطت ومنعت
segments.english: And he saw their working among the creatures — how they [were] general and specific, bringing near and distancing, giving and withholding.

segments.arabic: فشاهد بِقَلْبِه مواقع عدله سُبْحَانَهُ وقسطه وفضله وَرَحمته
segments.english: So he witnessed with his heart the places of His justice — glorified [is] He — His fairness, His grace, and His mercy.

segments.arabic: وَاجْتمعَ لَهُ الْإِيمَان بِلُزُوم حجَّته مَعَ نُفُوذ أقضيته
segments.english: And faith gathered for him [in] the binding nature of His proof along with the carrying out of His decrees,

segments.arabic: وَكَمَال قدرته مَعَ كَمَال عدله وحكمته
segments.english: and the perfection of His power along with the perfection of His justice and His wisdom,

segments.arabic: وَنِهَايَة علوّه على جَمِيع خلقه مَعَ إحاطته ومعيّته
segments.english: and the utmost [extent] of His highness over all His creation along with His surrounding [knowledge] and His closeness,

segments.arabic: وعظمته وجلاله وكبريائه وبطشه وانتقامه مَعَ رَحمته وبره ولطفه وجوده وعفوه وحلمه
segments.english: and His greatness, His majesty, His supreme glory, His might, and His punishment — along with His mercy, His goodness, His gentleness, His generosity, His pardon, and His forbearance.

segments.arabic: وَرَأى لُزُوم الْحجَّة مَعَ قهر الْمَقَادِير الَّتِي لَا خُرُوج لمخلوق عَنْهَا
segments.english: And he saw the binding nature of the proof along with the overpowering decrees that no created being can escape.

segments.arabic: وَكَيف اصطحاب الصِّفَات وتوافقها وَشَهَادَة بَعْضهَا لبَعض
segments.english: And [he saw] how the attributes accompany one another, agree with one another, and each testifies to the other.

segments.arabic: وانعطاف الْحِكْمَة الَّتِي هِيَ نِهَايَة وَغَايَة على الْمَقَادِير الَّتِي هِيَ أول وبداية
segments.english: And [he saw] how wisdom — which [is] the end and the goal — turns back upon the decrees — which [are] the beginning and the start,

segments.arabic: وَرُجُوع فروعها إِلَى أُصُولهَا ومبادئها إِلَى
segments.english: and [how] its branches return to their roots, and its beginnings to —

segments.arabic: غاياتها حَتَّى كَأَنَّهُ مشَاهد مبادىء الْحِكْمَة وتأسيس القضايا على وفْق الْحِكْمَة وَالْعدْل والمصلحة وَالرَّحْمَة وَالْإِحْسَان
segments.english: its ends — until [it is] as if he [is] witnessing the beginnings of wisdom, and the establishment of matters in accordance with wisdom, justice, benefit, mercy, and goodness.

segments.arabic: لَا تخرج قَضِيَّة عَن ذَلِك إِلَى انْقِضَاء الأكوان
segments.english: No matter goes beyond that, until the end of all creation,

segments.arabic: وانفصال الْأَحْكَام يَوْم الْفَصْل بَين الْعباد
segments.english: and the settlement of judgments [on] the Day of Separation between the servants,

segments.arabic: وَظُهُور عدله وحكمته وَصدق رسله وَمَا أخْبرت بِهِ عَنهُ لجَمِيع الخليقة انسها وجنّها مؤمنها وكافرها
segments.english: and the appearance of His justice and His wisdom, and the truthfulness of His messengers and what they reported about Him — to all of creation, its humans and its jinn, its believers and its disbelievers.

segments.arabic: وَحِينَئِذٍ يتَبَيَّن من صِفَات جَلَاله ونعوت كَمَاله لِلْخلقِ مَا لم يَكُونُوا يعرفونه قبل ذَلِك
segments.english: And at that time, [there] will become clear — from the attributes of His majesty and descriptions of His perfection — to creation, what they did not used to know before that,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى إِن أعرف خلقه بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا يثني عَلَيْهِ يَوْمئِذٍ من صِفَات كَمَاله ونعوت جَلَاله مَا لم يكن يُحسنهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: such that the most knowledgeable of His creation about Him in this world will praise Him on that Day with attributes of His perfection and descriptions of His majesty that he did not used to master in this world.

segments.arabic: وكما يظْهر ذَلِك لخلقه تظهر لَهُم الْأَسْبَاب الَّتِي بهَا زاغ الزائغون وضلّ الضالّون وَانْقطع المنقطعون
segments.english: And just as that becomes clear to His creation, the reasons by which the deviant deviated, the misguided went astray, and the cut-off were cut off become clear to them.

segments.arabic: فَيكون الْفرق بَين الْعلم يَوْمئِذٍ بحقائق الْأَسْمَاء وَالصِّفَات وَالْعلم بهَا فِي الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: So the difference between knowledge on that Day of the realities of the Names and Attributes, and knowledge of them in this world,

segments.arabic: كالفرق بَين الْعلم بِالْجنَّةِ وَالنَّار ومشاهدتهما وَأعظم من ذَلِك
segments.english: [will be] like the difference between knowledge of Paradise and the Fire and [actually] witnessing them — and greater than that.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ يفهم من العَبْد كَيفَ اقْتَضَت أسماؤه وَصِفَاته لوُجُود النُّبُوَّة والشرائع
segments.english: And likewise the servant understands how His Names and Attributes necessitated the existence of prophethood and [divine] laws,

segments.arabic: وَأَن لَا يتْرك خلقه سدى
segments.english: and that He [would] not leave His creation without purpose,

segments.arabic: وَكَيف اقْتَضَت مَا تضمّنته من الْأَوَامِر والنواهي
segments.english: and how they necessitated what they contain of commands and prohibitions,

segments.arabic: وَكَيف اقْتَضَت وُقُوع الثَّوَاب وَالْعِقَاب والمعاد
segments.english: and how they necessitated the occurrence of reward and punishment and the Return,

segments.arabic: وَأَن ذَلِك من مُوجبَات أَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاته
segments.english: and that all of that [is] from the requirements of His Names and Attributes,

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ ينزّه عَمَّا زعم أعداؤه من إِنْكَار ذَلِك
segments.english: such that He [is] exalted above what His enemies claimed of denying that.

segments.arabic: وَيرى شُمُول الْقُدْرَة وإحاطتها بِجَمِيعِ الكائنات حَتَّى لَا يشذّ عَنْهَا مِثْقَال ذرة
segments.english: And he sees the all-encompassing [nature] of [His] power and its surrounding of all beings, such that not [even] the weight of an atom escapes it.

segments.arabic: وَيرى أَنه لَو كَانَ مَعَه إِلَه آخر لفسد هَذَا الْعَالم
segments.english: And he sees that if there were with Him another god, this world would [have been] ruined,

segments.arabic: فَكَانَت تفْسد السَّمَاوَات وَالْأَرْض وَمن فِيهِنَّ
segments.english: and the heavens and the earth and whoever [is] in them would [have been] ruined.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه سُبْحَانَهُ لَو جَازَ عَلَيْهِ النّوم أَو الْمَوْت لتدكدك هَذَا الْعَالم بأسره وَلم يثبت طرفَة عين
segments.english: And that He — glorified [is] He — if sleep or death were possible for Him, this entire world would collapse and [would] not remain [for even] the blink of an eye.

segments.arabic: وَيرى ذَلِك الْإِسْلَام وَالْإِيمَان اللَّذين تعبّد الله بهما جَمِيع عباده
segments.english: And he sees that Islam and faith — with which God obligated all His servants [to worship] —

segments.arabic: كَيفَ انبعاثهما من الصِّفَات المقدسة
segments.english: how they both spring from the sacred Attributes,

segments.arabic: وَكَيف اقتضيا الثَّوَاب وَالْعِقَاب عَاجلا وآجلا
segments.english: and how they both necessitated reward and punishment, immediately and in the future.

segments.arabic: وَيرى مَعَ ذَلِك أَنه لَا يَسْتَقِيم قبُول هَذَا الْعَهْد والتزامه لمن جحد صِفَاته
segments.english: And he sees along with that, that acceptance of this covenant and commitment to it [is] not sound for whoever denied His Attributes,

segments.arabic: وَأنكر علوه على خلقه وتكلمه بكتبه وعهوده
segments.english: and denied His elevation over His creation, and His speaking with His books and His covenants,

segments.arabic: كَمَا لَا يَسْتَقِيم قبُوله لمن أنكر حَقِيقَة سَمعه وبصره وحياته وإرادته وقوته
segments.english: just as its acceptance [is] not sound for whoever denied the reality of His hearing, His sight, His life, His will, and His power.

segments.arabic: وَأَن هَؤُلَاءِ هم الَّذين ردوا عَهده وأبوا قبُوله
segments.english: And that these [are] the ones who rejected His covenant and refused to accept it,

segments.arabic: وَأَن من قبله مِنْهُم لم يقبله بِجَمِيعِ مَا فِيهِ
segments.english: and that whoever among them accepted it did not accept it with all that [is] in it.

segments.arabic: وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And with God [is] success.

headings.arabic: فصل خلق بدن ابن آدم من الأرض وروحه من ملكوت السماء وقرن بينهما
headings.english: Chapter: The body of the son of Adam was created from the earth, and his spirit from the kingdom of the heavens, and [God] joined between them

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أجاع بدنه وأسهره وأقامه فِي الْخدمَة
segments.english: So when he starves his body, and keeps it awake, and establishes it in service,

segments.arabic: وجدت روحه خفَّة وراحة
segments.english: his spirit finds lightness and comfort,

segments.arabic: فتاقت إِلَى الْموضع الَّذِي خلقت مِنْهُ واشتاقت إِلَى عالمها الْعلوِي
segments.english: and [it] yearns for the place from which it was created, and [it] longs for its upper world.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا أشبعه ونعّمه ونومه واشتغل بخدمته وراحته
segments.english: And when he fills it, and pampers it, and lets it sleep, and busies himself with its comfort and rest,

segments.arabic: أخلد الْبدن إِلَى الْموضع الَّذِي خلق مِنْهُ
segments.english: the body settles down toward the place from which it was created,

segments.arabic: فانجذبت الرّوح مَعَه فَصَارَت فِي السجْن
segments.english: and the spirit [is] pulled along with it, and [it] ends up in [a] prison.

segments.arabic: فلولا أَنَّهَا ألفت السجْن لاستغاثت من ألم وفارقتها وانقطاعها عَن عالمها الَّذِي خلقت مِنْهُ
segments.english: And were it not that it had grown used to the prison, it would cry out from the pain of its separation and its being cut off from the world from which it was created,

segments.arabic: كَمَا يستغيث المعذّب
segments.english: just as the one being punished cries out.

segments.arabic: وَبِالْجُمْلَةِ فَكَمَا خف الْبدن لطفت الرّوح وَخفت وَطلبت عالمها الْعلوِي
segments.english: And in summary, the lighter the body [becomes], the more the spirit becomes refined and light, and [it] seeks its upper world.

segments.arabic: وَكلما ثقل وأخلد إِلَى الشَّهَوَات والراحة
segments.english: And the heavier [it becomes] and the more it settles into desires and comfort,

segments.arabic: ثقلت الرّوح وهبطت من عالمها وَصَارَت أرضية سفليّة
segments.english: the heavier the spirit [becomes], and [it] descends from its world and becomes earthly [and] lowly.

segments.arabic: فترى الرجل روحه فِي الرفيق الْأَعْلَى وبدنه عنْدك
segments.english: So you see [a] man — his spirit [is] in the Highest Company while his body [is] with you.

segments.arabic: فَيكون نَائِما على فرَاشه وروحه عِنْد سِدْرَة الْمُنْتَهى تجول حول الْعَرْش
segments.english: He may be sleeping on his bed while his spirit [is] at the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary, roaming around the Throne.

segments.arabic: وَآخر وَاقِف فِي الْخدمَة بِبدنِهِ وروحه فِي السّفل تجول حول السفليات
segments.english: And another [is] standing in service with his body, while his spirit [is] in the lowest [depths], roaming around lowly things.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا فَارَقت الرّوح الْبدن التحقت برفيقها الْأَعْلَى أَو الْأَدْنَى
segments.english: So when the spirit leaves the body, it joins its companion — the higher or the lower.

segments.arabic: فَعِنْدَ الرفيق الْأَعْلَى كل قرّة عين وكل نعيم وسرور وبهجة وَلَذَّة وحياة طيبَة
segments.english: With the higher companion [there is] every delight of the eye, and every blessing, and joy, and happiness, and pleasure, and [a] good life.

segments.arabic: وَعند الرفيق الْأَسْفَل كل هم وغم وضيق وحزن وحياة نكدة ومعيشة ضنك
segments.english: And with the lower companion [there is] every worry, and grief, and tightness, and sadness, and [a] miserable life, and [a] wretched living.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْ ذِكْرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا
segments.english: And whoever turns away from My remembrance, then indeed for him [there is] [a] wretched living.
segments.sahih_international: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."

segments.arabic: فذِكْره كَلَامه الَّذِي أنزلهُ على رَسُوله
segments.english: So His remembrance [is] His speech which He sent down upon His Messenger,

segments.arabic: والإعراض عَنهُ ترك تدبره وَالْعَمَل بِهِ
segments.english: and turning away from it [is] abandoning reflection on it and acting by it.

segments.arabic: والمعيشة الضنك فَأكْثر مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّفْسِير أَنَّهَا عَذَاب الْقَبْر
segments.english: And the wretched living — most of what came in the interpretation [is] that it [is] the punishment of the grave.

segments.arabic: قَالَه ابْن مَسْعُود وَأَبُو هُرَيْرَة وَأَبُو سعيد الْخُدْرِيّ وَابْن عَبَّاس وَفِيه حَدِيث مَرْفُوع
segments.english: Ibn Masʿūd said this, and Abū Hurayrah, and Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, and Ibn ʿAbbās — and there [is] [a] raised narration about it.

segments.arabic: وأصل الضنك فِي اللُّغَة الضّيق والشدة
segments.english: And the root of "wretched" in the language [is] tightness and hardship.

segments.arabic: وكل مَا ضَاقَ فَهُوَ ضنك يُقَال منزل ضنك وعيش الضنك
segments.english: And everything that [is] tight, then it [is] wretched — [one] says: [a] wretched dwelling and [a] wretched life.

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ الْمَعيشَة الضنك فِي مُقَابلَة التوسيع على النَّفس وَالْبدن بالشهوات وَاللَّذَّات والراحة
segments.english: So this wretched living [is] in return for giving the self and the body ease through desires, and pleasures, and comfort.

segments.arabic: فَإِن النَّفس كلما وسعت عَلَيْهَا ضيّقت على الْقلب حَتَّى تصير معيشة ضنكا
segments.english: For indeed the self — the more you give it ease, the more it tightens upon the heart, until [its] living becomes wretched.

segments.arabic: وَكلما ضيّقت عَلَيْهَا وسعت على الْقلب حَتَّى ينشرح وينفسخ
segments.english: And the more you tighten upon it, the more it gives ease to the heart, until it opens up and expands.

segments.arabic: فضنك الْمَعيشَة فِي
segments.english: So the wretchedness of living [is] in —

headings.arabic: فصل بين رعاية الحقوق مع الضر ورعايتها مع العافية بون بعيد إن عبدي
headings.english: Section: Between observing the rights with hardship and observing them with well-being [is a] far distance — 'Indeed My servant...'

segments.arabic: الدُّنْيَا بِمُوجب التَّقْوَى سعتها فِي البرزخ وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: this world, according to God-consciousness — its spaciousness [is] in the Barzakh and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وسعة الْمَعيشَة فِي الدُّنْيَا بِحكم الْهوى ضنكها فِي البرزخ وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: And the spaciousness of livelihood in this world by the rule of desire [is] its constriction in the Barzakh and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: فآثر أحسن المعيشتين وأطيبهما وأدومهما
segments.english: So prefer the better of the two lives, the more pleasant of them, and the more lasting of them.

segments.arabic: وأشق الْبدن بنعيم الرّوح وَلَا تشق الرّوح بنعيم الْبدن
segments.english: And tire the body with the bliss of the spirit, and do not tire the spirit with the bliss of the body.

segments.arabic: فَإِن نعيم الرّوح وشقاءها أعظم وأدوم
segments.english: For the bliss of the spirit and its misery [are] greater and more lasting,

segments.arabic: ونعيم الْبدن وشقاؤه أقصر وأهون وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: and the bliss of the body and its misery [are] shorter and lighter. And God [is] the One whose help [is] sought.

segments.arabic: الْعَارِف لَا يَأْمر النَّاس بترك الدُّنْيَا فَإِنَّهُم لَا يقدرُونَ على تَركهَا
segments.english: The knower does not command people to leave this world, for they are not able to leave it.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن يَأْمُرهُم بترك الذُّنُوب مَعَ إقامتهم على دنياهم
segments.english: But he commands them to leave sins while remaining in their worldly life.

segments.arabic: فَترك الدُّنْيَا فَضِيلَة وَترك الذُّنُوب فَرِيضَة
segments.english: For leaving this world [is a] virtue, and leaving sins [is an] obligation.

segments.arabic: فَكيف يُؤمر بالفضيلة من لم يقم الْفَرِيضَة
segments.english: So how [can] one who has not fulfilled the obligation be commanded with the virtue?

segments.arabic: فَإِن صَعب عَلَيْهِم ترك الذُّنُوب فاجتهد أَن تحبب الله إِلَيْهِم
segments.english: And if leaving sins [is] difficult for them, then strive to make God beloved to them

segments.arabic: بِذكر آلائه وإنعامه وإحسانه وصفات كَمَاله ونعوت جَلَاله
segments.english: by mentioning His blessings, His favors, His goodness, the attributes of His perfection, and the descriptions of His majesty.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْقُلُوب مفطورة على محبته
segments.english: For hearts [are] naturally inclined toward loving Him.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا تعلّقت بحبه هان عَلَيْهَا ترك الذُّنُوب والاستقلال مِنْهَا والإصرار عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: And when they become attached to His love, leaving sins becomes easy for them, and [so does] freeing themselves from them and [abandoning] persistence in them.

segments.arabic: وَقد قَالَ يحيى بن معَاذ طلب الْعَاقِل للدنيا خير من ترك الْجَاهِل لَهَا
segments.english: And Yahya ibn Mu'adh said: the wise person's pursuit of this world [is] better than the ignorant person's leaving of it.

segments.arabic: الْعَارِف يَدْعُو النَّاس إِلَى الله من دنياهم فتسهل عَلَيْهِم الْإِجَابَة
segments.english: The knower calls people to God from within their worldly life, so the response [is] easy for them.

segments.arabic: والزاهد يَدعُوهُم إِلَى الله بترك الدُّنْيَا فتشق عَلَيْهِم الْإِجَابَة
segments.english: And the ascetic calls them to God by leaving this world, so the response [is] hard for them.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْفِطَام عَن الثدي الَّذِي مَا عقل الْإِنْسَان نَفسه إِلَّا وَهُوَ يرتضع مِنْهُ شَدِيد
segments.english: For weaning from the breast — which [a] person has never been aware of himself except while nursing from it — [is] severe.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن بِخَير من المرضعات أزكاهن وأفضلهن
segments.english: But [choose] the best of wet-nurses — the purest and finest of them.

segments.arabic: فَإِن للبن تَأْثِيرا فِي طبيعة المرتضع
segments.english: For milk has [an] effect on the nature of the nursling.

segments.arabic: ورضاع الْمَرْأَة الحمقى يعود بحمق الْوَلَد
segments.english: And the nursing of the foolish woman leads to the foolishness of the child.

segments.arabic: وأنفع الرضَاعَة مَا كَانَ من المجاعة
segments.english: And the most beneficial nursing [is] what comes from hunger.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قويت على مرَارَة الْفِطَام وَإِلَّا فارتضع بِقدر
segments.english: So if you can bear the bitterness of weaning, [then do so]; otherwise, nurse in moderation.

segments.arabic: فَإِن من البشم مَا يقتل
segments.english: For among overeating [there is] what kills.

segments.arabic: كل عَبدِي الَّذِي يذكرنِي وَهُوَ ملاق قرنه
segments.english: [is] truly My servant — the one who remembers Me while he [is] meeting his match.

segments.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَاثْبُتُوا وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
segments.english: O you who believe, when you meet [a] group, stand firm and remember God much, so that you may succeed.
segments.sahih_international: O you who have believed, when you encounter a company [from the enemy forces], stand firm and remember Allah much that you may be successful.

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ الْعجب من صَحِيح فارغ وَاقِف مَعَ الْخدمَة
segments.english: It [is] not amazing [that a] healthy, free person stands firm in service.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا الْعجب من ضَعِيف سقيم تعتوره الأشغال وتختلف عَلَيْهِ الْأَحْوَال
segments.english: Rather, the amazing [thing is a] weak, sick person whom tasks overwhelm and conditions change upon him,

segments.arabic: وَقَلبه وَاقِف فِي الْخدمَة غير متخلف بِمَا يقدر عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: while his heart [is] standing firm in service, not falling behind, with whatever he [is] able [to do].

headings.arabic: فصل
headings.english: Chapter

headings.arabic: فصل
headings.english: Chapter

segments.arabic: معرفَة الله سُبْحَانَهُ نَوْعَانِ
segments.english: Knowledge of God, glorified [is] He, [is of] two types.

segments.arabic: معرفَة إِقْرَار وَهِي الَّتِي اشْترك فِيهَا النَّاس الْبر والفاجر والمطيع والعاصي
segments.english: [A] knowledge of acknowledgment, and it [is] that which people share in — the righteous and the wicked, the obedient and the disobedient.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي معرفَة توجب الْحيَاء مِنْهُ والمحبة لَهُ وَتعلق الْقلب بِهِ والشوق إِلَى لِقَائِه
segments.english: And the second [is a] knowledge that requires shyness before Him, and love for Him, and the attachment of the heart to Him, and longing to meet Him,

segments.arabic: وخشيته والإنابة إِلَيْهِ والأنس بِهِ والفرار من الْخلق إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and fear of Him, and turning back to Him, and finding comfort in Him, and fleeing from the creation to Him.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه هِيَ الْمعرفَة الْخَالِصَة الْجَارِيَة على لسن الْقَوْم
segments.english: And this — it [is] the pure knowledge that flows on the tongues of the people.

segments.arabic: وتفاوتهم فيها لا يُحْصِيه إِلَّا الَّذِي عرفهم بِنَفسِهِ
segments.english: And their differences in it — none can count them except the One who made them know Himself,

segments.arabic: وكشف لقُلُوبِهِمْ من مَعْرفَته مَا أخفاه عَن سواهُم
segments.english: and [He] revealed to their hearts of His knowledge what He hid from others.

segments.arabic: وكل أَشَارَ إِلَى هَذِه الْمعرفَة بِحَسب مقَامه وَمَا كشف لَهُ مِنْهَا
segments.english: And each [one] pointed to this knowledge according to his station and what was revealed to him of it.

segments.arabic: وَقد قَالَ أعرف الْخلق بِهِ لَا أحصي ثَنَاء عَلَيْك أَنْت كَمَا أثنيت على نَفسك
segments.english: And the most knowledgeable of creation about Him said: "I cannot count praise upon You; You [are] as You have praised Yourself."

segments.arabic: وَأخْبر أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ يفتح عَلَيْهِ يَوْم الْقِيَامَة من محامده بِمَا لَا يُحسنهُ الْآن
segments.english: And he informed that He, glorified [is] He, [will] open for him on the Day of Judgment [such] praises that he does not know now.

segments.arabic: ولهذه الْمعرفَة بَابَانِ واسعان
segments.english: And this knowledge has two wide doors.

segments.arabic: بَاب التفكّر والتأمّل فِي آيَات الْقُرْآن كلهَا والفهم الْخَاص عَن الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: [The] door of reflection and contemplation on all the verses of the Quran, and the special understanding from God and His Messenger.

segments.arabic: وَالْبَاب الثَّانِي التفكّر فِي آيَاته المشهودة وَتَأمل حكمته فِيهَا وَقدرته ولطفه وإحسانه
segments.english: And the second door [is] reflection on His witnessed signs, and contemplating His wisdom in them, and His power, and His kindness, and His goodness,

segments.arabic: وعدله وقيامه بِالْقِسْطِ على خلقه
segments.english: and His justice, and His upholding of fairness over His creation.

segments.arabic: وجماع ذَلِك الْفِقْه فِي مَعَاني أَسْمَائِهِ الْحسنى وجلالها وكمالها
segments.english: And the sum of all that [is] deep understanding of the meanings of His Most Beautiful Names, and their majesty, and their perfection,

segments.arabic: وتفرّده بذلك وتعلّقها بالخلق وَالْأَمر
segments.english: and His uniqueness in that, and their connection to the creation and the command.

segments.arabic: فَيكون فَقِيها فِي أوامره ونواهيه فَقِيها فِي قَضَائِهِ وَقدره
segments.english: So he becomes deeply understanding of His commands and prohibitions, deeply understanding of His decree and destiny,

segments.arabic: فَقِيها فِي أَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاته فَقِيها فِي الحكم الديني الشَّرْعِيّ وَالْحكم الكوني القدري
segments.english: deeply understanding of His names and attributes, deeply understanding of the religious law and the cosmic decree.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.english: And that [is] the bounty of God, He gives it [to] whom He wills, and God [is] the possessor of great bounty.
segments.sahih_international: That is the bounty of Allah, which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty.

segments.arabic: الدَّرَاهِم أَرْبَعَة
segments.english: Coins [are of] four [types].

segments.arabic: دِرْهَم اكْتسب بِطَاعَة الله وَأخرج فِي حق الله فَذَاك خير الدَّرَاهِم
segments.english: [A] coin earned through obedience to God and spent in the right of God — that [is] the best of coins.

segments.arabic: وَدِرْهَم اكْتسب بِمَعْصِيَة الله وَأخرج فِي مَعْصِيّة الله فَذَاك شَرّ الدَّرَاهِم
segments.english: And [a] coin earned through disobedience to God and spent in disobedience to God — that [is] the worst of coins.

segments.arabic: وَدِرْهَم اكْتسب بأذى مُسلم وَأخرج فِي أَذَى مُسلم فَهُوَ كَذَلِك
segments.english: And [a] coin earned by harming [a] Muslim and spent in harming [a] Muslim — it [is] likewise.

segments.arabic: وَدِرْهَم اكْتسب بمباح وَأنْفق فِي شَهْوَة مُبَاحَة فَذَاك لَا لَهُ وَلَا عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And [a] coin earned through [something] permissible and spent on [a] permissible desire — that [is] neither for him nor against him.

segments.arabic: هَذِه أصُول الدَّرَاهِم ويتفرّع
segments.english: These [are] the foundations of [the types of] coins, and [from them] branches out —

headings.arabic: فصل الجهل بالطريق وآفاتها والمقصود يوجب التعب الكثير مع الفائدة
headings.english: Section: Ignorance of the Path, Its Ailments, and the Goal Causes Much Fatigue with Little Benefit

segments.arabic: عَلَيْهَا دَرَاهِمُ أُخَرُ مِنْهَا دِرْهَم اكْتسب بِحَقٍّ وَأنْفق فِي بَاطِل
segments.english: Upon it [are] other dirhams. Among them: [a] dirham earned through right and spent on falsehood,

segments.arabic: وَدِرْهَم اكْتسب بِبَاطِل وَأنْفق فِي حَقٍّ فإنفاقه كفّارته
segments.english: and [a] dirham earned through falsehood and spent on right — so its spending [is] its expiation,

segments.arabic: وَدِرْهَم اكْتسب من شُبْهَة فكفّارته أَن يُنْفِق فِي طَاعَة
segments.english: and [a] dirham earned from [a] doubtful [source] — so its expiation [is] that he spends [it] in obedience.

segments.arabic: وكما يتَعَلَّق الثَّوَاب وَالْعِقَاب والمدح والذم بِإِخْرَاج الدِّرْهَم فَكَذَلِك يتَعَلَّق باكتسابه
segments.english: And just as reward and punishment, praise and blame relate to spending the dirham, likewise they relate to earning it.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ يُسْأَل عَنهُ مُسْتَخْرَجُهُ ومصروفه من أَيْن اكْتَسبهُ وَفِيمَا أنفقهُ
segments.english: And likewise he [will be] asked about it — its earning and its spending: from where he earned it and in what he spent it.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Section

segments.arabic: الْمُوَاسَاة لِلْمُؤمنِ أَنْوَاع
segments.english: Supporting the believer [has] types:

segments.arabic: مواساة بِالْمَالِ ومواساة بالجاه ومواساة بِالْبدنِ والخدمة
segments.english: support with wealth, support with status, support with the body and service,

segments.arabic: ومواساة بِالنَّصِيحَةِ والإرشاد ومواساة بِالدُّعَاءِ وَالِاسْتِغْفَار لَهُم ومواساة بالتوجع لَهُم
segments.english: support with advice and guidance, support with supplication and seeking forgiveness for them, and support by feeling their pain.

segments.arabic: على قدر الْإِيمَان تكون هَذِه الْمُوَاسَاة
segments.english: According to the measure of faith [is] this support.

segments.arabic: فَكلما ضعف الْإِيمَان ضعفت الْمُوَاسَاة وَكلما قوي قويت
segments.english: So whenever faith weakens, support weakens, and whenever it strengthens, [it] strengthens.

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ رَسُول الله ﷺ أعظم النَّاس مواساةً لأَصْحَابه بذلك كُله
segments.english: And the Messenger of God ﷺ was the greatest of people in supporting his companions with all of that.

segments.arabic: فلأتباعه من الْمُوَاسَاة بِحَسب اتّباعهم لَهُ
segments.english: So for his followers [there is] support according to their following of him.

segments.arabic: ودخلوا على بشر الحافي فِي يَوْم شَدِيد الْبرد وَقد تجرّد وَهُوَ ينتفض
segments.english: And they entered upon Bishr al-Hafi on [a] severely cold day, and he had stripped [his clothes] and was shivering.

segments.arabic: فَقَالُوا مَا هَذَا يَا أَبَا نصر
segments.english: So they said: 'What [is] this, O Abu Nasr?'

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ ذكرت الْفُقَرَاء وبردهم وَلَيْسَ لي مَا أواسيهم بِهِ
segments.english: So he said: 'I remembered the poor and their cold, and I have nothing to support them with,

segments.arabic: فَأَحْبَبْت أَن أواسيهم فِي بردهمْ
segments.english: so I wanted to share with them in their cold.'

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Section

segments.arabic: الْجَهْل بِالطَّرِيقِ وآفاتها وَالْمَقْصُود يُوجب التَّعَب الْكثير مَعَ الْفَائِدَة القليلة
segments.english: Ignorance of the path, its ailments, and the goal causes much fatigue with little benefit.

segments.arabic: فَإِن صَاحبه إِمَّا أَن يجْتَهد فِي نَافِلَة مَعَ إِضَاعَة الْفَرْض
segments.english: For its person either strives in [a] voluntary [deed] while neglecting the obligatory,

segments.arabic: أَو فِي عمل بالجوارح لم يواطئه عمل الْقلب
segments.english: or in [a] deed of the limbs that the work of the heart did not match,

segments.arabic: أَو عمل بالباطن وَالظَّاهِر لم يتَقَيَّد بالاقتداء
segments.english: or [a] deed of the inner and outer [self] not bound by following [the Prophet],

segments.arabic: أَو همة إِلَى عمل لم ترق بصاحبها إِلَى مُلَاحظَة الْمَقْصُود
segments.english: or [a] drive toward [a] deed that did not elevate its person to observing the goal,

segments.arabic: أَو عمل لم يتحرز من آفاته الْمفْسدَة لَهُ حَال الْعَمَل وَبعده
segments.english: or [a] deed in which he did not guard against its corrupting ailments during the deed and after it,

segments.arabic: أَو عمل غفل فِيهِ عَن مُشَاهدَة المنّة فَلم يتجرّد عَن مُشَاركَة النَّفس فِيهِ
segments.english: or [a] deed in which he was heedless of witnessing [God's] favor, so he did not free himself from the self's involvement in it,

segments.arabic: أَو عمل لم يشْهد تَقْصِيره فِيهِ فَيقوم بعده فِي مقَام الِاعْتِذَار مِنْهُ
segments.english: or [a] deed in which he did not witness his shortcoming, so [that] he [would] stand after it in the position of apologizing for it,

segments.arabic: أَو عمل لم يوفّه حَقه من النصح وَالْإِحْسَان وَهُوَ يظنّ أنّه وفّاه
segments.english: or [a] deed [that] he did not give its right of sincerity and excellence, while he thinks he [has] given it [its due].

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا كُله مِمَّا ينقص الثَّمَرَة مَعَ كَثْرَة التَّعَب وَالله الموفّق
segments.english: So all of this [is] from what reduces the fruit despite the abundance of effort. And God [is] the One who grants success.

headings.arabic: فصل النعم ثلاثة نعمة حاصلة يعلم بها العبد ونعمة منتظرة يرجوها ونعمة
headings.english: Section: Blessings [are] three — [a] blessing [that is] present [which] the servant knows, [a] blessing awaited [which] he hopes for, and [a] blessing

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Section

segments.arabic: إِذا عزم العَبْد على السّفر إِلَى الله تَعَالَى وإرادته عرضت لَهُ الخوادع والقواطع
segments.english: When the servant resolves upon the journey to God Most High and desiring Him, the deceptions and obstacles present themselves to him.

segments.arabic: فينخدع أَولا بالشهوات والرياسات والملاذ والمناكح والملابس
segments.english: So he [is] first deceived by desires, positions of authority, pleasures, women, and clothing.

segments.arabic: فَإِن وقف مَعهَا انْقَطع
segments.english: If he stops with them, he [is] cut off.

segments.arabic: وَإِن رفضها وَلم يقف مَعهَا وَصدق فِي طلبه
segments.english: And if he rejects them and does not stop with them and [is] sincere in his seeking,

segments.arabic: ابْتُلِيَ بِوَطْء عقبه وتقبيل يَده والتوسعة لَهُ فِي الْمجْلس وَالْإِشَارَة إِلَيْهِ بِالدُّعَاءِ ورجاء بركته وَنَحْو ذَلِك
segments.english: he [is] tested with people stepping on his heels, kissing his hand, making room for him in the gathering, pointing to him for supplication, hoping for his blessing, and the like.

segments.arabic: فَإِن وقف مَعَه وَانْقطع بِهِ عَن الله وَكَانَ حَظه مِنْهُ
segments.english: If he stops with that and [is] cut off by it from God, then it becomes his share from Him.

segments.arabic: وَإِن قطعه وَلم يقف مَعَه ابْتُلِيَ بالكرامات والكشوفات
segments.english: And if he cuts past it and does not stop with it, he [is] tested with miracles and spiritual unveilings.

segments.arabic: فَإِن وقف مَعهَا انْقَطع بهَا عَن الله وَكَانَت حَظه
segments.english: If he stops with them, he [is] cut off by them from God, and they become his share.

segments.arabic: إِن لم يقف مَعهَا ابْتُلِيَ بالتجريد والتخلي وَلَذَّة الجمعية وَعزة الْوحدَة والفراغ من الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: If he does not stop with them, he [is] tested with renunciation, withdrawal, the sweetness of inner focus, the comfort of solitude, and emptiness from this world.

segments.arabic: فَإِن وقف مَعَ ذَلِك انْقَطع الْمَقْصُود
segments.english: If he stops with that, he [is] cut off from the goal.

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم يقف مَعَه وَسَار نَاظرا إِلَى مُرَاد الله مِنْهُ وَمَا يُحِبهُ مِنْهُ
segments.english: And if he does not stop with it and continues, looking to what God wants from him and what He loves from him,

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ يكون عَبده الْمَوْقُوف على محابّه ومراضيه أَيْن كَانَت وَكَيف كَانَت
segments.english: such that he becomes His servant, devoted to what He loves and what pleases Him, wherever it [is] and however it [is] —

segments.arabic: تَعب بهَا أَو استراح تنعّم أَو تألّم أخرجته إِلَى النَّاس أَو عزلته عَنْهُم
segments.english: whether he tires by it or rests, enjoys or suffers, whether it brings him out to people or secludes him from them —

segments.arabic: لَا يخْتَار لنَفسِهِ غير مَا يختاره لَهُ وليه وسيده
segments.english: he does not choose for himself other than what his Master and Lord chooses for him,

segments.arabic: وَاقِف مَعَ أمره ينفذهُ بِحَسب الْإِمْكَان
segments.english: standing with His command, carrying it out as best he can,

segments.arabic: وَنَفسه عِنْده أَهْون عَلَيْهِ أَن يقدم راحتها ولذتها على مرضاة سَيّده وَأمره
segments.english: and his self [is] too lowly in his eyes for him to put its comfort and pleasure before the pleasure of his Master and His command.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا هُوَ العَبْد الَّذِي قد وصل وَنفذ وَلم يقطعهُ عَن سَيّده شَيْء
segments.english: So this — he [is] the servant who has arrived and succeeded, and nothing cut him off from his Master.

segments.arabic: وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And with God [is] success.

segments.arabic: فصل النعم ثَلَاثَة نعْمَة حَاصِلَة يعلم بهَا العَبْد ونعمة منتظرة يرجوها ونعمة هُوَ فِيهَا لَا يشْعر بهَا
segments.english: Section: Blessings [are] three — [a] blessing [that is] present [which] the servant knows, [a] blessing awaited [which] he hopes for, and [a] blessing he [is] in [and] does not feel.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أَرَادَ الله إتْمَام نعْمَته على عَبده عرّفه نعْمَته الْحَاضِرَة
segments.english: So when God wants to complete His blessing upon His servant, He makes him recognize His present blessing,

segments.arabic: وَأَعْطَاهُ من شكره قيدا بِهِ حَتَّى لَا تشرد
segments.english: and gives him from gratitude [a] chain for it so that it does not flee.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا تشرد بالمعصية وتقيّد بالشكر
segments.english: For it flees through disobedience and [is] chained by gratitude.

segments.arabic: ورفقة لعمل يستجلب بِهِ النِّعْمَة المنتظرة
segments.english: And [He gives him the] means for [a] deed by which he attracts the awaited blessing,

segments.arabic: وبصَّره بالطرق الَّتِي تسدها وتقطع طريقها
segments.english: and shows him the paths that block it and cut off its way,

segments.arabic: ورفقة لاجتنابها
segments.english: and [the] means to avoid them.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا بهَا قد وافت إِلَيْهِ على أتم الْوُجُوه
segments.english: And then it comes to him in the most complete way.

segments.arabic: وعرّفه النعم الَّتِي
segments.english: And He makes him recognize the blessings that —

headings.arabic: قاعدة جليلة مبدأ كل علم نظري وعمل اختياري هو الخواطر والأفكار فإنها
headings.english: An Important Principle: The origin of every theoretical knowledge and voluntary action [is] thoughts and ideas, for they...

segments.arabic: هُوَ فِيهَا فَلَا يشْعر بهَا
segments.english: he [is] in them but does not feel them.

segments.arabic: ويحكى أَن أَعْرَابِيًا دخل على الرشيد
segments.english: And it [is] narrated that [a] Bedouin entered upon al-Rashid,

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ أَمِير الْمُؤمنِينَ ثبّت الله عَلَيْك النعم الَّتِي أَنْت فِيهَا بإدامة شكرها
segments.english: and he said: "O Commander of the Believers, may God make firm upon you the blessings that you [are] in, by continuing to be grateful for them,

segments.arabic: وحقق لَك النعم الَّتِي ترجوها بِحسن الظَّن بِهِ ودوام طَاعَته
segments.english: and may He fulfill for you the blessings that you hope for, by having good expectations of Him and continuous obedience to Him,

segments.arabic: وعرّفك النعم الَّتِي أَنْت فِيهَا وَلَا تعرفها لتشكرها
segments.english: and may He make you recognize the blessings that you [are] in but do not recognize, so that you may be grateful for them."

segments.arabic: فأعجبه ذَلِك مِنْهُ وَقَالَ مَا أحسن تقسيمه
segments.english: So that pleased him from him, and he said: "How excellent [is] his classification!"

segments.arabic: مبدأ كل علم نَظَرِي وَعمل اخْتِيَاري هُوَ الخواطر والأفكار
segments.english: The origin of every theoretical knowledge and voluntary action [is] thoughts and ideas.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا توجب التصورات والتصورات تَدْعُو إِلَى الإيرادات
segments.english: For they bring about mental images, and mental images call to intentions,

segments.arabic: والإيرادات تَقْتَضِي وُقُوع الْفِعْل وَكَثْرَة تكراره تُعْطِي الْعَادة
segments.english: and intentions require the occurrence of action, and frequent repetition of it produces [the] habit.

segments.arabic: فصلاح هَذِه الْمَرَاتِب بصلاح الخواطر والأفكار وفسادها بفسادها
segments.english: So the soundness of these stages [is] by the soundness of thoughts and ideas, and their corruption [is] by their corruption.

segments.arabic: فصلاح الخواطر بِأَن تكون مراقبة لوَلِيّهَا وإلهها صاعدة إِلَيْهِ دَائِرَة على مرضاته ومحابّه
segments.english: So the soundness of thoughts [is] by them being watchful of their Master and their God, ascending to Him, revolving around His pleasure and what He loves.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ بِهِ كل صَلَاح وَمن عِنْده كل هدى
segments.english: For glorified [is] He — with Him [is] every soundness, and from Him [is] every guidance,

segments.arabic: وَمن توفيقه كل رشد وَمن توليه لعَبْدِهِ كل حفظ
segments.english: and from His granting success [is] every right direction, and from His care for His servant [is] every protection,

segments.arabic: وَمن تولّيه وإعراضه عَنهُ كل ضلال وشقاء
segments.english: and from His turning away and His neglect of him [is] every misguidance and misery.

segments.arabic: فيظفر العَبْد بِكُل خير وَهدى ورشد
segments.english: So the servant attains every good and guidance and right direction,

segments.arabic: بِقدر إِثْبَات عين فكرته فِي آلائه ونعمه وتوحيده
segments.english: in proportion to fixing the eye of his thought on His blessings and His favors and His oneness,

segments.arabic: وطرق مَعْرفَته وطرق عبوديته
segments.english: and the paths of knowing Him and the paths of worshipping Him,

segments.arabic: وإنزاله إِيَّاه حَاضرا مَعَه مشاهدا لَهُ نَاظرا إِلَيْهِ رقيبا عَلَيْهِ مطّلعا على خواطره وإرادته وهمّه
segments.english: and regarding Him [as] present with him, witnessing him, looking at him, watching over him, aware of his thoughts and intentions and concerns.

segments.arabic: فَحِينَئِذٍ يستحي مِنْهُ ويجله
segments.english: So then he [would] feel shy before Him and honor Him —

segments.arabic: أَن يطلعه مِنْهُ على عَورَة يكره أَن يطلع عَلَيْهَا مَخْلُوق مثله
segments.english: [too much] to expose to Him from himself [a] flaw that he [would] hate for [a] created being like him to see,

segments.arabic: أَو يرى من نَفسه خاطرا يمقته عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: or for [God] to see from him [a] thought for which He [would] despise him.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى أنزل ربه هَذِه الْمنزلَة مِنْهُ رَفعه وقرّبه مِنْهُ وأكرمه واجتباه وولاه
segments.english: So whenever he placed his Lord [in] this position from him, He [would] raise him and bring him close to Him and honor him and choose him and care for him.

segments.arabic: وبقدر ذَلِك يبعد عَن الأوساخ والدناآت والخواطر الرَّديئَة والأفكار الدنيئة
segments.english: And in proportion to that, he distances [himself] from filth and lowliness and bad thoughts and base ideas,

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَنه بعد مِنْهُ وَأعْرض عَنهُ وَقرب من الأوساخ والدناآت والأقذار
segments.english: just as when he distances from Him and turns away from Him, he draws near to filth and lowliness and impurities,

segments.arabic: وَيُقطع عَن جَمِيع الكمالات ويتصل بِجَمِيعِ النقائص
segments.english: and [is] cut off from all perfections and connected to all deficiencies.

segments.arabic: فالإنسان خير الْمَخْلُوقَات إِذا تقرّب من بارئه وَالْتزم أوامره ونواهيه
segments.english: So the human [is] the best of creatures when he draws near to his Creator and follows His commands and prohibitions,

segments.arabic: وَعمل بمرضاته وآثره على هَوَاهُ
segments.english: and acts according to His pleasure and prefers Him over his desire.

segments.arabic: وشرّ الْمَخْلُوقَات إِذا تبَاعد عَنهُ وَلم يَتَحَرَّك قلبه لقُرْبه وطاعته وابتغاء مرضاته
segments.english: and [the] worst of creatures if he distances himself from Him and his heart does not move toward His closeness and His obedience and seeking His pleasure.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى اخْتَار التقرّب إِلَيْهِ وآثره على نَفسه وهواه
segments.english: So whenever he chooses drawing near to Him and prefers Him over his self and his desire,

segments.arabic: فقد حكم قلبه عقله وإيمانه على نَفسه وشيطانه وحكّم رشده على غيّه وهداه على هَوَاهُ
segments.english: then his heart has given authority [to] his intellect and his faith over his self and his devil, and given authority [to] his right guidance over his misguidance, and his guidance over his desire.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى اخْتَار التباعد مِنْهُ فقد حكم نَفسه وهواه وشيطانه على عقله وَقَلبه ورشده
segments.english: And whenever he chooses distancing from Him, then he has given authority [to] his self and his desire and his devil over his intellect and his heart and his right guidance.

segments.arabic: وَأعلم أَن الخاطرات والوساوس تُؤدِّي متعلقاتها إِلَى الْفِكر فيأخذها الْفِكر فيؤديها إِلَى التَّذَكُّر
segments.english: And know that passing thoughts and whisperings deliver what [is] attached to them to reflection, then reflection takes them and delivers them to recollection,

segments.arabic: فيأخذها الذّكر فيؤديها إِلَى الْإِرَادَة فتأخذها الْإِرَادَة فتؤديها إِلَى الْجَوَارِح وَالْعَمَل
segments.english: then recollection takes them and delivers them to the will, then the will takes them and delivers them to the limbs and action.

segments.arabic: فتستحكم فَتَصِير عَادَة
segments.english: Then they become firmly rooted and turn into [a] habit.

segments.arabic: فرّدها من مبادئها أسهل من قطعهَا بعد قوتها وتمامها
segments.english: So repelling them from their beginnings [is] easier than cutting them off after their strength and completion.

segments.arabic: وَمَعْلُوم أَنه لم يُعْط الْإِنْسَان إماتة الخواطر وَلَا الْقُوَّة على قطعهَا
segments.english: And [it is] known that the human being was not given [the ability to] kill [his] thoughts, nor the power to cut them off,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا تهجم عَلَيْهِ هجوم النَّفس
segments.english: for they rush upon him [like] the rushing of breath.

segments.arabic: إِلَّا أَن قُوَّة الْإِيمَان وَالْعقل تعينه على قبُول أحْسنهَا وَرضَاهُ بِهِ ومساكنته لَهُ
segments.english: However, the strength of faith and intellect helps him to accept the best of them and [to] be pleased with it and settle with it,

segments.arabic: وعَلى رفع أقبحها وكراهته لَهُ نفرته مِنْهُ
segments.english: and to reject the ugliest of them and dislike it and be repelled by it.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ الصَّحَابَة يَا رَسُول الله إِن أَحَدنَا يجد فِي نَفسه مَا لِأَن يَحْتَرِق حَتَّى يصير حممة أحب إِلَيْهِ من أَن يتَكَلَّم بِهِ
