segments.english: As the Companions said: 'O Messenger of God, one of us finds in himself something that to burn until he becomes charcoal [would be] more beloved to him than to speak of it.'

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ أَو قد وجدتموه قَالُوا نعم قَالَ ذَاك صَرِيح الْإِيمَان
segments.english: So he said: 'Have you [really] found it?' They said: 'Yes.' He said: 'That [is] pure faith.'

segments.arabic: وَفِي لفظ الْحَمد لله الَّذِي رد كَيده إِلَى الوسوسة
segments.english: And in [another] wording: 'Praise [be] to God who reduced his plot to [mere] whispering.'

segments.arabic: وَفِيه قَولَانِ أَحدهمَا أَن رده وكراهيته صَرِيح الْإِيمَان
segments.english: And regarding it [there are] two views. The first [is] that rejecting it and disliking it [is] pure faith.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي أَن وجوده وإلقاء الشَّيْطَان لَهُ فِي النَّفس صَرِيح الْإِيمَان
segments.english: And the second [is] that its occurrence and the devil's casting of it into the self [is] pure faith,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ إِنَّمَا أَلْقَاهُ فِي النَّفس طلبا لمعارضة الْإِيمَان وإزالته بِهِ
segments.english: for he only cast it into the self seeking to oppose faith and remove it by it.

segments.arabic: وَقد خلق الله سُبْحَانَهُ النَّفس شَبيهَة بالرحا الدائرة الَّتِي لَا تسكن
segments.english: And God, glorified [is] He, created the self resembling the turning millstone that does not stop.

segments.arabic: وَلَا بُد لَهَا من شَيْء تطحنه
segments.english: And it must have something to grind.

segments.arabic: فَإِن وضع فِيهَا حب طحنته وَإِن وضع فِيهَا تُرَاب أَو حصا طحنته
segments.english: So if grain [is] placed in it, it grinds it; and if dirt or pebbles [are] placed in it, it grinds them.

segments.arabic: فالأفكار والخواطر الَّتِي تجول فِي النَّفس هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَة الْحبّ الَّذِي يوضع فِي الرحا
segments.english: So the thoughts and ideas that roam in the self — they [are] like the grain that [is] placed in the millstone.

segments.arabic: وَلَا تبقى تِلْكَ الرحا معطلة قطّ بل لَا بُد لَهَا من شَيْء يوضع فِيهَا
segments.english: And that millstone never remains idle at all; rather, it must have something placed in it.

segments.arabic: فَمن النَّاس من تطحن رحاه حبا يخرج دَقِيقًا ينفع بِهِ نَفسه وَغَيره
segments.english: So among people [there is he] whose millstone grinds grain that produces flour, [by which] he benefits himself and others.

segments.arabic: وَأَكْثَرهم يطحن رملا وحصا وتبنا وَنَحْو ذَلِك
segments.english: And most of them grind sand and pebbles and straw and the like.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا جَاءَ وَقت العجن وَالْخبْز تبيّن لَهُ حَقِيقَة طحينه
segments.english: So when the time of kneading and baking comes, the reality of his grinding becomes clear to him.

headings.arabic: فصل فإذا دفعت الخاطر الوارد عليك اندفع عنك ما بعده وإن قبلته صار
headings.english: Section: If you push away the passing thought that comes to you, what [comes] after it [is] pushed away from you, and if you accept it, it becomes...

segments.arabic: فَإِذا دفعت الخاطر الْوَارِد عَلَيْك انْدفع عَنْك مَا بعده
segments.english: So if you push away the passing thought that comes to you, what [comes] after it [is] pushed away from you.

segments.arabic: وَإِن قبلته صَار فكرا جوّالا فاستخدم الْإِرَادَة
segments.english: And if you accept it, it becomes [a] roaming thought, and it puts the will to work.

segments.arabic: فتساعدت هِيَ والفكر على اسْتِخْدَام الْجَوَارِح
segments.english: So it and the thought cooperate in putting the limbs to work.

segments.arabic: فَإِن تعذّر استخدامها رجعا إِلَى الْقلب بالمني والشهوة وتوجهه إِلَى جِهَة المُرَاد
segments.english: And if putting them to work [is] not possible, they both return to the heart with wishful thinking and desire, directing it toward what [is] wanted.

segments.arabic: وَمن الْمَعْلُوم أَن إصْلَاح الخواطر أسهل من إصْلَاح الأفكار
segments.english: And [it is] known that correcting passing thoughts [is] easier than correcting [sustained] thoughts.

segments.arabic: وَإِصْلَاح الأفكار أسهل من إصْلَاح الإرادات
segments.english: And correcting [sustained] thoughts [is] easier than correcting intentions.

segments.arabic: وَإِصْلَاح الإرادات أسهل من تدارك فَسَاد الْعَمَل
segments.english: And correcting intentions [is] easier than fixing the corruption of action.

segments.arabic: وتداركه أسهل من قطع العوائد
segments.english: And fixing it [is] easier than breaking habits.

segments.arabic: فأنفع الدَّوَاء أَن تشغل نَفسك بالفكر فِيمَا يَعْنِيك دون مَالا يَعْنِيك
segments.english: So the most beneficial cure [is] that you occupy yourself with thinking about what concerns you, not what does not concern you.

segments.arabic: فالفكر فِيمَا لَا يَعْنِي بَاب كل شَرّ
segments.english: For thinking about what does not concern [you is] the door of every evil.

segments.arabic: وَمن فكّر فِيمَا لَا يعنيه فَاتَهُ مَا يعنيه
segments.english: And whoever thinks about what does not concern him, what concerns him passes him by.

segments.arabic: واشتغل عَن أَنْفَع الْأَشْيَاء لَهُ بِمَا لَا مَنْفَعَة لَهُ فِيهِ
segments.english: And he becomes busy away from the most beneficial things for him with what has no benefit for him in it.

segments.arabic: فالفكر والخواطر والإرادة والهمة أَحَق شَيْء بإصلاحه من نَفسك
segments.english: So thought, passing thoughts, will, and drive [are] the most deserving thing of your self to be corrected.

segments.arabic: فَإِن هَذِه خاصتك وحقيقتك الَّتِي تبتعد بهَا أَو تقرب من إلهك ومعبودك
segments.english: For these [are] your essence and your reality, by which you distance [yourself] or draw near to your God and the One you worship —

segments.arabic: الَّذِي لَا سَعَادَة لَك إِلَّا فِي قربه وَرضَاهُ عَنْك
segments.english: the One for whom there [is] no happiness for you except in nearness to Him and His pleasure with you.

segments.arabic: وكل الشَّقَاء فِي بعْدك عَنهُ وَسخطه عَلَيْك
segments.english: And all misery [is] in your distance from Him and His anger upon you.

segments.arabic: وَمن كَانَ فِي خواطره ومجالات فكره دنيئا خسيسا
segments.english: And whoever was in his passing thoughts and the areas of his thinking low [and] worthless,

segments.arabic: لم يكن فِي سَائِر أمره إِلَّا كَذَلِك
segments.english: he would not be in the rest of his affairs except like that.

segments.arabic: وَإِيَّاك أَن تمكّن الشَّيْطَان من بَيت أفكارك وإرادتك
segments.english: And beware of giving Satan [access to] the house of your thoughts and your will,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ يُفْسِدهَا عَلَيْك فَسَادًا يصعب تَدَارُكه
segments.english: for he [will] corrupt them against you [with a] corruption [that is] hard to fix.

segments.arabic: ويلقي إِلَيْك أَنْوَاع الوساوس والأفكار المضرّة
segments.english: And he [will] throw at you types of whispers and harmful thoughts,

segments.arabic: ويحول بَيْنك وَبَين الْفِكر فِيمَا ينفعك
segments.english: and he [will] come between you and thinking about what benefits you.

segments.arabic: وَأَنت الَّذِي أعنته على نَفسك بتمكينه من قَلْبك وخواطرك فملكها عَلَيْك
segments.english: And you [are] the one who helped him against yourself by giving him access to your heart and your passing thoughts, so he took control of them over you.

segments.arabic: فمثالك مَعَه مِثَال صَاحب رَحا يطحن فِيهَا جيّد الْحُبُوب
segments.english: So your example with him [is] the example of the owner of [a] mill, grinding in it good grain.

segments.arabic: فَأَتَاهُ شخص مَعَه حمل تُرَاب وبعر وفحم وغثاء ليطحنه فِي طاحونته
segments.english: Then [a] person came to him carrying dirt, dung, coal, and debris to grind it in his mill.

segments.arabic: فَإِن طرده وَلم يُمكنهُ من إِلْقَاء مَا مَعَه فِي الطاحون اسْتمرّ على طحن مَا يَنْفَعهُ
segments.english: So if he drives him away and does not let him throw what he has into the mill, he continues grinding what benefits him.

segments.arabic: وَإِن مكنه فِي إِلْقَاء ذَلِك فِي الطاحون أفسد مَا فِيهَا من الْحبّ وَخرج الطحين كُله فَاسِدا
segments.english: And if he lets him throw that into the mill, it ruins what [is] in it of grain, and the flour all comes out ruined.

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِي يلقيه الشَّيْطَان فِي النَّفس لَا يخرج عَن الْفِكر فِيمَا كَانَ وَدخل الْوُجُود لَو كَانَ على خلاف ذَلِكَ
segments.english: And what Satan throws into the self does not go beyond thinking about what happened and entered existence — [wondering] if it had been different from that,

segments.arabic: وَفِيمَا لم يكن لَو كَانَ كَيفَ كَانَ يكون
segments.english: and [thinking] about what did not happen — if it had [happened], how it would have been,

segments.arabic: أَو فِيمَا يملك الْفِكر فِيهِ من أَنْوَاع
segments.english: or [thinking] about what one has no power over, of types [of] —

segments.arabic: الْفَوَاحِش وَالْحرَام أَو فِي خيالات وهمية لاحقيقة لَهَا
segments.english: indecencies and the forbidden, or in imaginary fantasies that have no reality.

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا فِي بَاطِل أَو فِيمَا لَا سَبِيل إِلَى إِدْرَاكه من أَنْوَاع مَا طوى عَنهُ علمه
segments.english: Or in falsehood, or in what there [is] no way to grasp — from the types of what [its] knowledge has been hidden from him.

segments.arabic: فيلقيه فِي تِلْكَ الخواطر الَّتِي لَا يبلغ مِنْهَا غَايَة وَلَا يقف مِنْهَا على نِهَايَة
segments.english: So it throws him into those thoughts from which he reaches no end and from which he arrives at no conclusion.

segments.arabic: فَيجْعَل ذَلِك مجَال فكره ومسرح وهمه
segments.english: So he makes that the field of his thinking and the playground of his imagination.

segments.arabic: وجماع إصْلَاح ذَلِك أَن تشغل فكرك فِي بَاب الْعُلُوم والتصورات بِمَعْرِفَة مَا يلزمك التَّوْحِيد وحقوقه
segments.english: And the sum of fixing that [is] that you occupy your thinking — in the area of knowledge and ideas — with knowing what monotheism and its rights require of you.

segments.arabic: وَفِي الْمَوْت وَمَا بعده إِلَى الدُّخُول إِلَى الْجنَّة وَالنَّار
segments.english: And [with thinking] about death and what [comes] after it, up to the entering into Paradise and the Fire.

segments.arabic: وَفِي آفَات الْأَعْمَال وطرق التَّحَرُّز مِنْهَا
segments.english: And about the diseases of deeds and the ways of guarding against them.

segments.arabic: وَفِي بَاب الإرادات والعزوم أَن تشغل نَفسك بِإِرَادَة مَا ينفعك إِرَادَته وَطرح إِرَادَة مَا يَضرك إِرَادَته
segments.english: And in the area of intentions and resolves, [it is] that you occupy yourself with wanting what benefits you to want, and dropping the want of what harms you to want.

segments.arabic: وَعند العارفين أَن تمني الْخِيَانَة وإشغال الْفِكر وَالْقلب بهَا أضرّ على الْقلب من نفس الْخِيَانَة
segments.english: And according to those who know, wishing for betrayal and occupying the thought and the heart with it [is] more harmful to the heart than the betrayal itself.

segments.arabic: وَلَا سِيمَا إِذا فرغ قلبه مِنْهَا بعد مباشرتها
segments.english: Especially if his heart [is] emptied of it after committing it.

segments.arabic: فَإِن تمنيها يشغل الْقلب بهَا ويملؤه مِنْهَا ويجعلها همه وَمرَاده
segments.english: For wishing for it occupies the heart with it, and fills it with it, and makes it his concern and his desire.

segments.arabic: وَأَنت تَجِد فِي الشَّاهِد أَن الْملك من الْبشر إِذا كَانَ فِي بعض حَاشِيَته وخدمه من هُوَ متمن لخيانته مَشْغُول الْقلب والفكر بهَا ممتلىء مِنْهَا
segments.english: And you find in real life that [when] a king among people has among some of his court and servants someone who [is] wishing to betray him, [with] his heart and thought occupied with it, filled with it —

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ مَعَ ذَلِك فِي خدمته وَقَضَاء أشغاله
segments.english: while he [is] despite that in his service and carrying out his tasks —

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اطّلع على سره وَقصد مقته غَايَة المقت وأبغضه وقابله بِمَا يستحقّه
segments.english: then if [the king] discovered his secret and intention, he [would] hate him with the utmost hatred and despise him and treat him with what he deserves.

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ أبْغض إِلَيْهِ من رجل بعيد عَنهُ جنى بعض الْجِنَايَات
segments.english: And he [would be] more hateful to him than [a] man far from him [who] committed some crimes,

segments.arabic: وَقَلبه وسره مَعَ الْملك غير منطو على تمنّي الْخِيَانَة ومحبتها والحرص عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: while his heart and his inner [self are] with the king, not harboring the wish for betrayal, nor love of it, nor eagerness for it.

segments.arabic: فالأوّل يَتْرُكهَا عَجزا واشتغالا بِمَا هُوَ فِيهِ وَقَلبه ممتلىء بهَا
segments.english: So the first [man] leaves it [only] out of inability and being busy with what he [is] in, while his heart [is] filled with it.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي يَفْعَلهَا وَقَلبه كَارِه لَهَا لَيْسَ فِيهِ إِضْمَار الْخِيَانَة وَلَا الْإِصْرَار عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: And the second [man] does it while his heart [is] hating it — there [is] not in him the hiding of betrayal nor the insistence on it.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا أحسن حَالا وَأسلم عَاقِبَة من الأول
segments.english: So this one [is] better in condition and safer in outcome than the first.

segments.arabic: وَبِالْجُمْلَةِ فالقلب لَا يَخْلُو من الْفِكر
segments.english: And in summary, the heart [is] never free from thought:

segments.arabic: وَأما فِي وَاجِب آخرته ومصالحها
segments.english: either in what [is] required for his Hereafter and its benefits,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا فِي مصَالح دُنْيَاهُ ومعاشه
segments.english: or in the benefits of his world and his livelihood,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا فِي الوساوس والأماني الْبَاطِلَة والمقدرات الْمَفْرُوضَة
segments.english: or in whispers and false wishes and imagined situations.

segments.arabic: وَقد تقدم أَن النَّفس مثلهَا كَمثل رَحا تَدور بِمَا يلقى فِيهَا
segments.english: And it has been mentioned before that the self — its example [is] like [a] millstone that turns with whatever [is] thrown into it.

segments.arabic: فَإِن ألقيت فِيهَا حبا دارت بِهِ
segments.english: So if you throw grain into it, it turns with it.

segments.arabic: وَإِن ألقيت فِيهَا زجاجا وحصا وبعرا دارت بِهِ
segments.english: And if you throw glass, pebbles, and dung into it, it turns with that.

segments.arabic: وَالله سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ قيم تِلْكَ الرحا ومالكها ومصرّفها
segments.english: And God, glorified [is] He, [is] the keeper of that millstone, its owner, and its director.

segments.arabic: وَقد أَقَامَ لَهَا ملكا يلقِي فِيهَا مَا ينفعها فتدور بِهِ
segments.english: And He has appointed for it an angel who throws into it what benefits it, so it turns with that;

segments.arabic: شَيْطَانا يلقِي فِيهَا مَا يَضرهَا فتدور بِهِ
segments.english: and [a] devil who throws into it what harms it, so it turns with that.

segments.arabic: فالملك يلم بهَا مرّة والشيطان يلم بهَا مرّة
segments.english: So the angel visits it once and the devil visits it once.

segments.arabic: فالحب الَّذِي يَقِيه
segments.english: And the grain that protects it —

segments.arabic: الْملك إيعاد بِالْخَيرِ وتصديق بالوعد
segments.english: [that of] the angel [is] a promise of good and confirmation of the promise.

segments.arabic: وَالْحب الَّذِي يلقيه الشَّيْطَان إيعاد بِالشَّرِّ وَتَكْذيب بالوعد
segments.english: And the grain that Satan throws [is] a promise of evil and denial of the promise.

segments.arabic: والطحين على قدر الْحبّ
segments.english: And the grinding [is] according to the grain.

segments.arabic: وَصَاحب الْحبّ المضر لَا يتَمَكَّن من إلقائه إِلَّا إِذا وجد الرَّحَى فارغة من الْحبّ النافع
segments.english: And the owner of the harmful grain cannot throw it in except when he finds the mill empty of beneficial grain,

segments.arabic: وقيمها قد أهملها وَأعْرض عَنْهَا
segments.english: and its keeper has neglected it and turned away from it.

segments.arabic: فَحِينَئِذٍ يُبَادر إِلَى إِلْقَاء مَا مَعَه فِيهَا
segments.english: So then he rushes to throw what he has into it.

segments.arabic: وَبِالْجُمْلَةِ فقيم الرحا إِذا تخلى عَنْهَا وَعَن إصلاحها وإلقاء الْحبّ النافع فِيهَا
segments.english: And in summary, the keeper of the mill — when he abandons it and [abandons] repairing it and throwing beneficial grain into it —

segments.arabic: وجد الْعَدو السَّبِيل إِلَى إفسادها وإرادتها بِمَا مَعَه
segments.english: the enemy finds the way to corrupting it and running it with what he has.

segments.arabic: وأصل صَلَاح هَذِه الرَّحَى بالاشتغال بِمَا يَعْنِيك
segments.english: And the root of the soundness of this mill [is] in occupying [yourself] with what concerns you,

segments.arabic: وفسادها كُله فِي الِاشْتِغَال بِمَا لَا يَعْنِيك
segments.english: and all its corruption [is] in occupying [yourself] with what does not concern you.

segments.arabic: وَمَا أحسن مَا قَالَ بعض الْعُقَلَاء
segments.english: And how excellent [is] what some wise people said:

segments.arabic: لما وجدت أَنْوَاع الذَّخَائِر مَنْصُوبَة غَرضا للمتألف
segments.english: "When I found the types of treasures set up [as] a target for ruin,

segments.arabic: وَرَأَيْت الزَّوَال حَاكما عَلَيْهَا مدْركا لَهَا
segments.english: and I saw decline ruling over them, overtaking them,

segments.arabic: انصرفت عَن جَمِيعهَا إِلَى مَا لَا يُنَازع فِيهِ الحجا
segments.english: I turned away from all of them toward what the intellect does not dispute

segments.arabic: أَنه أَنْفَع الذَّخَائِر وَأفضل المكاسب وأربح المتاجر
segments.english: — that it [is] the most beneficial of treasures, the best of earnings, and the most profitable of trades."

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: And God [is] the One whose help [is] sought.

segments.arabic: قَالَ شَقِيق بن إِبْرَاهِيم
segments.english: Shaqiq ibn Ibrahim said:

segments.arabic: أغلق بَاب التَّوْفِيق عَن الْخلق من سِتَّة أَشْيَاء
segments.english: "The door of divine guidance was closed upon creation because of six things:

segments.arabic: اشتغالهم بِالنعْمَةِ عَن شكرها
segments.english: their preoccupation with blessings instead of being grateful for them,

segments.arabic: ورغبتهم فِي الْعلم وتركهم الْعَمَل
segments.english: and their desire for knowledge while abandoning action,

segments.arabic: والمسارعة إِلَى الذَّنب وَتَأْخِير التَّوْبَة
segments.english: and rushing toward sin and delaying repentance,

segments.arabic: والاغترار بِصُحْبَة الصَّالِحين وَترك الِاقْتِدَاء بفعالهم
segments.english: and being fooled by the company of the righteous while abandoning following their deeds,

segments.arabic: وإدبار الدُّنْيَا عَنْهُم وهم يتبعونها
segments.english: and this world turning away from them while they chase it,

segments.arabic: وإقبال الْآخِرَة عَلَيْهِم وهم معرضون عَنْهَا
segments.english: and the Hereafter approaching them while they turn away from it."

segments.arabic: قلت وأصل ذَلِك عدم الرَّغْبَة والرهبة
segments.english: I say: the root of that [is] the lack of desire and fear,

segments.arabic: وَأَصله ضعف الْيَقِين
segments.english: and its root [is] the weakness of certainty,

segments.arabic: وَأَصله ضعف البصيرة
segments.english: and its root [is] the weakness of insight,

segments.arabic: وَأَصله مهانة النَّفس ودناءتها
segments.english: and its root [is] the lowliness of the self and its baseness,

segments.arabic: واستبدال الَّذِي هُوَ أدنى بِالَّذِي هُوَ خير
segments.english: and exchanging that which [is] lower for that which [is] better.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا فَلَو كَانَت النَّفس شريفة كَبِيرَة لم ترض بالدون
segments.english: Otherwise, if the self were noble [and] great, it would not be content with what [is] lesser.

segments.arabic: فَأصل الْخَيْر كُله بِتَوْفِيق الله ومشيئته وَشرف النَّفس ونبلها وكبرها
segments.english: So the root of all good — by God's guidance and [His] will — [is] the nobility of the self, its honor, and its greatness,

segments.arabic: وأصل الشَّرّ خستها ودناءتها وصغرها
segments.english: and the root of evil [is] its lowliness, its baseness, and its smallness.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلح من زكاها
segments.english: He has succeeded — whoever purified it.

segments.arabic: وَقد خَابَ من دساها
segments.english: And he has failed — whoever corrupted it.

segments.arabic: أَي أَفْلح من كبرها وكثرها ونماها بِطَاعَة الله
segments.english: Meaning: he succeeded who made it great and increased it and grew it through obedience to God,

segments.arabic: وخاب من صغرها وحقرها بمعاصي الله
segments.english: and he failed who made it small and belittled it through disobedience to God.

segments.arabic: فالنفوس الشَّرِيفَة لَا ترْضى من الْأَشْيَاء إِلَّا بِأَعْلَاهَا وأفضلها وأحمدها عَاقِبَة
segments.english: So the noble souls [are] not content with things except the highest of them, the best of them, and the most praiseworthy of them in outcome.

segments.arabic: والنفوس الدنيئة تحوم حول الدناءات وَتَقَع عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: And the lowly souls circle around lowly things and fall upon them,

segments.arabic: كَمَا يَقع الذُّبَاب على الأقذار
segments.english: just as flies fall upon filth.

segments.arabic: فَالنَّفْس الشَّرِيفَة الْعلية لَا ترْضى بالظلم وَلَا بالفواحش وَلَا بِالسَّرقَةِ والخيانة
segments.english: So the noble, lofty self [is] not content with injustice, nor with shameful deeds, nor with theft and betrayal,

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهَا أكبر من ذَلِك وأجلّ
segments.english: because it [is] greater than that and more dignified.

segments.arabic: وَالنَّفس المهينة
segments.english: And the lowly self —

segments.arabic: بَادر إِلَى إِصْلَاحه ولمّه خشيَة انْتِقَال السَّاكِن مِنْهُ
segments.english: he rushed to repair it and mend it, fearing the departure of the resident from it.

segments.arabic: فَنعم السَّاكِن وَنعم الْمسكن
segments.english: So what an excellent resident, and what an excellent dwelling!

segments.arabic: فسبحان الله رب الْعَالمين
segments.english: So glorified [is] God, Lord of the worlds —

segments.arabic: كم بَين هَذَا الْبَيْت وَبَيت قد استولى عَلَيْهِ الخراب
segments.english: how [great is the difference] between this house and [a] house that ruin has overtaken,

segments.arabic: وَصَارَ مأوى للحشرات والهوام
segments.english: and [it] became [a] shelter for insects and vermin,

segments.arabic: ومحلا لإلقاء الأنتان والقاذورات فِيهِ
segments.english: and [a] place for throwing filth and waste into it.

segments.arabic: فَمن أَرَادَ التخلي وَقَضَاء الْحَاجة وجد خربة لَا سَاكن فِيهَا وَلَا حَافظ لَهَا
segments.english: So whoever wanted to relieve himself and answer the call of nature found [a] ruin — no resident in it and no guardian for it,

segments.arabic: وَهِي معدة لقَضَاء الْحَاجة مظْلمَة الأرجاء مُنْتِنَة الرَّائِحَة
segments.english: and it [is] prepared for answering the call of nature, dark in [its] corners, foul in [its] smell,

segments.arabic: قد عمّها الخراب وملأتها القاذورات
segments.english: ruin has spread through it and filth has filled it.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يأنس بهَا وَلَا ينزل فِيهَا إِلَّا من يُنَاسِبه سكناهَا
segments.english: So no one feels at ease in it or settles in it except one whom dwelling there suits —

segments.arabic: من الحشرات والديدان والهوام
segments.english: [that is,] the insects, worms, and vermin.

segments.arabic: الشَّيْطَان جَالس على سريرها
segments.english: Satan [is] sitting on its throne,

segments.arabic: وعَلى السرير بِسَاط من الْجَهْل
segments.english: and on the throne [is] a carpet of ignorance,

segments.arabic: وتخفق فِيهِ الْأَهْوَاء
segments.english: and desires flutter within it.

segments.arabic: وَعم يَمِينه وشماله مرافق الشَّهَوَات
segments.english: And the comforts of lusts [have] spread to his right and his left.

segments.arabic: وَقد فتح إِلَيْهِ بَاب من حقل الخذلان والوحشة
segments.english: And [there] has been opened toward it [a] door from [a] field of abandonment and loneliness,

segments.arabic: والركون إِلَى الدُّنْيَا والطمأنينة بهَا والزهد فِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: and leaning toward this world, and feeling secure in it, and having no interest in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وأمطر من وابل الْجَهْل والهوى والشرك والبدع
segments.english: And [it was] rained upon with [a] downpour of ignorance, desire, associating partners [with God], and innovations.

segments.arabic: وَمَا أنبت فِيهِ أَصْنَاف الشوك والحنظل
segments.english: And how [many] types of thorns and bitter fruit it grew in it!

segments.arabic: وَالْأَشْجَار المثمرة بأنواع الْمعاصِي والمخالفات
segments.english: And trees bearing fruit of [all] kinds of sins and violations —

segments.arabic: من الزَّوَائِد والتنديبات والنوادر والهزليات والمضحكات
segments.english: from tall tales, laments, anecdotes, jokes, and laughable things,

segments.arabic: والأشعار الغزليات والخمريات
segments.english: and love poems and wine poems

segments.arabic: الَّتِي تهيج على ارْتِكَاب الْمُحرمَات وتزهد فِي الطَّاعَات
segments.english: that stir [one] toward committing forbidden things and make [one] lose interest in acts of obedience.

segments.arabic: وَجعل فِي وسط الحقل شَجَرَة الْجَهْل بِهِ والإعراض عَنهُ
segments.english: And he placed in the middle of the field the tree of ignorance of Him and turning away from Him.

segments.arabic: فَهِيَ تؤتي أكلهَا كل حِين
segments.english: So it gives its fruit every time —

segments.arabic: من الفسوق والمعاصي وَاللَّهْو واللعب والمجون
segments.english: [fruit] of wickedness, sins, amusement, play, and shamelessness,

segments.arabic: والذهاب مَعَ كل ريح واتّباع كل شَهْوَة
segments.english: and going with every wind and following every lust.

segments.arabic: وَمن ثَمَرهَا الْعُمُوم والغموم وَالْأَحْزَان والآلام
segments.english: And among its fruits [are] worries, sorrows, grief, and pains,

segments.arabic: وَلكنهَا متوارية بإشغال النَّفس بلهوها ولعبها
segments.english: but they [are] hidden by keeping the self busy with its amusement and its play.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أفاقت من سكرها
segments.english: So when [the self] wakes up from its drunkenness,

segments.arabic: أحضرت كل هم وغم وحزن وقلق ومعيشة ضنك
segments.english: [the tree] brings every worry, distress, sadness, anxiety, and [a] miserable life.

segments.arabic: وأجرى إِلَى تِلْكَ الشَّجَرَة مَا يسقيها من اتّباع الْهوى وَطول الأمل والغرور
segments.english: And he made flow to that tree what waters it — from following desire, long hopes, and delusion.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ ترك ذَلِك الْبَيْت وظلماته وخراب حيطانه
segments.english: Then he left that house in its darkness and the ruin of its walls,

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ لَا يمْنَع مِنْهُ مُفسد وَلَا حَيَوَان وَلَا مؤذ وَلَا قذر
segments.english: such that nothing prevents from it [any] corruptor, nor [any] animal, nor [any] harmful thing, nor [any] filth.

segments.arabic: فسبحان خَالق هَذَا الْبَيْت وَذَلِكَ الْبَيْت
segments.english: So glorified [is] the Creator of this house and that house!

segments.arabic: فَمن عرف بَيته وَقدر السَّاكِن فِيهِ
segments.english: So whoever knew his house and [knew] the value of the resident in it,

segments.arabic: وقدّر مَا فِيهِ من الْكُنُوز والذخائر والآلات
segments.english: and appreciated what [is] in it of treasures, stored riches, and tools —

segments.arabic: انْتفع بحياته وَنَفسه
segments.english: he benefited from his life and his self.

segments.arabic: وَمن جهل ذَلِك جهل نَفسه وأضاع سعادته
segments.english: And whoever [was] ignorant of that [was] ignorant of himself and wasted his happiness.

segments.arabic: وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And with God [is] success.

segments.arabic: سَأَلَ سهل التسترِي الرجل يَأْكُل فِي الْيَوْم أَكلَة
segments.english: Sahl al-Tustari was asked [about] [a] man [who] eats one meal in the day.

segments.arabic: قَالَ أكل الصديقين
segments.english: He said: [That is] the eating of the truthful ones.

segments.arabic: قيل لَهُ فأكلتين
segments.english: [It] was said to him: And two meals?

segments.arabic: قَالَ أكل الْمُؤمنِينَ
segments.english: He said: [That is] the eating of the believers.

segments.arabic: قيل لَهُ فَثَلَاث أكلات
segments.english: [It] was said to him: And three meals?

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ قل لأَهله يبنوا
segments.english: So he said: Tell his family [to] build [for him a feeding trough].

headings.arabic: فائدة من الآفات الخفية العامة أن يكون العبد في نعمة أنعم الله بها
headings.english: Benefit: Among the hidden, common afflictions [is] that the servant [is] in [a] blessing [that] God blessed him with

segments.arabic: لَهُ معلفا
segments.english: for it [a] manger.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْأسود بن سَالم رَكْعَتَيْنِ أصليهما لله أحب إِلَيّ من الْجنَّة بِمَا فِيهَا
segments.english: Al-Aswad ibn Salim said: "Two units of prayer [that] I pray for God [are] more beloved to me than Paradise with all that [is] in it."

segments.arabic: فَقيل لَهُ هَذَا خطأ
segments.english: So it was said to him: "This [is a] mistake."

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ دَعونَا من كلامكم
segments.english: So he said: "Leave us alone with your talk.

segments.arabic: الْجنَّة رضى نَفسِي والركعتان رضى رَبِّي
segments.english: Paradise [is] the pleasure of my self, and the two units of prayer [are] the pleasure of my Lord.

segments.arabic: ورضى رَبِّي أحب إِلَيّ من رضى نَفسِي
segments.english: And the pleasure of my Lord [is] more beloved to me than the pleasure of my self."

segments.arabic: الْعَارِف فِي الأَرْض رَيْحَانَة من رياحين الْجنَّة
segments.english: The knower on the earth [is a] sweet basil from the sweet basils of Paradise.

segments.arabic: إِذا شمها المريد اشتاقت نَفسه إِلَى الْجنَّة
segments.english: When the seeker smells it, his soul longs for Paradise.

segments.arabic: قلب الْمُحب بَين جلال محبوبه وجماله
segments.english: The heart of the lover [is] between the majesty of his Beloved and His beauty.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا لاحظ جَلَاله هابه وعظّمه
segments.english: So when he observes His majesty, he fears Him and honors Him.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا لاحظ جماله أحبه واشتاق إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And when he observes His beauty, he loves Him and longs for Him.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة
segments.english: Benefit

segments.arabic: من النَّاس من يعرف الله بالجود والإفضال وَالْإِحْسَان
segments.english: Among people [there is he] who knows God through generosity, grace, and goodness.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من يعرفهُ بِالْعَفو والحلم والتجاوز
segments.english: And among them [is he] who knows Him through pardon, forbearance, and overlooking.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من يعرفهُ بالبطش والانتقام
segments.english: And among them [is he] who knows Him through might and vengeance.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من يعرفهُ بِالْعلمِ وَالْحكمَة
segments.english: And among them [is he] who knows Him through knowledge and wisdom.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْه من يعرفهُ بِالْعِزَّةِ والكبرياء
segments.english: And among them [is he] who knows Him through honor and greatness.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من يعرفهُ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَالْبر واللطف
segments.english: And among them [is he] who knows Him through mercy, goodness, and gentleness.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من يعرفهُ بالقهر وَالْملك
segments.english: And among them [is he] who knows Him through domination and sovereignty.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من يعرفهُ بإجابة دَعوته وإغاثة لهفته وَقَضَاء حَاجته
segments.english: And among them [is he] who knows Him through answering his call, relieving his distress, and fulfilling his need.

segments.arabic: وأعم هَؤُلَاءِ معرفَة من عرفه من كَلَامه
segments.english: And the most complete of these in knowledge [is the one] who knew Him from His speech.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ يعرف رَبًّا قد اجْتمعت لَهُ صِفَات الْكَمَال ونعوت الْجلَال
segments.english: For he knows [a] Lord for whom the attributes of perfection and the descriptions of majesty have gathered together.

segments.arabic: منزّه عَن الْمِثَال برِئ من النقائص والعيوب
segments.english: [He is] free from any likeness, clear of flaws and defects.

segments.arabic: لَهُ كل اسْم حسن وكل وصف كَمَال
segments.english: To Him [belongs] every beautiful name and every attribute of perfection.

segments.arabic: فعّال لما يُرِيد فَوق كل شَيْء وَمَعَ كل شَيْء
segments.english: [He is a] doer of whatever He wills, above everything and with everything.

segments.arabic: وقادر على كل شَيْء ومقيم لكل شَيْء
segments.english: And [He is] capable of everything and sustaining everything.

segments.arabic: آمرناه مُتَكَلم بكلماته الدِّينِيَّة والكونية
segments.english: [He is] commanding [and] forbidding, speaking with His words — religious and cosmic.

segments.arabic: أكبر من كل شَيْء وأجمل من كل شَيْء
segments.english: Greater than everything and more beautiful than everything.

segments.arabic: أرْحم الرَّاحِمِينَ وأقدر القادرين وَأحكم الْحَاكِمين
segments.english: The Most Merciful of those who show mercy, the Most Powerful of those who have power, and the Wisest of those who judge.

segments.arabic: فالقرآن أنزل لتعريف عباده بِهِ
segments.english: So the Quran was sent down to make His servants know Him,

segments.arabic: وبصراطه الْموصل إِلَيْهِ وبحال السالكين بعد الْوُصُول إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and [to know] His path that leads to Him, and the state of the travelers after reaching Him.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة
segments.english: Benefit

segments.arabic: من الْآفَات الْخفية الْعَامَّة أَن يكون العَبْد فِي نعْمَة أنعم الله بهَا عَلَيْهِ واختارها لَهُ
segments.english: Among the hidden, common afflictions [is] that the servant [is] in [a] blessing [that] God blessed him with and chose for him.

segments.arabic: فيملها العَبْد وَيطْلب الِانْتِقَال مِنْهَا
segments.english: But the servant becomes bored of it and seeks to move away from it,

segments.arabic: إِلَى مَا يزْعم لجهله أَنه خير لَهُ مِنْهَا
segments.english: to what he claims, out of his ignorance, [is] better for him than it.

segments.arabic: وربه برحمته لَا يُخرجهُ من تِلْكَ النِّعْمَة
segments.english: And his Lord, out of His mercy, does not take him out of that blessing,

segments.arabic: وبعذره بجهله وَسُوء اخْتِيَاره لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: and excuses him for his ignorance and his poor choosing for himself,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى إِذا ضَاقَ ذرعا
segments.english: until when he becomes fed up —

headings.arabic: فصل ومن أعز أنواع المعرفة معرفة الرب سبحانه بالجمال وهي معرفة خواص
headings.english: Section: Among the most precious types of knowledge [is] knowing the Lord, glorified [is] He, through beauty — and it [is] the knowledge of the elite

segments.arabic: بِتِلْكَ النِّعْمَة وسخطها وتبرّم بهَا واستحكم ملكه لَهَا سلبه الله إِيَّاهَا
segments.english: with that blessing, and [he] resented it and grew tired of it, and [when] his possession of it [was] firmly established, God stripped it from him.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا انْتقل إِلَى مَا طلبه وَرَأى التَّفَاوُت بَين مَا كَانَ فِيهِ وَمَا صَار إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: So when he moved on to what he had sought and saw the difference between what he [had] been in and what he ended up in,

segments.arabic: اشْتَدَّ قلقه وندمه وَطلب العودة إِلَى مَا كَانَ فِيهِ
segments.english: his worry and regret grew strong, and he sought to return to what he [had] been in.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أَرَادَ الله بِعَبْدِهِ خيرا ورشدا أشهده أَن مَا هُوَ فِيهِ نعْمَة من نعمه عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: So when God wants good and guidance for His servant, He makes him witness that what he [is] in [is] a blessing from His blessings upon him,

segments.arabic: وَرضَاهُ بِهِ وأوزعه شكره عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and [grants] him contentment with it, and inspires him to give thanks for it.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا حدثته نَفسه بالانتقال عَنهُ استخار ربه استخارة جَاهِل بمصلحته عَاجز عَنْهَا
segments.english: So when his self urges him to move away from it, he seeks guidance from his Lord — the seeking of one [who is] ignorant of what [is] good for him, unable [to achieve] it,

segments.arabic: مفوض إِلَى الله طَالب مِنْهُ حسن اخْتِيَاره لَهُ
segments.english: entrusting [his affair] to God, asking Him for the best of His choice for him.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ على العَبْد أضرّ من ملله لنعم الله
segments.english: And nothing [is] more harmful to the servant than his boredom with God's blessings,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَرَاهَا نعْمَة وَلَا يشكره عَلَيْهَا وَلَا يفرح بهَا
segments.english: for he does not see it [as] a blessing, and does not thank Him for it, and does not rejoice in it,

segments.arabic: بل يسخطها ويشكوها ويعدّها مُصِيبَة
segments.english: but rather he resents it, complains about it, and counts it [as] a hardship —

segments.arabic: هَذَا وَهِي من أعظم نعم الله عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: this, while it [is] among the greatest of God's blessings upon him.

segments.arabic: فَأكْثر النَّاس أَعدَاء نعم الله عَلَيْهِم
segments.english: So most people [are] enemies of God's blessings upon them,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يَشْعُرُونَ بِفَتْح الله عَلَيْهِم نعمه وهم مجتهدون فِي دَفعهَا وردهَا جهلا وظلما
segments.english: and they do not feel God opening His blessings upon them while they [are] striving to push them away and reject them out of ignorance and wrongdoing.

segments.arabic: فكم من سعت إِلَى أحدهم من نعْمَة وَهُوَ ساع فِي ردهَا بِجهْدِهِ
segments.english: So how many a blessing came toward one of them while he [was] striving with all his effort to reject it,

segments.arabic: وَكم وصلت إِلَيْهِ وَهُوَ ساع فِي دَفعهَا وزوالها بظلمه وجهله
segments.english: and how many [a blessing] reached him while he [was] striving to push it away and remove it through his wrongdoing and ignorance.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِعْمَةً أَنْعَمَهَا عَلَى قَوْمٍ حَتَّى يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ
segments.english: That [is] because God would not change a blessing He had blessed upon a people until they change what [is] in themselves.
segments.sahih_international: That is because Allah would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّى يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ
segments.english: Indeed God does not change what [is] with a people until they change what [is] in themselves.
segments.sahih_international: For each one are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allah. Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allah intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron.

segments.arabic: فَلَيْسَ للنعم أعدى من نفس العَبْد
segments.english: So nothing [is] more hostile to blessings than the self of the servant.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مَعَ عدوه ظهير على نَفسه
segments.english: For he [is] with his enemy [a] supporter against himself.

segments.arabic: فعدوه يطْرَح النَّار فِي نعمه وَهُوَ ينْفخ فِيهَا
segments.english: His enemy throws fire into his blessings, and he [is] blowing on it.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ الَّذِي مكّنه من طرح النَّار ثمَّ أَعَانَهُ بالنفخ
segments.english: So he [is] the one who enabled him to throw the fire, then helped him by blowing.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اشتدّ ضرامها اسْتَغَاثَ من الْحَرِيق وَكَانَ غَايَته معاتبة الأقدار
segments.english: So when its blaze grew fierce, he cried for help from the burning, and the most he [could] do [was] blaming fate.

segments.arabic: وعاجز الرَّأْي مضياع لفرصته ... حَتَّى إِذا فَاتَ أَمر عَاتب القدرا
segments.english: The one weak in judgment wastes his chance… until when [a] matter passes him by, he blames fate.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Section

segments.arabic: وَمن أعز أَنْوَاع الْمعرفَة معرفَة الرب سُبْحَانَهُ بالجمال
segments.english: And among the most precious types of knowledge [is] knowing the Lord, glorified [is] He, through [His] beauty.

segments.arabic: وَهِي معرفَة خَواص الْخلق
segments.english: And it [is] the knowledge of the elite of creation.

segments.arabic: وَكلهمْ عرفه بِصفة من صِفَاته
segments.english: And all of them knew Him through [a] quality from His qualities,

segments.arabic: وأتمهم معرفَة من عرفه بِكَمَالِهِ وجلاله وجماله سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: and the most complete of them in knowledge [is] the one who knew Him through His perfection, His majesty, and His beauty, glorified [is] He.

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ كمثله شَيْء فِي سَائِر صِفَاته
segments.english: Nothing [is] like Him in any of His qualities.

segments.arabic: وَلَو فرضت الْخلق كلهم على أجملهم صُورَة وَكلهمْ على تِلْكَ الصُّورَة
segments.english: And if you imagined all of creation in the most beautiful form among them, and all of them upon that form,

segments.arabic: ونسبت جمَالهمْ الظَّاهِر وَالْبَاطِن إِلَى جمال الرب سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: and you compared their beauty, outer and inner, to the beauty of the Lord, glorified [is] He,

segments.arabic: لَكَانَ أقل من نِسْبَة سراج ضَعِيف إِلَى قرص الشَّمْس
segments.english: it would [be] less than the comparison of [a] weak lamp to the disk of the sun.

segments.arabic: وَيَكْفِي فِي جماله أَنه لَو كشف الْحجاب
segments.english: And it [is] enough [to say] about His beauty that if the veil were lifted —

segments.arabic: عَن وَجهه لأحرقت سُبْحَانَهُ مَا انْتهى إِلَيْهِ بَصَره من خلقه
segments.english: from His face — glorified [is] He — [it] would have burned whatever His sight reaches of His creation.

segments.arabic: وَيَكْفِي فِي جماله أَن كل جمال ظَاهر وباطن فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة فَمن آثَار صَنعته
segments.english: And [it] suffices regarding His beauty that every beauty, outward and inward, in this world and the Hereafter, [is] from the traces of His craftsmanship.

segments.arabic: فَمَا الظَّن بِمن صدر عَنهُ هَذَا الْجمال
segments.english: So what [is] the thought about the One from whom this beauty came?

segments.arabic: وَيَكْفِي فِي جماله أَنه لَهُ الْعِزَّة جَمِيعًا وَالْقُوَّة جَمِيعًا والجود كُله وَالْإِحْسَان كُله وَالْعلم كُله وَالْفضل كُله
segments.english: And [it] suffices regarding His beauty that to Him [belongs] all might, all power, all generosity, all goodness, all knowledge, and all favor.

segments.arabic: ولنور وَجهه أشرقت الظُّلُمَات
segments.english: And by the light of His face the darknesses were illuminated.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ النَّبِي فِي دُعَاء الطَّائِف
segments.english: As the Prophet said in the supplication of Ta'if:

segments.arabic: أعوذ بِنور وَجهك الَّذِي أشرقت لَهُ الظُّلُمَات وَصلح عَلَيْهِ أَمر الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: "I seek refuge in the light of Your face, by which the darknesses were illuminated and the affairs of this world and the Hereafter were set right."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ عبد الله بن مَسْعُود لَيْسَ عِنْد ربكُم ليل وَلَا نَهَار
segments.english: And Abdullah ibn Mas'ud said: "There [is] no night nor day with your Lord.

segments.arabic: نور السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض من نور وَجهه
segments.english: The light of the heavens and the earth [is] from the light of His face."

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ نور السَّمَوَات وَالْأَرْض
segments.english: So He — glorified [is] He — [is] the light of the heavens and the earth.

segments.arabic: وَيَوْم الْقِيَامَة إِذا جَاءَ لفصل الْقَضَاء وتشرق الأَرْض بنوره
segments.english: And [on] the Day of Judgment, when He comes to settle the decree, the earth [will] shine with His light.

segments.arabic: وَمن أَسْمَائِهِ الْحسنى الْجَمِيل
segments.english: And among His most beautiful names [is] "the Beautiful."

segments.arabic: وَفِي الصَّحِيح عَنهُ إِن الله جميل يحب الْجمال
segments.english: And in the authentic [hadith] from him: "Indeed God [is] beautiful [and] loves beauty."

segments.arabic: وجماله سُبْحَانَهُ على أَربع مَرَاتِب
segments.english: And His beauty — glorified [is] He — [is] upon four levels:

segments.arabic: جمال الذَّات وجمال الصِّفَات وجمال الْأَفْعَال وجمال الْأَسْمَاء
segments.english: the beauty of the Essence, the beauty of the Attributes, the beauty of the Actions, and the beauty of the Names.

segments.arabic: فأسماؤه كلهَا حسنى وَصِفَاته كلهَا صِفَات كَمَال
segments.english: So His names [are] all most beautiful, and His attributes [are] all attributes of perfection.

segments.arabic: وأفعاله كلهَا حِكْمَة ومصلحة وَعدل وَرَحْمَة
segments.english: And His actions [are] all wisdom, benefit, justice, and mercy.

segments.arabic: وَأما جمال الذَّات وَمَا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ فَأمر لَا يُدْرِكهُ سواهُ وَلَا يُعلمهُ غَيره
segments.english: As for the beauty of the Essence and what He [is] upon, [it is] a matter none can grasp except Him, and none knows it other than Him.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ عِنْد المخلوقين مِنْهُ إِلَّا تعريفات تعرّف بهَا إِلَى من أكْرمه من عباده
segments.english: And the created beings have nothing of it except glimpses by which He made Himself known to those He honored among His servants.

segments.arabic: فَإِن ذَلِك الْجمال مصون عَن الأغيار مَحْجُوب بستر الرِّدَاء والإزار
segments.english: For that beauty [is] guarded from others, veiled by the covering of the upper garment and the lower garment.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ رَسُوله فِيمَا يحْكى عَنهُ
segments.english: As His Messenger said, in what [is] narrated from Him:

segments.arabic: الْكِبْرِيَاء رِدَائي وَالْعَظَمَة إزَارِي
segments.english: "Pride [is] My upper garment and greatness [is] My lower garment."

segments.arabic: وَلما كَانَت الْكِبْرِيَاء أعظم وأوسع كَانَت أَحَق باسم الرِّدَاء
segments.english: And since pride was greater and more vast, it was more fitting for the name "upper garment."

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ الْكَبِير المتعال
segments.english: For He — glorified [is] He — [is] the Great, the Most High.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ الْعلي الْعَظِيم
segments.english: So He — glorified [is] He — [is] the Most High, the Supreme.

segments.arabic: قَالَ ابْن عَبَّاس حجب الذَّات بِالصِّفَاتِ وحجب الصِّفَات بالأفعال
segments.english: Ibn Abbas said: He veiled the Essence with the Attributes, and veiled the Attributes with the Actions.

segments.arabic: فَمَا ظَنك بِجَمَال حجب بأوصاف الْكَمَال وَستر بنعوت العظمة والجلال
segments.english: So what [is] your thought about [a] beauty [that was] veiled by descriptions of perfection and covered by qualities of greatness and majesty?

segments.arabic: وَمن هَذَا الْمَعْنى يفهم بعض مَعَاني جمال ذَاته
segments.english: And from this meaning, some of the meanings of the beauty of His Essence [are] understood.

segments.arabic: فَإِن العَبْد يترقّى من معرفَة الْأَفْعَال إِلَى معرفَة الصِّفَات
segments.english: For the servant rises from knowledge of the Actions to knowledge of the Attributes,

segments.arabic: وَمن معرفَة الصِّفَات إِلَى معرفَة الذَّات
segments.english: and from knowledge of the Attributes to knowledge of the Essence.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا شَاهد شَيْئا من جمال الْأَفْعَال اسْتدلَّ بِهِ على جمال الصِّفَات
segments.english: So when he witnesses something of the beauty of the Actions, he uses it as proof of the beauty of the Attributes.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ استدلَّ بِجَمَال الصِّفَات على جمال الذَّات
segments.english: Then [he] infers from the beauty of the Attributes the beauty of the Essence.

segments.arabic: وَمن هَهُنَا يتَبَيَّن أَنه سُبْحَانَهُ لَهُ الْحَمد كُله
segments.english: And from here it becomes clear that He — glorified [is] He — to Him [belongs] all praise,

segments.arabic: وَأَن أحدا من خلقه لَا يحصي ثَنَاء
segments.english: and that no one among His creation can count [His] praise.

segments.arabic: عَلَيْهِ بل هُوَ كَمَا أثنى على نَفسه
segments.english: upon Him, rather He [is] as He praised Himself

segments.arabic: وَأَنه يسْتَحق أَن يعبد لذاته وَيُحب لذاته ويشكر لذاته
segments.english: and that He deserves to be worshipped for His essence, and loved for His essence, and thanked for His essence

segments.arabic: وَأَنه سُبْحَانَهُ يحب نَفسه ويثني على نَفسه ويحمد نَفسه
segments.english: and that He, glorified [is] He, loves Himself and praises Himself and commends Himself

segments.arabic: وَأَن محبته لنَفسِهِ وحمده لنَفسِهِ وثناءه على نَفسه وتوحيده لنَفسِهِ هُوَ فِي الْحَقِيقَة الْحَمد وَالثنَاء وَالْحب والتوحيد
segments.english: and that His love for Himself, and His commending of Himself, and His praise of Himself, and His declaring oneness of Himself — that [is] in reality the [true] commending, and praise, and love, and monotheism

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ كَمَا أثنى على نَفسه وَفَوق مَا يثني بِهِ عَلَيْهِ خلقه
segments.english: so He, glorified [is] He, [is] as He praised Himself, and above what His creation praises Him with

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ كَمَا يحب ذَاته يحب صِفَاته وأفعاله
segments.english: and He, glorified [is] He, just as He loves His essence, He loves His attributes and His actions

segments.arabic: فَكل أَفعاله حسن مَحْبُوب
segments.english: so all His actions [are] good [and] beloved

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ فِي مفعولاته مَا يبغضه ويكرهه
segments.english: and even if among His created things [there is] what He hates and dislikes

segments.arabic: فَلَيْسَ فِي أَفعاله مَا هُوَ مَكْرُوه مسخوط
segments.english: then [there is] nothing in His actions that [is] hated [or] displeasing

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ فِي الْوُجُود مَا يحب لذاته ويحمد لذاته إِلَّا هُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: and [there is] nothing in existence that [is] loved for its essence and commended for its essence except Him, glorified [is] He

segments.arabic: وكل مَا يحب سواهُ فَإِن كَانَت محبته تابعة لمحبته سُبْحَانَهُ بِحَيْثُ يحب لأَجله فمحبته صَحِيحَة
segments.english: and everything that [is] loved besides Him — if its love [is] following from love of Him, glorified [is] He, such that it [is] loved for His sake, then its love [is] correct

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا فَهِيَ محبَّة بَاطِلَة
segments.english: and otherwise, then it [is] [a] false love

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا هُوَ حَقِيقَة الإلهية
segments.english: and this — it [is] the reality of divinity

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْإِلَه الْحق هُوَ الَّذِي يحب لذاته ويحمد لذاته
segments.english: for the true God — He [is] the one who [is] loved for His essence and commended for His essence

segments.arabic: فَكيف إِذا انضاف إِلَى ذَلِك إحسانه وإنعامه وحلمه وتجاوزه وعفوه وبرّه وَرَحمته
segments.english: so how [much more] when added to that [is] His kindness, and His granting of blessings, and His forbearance, and His overlooking, and His pardon, and His goodness, and His mercy

segments.arabic: فعلى العَبْد أَن يعلم أَنه لَا إِلَه إِلَّا الله فَيُحِبهُ وَيَحْمَدهُ لذاته وكماله
segments.english: so the servant must know that there [is] no god but God, and [so] love Him and commend Him for His essence and His perfection

segments.arabic: وَأَن يعلم أَنه لَا محسن على الْحَقِيقَة بأصناف النعم الظَّاهِرَة والباطنة إِلَّا هُوَ
segments.english: and [he must] know that there [is] no [one] truly kind with [all] types of blessings, outer and inner, except Him

segments.arabic: فَيُحِبهُ لإحسانه وإنعامه وَيَحْمَدهُ على ذَلِك
segments.english: so [he should] love Him for His kindness and His granting of blessings, and commend Him for that

segments.arabic: فَيُحِبهُ من الْوَجْهَيْنِ جَمِيعًا
segments.english: so [he should] love Him from both angles together

segments.arabic: وكما أَنه لَيْسَ كمثله شَيْء فَلَيْسَ كمحبته محبَّة
segments.english: and just as there [is] nothing like Him, [so] there [is] no love like [the] love of Him

segments.arabic: والمحبة مَعَ الخضوع هِيَ الْعُبُودِيَّة الَّتِي خلق الْخلق لأَجلهَا
segments.english: and love together with submission — it [is] the servitude for which the creation was created

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا غَايَة الْحبّ بغاية الذل
segments.english: for it [is] the utmost love with the utmost humility

segments.arabic: وَلَا يصلح ذَلِك إِلَّا لَهُ سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: and that [is] not fitting except for Him, glorified [is] He

segments.arabic: والإشراك بِهِ فِي هَذَا هُوَ الشّرك الَّذِي لَا يغفره الله وَلَا يقبل لصَاحبه عملا
segments.english: and associating partners with Him in this — it [is] the associating [of partners] that God does not forgive, and [He] does not accept from its doer any deed

segments.arabic: وحمده يتَضَمَّن أصلين
segments.english: and His commending contains two foundations

segments.arabic: الْإِخْبَار بمحامده وصفات كَمَاله والمحبة لَهُ عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: reporting His praiseworthy [qualities] and attributes of His perfection, and loving Him for them

segments.arabic: فَمن أخبر بمحاسن غَيره من غير محبَّة لَهُ لم يكن حامدا
segments.english: so whoever reports the good qualities of another without love for him, [he] [is] not [one who is] commending

segments.arabic: وَمن أحبّه من غير إِخْبَار بمحاسنه لم يكن حامدا حَتَّى يجمع الْأَمريْنِ
segments.english: and whoever loves him without reporting his good qualities, [he] [is] not [one who is] commending — until he combines the two matters

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يحمد نَفسه بِنَفسِهِ
segments.english: and He, glorified [is] He, commends Himself by Himself

segments.arabic: ويحمد نَفسه بِمَا يجريه على أَلْسِنَة الحامدين لَهُ من مَلَائكَته وأنبيائه وَرُسُله وعباده الْمُؤمنِينَ
segments.english: and He commends Himself through what He causes to flow upon the tongues of those who commend Him — from His angels, and His prophets, and His messengers, and His believing servants

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ الحامد لنَفسِهِ بِهَذَا وَهَذَا
segments.english: so He [is] the one commending Himself through this and this

segments.arabic: فَإِن حمدهم لَهُ بمشيئته وإذنه وتكوينه
segments.english: for their commending of Him [is] by His will, and His permission, and His bringing [it] into being

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ هُوَ الَّذِي جعل الحامد حامدا وَالْمُسلم مُسلما وَالْمُصَلي مُصَليا والتائب تَائِبًا
segments.english: for He [is] the one who made the one commending [a] commender, and the Muslim [a] Muslim, and the one praying [a] prayer, and the one repenting [a] repenter

segments.arabic: فَمِنْهُ ابتدأت النعم واليه انْتَهَت
segments.english: so from Him the blessings began, and to Him they returned

segments.arabic: فابتدأت بِحَمْدِهِ وانتهت إِلَى حَمده
segments.english: so they began with His commending and ended at His commending

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي ألهم عَبده التَّوْبَة وَفَرح
segments.english: and He [is] the one who inspired His servant [with] repentance and [He] rejoiced

headings.arabic: فصل وقوله في الحديث إن الله جميل يحب الجمال يتناول جمال الثياب
headings.english: Section: His saying in the hadith 'God [is] beautiful [and] loves beauty' covers the beauty of clothing

segments.arabic: بهَا أعظم فَرح وَهِي من فَضله وجوده
segments.english: with it [is] the greatest joy, and it [is] from His grace and generosity.

segments.arabic: وألهم عَبده الطَّاعَة وأعانه عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: And He inspired His servant [to] obedience and helped him upon it.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أثابه عَلَيْهَا وَهِي من فَضله وجوده
segments.english: Then He rewarded him for it, and it [is] from His grace and generosity.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ غَنِي عَن كل مَا سواهُ بِكُل وَجه
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, [is] free of need from everything other than Him in every way.

segments.arabic: وَمَا سواهُ فَقير إِلَيْهِ بِكُل وَجه
segments.english: And everything other than Him [is] in need of Him in every way.

segments.arabic: وَالْعَبْد مفتقر إِلَيْهِ لذاته فِي الْأَسْبَاب والغايات
segments.english: And the servant [is] in need of Him by his very nature, in [both] the means and the ends.

segments.arabic: فَإِن مَالا يكون بِهِ لَا يكون وَمَا لَا يكون لَهُ لَا ينفع
segments.english: For what does not come about through Him does not come about, and what [is] not for Him does not benefit.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله فِي الحَدِيث إِن الله جميل يحب الْجمال يتَنَاوَل جمال الثِّيَاب المسؤول عَنهُ فِي نفس الحَدِيث
segments.english: And his saying in the hadith, 'God [is] beautiful [and] loves beauty,' covers the beauty of clothing that was asked about in the hadith itself.

segments.arabic: وَيدخل فِيهِ بطرِيق الْعُمُوم الْجمال من كل شَيْء
segments.english: And included in it, by way of generality, [is] beauty in everything.

segments.arabic: كَمَا فِي الحَدِيث الآخر إِن الله نظيف يحب النَّظَافَة
segments.english: As in the other hadith: 'God [is] clean [and] loves cleanliness.'

segments.arabic: وَفِي الصَّحِيح إِن الله طيب لَا يقبل إِلَّا طيبا
segments.english: And in the Sahih: 'God [is] good [and] does not accept except [what is] good.'

segments.arabic: وَفِي السّنَن إِن الله يحب أَن يرى أثر نعْمَته على عَبده
segments.english: And in the Sunan: 'God loves to see the trace of His blessing on His servant.'

segments.arabic: وفيهَا عَن أبي الْأَحْوَص الْجُشَمِي قَالَ رَآنِي النَّبِي وعليَّ أطمار
segments.english: And in it, from Abu al-Ahwas al-Jushami, he said: 'The Prophet saw me and on me [were] worn-out clothes.'

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ هَل لَك من مَال قلت نعم قَالَ من أَي المَال
segments.english: So he said: 'Do you have any wealth?' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'What kind of wealth?'

segments.arabic: قلت من كل مَا أَتَى الله من الْإِبِل والشاه
segments.english: I said: 'From everything God has given [me] — camels and sheep.'

segments.arabic: قَالَ فلتر نعْمَته وكرامته عَلَيْك
segments.english: He said: 'Then let His blessing and His honor be seen on you.'

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ يحب ظُهُور أثر نعْمَته على عَبده
segments.english: So He, glorified [is] He, loves the appearance of the trace of His blessing on His servant.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ من الْجمال الَّذِي يُحِبهُ
segments.english: For it [is] from the beauty that He loves.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ من شكره على نعمه وَهُوَ جمال بَاطِن
segments.english: And that [is] from gratitude to Him for His blessings, and it [is] an inner beauty.

segments.arabic: فيحب أَن يرى على عَبده الْجمال الظَّاهِر بِالنعْمَةِ وَالْجمال الْبَاطِن بالشكر عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: So He loves to see on His servant the outer beauty through [His] blessing, and the inner beauty through gratitude for it.

segments.arabic: ولمحبته سُبْحَانَهُ للجمال أنزل على عباده لباسا وزينة تجمّل ظواهرهم وتقوى تجمّل بواطنهم
segments.english: And because of His love, glorified [is] He, for beauty, He sent down upon His servants clothing and adornment [that] beautifies their outward [appearance], and God-consciousness [that] beautifies their inward [selves].

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ
segments.english: So He said:

segments.arabic: يَا بَنِي آدَمَ قَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُوَارِي سَوْآتِكُمْ وَرِيشًا وَلِبَاسُ التَّقْوَى ذَلِك خير
segments.english: O children of Adam, We have sent down upon you clothing [that] covers your nakedness, and [as] adornment. But the clothing of God-consciousness — that [is] better.
segments.sahih_international: O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment. But the clothing of righteousness - that is best. That is from the signs of Allah that perhaps they will remember.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ فِي أهل الْجنَّة
segments.english: And He said about the people of Paradise:

segments.arabic: ولقاهم نضرة وَسُرُورًا
segments.english: And He [will] meet them [with] radiance and joy.

segments.arabic: وَجَزَاهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُوا جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
segments.english: And [will] reward them for their patience [with] Paradise and silk.
segments.sahih_international: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

segments.arabic: فجمل وُجُوههم بالنضرة وبواطنهم بالسرور وأبدانهم بالحرير
segments.english: So He beautified their faces with radiance, and their inner [selves] with joy, and their bodies with silk.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ كَمَا يحب الْجمال فِي الْأَقْوَال وَالْأَفْعَال واللباس والهيأة
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, just as He loves beauty in words and deeds and clothing and appearance,

segments.arabic: يبغض الْقَبِيح من الْأَقْوَال وَالْأَفْعَال وَالثيَاب والهيأة
segments.english: [He] hates ugliness in words and deeds and clothing and appearance.

segments.arabic: فيبغض الْقَبِيح وَأَهله وَيُحب الْجمال وَأَهله
segments.english: So He hates ugliness and its people, and loves beauty and its people.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن ضل فِي هَذَا الْمَوْضُوع فريقان
segments.english: But two groups went astray regarding this matter.

segments.arabic: فريق قَالُوا كل مَا خلقه جميل فَهُوَ يحب كل مَا خلقه وَنحن نحب جَمِيع
segments.english: [The first] group said: 'Everything He created [is] beautiful, so He loves everything He created, and we love all'

headings.arabic: فصل وقابلهم في الفريق الثاني فقالوا قد ذم الله سبحانه جمال الصور
headings.english: Section: The second group opposed them, saying God, glorified [is] He, condemned the beauty of appearances

segments.arabic: مَا خلقه فَلَا نبغض مِنْهُ شَيْئا
segments.english: what He created, so we do not hate anything of it.

segments.arabic: قَالُوا وَمن رأى الكائنات مِنْهُ رَآهَا كلهَا جميلَة
segments.english: They said: and whoever sees [all] beings [as coming] from Him, sees them all [as] beautiful.

segments.arabic: وَأنْشد منشدهم
segments.english: And one of their poets recited:

segments.arabic: وَإِذا رَأَيْت الكائنات بعينهم ... فَجَمِيع مَا يحوي الْوُجُود مليح
segments.english: And when you see [all] beings through their eyes... then everything that existence holds [is] beautiful.

segments.arabic: وَاحْتَجُّوا بقوله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And they argued with the saying of [God] Most High:

segments.arabic: الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ
segments.english: the One who made everything He created well,
segments.sahih_international: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: and His saying:

segments.arabic: صُنْعَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
segments.english: [It is] the work of God, who perfected everything,
segments.sahih_international: And you see the mountains, thinking them rigid, while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allah, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Acquainted with that which you do.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله
segments.english: and His saying:

segments.arabic: مَا تَرَى فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَنِ مِنْ تَفَاوُتٍ
segments.english: you do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any flaw.
segments.sahih_international: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

segments.arabic: والعارف عِنْدهم هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَرح بِإِطْلَاق الْجمال
segments.english: And the knower, according to them, [is] the one who declares beauty without limit,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يرى فِي الْوُجُود قبيحا
segments.english: and does not see in existence anything ugly.

segments.arabic: وَهَؤُلَاء قد عدمت الْغيرَة لله من قُلُوبهم
segments.english: And these [people] — protective jealousy for God has vanished from their hearts,

segments.arabic: والبغض فِي الله والمعاداة فِيهِ وإنكار الْمُنكر
segments.english: and hatred for the sake of God, and enmity for His sake, and rejecting [the] wrong,

segments.arabic: وَالْجهَاد فِي سَبيله وَإِقَامَة حُدُوده
segments.english: and striving in His path, and upholding His limits.

segments.arabic: وَيرى جمال الصُّور من الذُّكُور وَالْإِنَاث من الْجمال الَّذِي يُحِبهُ الله
segments.english: And [one of them] sees the beauty of appearances — of males and females — as [part] of the beauty that God loves,

segments.arabic: فيتعبدون بفسقهم
segments.english: so they worship [God] through their sinfulness.

segments.arabic: وَرُبمَا غلا بَعضهم حَتَّى يزْعم أَن معبوده يظْهر فِي تِلْكَ الصُّورَة وَيحل فِيهَا
segments.english: And perhaps some of them go so far as to claim that their object of worship appears in that form and dwells in it.

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ اتحاديا قَالَ هِيَ مظهر من مظَاهر الْحق
segments.english: And if [he] was [a] unificationist, he said: it [is a] manifestation of the manifestations of the Truth,

segments.arabic: ويسميها الْمظَاهر الجمالية
segments.english: and he calls them the beautiful manifestations.

segments.arabic: فصل وقابلهم فِي الْفَرِيق الثَّانِي فَقَالُوا قد ذمّ الله سُبْحَانَهُ جمال الصُّور
segments.english: Section: And the second group opposed them, and they said: God, glorified [is] He, [has] condemned the beauty of appearances,

segments.arabic: وَتَمام الْقَامَة والخلقة
segments.english: and the perfection of stature and form.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ عَن النافقين
segments.english: So He said about the hypocrites:

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ
segments.english: And when you see them, their bodies impress you.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَاثًا وَرِئْيًا
segments.english: And how many [a] generation We destroyed before them — [they were] better in possessions and appearance!
segments.sahih_international: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?

segments.arabic: أَي أَمْوَالًا ومناظر
segments.english: meaning: wealth and looks.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْحسن هُوَ الصُّور
segments.english: Al-Hasan said: it [means] the appearances.

segments.arabic: وَفِي صَحِيح مُسلم عَنهُ
segments.english: And in Sahih Muslim, from him [the Prophet ﷺ]:

segments.arabic: إِن الله لَا ينظر إِلَى صوركُمْ وَأَمْوَالكُمْ
segments.english: "God does not look at your appearances and your wealth,

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا ينظر إِلَى قُلُوبكُمْ وَأَعْمَالكُمْ
segments.english: but rather He looks at your hearts and your deeds."

segments.arabic: قَالُوا وَمَعْلُوم أَنه لم ينف نظر الْإِدْرَاك
segments.english: They said: and [it is] known that He did not negate the looking of awareness,

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا نفى نظر الْمحبَّة
segments.english: but rather He negated the looking of love.

segments.arabic: قَالُوا وَقد حرّم علينا لِبَاس الْحَرِير وَالذَّهَب وآنية الذَّهَب وَالْفضة
segments.english: They said: and He [has] forbidden for us the wearing of silk and gold, and vessels of gold and silver,

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ من أعظم جمال الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: and that [is] from the greatest beauty of this world.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَمُدَّن عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ
segments.english: And do not extend your eyes toward what We have given [as] enjoyment to groups of them — the splendor of the life of this world — so that We may test them through it.
segments.sahih_international: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.

segments.arabic: وَفِي الحَدِيث البذاذة من الْإِيمَان
segments.english: And in the hadith: "Simplicity in dress [is] from faith."

segments.arabic: وَقد ذمّ الله المسرفين
segments.english: And God [has] condemned the wasteful.

segments.arabic: والسرف كَمَا يكون فِي الطَّعَام وَالشرَاب يكون فِي اللبَاس
segments.english: And excess, just as it occurs in food and drink, [also] occurs in clothing.

segments.arabic: وَفصل النزاع أَن يُقَال
segments.english: And the settling of the dispute [is] to say:

segments.arabic: الْجمال فِي الصُّورَة واللباس والهيأة ثَلَاثَة أَنْوَاع
segments.english: beauty in appearance, clothing, and presentation [is of] three types:

segments.arabic: مِنْهُ مَا يحمد وَمِنْه مَا يذم وَمِنْه مَالا يتَعَلَّق بِهِ مدح وَلَا ذمّ
segments.english: of it [is] what [is] praised, and of it [is] what [is] condemned, and of it [is] what has no praise or blame attached to it.

segments.arabic: فالمحمود مِنْهُ مَا كَانَ
segments.english: So the praised of it [is] what was

headings.arabic: فصل ليس للعبد شيء أنفع من صدقه ربه في جميع أموره مع صدق
headings.english: Section: There [is] nothing more beneficial for the servant than his truthfulness with his Lord in all his affairs, with truthfulness

segments.arabic: لله وأعان على طَاعَة الله وتنفيذ أوامره والاستجابة لَهُ
segments.english: for God, and helped in obeying God and carrying out His commands and responding to Him

segments.arabic: كَمَا كَانَ النَّبِي يتجمّل للوفود
segments.english: just as the Prophet used to beautify [himself] for the delegations

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ نَظِير لِبَاس آلَة الْحَرْب لِلْقِتَالِ ولباس الْحَرِير فِي الْحَرْب وَالْخُيَلَاء فِيهِ
segments.english: And it [is] similar to wearing the armor of war for fighting, and wearing silk in war, and strutting in it

segments.arabic: فَإِن ذَلِك مَحْمُود إِذا تضمّن إعلاء كلمة الله وَنصر دينه وغيظ عدوّه
segments.english: For that [is] praiseworthy when it involves raising the word of God, and supporting His religion, and angering His enemy

segments.arabic: والمذموم مِنْهُ مَا كَانَ للدنيا والرياسة وَالْفَخْر وَالْخُيَلَاء
segments.english: And the blameworthy of it [is] what was for this world, and leadership, and boasting, and strutting

segments.arabic: والتوسل إِلَى الشَّهَوَات وَأَن يكون هُوَ غَايَة العَبْد وأقصى مطلبه
segments.english: and [a] means to desires, and that it be the goal of the servant and the utmost of his pursuit

segments.arabic: فَإِن كثيرا من النُّفُوس لَيْسَ لَهَا همّة فِي سوى ذَلِك
segments.english: For many of the souls have no concern in anything other than that

segments.arabic: وَأما مَالا يحمد وَلَا يذم هُوَ مَا خلا عَن هذَيْن القصدين وتجرّد عَن الوصفين
segments.english: And as for what [is] neither praised nor blamed — it [is] what [is] free from these two intentions and stripped of the two descriptions

segments.arabic: وَالْمَقْصُود أَن هَذَا الحَدِيث الشريف مُشْتَمل على أصلين عظيمين
segments.english: And the point [is] that this noble hadith contains two great foundations

segments.arabic: فأوله معرفَة وَآخره سلوك
segments.english: its beginning [is] knowledge and its end [is] conduct

segments.arabic: فَيعرف الله سُبْحَانَهُ بالجمال الَّذِي لَا يماثله فِيهِ شَيْء
segments.english: So God, glorified [is] He, [is] known by the beauty that nothing resembles Him in

segments.arabic: ويعبد بالجمال الَّذِي يُحِبهُ من الْأَقْوَال والأعمال والأخلاق
segments.english: and [He is] worshipped through the beauty that He loves of speech, and deeds, and character

segments.arabic: فيحب من عَبده أَن يجمل لِسَانه بِالصّدقِ وَقَلبه بالإخلاص والمحبة والإنابة والتوكل
segments.english: So He loves from His servant that he beautify his tongue with truthfulness, and his heart with sincerity, and love, and turning [to God], and reliance [on God]

segments.arabic: وجوارحه بِالطَّاعَةِ وبدنه بِإِظْهَار نعمه عَلَيْهِ فِي لِبَاسه
segments.english: and his limbs with obedience, and his body by showing His blessings upon him in his clothing

segments.arabic: وتطهيره لَهُ من الأنجاس والأحداث والأوساخ والشعور المكروهة والختان وتقليم الْأَظْفَار
segments.english: and purifying it from filth, and impurities, and dirt, and disliked hair, and circumcision, and trimming the nails

segments.arabic: فيعرفه بِصِفَات الجمال ويتعرف إِلَيْهِ بالأفعال والأقوال والأخلاق الجميلة
segments.english: So he knows Him by the attributes of beauty, and draws near to Him through beautiful deeds, and speech, and character

segments.arabic: فيعرفه بالجمال الَّذِي هُوَ وَصفه ويعبده بالجمال الَّذِي هُوَ شَرعه وَدينه
segments.english: So he knows Him by the beauty that [is] His description, and worships Him by the beauty that [is] His law and His religion

segments.arabic: فَجمع الحَدِيث قاعدتين الْمعرفَة والسلوك
segments.english: So the hadith gathered two principles: knowledge and conduct

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ للْعَبد شَيْء أَنْفَع من صدقه ربه فِي جَمِيع أُمُوره مَعَ صدق الْعَزِيمَة
segments.english: There [is] nothing more beneficial for the servant than his truthfulness with his Lord in all his affairs, with truthfulness of resolve

segments.arabic: فيصدقه فِي عزمه وَفِي فعله
segments.english: so he [is] truthful to Him in his resolve and in his action

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said

segments.arabic: فَإِذَا عَزَمَ الْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوا اللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ
segments.english: And when the matter [is] decided, then if they [were] truthful to God, it would [have] been better for them
segments.sahih_international: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them.

segments.arabic: فسعادته فِي صدق الْعَزِيمَة وَصدق الْفِعْل
segments.english: So his happiness [is] in truthfulness of resolve and truthfulness of action

segments.arabic: فَصدق الْعَزِيمَة جمعهَا وجزمها وَعدم التَّرَدُّد فِيهَا
segments.english: And truthfulness of resolve [is] gathering it and being firm in it and not hesitating in it

segments.arabic: بل تكون عَزِيمَة لَا يشوبها تردد وَلَا تلوّم
segments.english: rather, it [is] [a] resolve that no hesitation mixes with and no second-guessing

segments.arabic: فَإِذا صدقت عزيمته بَقِي عَلَيْهِ صدق الْفِعْل
segments.english: And when his resolve [is] truthful, there remains upon him truthfulness of action

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ استفراغ الوسع وبذل الْجهد فِيهِ
segments.english: and that [is] exhausting [one's] capacity and giving [one's] effort in it

segments.arabic: وَأَن لَا يتخلّف عَنهُ بِشَيْء من ظَاهره وباطنه
segments.english: and that nothing of his outward or inward holds back from it

segments.arabic: فعزيمة الْقَصْد تَمنعهُ من ضعف الْإِرَادَة والهمّة
segments.english: So the resolve of intention prevents him from weakness of will and concern

segments.arabic: وَصدق الْفِعْل يمنعهُ من الكسل والفتور
segments.english: and truthfulness of action prevents him from laziness and slackness

segments.arabic: وَمن صدق الله فِي جَمِيع أُمُوره صنع الله لَهُ فَوق مَا يصنع لغيره
segments.english: And whoever [is] truthful with God in all his affairs, God [will] do for him beyond what He does for others

headings.arabic: فصل من أعظم الظلم والجهل أن تطلب التعظيم والتوقير من الناس وقلبك
headings.english: Chapter: Among the greatest injustice and ignorance [is] that you seek glorification and reverence from people while your heart...

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا الصدْق معنى يلتئم من صحّة الْإِخْلَاص وَصدق التوكّل
segments.english: And this truthfulness [is a] meaning that comes together from the soundness of sincerity and the truthfulness of reliance [on God].

segments.arabic: فَأَصدق النَّاس من صحّ إخلاصه وتوكّله
segments.english: So the most truthful of people [is] the one whose sincerity and reliance [on God] [are] sound.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة جليلة فِي الْقدر
segments.english: [A] great benefit regarding divine decree:

segments.arabic: رب ذُو إِرَادَة أَمر عبدا ذَا إِرَادَة
segments.english: [A] Lord possessing will commanded [a] servant possessing will.

segments.arabic: فان وفّقه وَأَرَادَ من نَفسه أَن يُعينهُ ويلهمه فعل مَا أَمر بِهِ
segments.english: So if He grants him success and wills from Himself to help him and inspire him, he does what he was commanded with.

segments.arabic: وَإِن خذله وخلاّه وإرادته وَنَفسه
segments.english: And if He abandons him and leaves him to his [own] will and self —

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ من هَذِه الحثيثة لَا يخْتَار إِلَّا مَا تهواه نَفسه وطبعه
segments.english: and he, from this aspect, does not choose except what his self and his nature desire —

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ من حَيْثُ هُوَ إِنْسَان لَا يُرِيد إِلَّا ذَلِك
segments.english: then he, in so far as he [is a] human being, does not want except that.

segments.arabic: وَلذَلِك ذمّه الله فِي كِتَابه من هَذِه الحثيثة
segments.english: And for that [reason] God blamed him in His Book from this aspect,

segments.arabic: وَلم يمدحه إِلَّا بِأَمْر زَائِد على تِلْكَ الحثيثة
segments.english: and did not praise him except for something additional beyond that aspect,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ كَونه مُسلما ومؤمنا وصابرا ومحسنا وشكورا وتقيا وَبرا وَنَحْو ذَلِك
segments.english: and that [is] his being [a] Muslim, [a] believer, patient, good-doing, grateful, God-conscious, righteous, and the like of that.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا أَمر زَائِد على مجرّد كَونه إنْسَانا
segments.english: And this [is] something additional beyond merely being [a] human being.

segments.arabic: وإرادته صَالِحَة وَلَكِن لَا يَكْفِي مجرّد صلاحيتها إِن لم تؤيد بِقدر زَائِد على ذَلِك وَهُوَ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And his will [is] sound, but the mere soundness of it [is] not enough if it [is] not supported by [a] decree additional to that, and that [is] God's granting of success.

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَنه لَا يَكْفِي فِي الرُّؤْيَة مجرّد صَلَاحِية الْعين للإدراك إِن لم يحصل سَبَب آخر من النُّور الْمُنْفَصِل عَنْهَا
segments.english: Just as it [is] not enough for seeing [that there is] merely the soundness of the eye for perception, if there does not come about another cause — [that is,] the light separate from it.

segments.arabic: فصل
segments.english: Chapter:

segments.arabic: من أعظم الظُّلم وَالْجهل أَن تطلب التَّعْظِيم والتوقير من النَّاس وقلبك خَال من تَعْظِيم الله وتوقيره
segments.english: Among the greatest injustice and ignorance [is] that you seek glorification and reverence from people while your heart [is] empty of glorifying God and revering Him.

segments.arabic: فانك توقّر الْمَخْلُوق وتجلّه أَن يراك فِي حَال
segments.english: For you revere the created being and honor him [so much] that he [would] see you in [a] state —

segments.arabic: لَا توقّر الله أَن يراك عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: [yet] you do not revere God [enough] that He [would] see you upon it.

segments.arabic: مَا لكم لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
segments.english: What [is wrong] with you that you do not attribute to God [due] reverence?
segments.sahih_international: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

segments.arabic: أَي لَا تعاملونه مُعَاملَة من توقّرونه
segments.english: meaning: you do not treat Him [with] the treatment of one you revere.

segments.arabic: والتوقير وَالْعَظَمَة
segments.english: And reverence [is] greatness.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْه قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And from it [is] His saying, Most High:

segments.arabic: وَتُوَقِّرُوه
segments.english: and [that] you revere Him.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْحسن مَا لكم لَا تعرفُون لله حَقًا وَلَا تشكرونه
segments.english: Al-Hasan said: What [is wrong] with you that you do not recognize for God [a] right and you do not thank Him?

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ مُجَاهِد لَا تبالون عَظمَة ربكُم
segments.english: And Mujahid said: You do not care about the greatness of your Lord.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ ابْن زيد لَا ترَوْنَ لله طَاعَة
segments.english: And Ibn Zayd said: You do not see for God [any] obedience [as due].

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ ابْن عَبَّاس لَا تعرفُون حق عَظمته
segments.english: And Ibn Abbas said: You do not recognize the right of His greatness.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه الْأَقْوَال ترجع إِلَى معنى وَاحِد
segments.english: And these sayings all return to one meaning,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أَنهم لَو عظّموا الله وَعرفُوا حق عَظمته وحّدوه وأطاعوه وشكروه
segments.english: and that [is] that if they had glorified God and recognized the right of His greatness, they would have declared His oneness, obeyed Him, and thanked Him.

segments.arabic: فطاعته سُبْحَانَهُ اجْتِنَاب مَعَاصيه وَالْحيَاء مِنْهُ بِحَسب وقاره
segments.english: For obedience to Him, glorified [is] He, [is] avoiding His disobedience and [having] shyness before Him according to His reverence.

segments.arabic: فِي الْقلب
segments.english: in the heart.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا قَالَ بعض السّلف ليعظم وقار الله فِي قلب أحدكُم
segments.english: And for this reason, some of the early generations said: let the reverence of God [be] great in the heart of each of you —

segments.arabic: أَن يذكرهُ عِنْد مَا يستحي من ذكره فيقرن اسْمه بِهِ
segments.english: that he mention Him alongside what he [would be] ashamed to mention, pairing His name with it,

segments.arabic: كَمَا تَقول قبّح الله الْكَلْب وَالْخِنْزِير وَالنَّتن وَنَحْو ذَلِك
segments.english: as [when] you say: 'May God curse the dog, the pig, and the filth,' and things like that.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا من وقار الله
segments.english: So this [is] from the reverence of God.
