segments.arabic: وَمن وقاره أَن لَا تعدل بِهِ شَيْئا من خلقه لَا فِي اللَّفْظ
segments.english: And from His reverence [is] that you do not equate anything from His creation with Him — not in speech,

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ تَقول وَالله وحياتك مَالِي إِلَّا الله وَأَنت وَمَا شَاءَ الله وشئت
segments.english: such that you say: 'By God and by your life,' or 'I have no one but God and you,' or 'What God willed and [what] you willed.'

segments.arabic: وَلَا فِي الْحبّ والتعظيم والإجلال
segments.english: And not in love, glorification, or honor.

segments.arabic: وَلَا فِي الطَّاعَة فتطيع الْمَخْلُوق فِي أمره وَنَهْيه كَمَا تطيع الله بل أعظم
segments.english: And not in obedience — so you obey the created being in his commands and prohibitions as you obey God, or even more,

segments.arabic: كَمَا عَلَيْهِ أَكثر الظلمَة والفجرة
segments.english: as [is the case] with most of the wrongdoers and the wicked.

segments.arabic: وَلَا فِي الْخَوْف والرجاء
segments.english: And not in fear and hope.

segments.arabic: ويجعله أَهْون الناظرين إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And [that] he makes Him the least [important] of those watching him,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يستهين بِحقِّهِ وَيَقُول هُوَ مَبْنِيّ على الْمُسَامحَة
segments.english: and [that] he not take His right lightly and say: 'It [is] built on leniency,'

segments.arabic: وَلَا يَجعله على الفضلة ويقدّم حق الْمَخْلُوق عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and [that] he not place Him as secondary and give the right of the created being priority over Him,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يكون الله وَرَسُوله فِي حد وناحية وَالنَّاس فِي نَاحيَة وحد
segments.english: and [that] God and His Messenger not [be] on one side, and the people on [another] side,

segments.arabic: فَيكون فِي الْحَد والشق الَّذِي فِيهِ النَّاس دون الْحَد والشق الَّذِي فِيهِ الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: so that he [is] on the side and the part where the people [are], rather than the side and the part where God and His Messenger [are].

segments.arabic: وَلَا يُعْطي الخلوق فِي مخاطبته قلبه ولبه
segments.english: And [that] he not give the created being, in addressing him, his heart and his core,

segments.arabic: وَيُعْطِي الله فِي خدمته بدنه وَلسَانه دون قلبه وروحه
segments.english: while giving God in His service [only] his body and his tongue, without his heart and his spirit.

segments.arabic: وَلَا يَجْعَل مُرَاد نَفسه مقدما على مُرَاد ربه
segments.english: And [that] he not make what his self wants take priority over what his Lord wants.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا كُله من عدم وقار الله فِي الْقلب
segments.english: So all of this [is] from [a] lack of reverence of God in the heart.

segments.arabic: وَمن كَانَ كَذَلِك فَإِن الله لَا يلقِي لَهُ فِي قُلُوب النَّاس وقارا وَلَا هَيْبَة
segments.english: And whoever [is] like that, then God [will] not place for him in the hearts of people any reverence or awe,

segments.arabic: بل يسْقط وقاره وهيبته فِي قُلُوبهم
segments.english: rather He [will] cause his reverence and his awe to fall from their hearts.

segments.arabic: وَإِن وقّروه مَخَافَة شرّه فَذَاك وقار بغض لَا وقار حب وتعظيم
segments.english: And if they revere him out of fear of his harm, then that [is] [a] reverence of hatred, not [a] reverence of love and glorification.

segments.arabic: وَمن وقار الله أَن يستحي من اطِّلَاعه على سره وضميره فَيرى فِيهِ مَا يكره
segments.english: And from the reverence of God [is] that he [be] ashamed of His looking into his secret and his inner thoughts, and [God] seeing in it what He dislikes.

segments.arabic: وَمن وقاره أَن يستحي مِنْهُ فِي الْخلْوَة أعظم مِمَّا يستحي من أكَابِر النَّاس
segments.english: And from His reverence [is] that he [be] ashamed before Him in private more than he [is] ashamed before the greatest of people.

segments.arabic: وَالْمَقْصُود أَن من لَا يوقّر الله وَكَلَامه وَمَا آتَاهُ من الْعلم وَالْحكمَة
segments.english: And the point [is] that whoever does not revere God, and His speech, and what He gave him of knowledge and wisdom —

segments.arabic: كَيفَ يطْلب من النَّاس توقيره وتعظيمه
segments.english: how [can] he seek from the people reverence and glorification [for himself]?

segments.arabic: الْقُرْآن وَالْعلم وَكَلَام الرَّسُول صلات من الْحق وتنبيهات وروادع وزواجر وَارِدَة إِلَيْك
segments.english: The Quran, knowledge, and the speech of the Messenger [are] connections from the Truth, and warnings, and restraints, and reprimands coming to you.

segments.arabic: والشيب زاجر ورادع وموقظ قَائِم بك
segments.english: And grey hair [is a] reprimand, and [a] restraint, and [a] wake-up call standing within you.

segments.arabic: فَلَا مَا ورد إِلَيْك وعظك وَلَا مَا قَامَ بك نصحك
segments.english: So neither what came to you [has] advised you, nor what stood within you [has] counseled you.

segments.arabic: وَمَعَ هَذَا تطلب التوقير والتعظيم من غَيْرك
segments.english: And despite this, you seek reverence and glorification from others!

segments.arabic: فَأَنت كمصاب لم تؤثّر فِيهِ مُصِيبَة وعظا وانزجارا
segments.english: So you [are] like one struck [by calamity] whom [a] calamity did not affect [with] admonition or restraint,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ يطْلب من غَيره أَن يتّعظ وينزجر بِالنّظرِ إِلَى مصابه
segments.english: yet he seeks from others that they take heed and [be] restrained by looking at his calamity.

segments.arabic: فالضرب لم يُؤثر فِيهِ زجرا وَهُوَ يُرِيد الانزجار مِمَّن نظر إِلَى ضربه من سمع بالمثلات والعقوبات
segments.english: So the beating did not produce in him [any] restraint, yet he wants restraint from whoever looked at his beating — from [those who merely] heard of punishments and penalties.

segments.arabic: والآيات فِي حق غَيره
segments.english: and the signs regarding other than him.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ الله كمن رَآهَا عيَانًا فِي غَيره
segments.english: And — by God — [he is] not like the one who saw them with his own eyes in other than himself.

segments.arabic: فَكيف بِمن وجدهَا فِي نَفسه
segments.english: So how about the one who found them in himself?

segments.arabic: سَنُرِيهِمْ آيَاتِنَا فِي الْآفَاقِ وَفِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ
segments.english: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and in themselves.
segments.sahih_international: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?

segments.arabic: فآياته فِي الْآفَاق مسموعة مَعْلُومَة
segments.english: So His signs in the horizons [are] heard [and] known,

segments.arabic: وآياته فِي النَّفس مَشْهُودَة مرئيّة
segments.english: and His signs in the self [are] witnessed [and] seen.

segments.arabic: فعياذا بِاللَّه من الخذلان
segments.english: So [we seek] refuge in God from abandonment!

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: إِن الَّذِينَ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ كلمة رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
segments.english: Indeed, those upon whom the word of your Lord has been justified — they [will] not believe,
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, those upon whom the word of your Lord has come into effect will not believe,

segments.arabic: وَلَوْ جَاءَتْهُمْ كُلُّ آيَةٍ حَتَّى يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ
segments.english: even if every sign came to them, until they see the painful punishment.
segments.sahih_international: Even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: وَلَو أننا أنزلنَا إِلَيْهِمُ الْمَلائِكَةَ وَكَلَّمَهُمُ الْمَوْتَى وَحَشَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ قُبُلًا
segments.english: And if We had sent down to them the angels, and the dead spoke to them, and We gathered before them everything face to face,
segments.sahih_international: And even if We had sent down to them the angels [with the message] and the dead spoke to them [of it] and We gathered together every [created] thing in front of them, they would not believe unless Allah should will. But most of them, [of that], are ignorant.

segments.arabic: مَا كَانُوا لِيُؤْمِنُوا إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ
segments.english: they would not have believed — unless God willed.

segments.arabic: والعاقل الْمُؤَيد بالتوفيق يعْتَبر بِدُونِ هَذَا
segments.english: And the wise one, supported with [divine] success, takes [a] lesson from less than this,

segments.arabic: وَيتم نقائص خلقته بفضائل أخلاقه وأعماله
segments.english: and completes the deficiencies of his creation with the virtues of his character and deeds.

segments.arabic: فَكلما امتحى من جثمانه أثر زَاد إيمَانه
segments.english: So whenever [a] trace [was] erased from his body, his faith increased,

segments.arabic: وَكلما نقص من قوى بدنه زَاد فِي قُوَّة إيمَانه ويقينه ورغبته فِي الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة
segments.english: and whenever his bodily strength decreased, [it] increased in the strength of his faith, his certainty, and his longing for God and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم يكن هَكَذَا فالموت خير لَهُ
segments.english: And if [he] was not like this, then death [is] better for him,

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ يقف بِهِ على حد معِين من الْأَلَم وَالْفساد
segments.english: because it stops him at [a] set limit of pain and corruption,

segments.arabic: بِخِلَاف الْعُيُوب والنقائص مَعَ طول الْعُمر
segments.english: unlike faults and deficiencies with [a] long life,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا زِيَادَة فِي ألمه وهمّه وغمّه وحسرته
segments.english: for they [are] an increase in his pain, his worry, his grief, and his regret.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا حسن طول الْعُمر ونفع ليحصل التذكّر والاستدراك واغتنام الْغَرَض وَالتَّوْبَة النصوح
segments.english: And [a] long life [is] only good and beneficial so that remembering, making amends, seizing the opportunity, and sincere repentance may happen,

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: as [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: أولم نعمّركم مَا يتذكّر فِيهِ من تذكّر
segments.english: Did We not give you [a] life long enough for whoever would remember to remember in it?
segments.sahih_international: And they will cry out therein, "Our Lord, remove us; we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" But did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? So taste [the punishment], for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper.

segments.arabic: فَمن لم يورثه التَّعْمِير وَطول الْبَقَاء إصْلَاح معائبه وتدارك فارطه واغتنام بقيّة أنفاسه
segments.english: So whoever [was] not led by long life and length of remaining to fix his faults, make up for what he missed, and seize the rest of his breaths,

segments.arabic: فَيعْمل على حَيَاة قلبه وَحُصُول النَّعيم الْمُقِيم
segments.english: working for the life of his heart and the gaining of lasting bliss —

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا فَلَا خير لَهُ فِي حَيَاته
segments.english: then [there is] no good for him in his life.

segments.arabic: فَإِن العَبْد على جنَاح سفر
segments.english: For the servant [is] on the wing of [a] journey —

segments.arabic: إِمَّا إِلَى الْجنَّة وَإِمَّا إِلَى النَّار
segments.english: either to Paradise or to the Fire.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا طَال عمره وَحسن عمله كَانَ طول سَفَره زِيَادَة لَهُ فِي حُصُول النَّعيم واللذة
segments.english: So if his life [was] long and his deeds [were] good, then the length of his journey [was] an increase for him in gaining bliss and pleasure.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ كلما طَال السّفر أَيهَا كَانَت الصبابة أجلّ وَأفضل
segments.english: For whenever the journey [was] longer, the longing [was] greater and finer.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا طَال عمره وساء عمله كَانَ طول سَفَره زِيَادَة فِي ألمه وعذابه
segments.english: And if his life [was] long and his deeds [were] bad, then the length of his journey [was] an increase in his pain and punishment,

segments.arabic: ونزولا لَهُ إِلَى أَسْفَل
segments.english: and [a] descent for him to [a] lower [place].

segments.arabic: فالمسافر إِمَّا صاعد وَإِمَّا نَازل
segments.english: So the traveler [is] either ascending or descending.

segments.arabic: وَفِي الحَدِيث الْمَرْفُوع
segments.english: And in the raised hadith:

segments.arabic: خَيركُمْ من طَال عمره وَحسن عمله
segments.english: "The best of you [is] the one whose life [is] long and whose deeds [are] good,

segments.arabic: وشرّكم من طَال عمره وقبيح عمله
segments.english: and the worst of you [is] the one whose life [is] long and whose deeds [are] ugly."

segments.arabic: فالطالب الصَّادِق فِي طلبه كَمَا خرب شَيْء من ذَاته جعله عمَارَة لِقَلْبِهِ وروحه
segments.english: So the sincere seeker in his seeking — whenever something of his self [was] ruined, he made it [a] building up of his heart and spirit.

segments.arabic: وَكلما نقص شَيْء من دُنْيَاهُ جعله زِيَادَة فِي آخرته
segments.english: And whenever something decreased from this world of his, he made it an increase in his Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَكلما منع شَيْئا من لذّات دُنْيَاهُ جعله زِيَادَة فِي لذّات آخرته
segments.english: And whenever he [was] denied something of the pleasures of this world, he made it an increase in the pleasures of his Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَكلما ناله هم أَو حزن أَو غم جعله فِي أفراح آخرته
segments.english: And whenever worry, sadness, or grief reached him, he placed it among the joys of his Hereafter.

headings.arabic: فائدة طالب النفوذ إلى الله والدار الآخرة بل وإلى كل علم وصناعة
headings.english: Benefit: The Seeker of Passage to God and the Hereafter — Rather, to Every Knowledge and Craft

segments.arabic: كل الحذر من قصد النَّاس لَك وإقبالهم عَلَيْك
segments.english: [Be on] complete guard against people turning to you and their approaching you

segments.arabic: وَأَن يعثروا على مَوضِع غرضك فَإِنَّهَا الآفة الْعُظْمَى
segments.english: and [against] them discovering the place of your purpose, for it [is] the greatest affliction.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة: كل ذِي لب يعلم أَنه لَا طَرِيق للشَّيْطَان عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا من ثَلَاث جِهَات
segments.english: Benefit: Every person of understanding knows that there [is] no path for Satan over him except from three directions.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا التزيّد والإسراف فيزيد على قدر الْحَاجة فَتَصِير فضلَة
segments.english: The first of them [is] excess and extravagance — so [one] increases beyond the measure of need, and it becomes [a] surplus,

segments.arabic: وَهِي حَظّ الشَّيْطَان ومدخله إِلَى الْقلب
segments.english: and it [is] the share of Satan and his entry point to the heart.

segments.arabic: وَطَرِيق الِاحْتِرَاز من إِعْطَاء النَّفس تَمام مطلوبها من غذَاء أَو نوم أَو لَذَّة أَو رَاحَة
segments.english: And the way of caution [is to refrain] from giving the self all of what it seeks of food, or sleep, or pleasure, or rest.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى أغلقت هَذَا الْبَاب حصل الْأمان من دُخُول الْعَدو مِنْهُ
segments.english: So whenever you close this door, safety from the enemy entering through it [is] achieved.

segments.arabic: الثَّانِيَة الْغَفْلَة فَإِن الذاكر فِي حصن الذّكر
segments.english: The second [is] heedlessness, for the one who remembers [is] in [a] fortress of remembrance.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى غفل فتح بَاب الْحصن فولجه الْعَدو فيعسر عَلَيْهِ أَو يصعب إِخْرَاجه
segments.english: So whenever he becomes heedless, the door of the fortress [is] opened, and the enemy enters it, and it becomes hard for him — or difficult — to drive him out.

segments.arabic: الثَّالِثَة تكلّف مَالا يعنيه من جَمِيع الْأَشْيَاء
segments.english: The third [is] burdening oneself with what does not concern him of all things.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة: طَالب النّفُوذ إِلَى الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة بل وَإِلَى كل علم وصناعة
segments.english: Benefit: The seeker of passage to God and the Hereafter — rather, [even] to every knowledge and craft

segments.arabic: ورئاسة بِحَيْثُ يكون رَأْسا فِي ذَلِك مقتدى بِهِ فِيهِ
segments.english: and leadership, such that he becomes [a] leader in that, followed in it —

segments.arabic: يحْتَاج أَن يكون شجاعا مقداما حَاكما على وهمه
segments.english: [he] needs to be brave, bold, ruling over his doubts,

segments.arabic: غير مقهور تَحت سُلْطَان تخيّله
segments.english: not overcome under the power of his imagination,

segments.arabic: زاهدا فِي كل مَا سوى مَطْلُوبه عَاشِقًا لما توجه إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: detached from everything other than his goal, passionately devoted to what he has turned toward,

segments.arabic: عَارِفًا بطرِيق الْوُصُول إِلَيْهِ والطرق القواطع عَنهُ
segments.english: knowing the path of reaching it and the paths that cut [one] off from it,

segments.arabic: مِقْدَام الهمة ثَابت الجأش لَا يثنيه عَن مَطْلُوبه لوم لائم وَلَا عذل عاذل
segments.english: bold in ambition, firm in resolve — the blame of [a] blamer does not turn him from his goal, nor the reproach of [a] reproacher,

segments.arabic: كثير السّكُون دَائِم الْفِكر
segments.english: much in stillness, constant in thought,

segments.arabic: غير مائل مَعَ لَذَّة الْمَدْح وَلَا ألم الذَّم
segments.english: not leaning with the pleasure of praise nor the pain of blame,

segments.arabic: قَائِما بِمَا يحْتَاج إِلَيْهِ من أَسبَاب معونته لَا تستفزه المعارضات
segments.english: standing by what he needs of the means of his support — obstacles do not shake him,

segments.arabic: شعاره الصَّبْر وراحته التَّعَب
segments.english: his motto [is] patience and his rest [is] hard work,

segments.arabic: محبا لمكارم الْأَخْلَاق حَافِظًا لوقته
segments.english: loving noble character, guarding his time,

segments.arabic: لَا يخالط النَّاس إِلَّا على حذر كالطائر الَّذِي يلتقط الْحبّ بَينهم
segments.english: not mixing with people except with caution, like [a] bird that picks up seeds among them,

segments.arabic: قَائِما على نَفسه بالرغبة والرهبة
segments.english: standing over himself with hope and fear,

segments.arabic: طامعا فِي نتائج الِاخْتِصَاص على بني جنسه
segments.english: aspiring to the fruits of distinction over his fellow kind,

segments.arabic: غير مُرْسل شَيْئا من حواسه عَبَثا وَلَا مسرحا
segments.english: not releasing any of his senses without purpose, nor letting [them] wander.

headings.arabic: فائدة
headings.english: A Benefit

headings.arabic: فصل
headings.english: Section

headings.arabic: فصل اللذة المحرمة ممزوجة بالقبح حال تناولها مثمرة للألم بعد انقضائها
headings.english: Section: The Forbidden Pleasure [is] Mixed with Ugliness at the Time of Taking It, [and] Produces Pain after Its End

segments.arabic: خواطره فِي مَرَاتِب الْكَوْن
segments.english: his thoughts in the ranks of existence.

segments.arabic: وملاك ذَلِك هجر العوائد وَقطع العلائق الحائلة بَيْنك وَبَين الْمَطْلُوب
segments.english: And the key to that [is] abandoning habits and cutting the ties standing between you and what [is] sought.

segments.arabic: وَعند الْعَوام أَن لُزُوم الْأَدَب مَعَ الْحجاب خير من إطراح الْأَدَب مَعَ الْكَشْف
segments.english: And according to the common people, holding to good manners with [the] veil [is] better than dropping good manners with [the] unveiling.

segments.arabic: من الذَّاكِرِينَ من يبتديء بِذكر اللِّسَان وَإِن كَانَ على غَفلَة
segments.english: Among those who remember [God are] those who begin with remembrance of the tongue, even if [they are] in heedlessness.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ لَا يزَال فِيهِ حَتَّى يحضر قلبه فيتواطئا على الذّكر
segments.english: Then [they] keep at it until their heart becomes present, and the two agree upon the remembrance.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من لَا يرى ذَلِك وَلَا يبتدىء على غَفلَة
segments.english: And among them [are] those who do not see that [as right] and do not begin in heedlessness.

segments.arabic: بل يسكن حَتَّى يحضر قلبه فيشرع فِي الذّكر بِقَلْبِه
segments.english: Rather, [they] become still until their heart becomes present, then [they] begin the remembrance with their heart.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا قوي استتبع لِسَانه فتواطئا جَمِيعًا
segments.english: And when it grows strong, it draws the tongue along, and the two agree together.

segments.arabic: فَالْأول ينْتَقل الذّكر من لِسَانه إِلَى قلبه
segments.english: So the first — the remembrance moves from his tongue to his heart.

segments.arabic: وَالثَّانِي ينْتَقل من قلبه إِلَى لِسَانه
segments.english: And the second — [it] moves from his heart to his tongue,

segments.arabic: من غير أَن يَخْلُو قلبه مِنْهُ
segments.english: without his heart being empty of it.

segments.arabic: بل يسكن أَولا حَتَّى يحس بِظُهُور النَّاطِق فِيهِ
segments.english: Rather, he becomes still first until he senses the appearance of the speaker within him.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أحس بذلك نطق قلبه
segments.english: And when he senses that, his heart speaks.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ انْتقل النُّطْق القلبي إِلَى الذّكر اللساني
segments.english: Then the speech of the heart moves to the remembrance of the tongue.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ يسْتَغْرق فِي ذَلِك حَتَّى يجد كل شَيْء مِنْهُ ذَاكِرًا
segments.english: Then he becomes absorbed in that until he finds every part of him remembering.

segments.arabic: وَأفضل الذّكر وأنفعه مَا واطأ فِيهِ الْقلب اللِّسَان
segments.english: And the best remembrance and the most beneficial [is] that in which the heart agrees with the tongue,

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ من الْأَذْكَار النَّبَوِيَّة وَشهد الذاكر مَعَانِيه ومقاصده
segments.english: and [it] was from the Prophetic remembrances, and the one remembering witnessed its meanings and purposes.

segments.arabic: أَنْفَع النَّاس لَك رجل مكّنك من نَفسه حَتَّى تزرع فِيهِ خيرا
segments.english: The most beneficial of people to you [is] a man [who] gave you access to himself so that you plant good in him,

segments.arabic: أَو تصنع إِلَيْهِ مَعْرُوفا
segments.english: or do [a] kindness to him.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ نعم العون لَك على منفعتك وكمالك
segments.english: For he [is] the best helper for you toward your benefit and your completeness.

segments.arabic: فانتفاعك بِهِ فِي الْحَقِيقَة مثل انتفاعه بك أَو أَكثر
segments.english: So your benefit from him in reality [is] like his benefit from you, or more.

segments.arabic: وأضر النَّاس عَلَيْك من مكّن نَفسه مِنْك حَتَّى تَعْصِي الله فِيهِ
segments.english: And the most harmful of people to you [is] whoever gained power over you so that you disobey God through him.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ عون لَك على مضرّتك ونقصك
segments.english: For he [is] [a] helper for you toward your harm and your deficiency.

segments.arabic: اللَّذَّة المحرّمة ممزوجة بالقبح حَال تنَاولهَا
segments.english: The forbidden pleasure [is] mixed with ugliness at the time of taking it,

segments.arabic: مثمرة للألم بعد انْقِضَائِهَا
segments.english: [and is] producing pain after its end.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اشتدّت الداعية مِنْك إِلَيْهَا ففكر فِي انقطاعها وَبَقَاء قبحها وألمها
segments.english: So when the urge within you toward it grows strong, then reflect on its passing and the remaining of its ugliness and its pain.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ وازن بَين الْأَمريْنِ
segments.english: Then weigh between the two matters.

headings.arabic: فصل لله على العبد في كل عضو من أعضائه أمر وله عليه فيه نهي وله فيه نعمة وله به منفعة ولذة
headings.english: Section: God has upon the servant in every limb of his limbs [a] command, and He has upon him regarding it [a] prohibition, and He has in it [a] blessing, and he has through it benefit and pleasure

headings.arabic: فصل أقام الله سبحانه هذا الخلق بين الأمر والنهي والعطاء والمنع
headings.english: Section: God, glorified [is] He, established this creation between command and prohibition, and giving and withholding

segments.arabic: وَانْظُر مَا بَينهمَا من التَّفَاوُت
segments.english: And look at what [is] between them of difference.

segments.arabic: والتعب بِالطَّاعَةِ ممزوج بالْحسنِ مثمر للذة والراحة
segments.english: And the tiredness from obedience [is] mixed with goodness, producing pleasure and rest.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا ثقلت على النَّفس ففكر فِي انْقِطَاع تعبها وَبَقَاء حسنها ولذتها وسرورها
segments.english: So if it weighs heavy on the self, then think about the end of its tiredness and the lasting of its goodness, its pleasure, and its joy.

segments.arabic: ووازن بَين الْأَمريْنِ وآثر الرَّاجِح على الْمَرْجُوح
segments.english: And weigh between the two matters, and prefer the stronger over the weaker.

segments.arabic: فَإِن تألّمت بِالسَّبَبِ فَانْظُر إِلَى مَا فِي الْمُسَبّب من الفرحة وَالسُّرُور واللذة
segments.english: So if you feel pain from the cause, then look at what [is] in the result of happiness, joy, and pleasure —

segments.arabic: يهن عَلَيْك مقاساته
segments.english: [and] its hardship [will] become easy for you.

segments.arabic: وَإِن تألمت بترك اللَّذَّة الْمُحرمَة فَانْظُر إِلَى الْأَلَم الَّذِي يعقبه
segments.english: And if you feel pain from leaving the forbidden pleasure, then look at the pain that follows it.

segments.arabic: ووازن بَين الألمين
segments.english: And weigh between the two pains.

segments.arabic: وخاصيّة الْعقل تَحْصِيل أعظم المنفعتين بتفويت أدناهما
segments.english: And the special quality of the mind [is] gaining the greater of the two benefits by letting go of the lesser of them,

segments.arabic: وَاحْتِمَال أَصْغَر الألمين لدفع أعلاهما
segments.english: and bearing the smaller of the two pains to push away the greater of them.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يحْتَاج إِلَى علم بالأسباب ومقتضياتها
segments.english: And this needs knowledge of the causes and what they lead to,

segments.arabic: وَإِلَى عقل يخْتَار بِهِ الأولى
segments.english: and [a] mind with which [one] chooses what [is] better,

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا نفع بِهِ لَهُ مِنْهَا
segments.english: otherwise [there is] no benefit for him from them.

segments.arabic: فَمن وفّر قسمه من الْعقل وَالْعلم اخْتَارَ الْأَفْضَل وآثره
segments.english: So whoever was given his full share of mind and knowledge chose the best and preferred it.

segments.arabic: وَمن نقص حَظه مِنْهُمَا أَو من أَحدهمَا اخْتَار خِلَافه
segments.english: And whoever had less of his share of them — or of one of them — chose the opposite.

segments.arabic: وَمن فكّر فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة علم أَنه لَا ينَال وَاحِدًا مِنْهُمَا إِلَّا بمشّقة
segments.english: And whoever thought about this world and the Hereafter knew that he [will] not reach either of them except with hardship.

segments.arabic: فليتحمّل المشقّة لخيرهما وأبقاهما
segments.english: So let him bear the hardship for the better and more lasting of them.

segments.arabic: لله على العَبْد فِي كل عُضْو من أَعْضَائِهِ أَمر
segments.english: God has upon the servant in every limb of his limbs [a] command,

segments.arabic: وَله عَلَيْهِ فِيهِ نهي وَله فِيهِ نعْمَة
segments.english: and He has upon him regarding it [a] prohibition, and He has in it [a] blessing,

segments.arabic: وَله بِهِ مَنْفَعَة وَلَذَّة
segments.english: and he has through it benefit and pleasure.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قَامَ لله فِي ذَلِك الْعُضْو بأَمْره واجتنب فِيهِ نَهْيه
segments.english: So if he stands for God in that limb [by fulfilling] His command and avoids in it His prohibition,

segments.arabic: فقد أدّى شكر نعْمَته عَلَيْهِ فِيهِ
segments.english: then he has fulfilled the gratitude for His blessing upon him in it,

segments.arabic: وسعى فِي تَكْمِيل انتفاعه ولذته بِهِ
segments.english: and strived to complete his benefit and pleasure through it.

segments.arabic: وَإِن عطّل أَمر الله وَنَهْيه فِيهِ
segments.english: And if he neglected God's command and His prohibition in it,

segments.arabic: عطّله الله من انتفاعه بذلك الْعُضْو
segments.english: God [will] deprive him of his benefit from that limb,

segments.arabic: وَجعله من أكبر أَسبَاب ألمه ومضرّته
segments.english: and make it one of the greatest causes of his pain and harm.

segments.arabic: وَله عَلَيْهِ فِي كل وَقت من أوقاته عبوديّة تقدمه إِلَيْهِ تقربه مِنْهُ
segments.english: And He has upon him in every moment of his moments [a] servitude that advances him toward Him [and] brings him closer to Him.

segments.arabic: فَإِن شغل وقته بعبودية الْوَقْت تقدم إِلَى ربه
segments.english: So if he fills his time with the servitude of the moment, he advances toward his Lord.

segments.arabic: وَإِن شغله بهوى أرواحه وبطالة تأخّر
segments.english: And if he fills it with desire, or comfort, and idleness, he falls behind.

segments.arabic: فَالْعَبْد لَا يزَال فِي التَّقَدُّم أَو تأخّر وَلَا وقُوف فِي الطَّرِيق البتّة
segments.english: So the servant never stops [being] in advancement or falling behind, and [there is] no standing still on the path at all.

segments.arabic: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
segments.english: for whoever among you wills to advance or fall behind.
segments.sahih_international: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.

segments.arabic: أَقَامَ الله سُبْحَانَهُ هَذَا الْخلق بَين الْأَمر وَالنَّهْي وَالعطَاء وَالْمَنْع
segments.english: God, glorified [is] He, established this creation between command and prohibition, and giving and withholding.

segments.arabic: فافترقوا فرْقَتَيْن
segments.english: So they split into two groups:

segments.arabic: فرقة قابلت أمره بِالتّرْكِ وَنَهْيه بالارتكاب
segments.english: [a] group [that] met His command with abandonment and His prohibition with committing [it],

segments.arabic: وعطاءه بالغفلة عَن الشُّكْر وَمنعه
segments.english: and His giving with heedlessness from gratitude, and His withholding —

headings.arabic: فصل التوحيد أصلف شيء وأنزهه وأنظفه وأصفاه فأدنى شيء يخدشه ويدنسه
headings.english: Chapter: Monotheism [is] the most delicate thing, the purest, the cleanest, and the clearest — so the slightest thing scratches it and stains it

segments.arabic: بالسخط وَهَؤُلَاء أعداؤه وَفِيهِمْ من الْعَدَاوَة بِحَسب مَا فيهم من ذَلِك
segments.english: with displeasure. And these [are] His enemies, and in them [is] enmity according to what [is] in them of that.

segments.arabic: وَقسم قَالُوا إِنَّمَا نَحن عبيدك
segments.english: And [a] group said: 'We [are] only your servants.

segments.arabic: فَإِن أمرتنا سارعنا إِلَى الْإِجَابَة وَإِن نَهَيْتنَا أمسكنا نفوسنا وكففناها عمّا نَهَيْتنَا عَنهُ
segments.english: If you command us, we hasten to respond. And if you forbid us, we hold back ourselves and restrain them from what you forbade us from.

segments.arabic: وَإِن أَعطيتنَا حمدناك وشكرناك وان منعتنا تضرّعنا إِلَيْك وَذَكَرْنَاك
segments.english: And if you give us, we praise you and thank you. And if you withhold from us, we humbly turn to you and remember you.'

segments.arabic: فَلَيْسَ بَين هَؤُلَاءِ وَبَين الْجنَّة إِلَّا ستر الْحَيَاة الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: So there [is] nothing between these [people] and Paradise except the veil of the life of this world.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا مزقه عَلَيْهِم الْمَوْت صَارُوا إِلَى النَّعيم الْمُقِيم وقرة الْأَعْين
segments.english: So when death tears it away from them, they arrive at lasting bliss and delight of the eyes.

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن أُولَئِكَ لَيْسَ بَينهم وَبَين النَّار إِلَّا ستر الْحَيَاة
segments.english: Just as those [others] — there [is] nothing between them and the Fire except the veil of life.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا مزّقه الْمَوْت صَارُوا إِلَى الْحَسْرَة والألم
segments.english: So when death tears it, they arrive at regret and pain.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا تصادمت جيوش الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة فِي قَلْبك
segments.english: So when the armies of this world and the Hereafter clash in your heart,

segments.arabic: وَأَرَدْت أَن تعلم من أَي الْفَرِيقَيْنِ أَنْت
segments.english: and you want to know from which of the two groups you [are],

segments.arabic: فَانْظُر مَعَ من تميل مِنْهُمَا وَمَعَ من تقَاتل
segments.english: then look: with which of them do you side, and with which do you fight?

segments.arabic: إِذْ لَا يمكنك الْوُقُوف بَين الجيشين فَأَنت مَعَ أَحدهمَا لَا محَالة
segments.english: Since it [is] not possible for you to stand between the two armies — so you [are] with one of them, without doubt.

segments.arabic: فالفريق الأول استغشوا الْهوى فخالفوه
segments.english: The first group suspected desire, so they opposed it.

segments.arabic: واستنصحوا الْعقل فشاوروه
segments.english: And they sought sincere advice from reason, so they consulted it.

segments.arabic: وفرّغوا قُلُوبهم للفكر فِيمَا خلقُوا لَهُ
segments.english: And they freed their hearts to reflect on what they were created for.

segments.arabic: وجوارحهم للْعَمَل بِمَا أمروا بِهِ
segments.english: And [they freed] their limbs to act upon what they were commanded with.

segments.arabic: وأوقاتهم لعمارتها بِمَا يعمر مَنَازِلهمْ فِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: And [they freed] their times to fill them with what builds their stations in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: واستظهروا على سرعَة الْأَجَل بالمبادرة إِلَى الْأَعْمَال
segments.english: And they prepared against the swiftness of death by rushing to [good] deeds.

segments.arabic: وَسَكنُوا الدُّنْيَا وَقُلُوبهمْ مسافرة عَنْهَا
segments.english: And they lived in this world while their hearts were traveling away from it.

segments.arabic: واستوطنوا الْآخِرَة قبل انتقالهم إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: And they settled in the Hereafter before their departure to it.

segments.arabic: واهتموا بِاللَّه وطاعته على قدر حَاجتهم إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And they concerned themselves with God and His obedience according to their need of Him.

segments.arabic: وتزودوا للآخرة على قدر مقامهم فِيهَا
segments.english: And they took provision for the Hereafter according to their stay in it.

segments.arabic: فَعجل لَهُم سُبْحَانَهُ من نعيم الْجنَّة وروحها
segments.english: So He — glorified [is] He — hastened for them from the bliss of Paradise and its comfort:

segments.arabic: أَن آنسهم بِنَفسِهِ وَأَقْبل بقلوبهم إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: that He gave them closeness with Himself, and turned their hearts toward Him,

segments.arabic: وَجَمعهَا على محبته وشوقهم إِلَى لِقَائِه
segments.english: and gathered them upon His love, and made them long for meeting Him,

segments.arabic: ونعمهم بِقُرْبِهِ وَفرغ قُلُوبهم مِمَّا مَلأ قُلُوب غَيرهم
segments.english: and blessed them with His closeness, and freed their hearts from what filled the hearts of others —

segments.arabic: من محبَّة الدُّنْيَا والهم والحزن على فَوتهَا وَالْغَم من خوف ذهابها
segments.english: of love of this world, and worry and sadness over missing it, and distress from fear of its loss.

segments.arabic: فاستلانوا مَا استوعره المترفون
segments.english: So they found soft what the comfortable [ones] found rough.

segments.arabic: وأنسوا بِمَا استوحش مِنْهُ الجاهلون
segments.english: And they found comfort in what the ignorant found frightening.

segments.arabic: صحبوا الدُّنْيَا بأبدانهم وَالْمَلَأ الْأَعْلَى بأرواحهم
segments.english: They accompanied this world with their bodies, and the Highest Assembly with their souls.

segments.arabic: التَّوْحِيد أصلف شَيْء وأنزهه وأنظفه وأصفاه
segments.english: Monotheism [is] the most delicate thing, the purest, the cleanest, and the clearest.

segments.arabic: فأدنى شَيْء يخدشه ويدنّسه ويؤثّر فِيهِ
segments.english: So the slightest thing scratches it, stains it, and affects it.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ كأبيض ثوب يكون يؤثّر فِيهِ أدنى أثر
segments.english: For it [is] like the whitest garment — the slightest mark affects it.

segments.arabic: وكالمرآة الصافية جدا أدنى شَيْء يُؤثر فِيهَا
segments.english: And like [a] very clear mirror — the slightest thing affects it.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا تشوشه اللحظة واللفظة والشهوة الْخفية
segments.english: And for this reason, [a] glance disturbs it, and [a] word, and [a] hidden desire.

segments.arabic: فَإِن بَادر صَاحبه
segments.english: So if its companion hastens —

headings.arabic: فائدة ترك الشهوات لله وإن أنجى من عذاب الله وأوجب الفوز برحمته
headings.english: [A] Benefit: Leaving desires for God, even though [it] saves from the punishment of God and earns the winning of His mercy

segments.arabic: وَقلع ذَلِك الْأَثر بضده وَإِلَّا استحكم وَصَارَ طبعا يتعسّر عَلَيْهِ قلعه
segments.english: and uprooting that trace with its opposite — otherwise it [will] take hold and become [a] nature [that is] difficult for him to uproot.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه الْآثَار والطبوع الَّتِي تحصل فِيهِ مِنْهَا مَا يكون سريع الْحُصُول سريع الزَّوَال
segments.english: And these traces and natures that occur in it — some of them [are] quick to come [and] quick to go,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا مَا يكون سريع الْحُصُول بطيء الزَّوَال
segments.english: and some of them [are] quick to come [and] slow to go,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا مَا يكون بطيء الْحُصُول سريع الزَّوَال
segments.english: and some of them [are] slow to come [and] quick to go,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا مَا يكون بطيء الْحُصُول بطيء الزَّوَال
segments.english: and some of them [are] slow to come [and] slow to go.

segments.arabic: وَلَكِن من النَّاس من يكون توحيده كَبِيرا عَظِيما ينغمر فِيهِ كثير من تِلْكَ الْآثَار ويستحيل فِيهِ
segments.english: But among people [there are] those whose monotheism [is] great [and] mighty — many of those traces [are] drowned in it and dissolved in it,

segments.arabic: بِمَنْزِلَة المَاء الْكثير الَّذِي يخالطه أدنى نَجَاسَة أَو وسخ
segments.english: like abundant water that [is] mixed with the slightest filth or dirt.

segments.arabic: فيغتر بِهِ صَاحب التَّوْحِيد الَّذِي هُوَ دونه
segments.english: So the person of monotheism who [is] below him [is] deceived by that,

segments.arabic: فيخلط توحيده الضَّعِيف بِمَا خلط بِهِ صَاحب التَّوْحِيد الْعَظِيم الْكثير توحيده
segments.english: and [he] mixes his weak monotheism with what the person of great [and] abundant monotheism mixed with.

segments.arabic: فَيظْهر تَأْثِيره فِيهِ مَا لم يظْهر فِي التَّوْحِيد الْكثير
segments.english: So its effect appears in it in [a way] that [did] not appear in the abundant monotheism.

segments.arabic: وَأَيْضًا فان الْمحل الصافي جدا يظْهر لصَاحبه مِمَّا يدنسه مَالا يظْهر فِي الْمحل الَّذِي لم يبلغ فِي الصفاء مبلغه
segments.english: And also, the very pure place — there appears to its owner from what stains it what does not appear in the place that has not reached its level of purity.

segments.arabic: فيتداركه بالإزالة دون هَذَا فَإِنَّهُ لَا يشْعر بِهِ
segments.english: So [he] catches it by removing [it], unlike this [other] one, for he does not feel it.

segments.arabic: وَأَيْضًا فَإِن قُوَّة الْإِيمَان والتوحيد إِذا كَانَت قَوِيَّة جدا أحالت الْموَاد الرَّديئَة وقهرتها
segments.english: And also, the strength of faith and monotheism, when it [is] very strong, [it] transforms the bad substances and overpowers them,

segments.arabic: بِخِلَاف الْقُوَّة الضعيفة
segments.english: unlike the weak strength.

segments.arabic: وَأَيْضًا فَإِن صَاحب المحاسن الْكَثِيرَة والغامرة للسيئات ليسامح بِمَا لَا يسامح بِهِ من أَتَى مثل تِلْكَ السَّيِّئَات وَلَيْسَت لَهُ مثل تِلْكَ المحاسن
segments.english: And also, the person of many good deeds that overwhelm [his] bad deeds — [he] [is] forgiven for what [is] not forgiven for the one who committed the same bad deeds but does not have the same good deeds.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قيل
segments.english: As it [was] said:

segments.arabic: وَإِذا الحبيب أَتَى بذنب وَاحِد ... جَاءَت محاسنه بِأَلف شَفِيع
segments.english: And when the beloved comes with [a] single sin, his good qualities come with [a] thousand intercessors.

segments.arabic: وَأَيْضًا فَإِن صدق الطّلب وَقُوَّة الْإِرَادَة وَكَمَال الانقياد يحِيل تِلْكَ الْعَوَارِض والغواشي الغريبة إِلَى مُقْتَضَاهُ وموجبه
segments.english: And also, the truthfulness of seeking, the strength of will, and the completeness of submission — [they] transform those foreign symptoms and coverings to what [they] require and demand,

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن الْكَذِب وَفَسَاد الْقَصْد وَضعف الانقياد يحِيل الْأَقْوَال وَالْأَفْعَال الممدوحة إِلَى مُقْتَضَاهُ وموجبه
segments.english: just as lying, corruption of intention, and weakness of submission transform praiseworthy words and deeds to what [they] require and demand,

segments.arabic: كَمَا يُشَاهد ذَلِك فِي الأخلاط الْغَالِبَة وإحالتها لصالح الأغذية إِلَى طبعها
segments.english: just as that [is] seen in the dominant bodily humors and their transforming of good foods to their [own] nature.

segments.arabic: فذخائر الله وكنوز الْبر وَلَذَّة الْأنس والشوق إِلَيْهِ والفرح والابتهاج بِهِ
segments.english: So the treasures of God, the stores of goodness, the sweetness of closeness [to Him], the longing for Him, the joy and delight in Him —

segments.arabic: لَا يحصل فِي قلب فِيهِ غَيره
segments.english: [they] do not settle in [a] heart that has other than Him in it,

segments.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ من أهل الْعِبَادَة والزهد وَالْعلم
segments.english: even if [he] [was] from the people of worship, and renunciation, and knowledge.

segments.arabic: فَإِن سُبْحَانَهُ أَبى أَن يَجْعَل
segments.english: For glorified [is] He — [He] refused to place

headings.arabic: فائدة الإنابة هي عكوف القلب على الله ﷿ كاعتكاف البدن في المسجد
headings.english: Benefit: Turning back [to God] [is] the devotion of the heart to God, Mighty and Majestic, like the seclusion of the body in the mosque

segments.arabic: ذخائره فِي قلب فِيهِ سواهُ وهمّته ومتعلقة بِغَيْرِهِ
segments.english: His treasures in [a] heart that has other than Him in it, and its concern [is] attached to other than Him.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا يودع ذخائره فِي قلب يرى الْفقر غنى مَعَ الله والغنى فقرا دون الله
segments.english: Rather, He deposits His treasures in [a] heart [that] sees poverty [as] richness with God, and richness [as] poverty without God,

segments.arabic: والعز ذلا دونه والذل عزا وَمَعَهُ
segments.english: and honor [as] humiliation without Him, and humiliation [as] honor with Him,

segments.arabic: وَالنَّعِيم عذَابا دونه وَالْعَذَاب نعيما مَعَه
segments.english: and bliss [as] torment without Him, and torment [as] bliss with Him.

segments.arabic: وَبِالْجُمْلَةِ فَلَا يرى الْحَيَاة إِلَّا بِهِ
segments.english: And in summary, [he] does not see life except with Him,

segments.arabic: وَمَعَ الْمَوْت والألم والهم وَالْغَم والحزن إِذا لم يكن مَعَه
segments.english: and [he is] with death and pain and worry and grief and sorrow if [he] [is] not with Him.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا لَهُ جنتان جنَّة فِي الدُّنْيَا مُعجلَة وجنة يَوْم الْقِيَامَة
segments.english: So this [person] has two paradises: [a] paradise in this world [that is] hastened, and [a] paradise on the Day of Judgment.

segments.arabic: الْإِنَابَة هِيَ عكوف الْقلب على الله ﷿ كاعتكاف الْبدن فِي الْمَسْجِد لَا يُفَارِقهُ
segments.english: Turning back [to God] — it [is] the devotion of the heart to God, Mighty and Majestic, like the seclusion of the body in the mosque, not leaving Him.

segments.arabic: وَحَقِيقَة ذَلِك عكوف الْقلب على محبّته وَذكره بالإجلال والتعظيم
segments.english: And the reality of that [is] the devotion of the heart to His love and His remembrance with reverence and glorification,

segments.arabic: وعكوف الْجَوَارِح على طَاعَته بالإخلاص لَهُ والمتابعة لرَسُوله
segments.english: and the devotion of the limbs to His obedience with sincerity to Him and following His Messenger.

segments.arabic: وَمن لم يعكف قلبه على الله وَحده عكف على التماثيل المتنوعة
segments.english: And whoever's heart does not devote itself to God alone, [it] devotes itself to various idols,

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ إِمَام الحنفاء لِقَوْمِهِ
segments.english: as the leader of the monotheists said to his people:

segments.arabic: ﴿مَا هَذِهِ التَّمَاثِيلُ الَّتِي أَنْتُمْ لَهَا عَاكِفُونَ﴾
segments.english: "What [are] these statues that you [are] devoted to?"
segments.sahih_international: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"

segments.arabic: فاقتسم هُوَ وَقَومه حَقِيقَة العكوف
segments.english: So he and his people divided the reality of devotion between them.

segments.arabic: فَكَانَ حَظّ قومه العكوف على التماثيل وَكَانَ حَظه العكوف على الرب الْجَلِيل
segments.english: His people's share was devotion to the statues, and his share was devotion to the Majestic Lord.

segments.arabic: والتماثيل جمع تِمْثَال وَهُوَ الصُّور الممثلة
segments.english: And "statues" [is] the plural of "statue," and it [means] the represented images.

segments.arabic: فَتعلق الْقلب بِغَيْر الله واشتغاله بِهِ والركون إِلَيْهِ عكوف مِنْهُ على التماثيل الَّتِي قَامَت بِقَلْبِه
segments.english: So the heart's attachment to other than God, and its preoccupation with it, and leaning toward it, [is] devotion from it to the idols that have been set up in its heart,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ نَظِير العكوف على تماثيل الْأَصْنَام
segments.english: and it [is] the equivalent of devotion to the statues of [physical] idols.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا كَانَ شرك عباد الْأَصْنَام بالعكوف بقلوبهم وهممهم وإرادتهم على تماثيلهم
segments.english: And for this reason, the associating partners [with God] of the idol worshippers was through the devotion of their hearts and their concerns and their desires to their idols.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَ فِي الْقلب تماثيل قد ملكته واستعبدته بِحَيْثُ يكون عاكفا عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: So if there are in the heart idols that have possessed it and enslaved it, such that [he] [is] devoted to them,

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ نَظِير عكوف الْأَصْنَام عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: then it [is] the equivalent of the [idol worshippers'] devotion to their idols.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا سمّاه النَّبِي عبدا لَهَا ودعا عَلَيْهِ بالتعس والنكس
segments.english: And for this reason, the Prophet called him [a] slave to them, and prayed against him with ruin and downfall.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ تعس عبد الدِّينَار تعس عبد الدِّرْهَم تعس وانتكس وَإِذا شيك فَلَا انتقش
segments.english: So he said: "Ruined [is] the slave of the gold coin, ruined [is] the slave of the silver coin — ruined and fallen, and if [he is] pricked [by a thorn], may [he] not [be able to] pull it out."

segments.arabic: النَّاس فِي هَذِه الدَّار على جنَاح سفر كلهم
segments.english: People in this abode [are] all on the wing of travel.

segments.arabic: وكل مُسَافر فَهُوَ ظاعن إِلَى مقْصده ونازل على من يسرّ بالنزول عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And every traveler — he [is] departing toward his destination and arriving at [the one] who [is] pleased by his arrival.

segments.arabic: وطالب الله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة إِنَّمَا هُوَ ظاعن إِلَى الله فِي حَال سَفَره ونازل عَلَيْهِ عِنْد الْقدوم عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And the seeker of God and the Hereafter — he [is] only departing toward God during his journey, and arriving at Him upon reaching Him.

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ همته فِي سَفَره وَفِي
segments.english: So this [is] his concern during his journey and during —

headings.arabic: فائدة الشهقة التي تعرض عند سماع القرآن أو غيره لها أسباب أحدها يلوح
headings.english: Benefit: The gasp that occurs when hearing the Quran or other than it has causes — the first appears

segments.arabic: انقضائه
segments.english: its ending—

segments.arabic: يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
segments.english: O tranquil soul!

segments.arabic: ارْجِعِي إِلَى رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَرْضِيَّةً
segments.english: Return to your Lord, pleased [and] pleasing!
segments.sahih_international: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

segments.arabic: فَادْخُلِي فِي عِبَادِي
segments.english: So enter among My servants!

segments.arabic: وَادْخُلِي جَنَّتِي
segments.english: And enter My Paradise!

segments.arabic: ﴿وَقَالَت امْرَأَة فِرْعَوْن﴾
segments.english: And the wife of Pharaoh said:

segments.arabic: رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ
segments.english: My Lord, build for me near You [a] house in Paradise.
segments.sahih_international: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."

segments.arabic: فطلبت كَون الْبَيْت عِنْده قبل طلبَهَا أَن يكون فِي الْجنَّة
segments.english: So she asked for the house to be near Him before she asked for it to be in Paradise.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْجَار قبل الدَّار
segments.english: For indeed the neighbor [comes] before the house.

segments.arabic: من كَلَام الشَّيْخ على
segments.english: From the words of Sheikh Ali:

segments.arabic: قيل لي فِي نوم كاليقظة أَو يقظة كالنوم
segments.english: It was said to me in [a] sleep like wakefulness, or [a] wakefulness like sleep:

segments.arabic: لَا تبد فاقة إِلَى غَيْرِي فأضاعفها عَلَيْك
segments.english: "Do not show need to other than Me, for I [will] multiply it upon you,

segments.arabic: مُكَافَأَة لخروجك عَن حدك فِي عبوديتك
segments.english: [as] repayment for your going beyond your limit in your servitude.

segments.arabic: ابتليتك بالفقر لتصير ذَهَبا خَالِصا
segments.english: I tested you with poverty so that you become pure gold,

segments.arabic: فَلَا تزيفن بعد السبك
segments.english: so do not become counterfeit after the smelting.

segments.arabic: حكمت بالفقر ولنفسي بالغنى
segments.english: I decreed poverty [for you], and for Myself [I decreed] richness.

segments.arabic: فَإِن وصلتها بِي وصلتك بالغنى
segments.english: So if you connect it to Me, I [will] connect you to richness.

segments.arabic: وَإِن وصلتها بغيري حسمت عَنْك مواد معونتي
segments.english: And if you connect it to other than Me, I [will] cut off from you the sources of My aid,

segments.arabic: طردا لَك عَن بَابي
segments.english: driving you away from My door.

segments.arabic: لَا تركن إِلَى شَيْء دُوننَا فانه وبال عَلَيْك وَقَاتل لَك
segments.english: Do not lean on anything other than Us, for it [is] harm upon you and [a] killer of you.

segments.arabic: إِن ركنت إِلَى الْعَمَل رددناه عَلَيْك
segments.english: If you lean on [good] deeds, We [will] turn them back upon you.

segments.arabic: وَإِن ركنت إِلَى الْمعرفَة نكرناها عَلَيْك
segments.english: And if you lean on spiritual knowledge, We [will] make it strange to you.

segments.arabic: وَإِن ركنت إِلَى الوجد استدرجناك فِيهِ
segments.english: And if you lean on ecstasy, We [will] gradually lead you astray through it.

segments.arabic: وَإِن ركنت إِلَى الْعلم أَو قفناك مَعَه
segments.english: And if you lean on knowledge, We [will] halt you with it.

segments.arabic: وَإِن ركنت إِلَى المخلوقين وكلناك إِلَيْهِم
segments.english: And if you lean on created beings, We [will] leave you to them.

segments.arabic: أَرْضنَا لَك رَبًّا نرضاك لنا عبدا
segments.english: Please Us as [a] Lord for you, [and] We [will] please you as [a] servant for Us."

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة
segments.english: Benefit:

segments.arabic: الشهقة الَّتِي تعرض عِنْد سَماع الْقُرْآن أَو غَيره لَهَا أَسبَاب
segments.english: The gasp that occurs when hearing the Quran or other [than it] has [several] causes.

segments.arabic: أَحدهَا يلوح لَهُ عِنْد سَماع دَرَجَة لَيست لَهُ
segments.english: The first: [a] rank that [is] not his appears to him when listening,

segments.arabic: فيرتاح إِلَيْهَا فَتحدث لَهُ الشهقة
segments.english: so he longs for it, and the gasp happens to him.

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ شهقة شوق
segments.english: So this [is] [a] gasp of longing.

segments.arabic: وَثَانِيها أَن يلوح لَهُ ذَنْب ارْتَكَبهُ
segments.english: And the second: [a] sin he committed appears to him,

segments.arabic: فيشهق خوفًا وحزنا على نَفسه
segments.english: so he gasps [in] fear and grief over himself.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه شهقة خشيَة
segments.english: And this [is] [a] gasp of awe.

segments.arabic: وَثَالِثهَا أَن يلوح لَهُ نقص فِيهِ لَا يقدر على دَفعه
segments.english: And the third: [a] shortcoming in him appears to him [that] he cannot remove,

segments.arabic: فَيحدث لَهُ ذَلِك حزنا فيشهق شهقة حزن
segments.english: so that produces grief in him, and he gasps [a] gasp of grief.

segments.arabic: وَرَابِعهَا أَن يلوح لَهُ كَمَال محبوبه
segments.english: And the fourth: the perfection of his Beloved appears to him,

segments.arabic: وَيرى الطَّرِيق إِلَيْهِ مسدودة عَنهُ
segments.english: and he sees the path to Him blocked from him.

segments.arabic: فَيحدث ذَلِك شهقة أَسف وحزن
segments.english: So that produces [a] gasp of regret and grief.

segments.arabic: وخامسها أَن يكون قد توارى عَنهُ محبوبه واشتغل بِغَيْرِهِ
segments.english: And the fifth: his Beloved had hidden from him and he became busy with other than Him,

segments.arabic: فَذكره السماع محبوبه فلاح لَهُ جماله
segments.english: so the listening reminded him of his Beloved, and His beauty appeared to him,

segments.arabic: وَرَأى الْبَاب مَفْتُوحًا وَالطَّرِيق ظَاهِرَة
segments.english: and he saw the door [was] open and the path [was] clear.

segments.arabic: فشهق فَرحا وسرورا بِمَا لَاحَ
segments.english: So he gasped [in] joy and happiness at what appeared.

segments.arabic: وَبِكُل حَال فسبب الشهقة قُوَّة الْوَارِد وَضعف
segments.english: And in every case, the cause of the gasp [is] the strength of the incoming [state] and the weakness of—

headings.arabic: قاعدة جليلة أصل الخير والشر من قبل التفكر فإن الفكر مبدأ الإرادة
headings.english: [A] Great Principle: The Origin of Good and Evil [is] from Thinking, for Thought [is] the Beginning of Will

segments.arabic: الْمحل عَن الِاحْتِمَال وَالْقُوَّة أَن يعْمل ذَلِك الْوَارِد عمله دَاخِلا وَلَا يظْهر عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: the place [is too full] to bear [it], and the strength [is] that that incoming [feeling] does its work inwardly and does not appear on him.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ أقوى لَهُ وأدوم
segments.english: And that [is] stronger for him and more lasting.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ إِذا أظهره ضعف أَثَره وأوشك انْقِطَاعه
segments.english: For when he shows it, its effect weakens and its end draws near.

segments.arabic: هَذَا حكم الشهقة من الصَّادِق
segments.english: This [is] the ruling on the gasp from the truthful one.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الشاهق إِمَّا صَادِق وَإِمَّا سَارِق وَإِمَّا مُنَافِق
segments.english: For the one who gasps [is] either truthful, or [a] thief, or [a] hypocrite.

segments.arabic: قَاعِدَة جليلة
segments.english: [A] great principle:

segments.arabic: أصل الْخَيْر وَالشَّر من قبل التفكّر فَإِن الْفِكر مبدأ الْإِرَادَة والطلب فِي الزّهْد وَالتّرْك وَالْحب والبغض
segments.english: The origin of good and evil [is] from thinking, for thought [is] the beginning of will and pursuit — in renunciation and abandonment, and in love and hatred.

segments.arabic: وأنفع الْفِكر الْفِكر فِي مصَالح الْمعَاد وَفِي طرق اجتلابها
segments.english: And the most beneficial thought [is] thinking about the interests of the Return and the ways to bring them about,

segments.arabic: وَفِي دفع مفاسد الْمعَاد وَفِي طرق اجتنابها
segments.english: and about warding off the harms of the Return and the ways to avoid them.

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ أَرْبَعَة أفكار هِيَ أجلّ الأفكار
segments.english: So these [are] four thoughts — they [are] the noblest of thoughts.

segments.arabic: ويليها أَرْبَعَة فكّر فِي مصَالح الدُّنْيَا وطرق تَحْصِيلهَا
segments.english: And after them [come] four [more]: thinking about the interests of this world and the ways to achieve them,

segments.arabic: وفكّر فِي مفاسد الدُّنْيَا وطرق الِاحْتِرَاز مِنْهَا
segments.english: and thinking about the harms of this world and the ways to guard against them.

segments.arabic: فعلى هَذِه الْأَقْسَام الثَّمَانِية دارت أفكار الْعُقَلَاء
segments.english: So upon these eight categories the thoughts of the wise revolve.

segments.arabic: وَرَأس الْقسم الأول الْفِكر فِي آلَاء الله ونعمه وَأمره وَنَهْيه
segments.english: And the head of the first category [is] thinking about the blessings of God and His favors, and His commands and His prohibitions,

segments.arabic: وطرق الْعلم بِهِ وبأسمائه وَصِفَاته من كِتَابه وَسنة نبيه وَمَا ولاهما
segments.english: and the paths of knowledge of Him, and of His names and attributes, from His Book and the way of His Prophet and what follows them.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا الْفِكر يُثمر لصَاحبه الْمحبَّة والمعرفة
segments.english: And this thought produces for its companion love and knowledge [of God].

segments.arabic: فَإِذا فكر فِي الْآخِرَة وشرفها ودوامها وَفِي الدُّنْيَا وخستها وفنائها
segments.english: And when he thinks about the Hereafter and its nobility and permanence, and about this world and its lowliness and passing away,

segments.arabic: أثمر لَهُ ذَلِك الرَّغْبَة فِي الْآخِرَة والزهد فِي الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: that produces for him desire for the Hereafter and renunciation of this world.

segments.arabic: وَكلما فكّر فِي قصر الأمل وضيق الْوَقْت
segments.english: And whenever he thinks about the shortness of hope and the narrowness of time,

segments.arabic: أورثه ذَلِك الجدّ وَالِاجْتِهَاد وبذل الوسع فِي اغتنام الْوَقْت
segments.english: that gives him seriousness and striving and putting forth [his] effort in seizing the moment.

segments.arabic: وَهَذِه الأفكار تعلي همّته وتحييها بعد مَوتهَا وسفولها
segments.english: And these thoughts raise his ambition and bring it to life after its death and decline,

segments.arabic: وتجعله فِي وَاد وَالنَّاس فِي وَاد
segments.english: and place him in [one] valley and the people in [another] valley.

segments.arabic: وبإزاء هَذِه الأفكار الأفكار الرَّديئَة الَّتِي تجول فِي قُلُوب أَكثر هَذَا الْخلق
segments.english: And opposite these thoughts [are] the bad thoughts that wander in the hearts of most of this creation,

segments.arabic: كالفكر فِيمَا لم يُكَلف الْفِكر فِيهِ وَلَا أعْطى الْإِحَاطَة بِهِ من فضول الْعلم الَّذِي لَا ينفع
segments.english: like thinking about what one was not charged to think about, and was not given the ability to grasp — from excess knowledge that does not benefit.

segments.arabic: كالفكر فِي كَيْفيَّة ذَات الرب وَصِفَاته مِمَّا لَا سَبِيل للعقول إِلَى إِدْرَاكه
segments.english: Like thinking about the nature of the Lord's essence and His attributes — [things] that minds have no way to grasp.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا الْفِكر فِي الصناعات الدقيقة الَّتِي لَا تَنْفَع بل تضر
segments.english: And among them [is] thinking about fine crafts that do not benefit but rather cause harm,

segments.arabic: كالفكر فِي الشطرنج والموسيقى وأنواع الأشكال والتصاوير
segments.english: like thinking about chess, music, and types of shapes and images.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا الْفِكر فِي الْعُلُوم الَّتِي لَو كَانَت صَحِيحَة لم يُعْط الْفِكر فِيهَا النَّفس كمالا وَلَا شرفا
segments.english: And among them [is] thinking about sciences that, even if they were correct, thinking about them would not give the soul perfection or nobility,

segments.arabic: كالفكر فِي دقائق الْمنطق وَالْعلم الرياضي والطبيعي
segments.english: like thinking about the fine points of logic, mathematics, and natural science,

segments.arabic: وَأكْثر عُلُوم الفلاسفة الَّتِي لَو بلغ الْإِنْسَان غايتها لم يكمل بذلك وَلم يزك نَفسه
segments.english: and most of the sciences of the philosophers — which, even if [a] person reached their limit, he would not become complete by that nor purify his soul.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا الْفِكر فِي الشَّهَوَات
segments.english: And among them [is] thinking about desires.

headings.arabic: قاعدة الطلب لقاح الإيمان فإذا اجتمع الإيمان والطلب أثمر العمل
headings.english: A Principle: Seeking [is] the fertilizer of faith — so when faith and seeking come together, they bear fruit [in] deeds

segments.arabic: وَاللَّذَّات وطرق تَحْصِيلهَا
segments.english: and pleasures, and the ways of obtaining them.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا وَإِن كَانَ للنَفس فِيهِ لَذَّة لَكِن لَا عَاقِبَة لَهُ
segments.english: And this, even if the self finds pleasure in it, yet [there is] no [good] outcome for it,

segments.arabic: ومضرّته فِي عَاقِبَة الدُّنْيَا قبل الْآخِرَة أَضْعَاف مسرّته
segments.english: and its harm in the outcome of this world — before the Hereafter — [is] many times its joy.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا الْفِكر فِيمَا لم يكن لَو كَانَ كَيفَ كَانَ يكون
segments.english: And among them [is] thinking about what has not happened — if it had happened, how it would be —

segments.arabic: كالفكر فِيمَا إِذا صَار ملكا أَو وجد كنزا أَو ملك ضَيْعَة
segments.english: like thinking about if [one] became a king, or found [a] treasure, or owned [an] estate —

segments.arabic: مَاذَا يصنع وَكَيف يتصرّف وَيَأْخُذ وَيُعْطِي وينتقم
segments.english: what [he] would do, and how [he] would act, and take, and give, and take revenge,

segments.arabic: وَنَحْو ذَلِك من أفكار السّفل
segments.english: and the like of that, from the thoughts of the lowly.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا الْفِكر فِي جزيئات أَحْوَال النَّاس
segments.english: And among them [is] thinking about the petty details of people's affairs —

segments.arabic: وَمَا جراياتهم ومداخلهم ومخارجهم وتوابع ذَلِك
segments.english: their dealings, their ins and outs, and what follows from that —

segments.arabic: من فكر النُّفُوس المبطلة الفارغة من الله وَرَسُوله وَالدَّار الْآخِرَة
segments.english: from the thoughts of idle souls, empty of God and His Messenger and the Abode of the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا الْفِكر فِي دقائق الْحِيَل وَالْمَكْر الَّتِي يتَوَصَّل بهَا إِلَى أغراضه وهواه
segments.english: And among them [is] thinking about the fine points of tricks and schemes by which [one] reaches his goals and his desire,

segments.arabic: مُبَاحَة كَانَت أَو مُحرمَة
segments.english: whether they were permissible or forbidden.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا الْفِكر فِي أَنْوَاع الشّعْر وصروفه وأفانينه
segments.english: And among them [is] thinking about the types of poetry, its forms, and its styles —

segments.arabic: فِي الْمَدْح والهجاء والغزل والمراثي وَنَحْوهَا
segments.english: in praise, satire, love poetry, elegies, and the like.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ يشغل الْإِنْسَان عَن الْفِكر فِيمَا فِيهِ سعادته وحياته الدائمة
segments.english: For it distracts a person from thinking about what contains his happiness and his lasting life.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهَا الْفِكر فِي المقدرات الذهنية الَّتِي لَا وجود لَهَا فِي الْخَارِج
segments.english: And among them [is] thinking about mental hypotheticals that have no existence in reality,

segments.arabic: وَلَا بِالنَّاسِ حَاجَة إِلَيْهَا الْبَتَّةَ
segments.english: and people have no need for them at all.

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ مَوْجُود فِي كل علم حَتَّى فِي علم الْفِقْه وَالْأُصُول والطب
segments.english: And that [is] found in every field of knowledge, even in jurisprudence, legal theory, and medicine.

segments.arabic: فَكل هَذِه الأفكار مضرّتها أرجح من مَنْفَعَتهَا
segments.english: So all these thoughts — their harm outweighs their benefit,

segments.arabic: ويكتفي فِي مضرّتها شغلها عَن الْفِكر فِيمَا هُوَ أولى بِهِ وأعود عَلَيْهِ بالنفع عَاجلا وآجلا
segments.english: and it suffices as their harm that they distract from thinking about what [is] more deserving of [one's attention] and more beneficial to him, now and later.

segments.arabic: قَاعِدَة: الطّلب لقاح الْإِيمَان
segments.english: A Principle: Seeking [is] the fertilizer of faith.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمع الْإِيمَان والطلب أثمر الْعَمَل الصَّالح
segments.english: So when faith and seeking come together, they bear fruit [in] righteous deeds.

segments.arabic: وَحسن الظَّن بِاللَّه لقاح الافتقار والاضطرار إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: And good opinion of God [is] the fertilizer of neediness and desperation toward Him.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا أثمر إِجَابَة الدُّعَاء
segments.english: So when they come together, they bear fruit [in] the answering of supplication.

segments.arabic: والخشية لقاح الْمحبَّة
segments.english: And awe [is] the fertilizer of love.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا أثمر امْتِثَال الْأَوَامِر وَاجْتنَاب النواهي
segments.english: So when they come together, they bear fruit [in] obeying the commands and avoiding the prohibitions.

segments.arabic: وَالصَّبْر لقاح الْيَقِين
segments.english: And patience [is] the fertilizer of certainty.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا أورثا الْإِمَامَة فِي الدّين
segments.english: So when they come together, they produce leadership in the religion.

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا وَكَانُوا بِآياتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
segments.english: And We made from among them leaders who guide by Our command, when they were patient and had certainty in Our signs.
segments.sahih_international: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.

segments.arabic: وَصِحَّة الِاقْتِدَاء بالرسول لقاح الْإِخْلَاص
segments.english: And soundly following the Messenger [is] the fertilizer of sincerity.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا أثمر قبُول الْعَمَل والاعتداد بِهِ
segments.english: So when they come together, they bear fruit [in] the acceptance of the deed and its being counted.

segments.arabic: وَالْعَمَل لقاح الْعلم
segments.english: And deeds [are] the fertilizer of knowledge.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا كَانَ الْفَلاح والسعادة
segments.english: So when they come together, [there is] success and happiness.

segments.arabic: وَإِن انْفَرد أَحدهمَا عَن الآخر لم يفد شَيْئا
segments.english: And if one of them [is] separated from the other, it does not benefit [at] all.

segments.arabic: والحلم لقاح الْعلم
segments.english: And forbearance [is] the fertilizer of knowledge.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا حصلت سيادة الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: So when they come together, mastery of this world and the Hereafter [is] achieved,

segments.arabic: وَحصل الِانْتِفَاع بِعلم الْعَالم وَإِن انْفَرد
segments.english: and benefit [is] gained from the knowledge of the scholar, even if [he is] alone.

headings.arabic: قاعدة للعبد بين يدي الله موقفان
headings.english: Principle: The Servant Has Two Standings Before God

headings.arabic: قاعدة اللذة من حيث هي مطلوبة للإنسان بل ولكل حي فلا تذم من
headings.english: Principle: Pleasure, in That It Is Sought by Every Human and Every Living Being, Is Not to Be Blamed

segments.arabic: أَحدهمَا عَن صَاحبه فَاتَ النَّفْع وَالِانْتِفَاع
segments.english: one of them from its companion, benefit and gaining benefit [are] lost.

segments.arabic: والعزيمة لقاح البصيرة
segments.english: And determination [is] the pollinator of insight.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا نَالَ صَاحبهمَا خير الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: So when they come together, their possessor attains the good of this world and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: وَبَلغت بِهِ همّته من العلياء كل مَكَان
segments.english: and his ambition reaches through them every high place.

segments.arabic: فَتخلف الكمالات إِمَّا من عدم البصيرة وَإِمَّا من عدم الْعَزِيمَة
segments.english: So the falling behind of perfections [is] either from the lack of insight or from the lack of determination.

segments.arabic: وَحسن الْقَصْد لقاح لصِحَّة الذِّهْن
segments.english: And good intention [is a] pollinator for soundness of mind.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا فقدا فقدا الْخَيْر كُله
segments.english: So when they [are] lost, all good [is] lost.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا اجْتمعَا أثمرا أَنْوَاع الْخيرَات
segments.english: And when they come together, they bear fruit [in] all types of good things.

segments.arabic: وَصِحَّة الرَّأْي لقاح الشجَاعَة
segments.english: And soundness of judgment [is] the pollinator of courage.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا كَانَ النَّصْر وَالظفر
segments.english: So when they come together, [there is] victory and triumph.

segments.arabic: وَإِن قعدا فالخذلان والخيبة
segments.english: And if they [are] absent, then [there is] failure and disappointment.

segments.arabic: وَإِن وجد الرَّأْي بِلَا شجاعة فالجبن وَالْعجز
segments.english: And if judgment [is] found without courage, then [there is] cowardice and weakness.

segments.arabic: وَإِن حصلت الشجَاعَة بِلَا رَأْي فالتهوّر والعطب
segments.english: And if courage [is] found without judgment, then [there is] recklessness and ruin.

segments.arabic: وَالصَّبْر لقاح البصيرة
segments.english: And patience [is] the pollinator of insight.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا فالخير فِي اجْتِمَاعهمَا
segments.english: So when they come together, the good [is] in their togetherness.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْحسن إِذا شِئْت أَن ترى بَصِيرًا لَا صَبر لَهُ رَأَيْته
segments.english: Al-Hasan said: if you wish to see one with insight [but] no patience, you [will] see him.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا شِئْت أَن ترى صَابِرًا لَا بَصِيرَة لَهُ رَأَيْته
segments.english: And if you wish to see [a] patient one [with] no insight, you [will] see him.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا رَأَيْت صَابِرًا بَصيرًا فَذَاك
segments.english: But when you see [a] patient and insightful one — then that [is it]!

segments.arabic: والنصيحة لقاح الْعقل
segments.english: And sincere advice [is] the pollinator of the intellect.

segments.arabic: فَكلما قويت النَّصِيحَة قوي الْعقل واستنار
segments.english: So the stronger the sincere advice, the stronger the intellect [becomes] and the more illuminated.

segments.arabic: والتذكّر والتفكّر كل مِنْهُمَا لقاح الآخر
segments.english: And remembering and reflecting — each of them [is] the pollinator of the other.

segments.arabic: إِذا اجْتمعَا أنتجا الزّهْد فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالرَّغْبَة فِي الْآخِرَة
segments.english: When they come together, they produce detachment from this world and longing for the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: وَالتَّقوى لقاح التَّوَكُّل
segments.english: And God-consciousness [is] the pollinator of reliance [on God].

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا استقام الْقلب
segments.english: So when they come together, the heart becomes upright.

segments.arabic: ولقاح أَخذ أهبة الاستعداد للقاء قصر الأمل
segments.english: And the pollinator of preparing [oneself] for the meeting [with God is] shortening of hope.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا فالخير كُله فِي اجْتِمَاعهمَا وَالشَّر فِي فرقتهما
segments.english: So when they come together, all good [is] in their togetherness, and evil [is] in their separation.

segments.arabic: ولقاح الهمّة الْعَالِيَة النيّة الصَّحِيحَة
segments.english: And the pollinator of high ambition [is] sound intention.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا اجْتمعَا بلغ العَبْد غَايَة المُرَاد
segments.english: So when they come together, the servant reaches the ultimate goal.

segments.arabic: للْعَبد بَين يَدي الله موقفان
segments.english: The servant has before God two standings:

segments.arabic: موقف بَين يَدَيْهِ فِي الصَّلَاة
segments.english: [a] standing before Him in prayer,

segments.arabic: وموقف بَين يَدَيْهِ يَوْم لِقَائِه
segments.english: and [a] standing before Him on the Day of meeting Him.

segments.arabic: فَمن قَامَ بِحَق الْموقف الأول هوّن عَلَيْهِ الْموقف الآخر
segments.english: So whoever fulfills the right of the first standing, the other standing [will be] made easy for him.

segments.arabic: وَمن استهان بِهَذَا الْموقف وَلم يوفّه حقّه شدّد عَلَيْهِ ذَلِك الْموقف
segments.english: And whoever belittles this standing and does not give it its right, that standing [will be] made hard for him.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَمن اللَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهُ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
segments.english: And from the night, prostrate to Him and glorify Him [through a] long night.
segments.sahih_international: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.

segments.arabic: إِنَّ هَؤُلاءِ يُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَاءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
segments.english: Indeed, these [people] love the immediate [life] and leave behind them [a] heavy Day.
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

segments.arabic: اللَّذَّة من حَيْثُ هِيَ مَطْلُوبَة للْإنْسَان بل وَلكُل حَيّ
segments.english: Pleasure, in that it [is] sought by [every] human — rather, by every living being —

segments.arabic: فَلَا تذم من جِهَة كَونهَا لَذَّة
segments.english: [it is] not to be blamed from the standpoint of it being [a] pleasure.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا تذم وَيكون تَركهَا خيرا من نيلها وأنفع
segments.english: Rather, it [is] blamed and leaving it [is] better and more beneficial than attaining it,

segments.arabic: إِذا تَضَمَّنت فَوَات لَذَّة
segments.english: when it leads to the loss of [a] pleasure

headings.arabic: فائدة قوله تعالى عن يوسف نبيه أنه قال
headings.english: A Benefit: [God] Most High's saying about Yusuf, His prophet, that he said

segments.arabic: أعظم مِنْهَا وأكمل أَو أعقبت ألما حُصُوله أعظم من ألم فَوَاتهَا
segments.english: greater than it and more complete, or [it] resulted in [a] pain whose occurrence [is] greater than the pain of missing it —

segments.arabic: فههنا يظْهر الْفرق بَين الْعَاقِل الفطن والأحمق الْجَاهِل
segments.english: so here the difference appears between the wise, sharp person and the foolish, ignorant one.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى عَلِمَ التَّفَاوُت بَين اللذتين والألمين
segments.english: So whenever he knows the difference between the two pleasures and the two pains,

segments.arabic: وَأَنه لَا نِسْبَة لأَحَدهمَا إِلَى الآخر
segments.english: and that there [is] no comparison between one of them and the other,

segments.arabic: هان عَلَيْهِ ترك أدنى اللذتين لتَحْصِيل أعلاهما
segments.english: [it] became easy for him [to] leave the lesser of the two pleasures to attain the higher of them,

segments.arabic: وَاحْتِمَال أيسر الألمين لدفع أعلاهما
segments.english: and [to] bear the easier of the two pains to repel the greater of them.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا تقررت هَذِه الْقَاعِدَة فلذة الْآخِرَة أعظم وأدوم
segments.english: And when this principle [is] established, then the pleasure of the Hereafter [is] greater and more lasting,

segments.arabic: وَلَذَّة الدُّنْيَا أَصْغَر واقصر
segments.english: and the pleasure of this world [is] smaller and shorter.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ ألم الْآخِرَة وألم الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: And likewise [for] the pain of the Hereafter and the pain of this world.

segments.arabic: والمعوّل فِي ذَلِك على الْإِيمَان وَالْيَقِين
segments.english: And what [is] relied upon in that [is] faith and certainty.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا قوي الْيَقِين وباشر الْقلب
segments.english: So when certainty [is] strong and [it] directly touches the heart,

segments.arabic: آثر الْأَعْلَى على الْأَدْنَى فِي جَانب اللَّذَّة
segments.english: [one] prefers the higher over the lower in the matter of pleasure,

segments.arabic: وَاحْتمل الْأَلَم الأسهل على الأصعب
segments.english: and bears the easier pain over the harder.

segments.arabic: وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: And God [is] the One whose help [is] sought.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: A Benefit: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
segments.english: And Ayyub, when he called [upon] his Lord: "Harm has touched me, and You [are] the most merciful of the merciful."
segments.sahih_international: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful."

segments.arabic: جمع فِي هَذَا الدُّعَاء بَين حَقِيقَة التَّوْحِيد وَإِظْهَار الْفقر والفاقة إِلَى ربه
segments.english: He combined in this supplication the reality of monotheism and showing poverty and need to his Lord,

segments.arabic: وَوُجُود طعم الْمحبَّة فِي المتملق لَهُ
segments.english: and the presence of the taste of love in [his] humbling himself to Him,

segments.arabic: وَالْإِقْرَار لَهُ بِصفة الرَّحْمَة وَأَنه أرْحم الرَّاحِمِينَ
segments.english: and acknowledging to Him the attribute of mercy and that He [is] the most merciful of the merciful,

segments.arabic: والتوسل إِلَيْهِ بصفاته سُبْحَانَهُ وَشدَّة حَاجته وَهُوَ فقره
segments.english: and seeking nearness to Him through His attributes, glorified [is] He, and [through] the severity of his need — which [is] his poverty.

segments.arabic: وَمَتى وجد الْمُبْتَلى هَذَا كشف عَنهُ بلواه
segments.english: And whenever the afflicted one finds this, [God] removes from him his trial.

segments.arabic: وَقد جرّب أَنه من قَالَهَا سبع مَرَّات وَلَا سِيمَا مَعَ هَذِه الْمعرفَة كشف الله ضره
segments.english: And it has been tried that whoever says it seven times — especially with this understanding — God removes his harm.

segments.arabic: أَنْت ولي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بالصالحين
segments.english: You [are] my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Take me in death as [a] Muslim and join me with the righteous.
segments.sahih_international: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."

segments.arabic: جمعت هَذِه الدعْوَة الْإِقْرَار بِالتَّوْحِيدِ والاستلام للرب وَإِظْهَار الافتقار إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: This supplication combined the acknowledgment of monotheism and submission to the Lord and showing need for Him,

segments.arabic: والبراءة من مُوالَاة غَيره سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: and disassociation from allegiance to other than Him, glorified [is] He,

segments.arabic: وَكَون الْوَفَاة على الْإِسْلَام أجلّ غايات العَبْد
segments.english: and [the fact] that dying upon Islam [is] the greatest of the servant's goals,

segments.arabic: وَأَن ذَلِك بيد الله لَا بيد العَبْد
segments.english: and that this [is] in the hand of God, not in the hand of the servant,

segments.arabic: وَالِاعْتِرَاف بالمعاد وَطلب مرافقة السُّعَدَاء
segments.english: and the acknowledgment of the Return and the request [for] the companionship of the blessed ones.

headings.arabic: فائدة قول الله تعالى
headings.english: [A] Benefit [from] the Words of [God] Most High

segments.arabic: وَأَن من شَيْء إِلَّا عندنَا خزائنه
segments.english: "And [there is] not [a] thing except that with Us [are] its treasuries"

segments.arabic: مُتَضَمّن لكنز من الْكُنُوز
segments.english: [is] containing [a] treasure from [among] the treasures,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أَن يطْلب كل شَيْء لَا يطْلب إِلَّا مِمَّن عِنْده خزائنه
segments.english: and it [is] that everything [one] seeks should not be sought except from the One who has its treasuries,

segments.arabic: ومفاتيح تِلْكَ الخزائن بيدَيْهِ
segments.english: and the keys of those treasuries [are] in His hands,

segments.arabic: وَأَن طلبه من غَيره طلب مِمَّن لَيْسَ عِنْده وَلَا يقدر عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: and that seeking it from other than Him [is] seeking from one who does not have it and has no power over it.

segments.arabic: وَقَوله وَأَنَّ إِلَى رَبِّكَ الْمُنْتَهَى
segments.english: And His saying: "And that to your Lord [is] the final end"

segments.arabic: مُتَضَمّن لكنز عَظِيم
segments.english: [is] containing [a] great treasure,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أَن كل مُرَاد إِن لم يرد لأَجله ويتصل بِهِ وَإِلَّا فَهُوَ مضمحل مُنْقَطع
segments.english: and it [is] that every desired thing — if it [is] not desired for His sake and connected to Him — then it [is] fading [and] cut off,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ إِلَيْهِ الْمُنْتَهى
segments.english: for the final end [is] not to it.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ الْمُنْتَهى إِلَّا إِلَى الَّذِي انْتَهَت إِلَيْهِ الْأُمُور كلهَا
segments.english: And the final end [is] only to the One to whom all matters reach their end,

segments.arabic: فانتهت إِلَى خلقه ومشيئته وحكمته وَعلمه
segments.english: so they ended at His creation, His will, His wisdom, and His knowledge.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ غَايَة كل مَطْلُوب
segments.english: So He [is] the goal of everything sought.

segments.arabic: وكل مَحْبُوب لَا يحب لأَجله فمحبته عناء وَعَذَاب
segments.english: And every beloved [thing] not loved for His sake — its love [is] suffering and torment.

segments.arabic: وكل عمل لَا يُرَاد لأَجله فَهُوَ ضائع وباطل
segments.english: And every deed not intended for His sake — it [is] wasted and void.

segments.arabic: وكل قلب لَا يصل إِلَيْهِ فَهُوَ شقي مَحْجُوب عَن سعادته وفلاحه
segments.english: And every heart that does not reach Him — it [is] miserable, veiled from its happiness and its success.

segments.arabic: فَاجْتمع مَا يُرَاد مِنْهُ كُله فِي قَوْله
segments.english: So everything that [is] desired from Him gathered together in His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَإِن من شَيْء إِلَّا عندنَا خزائنه﴾
segments.english: "And [there is] not [a] thing except that with Us [are] its treasuries."
