segments.sahih_international: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.

segments.arabic: وَاجْتمعَ مَا يُرَاد لَهُ كُله فِي قَوْله
segments.english: And everything that [is] desired for His sake gathered together in His saying:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَأَنَّ إِلَى رَبِّكَ الْمُنْتَهَى﴾
segments.english: "And that to your Lord [is] the final end."

segments.arabic: فَلَيْسَ وَرَاءه سُبْحَانَهُ غَايَة تطلب
segments.english: So there [is] not beyond Him — glorified [is] He — [a] goal to be sought,

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ دونه غَايَة إِلَيْهَا الْمُنْتَهى
segments.english: and there [is] not besides Him [a] goal to which [is] the final end.

segments.arabic: وَتَحْت هَذَا سر عَظِيم من أسرار التَّوْحِيد
segments.english: And beneath this [is a] great secret from the secrets of monotheism,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أَن الْقلب لَا يسْتَقرّ وَلَا يطمئن ويسكن إِلَّا بالوصول إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: and it [is] that the heart does not settle, nor find peace and calm, except by reaching Him.

segments.arabic: وكل مَا سواهُ مِمَّا يحب وَيُرَاد فمراد لغيره
segments.english: And everything other than Him that [is] loved and desired — it [is] desired for [something] other than itself.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ المُرَاد المحبوب لذاته إِلَّا وَاحِد إِلَيْهِ الْمُنْتَهى
segments.english: And the One desired [and] loved for His own sake [is] none but One — to Him [is] the final end.

segments.arabic: ويستحيل أَن يكون الْمُنْتَهى إِلَى اثْنَيْنِ
segments.english: And it [is] impossible that the final end [would] be to two,

segments.arabic: كَمَا يَسْتَحِيل أَن يكون ابْتِدَاء الْمَخْلُوقَات من اثْنَيْنِ
segments.english: just as it [is] impossible that the beginning of creation [would] be from two.

segments.arabic: فَمن كَانَ انْتِهَاء محبته ورغبته وإرادته وطاعته إِلَى غَيره
segments.english: So whoever's love, longing, intention, and obedience end at other than Him —

segments.arabic: بَطل عَلَيْهِ ذَلِك وَزَالَ عَنهُ وفارقه أحْوج مَا كَانَ إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: that [will] fail him and leave him and depart from him when he [is] most in need of it.

segments.arabic: وَمن كَانَ انْتِهَاء محبته ورغبته ورهبته وَطَلَبه هُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: And whoever's love, longing, fear, and seeking end at Him — glorified [is] He —

segments.arabic: ظفر بنعمه ولذته وبهجته وسعادته أَبَد الآباد
segments.english: [will] win His blessing, His delight, His joy, and His happiness for all eternity.

segments.arabic: العَبْد دَائِما متقلب بَين أَحْكَام الْأَوَامِر وَأَحْكَام النَّوَازِل
segments.english: The servant [is] always moving between the rulings of commands and the rulings of trials.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مُحْتَاج بل مُضْطَر إِلَى العون عِنْد الْأَوَامِر وَإِلَى اللطف عِنْد النَّوَازِل
segments.english: So he [is] in need — rather, forced [to turn] — to help at [the time of] commands and to gentleness at [the time of] trials.

segments.arabic: وعَلى قدر قِيَامه بالأوامر يحصل لَهُ من اللطف عِنْد النَّوَازِل
segments.english: And according to [the degree of] his carrying out the commands, he receives of gentleness at [the time of] trials.

segments.arabic: فَإِن كمل الْقيام بالأوامر ظَاهرا وَبَاطنا ناله اللطف
segments.english: So if the carrying out of the commands [is] complete — outwardly and inwardly — gentleness reaches him.

headings.arabic: فائدة جليلة لا يزال منقطعا عن الله حتى تتصل إرادته ومحبته بوجه
headings.english: A Great Benefit: [A person] remains cut off from God until his will and love connect with the Face

segments.arabic: ظَاهرا وَبَاطنا
segments.english: outwardly and inwardly.

segments.arabic: وَإِن قَامَ بصورها دون حقائقها وبواطنها
segments.english: And if he performed their outward forms without their realities and inner dimensions,

segments.arabic: ناله اللطف فِي الظَّاهِر وَقل نصِيبه من اللطف فِي الْبَاطِن
segments.english: he would receive gentleness in the outward, but his share of gentleness in the inward would be little.

segments.arabic: فَإِن قلت وَمَا اللطف الْبَاطِن
segments.english: So if you say: what [is] the inner gentleness?

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مَا يحصل للقلب عِنْد النَّوَازِل من السكينَة والطمأنينة وَزَوَال القلق وَالِاضْطِرَاب والجزع
segments.english: Then it [is] what comes to the heart during hardships — of tranquility, peace of mind, and the removal of anxiety, disturbance, and panic.

segments.arabic: فيستخذى بَين يَدي سيّده ذليلا لَهُ مستكينا
segments.english: So he submits before his Master, humble to Him, yielding,

segments.arabic: نَاظرا إِلَيْهِ بِقَلْبِه سَاكِنا إِلَيْهِ بِرُوحِهِ وسره
segments.english: looking to Him with his heart, finding rest in Him with his spirit and his innermost being.

segments.arabic: قد شغله مُشَاهدَة لطفه بِهِ عَن شدَّة مَا هُوَ فِيهِ من الْأَلَم
segments.english: Witnessing His gentleness toward him has distracted him from the severity of the pain he [is] in.

segments.arabic: وَقد غيّبه عَن شُهُود ذَلِك مَعْرفَته بِحسن اخْتِيَاره لَهُ
segments.english: And his knowledge of [God's] good choice for him has made him absent from noticing that [pain].

segments.arabic: وَأَنه عبد مَحْض يجْرِي عَلَيْهِ سيّده أَحْكَامه
segments.english: And [he knows] that he [is] [a] pure servant upon whom his Master carries out His decrees —

segments.arabic: رَضِي أَو سخط
segments.english: whether he [is] pleased or displeased.

segments.arabic: فَإِن رَضِي نَالَ الرِّضَا وَإِن سخط فحظه السخط
segments.english: So if he [is] pleased, he attains [God's] pleasure. And if he [is] displeased, then his portion [is] displeasure.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا اللطف الْبَاطِن ثَمَرَة تِلْكَ الْمُعَامَلَة الْبَاطِنَة
segments.english: So this inner gentleness [is] the fruit of that inner conduct —

segments.arabic: يزِيد بزيادتها وَينْقص بنقصانها
segments.english: it increases with its increase and decreases with its decrease.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة جليلة
segments.english: A Great Benefit

segments.arabic: لَا يزَال مُنْقَطِعًا عَن الله حَتَّى تتصل إِرَادَته ومحبته بِوَجْه الْأَعْلَى
segments.english: [A person] remains cut off from God until his will and love connect with the Face of the Most High.

segments.arabic: وَالْمرَاد بِهَذَا الِاتِّصَال أَن تُفْضِي الْمحبَّة إِلَيْهِ وتتعلق بِهِ وَحده
segments.english: And what [is] meant by this connection [is] that love reaches Him and attaches to Him alone,

segments.arabic: فَلَا يحجبها شَيْء دونه
segments.english: so nothing veils it from Him.

segments.arabic: وَأَن تتصل الْمعرفَة بأسمائه وَصِفَاته وأفعاله
segments.english: And that knowledge connects with His names, attributes, and actions,

segments.arabic: فَلَا يطمس نورها ظلمَة التعطيل
segments.english: so that the darkness of denial does not put out its light —

segments.arabic: كَمَا لَا يطمس نور الْمحبَّة ظلمَة الشّرك
segments.english: just as the darkness of associating partners [with God] does not put out the light of love.

segments.arabic: وَأَن يتَّصل ذكره بِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: And that his remembrance connects with Him, glorified [is] He,

segments.arabic: فيزول بَين الذاكر وَالْمَذْكُور حجاب الْغَفْلَة
segments.english: so the veil of heedlessness between the one remembering and the One remembered [is] removed,

segments.arabic: والتفاته فِي حَال الذّكر إِلَى غير مذكوره
segments.english: and his turning during remembrance to other than the One he remembers.

segments.arabic: فَحِينَئِذٍ يتَّصل الذّكر بِهِ
segments.english: Then at that point, the remembrance connects with Him.

segments.arabic: ويتصل الْعَمَل بأوامره ونواهيه
segments.english: And action connects with His commands and prohibitions,

segments.arabic: فيفعل الطَّاعَة لأَنه أَمر بهَا وأحبها
segments.english: so he does the act of obedience because He commanded it and loved it,

segments.arabic: وَيتْرك المناهي لكَونه نهى عَنْهَا وأبغضها
segments.english: and he leaves the forbidden things because He forbade them and hated them.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا معنى اتِّصَال الْعَمَل بأَمْره وَنَهْيه
segments.english: So this [is] the meaning of action connecting with His command and prohibition,

segments.arabic: وَحَقِيقَة زَوَال الْعِلَل الباعثة على الْفِعْل وَالتّرْك من الْأَغْرَاض والحظوظ العاجلة
segments.english: and the reality of the removal of the motives driving doing and leaving — [motives] of [worldly] purposes and immediate gains.

segments.arabic: ويتصل التَّوَكُّل وَالْحب بِهِ
segments.english: And reliance [on God] and love connect with Him,

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ يصير واثقا بِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ مطمئنا إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: such that he becomes trusting in Him, glorified [is] He, at peace with Him,

segments.arabic: رَاضِيا بِحسن تَدْبيره لَهُ غير مُتَّهم لَهُ فِي حَال من الْأَحْوَال
segments.english: content with His good planning for him, not accusing Him in any situation.

segments.arabic: ويتصل فقره وفاقته بِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ دون سواهُ
segments.english: And his poverty and need connect with Him, glorified [is] He, and not anyone else.

segments.arabic: ويتصل خَوفه ورجاؤه وفرحه وسروره وابتهاجه بِهِ وَحده
segments.english: And his fear, hope, joy, happiness, and delight connect with Him alone.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يخَاف غَيره وَلَا يرجوه
segments.english: So he does not fear other than Him and does not hope in [anyone else].

segments.arabic: وَلَا يفرح بِهِ كل الْفَرح وَلَا يسر بِهِ غَايَة السرُور
segments.english: And he does not rejoice in [anything else] with complete joy, nor [is he] happy with it with the utmost happiness.

segments.arabic: وَإِن ناله بالمخلوق بعض الْفَرح وَالسُّرُور
segments.english: And even if some joy and happiness reach him through [a] created being,

segments.arabic: فَلَيْسَ الْفَرح التَّام وَالسُّرُور الْكَامِل والابتهاج وَالنَّعِيم وقرة الْعين وَسُكُون
segments.english: it [is] not the complete joy, the perfect happiness, the delight, the bliss, the coolness of the eye, and the rest of —

headings.arabic: قاعدة جليلة قد فكرت في هذا الأمر فإذا أصله أن تعلم أن النعم
headings.english: A Noble Principle: I Reflected on This Matter and [Found] Its Foundation [Is] That You Know That Blessings...

segments.arabic: الْقلب إِلَّا بِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: the heart except through Him, glorified [is] He.

segments.arabic: وَمَا سواهُ إِن أعَان على هَذَا الْمَطْلُوب فَرح بِهِ وسر بِهِ
segments.english: And whatever [is] besides Him — if it aids toward this goal, [one] rejoices in it and [is] delighted by it.

segments.arabic: وَإِن حجب عَنهُ فَهُوَ بالحزن بِهِ والوحشة مِنْهُ واضطراب الْقلب بحصوله أَحَق مِنْهُ بِأَن يفرح بِهِ
segments.english: And if it veils from Him, then it — with sadness over it, loneliness from it, and disturbance of the heart by its attainment — [is] more deserving than [one] rejoicing in it.

segments.arabic: فَلَا فرحة وَلَا سرُور إِلَّا بِهِ أَو بِمَا أوصل إِلَيْهِ وأعان على مرضاته
segments.english: So [there is] no joy and no delight except in Him, or in what leads to Him and aids in [reaching] His pleasure.

segments.arabic: وَقد أخبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَنه لَا يحب الفرحين بالدنيا وَزينتهَا
segments.english: And He, glorified [is] He, has told [us] that He does not love those who rejoice in this world and its adornment.

segments.arabic: وَأمر بالفرح بفضله وَرَحمته
segments.english: And He commanded rejoicing in His grace and His mercy,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ الْإِسْلَام وَالْإِيمَان وَالْقُرْآن كَمَا فسره الصَّحَابَة والتابعون
segments.english: and that [is] Islam, faith, and the Quran — as the Companions and the Successors explained it.

segments.arabic: وَالْمَقْصُود أَن من اتَّصَلت لَهُ هَذِه الْأُمُور بِاللَّه سُبْحَانَهُ فقد وصل
segments.english: And the point [is] that whoever connects these matters to God, glorified [is] He, has [truly] arrived.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا فَهُوَ مَقْطُوع عَن ربه مُتَّصِل بحظه وَنَفسه
segments.english: Otherwise, he [is] cut off from his Lord, attached to his own portion and his self,

segments.arabic: ملبس عَلَيْهِ فِي مَعْرفَته وإرادته وسلوكه
segments.english: confused in his knowledge, his intention, and his path.

segments.arabic: كلهَا من الله وَحده نعم الطَّاعَات وَنعم اللَّذَّات
segments.english: [are] all from God alone — blessings of obedience and blessings of pleasures.

segments.arabic: فترغب إِلَيْهِ أَن يلهمك ويوزعك شكرها
segments.english: So you turn to Him [asking] that He inspire you and grant you [the ability] to give thanks for them.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَمَا بِكُمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تجأرون
segments.english: And whatever blessing [is] with you [is] from God. Then when harm touches you, to Him you cry out.
segments.sahih_international: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: فَاذْكُرُوا آلاءَ اللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
segments.english: So remember the favors of God, that you may succeed.
segments.sahih_international: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allah that you might succeed.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ
segments.english: And He said:

segments.arabic: واشكروا نعْمَة اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِيَّاه تَعْبدُونَ
segments.english: And give thanks for the blessing of God, if it [is] Him you worship.
segments.sahih_international: Then eat of what Allah has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And be grateful for the favor of Allah, if it is [indeed] Him that you worship.

segments.arabic: وكما أَن تِلْكَ النعم مِنْهُ وَمن مُجَرَّد فَضله
segments.english: And just as those blessings [are] from Him and from His sheer grace,

segments.arabic: فَذكرهَا وشكرها لَا ينَال إِلَّا بتوفيقه
segments.english: so remembering them and giving thanks for them [is] not reached except by His enabling.

segments.arabic: والذنُوب من خذلانه وتخليه عَن عَبده وتخليته بَينه وَبَين نَفسه
segments.english: And sins [come] from His abandoning and forsaking His servant, and leaving him [alone] between himself and his self.

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم يكْشف ذَلِك عَن عَبده فَلَا سَبِيل لَهُ إِلَى كشفه عَن نَفسه
segments.english: And if He does not remove that from His servant, then [there is] no way for him to remove it from himself.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا هُوَ مُضْطَر إِلَى التضرع والابتهال إِلَيْهِ أَن تدفع عَنهُ أَسبَابهَا حَتَّى لَا تصدر مِنْهُ
segments.english: So he [is] in desperate need of humbling [himself] and pleading to Him, that He push away its causes from him, so that [sins] do not come from him.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا وَقعت بِحكم الْمَقَادِير وَمُقْتَضى البشرية
segments.english: And when [sins] occur by the decree of destiny and the demands of human nature,

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مُضْطَر إِلَى التضرع وَالدُّعَاء أَن يدْفع عَنهُ موجباتها وعقوباتها
segments.english: he [is] in desperate need of humbling [himself] and supplication, that He push away their consequences and punishments from him.

segments.arabic: فَلَا يَنْفَكّ العَبْد عَن ضَرُورَته إِلَى هَذِه الْأُصُول الثَّلَاثَة وَلَا فلاح لَهُ إِلَّا بهَا
segments.english: So the servant never ceases [to have] his need for these three foundations, and [there is] no success for him except through them:

segments.arabic: الشُّكْر وَطلب الْعَافِيَة وَالتَّوْبَة النصوح
segments.english: gratitude, seeking well-being, and sincere repentance.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ فَكرت فَإِذا مدَار ذَلِك على الرَّغْبَة والرهبة
segments.english: Then I reflected, and [I found] that the pivot of all that [is] upon hope and fear.

segments.arabic: وليسا بيد العَبْد بل بيد مُقَلِّب الْقُلُوب ومصرفها كَيفَ يَشَاء
segments.english: And they [are] not in the hand of the servant, but in the hand of the Turner of hearts and the One who directs them however He wills.

segments.arabic: فَإِن وفْق عَبده أقبل بِقَلْبِه إِلَيْهِ وملأه رَغْبَة وَرَهْبَة
segments.english: So if He grants His servant success, He turns his heart toward Him and fills it [with] hope and fear.

segments.arabic: وَإِن خذله تَركه وَنَفسه وَلم يَأْخُذ بِقَلْبِه إِلَيْهِ وَلم يسْأَله ذَلِك
segments.english: And if He abandons him, He leaves him with his self, and does not take his heart toward Him, and [the servant] does not ask Him for that.

segments.arabic: وَمَا شَاءَ الله كَانَ وَمَا لم يَشَاء لم يكن
segments.english: And whatever God wills [will] be, and whatever He does not will [will] not be.

headings.arabic: فصل وسبب الخذلان عدم صلاحية المحل وأهليته وقبوله للنعمة بحيث لو
headings.english: Section: The cause of abandonment [is] the lack of fitness of the place, its worthiness, and its receptivity to the blessing, such that if

segments.arabic: ثمَّ فَكرت هَل للتوفيق والخذلان سَبَب أم هما بِمُجَرَّد المشية لَا سَبَب لَهما
segments.english: Then I thought: does divine guidance and abandonment have [a] cause, or [are] they by mere will, [with] no cause for them?

segments.arabic: فَإِذا سببهما أَهْلِيَّة الْمحل وَعدمهَا
segments.english: So their cause [is] the fitness of the place and its absence.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ سُبْحَانَهُ خَالق الْمحَال مُتَفَاوِتَة فِي الاستعداد وَالْقَبُول أعظم تفَاوت
segments.english: So He, glorified [is] He, [is] the Creator of places, varying in readiness and receptivity [with] the greatest variation.

segments.arabic: فالجمادات لَا تقبل مَا يقبله الْحَيَوَان
segments.english: So lifeless things do not accept what animals accept.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ النوعان كل مِنْهُمَا متفاوت فِي الْقبُول
segments.english: And likewise the two types — each of them varies in receptivity.

segments.arabic: فالحيوان النَّاطِق يقبل مَا لَا يقبله البهيم
segments.english: So the rational animal accepts what the non-rational [animal] does not accept.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ متفاوت فِي الْقبُول أعظم تفَاوت
segments.english: And it varies in receptivity [with] the greatest variation.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ الْحَيَوَان البهيم متفاوت فِي الْقبُول
segments.english: And likewise the non-rational animal varies in receptivity.

segments.arabic: لَكِن لَيْسَ بَين النَّوْع الْوَاحِد من التَّفَاوُت كَمَا بَين النَّوْع الإنساني
segments.english: But there [is] not within [a] single species the [same] variation as [there is] within the human species.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا كَانَ الْمحل قَابلا للنعمة بِحَيْثُ يعرفهَا وَيعرف قدرهَا وخطرها
segments.english: So when the place was receptive to the blessing, such that he recognizes it and recognizes its worth and importance,

segments.arabic: ويشكر الْمُنعم بهَا ويثني عَلَيْهِ بهَا ويعظمه عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: and he thanks the Giver for it, and praises Him for it, and glorifies Him for it,

segments.arabic: وَيعلم أَنَّهَا من مَحْض الْجُود وَعين الْمِنَّة من غير أَن يكون هُوَ مُسْتَحقّا لَهَا
segments.english: and he knows that it [is] from pure generosity and the very essence of favor, without him being deserving of it,

segments.arabic: وَلَا هِيَ لَهُ وَلَا بِهِ وَإِنَّمَا هِيَ لله وَحده وَبِه وَحده
segments.english: and it [is] not his, nor by him, but rather it [is] for God alone and by Him alone,

segments.arabic: فوحده بنعمته إخلاصا وصرفها فِي محبته شكرا
segments.english: so he singled Him out with His blessing sincerely, and spent it in His love [as] gratitude,

segments.arabic: وشهدها من مَحْض جوده منَّة
segments.english: and witnessed it [as being] from [His] pure generosity [and] favor,

segments.arabic: وَعرف قصوره وتقصيره فِي شكرها عجزا أَو ضعفا وتفريطا
segments.english: and recognized his falling short and his neglect in being grateful for it — [whether from] inability, or weakness, or negligence,

segments.arabic: وَعلم أَنه إِن أدامها عَلَيْهِ فَذَلِك مَحْض صدقته وفضله وإحسانه
segments.english: and knew that if He continues it upon him, then that [is] purely His charity, His favor, and His goodness,

segments.arabic: وَإِن سلبه إِيَّاهَا فَهُوَ أهل لذَلِك مُسْتَحقّ لَهُ
segments.english: and if He takes it from him, then he [is] deserving of that, worthy of it,

segments.arabic: وَكلما زَاده من نعمه ازْدَادَ ذلالة وانكسارا وخضوعا بَين يَدَيْهِ
segments.english: and whenever He increases him in His blessings, he increases in humbleness and brokenness and submission before Him,

segments.arabic: وقياما بشكره وخشيته لَهُ سُبْحَانَهُ أَن يسلبه إِيَّاهَا لعدم توفيته شكرها
segments.english: and [in] standing in gratitude to Him, and fearing Him, glorified [is] He, that He [might] take it from him for not fulfilling its gratitude,

segments.arabic: كَمَا سلب نعْمَته عَمَّن لم يعرفهَا وَلم يرعها حق رعايتها
segments.english: just as He took His blessing from the one who did not recognize it and did not care for it [with] its due care.

segments.arabic: فَإِن لم يشْكر نعْمَته وقابلها بضد مَا يليق أَن يُقَابل بِهِ سلبه إِيَّاهَا وَلَا بُد
segments.english: So if he does not thank [God for] His blessing and meets it with the opposite of what [is] fitting to meet [it] with, He [will] take it from him, without doubt.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ لِيَقُولُوا أَهَؤُلاءِ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَم بِالشَّاكِرِينَ
segments.english: And thus We tested some of them so that they would say: '[Are] these [the ones] God [has] favored from among us?' [Is] not God most knowing of the grateful?
segments.sahih_international: And thus We have tried some of them through others that the disbelievers might say, "Is it these whom Allah has favored among us?" Is not Allah most knowing of those who are grateful?

segments.arabic: وهم الَّذين عرفُوا قدر النِّعْمَة وقبلوها وأحبوها
segments.english: And they [are] those who knew the worth of the blessing, and accepted it, and loved it,

segments.arabic: وأثنوا على الْمُنعم بهَا وأحبوه وَقَامُوا بشكره
segments.english: and praised the Giver for it, and loved Him, and stood in gratitude to Him.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ آيَةٌ قَالُوا لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ حَتَّى نُؤْتَى مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ رُسُلُ اللَّهِ
segments.english: And when [a] sign comes to them, they say: 'We will never believe until we [are] given the like of what the messengers of God were given.'
segments.sahih_international: And when a sign comes to them, they say, "Never will we believe until we are given like that which was given to the messengers of Allah." Allah is most knowing of where He places His message. There will afflict those who committed crimes debasement before Allah and severe punishment for what they used to conspire.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ يَجْعَلُ رِسَالَاتِهِ
segments.english: God [is] most knowing [of] where He places His messages.

segments.arabic: وَسبب الخذلان عدم صَلَاحِية الْمحل وأهليته وقبوله للنعمة
segments.english: And the cause of abandonment [is] the lack of fitness of the place, and its worthiness, and its receptivity to the blessing,

segments.arabic: بِحَيْثُ لَو وافته النعم لقَالَ هَذَا لي
segments.english: such that if the blessings came to him, he would say: 'This [is] mine,

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا أُوتِيتهُ لِأَنِّي أَهله ومستحقه
segments.english: and I was only given it because I [am] worthy of it and deserving of it,'

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: as [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ عِنْدِي
segments.english: He said: 'I was only given it based on knowledge [that is] with me.'
segments.sahih_international: He said, "I was only given it because of knowledge I have." Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? But the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked.

segments.arabic: أَي على علم علمه عِنْدِي أستحق بِهِ ذَلِك وأستوجبه وأستأهله
segments.english: Meaning: based on [a] knowledge He knew [was] in me, [by which] I deserve that, and [am] entitled to it, and [am] worthy of it.

segments.arabic: قَالَ
segments.english: He said:

segments.arabic: الْفراء أَي على فضل عِنْدِي إِنِّي كنت أَهله ومستحقا لَهُ إِذْ أَعْطيته
segments.english: Al-Farra' [said], meaning: "upon [a] favor I have — I was deserving of it and entitled to it when I was given it."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ مقَاتل يَقُول على خير علمه الله عِنْدِي
segments.english: And Muqatil said: he [is] saying "upon [a] good [that] God knew [was] in me."

segments.arabic: وَذكر عبد الله بن الْحَارِث بن نَوْفَل سُلَيْمَان بن دَاوُد فِيمَا أُوتِيَ من الْملك
segments.english: And Abdullah ibn al-Harith ibn Nawfal mentioned Sulayman ibn Dawud regarding what he was given of kingship.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ قَرَأَ قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: Then he recited [the saying of] [God] Most High:

segments.arabic: هَذَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي أَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ
segments.english: "This [is] from the favor of my Lord, to test me — will I be grateful or ungrateful?"
segments.sahih_international: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."

segments.arabic: وَلم يقل هَذَا من كَرَامَتِي
segments.english: And he did not say "this [is] from my honor."

segments.arabic: ثمَّ ذكر قَارون وَقَوله
segments.english: Then he mentioned Qarun and his saying:

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ عِنْدِي
segments.english: "I was only given it because of knowledge I have."
segments.sahih_international: He said, "I was only given it because of knowledge I have." Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? But the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked.

segments.arabic: يَعْنِي أَن سُلَيْمَان رأى مَا أُوتِيتهُ من فضل الله عَلَيْهِ ومنته
segments.english: Meaning that Sulayman saw what he was given [as being] from the favor of God upon him and His grace.

segments.arabic: وَأَنه ابتلى بِهِ شكره
segments.english: And that He tested his gratitude through it.

segments.arabic: وَقَارُون رأى ذَلِك من نَفسه واستحقاقه
segments.english: And Qarun saw that [as being] from himself and his [own] deservingness.

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ قَوْله سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: And likewise His saying, glorified [is] He:

segments.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِنَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَذَا لِي
segments.english: "And if We let him taste mercy from Us after hardship [that] touched him, he will surely say: 'This [is] for me.'"
segments.sahih_international: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me, and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.

segments.arabic: أَي أَنا أَهله وحقيق بِهِ
segments.english: Meaning: I [am] deserving of it and worthy of it.

segments.arabic: فاختصاصي بِهِ كاختصاص الْمَالِك بِملكه
segments.english: So my exclusive right to it [is] like the exclusive right of the owner to his property.

segments.arabic: وَالْمُؤمن يري ذَلِك ملكا لرَبه وفضلا مِنْهُ
segments.english: And the believer sees that [as] belonging to his Lord and [as] favor from Him.

segments.arabic: منّ بِهِ على عَبده من غير اسْتِحْقَاق مِنْهُ
segments.english: [He] granted it to His servant without [any] deservingness from him.

segments.arabic: بل صَدَقَة تصدق بهَا على عَبده
segments.english: Rather, [it is a] charity [that] He gave to His servant.

segments.arabic: وَله أَن لَا يتَصَدَّق بهَا
segments.english: And He [has the right] not to give it.

segments.arabic: فَلَو مَنعه إِيَّاهَا لم يكن قد مَنعه شَيْئا هُوَ لَهُ يسْتَحقّهُ عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: So if He withheld it from him, He would not have withheld from him something that [was] his [and that] he deserved from Him.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا لم يشْهد ذَلِك رَأْي فِيهِ أَهلا ومستحقا
segments.english: So when he does not witness that, he sees in himself [one who is] deserving and entitled.

segments.arabic: فأعجبه نَفسه وطغت بِالنعْمَةِ
segments.english: So his self amazes him, and it transgresses with the blessing.

segments.arabic: وعلت بهَا واستطالت على غَيرهَا
segments.english: And it rises with it and looks down upon others.

segments.arabic: فَكَانَ حظها مِنْهَا الْفَرح وَالْفَخْر
segments.english: So its share from it [was] joy and boasting.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: As [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَاهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ لَيَئُوسٌ كَفُورٌ
segments.english: "And if We let the human taste mercy from Us, then We take it away from him — he [is] surely despairing, ungrateful."
segments.sahih_international: And if We give man a taste of mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him, indeed, he is despairing and ungrateful.

segments.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ نَعْمَاءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئَاتُ عَنِّي إِنَّهُ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ
segments.english: "And if We let him taste good things after hardship [that] touched him, he will surely say: 'The bad things have gone from me.' He [is] surely joyful, boastful."
segments.sahih_international: But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful -

segments.arabic: فذمه باليأس وَالْكفْر عِنْد الامتحان بالبلاء
segments.english: So He blamed him for despair and ingratitude when tested with hardship.

segments.arabic: وبالفرح وَالْفَخْر عِنْد الِابْتِلَاء بالنعماء
segments.english: And for joy and boasting when tested with blessings.

segments.arabic: واستبدل بِحَمْد الله وشكره وَالثنَاء عَلَيْهِ إِذْ كشف عَنهُ الْبلَاء قَوْله ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئَاتُ عني
segments.english: And he replaced praising God and thanking Him and glorifying Him — when He removed the hardship from him — with his saying: "The bad things have gone from me."

segments.arabic: لَو أَنه قَالَ أذهب الله السَّيِّئَات عني برحمته وَمِنْه لما ذمّ على ذَلِك
segments.english: If he had said "God removed the bad things from me by His mercy and His grace," he would not have been blamed for that.

segments.arabic: بل كَانَ مَحْمُودًا عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: Rather, he would have been praised for it.

segments.arabic: وَلكنه غفل عَن الْمُنعم بكشفها
segments.english: But he was heedless of the One who blessed [him] by removing it.

segments.arabic: وَنسب الذّهاب إِلَيْهَا
segments.english: And he attributed the departure to it [itself].

segments.arabic: فَرح وافتخر
segments.english: [He] rejoiced and boasted.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا علم الله سُبْحَانَهُ هَذَا من قلب عبد
segments.english: So when God, glorified [is] He, knows this from the heart of [a] servant,

segments.arabic: فَذَلِك من أعظم أَسبَاب خذلانه وتخليه عَنهُ
segments.english: then that [is] among the greatest causes of abandoning him and leaving him.

segments.arabic: فَإِن مَحَله لَا تناسبه النِّعْمَة الْمُطلقَة التَّامَّة
segments.english: For his place does not suit the complete and total blessing.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: As [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَابِّ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الصُّمُّ الْبُكْمُ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
segments.english: "The worst of creatures before God [are] the deaf, the mute — those who do not understand."
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason.

segments.arabic: وَلَوْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا لَأَسْمَعَهُمْ وَلَوْ أَسْمَعَهُمْ لَتَوَلَّوْا وَهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ
segments.english: "And if God knew [any] good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He made them hear, they would have turned away while they [were] refusing."
segments.sahih_international: Had Allah known any good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He had made them hear, they would [still] have turned away, while they were refusing.

segments.arabic: فَأخْبر سُبْحَانَهُ أَن محلهم غير قَابل لنعمته
segments.english: So He informed, glorified [is] He, that their place [is] not accepting of His blessing.

segments.arabic: وَمَعَ عدم الْقبُول ففيهم مَانع آخر يمْنَع وصولها إِلَيْهِم
segments.english: And along with the lack of acceptance, there [is] in them another barrier preventing it from reaching them.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ توليهم وإعراضهم إِذا عرفوها وتحققوها
segments.english: And that [is] their turning away and their refusal when they recognize it and know it truly.

headings.arabic: فصل قال الله تعالى
headings.english: Section: [God] Most High said

segments.arabic: وَمِمَّا يَنْبَغِي أَن يعلم أَن أَسبَاب الخذلان من بَقَاء النَّفس على مَا خلقت عَلَيْهِ فِي الأَصْل وإهمالها وتخليتها
segments.english: And among what should be known [is] that the causes of abandonment [are] from the self remaining upon what it was created upon originally, and neglecting it and leaving it [alone].

segments.arabic: فأسباب الخذلان مِنْهَا وفيهَا
segments.english: So the causes of abandonment [are] from it and within it.

segments.arabic: وَأَسْبَاب التَّوْفِيق من جعل الله سُبْحَانَهُ لَهَا قَابِلَة للنعمة
segments.english: And the causes of success [are] from God, glorified [is] He, making it able to receive the blessing.

segments.arabic: فأسباب التَّوْفِيق مِنْهُ وَمن فَضله
segments.english: So the causes of success [are] from Him and from His grace.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ الْخَالِق لهَذِهِ وَهَذِه
segments.english: And He [is] the Creator of this and that.

segments.arabic: كَمَا خلق أَجزَاء الأَرْض هَذِه قَابِلَة للنبات وَهَذِه غير قَابِلَة لَهُ
segments.english: Just as He created parts of the earth — this [part] able [to produce] plants, and that [part] not able [to produce] them.

segments.arabic: وَخلق الشّجر هَذِه تقبل الثَّمَرَة وَهَذِه لَا تقبلهَا
segments.english: And He created trees — this [one] accepts fruit, and that [one] does not accept it.

segments.arabic: وَخلق النحلة قَابِلَة لِأَن يخرج من بطونها شراب مُخْتَلف ألوانه
segments.english: And He created the bee, able to produce from its belly [a] drink of different colors,

segments.arabic: والزنبور غير قَابل لذَلِك
segments.english: while the wasp [is] not able [to do] that.

segments.arabic: وَخلق الْأَرْوَاح الطّيبَة قَابِلَة لذكره وشكره وحجته وإجلاله وتعظيمه وتوحيده ونصيحة عباده
segments.english: And He created the good souls, able [to receive] remembrance of Him, gratitude to Him, His proof, honoring Him, glorifying Him, monotheism, and sincere advice to His servants.

segments.arabic: وَخلق الْأَرْوَاح الخبيثة غير قَابِلَة لذَلِك بل لضده
segments.english: And He created the evil souls, not able [to receive] that, but rather [able to receive] its opposite.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ الْحَكِيم الْعَلِيم
segments.english: And He [is] the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.

segments.arabic: قَالَ شيخ الْإِسْلَام بَحر الْعُلُوم مفتي الْفرق أَبُو الْعَبَّاس احْمَد بن تَيْمِية ﵀
segments.english: The Sheikh of Islam, the ocean of knowledge, the mufti of the groups, Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Taymiyyah, may God have mercy on him, said:

segments.arabic: فصل قَالَ الله تَعَالَى
segments.english: Section. [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: الم
segments.english: Alif, Lam, Mim.

segments.arabic: أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَنْ يُتْرَكُوا أَنْ يَقُولُوا آمَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ
segments.english: Do people think that they [will] be left [alone] because they say, 'We believe,' while they [are] not tested?
segments.sahih_international: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?

segments.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْكَاذِبِينَ
segments.english: And We certainly tested those before them, so God [will] surely know those who [are] truthful, and He [will] surely know the liars.
segments.sahih_international: But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.

segments.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ يَسْبِقُونَا سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
segments.english: Or do those who do evil deeds think that they [will] escape Us? How bad [is] what they judge!
segments.sahih_international: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us? Evil is what they judge.

segments.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُو لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ لَآتٍ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
segments.english: Whoever hopes for the meeting with God — then indeed the term of God [is] surely coming, and He [is] the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
segments.sahih_international: Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allah - indeed, the term decreed by Allah is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ جَاهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَاهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ
segments.english: And whoever strives, then he only strives for his own self. Indeed God [is] surely free of need of all the worlds.
segments.sahih_international: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds.

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ
segments.english: And those who believe and do righteous deeds — We [will] surely remove from them their evil deeds,
segments.sahih_international: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

segments.arabic: وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ الَّذِي كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
segments.english: and We [will] surely reward them [with] the best of what they used to do.

segments.arabic: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْأِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا
segments.english: And We instructed man to [treat] his parents [with] goodness.

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلا تُطِعْهُمَا
segments.english: And if they strive against you to make you associate with Me what you have no knowledge of, then do not obey them.
segments.sahih_international: And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.

segments.arabic: إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُم تعلمُونَ
segments.english: To Me [is] your return, and I [will] inform you of what you used to do.

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِي الصَّالِحِينَ
segments.english: And those who believe and do righteous deeds — We [will] surely enter them among the righteous.
segments.sahih_international: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].

segments.arabic: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَقُولُ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ فَإِذَا أُوذِيَ فِي اللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللَّهِ
segments.english: And among people [is he] who says, 'We believe in God,' but when he [is] harmed for [the sake of] God, he makes the trial of people like the punishment of God.
segments.sahih_international: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures?

segments.arabic: وَلَئِنْ جَاءَ نَصْرٌ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعكُمْ
segments.english: And if victory comes from your Lord, they [will] surely say, 'Indeed, we were with you.'

segments.arabic: أَو لَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ الْعَالَمِينَ
segments.english: [Is] God not most knowing of what [is] in the chests of [all] the worlds?

segments.arabic: وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ
segments.english: And God [will] surely know those who believe, and He [will] surely know the hypocrites.
segments.sahih_international: And Allah will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ الله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِكُمْ مَثَلُ
segments.english: Or did you think that you [would] enter Paradise while there has not yet come to you the example of...
segments.sahih_international: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while such [trial] has not yet come to you as came to those who passed on before you? They were touched by poverty and hardship and were shaken until [even their] messenger and those who believed with him said, "When is the help of Allah?" Unquestionably, the help of Allah is near.

segments.arabic: الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ مَسَّتْهُمُ الْبَأْسَاءُ وَالضَّرَّاءُ وَزُلْزِلُوا
segments.english: those who passed before you — hardship and suffering touched them and they were shaken,
segments.sahih_international: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while such [trial] has not yet come to you as came to those who passed on before you? They were touched by poverty and hardship and were shaken until [even their] messenger and those who believed with him said, "When is the help of Allah?" Unquestionably, the help of Allah is near.

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يَقُولَ الرَّسُولُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ مَتَى نَصْرُ اللَّهِ
segments.english: until the Messenger and those who believed with him said, 'When [will] the help of God [come]?'

segments.arabic: أَلا إِنَّ نَصْرَ اللَّهِ قريب
segments.english: Indeed, the help of God [is] near.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ الله تَعَالَى لما ذكر الْمُرْتَد وَالْمكْره بقوله
segments.english: And God Most High said — when He mentioned the one who turned back and the one who [was] forced — in His saying:

segments.arabic: مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ بعد إيمَانه
segments.english: Whoever disbelieved in God after his faith —
segments.sahih_international: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief... except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. But those who [willingly] open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from Allah, and for them is a great punishment;

segments.arabic: قَالَ بعد ذَلِك
segments.english: He said after that:

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوا ثُمَّ جَاهَدُوا وَصَبَرُوا
segments.english: Then indeed your Lord — for those who emigrated after they were tested, then struggled and [were] patient —
segments.sahih_international: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to renounce their religion] and thereafter fought [for the cause of Allah] and were patient - indeed, your Lord, after that, is Forgiving and Merciful

segments.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
segments.english: indeed your Lord, after that, [is] surely Forgiving, Merciful.

segments.arabic: فَالنَّاس إِذا أرسل إِلَيْهِم الرُّسُل بَين أَمريْن
segments.english: So people, when messengers are sent to them, [are] between two matters:

segments.arabic: إِمَّا أَن يَقُول أحدهم آمنا وَإِمَّا أَن لَا يَقُول آمنا بل يسْتَمر على عمل السَّيِّئَات
segments.english: either one of them says, 'We believe,' or he does not say, 'We believe,' but continues doing bad deeds.

segments.arabic: فَمن قَالَ آمنا امتحنه الرب ﷿ وابتلاه
segments.english: So whoever said, 'We believe,' the Lord, glorified and exalted [is] He, tests him and tries him,

segments.arabic: وَألبسهُ الِابْتِلَاء والاختبار ليبين الصَّادِق من الْكَاذِب
segments.english: and clothes him [in] trial and testing, to distinguish the truthful from the liar.

segments.arabic: وَمن لم يقل آمنا فَلَا يحْسب أَنه يسْبق الرب لتجربته
segments.english: And whoever did not say, 'We believe,' let him not think that he [will] outrun the Lord or [escape] His test,

segments.arabic: فَإِن أحدا لن يعجز الله تَعَالَى
segments.english: for indeed no one [will] ever escape God Most High.

segments.arabic: هَذِه سنته تَعَالَى يُرْسل الرُّسُل إِلَى الْخلق فيكذبهم النَّاس ويؤذنهم
segments.english: This [is] His way, Most High — He sends the messengers to creation, and people deny them and harm them.

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا شَيَاطِينَ الْأِنْسِ وَالْجِنّ
segments.english: And likewise We made for every prophet an enemy — devils of mankind and jinn.
segments.sahih_international: And thus We have made for every prophet an enemy - devils from mankind and jinn, inspiring to one another decorative speech in delusion. But if your Lord had willed, they would not have done it, so leave them and that which they invent.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: كَذَلِكَ مَا أَتَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُون
segments.english: Likewise, no messenger came to those before them except they said, '[He is a] sorcerer or [a] madman.'
segments.sahih_international: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ
segments.english: Nothing [is] said to you except what was already said to the messengers before you.
segments.sahih_international: Nothing is said to you, [O Muhammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.

segments.arabic: وَمن آمن بالرسل وأطاعهم عادوه وآذوه فَابْتلى بِمَا يؤلمه
segments.english: And whoever believed in the messengers and obeyed them — they opposed him and harmed him, so he [was] tested with what pains him.

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم يُؤمن بهم عُوقِبَ فَحصل مَا يؤلمه أعظم وأدوم
segments.english: And if he did not believe in them, he [was] punished, and what pains him [was] greater and longer lasting.

segments.arabic: فَلَا بُد من حُصُول الْأَلَم لكل نفس سَوَاء آمَنت أم كفرت
segments.english: So there [is] no escaping pain for every soul, whether it believed or disbelieved.

segments.arabic: لَكِن الْمُؤمن يحصل لَهُ الْأَلَم فِي الدُّنْيَا ابْتِدَاء
segments.english: But the believer — pain comes to him in this world at first,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ تكون لَهُ الْعَاقِبَة وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: then the [good] outcome and the Hereafter [are] his.

segments.arabic: وَالْكَافِر تحصل لَهُ النِّعْمَة ابْتِدَاء ثمَّ يصير فِي الْأَلَم
segments.english: And the disbeliever — comfort comes to him at first, then he ends up in pain.

segments.arabic: سَأَلَ رجل الشَّافِعِي فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عبد الله أَيّمَا أفضل للرجل أَن يمكَّن أَو يَبْتَلِي
segments.english: [A] man asked al-Shafi'i and said, 'O Abu Abdullah, which [is] better for [a] man — to be empowered or to be tested?'

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ الشَّافِعِي لَا يمكَّن حَتَّى يبتلى
segments.english: Al-Shafi'i said, 'He [will] not be empowered until he [is] tested.'

segments.arabic: فَإِن الله ابْتُلِيَ نوحًا وَإِبْرَاهِيم ومُوسَى وَعِيسَى ومحمدا صلوَات الله وَسَلَامه عَلَيْهِم أَجْمَعِينَ
segments.english: 'For indeed God tested Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus, and Muhammad — God's prayers and peace [be] upon them all.'

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا صَبَرُوا مكنهم
segments.english: 'And when they [were] patient, He empowered them.'

segments.arabic: فَلَا يظنّ أحد أَنه يخلص من الْأَلَم الْبَتَّةَ
segments.english: So let no one think that he [will] escape pain completely.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا أصل عَظِيم فَيَنْبَغِي للعاقل أَن يعرفهُ
segments.english: And this [is] [a] great principle, so the wise person should know it.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يحصل لكل أحد فَإِن الْإِنْسَان مدنِي بالطبع
segments.english: And this happens to everyone, for [a] human [is] social by nature.

segments.arabic: لَا بُد لَهُ من أَن يعِيش مَعَ النَّاس
segments.english: He must live with people.

segments.arabic: وَالنَّاس لَهُم إرادات وتصورات يطْلبُونَ مِنْهُ أَن يوافقهم عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: And people have desires and ideas — they demand from him that he agrees with them on these.

segments.arabic: وَإِن لم يوافقهم آذوه وعذبوه
segments.english: And if he does not agree with them, they harm him and punish him.

segments.arabic: وَإِن وافقهم حصل لَهُ الْأَذَى وَالْعَذَاب تَارَة مِنْهُم وَتارَة من غَيرهم
segments.english: And if he agrees with them, harm and punishment come to him — sometimes from them, and sometimes from others.

segments.arabic: وَمن اختبر أَحْوَاله وأحوال النَّاس وجد من هَذَا شَيْئا كثيرا
segments.english: And whoever examines his own situation and the situations of people [will] find much of this —

segments.arabic: كقوم يُرِيدُونَ الْفَوَاحِش وَالظُّلم
segments.english: like people who want immoral acts and wrongdoing.

segments.arabic: وَلَهُم أَقْوَال بَاطِلَة فِي الدّين أَو شرك
segments.english: And they have false statements in the religion, or associating partners [with God].

segments.arabic: فهم مرتكبون بعض مَا ذكره الله من الْمُحرمَات فِي قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: So they [are] committing some of what God mentioned of the forbidden things, in His saying, Most High:

segments.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظهر مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَالْأِثْمَ وَالْبَغْيَ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ
segments.english: Say: my Lord has only forbidden shameful deeds — what [is] apparent of them and what [is] hidden — and sin, and wrongful aggression without right,
segments.sahih_international: Say, "My Lord has only forbidden immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed - and sin, and oppression without right, and that you associate with Allah that for which He has not sent down authority, and that you say about Allah that which you do not know."

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُشْرِكُوا بِاللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطَانًا
segments.english: and that you associate with God what He [has] not sent down any proof for,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تَقُولُوا على الله مَا لَا تعلمُونَ
segments.english: and that you say about God what you do not know.

segments.arabic: وهم فِي مَكَان مُشْتَرك كدار جَامِعَة أَو خَان أَو قيسرية أَو مدرسة أَو رِبَاط أَو قَرْيَة أَو درب أَو مَدِينَة
segments.english: And they [are] in [a] shared place — like [a] communal house, or an inn, or [a] marketplace, or [a] school, or [a] hospice, or [a] village, or [a] street, or [a] city —

segments.arabic: فِيهَا غَيرهم
segments.english: in which [there are] others besides them.

segments.arabic: وهم لَا يتمكنون مِمَّا يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا بموافقة أُولَئِكَ أَو بسكوتهم عَن الْإِنْكَار عَلَيْهِم
segments.english: And they cannot achieve what they want except by the agreement of those [others], or by their silence from objecting to them.

segments.arabic: فيطلبون من أُولَئِكَ الْمُوَافقَة أَو السُّكُوت
segments.english: So they demand from those [people] agreement or silence.

segments.arabic: فَإِن وافقوهم أَو سكتوا سلمُوا من شرهم فِي الِابْتِلَاء
segments.english: If they agree with them or stay silent, they [are] safe from their evil in [terms of] trial.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ قد يتسلطون هم أنفسهم على أُولَئِكَ يهينونهم ويعاقبونهم أَضْعَاف مَا كَانَ أُولَئِكَ يخافونه ابْتِدَاء
segments.english: Then they themselves may overpower those [people], humiliating them and punishing them many times [more than] what those [people] feared at the beginning.

segments.arabic: كمن يطْلب مِنْهُ شَهَادَة الزُّور أَو الْكَلَام فِي الدّين بِالْبَاطِلِ
segments.english: Like someone [who is] asked to give false testimony, or to speak in the religion with falsehood —

segments.arabic: إِمَّا فِي الْخَبَر وَإِمَّا فِي الْأَمر
segments.english: either in matters of information or in matters of command —

segments.arabic: أَو المعاونة على الْفَاحِشَة وَالظُّلم
segments.english: or [asked] to help in indecency and injustice.

segments.arabic: فَإِن لم يجبهم آذوه وعادوه
segments.english: If he does not comply with them, they harm him and oppose him.

segments.arabic: وَإِن أجابهم فهم أنفسهم يتسلطون عَلَيْهِ فيهينونه ويؤذونه أَضْعَاف مَا كَانَ يخافه
segments.english: And if he complies with them, then they themselves overpower him, humiliating him and harming him many times [more than] what he used to fear.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا عذب بغيرهم
segments.english: And otherwise, he [is] punished by other than them.

segments.arabic: فَالْوَاجِب مَا فِي حَدِيث عَائِشَة الَّذِي بعثت بِهِ إِلَى مُعَاوِيَة
segments.english: So what [is] required [is] what [is] in the hadith of Aisha, which she sent to Muawiyah,

segments.arabic: ويروى مَوْقُوفا وَمَرْفُوعًا
segments.english: and [it is] narrated [both] as stopped [at the companion] and as raised [to the Prophet]:

segments.arabic: من أرْضى الله بسخط النَّاس كَفاهُ الله مُؤنَة النَّاس
segments.english: "Whoever pleases God [even] with the anger of people, God [will] spare him the trouble of people.

segments.arabic: وَفِي لفظ ﵁ وأرضى عَنهُ النَّاس
segments.english: And in [another] wording — may God be pleased with her — '[God] made the people pleased with him.'

segments.arabic: وَمن أرْضى النَّاس بسخط الله لم يغنوا عَنهُ من الله شَيْئا
segments.english: And whoever pleases the people with the anger of God, they [will] not help him against God [in] anything.

segments.arabic: وَفِي لفظ عَاد حامده من النَّاس ذامّا
segments.english: And in [another] wording: 'his praiser among the people turned into [a] blamer."

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يجْرِي فِيمَن يعين الْمُلُوك والرؤساء على أغراضهم الْفَاسِدَة
segments.english: And this applies to whoever helps the kings and leaders in their corrupt purposes,

segments.arabic: وفيمن يعين أهل الْبدع المنتسبين إِلَى الْعلم وَالدّين على بدعهم
segments.english: and to whoever helps the people of innovation — those who claim [to belong to] knowledge and religion — in their innovations.

segments.arabic: فَمن هداه الله وأرشده امْتنع من فعل الْمحرم وصبر على أذاهم وعداوتهم
segments.english: So whoever God guided and directed, he refrained from doing the forbidden and was patient with their harm and hostility.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ تكون الْعَاقِبَة فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة
segments.english: Then the outcome [is] in this world and the Hereafter —

segments.arabic: كَمَا جرى للرسل وأتباعهم مَعَ من آذاهم وعاداهم
segments.english: as [it] happened for the messengers and their followers, with those who harmed them and opposed them —

segments.arabic: مثل الْمُهَاجِرين فِي هَذِه الْأمة
segments.english: like the emigrants in this nation,

segments.arabic: وَمن ابْتُلِيَ من علمائها وعبادها وتجارها وولاتها
segments.english: and those who were tested from its scholars, its worshippers, its merchants, and its rulers.

segments.arabic: وَقد يجوز فِي بعض الْأُمُور إِظْهَار الْمُوَافقَة وإبطان الْمُخَالفَة كالمكره على الْكفْر
segments.english: And it may be permissible in some matters to show agreement while hiding disagreement, like the one forced into disbelief,

segments.arabic: كَمَا هُوَ مَبْسُوط فِي غير هَذَا الْموضع
segments.english: as it [is] explained in detail in other than this place.

segments.arabic: إِذْ الْمَقْصُود هُنَا أَنه لَا بُد من الِابْتِلَاء بِمَا يُؤْذِي النَّاس
segments.english: Since the purpose here [is] that there [is] no escape from trial with what harms people.

segments.arabic: فَلَا خلاص لأحد مِمَّا يُؤْذِيه الْبَتَّةَ
segments.english: So there [is] no escape for anyone from what harms him, ever.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا ذكر الله تَعَالَى فِي غير مَوضِع
segments.english: And for this [reason], God Most High mentioned in more than one place —

segments.arabic: أَنه لَا بُد أَن يَبْتَلِي النَّاس والابتلاء يكون بالسراء وَالضَّرَّاء
segments.english: that He must test people, and the testing [is] through ease and hardship

segments.arabic: وَلَا بُد أَن يبتلى الْإِنْسَان بِمَا يسره وَبِمَا يسوؤه
segments.english: and the human must be tested with what pleases him and with what harms him

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مُحْتَاج إِلَى أَن يكون صَابِرًا شكُورًا
segments.english: so he [is] in need of being patient [and] grateful

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
segments.english: [God] Most High said: "Indeed, We made what [is] on the earth [as] adornment for it, to test them [as to] which of them [is] best in deeds"
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى وَبَلَوْنَاهُمْ بِالْحَسَنَاتِ وَالسَّيِّئاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يرجعُونَ
segments.english: And [God] Most High said: "And We tested them with good [things] and bad [things], so that they might return"
segments.sahih_international: And We divided them throughout the earth into nations. Of them some were righteous, and of them some were otherwise. And We tested them with good [times] and bad that perhaps they would return [to obedience].

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ مِنِّي هُدىً فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلا يَضِلُّ وَلا يَشْقَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said: "Then if there comes to you from Me guidance, then whoever follows My guidance [will] not go astray and not suffer"
segments.sahih_international: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْ ذِكْرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُ معيشة ضنكا وَنَحْشُرُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أعمى
segments.english: "And whoever turns away from My remembrance, then indeed for him [is a] tight life, and We [will] gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind"
segments.sahih_international: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا مِنْكُمْ وَيَعْلَمَ الصَّابِرِينَ
segments.english: And [God] Most High said: "Or did you think you [would] enter Paradise while God has not yet known those among you who struggled, and known the patient ones?"
segments.sahih_international: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while Allah has not yet made evident those of you who fight in His cause and made evident those who are steadfast?

segments.arabic: هَذَا فِي آل عمرَان وَقد قَالَ قبل ذَلِك فِي الْبَقَرَة نزل أَكْثَرهَا قبل آل عمرَان
segments.english: This [is] in Aal Imran, and He had said before that in al-Baqarah — most of which [was] revealed before Aal Imran:

segments.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِكُمْ مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ
segments.english: "Or did you think you [would] enter Paradise while there has not yet come to you the example of those who passed before you?"
segments.sahih_international: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while such [trial] has not yet come to you as came to those who passed on before you? They were touched by poverty and hardship and were shaken until [even their] messenger and those who believed with him said, "When is the help of Allah?" Unquestionably, the help of Allah is near.

segments.arabic: مَسَّتْهُمُ الْبَأْسَاءُ وَالضَّرَّاءُ وَزُلْزِلُوا حَتَّى يَقُولَ الرَّسُولُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ مَتَى نَصْرُ اللَّهِ
segments.english: "Hardship and harm touched them and they were shaken, until the Messenger and those who believed with him said: When [will] the help of God [come]?"

segments.arabic: أَلا إِنَّ نَصْرَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ
segments.english: "Indeed, the help of God [is] near"

segments.arabic: وَذَلِكَ أَن النَّفس لَا تزكو وَتصْلح حَتَّى تمحص بالبلاء
segments.english: And that [is] because the self does not become pure or upright until it [is] refined through trials

segments.arabic: كالذهب الَّذِي لَا يخلص جيده من رديئه حَتَّى يفتن فِي كبر الامتحان
segments.english: like gold whose good [part] cannot be separated from its bad [part] until it [is] smelted in the furnace of testing

segments.arabic: إِذْ كَانَت النَّفس جاهلة ظالمة وَهِي منشأ كل شَرّ يحصل للْعَبد
segments.english: since the self [was] ignorant [and] wrongdoing, and it [is] the source of every evil that happens to the servant

segments.arabic: فَلَا يحصل لَهُ شَرّ إِلَّا مِنْهَا
segments.english: so no evil happens to him except from it

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى مَا أَصَابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ وَمَا أَصَابَكَ مِنْ سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِنْ نَفسك
segments.english: [God] Most High said: "Whatever good reaches you [is] from God, and whatever bad reaches you [is] from yourself"
segments.sahih_international: What comes to you of good is from Allah, but what comes to you of evil, [O man], is from yourself. And We have sent you, [O Muhammad], to the people as a messenger, and sufficient is Allah as Witness.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى أَو لما أَصَابَتْكُم مُصِيبَة من مُصِيبَةٌ قَدْ أَصَبْتُمْ مِثْلَيْهَا قُلْتُمْ أَنَّى هَذَا
segments.english: And [God] Most High said: "And when [a] disaster struck you — [one] you had [already] struck [them with] twice its like — you said: How [is] this?"
segments.sahih_international: Why [is it that] when a [single] disaster struck you [on the day of Uhud], although you had struck [the enemy in the battle of Badr] with one twice as great, you said, "From where is this?" Say, "It is from yourselves." Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

segments.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ أَنْفُسِكُمْ
segments.english: "Say: It [is] from yourselves"

segments.arabic: ﴿وَقَالَ﴾ وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ من مُصِيبَة فِيمَا كسبت أيدكم وَيَعْفُو عَنْ كَثِيرٍ
segments.english: And [God] said: "And whatever disaster strikes you, [it is] because of what your hands have earned, and He pardons much"
segments.sahih_international: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِعْمَةً أَنْعَمَهَا عَلَى قَوْمٍ حَتَّى يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنْفسِهِم
segments.english: And [God] Most High said: "That [is] because God [would] not change [a] blessing He had blessed upon [a] people until they change what [is] in themselves"
segments.sahih_international: That is because Allah would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا أَرَادَ الله بِقوم سوءا فَلَا مرد لَهُ ومالهم من دونه من وَال
segments.english: "And when God intends evil for [a] people, there [is] no turning it back, and they have no protector besides Him"
segments.sahih_international: For each one are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allah. Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allah intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron.

segments.arabic: وَقد ذكر عقوبات الْأُمَم من آدم إِلَى آخر وَقت
segments.english: And He has mentioned the punishments of the nations from Adam to the last time

segments.arabic: وَفِي كل ذَلِك يَقُول إِنَّهُم ظلمُوا أنفسهم فهم الظَّالِمُونَ لَا المظلومون
segments.english: and in all of that He says that they wronged themselves — so they [are] the wrongdoers, not the wronged

segments.arabic: وَأول من اعْترف بذلك أبواهم
segments.english: and the first to admit that [were] their parents

segments.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ من الخاسرين
segments.english: They both said: "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we [will] surely be among the losers"
segments.sahih_international: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ لإبليس
segments.english: And He said to Iblis:

segments.arabic: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ وَمِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
segments.english: "I [will] surely fill Hell with you and with whoever follows you from among them, all together"
segments.sahih_international: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."

segments.arabic: وإبليس إِنَّمَا اتبعهُ الغواة مِنْهُم كَمَا قَالَ
segments.english: And Iblis — only the misguided among them followed him, as he said:

segments.arabic: فبمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
segments.english: "Because You have led me astray, I [will] surely make [things] attractive for them on the earth, and I [will] surely lead them all astray"
segments.sahih_international: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all

segments.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُم المخلصين
segments.english: "except Your servants among them, the sincere ones"

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى إِنَّ عِبَادِي
segments.english: And [God] Most High said: "Indeed, My servants—"

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ
segments.english: You have no authority over them, except whoever followed you from the deviants
segments.sahih_international: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

segments.arabic: والغي اتّباع هوى النَّفس
segments.english: And deviation [is] following the desire of the self.

segments.arabic: وَمَا زَالَ السّلف معترفون بذلك
segments.english: And the early [Muslims] continued to acknowledge that,

segments.arabic: كَقَوْل أبي بكر وَعمر وَابْن مَسْعُود
segments.english: like the saying of Abu Bakr, Umar, and Ibn Mas'ud:

segments.arabic: أَقُول فِيهَا برأيي فَإِن يكن صَوَابا فَمن الله
segments.english: "I say regarding it with my [own] opinion, so if it [is] correct, then [it is] from God,

segments.arabic: وَإِن يكن خطأ فمني وَمن الشَّيْطَان وَالله وَرَسُوله بريئان مِنْهُ
segments.english: and if it [is] wrong, then [it is] from me and from Satan, and God and His Messenger [are] free of it."

segments.arabic: وَفِي الحَدِيث الإلهي حَدِيث أبي ذَر الَّذِي يرويهِ الرَّسُول عَن ربه ﷿
segments.english: And in the divine hadith — the hadith of Abu Dharr — which the Messenger narrates from his Lord, glorified and Most High:

segments.arabic: يَا عبَادي إِنَّمَا هِيَ أَعمالكُم أحصيها لكم
segments.english: "O My servants, they [are] only your deeds — I count them for you,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أوفيكم إِيَّاهَا
segments.english: then I repay you for them in full.

segments.arabic: فَمن وجد خيرا فليحمد الله
segments.english: So whoever finds good, let him praise God,

segments.arabic: وَمن وجد غير ذَلِك فَلَا يَلُومن إِلَّا نَفسه
segments.english: and whoever finds other than that, let him not blame [anyone] except himself."

segments.arabic: وَفِي الحَدِيث الصَّحِيح حَدِيث سيد الاسْتِغْفَار أَن يَقُول العَبْد
segments.english: And in the authentic hadith — the hadith of the master of seeking forgiveness — [is] that the servant says:

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْت رَبِّي لَا إِلَه إِلَّا أَنْت خلقتني وَأَنا عَبدك
segments.english: "O God, You [are] my Lord, there [is] no god except You, You created me and I [am] Your servant,

segments.arabic: وَأَنا على عَهْدك وَوَعدك مَا اسْتَطَعْت
segments.english: and I [am] upon Your covenant and Your promise as much as I can.

segments.arabic: أعوذ بك من شَرّ مَا صنعت
segments.english: I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done.

segments.arabic: وأبوء لَك بنعمتك عَليّ وأبوء بذنبي
segments.english: I acknowledge to You Your blessing upon me, and I acknowledge my sin.

segments.arabic: فَاغْفِر لي إِنَّه لَا يغْفر الذُّنُوب إِلَّا أَنْت
segments.english: So forgive me, for none forgives sins except You."

segments.arabic: من قَالَهَا إِذا أصبح موقنا بهَا فَمَاتَ من يَوْمه دخل الْجنَّة
segments.english: Whoever says it when he reaches morning, having certainty in it, and dies that day — [he] enters Paradise.

segments.arabic: وَمن قَالَهَا إِذا أَمْسَى موقنا بهَا فَمَاتَ من ليلته دخل الْجنَّة
segments.english: And whoever says it when he reaches evening, having certainty in it, and dies that night — [he] enters Paradise.

segments.arabic: وَفِي حَدِيث أبي بكر الصّديق من طَرِيق أبي هُرَيْرَة وَعبد الله بن عَمْرو
segments.english: And in the hadith of Abu Bakr al-Siddiq, through the route of Abu Hurayrah and Abdullah ibn Amr,

segments.arabic: أَن رَسُول الله علّمه مَا يَقُوله إِذا أصبح وَإِذا أَمْسَى وَإِذا أَخذ مضجعه
segments.english: that the Messenger of God taught him what to say when he reaches morning, when he reaches evening, and when he goes to his bed:

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فاطر السَّمَاوَات وَالْأَرْض عَالم الْغَيْب وَالشَّهَادَة
segments.english: "O God, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen,

segments.arabic: رب كل شَيْء ومليكه
segments.english: Lord of everything and its King,

segments.arabic: أشهد أَن لَا اله إِلَّا أَنْت
segments.english: I bear witness that there [is] no god except You.

segments.arabic: أعوذ بك من شَرّ نَفسِي وَشر الشَّيْطَان وشركه
segments.english: I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, the evil of Satan, and his traps,

segments.arabic: وان أقترف على نَفسِي سوءا أَو أجرّه إِلَى مُسلم
segments.english: and from committing evil against myself or dragging it upon [a] Muslim."

segments.arabic: قله إِذا أَصبَحت وَإِذا أمسيت وَإِذا أخذت مضجعك
segments.english: "Say it when you reach morning, when you reach evening, and when you go to your bed."

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ النَّبِي يَقُول فِي خطبَته
segments.english: And the Prophet used to say in his sermon:

segments.arabic: الْحَمد لله نستعينه وَنَسْتَغْفِرهُ ونعوذ بِاللَّه من شرور أَنْفُسنَا وَمن سيئات أَعمالنَا
segments.english: "All praise [is] for God, we seek His help and seek His forgiveness, and we seek refuge in God from the evils of ourselves and from the bad [deeds] of our actions."

segments.arabic: وَقد قَالَ النَّبِي إِنِّي آخذ بحجزكم عَن النَّار وَأَنْتُم تهافتون تهافت الْفراش
segments.english: And the Prophet said: "I [am] holding you back by your waistbands from the Fire, and you [are] rushing in like moths rush [in]."

segments.arabic: شبههم بالفراش لجهله وخفة حركته
segments.english: He compared them to moths because of their ignorance and the lightness of their movement.

segments.arabic: وَهِي صَغِيرَة النَّفس فَإِنَّهَا جاهلة سريعة الْحَرَكَة
segments.english: And they [are] small in self, for they [are] ignorant [and] quick in movement.

segments.arabic: وَفِي الحَدِيث مثل الْقلب مثل ريشة ملقاة بِأَرْض فلاة
segments.english: And in the hadith: "The likeness of the heart [is] like [a] feather thrown in [an] open land."

segments.arabic: وَفِي حَدِيث آخر للقلب أَشد تقلبا من الْقدر إِذا استجمعت غليانا
segments.english: And in another hadith: "The heart [is] more changeable than [a] pot when it reaches full boiling."

segments.arabic: وَمَعْلُوم سرعَة حَرَكَة الريشة وَالْقدر مَعَ الْجَهْل
segments.english: And [it is] known — the speed of movement of the feather and the pot — along with ignorance.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا يُقَال لمن أطَاع من يغويه أَنه استخفه
segments.english: And for this reason, it [is] said about whoever obeys the one who leads him astray — that he made him light-minded.

segments.arabic: قَالَ عَن فِرْعَوْن إِنَّه استخف قومه فأطاعوه
segments.english: [God] said about Pharaoh: "He made his people light-minded, so they obeyed him."

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
segments.english: So be patient, for the promise of God [is] true, and let not those who have no certainty make you light-minded
segments.sahih_international: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْخَفِيف لَا يثبت بل يطيش
segments.english: For the light [thing] does not stay firm, rather it sways.

segments.arabic: وَصَاحب الْيَقِين ثَابت
segments.english: And the person of certainty [is] firm.

segments.arabic: يُقَال أَيقَن إِذا كَانَ مُسْتَقرًّا
segments.english: It [is] said "[he] became certain" when he was settled.

segments.arabic: وَالْيَقِين واستقرار الإيمان فِي الْقلب علما وَعَملا
segments.english: And certainty [is] the settling of faith in the heart — [in] knowledge and action.

segments.arabic: فقد يكون علم العَبْد جيدا لَكِن نَفسه لَا تصبر عِنْد المصائب بل تطيش
segments.english: So the servant's knowledge may be good, but his self does not have patience at [times of] hardship, rather it sways.

segments.arabic: قَالَ الْحسن الْبَصْرِيّ إِذا شِئْت أَن ترى بَصيرًا لَا صَبر لَهُ رَأَيْته
segments.english: Al-Hasan al-Basri said: "If you wished to see [a] person of insight with no patience, you [would] see him.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا شِئْت أَن ترى صَابِرًا لَا بَصِيرَة لَهُ رَأَيْته
segments.english: And if you wished to see [a] patient person with no insight, you [would] see him.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا رَأَيْت بَصيرًا صَابِرًا فَذَاك
segments.english: But if you saw [a] person of insight [who is] patient — then that [is it]."

segments.arabic: قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا وَكَانُوا بِآياتِنَا يوقنون﴾
segments.english: And We made from among them leaders who guide by Our command, when they were patient and had certainty in Our signs.
segments.sahih_international: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.

segments.arabic: وَلِهَذَا تشبه النَّفس بالنَّار فِي سرعَة حركتها وإفسادها
segments.english: And for this [reason], the self [is] compared to fire in the speed of its movement and its corruption.

segments.arabic: وغضبها وشهوتها من النَّار
segments.english: And its anger and its desire [are] from fire.

segments.arabic: والشيطان من النَّار
segments.english: And Satan [is] from fire.

segments.arabic: وَفِي السّنَن عَن النَّبِي أَنه قَالَ
segments.english: And in the Sunan, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said:

segments.arabic: الْغَضَب من الشَّيْطَان والشيطان من النَّار وَإِنَّمَا تطفأ النَّار بِالْمَاءِ
segments.english: "Anger [is] from Satan, and Satan [is] from fire, and fire [is] only put out with water.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا غضب أحدكُم فليتوضأ
segments.english: So if one of you becomes angry, let him make ablution."

segments.arabic: وَفِي الحَدِيث الآخر
segments.english: And in the other hadith:

segments.arabic: الْغَضَب جَمْرَة توقد فِي جَوف ابْن آدم
segments.english: "Anger [is] [a] burning coal lit in the belly of the son of Adam.

segments.arabic: أَلا ترى إِلَى حمرَة عَيْنَيْهِ وانتفاخ أوداجه
segments.english: Do you not see the redness of his eyes and the swelling of his veins?"

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ غليان دم الْقلب لطلب الانتقام
segments.english: And it [is] the boiling of the blood of the heart, seeking revenge.

segments.arabic: وَفِي الحَدِيث الْمُتَّفق على صِحَّته
segments.english: And in the hadith agreed upon [as] authentic:

segments.arabic: إِن الشَّيْطَان يجْرِي من ابْن آدم مجْرى الدَّم
segments.english: "Satan flows through the son of Adam [the way] blood flows."

segments.arabic: وَفِي الصَّحِيحَيْنِ أَن رجلَيْنِ اسْتَبَّا عِنْد النَّبِي
segments.english: And in the two Sahihs, two men insulted each other in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ,

segments.arabic: وَقد اشْتَدَّ غضب أَحدهمَا
segments.english: and the anger of one of them had become intense.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ النَّبِي إِنِّي لأعْلم كلمة لَو قَالَهَا لذهب عَنهُ مَا يجد
segments.english: So the Prophet ﷺ said: "I know [a] word — if he said it, what he [is] feeling would leave him.

segments.arabic: لَو قَالَ أعوذ بِاللَّه من الشَّيْطَان الرَّجِيم
segments.english: If he said: 'I seek refuge in God from the accursed Satan.'"

segments.arabic: وَقد قَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أحسن فَإِذَا الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَاوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ﴾
segments.english: Repel [evil] with that which [is] better, and then the one between you and him [there was] hatred [will become] as if he [were] [a] close friend.
segments.sahih_international: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.

segments.arabic: ﴿وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ﴾
segments.english: And none [is] granted it except those who were patient, and none [is] granted it except the possessor of [a] great fortune.
segments.sahih_international: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].

segments.arabic: ﴿وَإِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ﴾
segments.english: And if [a] provocation from Satan provokes you, then seek refuge in God. He — He [is] the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
segments.sahih_international: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿خُذِ الْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجَاهِلِينَ﴾
segments.english: Take [to] forgiveness, and command what [is] right, and turn away from the ignorant.
segments.sahih_international: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.

segments.arabic: ﴿وَإِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾
segments.english: And if [a] provocation from Satan provokes you, then seek refuge in God. He [is] All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
segments.sahih_international: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing.

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ تَعَالَى
segments.english: And [God] Most High said:

segments.arabic: ﴿ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ﴾
segments.english: Repel the evil with that which [is] better. We [are] most knowing of what they describe.
segments.sahih_international: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.

segments.arabic: ﴿وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ﴾
segments.english: And say: "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of the devils."
segments.sahih_international: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

segments.arabic: ﴿وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ﴾
