segments.english: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from them being present [with me]."
segments.sahih_international: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

segments.arabic: تمّ الْكتاب وَالْحَمْد لله أَولا وآخرا
segments.english: The book [is] completed, and [all] praise [is] for God, first and last.

segments.arabic: وَصلى الله على رَسُولنَا مُحَمَّد النَّبِي الْأُمِّي وعَلى آله وَصَحبه وتابعيه
segments.english: And may God send blessings upon our Messenger Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and upon his family, his companions, and his followers,

segments.arabic: والمقتدين بآثارهم إِلَى يَوْم الدّين
segments.english: and those who follow in their footsteps until the Day of Judgment.

segments.arabic: وَآخر دعوانا أَن الْحَمد لله رب الْعَالمين
segments.english: And the last of our prayer [is] that [all] praise [is] for God, Lord of all the worlds.

headings.arabic: فصل القرآن كلام الله وقد تجلى الله فيه لعباده وصفاته فتارة يتجلى في
headings.english: Chapter: The Quran [is] the speech of God, and God has revealed Himself in it to His servants [through] His attributes — sometimes He reveals [Himself] in

segments.arabic: لخمر الْهوى فَكلما طيبت الثَّوْب فاحت رَائِحَة الْمُسكر من تَحْتَهُ
segments.english: for the wine of desire. So whenever you perfume the garment, the smell of the intoxicant wafts from beneath it.

segments.arabic: فتباعد مِنْك الصادقون وانحاز إِلَيْك الْفَاسِقُونَ
segments.english: So the truthful ones distance themselves from you, and the sinful ones draw close to you.

segments.arabic: يدْخل عَلَيْك لص الْهوى وَأَنت فِي زَاوِيَة التَّعَبُّد
segments.english: The thief of desire enters upon you while you [are] in the corner of worship,

segments.arabic: فلايرى مِنْك طردا لَهُ فَلَا يزَال بك حَتَّى يخْرجك من الْمَسْجِد
segments.english: and [he] sees no rejection from you toward him, so he keeps at you until he drives you out of the mosque.

segments.arabic: أصدق فِي الطّلب وَقد جاءتك المعونة
segments.english: Be sincere in [your] seeking, for the aid has already come to you.

segments.arabic: فَقَالَ رجل لمعروف عَلمنِي الْمحبَّة فَقَالَ الْمحبَّة لَا تَجِيء بالتعليم
segments.english: A man said to Ma'ruf, "Teach me love." He said, "Love does not come through teaching."

segments.arabic: هُوَ الشوق مدلولا على مقتل الفنا ... إِذا لم يعد صبا بلقيا حَبِيبه
segments.english: It [is] longing, led to the place where one perishes … if he does not return [as a] lover by meeting his beloved.

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ العجيب من قَوْله يحبونه إِنَّمَا الْعجب من قَوْله يُحِبهُمْ
segments.english: The wonder [is] not in His saying "they love Him" — rather, the wonder [is] in His saying "He loves them."

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ الْعجب من فَقير مِسْكين يحب محسنا إِلَيْهِ
segments.english: The wonder [is] not from [a] poor, needy person loving one who [is] good to him.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا الْعجب من محسن يحب فَقِيرا مِسْكينا
segments.english: Rather, the wonder [is] from [a] benefactor loving [a] poor, needy person.

segments.arabic: فصل الْقُرْآن كَلَام الله وَقد تجلى الله فِيهِ لِعِبَادِهِ وَصِفَاته
segments.english: Chapter: The Quran [is] the speech of God, and God has revealed Himself in it to His servants [through] His attributes.

segments.arabic: فَتَارَة يتجلى فِي جِلْبَاب الهيبة وَالْعَظَمَة والجلال
segments.english: So sometimes He reveals [Himself] in the garment of awe, greatness, and majesty,

segments.arabic: فتخضع الْأَعْنَاق وتنكسر النُّفُوس وتخشع الْأَصْوَات
segments.english: so the necks submit, and the souls break, and the voices humble [themselves],

segments.arabic: ويذوب الْكبر كَمَا يذوب الْملح فِي المَاء
segments.english: and arrogance melts as salt melts in water.

segments.arabic: وَتارَة يتجلى فِي صِفَات الْجمال والكمال
segments.english: And sometimes He reveals [Himself] in the attributes of beauty and perfection —

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ كَمَال الْأَسْمَاء وجمال الصِّفَات وجمال الْأَفْعَال الدَّال على كَمَال الذَّات
segments.english: and that [is] the perfection of the Names, and the beauty of the Attributes, and the beauty of the Actions, pointing to the perfection of the Essence.

segments.arabic: فيستنفد حبه من قلب العَبْد قُوَّة الْحبّ كلهَا
segments.english: So His love draws out from the heart of the servant the entire strength of love,

segments.arabic: بحب مَا عرفه من صِفَات جماله ونعوت كَمَاله
segments.english: through loving what he has known of the attributes of His beauty and the descriptions of His perfection.

segments.arabic: فَيُصْبِح فؤاد عَبده فَارغًا إِلَّا من محبته
segments.english: So the heart of His servant becomes empty except of His love.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أَرَادَ مِنْهُ الغيران يعلق تِلْكَ الْمحبَّة بِهِ
segments.english: And when [a] rival wants him to attach that love to himself [instead],

segments.arabic: أَبى قلبه وأحشاؤه ذَلِك كل الإباء
segments.english: his heart and his innermost [being] refuse that with complete refusal.

segments.arabic: كَمَا قيل يُرَاد من الْقلب نسيانكم ... وتأبى الطباع على النَّاقِل
segments.english: As it was said: "The heart [is] asked to forget you … but nature refuses the one who [would] change [it]."

segments.arabic: فَتبقى الْمحبَّة لَهُ طبعا لَا تكلفا
segments.english: So love for Him remains [as] nature, not [as] forced effort.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا تجلى بِصِفَات الرَّحْمَة وَالْبر واللطف وَالْإِحْسَان
segments.english: And when He reveals [Himself] through the attributes of mercy, goodness, gentleness, and kindness,

segments.arabic: انبعثت قُوَّة الرَّجَاء من العَبْد وانبسط أمله
segments.english: the strength of hope rises from the servant, and his expectation expands,

segments.arabic: وَقَوي طمعه وَسَار إِلَى ربه
segments.english: and his longing grows strong, and he journeys toward his Lord,

segments.arabic: وحادى الرَّجَاء يَحْدُو ركاب سيره
segments.english: with the driver of hope driving the caravan of his journey.

segments.arabic: وَكلما قوي الرَّجَاء جد فِي الْعَمَل
segments.english: And whenever hope grows stronger, he strives harder in [his] deeds,

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَن الباذر كلما قوي طمعه فِي الْمغل غلق أرضه بالبذر
segments.english: just as the sower — whenever his desire for the harvest grows stronger — fills his land with seeds.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا ضعف رجاؤه قصر فِي الْبذر
segments.english: And when his hope weakens, he falls short in [his] sowing.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا تجلى بِصِفَات الْعدْل والانتقام
segments.english: And when He reveals [Himself] through the attributes of justice and retribution —

headings.arabic: فائدة لا تتم الرغبة في الآخرة إلا بالزهد في الدنيا ولا يستقيم الزهد
headings.english: Benefit: Desire for the Hereafter [is] not complete except through detachment from this world, and detachment [is] not sound

segments.arabic: فأجمل فِي لَفْظَة بِشَرْطِهِ مَا يَتَرَتَّب على الذَّنب من الْآثَار المحبوبة لله
segments.english: So He gathered in [a] single word — with its condition — what results from sin of effects beloved to God:

segments.arabic: من التَّوْبَة والانكسار والندم والخضوع والذل والبكاء وَغير ذَلِك
segments.english: from repentance, brokenness, regret, humility, lowliness, weeping, and other than that.

segments.arabic: فَائِدَة لَا تتمّ الرَّغْبَة فِي الْآخِرَة إِلَّا بالزهد فِي الدُّنْيَا
segments.english: Benefit: Desire for the Hereafter [is] not complete except through detachment from this world,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يَسْتَقِيم الزّهْد فِي الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا بعد نظرين صَحِيحَيْنِ
segments.english: and detachment from this world [is] not sound except after two correct considerations.

segments.arabic: نظر فِي الدُّنْيَا وَسُرْعَة زَوَالهَا وفنائها واضمحلالها ونقصها وخسّتها
segments.english: A consideration of this world: the speed of its passing, its perishing, its fading away, its deficiency, and its lowness,

segments.arabic: وألم الْمُزَاحمَة عَلَيْهَا والحرص عَلَيْهَا وَمَا فِي ذَلِك من الْغصَص والنغص والأنكاد
segments.english: and the pain of competing over it and being greedy for it, and what [is] in that of choking grief, bitterness, and misery,

segments.arabic: وَآخر ذَلِك الزَّوَال والانقطاع مَعَ مَا يعقب من الْحَسْرَة والأسف
segments.english: and the end of that [is] disappearance and cutting off, along with the regret and sorrow that follow.

segments.arabic: فطالبها لَا يَنْفَكّ من هم قبل حُصُولهَا وهم حَال الظفر بهَا وغم وحزن بعد فَوَاتهَا
segments.english: So the one who seeks it [is] never free from worry before getting it, worry at the time of winning it, and grief and sadness after losing it.

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا أحد النظرين
segments.english: So this [is] the first of the two considerations.

segments.arabic: النّظر الثَّانِي النّظر فِي الْآخِرَة وإقبالها ومجيئها وَلَا بُد
segments.english: The second consideration: [a] consideration of the Hereafter — its approach and its coming without doubt,

segments.arabic: ودوامها وبقائها وَشرف مَا فِيهَا من الْخيرَات والمسرات
segments.english: and its permanence and its lasting, and the nobility of what [is] in it of good things and joys,

segments.arabic: والتفاوت الَّذِي بَينه وَبَين مَا هُنَا
segments.english: and the vast difference between it and what [is] here.

segments.arabic: فهى كَمَال الله سُبْحَانَهُ
segments.english: For it [is] from the perfection of God, glorified [is] He.

segments.arabic: ﴿وَالْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأبقى﴾
segments.english: And the Hereafter [is] better and more lasting.

segments.arabic: فَهِيَ خيرات كَامِلَة دائمة وَهَذِه خيالات نَاقِصَة مُنْقَطِعَة مضمحلة
segments.english: So it [is] complete, lasting good things, while these [are] deficient, fleeting, fading illusions.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا تمّ لَهُ هَذَانِ النظران آثر مَا يَقْتَضِي الْعقل إيثاره
segments.english: So when these two considerations [are] complete for him, he prefers what the intellect demands [that he] prefer,

segments.arabic: وزهد فِيمَا يَقْتَضِي الزّهْد فِيهِ
segments.english: and he detaches from what [it] demands detachment from.

segments.arabic: فَكل أحد مطبوع على أَن لَا يتْرك النَّفْع العاجل واللذة الْحَاضِرَة إِلَى النَّفْع الآجل واللذة الغائبة المنتظرة
segments.english: For every person [is] naturally inclined not to leave immediate benefit and present pleasure for delayed benefit and absent, awaited pleasure —

segments.arabic: الى إِذا تبين لَهُ فضل الآجل على العاجل وقويت رغبته فِي الْأَعْلَى الْأَفْضَل
segments.english: unless the superiority of the delayed over the immediate becomes clear to him and his desire for the higher and better grows strong.

segments.arabic: فَإِذا آثر الفاني النَّاقِص كَانَ ذَلِك إِمَّا لعدم تبين الْفضل لَهُ وَإِمَّا لعدم رغبته فِي الْأَفْضَل
segments.english: So if he prefers what [is] perishing [and] deficient, that [is] either because the superiority [was] not clear to him, or because of [a] lack of desire in him for what [is] better.

segments.arabic: وكل وَاحِد من الْأَمريْنِ يدل على ضعف الْإِيمَان وَضعف الْعقل والبصيرة
segments.english: And each one of these two matters points to weakness of faith and weakness of intellect and insight.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الرَّاغِب فِي الدُّنْيَا الْحَرِيص عَلَيْهِ الْمُؤثر لَهَا
segments.english: For the one who desires this world, [who is] greedy for it, [who] prefers it —

segments.arabic: إِمَّا أَن يصدّق بِأَن مَا هُنَاكَ أشرف وَأفضل وَأبقى وَإِمَّا أَن لَا يصدّق بذلك
segments.english: either he believes that what [is] there [is] nobler, better, and more lasting, or he does not believe in that.

segments.arabic: كَانَ عادما للْإيمَان رَأْسا
segments.english: [If he does not believe], then he [is] lacking faith entirely.

segments.arabic: وَإِن صدّق بذلك وَلم يؤثره كَانَ فَاسد الْعقل سيء الِاخْتِيَار لنَفسِهِ
segments.english: And if he believes in that but does not prefer it, then he [is] corrupt in intellect, bad in his choice for himself.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا تَقْسِيم حَاضر ضَرُورِيّ لَا يَنْفَكّ العَبْد من أحد الْقسمَيْنِ مِنْهُ
segments.english: And this [is] an obvious, necessary division — the servant [is] never free from one of the two categories.

segments.arabic: فإيثار الدُّنْيَا على الْآخِرَة
segments.english: So preferring this world over the Hereafter —

headings.arabic: فَائِدَة جليلة إِنَّمَا يجد الْمَشَقَّة فِي ترك المألوفات والعوائد من تَركهَا لغير الله
headings.english: A Great Benefit: Only the one who leaves habits and customs for other than God finds difficulty in leaving them

segments.arabic: من جعل الْإِيمَان مَا لَا يعْتَبر فِي الْإِيمَان
segments.english: whoever counted as faith what [is] not considered [part] of faith,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من جعله مَا هُوَ شَرط فِيهِ وَلَا يَكْفِي فِي حُصُوله
segments.english: and among them [is] whoever made it [to be] what [is merely] a condition for it but [is] not enough for its attainment,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من اشْترط فِي ثُبُوته مَا يناقضه ويضاده
segments.english: and among them [is] whoever required for its establishment what contradicts it and opposes it,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْهُم من اشْترط فِيهِ مَا لَيْسَ مِنْهُ بِوَجْه
segments.english: and among them [is] whoever required in it what [is] not from it in any way.

segments.arabic: وَالْإِيمَان وَرَاء ذَلِك كُله
segments.english: And faith [is] beyond all of that.

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ حَقِيقَة مركبة من معرفَة مَا جَاءَ بِهِ الرَّسُول علما والتصديق بِهِ عقدا
segments.english: And it [is] a reality composed of knowing what the Messenger brought [as] knowledge, and affirming it [as] belief,

segments.arabic: وَالْإِقْرَار بِهِ نطقا والانقياد لَهُ محبَّة وخضوعا
segments.english: and declaring it [as] speech, and submitting to it [with] love and humility,

segments.arabic: وَالْعَمَل بِهِ بَاطِنا وظاهرا وتنفيذه والدعوة إِلَيْهِ بِحَسب الْإِمْكَان
segments.english: and acting upon it inwardly and outwardly, and carrying it out, and calling to it according to [one's] ability.

segments.arabic: وكماله فِي الْحبّ فِي الله والبغض فِي الله وَالعطَاء لله وَالْمَنْع لله
segments.english: And its perfection [is] in loving for [the sake of] God, and hating for [the sake of] God, and giving for [the sake of] God, and withholding for [the sake of] God,

segments.arabic: وَأَن يكون الله وَحده إلهه ومعبوده
segments.english: and that God alone [is] his deity and [the one] worshipped.

segments.arabic: وَالطَّرِيق إِلَيْهِ تَجْرِيد مُتَابعَة رَسُوله ظَاهرا وَبَاطنا
segments.english: And the path to Him [is] purely following His Messenger, outwardly and inwardly,

segments.arabic: وتغميض عين الْقلب عَن الِالْتِفَات إِلَى سوى الله وَرَسُوله
segments.english: and closing the eye of the heart from turning to [anything] other than God and His Messenger.

segments.arabic: وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And with God [is] success.

segments.arabic: من اشْتغل بِاللَّه عَن نَفسه كفاء الله مؤونة نَفسه
segments.english: Whoever [is] occupied with God [instead] of himself, God [will] spare him the burden of himself.

segments.arabic: وَمن اشْتغل بِاللَّه عَن النَّاس كَفاهُ الله مؤونة النَّاس
segments.english: And whoever [is] occupied with God [instead] of people, God [will] spare him the burden of people.

segments.arabic: وَمن اشْتغل بِنَفسِهِ عَن الله وَكله الله إِلَى نَفسه
segments.english: And whoever [is] occupied with himself [instead] of God, God [will] leave him to himself.

segments.arabic: وَمن اشْتغل بِالنَّاسِ عَن الله وَكله الله إِلَيْهِم
segments.english: And whoever [is] occupied with people [instead] of God, God [will] leave him to them.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا يجد الْمَشَقَّة فِي ترك المألوفات والعوائد من تَركهَا لغير الله
segments.english: Only the one who leaves them for other than God finds difficulty in leaving habits and customs.

segments.arabic: فَأَما من تَركهَا صَادِقا مخلصا من قلبه لله
segments.english: As for whoever leaves them truthfully, sincerely from his heart for God,

segments.arabic: فانه لَا يجد فِي تَركهَا مشقة إِلَّا فِي أول وهلة
segments.english: then he does not find difficulty in leaving them except at the first moment,

segments.arabic: ليمتحن أصادق هُوَ فِي تَركهَا أم كَاذِب
segments.english: so that [it may be] tested — [is] he truthful in leaving them or [is he] lying?

segments.arabic: فان صَبر على تِلْكَ الْمَشَقَّة قَلِيلا استحالت لَذَّة
segments.english: And if he [is] patient with that difficulty [for] a little [while], it turns into pleasure.

segments.arabic: قَالَ ابْن سِيرِين سَمِعت شريحا يحلف بِاللَّه مَا ترك عبد لله شَيْئا فَوجدَ فَقده
segments.english: Ibn Sirin said: I heard Shuraih swearing by God [that] no servant leaves something for God and then finds [the pain of] its loss.

segments.arabic: وَقَوْلهمْ من ترك لله شَيْئا عوضه الله خيرا مِنْهُ حق
segments.english: And their saying, 'Whoever leaves something for God, God [will] replace [it] for him [with something] better than it,' [is] true.

segments.arabic: والعوض أَنْوَاع مُخْتَلفَة
segments.english: And the replacement [is of] different types.

segments.arabic: وأجلّ مَا يعوض بِهِ الْأنس بِاللَّه ومحبته وطمأنينة الْقلب بِهِ
segments.english: And the greatest [thing] one [is] replaced with [is] closeness to God, love of Him, and tranquility of the heart with Him,

segments.arabic: وقوته ونشاطه وفرحه وَرضَاهُ عَن ربه تَعَالَى
segments.english: and its strength, and energy, and joy, and contentment with his Lord, Most High.

segments.arabic: أغبى النَّاس من ضل فِي آخر سَفَره وَقد قَارب الْمنزل
segments.english: The most foolish of people [is] whoever goes astray at the end of his journey, having nearly reached the destination.

segments.arabic: الْعُقُول المؤيدة
segments.english: The Supported Minds

headings.arabic: فصل للأخلاق حد مَتى جاوزته صَارَت عُدْوانًا وَمَتى قصّرت عَنهُ كَانَ نقصا ومهانة
headings.english: Section: Character traits have [a] limit — when [one] goes beyond it, [they] become aggression, and when [one] falls short of it, [it] becomes deficiency and disgrace

segments.arabic: وأحواله وتخبطت عَلَيْهِ وَلم يهتد إِلَى الصِّرَاط الْمُسْتَقيم الْموصل لَهُ إِلَى الله
segments.english: and his states, and [they] became confused upon him, and he [was] not guided to the straight path that leads him to God.

segments.arabic: فإيصال العَبْد بتحقيق هَاتين المعرفتين علما وَحَالا وانقطاعه بفواتهما
segments.english: So the servant's connection [is] through realizing these two types of knowledge — in learning and in state — and his disconnection [is] through missing them.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا معنى قَوْلهم من عرف نَفسه عرف ربه
segments.english: And this [is] the meaning of their saying: 'Whoever knew himself knew his Lord.'

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ من عرف نَفسه بِالْجَهْلِ وَالظُّلم وَالْعَيْب والنقائص وَالْحَاجة والفقر والذل والمسكنة والعدم
segments.english: For whoever knew himself [to be characterized] by ignorance, wrongdoing, flaw, deficiencies, need, poverty, lowliness, helplessness, and nothingness —

segments.arabic: عرف ربه بضد ذَلِك
segments.english: knew his Lord by the opposite of that.

segments.arabic: فَوقف بِنَفسِهِ عِنْد قدرهَا وَلم يَتَعَدَّ بهَا طورها
segments.english: So he kept himself at its proper place and did not go beyond its limit.

segments.arabic: وَأثْنى على ربه بِبَعْض مَا هُوَ أَهله
segments.english: And he praised his Lord with some of what He [is] worthy of.

segments.arabic: وانصرفت قُوَّة حبه وخشيته ورجائه وإنابته وتوكله إِلَيْهِ وَحده
segments.english: And the strength of his love, fear, hope, turning back, and reliance [on God] turned to Him alone.

segments.arabic: وَكَانَ أحب شَيْء إِلَيْهِ وأخوف شَيْء عِنْده وأرجاه لَهُ
segments.english: And He was the most beloved thing to him, the most feared thing to him, and the most hoped for by him.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا هُوَ حَقِيقَة الْعُبُودِيَّة وَالله الْمُسْتَعَان
segments.english: And this — it [is] the reality of servitude, and God [is] the One whose help [is] sought.

segments.arabic: ويحكى أَن بعض الْحُكَمَاء كتب على بَاب بَيته
segments.english: And it [is] told that one of the wise men wrote on the door of his house:

segments.arabic: انه لن ينْتَفع بحكمتنا إِلَّا من عرف نَفسه ووقف بهَا عِنْد قدرهَا
segments.english: 'No one will benefit from our wisdom except whoever knew himself and kept it at its proper place.

segments.arabic: فَمن كَانَ كَذَلِك فَلْيدْخلْ وَإِلَّا فَليرْجع حَتَّى يكون بِهَذِهِ الصّفة
segments.english: So whoever [is] like that, let him enter; otherwise, let him go back until he has this quality.'

segments.arabic: فصل الصَّبْر عَن الشَّهْوَة أسهل من الصَّبْر على مَا توجبه الشَّهْوَة
segments.english: Section: Patience [in staying] away from desire [is] easier than patience over what desire brings about.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهَا إِمَّا إِن توجب ألما وعقوبة
segments.english: For it either brings about pain and punishment,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تقطع لَذَّة أكمل مِنْهَا
segments.english: or it cuts off [a] pleasure more complete than it,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تضيع وقتا إضاعته حسرة وندامة
segments.english: or it wastes [a] time whose wasting [is] regret and remorse,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تثلم عرضا توفيره أَنْفَع للْعَبد من ثلمه
segments.english: or it damages [a] reputation whose protection [is] more beneficial for the servant than its damage,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تذْهب مَالا بَقَاؤُهُ خير لَهُ من ذَهَابه
segments.english: or it wastes wealth whose remaining [is] better for him than its going,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تضع قدرا وجاها قِيَامه خير من وَضعه
segments.english: or it lowers [a] status and standing whose upholding [is] better than its lowering,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تسلب نعْمَة بَقَاؤُهَا ألذ وَأطيب من قَضَاء الشَّهْوَة
segments.english: or it takes away [a] blessing whose remaining [is] sweeter and better than fulfilling the desire,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تطرق لوضيع إِلَيْك طَرِيقا لم يكن يجدهَا قبل ذَلِك
segments.english: or it opens up for [a] lowly person [a] way to you that he could not find before that,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تجلب هما وغما وحزنا وخوفا لَا يُقَارب لَذَّة الشَّهْوَة
segments.english: or it brings worry, distress, sadness, and fear that does not come close to the pleasure of the desire,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تنسي علما ذكره ألذ من نيل الشَّهْوَة
segments.english: or it makes [you] forget knowledge whose remembrance [is] sweeter than obtaining the desire,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تشمت عدوا وتحزن وليا
segments.english: or it makes [an] enemy gloat and makes [a] friend grieve,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تقطع الطَّرِيق على نعْمَة مقبلة
segments.english: or it cuts off the path for [a] blessing [that was] coming,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَّا أَن تحدث عَيْبا يبْقى صفة لَا تَزُول
segments.english: or it creates [a] flaw that remains [as a] quality that does not go away.

segments.arabic: فَإِن الْأَعْمَال تورث الصِّفَات والأخلاق
segments.english: For actions give rise to qualities and character traits.

segments.arabic: فصل للأخلاق حد مَتى جاوزته صَارَت عُدْوانًا وَمَتى قصّرت عَنهُ كَانَ نقصا ومهانة
segments.english: Section: Character traits have [a] limit — when [one] goes beyond it, [they] become aggression, and when [one] falls short of it, [it] becomes deficiency and disgrace.

headings.arabic: فصل
headings.english: Section

segments.arabic: الحقيرة والخسيسة بالضد من ذَلِك
segments.english: the lowly and base [ones are] the opposite of that.

segments.arabic: فَكل نفس تميل إِلَى مَا يُنَاسِبهَا ويشاكلها
segments.english: So every soul inclines toward what suits it and resembles it.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا معنى قَوْله تَعَالَى
segments.english: And this [is] the meaning of [God] Most High's saying:

segments.arabic: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَى شَاكِلَتِهِ
segments.english: Say: each acts according to his nature.
segments.sahih_international: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."

segments.arabic: أَي على مَا يشاكله ويناسبه
segments.english: meaning, according to what resembles him and suits him.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ يعْمل على طَرِيقَته الَّتِي تناسب أخلاقه وطبيعته
segments.english: So he acts along his way that suits his character and nature.

segments.arabic: وكل إِنْسَان يجْرِي على طَرِيقَته ومذهبه وعادته الَّتِي ألفها وجبل عَلَيْهَا
segments.english: And every person runs along his way, his path, and his habit that he grew used to and was shaped upon.

segments.arabic: فالفاجر يعْمل بِمَا يشبه طَرِيقَته من مُقَابلَة النعم بِالْمَعَاصِي والإعراض عَن النعم
segments.english: So the sinful one acts according to what resembles his way — of meeting blessings with sins and turning away from blessings.

segments.arabic: وَالْمُؤمن يعْمل بِمَا يشاكله من شكر النعم ومحبته وَالثنَاء عَلَيْهِ
segments.english: And the believer acts according to what resembles him — of thankfulness for blessings, loving Him, and praising Him.

segments.arabic: والتودد إِلَيْهِ وَالْحيَاء مِنْهُ والمراقبة لَهُ وتعظيمه وإجلاله
segments.english: and showing affection toward Him, feeling shy before Him, being watchful of Him, honoring Him, and revering Him.

segments.arabic: من لم يعرف نَفسه كَيفَ يعرف خالقه
segments.english: Whoever does not know himself — how [can] he know his Creator?

segments.arabic: فَاعْلَم أَن الله تَعَالَى خلق فِي صدرك بَيْتا وَهُوَ الْقلب
segments.english: So know that God Most High created in your chest [a] house, and it [is] the heart.

segments.arabic: وَوضع فِي صَدره عرشا لمعرفته يَسْتَوِي عَلَيْهِ الْمثل الْأَعْلَى
segments.english: And He placed in its center [a] throne for knowing Him, upon which the highest description rises.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ مستو على عَرْشه بِذَاتِهِ بَائِن من خلقه
segments.english: So He [is] risen over His Throne by His essence, separate from His creation.

segments.arabic: والمثل الْأَعْلَى من مَعْرفَته ومحبته وتوحيده مستو على سَرِير الْقلب
segments.english: And the highest description — of knowing Him, loving Him, and monotheism — [is] risen upon the seat of the heart.

segments.arabic: وعَلى السرير بِسَاط من الرِّضَا
segments.english: And upon the seat [is] a carpet of contentment.

segments.arabic: وَوضع عَن يَمِينه وشماله مرافق شرائعه وأوامره
segments.english: And He placed on its right and left the supports of His laws and commands.

segments.arabic: وَفتح إِلَيْهِ بَابا من جنَّة رَحمته والأنس بِهِ والشوق إِلَى لِقَائِه
segments.english: And He opened toward it [a] door from the garden of His mercy, intimacy with Him, and longing to meet Him.

segments.arabic: وأمطره من وابل كَلَامه مَا أنبت فِيهِ أَصْنَاف الرياحين وَالْأَشْجَار المثمرة
segments.english: And He rained upon it from the downpour of His speech what grew in it [all] kinds of fragrant plants and fruit-bearing trees.

segments.arabic: من أَنْوَاع الطَّاعَات والتهليل وَالتَّسْبِيح والتحميد وَالتَّقْدِيس
segments.english: of types of obedience — declaring God's oneness, glorification, praise, and sanctification.

segments.arabic: وَجعل فِي وسط الْبُسْتَان شَجَرَة معرفَة
segments.english: And He placed in the middle of the garden [a] tree of knowledge.

segments.arabic: فَهِيَ تُؤْتِي أكلهَا كل حِين بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا
segments.english: And it gives its fruit every season by the permission of its Lord.

segments.arabic: من الْمحبَّة والإنابة والخشية والفرح بِهِ والابتهاج بِقُرْبِهِ
segments.english: of love, turning [to God], awe, joy in Him, and delight in His closeness.

segments.arabic: وأجرى إِلَى تِلْكَ الشَّجَرَة مَا يسقيها من تَدْبِير كَلَامه وفهمه وَالْعَمَل بوصاياه
segments.english: And He made to flow toward that tree what waters it — of reflecting on His speech, understanding it, and acting upon His instructions.

segments.arabic: وعلّق فِي ذَلِك الْبَيْت قِنْدِيلًا أسرجه بضياء مَعْرفَته وَالْإِيمَان بِهِ وتوحيده
segments.english: And He hung in that house [a] lamp, [which] He lit with the light of knowing Him, faith in Him, and monotheism.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ يستمد من شَجَرَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِيءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تمسسه نَار
segments.english: So it draws from [a] blessed tree — an olive — neither eastern nor western, whose oil nearly glows even if no fire touched it.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أحَاط عَلَيْهِ حَائِطا يمنعهُ من دُخُول الْآفَات والمفسدين وَمن يُؤْذِي الْبُسْتَان فَلَا يلْحقهُ إِذا هم
segments.english: Then He surrounded it with [a] wall preventing the entry of harms, corrupters, and whoever [would] hurt the garden — so their harm does not reach it.

segments.arabic: وَأقَام عَلَيْهِ حرسا من الْمَلَائِكَة يَحْفَظُونَهُ فِي يقظته ومنامه
segments.english: And He stationed over it guards from the angels who protect him in his wakefulness and sleep.

segments.arabic: ثمَّ أعلم صَاحب الْبَيْت والبستان بالساكن فِيهِ
segments.english: Then He informed the owner of the house and garden about the one dwelling in it.

segments.arabic: فَهُوَ دَائِما همه إصْلَاح السكن وَلم شعثه ليرضاه السَّاكِن منزلا
segments.english: So his constant concern [is] fixing the dwelling and mending its disrepair, so the dweller [is] pleased with it [as] [a] home.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا أحس بِأَدْنَى شعث فِي السكن
segments.english: And whenever he senses the slightest disrepair in the dwelling

headings.arabic: فَائِدَة
headings.english: A Benefit

headings.arabic: فائدة عند العارفين أن الاشتغال بالمشاهدة عن البر في السير في السر
headings.english: A Benefit: According to the knowers, being occupied with contemplation at the expense of righteous [action] in the journey in the inner [realm]

segments.arabic: فنقصان بدنه ودنياه ولذته وجاهه ورئاسته
segments.english: So the decrease of his body, his worldly [life], his pleasure, his status, and his leadership —

segments.arabic: إِن زَاد فِي حُصُول ذَلِك وتوفيره عَلَيْهِ فِي معاده كَانَ رَحْمَة بِهِ وَخيرا لَهُ
segments.english: if it increased the gaining of that and its preservation for him in his Return, [then] it was [a] mercy for him and [a] good for him.

segments.arabic: وَإِلَّا كَانَ حرمانا وعقوبة على ذنُوب ظَاهِرَة أَو باطنة
segments.english: And otherwise, it was [a] deprivation and [a] punishment for sins — outward or inward —

segments.arabic: أَو ترك وَاجِب ظَاهر أَو بَاطِن
segments.english: or [the] leaving of [an] obligation — outward or inward.

segments.arabic: فَإِن حرمَان خير الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَة مرتّب على هَذِه الْأَرْبَعَة
segments.english: For the deprivation of the good of this world and the Hereafter [is] based on these four.

segments.arabic: وَبِاللَّهِ التَّوْفِيق
segments.english: And with God [is] success.

segments.arabic: النَّاس مُنْذُ خلقُوا لم يزَالُوا مسافرين
segments.english: People, since they were created, have not ceased [to be] travelers.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ لَهُم حط عَن رحالهم إِلَّا فِي الْجنَّة أَو النَّار
segments.english: And there [is] no setting down of their baggage except in Paradise or the Fire.

segments.arabic: والعاقل يعلم أَن السّفر مَبْنِيّ على المشقّة وركوب الأخطار
segments.english: And the wise [person] knows that travel [is] built upon hardship and facing dangers.

segments.arabic: وَمن الْمحَال عَادَة أَن يطْلب فِيهِ نعيم ولذّة وراحة
segments.english: And it [is] normally impossible to seek in it comfort, pleasure, and rest.

segments.arabic: إِنَّمَا ذَلِك بعد انْتِهَاء السّفر
segments.english: That [is] only after the end of the journey.

segments.arabic: وَمن الْمَعْلُوم أَن كل وَطْأَة قدم أَو كل آن من آنات السّفر غير واقفة وَلَا الْمُكَلف وَاقِف
segments.english: And it [is] known that every footstep, or every moment of the moments of the journey, [is] not standing still — nor [is] the responsible [person] standing still.

segments.arabic: وَقد ثَبت أَنه مُسَافر على الْحَال الَّتِي يجب أَن يكون الْمُسَافِر عَلَيْهَا من تهيئة الزَّاد الْموصل
segments.english: And it [has been] established that he [is a] traveler, in the state that the traveler must be in — of preparing the provisions that deliver [him].

segments.arabic: وَإِذا نزل أَو نَام أَو استراح فعلى قدم الاستعداد للسير
segments.english: And when he stops, or sleeps, or rests, [it is] upon [the] readiness to continue the journey.

segments.arabic: أَن الِاشْتِغَال بِالْمُشَاهَدَةِ عَن الْبر فِي السّير فِي السِّرّ وقُوف
segments.english: that being occupied with contemplation at the expense of righteous [action] in the journey in the inner [realm] [is a] standstill.

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ فِي زمن الْمُشَاهدَة لَو كَانَ صَاحب عمل ظَاهر أَو بَاطِن أَو ازدياد من معرفَة وإيمان مفصّل كَانَ أولى بِهِ
segments.english: Because during the time of contemplation, if he were [a] person of outward or inward action, or of increase in knowledge and detailed faith, that would be better for him.

segments.arabic: فَإِن اللطيفة الإنسانية تحْشر على صُورَة عَملهَا ومعرفتها وهمّتها وإرادتها
segments.english: For the human spirit [is] gathered on the form of its action, its knowledge, its resolve, and its will.

segments.arabic: وَالْبدن يحْشر على صُورَة عمله الْحسن أَو الْقَبِيح
segments.english: And the body [is] gathered on the form of its action — good or ugly.

segments.arabic: وَإِذا انْتَقَلت من هَذِه الدَّار شاهدت حَقِيقَة ذَلِك
segments.english: And when it departs from this abode, it witnesses the reality of that.

segments.arabic: وعَلى قدر قرب قَلْبك من الله تبعد من الْأنس بِالنَّاسِ ومساكنتهم
segments.english: And to the degree of your heart's closeness to God, you distance [yourself] from comfort with people and dwelling with them.

segments.arabic: وعَلى قدر صيانتك لسرّك وإرادتك يكون حفظه
segments.english: And to the degree of your guarding of your inner secret and your will, [will be] its protection.

segments.arabic: وملاك ذَلِك صِحَة التَّوْحِيد
segments.english: And the foundation of that [is the] soundness of monotheism,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ صحّة الْعلم بِالطَّرِيقِ
segments.english: then [the] soundness of knowledge of the path,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ صِحَة الْإِرَادَة
segments.english: then [the] soundness of the will,

segments.arabic: ثمَّ صِحَة الْعَمَل والحذر
segments.english: then [the] soundness of action and caution.
